requests the government to refrain from this, and proceeds to the agenda.

Amendement van het lid Tony van Dijck dat regelt dat de uitzondering op het bonusplafond van 20% voor personen die binnen Nederland werken wordt geschrapt

Motie van het lid Tony van Dijck over afzien van de automatische inflatiecorrectie voor benzine, lpg en diesel

to refrain from the automatic inflation correction from 1 January 2015 on petrol, diesel and LPG
af te zien van de automatische inflatiecorrectie per 1 januari 2015 op benzine, diesel en lpg
Motie van het lid Tony van Dijck over compensatie aan pompstationhouders in de grensstreek voor geleden omzetderving

requests the government to compensate all fuel station operators in the border region for lost turnover
verzoekt de regering, alle pompstationhouders in de grensstreek te compenseren voor de geleden omzetderving
Motie van het lid Tony van Dijck over per direct terugdraaien van de accijnsverhoging op lpg en diesel
Asks the government to immediately reverse the excise duty increases on LPG and diesel.
requests the government to immediately reverse the excise increases on LPG and diesel
verzoekt de regering, per direct de accijnsverhogingen op lpg en diesel terug te draaien
Motie van het lid Tony van Dijck over afzien van verdere accijnsverhoging op tabak
Asks the government to refrain from a further excise duty increase on tobacco from 1 January 2015.
requests the government to refrain from a further excise increase on tobacco per 1 January 2015
verzoekt de regering, af te zien van een verdere accijnsverhoging op tabak per 1 januari 2015
Motie van de leden Tony Van Dijck en Wilders over het verlagen van de accijnsverhogingen tot ten minste 1% onder de accijnstarieven van de ons omringende landen
Asks the government to reverse excise increases on LPG, diesel and alcohol and set rates at least 1% below neighbouring countries.
requests the government to immediately reverse the excise increases on LPG, diesel and alcohol
verzoekt de regering, per direct de accijnsverhogingen op lpg, diesel en alcohol terug te draaien
Motie van de leden Tony Van Dijck en Wilders over compensatie voor alle pompstationhouders in de grensstreek
Motion asking the government to compensate all petrol station owners in the border region for lost diesel and LPG sales caused by the excise measure.
requests the government to compensate all petrol station owners in the border region for lost turnover
verzoekt de regering, alle pompstationhouders in de grensstreek te compenseren voor de omzetderving
Amendement van het lid Tony van Dijck over het verhogen van de opbrengst van de resolutieheffing
Raises the 2014 resolution levy rate so that it yields about 3.7 billion euros, shifting the cost of the SNS nationalisation onto the financial sector.
This raises the yield of the 2014 resolution levy to 3.7 billion euros
Hiermee wordt de opbrengst van de resolutieheffing 2014 verhoogd naar € 3,7 miljard
Motie van het lid Tony Van Dijck over advies van de Raad van State
Asks the government to seek advice from the Raad van State on the annual release of DNB profits and to take no irreversible steps meanwhile.
to seek advice from the Raad van State and until then take no irreversible steps
advies te vragen bij de Raad van State en tot die tijd geen onomkeerbare stappen te nemen
Motie van het lid Tony Van Dijck over de algemene reserves van DNB
Asks the government to ensure DNB's general reserves and capital are used before the state guarantee can be invoked in a crisis-related risk.
requests the government to ensure that DNB's general reserves are tapped before the state guarantee can be invoked
verzoekt de regering, ervoor te zorgen dat eerst de algemene reserves van de DNB worden aangesproken alvorens de staatsgarantie kan worden ingeroepen
Motie van het lid Ouwehand c.s. over een besluit over ratificatie pas na de verkiezingen van 12 september 2012
Asks that a decision on ratifying the European Stability Mechanism be taken only after the September 2012 elections by the newly elected House.
a decision on possible ratification of the ESM can only be taken after the elections of 12 September 2012
een besluit over eventuele ratificatie van het ESM pas na de verkiezingen van 12 september 2012 kan worden genomen
Amendement van het lid Tony van Dijck over het terugdraaien van de garantieverplichting
Reduces the budget commitment amount for international financial relations by reversing an earlier guarantee obligation increase.
With this amendment the submitter reverses the increase in the guarantee obligation included in the bill via the amendment note.
Met dit amendement draait de indiener de verhoging van de garantieverplichting, die in het wetsvoorstel is opgenomen met de nota van wijziging
Amendement van het lid Harbers c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 3 inzake het structureel in de begroting verwerken van de door de Kamer ontvangen loonbijstelling voor 2010
Structurally adds the 2010 wage-indexation allowance to the budget of the States General (parliament), placing it on the same footing as the other colleges of state.
There is no rationale for treating the States General differently in this respect from the other colleges of state.
Er is geen ratio om de Staten-Generaal in deze anders te behandelen dan de overige colleges van Staat.
Amendement van het lid Harbers c.s. inzake het structureel in de begroting verwerken van de door de Kamer ontvangen loonbijstelling 2010
Amendment adding structural wage adjustment for the States General in the budget, equal to other high state colleges, bringing parliament's own budget in line with the cabinet's.
This amendment aims to also incorporate structurally in the budget the 2010 wage adjustment that the House of Representatives received.
Dit amendement beoogt de loonbijstelling 2010 die de Tweede Kamer heeft ontvangen ook structureel in de begroting te verwerken.
Amendement van het lid Irrgang c.s. strekkende tot het ongedaan maken van de verwijdering van de bepalingen van het amendement Tang en Irrgang
Removes subsection a of article I.1 of the bill so that an earlier amendment on BV company law stays in the bill.
In article I.1, part A, subsection a is deleted.
In artikel I.1, onderdeel A, komt subonderdeel a te vervallen.
Motie Bosma en Tony van Dijck over afzien van verhoging van de AOW-leeftijd
Asks the government to abandon raising the AOW pension age to 67, citing weak support and critical advice from the Raad van State and CPB.
requests the government to refrain from raising the AOW age to 67
verzoekt de regering af te zien van de verhoging van de AOW-leeftijd naar 67 jaar
Motie-Van Dijck over halveren van de overdrachtsbelasting voor woningen
Asks the government to halve the transfer tax on homes, funded from the PVV counter-budget.
requests the government to halve the transfer tax for homes
verzoekt de regering de overdrachtsbelasting voor woningen te halveren
Motie-Van Dijck over verlagen met 3% van de tweede schijf loon- en inkomstenbelasting
Motion asking the government to cut the second income tax bracket by 3% with coverage from the PVV counter-budget.
requests the government to lower the second bracket of wage and income tax by 3%
verzoekt de regering de tweede schijf loon- en inkomstenheffing met 3% te verlagen
Motie-Van Dijck over begin 2010 deblokkeren van het spaarloon
Asks the government to unblock about 4 billion euros of savings-linked wage money at the start of 2010 so citizens can use it.
requests the government to unblock this savings-linked wage at the start of 2010
verzoekt de regering dit spaarloon begin van 2010 te deblokkeren
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Tony van Dijck ter vervanging van dat gedrukt onder nr. 50 over een uitstelregeling bij de verkrijging van de blote eigendom van een eigen woning
Lets the minister set by ministerial regulation the rules for deferring inheritance tax on bare ownership of a home, which widens ministerial discretion.
By ministerial regulation, rules are set on granting deferral of payment
Bij ministeriële regeling worden regels gesteld met betrekking tot het verlenen van uitstel van betaling
Amendement van het lid Tony Van Dijck over een uitstelregeling bij de verkrijging van de blote eigendom van een eigen woning
Proposes a tax payment deferral scheme, under ministerial rules, for inheritance tax on bare ownership of a home where the surviving spouse holds usufruct.
By ministerial regulation rules are set for granting deferral of payment
Bij ministeriële regeling worden regels gesteld met betrekking tot het verlenen van uitstel van betaling
Amendement van het lid Omtzigt c.s. over de inwerkingtreding van het wtsvoorstel bij koninklijk besluit
Makes entry into force of the VAT bill subject to a royal decree, which may only be proposed two weeks after the bill is submitted and is blocked if either chamber objects.
If either chamber of the States General decides not to agree with the draft, no proposal is made
Indien een der kamers der Staten-Generaal besluit niet in te stemmen met het ontwerp, wordt er geen voordracht gedaan
Motie Tony van Dijck over een terughoudend gebruik van obligo swaps
Asks the government to use obligo swaps for export credit insurance only very sparingly and to inform the Kamer first.
requests the government to use the possibility of obligo swaps only very sparingly for expanding the EKV facility and to inform the Kamer about this first
verzoekt de regering de mogelijkheid van obligoswaps slechts zeer terughoudend te gebruiken voor de uitbreiding van de EKV-faciliteit en de Kamer hierover eerst te informeren
Motie Tony van Dijck over behoud van het risicomanagement van de exportkredietverzekering bij DNB
Asks the government to keep risk management of export credit insurance at De Nederlandsche Bank rather than transferring it to the Ministry of Finance.
requests the government to keep risk management of export credit insurance at De Nederlandsche Bank
verzoekt de regering het risicomanagement van de exportkredietverzekering bij De Nederlandsche Bank te behouden
Motie Van Dijck over terugdraaien van het besluit om de ontslagvergoeding te versoberen
Asks the government to reverse the decision to cut dismissal compensation and restore the previous level.
requests the government to reverse the decision to reduce the dismissal compensation
verzoekt de regering het besluit om de ontslagvergoeding te versoberen terug te draaien
Motie Van Dijck over tegenhouden van de vrije toelating van Roemenen en Bulgaren op de arbeidsmarkt
Asks the government to block free labour market access for Romanians and Bulgarians for at least three more years.
requests the government to hold back free admission of Romanians and Bulgarians to the labour market for at least three years
verzoekt de regering de vrije toelating van Roemenen en Bulgaren op de arbeidsmarkt nog voor minimaal drie jaar tegen te houden
Motie Tony Van Dijck over verruimen van de vrijwilligersvergoeding voor werkzaamheden in de zorg
Asks the government to propose widening the volunteer allowance for care work for welfare recipients far from the labour market.
requests the government to come with proposals to widen the volunteer allowance for care work
verzoekt de regering met voorstellen te komen om de vrijwilligersvergoeding voor werkzaamheden in de zorg
Motie Van Dijck over terugdraaien van de openstelling van de arbeidsmarkt voor Polen
Asks the government to reverse opening the labour market to Polish workers because of immigration numbers and social problems.
requests the government to reverse the opening of the labour market for Poland
verzoekt de regering de openstelling van de arbeidsmarkt voor Polen terug te draaien
Motie Tony van Dijck over verlaging van het belastingtarief van de tweede schijf
Asks the government to cut the second income tax bracket rate by 4% for all citizens, covered by the PVV counter-budget.
requests the government to lower the second bracket rate by 4% for all citizens
verzoekt de regering om het tarief in de tweede schijf te verlagen met 4% voor alle burgers
Motie Graus en Tony van Dijck over verlaging van belastingen en administratieve lasten
Asks the government to cut taxes and reduce administrative burdens so citizens and firms can spend more and speed up economic recovery.
requests the government to lower taxes and reduce administrative burdens
verzoekt de regering de belastingen te verlagen en de administratieve lasten te verlichten
Motie Sap c.s. over duidelijkheid over het aantal langdurig uitkeringsgerechtigden en herintreedsters dat extra aan een baan geholpen wordt
Asks the government to inform the House before the budget debate on results and on its ambition for long-term unemployed and returners placed in jobs.
requests the government to inform the House before the budget debate about the results achieved
verzoekt de regering voor de behandeling van de begroting van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid de Kamer te informeren over de bereikte resultaten
Amendement van de leden Weekers en van Dijck over een drempelvrijstelling
Amendment adding a threshold exemption of 5,000 euro for small employee equity stakes under the excessive remuneration tax rules.
the employment-related lucrative interest whose benefits in total do not exceed 5,000 euro is excluded
wordt uitgesloten het met een werkzaamheid verband houdende lucratieve belang waarvan de voordelen in totaal niet meer bedragen dan € 5 000
Amendement van de leden Van Dijck en Weekers over carried interest-regelingen bij private equity organisaties
Removes the carried-interest tax provisions from this excessive-remuneration tax bill and asks for a separate law with a clearly defined group.
The proposed tax measure in this bill on carried interest is far too broadly worded
De voorgestelde fiscale maatregel in dit wetsvoorstel ten aanzien van carried interest is veel te ruim geformuleerd
Amendement van de leden Weekers en van Dijck over het nader invullen van de definitie 'lucratief belang'
Narrows the definition of 'lucratief belang' in the excessive remuneration tax rules by objectifying it and clarifying the catch-all provision, to increase legal certainty for taxpayers.
by further specifying the definition of 'lucratief belang', to increase legal certainty for taxpayers
door de definitie «lucratief belang» nader in te vullen. Dit om de rechtszekerheid voor belastingplichtigen te vergroten
Motie-Tony van Dijck over het opnemen van een gedragscode in de corporate governance code
Asks the government to add to the corporate governance code a rule that executive bonuses may not exceed gross annual salary.
requests the government to include in the corporate governance code a code of conduct whereby the bonus paid may not exceed the employee's gross annual income.
verzoekt de regering om in de corporate governance code een gedragscode op te nemen waarbij de uitgekeerde bonus het bruto jaarinkomen van de werknemer niet mag overschrijden
Amendement van de leden Weekers en van Dijck dat bewerkstelligt dat de latente aanmerkelijk belang claim op een lucratief belang heffing niet ongedaan wordt gemaakt middels de step-up
Removes retroactive effect of the tax on latent substantial-interest claims by excluding it from the step-up rule, setting a 13 May 2008 reference date.
The addition to the fifth paragraph ensures that the latent substantial-interest claim on a lucrative interest levy is not undone through the step-up.
De toevoeging aan het vijfde lid bewerkstelligt dat de latente aanmerkelijk belang claim op een lucratief belang heffing niet ongedaan wordt gemaakt middels de step-up.
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tony van Dijck over het bericht dat bijna een kwart van het personeel weg moet bij ABN AMRO

PVV MP Tony van Dijck asked the Finance Minister about ABN AMRO's plan to cut about a quarter of staff, the reasons for it, the NIBC takeover, possible effects on state dividends, and the timing of further share sales. The minister said the state had no influence on the strategy or the NIBC deal, that it is for the bank to disclose such information, and that the remaining stake sale is ongoing without disclosing timing or size.
I can therefore only inform your House afterwards, based on the information the company has already provided.
Ik kan uw Kamer daardoor alleen achteraf informeren op basis van de informatie die de vennootschap al heeft verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Tony van Dijck over het verlagen van de NHG-premie

MPs Madlener and Tony van Dijck asked whether the NHG mortgage guarantee premium should be lowered, whether NHG's guarantee capital is larger than needed, and whether NHG should use its capital for wider social goals. The minister answered that the premium must stay low but sufficient to protect the state as backstop, that a large fund remains necessary, that a revised premium methodology will be applied for 2025, and that NHG will study a broader role in sustainability while protecting its core purpose.
After this elaboration, I want to arrive at an improved premium methodology that can be applied when calculating the premium for 2025.
Na deze uitwerking wil ik komen tot een verbeterde provisiemethodiek die kan worden toegepast bij de berekening van de premie voor 2025.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tony van Dijck over het bericht dat een onverwachte strop dreigt voor ABN AMRO als de staat haar aandelen verkoopt

Tony van Dijck (PVV) asked the Finance Minister whether reducing the state's ABN AMRO stake below 50 percent could force the bank to buy out insurer NN under a change-of-control clause, and why parliament was not informed earlier. Minister Kaag answered that NN will not invoke the clause now that the state stake is below 50 percent, so ABN AMRO suffers no loss, and that the bank, not the shareholder, is responsible for its contractual arrangements.
I informed your House on 25 September 2023 that the state's stake has indeed fallen below 50% and that I will inform the House further once the sales programme is fully completed.

Ik heb uw Kamer op 25 september 2023 geïnformeerd dat het staatsbelang daadwerkelijk onder de 50% gedaald is en dat ik de Tweede Kamer nader zal informeren wanneer het verkoopprogramma volledig is afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tony van Dijck over het bericht dat de staat miljoenen verdient dankzij de aandeleninkoop van ABN AMRO

An MP asks the Finance Minister about the state's gains from the ABN AMRO share buyback and whether savers and taxpayers should benefit more, and about banks' savings and mortgage rates and the total cost and revenue of the rescue. The minister defends participation in the buyback to avoid a relative increase in the state's stake, reports cost and revenue figures, and says further sell-off steps will be communicated to parliament.
As usual, I will inform the House (confidentially if necessary) when there are new developments.
Zoals gebruikelijk zal ik uw Kamer (indien nodig vertrouwelijk) informeren op het moment dat er nieuwe ontwikkelingen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tony van Dijck over het bericht dat er sinds begin deze eeuw 93 procent van de bankenkantoren is gesloten

An MP asks the Finance Minister about the closure of 93 percent of bank branches since 2000, whether customers' declining visits explain it, bank profits, the SME-failure warning, the motion for a national branch network, and the Accessible Payments Action Plan. The minister attributes closures mainly to digitalisation and declining demand for physical services, provides branch figures and profit data, says she lacks insight into SME failure causes, and notes ongoing talks with banks but declines to commit to a branch-count norm.
I consider it important that banks get to work promptly on implementing the stated intentions.
Ik vind het daarom belangrijk dat banken voortvarend aan de slag gaan met het uitvoeren van de uitgesproken intenties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tony van Dijck over de nevenfunctie van de Minister als GPMB-bestuurslid tijdens haar ministerschap

An MP asked whether Minister Kaag's board membership of the GPMB during her ministership was a side position that should have been declared under the Handbook for Ministers, and whether she had been transparent to parliament. The government answered that it was not a side position in the sense of the Handbook because it was carried out as part of her ministerial policy work, that parliament had been informed, and that the minister had no other side positions.
There has been no side position within the meaning of the Blue Book, Handbook for Ministers.
Er is geen sprake geweest van een nevenfunctie in de zin van het Blauwe Boek, Handboek voor Ministers.
Antwoord op vragen van Tony van Dijck over het bericht dat het kabinet de Duitse tak van Tennet wil verkopen

An MP asks the Finance Minister whether the cabinet wants to sell TenneT's German arm, the size of its capital need, investment and sale proceeds, the negotiation status, and whether Dutch taxpayers should bear foreign ventures of state holdings. The minister says talks with Germany are at an early stage with no irreversible steps, that a German stake is being explored, that sale proceeds cannot yet be disclosed, and that the state only injects capital into Dutch grid investments.
We will continue to inform your House about the scenarios now under consideration and the trade-offs involved (confidentially where necessary and publicly where possible).
Wij zullen uw Kamer blijven informeren over de nu voorliggende scenario's en de daarbij te maken afweging (vertrouwelijk waar nodig en publiek waar dat kan).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tony van Dijck over het bericht dat banken contant geld van bedrijven weren

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether banks are restricting cash transactions of businesses to curb money-laundering risks, and what should be done to keep cash a legal tender. The minister confirmed signals of banks asking clients to reduce cash use, promised clarifications to the anti-money-laundering guidance and an independent study on safeguarding the public interest in cash.
I agree with the position that cash is a legal tender and remains so.
Ik ben het eens met de stelling dat contant geld een wettig betaalmiddel is en blijft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tony van Dijck en Maeijer over de berichten dat Nederland miljarden minder ontvangt en meer mag betalen aan de EU

MPs Tony van Dijck and Maeijer asked whether Dutch receipts from the EU recovery fund (RRF) will fall and whether the Dutch EU contribution will rise through the Social Climate Fund and MFF revision, and whether the government will oppose higher contributions. The ministers answered that the RRF allocation will be finalised by the Commission by 30 June and the Dutch plan will then be fixed, provided tables of allocations and disbursements, and that the government is cautious about higher contributions but will assess the total package and aims for prudent EU budget development.
The cabinet is pursuing a prudent development of the EU budget, with more attention to policy areas that are a priority for the Netherlands.
Het kabinet zet in op een prudente ontwikkeling van de EU-begroting, met meer aandacht voor beleidsterreinen die voor Nederland prioritair zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord.

Eleven MPs asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, and the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen, 17 questions on the 2021 coalition agreement covering nitrogen targets, the transition fund, carbon credits, sustainable food, buyouts, legalisation of PAS cases and a possible consumer levy. The ministers largely answered by pointing to forthcoming analyses, planned provincial area plans and later decisions, with several answers promising to inform the House soon.
To determine the precise target achievement, an additional calculation is necessary, after further elaboration of the plans.
Om het precieze doelbereik te bepalen is een aanvullende doorrekening noodzakelijk, na verdere uitwerking van de plannen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

Eleven MPs from across the opposition and coalition asked the Minister of Justice and Security 25 factual questions about the coalition agreement, covering asylum and migration, police staffing, financing, cybersecurity, organized crime and the bar. The government answered many questions only partially, deferring details to later elaboration or a decision by the cabinet, and gave specific answers on police numbers, withdrawn bills, asylum spending and the reasons for expected higher asylum inflow.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and a decision by the cabinet. You will be informed about this as soon as possible.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover zo spoedig mogelijk geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parties asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Waterstaat factual questions about the coalition agreement, covering short-haul flight discouragement, flight numbers, investment splits, air quality, aviation tax revenue, road safety budgets and infrastructure maintenance. The minister answered most questions in general terms, deferring several figures and allocations to later cabinet decisions or reports.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and decision-making by the cabinet. You will be informed about this as soon as possible.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover zo spoedig mogelijk geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from eleven parties asked the government dozens of factual questions about the 2021 coalition agreement's climate, energy, and biomass plans, including Ternaard gas drilling, CCS, nuclear, and the Westerschelde tunnel toll. The minister answered only a handful on substance and deferred most questions to later cabinet decisions.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and decision-making by the cabinet. You will be informed about this as soon as possible.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover zo spoedig mogelijk geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from eleven parties asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the 2021 coalition agreement, covering minimum wage, childcare subsidy, rent allowance, the AOW gap, child poverty targets, institutional racism and the Rainbow Accord. The government answered most questions substantively but deferred many details (funding, targets, the Rainbow Accord) to later elaboration by the cabinet.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and a cabinet decision. You will be informed about this during the further elaboration.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover bij de nadere uitwerking geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parties asked the foreign minister, in written questions, about the coalition agreement, covering EU budget and enlargement, ODA targets, asylum spending, migration partnerships, Middle East resolutions, and transparency. The ministers answered most questions in substance, pointing to existing reports and promising further studies and letters, with few concrete commitments.
The cabinet will inform your House about this in more detail with a BNC fiche.
Het kabinet zal uw Kamer hierover met een BNC-fiche nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

Eleven MPs asked the Finance Minister about the coalition agreement, covering the budget, tax burden, fiscal rules, the RRF recovery plan, and wealth inequality. The minister answered most questions in detail, citing indicative figures, and deferred several items (inflation effects, purchasing-power tables, the sugar tax, asset-tax reform) to the Spring Memorandum and later analyses.
The cabinet is examining the options for eventually lowering VAT on fruit and vegetables to 0% and introducing a sugar tax.
Het kabinet beziet de mogelijkheden voor het op termijn verlagen van de btw op groente en fruit naar 0% en het invoeren van een suikerbelasting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parliamentary groups asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the coalition agreement, covering student grants, research funding, teacher pay, press funding, special education, childcare and digitalisation. The government answered most questions with references to further elaboration and future decisions, providing concrete figures only in a few places.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and a decision by the cabinet. You will be informed about this further.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover nader geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parties asked the Health Minister about the 2021 coalition agreement, covering youth care savings, health inequality, healthcare wages, the chief medical officer, ICU capacity, the health deductible and premium effects. The minister answered most questions in substance, deferred several to later decision-making, and pointed to other documents for details.
For a number of questions, further elaboration and decision-making by the cabinet is still required.
Voor een aantal vragen geldt dat deze nog nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming vragen door het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parties asked the Defence Minister, in a set of factual questions before the government declaration debate, about the defence budget increases in the coalition agreement, how the funds are allocated, European defence cooperation, specialisation and strategic autonomy, and the NATO spending norm. The minister answered that the money is additional, broken down into intensification and maintenance items, will be detailed in a forthcoming Defence Note, and brings spending to the European NATO average of 1.85% of GDP.
How the coalition agreement funds will exactly be spent requires further elaboration and decision-making by the cabinet.
Hoe de middelen uit het coalitieakkoord precies worden uitgegeven, vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet.

Antwoord op van het lid Tony van Dijck over de berichten dat bedrijven voor ruim €4 miljard aan loonsteun moeten terugbetalen en dat dit voor veel ondernemers dreigt uit te draaien op een financiële strop

MP Tony van Dijck asked ministers whether reports that firms must repay over 4 billion euro in NOW wage subsidy, with a risk of financial ruin due to delayed accountant certificates, are accurate, and about the scope of repayments in other Covid schemes and conditions for repayment. The government answered that the repayment estimate is uncertain and partly based on incomplete data, that a 14-week extension is available for accountant and third-party certificates, that repayment terms are generous and interest-free, and that no compensation for accountant costs is planned.
The determination process for the NOW is still ongoing, so it is still unclear how much NOW support will ultimately be paid out.
Het vaststellingsproces van de NOW loopt nog, waardoor het nog onduidelijk is hoeveel NOW-steun er uiteindelijk wordt uitgekeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tony van Dijck en Maeijer over het bericht er een akkoord is bereikt over de financiering van de eurozonebegroting

PVV MPs Tony van Dijck and Maeijer asked whether the agreement on financing a eurozone budget (BICC) is a first step toward a separate eurozone budget and whether the Netherlands can veto spending or block new own resources. Minister Hoekstra answers that the instrument will be part of the regular EU budget under the MFF ceiling, that the Netherlands opposes new own resources, and that participation in any intergovernmental agreement is voluntary, while the detailed size and distribution remain unresolved.
It has been agreed that the discussion on the necessity, content, modalities and size of a desired intergovernmental agreement will continue in the preparatory working groups of the Eurogroup.
Afgesproken is dat de discussie over de noodzaak, inhoud, modaliteiten en omvang van een door een aantal lidstaten gewenste IGA zal doorgaan in ambtelijke voorportalen van de Eurogroep.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Jong, Tony van Dijck en Wilders over het bericht 'Korten kan niet wachten'

Three PVV MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about DNB calls for pension cuts, questioning DNB's stance and its president's fitness, and asked for cuts to be taken off the table. The minister rejected these views, defended DNB's independence and advisory role, and acknowledged that some pension entitlements may need to be reduced while promising a ministerial regulation to soften the MVEV cut.
Following the pension agreement of 5 June 2019, I do intend to draft a ministerial regulation that can soften the so-called MVEV cut by giving pension funds more time to meet the MVEV requirement.
Voortvloeiend uit het pensioenakkoord van 5 juni 2019 ben ik wel voornemens om een ministeriële regeling uit te werken die de zogenoemde MVEV-korting kan verzachten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Tony van Dijck over hypotheken voor ‘duurhuurders’

PVV MPs Kops and Tony van Dijck asked whether tenants paying high rents should be able to get mortgages based on actual monthly costs, and whether stricter income rules should be relaxed given lost wealth-building. The minister defended current income-based mortgage rules, saying individual case-by-case exceptions (the explain option) are possible and that the pilot by BLG Wonen is being monitored, while refusing a general loosening of income requirements.
I am not in favour of generally relaxing the income requirements for mortgage credit, because this would increase the risk of over-lending to consumers.
Ik ben geen voorstander van het generiek versoepelen van de inkomenseisen voor hypothecair krediet, omdat dit het risico van overkreditering van consumenten doet toenemen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van der Linde, Bruins, Stoffer, Tony van Dijck, Leijten, Baudet en Van Rooijen over de brief van de Minister van Financiën d.d. 5 februari 2019 over het op handen zijnde akkoord b

MPs asked the Finance Minister when the PEPP pension regulation would be finalised, what delegated acts it contains, whether Dutch pension rules could be affected without Dutch influence, and whether the Netherlands will oppose it. The minister said the Netherlands cannot agree to the negotiated text because of the number of delegated-act powers and the EIOPA role, though the second-pillar pension system and tax rules are unaffected, and that the Chamber's view will be weighed in the vote.

As I announced in my letter of 5 February, I informed the Romanian presidency yesterday that the Netherlands cannot agree to the negotiated text of the PEPP regulation at Coreper this coming Wednesday.

Zoals ik in mijn brief van 5 februari jl. heb aangekondigd, heb ik gisteren aan het Roemeense voorzitterschap kenbaar gemaakt dat Nederland op Coreper aanstaande woensdag niet kan instemmen met het onderhandelaarsakkoord inzake de PEPP-verordening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Tony van Dijck over het bericht ‘Hypotheekkeurslijf nekt starters en senioren’

MPs Kops and Tony van Dijck asked whether mortgage lenders deliberately refuse maatwerk (tailored) mortgages to starters and seniors, whether strict rules deter lenders, and what the government will do about it. The minister replied that lenders choose whether to offer maatwerk for commercial reasons, that the platform maatwerk has improved clarity, that about 43% of lenders now offer it, and promised to inform parliament before the summer after evaluating the outcomes with the sector.
I will inform you about this before the summer.
Ik zal u voor de zomer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, van Dijck en Wilders over de berichten 'Stichtingen steunen terreur' en 'Drinkwater uitgedeeld in Syrië, maar waar dan'?

PVV MPs asked how many people have been convicted in the Netherlands since 2012 for financing Islamist terrorism, whether citizens convicted of such financing can have their Dutch nationality revoked and be deported, and whether bank and money-transfer reporting duties should be tightened. The government answered that no separate figures exist because terrorism financing is not split by ideology, that nationality revocation is possible case by case for dual nationals, and that the existing Wwft reporting system needs no stricter rules.
Figures on how many people in the Netherlands have been convicted for financing Islamist terrorism are therefore not known.
Cijfers over hoeveel mensen er in Nederland zijn veroordeeld voor het financieren van islamitisch terrorisme zijn daarom niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer en Tony van Dijck over exorbitant reisgedrag van Eurocommissarissen

PVV MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Finance about the travel costs of EU Commissioners, including €492,249 spent in January–February 2016 and a €75,000 trip by High Representative Mogherini to Baku. The minister replied that the trips served Dutch interests, that EU travel is paid from the EU budget under oversight by the European Court of Auditors, the Council and the European Parliament, and that the Commission now publishes these costs; he declined to commit to any action.
Public control over these expenditures is the responsibility of the European Court of Auditors and the Council.
De publieke controle op deze uitgaven is de verantwoordelijkheid van de Europese Rekenkamer en de Raad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Jong en Van Dijck over de berichten 'Pensioenfondsen oneerlijk' en 'DNB: Rendement pensioenfondsen te laag om te herstellen'

Two PVV MPs asked the state secretary about press reports on pension funds' low returns and DNB's warning of possible pension cuts, questioning why cuts are possible given large fund assets and whether low discount rates distort funding pictures. The state secretary answered that coverage ratios remain below required buffers, the discount rate should not be raised, DNB's warning is part of its supervisory role, and cuts are a last resort under the 2015 framework.
It is the supervisor's task to point pension funds to their responsibilities and to point out the risks for the pension sector as a whole.
Het is de taak van de toezichthouder om pensioenfondsen te wijzen op hun verantwoordelijkheden en te wijzen op de risico's voor de pensioensector als geheel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tony van Dijck, Maeijer en Wilders over het bericht dat Griekenland geld krijgt uit het noodfonds

MPs Van Dijck, Maeijer and Wilders asked the Finance Minister about reports that Greece would receive 8.5 billion euro from the bailout fund, what the Dutch share is, and why Dutch taxpayers should keep funding Greece. The minister confirmed the ESM proposal is subject to a Raad van Bewind decision, explained how ESM loans are funded and the Dutch capital contribution, and referred to earlier letters for the government's position.
You were recently informed of the cabinet's position in the Eurogroup report of 15 June and a letter to the House on the progress report of the second progress mission of the ESM programme.

U bent recent over het standpunt van het kabinet geïnformeerd in het verslag van de Eurogroep van 15 juni en een Kamerbrief over de voortgangsrapportage van de tweede voortgangsmissie van het ESM-programma.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tony van Dijck en Kops over het bericht “Banken rekenen nog steeds te veel boeterente bij hypotheek”

PVV MPs asked the Finance Minister whether banks still charge excessive early-repayment penalties on mortgages despite the AFM guidance, how many people are affected, what compensation is planned, and what measures will be taken. The minister acknowledges possible overcharging since July 2016, says lenders have pledged proactive compensation, and sees no need for further measures on competition and mobility.
I consider it important that all customers who after 14 July 2016 paid too high a fee under the new rules and the AFM guidance are compensated with retroactive effect.

Ik vind het belangrijk dat alle klanten met terugwerkende kracht worden gecompenseerd die na 14 juli 2016 op grond van de nieuwe regels en de leidraad van de AFM een te hoge vergoeding hebben betaald.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en Tony van Dijck over de te hoge buffers van zorgverzekeraars

Two PVV MPs asked the Finance and Health ministers about health insurers' excessive capital buffers, the EU Solvency II rules, insolvency risk and consequences for insured persons, and whether premium money is effectively being stolen. The ministers replied that Solvency II already accounts for the Dutch system, that the insolvency probability is about 0.5% per year, that insured persons are protected under Article 31 Zvw, and that insurers may choose their own safety margins, with excess solvency returned via lower premiums.
Should a health insurer go bankrupt, insured persons will look for a new health insurer and take out new health insurance.
Mocht een zorgverzekeraar failliet gaan, dan zullen verzekerden een nieuwe zorgverzekeraar zoeken en een nieuwe zorgverzekering afsluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Tony van Dijck over het bericht dat PSA Groep (Peugeot Citroën) de werkelijke verbruikscijfers van auto’s bekend heeft gemaakt

MPs Madlener and Tony van Dijck asked whether the new WLTP test method would raise measured CO2 emissions and tax revenue, and what it means for consumers, air quality policy and milieuzones. The government answered that WLTP will likely raise measured CO2 figures but is a technical change not intended to increase tax revenue, promised a bill by end 2016 with details on financial effects, and said WLTP does not affect air quality policy.
For the implementation of the WLTP in the car taxes, a legislative amendment is necessary.
Voor de implementatie van de WLTP in de autobelastingen is een wetswijziging noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tony van Dijck over het bericht dat Italië banken van slechte leningen af mag helpen

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether Italy's state guarantees for non-performing loans constitute state aid and why Dutch bank interventions were treated differently, and asked how Italian banks passed the ECB stress test and what measures protect the Netherlands. The minister answered that the Commission found the Italian scheme not to be state aid if the fee is market-based, explained the 2014 stress test outcomes, and pointed to the banking union safeguards, while refusing to answer a question on leaving the euro.
Moreover, the European Commission has not yet published the full decision for this case.
Overigens heeft de Europese Commissie het volledige besluit voor deze casus nog niet gepubliceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tony van Dijck over het bericht dat Nederland interesse heeft in de transactietaks

An MP from the PVV asked the Finance Ministry whether the Netherlands intends to join the group negotiating a financial transaction tax, and about Estonia's withdrawal, the coalition agreement's conditions, effects on finance and pensions, a possible UK court challenge, and whether the EU should be left. The minister replied that the Netherlands has not joined the enhanced cooperation group, that no deal exists yet, that any deal will be assessed against the coalition criteria and shared with parliament, and that tax is a national competence while international cooperation remains important.
As previously promised to your House, I will share this assessment with the House.
Zoals eerder in uw Kamer toegezegd, zal ik deze appreciatie dan met de Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes c.s. over de inhoud van de prospectus voor beursgang ABN AMRO

MPs from several parties asked the Finance Minister whether the ABN AMRO prospectus for its stock market listing shows share-linked bonuses that conflict with earlier assurances and the Merkies/Nijboer amendment, and about conflicts of interest of two board members. The minister answered that identified staff may receive variable pay in non-cash form, that the top 7 board members and 25 senior managers are barred from variable pay while the state holds a stake, that the amendment is complied with, and that the bonus decisions rest with ABN AMRO itself.
ABN AMRO as a company itself bears responsibility for drawing up a variable pay scheme within the legal framework.
ABN AMRO heeft als vennootschap zelf de verantwoordelijkheid om binnen het wettelijke kader een variabele beloningsregeling op te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt, Bashir, Tony van Dijck en Van Vliet over de afschaffing van de oldtimervrijstelling

MPs from CDA, SP, PVV and Van Vliet asked the Finance State Secretary about the revenue estimates for abolishing the classic-car tax exemption, the number of diesel and LPG cars affected, and the cost of extending transitional rules to them. The State Secretary defended revised revenue estimates of roughly 60 to 70 million euros, gave a table of affected vehicles, and rejected extending transitional rules to diesel and LPG cars because of budget and air-quality concerns.

In my letter on the classic car measure I only intended to indicate that, to reach the estimated revenue of 137 million euros, the second part of the revenue, the replacement cars, would need to yield 82 million euros in motor vehicle tax.

Ik heb in mijn brief over de oldtimermaatregel slechts willen aangegeven dat, om de geraamde opbrengst van € 137 miljoen te halen, het tweede deel van de opbrengst, de vervangende auto's, € 82 miljoen aan MRB zou moeten opbrengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tony van Dijck over het bericht dat het “Aangifteseizoen start met een overbelaste site fiscus”

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the Tax Authority's website, overloaded on the first day of the 2014 income tax filing season, has been overloaded before, how many people can log in simultaneously, and how it will prevent overload and track failed logins. The State Secretary answered that overload had occurred only for a few hours on two days, that a cap of about 45,000 concurrent users is deliberately enforced, that capacity is being increased gradually, and that the filing deadline was extended to 1 May.
It is neither realistic nor efficient to enable all people to file their returns at all times simultaneously.
Het is niet realistisch en doelmatig om alle mensen in staat te stellen te allen tijde tegelijkertijd hun aangifte te kunnen laten doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever, Madlener en Tony van Dijck over het bericht dat een zwaar gesubsidieerde elektrische auto bijna net zoveel fijnstof produceert als een benzinewagen

Three PVV MPs asked whether the government will stop subsidising electric cars after a report claimed they emit almost as much fine particulate matter as petrol cars, and whether VAT and registration tax should be cut instead. Minister Kamp answered that total particulate emissions including brake and tyre wear are about a third lower for electric cars, that subsidies will be reconsidered in the Autobrief 2.0, and that the 160,000 euro-per-car figure is not recognised.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tony van Dijck over de naheffing door de EU

An MP asked the Finance Minister how the UK can claim a 50% reduction on the EU levy, how the UK rebate works, and whether the Netherlands' 642 million euro payment should be dropped. The minister answered that the UK rebate has not been halved, explained the rebate mechanism and the 25% reduced contribution by four member states, and referred to earlier letters on the macroeconomic revisions.
The British have not received a 50% discount on their surcharge.
De Britten hebben geen 50% korting op hun naheffing gekregen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tony van Dijck over het bericht dat vijf miljoen Nederlanders een naheffing van €150 tegemoet kunnen zien door fout fiscus

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance whether a late-applied change to income-dependent tax credits leaves about five million taxpayers facing an average extra €150 at assessment, and how this was allowed to happen. The State Secretary confirms the cause (the change could not be built into the 2014 wage-tax tables and provisional assessment in time), says the situation is regrettable, rejects the word 'error', and denies any link to a separate EU levy.
I therefore wish to distance myself from the qualification 'error'.
Van de kwalificatie «fout» wil ik dan ook afstand nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Tony van Dijck over het bericht dat de NS in Schotland gaat rijden

Two PVV MPs asked whether NS's Scottish rail subsidiary Abellio carries financial risks for the State as shareholder, and whether NS should stop international concessions to focus on domestic rail after the Fyra debacle. The Secretary of State replied that the UK concession model leaves most asset and personnel risk with the authority, that NS needs no capital or guarantees from the shareholder, that the €3.2 billion is a fixed operating payment rather than a price paid by NS, and that NS decides its own foreign concessions within agreed financial frameworks.
I do not share that view. NS has not paid €3.2 billion for the Scottish concession, but receives a fixed amount to cover operating costs.
Ik deel die mening niet. NS heeft geen € 3,2 miljard betaald voor de Schotse concessie, maar ontvangt een vast bedrag ter dekking van de exploitatiekosten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Tony Van Dijck en Bosma over het bericht ‘Terrorisme wordt vanuit Nederland gesteund met geld’

PVV MPs asked whether terror groups in Pakistan and Afghanistan received money from the Netherlands over 100 times, why money transfers flagged by exchange offices were not stopped sooner, and what action would be taken against those involved. The government answered that the press report misrepresented the figures: 108 dossiers in 2013 were reported to the authorities after analysis, none yet shown to involve terrorist financing, and prosecution decisions rest with the Public Prosecution Service.
Under the statutory duty of confidentiality, no further details can be given about the amounts involved.
Uit hoofde van de wettelijke geheimhoudingsplicht kunnen geen nadere gegevens vermeld worden omtrent de in het geding zijnde bedragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en Tony van Dijck over het bericht ‘Eneco laat particulieren beleggen in zijn windpark’

MPs Klever and Tony van Dijck asked the ministers about a report that Eneco lets private individuals invest in its wind park, including how the AFM checks and warns about risks, whether subsidised returns of 8 to 12% are possible, what happens to investors if subsidies or electricity prices fall. The minister answered that the AFM reviews prospectuses for completeness, consistency and comprehensibility, that the 8 to 12% figures were wrongly reported, that subsidy changes affect only new parks, and that the AFM oversees advertising but no advance warning was committed.
The AFM checks whether the prospectus is complete, consistent and comprehensible.
De AFM controleert of het prospectus volledig, consistent en begrijpelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en Tony van Dijck over het ontbreken van democratische controle op de kosten van het Energieakkoord

PVV MPs Klever and Tony van Dijck asked whether the government accepts that the Energieakkoord lacks a carefully substantiated cost calculation and asked for an overview of direct and indirect costs, including tax revenue loss and private damage. Minister Kamp rejects the claim that the calculation is missing, points to the PBL and ECN analyses and promised annual energy projections (NEV) from October 2014, but did not provide the requested overview.
Are you willing to send the Chamber an overview of all costs arising from the Energy Agreement?
Bent u bereid om alsnog een overzicht van alle uit het Energieakkoord voortvloeiende kosten naar de Kamer te sturen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tony van Dijck, Madlener en Wilders over het bericht 'Mogelijk 300 miljoen extra naar Brussel'

PVV MPs asked the Finance Minister whether the cabinet budgets for EU payments beyond the 8 billion euro for next year, why the money goes to Brussels rather than domestic tax relief or elderly care, and whether he will leave the EU. The minister replied that the 2015 EU payments are estimated at 7.2 billion in the 2014 budget, that CBS revisions may affect them but cannot yet be quantified, that details will follow in the Spring Memorandum, referred to the Prinsjesdag budget documents for the rationale, and rejected leaving the EU.
In the Miljoenennota 2015 I will address the changes that occur in budget year 2015.
In de Miljoenennota 2015 zal ik ingaan op de mutaties die zich voordoen in het begrotingsjaar 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tony van Dijck en Wilders over het bericht "Grieken belazeren de boel opnieuw...."

Two PVV MPs asked the Finance Minister whether Greece's primary surplus is an illusion, whether Eurostat and member states knew of statistical manipulation, whether the pension fund holds 4.7 billion euro, and whether he will travel to Greece to reclaim loans. The minister denied the manipulation claims, citing Eurostat-confirmed deficit and debt figures and programme definitions, explained the social fund surplus as neutral state transfers, and declined to travel.
No, Eurostat has confirmed that for 2013 the Greek government deficit comes to 12.7% of GDP (incl. bank recapitalisation) and debt to 175.1% of GDP.
Nee, Eurostat heeft bevestigd dat voor 2013 het Griekse overheidstekort uitkomt op 12,7% BBP (incl. bankenherkapitalisatie) en de schuld op 175,1% BBP.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tony van Dijck over het akkoord over de Europese bankenunie

An MP asks the Finance Minister about the European banking union agreement: whether it accelerates pooling of national resolution funds, the fund's size and borrowing capacity, the Dutch contribution, bail-in rules, and the speed of resolution. The minister answers that the fund builds up over eight years to 1% of covered deposits (about 55 billion euro), with borrowing capacity and bail-in rules set out in the BRRD and SRM regulation, and the Dutch resolution authority remains involved in resolution decisions.
How much the fund can borrow cannot be stated with precision.
Hoeveel het fonds kan lenen is niet met precisie te zeggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tony van Dijck over de hypotheek van de president van de Nederlandsche Bank

An MP asked the Finance Minister about a favourable mortgage with an interest discount that the DNB president received, its size and compliance with rules, and whether such perks should be abolished or taxed. The minister confirmed a EUR 1.2 million mortgage meeting lending norms, defended the staff scheme as a permitted benefit, declined to discuss an individual taxpayer's tax position, and said the fiscal treatment would be reviewed in the Belastingplan 2015.
Questions from MP Tony van Dijck (PVV) to the Minister of Finance about the mortgage of the president of the Nederlandsche Bank
Vragen van het lid Tony van Dijck (PVV) aan de Minister van Financiën over de hypotheek van de president van de Nederlandsche Bank
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en Tony Van Dijck over het bericht dat zzp-ers in de zorg geen VAR-WUO (Verklaring Arbeidsrelatie Winst Uit Onderneming) meer krijgen van de belastingdienst

MPs Agema and Tony Van Dijck asked whether the Tax Authority's refusal to issue VAR-WUO declarations to self-employed care workers, which hurts patients who rely on agency-placed carers, is known and how it will be addressed. The government acknowledged the problem, said the Tax Authority reclassified 257 cases and issued 900 VAR-loon decisions after review while stressing genuine self-employment must still be recognised, and pointed to direct contracting pilots and ongoing labour-market attention.
I see the problem that is connected to this, although it is not a scale suggested in the broadcast.
Ik zie de problematiek die hier mee samenhangt, hoewel het niet om een schaal gaat die in de uitzending werd gesuggereerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tony van Dijck over het bericht ‘De Nederlandsche Bank verliest € 6,2 miljard op goudbelegging’

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that De Nederlandsche Bank lost €6.2 billion on its gold holdings, the current gold value, whether dividends or the 2014 budget are affected, the timing of physical gold checks, the storage locations, and whether the gold should be repatriated. The minister confirmed the €7.6 billion market value drop, said it is absorbed by the revaluation reserve without affecting dividends, reported annual physical checks with no discrepancies, listed the storage split, and declined to ask DNB to repatriate the gold.
I see no reason to ask DNB to bring its gold back to the Netherlands.
Ik zie geen reden om DNB te verzoeken haar goud terug te halen naar Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tony van Dijck over het bericht dat Rabobank-topman Sipko Schat vertrekt met bijna negen ton

The PVV MP Tony van Dijck asked whether it is acceptable that Rabobank executive Sipko Schat, not prosecuted in the LIBOR affair, receives a severance of nearly nine million euros, and why the US can charge former Rabobank traders while the Netherlands does not. The Minister of Finance answers that the Public Prosecution Service found no criminal conduct by Schat, that the severance is a bank matter subject to DNB supervision of remuneration rules, and that the Dutch criminal investigation into former staff is ongoing and coordinated with US authorities.
The criminal investigation in the Netherlands has not yet been concluded.
Het strafrechtelijk onderzoek in Nederland is nog niet afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tony van Dijck over het bericht ‘Rijken sluizen 54 miljard weg’

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that wealthy Greeks moved 54 billion euro abroad to avoid tax, and about the slow handling of the Lagarde list of Greek tax evaders. The minister said the government shares concern about the pace of the investigation, pressed the Greek authorities, and promised to address the issue in the next progress report.
Greece is itself responsible for criminal prosecution of possible tax evasion.
Griekenland is zelf verantwoordelijk voor de strafrechtelijke vervolging van mogelijke belastingontduiking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tony van Dijck over het bericht ‘Rabobank schikt in Libor-affaire voor €774 miljoen’

An MP asked the Finance Minister why most of Rabobank's 774 million euro Libor settlement goes to US and UK regulators and only 10% to the Dutch Public Prosecution Service, and how the money is spent. The minister answered that each authority settled separately under its own framework, that the Dutch prosecution received 70 million euro booked under Justice and Security, and that Dutch authorities have not settled with other banks for Libor/Euribor manipulation due to jurisdictional limits.
For the Dutch Public Prosecution Service, a transaction was concluded with Rabobank under which Rabobank pays 70 million euro.
Voor het Nederlandse Openbaar Ministerie (OM) geldt dat zij met de Rabobank een transactie is aangegaan waarbij de Rabobank een betaling doet van € 70 mln.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tony van Dijck over het bericht ‘Rabo ongekend hard veroordeeld voor fraude’

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the Rabobank Libor manipulation case, including the resignation of only the chair, the limited clawback of bonuses, disciplinary measures against traders, and tax consequences of the settlement. The minister answered that bonuses were partly held back and clawback was judged unlikely to succeed, announced a bonus-policy bill, and declined to give tax information about individual taxpayers.
Based on the confidentiality obligation of article 67 of the General State Taxes Act, I cannot provide information about individual taxpayers.
Op grond van de geheimhoudingsverplichting van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen kan ik geen informatie geven over individuele belastingplichtigen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wilders en Tony van Dijck over de mogelijke transfer van speler Gareth Bale van Tottenham Hotspur naar Real Madrid

PVV MPs Wilders and Van Dijck asked the Finance Minister about the reported 100 million euro transfer of Gareth Bale to Real Madrid, alleged Real Madrid tax debts, and whether Spanish bank Bankia, which received ESM-linked support, is a Real Madrid lender. The minister declined to comment on Spanish tax matters or Bankia's ties to Real Madrid, explained the ESM framework, and answered the closing question about the MP's own football ability with a flat no.
I make no statements about the individual tax matters in Spain, nor about the relationship between Bankia and Real Madrid.
Ik doe geen uitspraken over de individuele belastingzaken in Spanje en ook niet over de relatie tussen Bankia en Real Madrid.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tony van Dijck over het bericht dat het IMF de stekker uit het hulpprogramma voor Griekenland wil trekken als de leiders van de eurozone geen oplossing vinden voor een gat van 3 tot 4 milja

An MP asks whether the IMF's threat to withdraw from the Greek bailout over a 3-4 billion euro funding gap contradicts the Eurogroup chair's denial of any gap, and whether the Netherlands still treats IMF participation as a firm condition and regrets breaking its no-money-for-Greece pledge. The minister replies that the Troika's positive July assessment means no gap exists, that the government's position on IMF participation is unchanged, and that its view on the earlier motion is unchanged.
The IMF has indicated that there is no financing gap as long as the outcomes of the progress mission are positive.
Het IMF heeft aangegeven dat er geen sprake is van een financieringsgat zolang de uitkomsten van de voortgangsmissie positief zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Tony van Dijck over 25% meer betalingsachterstanden op de hypotheken

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers of Housing and Finance about the 25% rise in mortgage payment arrears, whether the government's policy is causing harm, and whether the PVV's proposal to keep mortgage interest deduction should be pursued. Minister Blok answered that arrears are hard to forecast but not expected to fall soon, that the government's measures give clarity and that he will not change current mortgage rules.
I can agree with the view that stability in the housing market is necessary.
Ik kan mij vinden in het standpunt dat rust op de woningmarkt noodzakelijk is.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Tony van Dijck, Wilders en Madlener over het bericht “Eurozone scheldt mogelijk Griekse schuld kwijt”

MPs Van Dijck, Wilders and Madlener asked the Finance Minister why he suggested in a Greek newspaper that eurozone countries might forgive Greek debt and demanded a public retraction. The minister answered that the Eurogroup will only revisit possible further debt-sustainability measures for Greece at a later date, and that the Netherlands opposes debt forgiveness.
The Netherlands is not in favour of debt forgiveness.
Nederland is geen voorstander van schuldkwijtschelding.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Tony van Dijck over het bericht dat Cyprus haar crisisonderzoek heeft gestaakt

An MP asks the Finance Minister whether he shares concern that Cyprus halted its inquiry into capital flight before the banking freeze, that the central bank withheld information, and that evidence was destroyed, and how an independent investigation will be ensured. The minister replies that responsibility lies primarily with the Cypriot authorities and the Troika, that he will not speculate on wrongdoing, and that he awaits the commission's results.
I do not want to speculate on whether there were irregularities or improper outflow of deposits, and I await the results of this commission's investigation.
Ik wil niet speculeren over of er sprake is geweest van onrechtmatigheden of een oneigenlijke uitstroom van deposito’s en wacht de resultaten van het onderzoek van deze commissie af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Tony van Dijck over het bericht dat een huishouden in Cyprus gemiddeld vier keer meer vermogen heeft dan een Nederlands huishouden

PVV MPs Wilders and Van Dijck asked why Cypriot households hold about four times the average wealth of Dutch households and why the Netherlands should contribute to Cypriot bailout aid, asking whether this aid should be reversed. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that the ECB itself notes Cyprus data are not comparable across the eurozone, pointed to earlier letters on the bailout, and did not reverse or commit to changing the aid.
The ECB states in its study that the figures for Cyprus are not well comparable with the rest of the eurozone for several reasons.
De ECB stelt in haar studie dat de cijfers voor Cyprus niet goed vergelijkbaar zijn met de rest van de eurozone om meerdere redenen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum, Schouw, Segers, Leijten, Klaver, Tony van Dijck, Dijkgraaf, Ouwehand en Klein over het bericht “VNG wil overleg kabinet over bezuinigingen”

MPs asked whether the government would commission research, with the VNG, into whether the decentralisations and cumulative efficiency cuts are feasible for municipalities, and how risks and cumulative effects on vulnerable groups are monitored. The minister declined a separate CPB study for now, pointed to monitoring commitments and a motion-based independent study to be scoped with the VNG, and said the minister of Social Affairs would map cumulative effects.
Your House has since, in a motion by MP Schouw, asked the government to have an independent party investigate the financial and implementation risks of the decentralisations.

Uw Kamer heeft inmiddels in een motie van het lid Schouw aan de regering verzocht door een onafhankelijke partij een onderzoek te laten doen naar de financiële risico's en uitvoeringsrisico's van de decentralisaties
Antwoord vragen van het lid Tony van Dijck over het bericht dat de schoonzoon van de Cypriotische president 21 miljoen weggesluisd heeft

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether he knew of a list of 132 account holders who moved nearly 700 million euro out of Cyprus before the bailout, including the president's son-in-law's firm, and whether suspicious transactions would be investigated independently. The minister said he would not speculate, that responsibility lies primarily with Cypriot authorities and the Troika, that a Cypriot commission has been appointed and he will await its results, and that the government considers adequate anti-money-laundering safeguards very important.
I do not wish to speculate on whether there has been an improper outflow of deposits.
Ik wil niet speculeren over of er sprake is geweest van een oneigenlijke uitstroom van deposito’s.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wilders, Tony van Dijck en Van Vliet over de sombere CBS-cijfers over de werkloosheid, de huizenprijzen en het consumentenvertrouwen

Opposition PVV MPs asked whether the minister would relax the 3% deficit ceiling and reconsider labour, housing and pension reforms in light of gloomy CBS figures on unemployment, house prices and consumer confidence. The minister replied that the 2013 deficit will exceed 3%, citing a housing package and business stimulus, that the government keeps its spending rules and will not add cuts in 2013, and that it will push ahead with reforms and targeted support for unemployed workers and youth.
The cabinet will further maintain the budget rules for 2013; any overruns will be resolved within the budget, and the spending ceiling will be respected.
Het kabinet zal verder voor 2013 de begrotingsregels handhaven; eventuele overschrijdingen zullen binnen de begroting worden opgelost, het uitgavenplafond wordt gerespecteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tony van Dijck en Van Klaveren over het CPB rapport «De Nederlandse woningmarkt – hypotheekrente, huizenprijzen en consumptie»

MPs Tony van Dijck and Van Klaveren asked the government to respond to a CPB report finding Dutch mortgage rates about 1 percentage point above neighbouring countries, and asked how to end excessive margins, quantify lost consumption, housing wealth and tax revenue, and recover losses from the financial sector. The minister acknowledged the rate gap, attributed house price changes to several factors, and said a quantification of 'excessive' interest and lost revenue was not feasible because no objective benchmark exists.

A calculation of the loss of purchasing power due to possibly 'excessively paid' interest is not feasible in my view, because there is no unambiguous and objective measure for the possibly 'excessively paid' part of the interest.

Een berekening van het verlies aan koopkracht als gevolg van eventueel «te veel betaalde rente» acht ik niet goed mogelijk omdat er geen eenduidige en objectieve maatstaf is voor het eventueel «te veel betaalde» deel van de rente.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Tony van Dijck over de beloningen bij de genationaliseerde SNS

An MP asked the Finance Minister about pay at nationalised SNS REAAL and ABN AMRO, including whether staff exceed the public-sector pay norm, executive and supervisory board pay, adviser fees, and whether bonuses can be clawed back. The minister said the WNT norm does not apply to these commercial banks, gave board and supervisory pay figures and fees, and committed to an independent clawback investigation and informing the House of its outcome.
I share the view that an independent investigation must be carried out into the possibilities of recovering the variable remuneration awarded and paid out.
Ik deel de mening dat er een onafhankelijk onderzoek moet komen naar de mogelijkheden de toegekende en uitgekeerde variabele beloningen terug te vorderen.
Antwoord vragen Madlener en Tony Van Dijck over het EU-trendrapport 2013 van de Algemene Rekenkamer

Two MPs (Madlener and Tony van Dijck, PVV) asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers about the Court of Audit's 2013 EU trend report, including the 3.9% error rate, unverified Greek loans and EFSF funds, member states' resistance to a national declaration, and whether governments should be forced to provide one. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that the government opposes the error rate, that EFSF/Greek loans are controlled via conditionality and national budget channels with an audit committee being explored, that no member state refuses accountability, and that he will not link ESM aid to a national declaration.
The cabinet is exploring whether EFSF funds can be placed under the supervision of the ESM audit committee.
Het kabinet verkent of de middelen van het EFSF onder toezicht van het ESM-auditcomité gebracht kunnen worden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wilders, Tony van Dijck en Madlener over het bericht: ‘EU-controleur in Den Haag’

MPs Wilders, Tony van Dijck and Madlener asked whether the government would send back an EU 'European Semester Officer' stationed in The Hague, object to growing Brussels interference, and station a Dutch controller in Brussels to oversee EU spending. The minister replied that the Commission's Semester role is important for budget oversight, that the officers only facilitate information exchange without changing Commission powers, and that the European Court of Auditors handles EU spending control while Netherlands pushes member-state accountability.
Appointing this officer changes nothing about the powers the Commission has under existing EU regulations.
Het aanstellen van deze functionaris verandert niets aan de bevoegdheden die de Commissie heeft op basis van de bestaande EU-regelgeving.
Antwoord vragen Tony van Dijck en Graus over het rapport van de Stichting SOMO “Het financiële overgewicht van Nederland”

Two PVV MPs asked the finance minister to respond to a SOMO report arguing that Dutch bank salaries are about 15% too high, costing around two billion euros in lending, and to state what the government will do about its recommendations. The minister said the lending effect cannot be isolated, that the government lacks direct influence over private wage setting, and listed existing and planned measures on shareholders, bank structure and mortgage tax incentives.
However, it is not possible to determine the specific effect of wage costs on lending.
Het is echter niet mogelijk om het specifieke effect van de loonkosten op de kredietverlening te bepalen.
Antwoord vragen Tony van Dijck en Wilders over het schandaal rondom de Griekse ex-minister van Financiën

MPs Tony van Dijck and Wilders asked the finance minister about the Greek tax-evasion list scandal, including whether it was cleaned of relatives of former PM Papandreou, why Dutch taxpayers should fund Greece, how Greek prosecution would be pursued, and whether an exit from the euro should be prepared. The minister answered that Greece itself is responsible for prosecution, that a new list was sent to the Greek prosecutor, that loan-programme reforms target tax evasion, and that a Greek exit is not on the agenda.
In principle, Greece itself is responsible for criminal prosecution of possible tax evasion.
In beginsel is Griekenland zelf verantwoordelijk voor de strafrechtelijke vervolging van mogelijke belastingontduiking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tony van Dijck en Wilders over het bericht “Grieken lopen fors achter op schema”

PVV MPs Van Dijck and Wilders asked the Prime Minister and Finance Minister about reports that Greece is well behind schedule on reforms, including 210 of 300 unimplemented measures, continued pension and disability benefit fraud, and whether the next loan tranche will be blocked. The answer was given in a letter of 28 November 2012, which the summary of the answer text provided here does not include.
Will you block the request for postponement of payment and the disbursement of the next tranche if Greece has not kept to the agreements?
Gaat u de aanvraag om uitstel van betaling en de uitbetaling van de volgende tranche blokkeren als Griekenland zich niet aan de afspraken heeft gehouden?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tony van Dijck en Wilders over het bericht «Griekenland kan niet aan eisen voldoen»

PVV MPs Van Dijck and Wilders asked the Finance Minister whether Greece can meet the conditions for its bailout tranche and why Dutch money should go to a country that fails to reform. The minister replied that the Troika found Greece had met the conditions, so the tranche was released and the loan programme continues.
Following the latest Troika progress report, I judge that Greece has ultimately met the requirements to disburse the tranche from the loan programme.
Naar aanleiding van het laatste voortgangsrapport van de Trojka oordeel ik dat Griekenland uiteindelijk aan de eisen heeft voldaan om de tranche uit het leningenprogramma uit te keren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tony Van Dijck over het bericht «Bundesbank-voorzitter vecht tegen plannen van het ECB» om weer staatsobligaties van failliete landen op te kopen

An MP asked the finance minister whether he knew of reports that Bundesbank president Weidmann was fighting ECB plans to resume buying sovereign bonds, whether he would speak out against this, and how the Dutch taxpayer's risk on the ECB (including Target-2, SMP and LTRO) could be prevented or quantified. The minister acknowledged the reports, declined to comment on ECB policy citing its independence, and said risks are shared under the ECB capital key without quantifying Dutch exposure.

Regarding the second part of your question, I emphasise that the ECB is independent in carrying out its monetary task and accordingly I do not comment on the ECB's policy regarding the purchase of government bonds.

Aangaande het tweede deel van uw vraag benadruk ik dat de ECB onafhankelijk is in de uitvoering van de monetaire taak en dienovereenkomstig spreek ik mij niet uit over het beleid van de ECB ten aanzien van de opkoop van staatsobligaties.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Tony van Dijck en Wilders over het bericht "overheidsmaffiapraktijken op Sicilië"

Two PVV MPs asked the Finance Minister about reports of excessive public spending and clientelism in Sicily, and whether the Netherlands would refuse financial aid to Italy. The minister confirmed awareness of the reports, said Italy has made no aid request, and that Italy must address its own problems.
Italy has not submitted a request for support.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wilders en Tony van Dijck over de uitspraken van de Finse minister van Financiën dat het uiteenvallen van de eurozone slechts een kwestie van tijd is

Wilders and Van Dijck asked the government to react to Finnish minister Tuomioja's remarks that eurozone breakup is a matter of time, and what the Netherlands is doing to prepare, and whether it will stop signing blank cheques for Brussels. Minister De Jager replied that Tuomioja is foreign minister, not finance minister, that the Finnish government did not endorse his view, that the Dutch government considers various scenarios and aims to strengthen the euro, and that existing measures (SGP automaticity, twopack, conditionality on EFSF aid) already reflect its position.
The government's aim is a strengthened euro.
De inzet van het kabinet is een versterkte euro.
Antwoord vragen Tony van Dijck,  Bontes en Wilders over de berichten "De Jager moet miljard bijlenen voor steun aan Griekenland" en "Merkel pleit voor nieuwe politieke unie in Europa"

MPs Van Dijck, Bontes and Wilders asked whether the government would refuse further Greek support and reject Merkel's call for more EU powers.
