The government answered that the Greek loan programme is funded via the EFSF without Dutch market borrowing, and that it will respond to the Van Rompuy report on the economic pillar once published.
The cabinet will come with a response to this report as soon as it has been published.
zal het kabinet met een reactie op dit rapport komen zodra dit is verschenen.
Antwoord vragen Wilders en Tony van Dijck over de uitbetaling van 4,2 miljard euro aan Griekenland

PVV MPs Wilders and Van Dijck asked the finance minister whether it is absurd to pay 4.2 billion euro to unstable Greece and whether he will stop such payments. The minister replied that the Eurogroup had already approved the Greek loan programme and that the EFSF CEO decided on the timing and amount of tranche payments, with the sum earmarked for bond repayments held by the public sector.
After approval by the Eurogroup, the CEO of the EFSF has the authority to decide on the amount and timing of the various payments of a tranche within the set deadline.

Na goedkeuring door de Eurogroep heeft de CEO van EFSF de bevoegdheid om te besluiten over de hoogte en het moment van de verschillende uitbetalingen van een tranche binnen de termijn die hiervoor is vastgesteld.
Antwoord vragen Wilders en Tony van Dijck over het Frans-Duitse voornemen om een financiële transactiebelasting in te voeren in de eurozone

Wilders and Van Dijck asked the government whether it shares business and pension-sector fears that a Franco-German financial transaction tax would cut pensions and shrink the economy, and whether it will oppose the tax. The minister acknowledged fears of higher pension costs and pointed to a cabinet reply to a CPB evaluation for the economic analysis, without committing to a position beyond that.

For a detailed analysis of the risks of structural economic contraction from a possible introduction of the financial transaction tax, and the government's view on the financial transaction tax, I would refer you to the cabinet's response to the CPB evaluation of the Financial Transaction Tax.

Voor een uitvoerige analyse van de risico's op een structurele krimp van de economie als gevolg van een eventuele invoering van de financiële transactiebelasting en de mening van de regering over de financiële transactiebelasting zou ik willen verwijzen naar de kabinetsreactie op de CPB evaluatie Financiële Transactiebelasting.
Antwoord vragen Van Bemmel en Tony van Dijck over de storingen bij ING (min ELI)

PVV MPs Van Bemmel and Van Dijck asked whether the government accepts that ING must always be reachable for internet banking, and whether the minister will talk with ING's management about a backup system. Finance Minister De Jager answered that ING has a full shadow backup system, that the outages were a rare combination of human error and technology, and that he sees no reason to discuss it further with ING's management.
In view of the above, I see no reason to exchange further views with ING's management on this.
Gelet op vorenstaande zie ik geen redenen om hier met de directie van ING verder nog over van gedachten te wisselen.
Antwoord vragen Driessen en Tony van Dijck over de integriteit van Lodewijk de Waal

PVV MPs Driessen and Tony van Dijck asked the state secretary for Foreign Affairs and the finance minister about the integrity of Lodewijk de Waal, a supervisory board member of SNV, over a 2010 Tanzania trip paid for by SNV. The government answered that the trip was SNV's own responsibility, that the costs (about 2,375 euro) were borne by SNV under normal practice, that it sees no reason to doubt the trip's legitimacy, and that it does not consider De Waal's integrity in question nor that he should step down from ING's supervisory board.
Decisions on working visits by members of its Supervisory Board are the responsibility of SNV itself.
Besluitvorming over werkbezoeken van leden van haar Raad van Toezicht is de verantwoordelijkheid van de SNV zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tony van Dijck, Van Vliet en Lucassen over het bericht dat banken weigeren om tweeverdieners met een modaal inkomen een hogere hypotheek te verstrekken

PVV MPs asked whether the AFM's objection to relaxed mortgage rules for dual-earner households with modal incomes, and its view on the limits of lending, was consistent with its supervisory role, and whether supervisors should refrain from commenting on the housing market. The minister replied that the AFM may state what it considers responsible lending under the open norm, and that the AFM and DNB, as independent supervisors, are free to comment on the housing market while respecting existing rules.
The AFM and DNB, as independent supervisors, are free to express views on the housing market.
Het staat de AFM en DNB als onafhankelijk toezichthouder vrij om zich uit te spreken over de woningmarkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tony van Dijck en Wilders over mogelijke militaire aankopen door Griekenland van miljarden euro’s

MPs Van Dijck and Wilders asked whether Greece plans billions in arms purchases (fighters, frigates, submarines, patrol boats) while relying on EU bailout funds, and whether the Dutch government would confront Greece or cut its funding. Minister De Jager answered that Greece's 2012 budget sets aside only 1 billion euros for defence, that no plans of the claimed size are known to him, and that the Troika would likely not approve such spending.
I am not aware of any plans for military purchases of the above-mentioned magnitude.
Er is mij geen informatie bekend dat er plannen zijn voor militaire aankopen van bovengenoemde omvang.

m: Amendement van het lid Bushoff c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 130 over 27 miljoen euro voor post-COVID-poliklinieken
Shifts 27 million euro within the health budget from unallocated funds to pilot specialised post-COVID outpatient clinics for two years.
With this amendment money is made available for two years, after which the clinics can be financed through the regular funding method
Met dit amendement wordt voor twee jaar geld vrijgemaakt, daarna kunnen deze klinieken volledig gefinancierd worden vanuit de reguliere financieringsmethodiek
Amendement van het lid Bushoff c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 42 over 27 miljoen euro voor post-COVID-poliklinieken
Moves 27 million euro in 2024 to a budget line for specialised post-COVID outpatient clinics by lowering the undistributed reserve.
This amendment therefore binding lowers the commitment and expenditure amounts in article 11 by 27 million euro.
Met dit amendement worden daarom taakstellend het verplichtingen- en uitgavenbedrag in artikel 11 verlaagd met € 27 miljoen.
Amendement van het lid Bushoff c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 131 over 27 miljoen euro voor post-COVID-poliklinieken
Shifts 27 million euros from the unallocated article 11 to curative care to fund specialised post-COVID outpatient clinics.
This amendment raises the commitment appropriation in article 2 (Curative Care) by 27 million euros and the expenditure amount by 12 million euros in 2024.
Dit amendement verhoogt het verplichtingenbedrag in artikel 2 (Curatieve Zorg) met € 27 miljoen en het uitgavenbedrag met € 12 miljoen in 2024.
Motie van het lid Agema c.s. over voorkomen dat de zorg implodeert door een topprioriteit te maken van de vermindering van de regeltijd
Asks the government to make reducing administrative burden in care, through digitalisation, automation and scrapping rules, an absolute top priority.
requests the government to make digitalising, automating and abolishing administrative time through screening national rules an absolute top priority
verzoekt de regering van het digitaliseren, automatiseren en afschaffen (doorlichten wet- en regelgeving vanuit het Rijk) van regeltijd een absolute topprioriteit te maken
Motie van de leden Eerdmans en Agema over het zo snel mogelijk onderbrengen van psychiatrische patiënten zonder strafblad in een instelling die bij hun complexe problematiek past in plaats van in een
Asks the government to make it a top priority to move psychiatric patients without a criminal record out of tbs clinics into institutions that fit their complex needs, as quickly as possible.

requests the government to make it a top priority to place psychiatric patients who are held in a tbs clinic without a criminal record in an institution that suits their complex problems, as soon as possible

verzoekt de regering er topprioriteit van te maken om psychiatrische patiënten die zonder strafblad noodgedwongen in een tbs-kliniek zitten, zo snel mogelijk onder te brengen in een instelling die bij hun complexe problematiek past
Motie van de leden Agema en Wilders over het opzeggen van het vertrouwen in de minister van VWS en de minister voor Langdurige Zorg en Sport
Motion expressing no confidence in the ministers of VWS and of Long-term Care and Sport over profit-making on personal protective equipment purchases.
expresses no confidence in the Ministers of VWS and for Long-term Care and Sport
zegt het vertrouwen op in de Ministers van VWS en voor Langdurige Zorg en Sport
Amendement van het lid Agema over het zelf kunnen bepalen in welke gemeente iemand wil wonen
Lets persons with a protected-living indication choose the municipality they apply to, rather than only their registered municipality of residence, to counter municipalities refusing applicants.
People with an indication for protected living must be able to decide for themselves in which municipality they want to live.
Mensen met een indicatie voor beschermd wonen moeten zelf kunnen bepalen in welke gemeente ze willen wonen.
Tweede nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Mohandis c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 21 over een evaluatie na drie en daarna periodiek na vijf jaar
Requires the minister to report to the Staten-Generaal within three years of entry into force and then every five years on the effectiveness of the healthcare fraud law.
The minister sends the Staten-Generaal a report on the effectiveness and effects of this law in practice within three years of its entry into force and then every five years.

Onze Minister zendt binnen drie jaar na de inwerkingtreding van deze wet en vervolgens telkens na vijf jaar aan de Staten-Generaal een verslag over de doeltreffendheid en de effecten van deze wet in de praktijk.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Hijink c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 23 over betrokkenheid van de IGJ

Requires that a suspicion of care fraud be confirmed by the NZa or the designated local supervisor before a provider is put on the fraud warning register, and that the IGJ be notified of each listing.
this amendment therefore provides that this justified conviction must first be confirmed by the NZa before a care provider or natural person is included in the warning register by a health insurer

dit amendement regelt daarom dat deze gerechtvaardigde overtuiging eerst moet worden bevestigd door de NZa, voordat een zorgaanbieder of natuurlijke persoon door een zorgverzekeraar in het waarschuwingsregister wordt opgenomen
Motie van het lid Agema over de green deal Zorg schrappen voor een salarisverhoging voor zorgmedewerkers
Motion asks the government to scrap the green deal Zorg and redirect 850-900 million euro to hospital funding for staff wage increases.
requests the government to scrap the green deal Zorg
verzoekt de regering de green deal Zorg te schrappen
Amendement van het lid Pouw-Verweij c.s. over het waarborgen van een brede inhoudelijke afweging ten aanzien van elk van de te nemen maatregelen.
Requires that for each measure under the Public Health Act emergency powers a separate broad substantive weighing be made and explained, so parliament can assess each measure.
This amendment ensures parliament can assess, for each measure, the broad substantive weighing underlying exercise of a power under the Wpg before the cabinet gets the green light.

Dit amendement regelt dat het parlement voor elke maatregel de brede inhoudelijke afweging kan beoordelen die ten grondslag ligt aan het uitoefenen van een bevoegdheid in de Wpg, alvorens het licht voor het kabinet op groen gaat.
Amendement van het lid Pouw-Verweij c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 21 over het toevoegen van het criterium daadwerkelijk aan de geschiktheidseis voor de toepassing van de bevoegdheden
Adds the word 'daadwerkelijk' so that emergency infectious-disease powers must actually be suitable for averting the threat, strengthening the proportionality test.
Amendement van het lid Omtzigt c.s. over middelen voor biomedisch onderzoek naar Long COVID
Shifts 10 million euro within the 2023 health budget from the corona access pass reserve to biomedical research on Long COVID.
The funding for the released amount is taken from the funds reserved for the corona access pass.
De dekking voor het vrijgemaakte bedrag wordt gehaald uit de middelen die gereserveerd zijn voor het coronatoegangsbewijs.
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Agema en Van der Staaij ter vervanging van nr. 5 over het laten vervallen van artikel 58d over de noodbevoegdheid
Removes the emergency power (article 58d) that would allow the government to take measures without a statutory legal basis.
The emergency power makes it possible to take measures without a statutory basis of authority.
De noodbevoegdheid maakt het alsnog mogelijk maatregelen te treffen zonder bevoegdheidsgrondslag.
Motie van het lid Van der Staaij c.s. over handvatten voor zorgprofessionals, zorgaanbieders en zorginkopers om casuïstiek in het hier en nu op te lossen
Asks the government, with supervisors and the care sector, to develop practical guidance for care actors on resolving case-specific shortages and to inform the House before summer 2023.
and to inform the House about this before the 2023 summer recess
en de Kamer hierover voor het zomerreces 2023 te informeren
Motie van het lid Agema over een overheadnorm in de langdurige zorg
Asks the government to adopt an overhead norm in long-term care and let staff moving to non-executive roles keep their salary in executive tasks.
requests the government to apply an overhead norm in long-term care
verzoekt de regering een overheadnorm in de langdurige zorg te hanteren
Motie van het lid Agema over een verpleeghuisplek voor hoogbejaarden met wie het thuis niet meer gaat
Asks the government to organise nursing home places for very elderly people who can no longer be cared for at home.

Amends the electronic health data exchange law to explicitly bar health insurers from the national switch point and EPD, with fines by the care authority and policyholder cancellation rights.
This amendment makes the prohibition explicit.
Dit amendement maakt het verbod expliciet.
Amendement van het lid Omtzigt c.s. over expliciet verbod op toegang tot het LSP en EPD voor zorgverzekeraars
Explicitly bans health insurers from accessing the LSP and EPD, with ministerial fines for violations, public disclosure of fines, and citizen rights to cancel policies.
The health insurer must under no circumstances have access to the LSP and to the data in the EPD.
De zorgverzekeraar dient onder geen beding toegang te hebben tot het LSP en tot de gegevens in het EPD.
Motie Agema over een richtlijn voor maximaal drie nevenfuncties
Asks the government to draft a guideline limiting supervisors, commissioners and board members in the healthcare sector to a maximum of three side positions.
requests the government to draw up a guideline on a maximum of three side functions for supervisors, commissioners and board members in the healthcare sector
verzoekt de regering een richtlijn op te stellen voor het maximale aantal van drie nevenfuncties voor toezichthouders, commissarissen en bestuurders in de zorgsector
Motie Agema over het niet zonder gevolgen blijven van het veroorzaken van financiële debacles bij Philadelphia Zorg
Asks the government to ensure that financial debacles at Philadelphia Zorg have consequences for former directors, supervisory board members and supervisors.
requests the government to ensure that causing financial debacles does not go without consequences for the departed directors, supervisory board members and supervisors
verzoekt de regering te bewerkstelligen dat het veroorzaken van financiële debacles niet zonder gevolgen blijft voor de vertrokken bestuurders, commissarissen en toezichthouders
Motie Agema over een verplichte VOG voor alle zorgmedewerkers
Asks the government to make a Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (certificate of conduct) mandatory for all care workers.
requests the government to ensure that a certificate of conduct (VOG) becomes mandatory for all care workers
verzoekt de regering te bewerkstelligen dat een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG) verplicht wordt voor alle zorgmedewerkers
Motie Agema over maximering van de omvang van zorginstellingen
Asks the government to cap the size of care institutions at three locations or 500 clients; a care-policy request not concerning checks on the executive.
requests the government to ensure that the size of care institutions is capped
verzoekt de regering te bewerkstelligen dat de omvang van zorginstellingen wordt gemaximeerd
Motie Agema over openstelling van de tunnels in de A73
Asks the government to open the A73 tunnels by 1 February 2009.
requests the government to open the A73 tunnels by 1 February 2009
verzoekt de regering voor 1 februari 2009 de tunnels A73 open te stellen
Motie Agema over verkenningen naar de A13, de A14 en de verbinding A4-A6
Asks the government to carry out an exploration of the A3, A14 and the A4-A6 connection road projects.
requests the government to carry out an exploration of the A3, the A14 and the A4-A6 connection
verzoekt de regering een verkenning uit te voeren naar de A3, de A14 en de verbinding A4-A6
Motie Van Heugten c.s. over het Hart van Dieren
Asks the government not to reopen the 53.3 million euro reserved for Hart van Dieren or start new planning, and to use the national contribution in the existing plan.
instructs the government not to reopen for discussion the 53.3 million reserved for Hart van Dieren
draagt de regering op om de 53,3 mln. die gereserveerd is voor het Hart van Dieren niet opnieuw ter discussie te stellen
Motie Agema over behoud van het deel van het FES bestemd voor verkeer en vervoer
Asks the government to ensure the part of the investment fund for transport and infrastructure does not decline in absolute terms after other purposes are added.
requests the government to ensure that the part of the fund intended for transport and transport infrastructure does not decrease in absolute terms after additions

verzoekt de regering te bewerkstelligen dat dat deel van het FES dat bestemd is voor verkeer en vervoerinfra na toevoeging van waterbeheer, verduurzaming van energiehuishoudens en ruimtelijke investeringen in absolute zin niet minder wordt
Motie Agema over het toekomstige Schelde-Seinekanaal
Asks the government to map the possibilities and limits of a future Schelde-Seine canal.
requests the government to map the possibilities and limits of the future Schelde-Seine canal
verzoekt de regering de mogelijkheden en beperkingen van het toekomstige Schelde-Seinekanaal in kaart te brengen
Motie Agema over afschaffing van de 80-kilometerzones
Motion asking the government to permanently abolish the 80-kilometre speed zones to reduce traffic congestion.
permanently abolish the 80-kilometre zones, which increase traffic congestion
de 80-kilometerzones, welke de filedruk vergroten, permanent af te schaffen
Motie Agema over het terugdraaien van alle beleid waarin een relatie bestaat tussen CO2-uitstoot en auto's
Asks the government to reverse all policy linking CO2 emissions and cars and to leave cars alone.
requests the government to reverse all policy in which a link exists between CO2 emissions and cars
verzoekt de regering alle beleid waarin een relatie bestaat tussen CO 2 -uitstoot en auto's terug te draaien
Motie Weekers c.s. over de verantwoordelijkheid van de staatssecretaris voor een vlekkeloze uitvoering van de wet
States that the state secretary must take full political responsibility for a flawless implementation of the chronic illness allowance law.
the state secretary of VWS must take her full political responsibility for a flawless implementation of the law
de staatssecretaris van VWS haar volledige politieke verantwoordelijkheid moet nemen voor een vlekkeloze uitvoering van de wet
Motie-Dibi c.s. over verdeling van de verantwoordelijkheid voor het wegwerken van de wachtlijsten in de jeugdzorg
Asks the government, together with provinces and city regions, to have each share responsibility for clearing youth care waiting lists.
requests the government, in consultation with the provinces and the three city regions, that each take its own share of responsibility
verzoekt de regering in samenspraak met de provincies en de drie stadsregio’s ieder zijn eigen deel van de verantwoordelijkheid te nemen
Motie-Agema over een aanvalsplan voor de bestrijding van loverboys
Asks the government to draw up an action plan against loverboys with fourteen measures, including tougher policing and sentencing.
requests the government to set up an action plan against loverboys
verzoekt de regering een aanvalsplan voor de bestrijding van loverboys in het leven te roepen
Motie-Sap c.s. over wettelijke minimumnormen voor de kwaliteit van de zorg
Asks the government to set statutory minimum quality norms for care so the Inspectorate can supervise effectively.
requests the government to guarantee basic care quality by setting statutory minimum quality norms for care
verzoekt de regering de basiskwaliteit van de zorg te garanderen door wettelijke minimumnormen voor de kwaliteit van de zorg op te stellen
Motie-Agema over voorstellen voor verbetering van de zorg
Motion asks the government to fund substantial structural pay rises, extra staff, equipment and training for care workers in the 2009 budget.
requests the government to structurally allocate 500 million for higher salaries for all care workers
verzoekt de regering: – 500 mln. structureel uit te trekken voor meer salaris voor alle zorgmedewerkers op de werkvloer
Motie-Agema over het terugdringen van ouderenmishandeling
Asks the government to make combating elder abuse a top priority, including mandatory certificates for care staff, a reporting point per municipality, and power for the Inspectorate to suspend staff.
power for the Health Inspectorate to suspend care workers
bevoegdheid Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg tot het schorsen van zorgmedewerkers
Motie Brinkman over het op non-actief stellen van het bestuur van Sint Maarten
Asks the Dutch government to suspend the Sint Maarten government over alleged corruption and hold new elections with integrity requirements.
requests the Dutch government to suspend the government of Sint Maarten
verzoekt de Nederlandse regering het bestuur van Sint Maarten op non-actief te stellen
Motie Agema over verplichte deelname van alle ggz-instellingen aan verbetertrajecten
Asks the government to ensure that all mental health institutions take part mandatorily in improvement trajectories to reduce coercive measures.
requests the government to ensure that all mental health institutions mandatorily participate in the improvement trajectories to reduce coercive measures
verzoekt de regering te bewerkstelligen dat alle ggz-instellingen verplicht deelnemen aan de verbetertrajecten ter vermindering van dwangtoepassingen
Motie Agema over voldoende zorgmedewerkers die kunnen reanimeren
Motion asking the government to ensure healthcare institutions have enough staff trained in resuscitation and enough defibrillators, including evenings, nights and weekends.
requests the government to ensure healthcare institutions have enough staff able to resuscitate
verzoekt de regering te bewerkstelligen dat onze zorginstellingen beschikken over voldoende zorgmedewerkers die kunnen reanimeren
Motie Agema over een landelijke richtlijn voor reanimatie gebaseerd op het "ja, tenzij"-principe
Asks the government to create a national resuscitation guideline based on a 'yes unless' principle to end uncertainty in care homes.
a national guideline comes that in case of resuscitation follows the 'yes unless' principle
een landelijke richtlijn komt die ingeval van reanimatie uitgaat van het «ja, tenzij»-principe
Motie Agema over sluiting van alle psychiatrische afdelingen waar de inspectie ernstige tekortkomingen constateert
Asks the government to ensure that psychiatric wards where the healthcare inspectorate finds serious shortcomings are closed immediately.
requests the government to ensure that all psychiatric wards where the Healthcare Inspectorate finds serious shortcomings are closed immediately
verzoekt de regering te bewerkstellingen dat alle psychiatrische afdelingen waar de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg ernstige tekortkomingen constateert direct gesloten worden
Motie Agema over wijziging van het uitgangspunt voor het terugdringen van separatie
Asks the government to measure separation use in total days rather than number of separations when reducing seclusion in care.
requests the government not to take the number of separations but the total number of days of separation nationally as the starting point
verzoekt de regering niet het aantal separaties, maar het totaal aantal dagen dat er landelijk gesepareerd wordt als uitgangspunt te nemen
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over ‘een integrale audit van ideologisch gedreven overheidsuitgaven en mogelijke systeemfraude in de overheidsadministratie’ aan

An FvD MP asked for a full audit of ideologically motivated government spending, including subsidies to organisations that have sued the state, checks on ghost employees and unused payment cards, and a DOGE-style taskforce. The government declined to create a list of litigating organisations or a taskforce, citing existing audit bodies (ADR, Algemene Rekenkamer) and disproportionate cost, while providing partial data on payroll ages and payment cards.
The Internal Audit Service of the State (ADR) and the Netherlands Court of Audit (AR) are both independent auditors that oversee lawful and efficient use of public funds.
De Auditdienst Rijk (ADR) en de Algemene Rekenkamer (AR) zijn beide onafhankelijke controleurs die toezien op rechtmatig en doelmatig gebruik van overheidsmiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de uitbuiting van buitenlandse zorgverleners

An MP asked the ministers about exploitation of foreign care workers providing 24-hour home care via personal budgets (pgb), including inspection, enforcement, and aftercare. The government answered that the Labour Inspectorate is investigating, outlined existing oversight and enforcement, and said it will consult the Inspectorate once its investigation is complete.
No statements are made about ongoing investigations.
Over lopende onderzoeken worden geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over de stand van zaken naar aanleiding van het bericht: 'Martine en Marieke moesten borstenfoto’s opsturen aan hun verzekeraar'

An MP asks the Minister of Medical Care about insurers requiring patients to send intimate photos for prior authorisation of plastic surgery, questioning whether insurers decide this themselves, whether patients and surgeons are involved in reviewing the process, who can appeal, and whether a sample-based post-hoc system would be preferable. The Minister replies that insurers have a legal duty to verify covered care, that medical photos are needed for visual assessment and are sent by the treating doctor via VECOZO rather than by patients, that a review of the procedure is ongoing without patient representatives, and that complaints can go to the SKGZ, but rejects a shift to post-hoc control.
I share the conclusion that primacy in the assessment of medical treatment lies with the treating physician.
Ik deel de conclusie dat het primaat van een medische behandeling bij de behandelend arts ligt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eerdmans en Agema over de reactie op de kamerbreed aangenomen motie Eerdmans en Agema over het zo snel mogelijk onderbrengen van psychiatrische patiënten zonder strafblad in een instelling

MPs Eerdmans and Agema asked the health minister how the government responded to a motion to move psychiatric patients without a criminal record out of TBS clinics, and why parliament was not informed earlier. The minister answered that roughly seven people are in a level-4 secure setting without a criminal title, that such placement requires a court-authorised compulsory care order under the Wvggz or Wzd, and that patients keep their legal protections.
Your House is in principle not informed about such individual cases in view of the privacy of all those involved and given the large number of individual cases in which the ministry is involved.
Uw Kamer wordt in principe niet over dergelijke casuïstiek geïnformeerd in verband met de privacy van alle betrokkenen en gelet op het grote aantal individuele gevallen waarbij VWS betrokken is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema, Claassen, Faber-van de Klashorst en Aardema over het toenemend geweld tegen zorgverleners

PVV MPs asked the health and justice ministers about rising violence against care workers, including reporting of assaults, sentencing, protective equipment costs, a ban on community sentences, mandatory anti-aggression courses and refusing treatment of violent patients. The minister answered at length, citing ongoing consultations, regional meetings and a pending sentencing study, while declining to give several figures or a cost overview.
No, I do not have an overview of this at my disposal.
Nee, ik heb hier geen overzicht van tot mijn beschikking.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat het OM over Fouad L. (verdachte van het doodschieten van drie mensen in Rotterdam op 29 september jl.) ook melding deed bij de Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd

An MP asked whether the Public Prosecution Service reported suspect Fouad L. to the health inspectorate IGJ before a fatal shooting, and what was done with that report. The minister confirmed a March 2023 OM letter and an IGJ investigation that was suspended after the shooting, but declined to share details on privacy and ongoing-investigation grounds and said the IGJ's memo is confidential.
Because of the privacy protection of those involved and the ongoing investigation by the Public Prosecution Service, I cannot share information about the report.
Vanwege de bescherming van de privacy van betrokkenen en het lopende onderzoek van het Openbaar Ministerie kan ik informatie over de melding niet delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht 'Geldproblemen door chronisch ziek kind: ik voel me een schooier'

An MP asked whether parents of chronically ill children are forced to move because the Wmo 2015 does not fully fund home adaptations, and what the government will do about the financial strain. The State Secretary answered that the Wmo appeal route exists, that moving can be an option when adaptations are not feasible, that municipalities are responsible for suitable support, and that cliëntondersteuning and a Wmo allowance for extra costs are available, without committing to new action.
I have no data on how often parents of chronically ill children have to move because home adaptations are not reimbursed under the Wmo 2015.
Ik heb geen gegevens over hoe vaak het voorkomt dat ouders van chronisch zieke kinderen moeten verhuizen omdat de aanpassingen aan hun woning niet vergoed worden vanuit de Wmo 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en Claassen over het niet vergoeden van revalidatietherapie voor een ernstig ziek kind

Two PVV MPs asked the health minister why a seriously ill boy's rehabilitation therapy abroad is not reimbursed and why parents must fund it themselves, including through crowdfunding. The minister declined to discuss the individual case because of a pending court dispute, explained the general criteria for basic-insurance coverage, and pointed to SKGZ and court routes for disputes.
As I indicated earlier, I cannot go into the specific circumstances of an individual case.
Zoals ik eerder heb aangegeven, kan ik niet ingaan op de specifieke omstandigheden van een individueel geval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over twee lopende acties om via crowdfunding geld in te zamelen voor een kankerbehandeling

An MP from the PVV asks the health minister how to respond to crowdfunding campaigns by two families for the cancer drug Enhertu, why the drug is unavailable in the Netherlands while covered in twenty other European countries, and why the early access programme ended on 1 July 2023. The minister replies that the drug is in the pricing 'sluis' pending price negotiations with the manufacturer, that he opposes early access schemes on cost and solidarity grounds, and that he will not intervene in individual cases.
I did not inform the House of this because the course of events surrounding Enhertu does not deviate from the usual procedures for drugs placed in the sluis.
Ik heb de Kamer hierover niet geïnformeerd aangezien de gang van zaken rondom Enhertu niet afwijkend is van de gebruikelijke procedures
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat spoedeisendehulppersoneel wegloopt door schaalvergroting van ziekenhuizen

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether hospital consolidation is driving emergency staff away and whether mid-sized hospitals provide better care, and asked what levers exist to reverse scale growth. The minister disputed the signal, said the optimal-scale study only covers operating costs, and stressed regional networked care and balanced concentration and dispersion of services, without committing to new measures.
It is up to insurers to steer, through their purchasing policy, toward an efficient organisation of hospital care and to ensure that all insured persons have access to good-quality care.
Het is aan verzekeraars om via hun inkoopbeleid te sturen op een doelmatige organisatie van de ziekenhuiszorg en om te zorgen dat alle verzekerden toegang hebben tot kwalitatief goede zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat het aantal kinderen met longontsteking het grootste is in drie jaar tijd

MP Agema asked the minister whether the rise in childhood and other age-group pneumonia cases was linked to COVID lockdowns, whether LHV could confirm virus circulation, and whether research into the cause would be conducted. The minister replied that the rise is attributed to several concurrent respiratory viruses and bacteria, is within seasonal patterns though early and elevated, and that surveillance at GP sentinel practices is being intensified.
In consultation with RIVM and Nivel, an intensification of surveillance at the GP sentinel practices is now being arranged.
In overleg met RIVM en Nivel wordt nu een intensivering van de surveillance bij de huisartsenpeilstations uitgezet
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht 'Klokkenluiders: De Overloop ging gebukt onder schrikbewind'

An MP asked the Minister for Long-term Care about reports that staff at Zorggroep Almere's De Overloop were suspended for misconduct including stolen medication, and whether the Inspectorate (IGJ) investigated and how staff can be kept out of care. The Minister said he cannot comment on the case, the provider has commissioned its own external investigation and promised to report to the IGJ, and the IGJ acts independently and has not been ordered to investigate.
I cannot make any statements about this from my position.
Ik kan hier vanuit mijn positie geen uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat zorg in de stervensfase nog altijd niet goed geregeld is

An MP asked the Minister for Long-term Care about a case where a widower kept receiving insurer bills a year after his wife's death, and why end-of-life care remains hard to arrange and reimburse across the Zvw, Wlz, Pgb and Wmo. The minister acknowledged the case, pointed to the NPPZ II programme, NZa work on alternative palliative care funding, and insurer brokerage services, while stating that most end-of-life care goes well.
Arranging and reimbursing end-of-life care goes well in very many cases.
Het regelen en vergoeden van stervenszorg gaat in heel veel gevallen goed.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat vrouwen die borstkanker hebben gehad of drager zijn van het borstkankergen bij een heroperatie van een borstreconstructie deze niet vergoed krijgen

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Health about reports that women who had breast cancer or carry the breast cancer gene are denied coverage for repeat breast reconstruction surgery, and why this is so. The Minister explained that coverage depends on medical necessity under published criteria (the VAV Werkwijzer), that cosmetic revision is excluded from the basic package, and that insurers, VAV and NVPC are reviewing the criteria, without committing to a specific change.
Repair operations should be reimbursed if there is a medical necessity to proceed with an operation.
Hersteloperaties dienen vergoed te worden als er sprake is van medische noodzaak om over te gaan tot een operatie.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat Gert-Jan Jonker ‘s nachts in zijn rolstoel slaapt

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister for Long-Term Care why a wheelchair user was sleeping in his chair at night for lack of home care, and asked about nursing home beds, staffing, and Buurtzorg's model. The Minister acknowledged the situation is unacceptable, pointed to the health insurer's duty of care and a practice team working on a solution, and otherwise gave general policy answers, declining to endorse claims about staffing hours or Buurtzorg's rollout.
This must not happen, which is why I asked the practice team of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport to work with him to find a solution so that he is helped to bed every day.

Dit mag niet gebeuren, daarom heb ik het praktijkteam van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport gevraagd samen met hem te kijken naar een oplossing, zodat hij toch elke dag naar bed wordt geholpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en Maeijer over het bericht dat het Erasmus MC vlees bant en snoepautomaten heeft verwijderd

MPs Agema and Maeijer asked the minister whether Erasmus MC's ban on meat and candy bars and removal of snack machines imposes a lifestyle on patients and whether the government should stop such dictation. The state secretary answered that hospitals are responsible for their own food offer, that choices remain available, and that the hospital is not banning anything.
Healthcare organisations are themselves responsible for the food offer in their institutions.
Zorgorganisaties zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor het voedingsaanbod in hun instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over de uitspraken inzake de toekomst van de ouderenzorg gedaan in het televisieprogramma Nieuwsuur

An MP asked the Minister for Long-Term Care about the future of elderly care, clustered housing versus nursing-home places, criteria and costs of Wlz care, and supervision in clustered settings. The Minister answered that more nursing-care places will be needed after 2030, explained the differences in criteria, tariffs and supervision, and gave the building targets and subsidy conditions.
It is currently not registered whether Wlz clients live in a clustered setting.
Er wordt momenteel niet geregistreerd of Wlz-cliënten woonachtig zijn in een geclusterde setting.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat de zorgkantoren eerder bezwaar maakten bij het ministerie van VWS over de stapeling van kortingen waar ouderenzorgorganisaties mee te maken krijgen

An MP asked whether care offices had objected to the ministry about stacked cuts hitting elderly care organisations, and whether those cuts were justified. The minister replied that care offices only expressed concerns (no formal objection), denied any cuts over the past five years, pointed to rising spending, and refused to reverse the measures, stating the Wlz budget for 2025 onward is for a future cabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over de eigen bijdrage voor een kunstgebit

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister about the 25% co-payment for dentures, its cost to patients, whether extraction costs are covered, how many people lack teeth due to cost, and the cost of abolishing the co-payment. The minister confirmed the coverage rules, said extractions are only covered in exceptional cases, estimated about EUR 53.35 million per year to abolish the co-payment, and pointed to wider work on dental access.
This cannot be determined so specifically.
Dit is niet zo specifiek te achterhalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Agema over het door de Europese Commissie behouden van een monopolie op een duur MS-medicijn

MPs Van den Berg and Agema asked the minister whether the European Commission overrode an EMA scientific assessment to keep the Tecfidera MS monopoly, costing the Netherlands savings, and what the Netherlands did in the Standing Committee. The minister answered that the issue follows a 2023 Court of Justice ruling, that discussions are ongoing in the Standing Committee so he will not pre-empt them, that the case is unique and he opposes stretching exclusivity, and that he will study whether pharmaceutical legislation needs correcting.
No decision has yet been taken on the consequences of the European Court's ruling for the marketing authorisations already granted to generic products.
Er is op dit moment nog geen besluit genomen over de gevolgen van de uitspraak van het Europese Hof op de afgegeven handelsvergunningen voor generieke producten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over welke huidige minister politiek verantwoordelijk is voor de Mondkapjesdeal

The PVV MP Agema asks which current minister is politically responsible for the Mondkapjesdeal (face-mask deal) that lost EUR 100.8 million, questioning why the Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport answers for it when the former minister and the current health minister are the responsible parties. The minister confirms earlier answers, explains she is responsible for the coordination of COVID-19 accountability including the additional PBM procurement investigation, and says the state's lawyer is monitoring claims and reports were passed to the Public Prosecution Service.
In addition, I have passed the reports to the Public Prosecution Service to assess whether there may be criminal culpable conduct in the transactions examined.
Daarnaast heb ik de rapporten aan het OM overgedragen om te beoordelen of er mogelijk sprake is van strafrechtelijk verwijtbaar handelen in de onderzochte transacties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over de uitspraken over de toekomst van de ouderenzorg gedaan in het televisieprogramma Nieuwsuur

An MP asks the Minister for Long-Term Care why she claims the sector cannot keep providing care as now, citing administrative burden, staff shortages, sick leave, the shortage of nursing home places and waiting lists, and why she does not act on proposals. The Minister responds by citing demographic and workforce data, the Ontregel programme and subsidies, a commitment to a WOZO programme and a 40,000 extra nursing-care places target by 2030, and rejects accusations of neglect.
I do not have data on overhead at individual institutions.
Over gegevens van de overhead bij individuele instellingen beschik ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over welke bewindspersoon op dit moment politiek verantwoordelijk is voor de mondkapjesdeal waarbij 100,8 miljoen euro belastinggeld verloren ging

An MP asked which minister is currently politically responsible for the face-mask deal that lost 100.8 million euros, and why the minister responsible is not the one handling the debate on the Deloitte report. The Minister for Long-term Care and Sport answers that she handles accountability coordination for COVID-19 at VWS, including the PBM procurement investigation, while the responsibility question was addressed earlier, and she confirms the report's findings on contacts with the suppliers.
As Minister for Long-term Care and Sport, I am responsible for the process of 'coordination of COVID-19 accountability' at VWS.
Als Minister voor Langdurige Zorg en Sport ben ik verantwoordelijk voor het proces «coördinatie verantwoording COVID-19» bij VWS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht 'Vrijblijvend kwaliteitskompas is feestje voor zorgaanbieder'

An MP asks the Minister for Long-Term Care why the new quality compass for nursing homes is non-binding, whether it abandons the staffing norm, and whether staff cuts are worsening the nursing-home staff shortage. The Minister replies that all parties support the compass, a deadline of 1 December 2023 is set with an independent chair, the government denies cutting staff and says 10,000 to 12,000 nursing vacancies remain.
The Generic compass 'Working together on quality of life', including measurement instruments, must be ready by 1 December 2023.
Het Generiek kompas «Samen werken aan kwaliteit van bestaan», inclusief meetinstrumenten, moet uiterlijk 1 december 2023 klaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over ’het antwoord dat oud-minister Martin van Rijn verantwoordelijk is voor de mondkapjesdeal waar 100,8 miljoen euro mee verloren ging’

An MP asks whether the current Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport is the constitutional successor responsible for the 100.8 million euro face-mask deal with RGA, whether the former minister cooperated with the Deloitte investigation, and whether the former minister forced renegotiation. The Minister replies that ministerial responsibility follows the policy portfolio (PBM policy lies with the VWS minister), that the former minister did cooperate with interviews and handed over mailboxes, that the legal advice is to await ongoing investigations and prosecution before recovering damages, and that the report does not show the former minister forcing renegotiation, though he did ask an official to contact Van Lienden.
The advice of the state attorney and VWS lawyers is to await the outcomes of the ongoing (further) investigations and the prosecution service's procedures.
Het advies van de landsadvocaat en de juristen van VWS is om de uitkomsten van de lopende (nadere) onderzoeken en de procedures van het OM af te wachten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het plotseling afbreken van een kankerbehandeling zonder overleg met de patiënt

An MP asked the Minister of Health why a cancer chemotherapy treatment was abruptly stopped without consultation with the patient, whether insurers and providers are failing their duties, and what can be done for affected patients. The Minister answered that the interruption stemmed from a misunderstanding about prior authorisation for care from a German provider, that the insurer has since approved the treatment, that agreements are in place with German parties to prevent recurrence, and that insurers must inform policyholders about contracted care under existing regulations.
A treatment that has already started may not be interrupted by uncertainties about reimbursement.
Een behandeling die al gestart is, mag niet worden onderbroken door onduidelijkheden over de vergoeding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het uitstel van antwoorden over coronawobs

An MP asked the Minister of Health why answers to earlier written questions on corona-related damage claims (coronawobs) were delayed, how many such claims remain and what they cost, and whether the answers were being held back until after the elections. The Minister replied that more time was needed to collect the information, that he wants to inform parliament correctly and completely, and that he aims to deliver the answers as soon as possible.
I attach importance to informing the House correctly and completely. As also follows from the postponement letter, I needed more time to gather the requested information.
Ik hecht eraan de Kamer correct en volledig te informeren. Zoals ook volgt uit de uitstelbrief had ik meer tijd nodig de gevraagde informatie bij elkaar te zoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over coronawobs

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Health about the handling of Wob and Woo public-access requests related to the COVID-19 crisis, including staffing, costs, and daily penalty payments (dwangsommen) for late decisions. The Minister answered that 428 requests were received by mid-February 2023, 138 were completed, around 290 remain open, staffing and costs are substantial, dwangsommen rose from €15,400 in 2021 to €223,100 in 2022, and measures such as AI-assisted document review are being used, without giving a firm completion date.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over de schriftelijke antwoorden over het bijna overstromen van de kinder-ic’s als gevolg van de coronamaatregelen

An MP from the PVV asks the health minister whether lockdown measures against COVID-19 caused the near-overflow of children's ICUs with RS-virus patients, the rise in invasive group A streptococcus infections and other rebound infections, and why ICU capacity was not expanded and why operational beds are 999 rather than the 1,700 claimed. The minister answers that the effects of measures on RS are hard to determine, that RS followed a normal seasonal pattern with co-circulating viruses, that capacity was not short, that expansion to 1,150 beds is planned under the Integrated Care Agreement, and that 999 is the baseline operational capacity with flexible scale-up.
To what extent the corona measures specifically influenced the current numbers of RS infections is, however, difficult to determine.
In hoeverre de coronamaatregelen specifiek van invloed zijn geweest op de huidige aantallen RS-infecties is echter moeilijk te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en Beertema over het bericht ‘Financieel niet rond kunnen komen tijdens opleiding in de zorg’

MPs Agema and Beertema asked whether medical students cannot afford their clinical rotations and whether the stipend of 100 euro per month is adequate. The minister replied that students can access student finance including loans during rotations, that no data exists on dropouts for financial reasons, and that the basic grant is being reintroduced.
No figures are available on the number of medical students who stop their clinical rotations each year for financial reasons.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal Geneeskundestudenten dat jaarlijks stopt met coschappen om financiële redenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over medicijnen waar zowel het eigen risico als een eigen bijdrage voor geldt

An MP asked the minister whether patients who cannot afford medicines are harmed by the deductible and co-payments, and asked for a list of medicines subject to a co-payment. The minister replied that co-payment status depends on the insurer's preferred-medicine arrangements so no complete list exists, pointed to medicijnkosten.nl, defended the co-payment as an incentive for cost-effective care, and said the monitor on cumulative payments will decide on further research.
All of this means that I do not have, and cannot draw up, a list, overview or enumeration of outpatient medicines for which a co-payment or the deductible is always charged.

Dit alles maakt dat ik geen lijst, overzicht of opsomming heb of kan opstellen van extramurale geneesmiddelen waarvoor in alle gevallen een eigen bijdrage of het eigen risico in rekening wordt gebracht.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van den Berg, Agema, Kuiken, Westerveld, Koekkoek, Stoffer, Azarkan, Gündoğan, Den Haan, Pouw-Verweij, Hijink, Van Esch en Van der Plas over longcovid onderzoek

MPs from many parties asked the health minister about the future of Long COVID research, the 2022 motion calling for more structural biomedical research, earlier incorrect answers on biomedical studies, the funding available and its duration, and whether structural money will be provided. The minister answered that about 14 million euro is currently spent on around twenty studies, thirteen with a biomedical component, that a knowledge agenda is being commissioned from ZonMw, and that extra multi-year funding and an expertise centre are being considered, to be decided in May.
In addition, I intend to make extra budget available for multi-year research and an expertise centre for post-COVID.
Daarnaast ben ik voornemens om extra budget beschikbaar te maken voor meerjarig onderzoek en een expertisecentrum post-COVID.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over wie politiek verantwoordelijk was voor de mondkapjesdeal

MP Agema asked which minister was politically responsible for the face-mask deal with Relief Goods Alliance, and whether the former minister van Rijn or de Jonge bore that responsibility. The government answered that the minister for Medical Care and Sport (van Rijn) was constitutionally responsible for the procurement, not de Jonge, and that officials bear no political responsibility.
As indicated in the answers to questions 4 and 5, the Minister for MZS was constitutionally responsible for concluding the agreement with RGA.
Zoals aangegeven bij de antwoorden op vraag 4 en 5 was de Minister voor MZS staatsrechtelijk verantwoordelijk voor het sluiten van de overeenkomst met RGA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over de beantwoording van schriftelijke vragen over de concentratie van kinderhartinterventies

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister of Health why answers to earlier written questions on concentrating children's heart interventions were sent late, which sources the Minister consulted, what evidence supports concentration, and whether the NZa's warnings on emergency care were set aside. The Minister answers that the answers were sent within the deadline, lists the consulted parties and scientific sources, argues that the NZa's integral perspective will be pursued in a different order, and commits to sending answers to the Chamber before a final decision.
I have also spoken with the patient organisations.
Ik heb daarnaast gesproken met de patiëntenorganisaties
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het proces rond besluitvorming over de concentratie van interventies bij aangeboren hartafwijkingen

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister whether concentrating paediatric and complex adult heart interventions in two centres is driven by market competition and whether it should be taken out of the market, and what the consequences are for the receiving hospitals' capacity. The minister denies that revenue or market competition is the driver, says the concentration serves quality, keeps two centres licensed under the Wet op de bijzondere medische verrichtingen, and states that the NZa impact analysis finds the receiving UMCs can expand, while staffing (PICU nurses) will be addressed by an independent commission.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer en Agema over het bericht dat het sterftecijfer voor kanker in Nederland hoger ligt dan het EU-gemiddelde

MPs Maeijer and Agema asked the Health Minister about reports that Dutch cancer mortality exceeds the EU average, and about cancer policy, screening, a national cancer plan and access to cancer medicines. The minister answered that incidence is high due to past smoking and screening, that mortality has fallen 11%, that a Nationaal Kanker Collectief is being set up, and that the sluis procedure for expensive medicines is maintained for cost control.
I have asked the Health Council to advise me on lung cancer screening, bearing in mind the relevant criteria for responsible screening.
Ik heb de Gezondheidsraad gevraagd om mij te adviseren over een screening op longkanker, indachtig de relevante criteria voor verantwoorde screening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht 'Radioloog.nu bindt strijd aan met wervingsbureaus vanwege ‘absurd’ hoge marges'

An MP asked the Minister for Long-term Care about reported very high margins charged by medical staffing agencies and whether the government will stop them. The minister acknowledges excessive margins, says only a limited share of costs is agency profit, and states talks with agency associations on a code of conduct plus programme actions on flexible labour.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat de kinder-ic’s vol liggen met jonge RS-patiëntjes

An MP asked the health minister about reports that paediatric intensive care units were full with young RSV patients, the timing of the outbreak, postponed operations, IC staffing shortages, RSV vaccination timing and whether more child IC beds are needed. The minister explained the atypical RSV season after COVID measures, said no healthy life years were lost and no capacity shortage occurred, cited staffing training measures, and said RSV vaccine advice is pending.
Paediatric wards were able to cope with the pressure and there was at no point insufficient availability.
Kinderafdelingen konden de drukte aan en er is op geen enkel moment onvoldoende beschikbaarheid geweest.
Antwoord op van het lid Agema over het bericht dat er sprake zou zijn van ‘onzuivere besluitvorming’ in de strijd om de kinderhartcentra

An MP asked the minister for her reaction to a press report alleging lobbying and improper decision-making in the concentration of paediatric heart surgery centres, and about a CDA MP's role in the 2021 decision to reduce four centres to two. The minister said the NZa impact analysis was sent to parliament, the NFU is advising on locations, and that the CDA MP's contact had no influence on the decision.
That is why I asked the NZa at the beginning of 2022 to carry out an impact analysis.
Daarom heb ik de NZa begin 2022 gevraagd een impactanalyse uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over 1300 meldingen over onveiligheid van papieren rietjes bij de NVWA

An MP asked the health minister about around 1,300 consumer reactions to the NVWA appeal on unsafe paper straws, the minister's earlier characterisation of paper straws as an inferior solution, and why the plastic straw ban is not withdrawn. The minister answered that the reports were reactions to an appeal rather than confirmed safety incidents, that the ban stays, and that the industry is investigating straw safety.
However, there are no 1,300 reports of unsafety, but 1,300 reactions to the NVWA's appeal, ranging from dissatisfaction with the straws to possible near-suffocation incidents.
Er is echter geen sprake van 1.300 meldingen van onveiligheid, maar van 1.300 reacties op de oproep van de NVWA
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het rapport van de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit dat verstrekkende gevolgen ziet van de concentratie van kinderhartchirurgie

An MP asked the Health Minister how the government will respond to the NZa report warning of far-reaching effects from concentrating paediatric heart surgery at two of four centres, including nurse retention, process transparency and patient access. The Minister answered that the NFU is being asked to advise on locations and mitigation measures, that he has consulted patient and professional bodies, and that he may decide himself if the NFU fails, while largely not addressing questions about lobbying parties and some workforce points.
I ensure this by informing your House about the various steps and underlying information in the decision-making process.
Ik borg dit door uw Kamer te informeren over de verschillende stappen en onderliggende informatie in het besluitvormingsproces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat van de bijna 22.000 hoogbejaarde wachtenden, 4.734 urgent wachten, wat een stijging van 70% is

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister for Long-Term Care about the rise in urgent nursing home placement waits, the timing of placements, and the care-intensity profiles of those waiting. The Minister replied that 307 people are urgent and 4,430 active, that most urgent cases are placed within the norm, that the waiting list rose to about 22,000, and that the government will talk with regions about organising home care better, while giving no firm timeline for clearing the list.
I am starting these talks in those places where this problem is greatest.
Ik begin met deze gesprekken op die plaatsen waar dit probleem het grootst is.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Agema over de beantwoording van vragen naar aanleiding van de begroting van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

Rep. Agema (PVV) asked the Health Minister to list which outpatient medicines carry both a co-payment and the deductible, the indications, and whether unaffordable co-payments cause patients to skip necessary medication. Minister Kuipers answered that combined charges depend on the case, that he will not abolish co-payments or the deductible, and that a monitor on cumulative patient payments is underway.
I am not willing to abolish the co-payment and the deductible.
Ik ben niet bereid de eigen bijdrage en het eigen risico af te schaffen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over haar reactie op de uitspraak van de Hoge Raad over het hinderpaalcriterium inzake de Vrije Artsenkeuze en het verlagen van de tarieven met 25–35% door verzekeraars voor ongecontr

An MP asks the Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport how she responds to the Supreme Court rulings on the hindrance criterion of free choice of provider, and to insurers cutting reimbursement for non-contracted mental health and home care by 25-35% from 2023, which may create a two-tier system; she asks why citizens are referred to courts and whether the government will stop the cuts before year end. The minister answers that the rulings permit generic discounts in principle but must be assessed case by case against the hindrance criterion, that complaints can go to insurers, the dispute body or courts, and that the cuts are part of the Integraal Zorgakkoord, with the hindrance criterion as a condition.
The hindrance criterion is laid down in law. It is for the dispute body and the court to assess in specific cases whether the insurer's reimbursement conflicts with the hindrance criterion.

Het hinderpaalcriterium ligt besloten in de wet. Het is aan de geschilleninstantie en de rechter om in specifieke gevallen te beoordelen of de vergoeding van de zorgverzekeraar in strijd is met het hinderpaalcriterium.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over een opiniestuk waarin wordt gepleit de zorgverzekeraars uit het zorgstelsel te halen

An MP asked the health minister whether they know an op-ed calling for health insurers to be removed from the system, what insurers cost per firm, and how the system would work without them. The minister confirmed awareness, tabled 2021 operating costs per insurer (about 81 euro per insured, 2.6% of care costs, down from earlier years), and argued that the functions insurers perform would still need to be carried out under any alternative model.
Even without the current health insurers, the tasks they perform in the current system must still be carried out.
Ook zonder huidige zorgverzekeraars moeten de taken die zij in het huidige systeem uitvoeren worden vervuld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het Deloitte-onderzoek naar de mondkapjesdeal

The MP Agema asked the minister about the Deloitte report on the face-mask deal, including which officials were CDA members and their functions. The minister confirmed knowledge of the report but declined to disclose officials' functions and party membership, citing personal data protection and Article 68 of the Constitution.
Given the traceability of the (special) personal data you requested, I therefore cannot share with you either the function or the political party membership of VWS officials.

Gelet op de herleidbaarheid van de door u gevraagde (bijzondere) persoonsgegevens kan ik daarom zowel geen functie alsook geen lidmaatschap van een politieke partij van VWS functionarissen met u delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het Deloitte-onderzoek naar de mondkapjesdeal

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether she knew of the Deloitte report on the face mask deal, whether a named civil servant was a CDA member and what function that official held at the ministry. The minister confirmed awareness of the report, explained that names, functions and party membership of officials are withheld under Article 68 of the Constitution and the GDPR, and agreed to answer before the committee debate.
Given the traceability of the (special category) personal data you requested, I therefore cannot share with you either the function or the political party membership of officials.
Gelet op de herleidbaarheid van de door u gevraagde (bijzondere) persoonsgegevens kan ik daarom zowel geen functie alsook geen lidmaatschap van een politieke partij van ambtenaren met u delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht ‘Minder administratie als oplossing voor personeelstekort’

PVV MP Agema asked the Minister for Long-term Care whether reducing administrative burden is the solution to staff shortages in care, citing Berenschot figures on time spent on administration. The minister agreed reducing unnecessary administrative burden can contribute, outlined the [Ont]Regel de Zorg programme and IZA commitments, but said a broad integrated approach is needed.
Reducing unnecessary administrative burden can make a substantial contribution to reducing the current staff shortages in care.
Het verminderen van onnodige administratieve lasten kan een substantiële bijdrage leveren aan het terugdringen van de huidige personeelstekorten in de zorg.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat een medewerker van vaccinproducent Bilthoven Biologicals besmet is met het poliovirus en dat dit aan het licht kwam door een driewekelijkse rioolcheck bij het Utr

An MP asked the Minister of Health about a reported poliovirus infection of a Bilthoven Biologicals employee detected through sewage monitoring, and about lab leak theories regarding COVID-19. The Minister said the incident is unacceptable, that the Omgevingsdienst and IGJ asked for an investigation, and that a bill introducing a permit requirement for polio facilities is in preparation, while the questions on COVID origins were answered by referring to published research and noting no further information was available.
I have prepared a bill proposing a permit requirement for polio facilities.
Ik heb hiertoe een wetsvoorstel voorbereid, waarin een vergunningplicht voor poliofaciliteiten wordt voorgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en Kops over het bericht 'Chronisch zieken hebben weinig baat bij het prijsplafond: ‘Het voelt als een oneerlijke strijd’'

PVV MPs Agema and Kops asked how the government will address chronically ill and disabled people who cannot afford energy bills, including whether the energy price cap can be raised or differentiated for high medical energy use. The minister acknowledged the hardship, said differentiation within a price cap is not feasible, pointed to municipal Bijzondere Bijstand and other measures, and promised to inform parliament on a related motion.

In reply to your questions 5 and 6, the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport will inform Parliament about the motion by MP Van der Plas et al. on energy compensation for higher energy costs due to medical causes.
Als antwoord op uw vraag 5 en 6 zal de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport (VWS) het Parlement informeren over de motie van het Kamerlid Van der Plas c.s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Agema over het bericht ‘Gespecialiseerde arrestatieteams politie hebben handen vol aan verwarde personen’

MPs Helder and Agema asked the Justice and Security Minister about rising police incidents involving confused persons, the workload of specialised arrest teams, and whether care rather than police should handle them, including questions on street triage, the Eindhoven pilot, bed capacity and dementia shares. The government answered that police intervention is sometimes necessary, that E33 registrations are not suited to steering information, that care is not a police core task, and that it will strengthen police-care-social domain cooperation, with a regional dashboard and an analysis of E33 data promised.
To gain more insight into the problem, Justice and Security and the police are currently working together on an analysis of the E-33 reports.
Om meer inzicht te krijgen in de problematiek, werken JenV en de politie momenteel samen aan een analyse van de E-33-meldingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat bij vrouwen met borstimplantaten nieuwe vormen van kanker zijn gevonden

An MP asked the health minister about reports of new cancer types, including skin and lymph node cancers, linked to breast implants, and whether Dutch women should get MRI screening and be warned. The minister said more research is needed, sees no reason for extra warnings or MRI screening, and noted that no implant is fully safe while pointing to existing information, monitoring and a pending assessment of fat transfer as an alternative.
I will continue to monitor the situation surrounding breast implants together with the IGJ and inform your House about important developments.
Ik blijf samen met de IGJ de situatie rondom borstimplantaten in de gaten houden en bij belangrijke ontwikkelingen uw Kamer hierover informeren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Paulusma, Van den Berg, Agema, Hijink, Bikker, Stoffer, Van Esch, Azarkan, Westerveld, Kuiken, Koekkoek, Van der Plas, Den Haan, Gündoğan en Sylvana Simons over de aangenomen moti

MPs asked the health minister about the adopted motion on Long COVID research, citing US and Dutch figures on prevalence and work incapacity, and asked for an estimate of its size in the Netherlands and a letter on implementation. The minister answered that around one in eight people report lasting symptoms, that 18 ZonMw studies and a RIVM LongCOVID study are under way, and that a joint knowledge agenda and an expert centre are being prepared, without a fixed timeline for the letter.
I refer to the annex 'Preparation and protection – other relevant topics related to the long-term approach to the coronavirus' attached to the letter on the long-term COVID-19 approach.

Antwoord 5 Ik verwijs hiervoor naar de bijlage «Voorbereiding en bescherming – andere relevante onderwerpen die verband houden met de langetermijnaanpak van het coronavirus» 6 bij de Kamerbrief langetermijnaanpak COVID-19.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht 'Wijkverpleging gebruikt nog veel onnodige vijfminutenregistratie'

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister for Long-Term Care about reports that a third of home-care providers still use the time-consuming five-minute registration, and what steps would end it. The minister says the practice is unacceptable, that about 8% still use the manual form which will be targeted, and that the government will actively approach remaining providers to support the switch to the alternative standard.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over de licht verhoogde kans op borstkanker voor GGD’ers door constante desinfectie van de handen met ethanol

An MP asks the Minister of Health why GGD staff were instructed to disinfect their hands with ethanol up to 150 times per six-hour shift despite RIVM findings of a slightly raised breast cancer risk, and who is liable for resulting harm. The Minister replies that the RIVM risk is very small, the work instruction was changed to a maximum of 25 times per day after an internal GGD review, GGD staff should contact their employer, and the health risks of alternative disinfectants are judged safe when used as prescribed.
GGD staff can direct questions about their specific situation to the contact person designated by the employer (the regional GGD or the temp agency).
GGD-medewerkers kunnen voor vragen over hun specifieke situatie terecht bij de door de werkgever (de regionale GGD of het uitzendbureau) aangewezen contactpersoon.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over papieren rietjes

The MP Agema (PVV) asked the Minister of Health about the safety of paper straws after an NVWA warning, including the risk to children and people with disabilities, and asked whether the plastic straw ban should be reversed. The Minister acknowledged the risk, said manufacturers are responsible for product safety and should find safer alternatives, and declined to reverse the ban.
I have no figures on that.
Ik heb daar geen cijfers over.
Antwoord op van de leden Agema en Van der Plas over de inzet van influencers tijdens de coronacrisis

MPs Agema and Van der Plas asked how many influencers the government deployed during the COVID-19 crisis, which messages, on which platforms, at what cost, and whether they opposed dissenting views or MPs. The minister answered in detail: 60 influencers were used under the Alleen Samen campaign, costs were listed, and the government denied commissioning influencers to counter dissenters or MPs.
In total, 60 influencers were deployed during the coronavirus crisis under the Alleen Samen campaign, both paid and unpaid.
In totaal zijn 60 influencers ingezet tijdens de coronacrisis in het kader van de campagne Alleen Samen, zowel betaald als belangeloos.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Westerveld, Van Esch, Agema, Sylvana Simons, Koekkoek, Kuzu, Van der Plas, Eerdmans en Den Haan over de gewiste opnames van de OMT-vergaderingen

MPs asked whether recordings of OMT (Outbreak Management Team) meetings fall under the Archiefwet, whether the 14 April 2020 recording was destroyed and by whom, and about COVID-19 hotspot archiving lists. The minister answered that audio recordings are used only to draft minutes, that the minutes are archived while recordings are deleted as standard practice, and that some answers (selection lists, hotspot lists) would follow later.
An audio recording of an OMT meeting is deleted by the secretariat after the minutes are finalised. There is no registration of this.
Een geluidsopname van een OMT-vergadering wordt door het secretariaat verwijderd na het definitief vaststellen van het verslag. Hier is geen registratie van.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat Buurtzorg Nederland al haar zorgmedewerkers gaat indelen in een hogere salarisschaal

An MP from the PVV asked the minister whether the government would follow Buurtzorg in placing all its care staff in a higher salary scale, how many staff Buurtzorg employs, and what starting, mid-career and late-career salaries are for district nurses, nursing assistants, primary school teachers and police officers. The minister answered that salary levels are set by collective bargaining partners rather than by government, gave the requested staffing and shortage figures and salary examples, and noted that the government provides annual funding for pay increases.
Determining the level of salaries in care is ultimately the responsibility of employer and employee representatives in the sector who negotiate at the collective bargaining table.
Het uiteindelijk vaststellen van de hoogte van salarissen in de zorg is de verantwoordelijkheid van werkgevers- en werknemersvertegenwoordigers in de zorg die aan de cao-tafel onderhandelen

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over de reactie van de minister op het meerderheidsverzoek van de commissie VWS van 4 februari 2022 om een spoedige reactie te geven op het bericht dat positief geteste zorgmedewerker

An MP from the PVV asks the Health Minister why the government's 7 March 2022 reply to a committee request did not address the consequences of deploying positive-tested healthcare workers for the unwithdrawn bill extending the corona access pass to workplaces, and why it cited the 15 February letter. The minister answers that the bill is being held in abeyance, the 1G pass in high-risk settings ends on 23 March 2022, the 2G differentiation law will be withdrawn, and the government drops the pass in healthcare, while maintaining that deploying positive-tested staff and the bill are not contradictory.
Holding the bill extending the corona access pass to workers allows the cabinet to examine whether a pass requirement for employees in pass-required sectors can contribute to this main goal.

Het aanhouden van het wetsvoorstel Tijdelijke wet verbreding inzet coronatoegangsbewijzen stelt het kabinet in staat om te onderzoeken of de mogelijkheid tot het beschikken over een ctb-plicht voor werknemers werkzaam in ctb-plichtige sectoren kan bijdragen aan dit hoofddoel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over meldingen dat kleine kinderen bijna zijn gestikt in papieren rietjes

An MP asked the Health Minister whether inspectorates would investigate reports of children nearly choking on paper straws, and whether the environmental benefit outweighs the risk, and whether the ban should be reversed. The minister said the NVWA is investigating, the IGJ has no incident reports and will act on its own risk assessment, and that the plastic straw ban stays because alternatives must meet safety rules.
I support the NVWA's initiative to investigate this further and will keep an eye on whether the supervisor receives signals that additional measures are needed.
Ik steun het initiatief van de NVWA om dit nader te onderzoeken en zal in het oog houden of de toezichthouder signalen krijgt dat aanvullende maatregelen nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het grote verschil in prognoses voor tekorten aan zorgmedewerkers in de verpleeghuizen tussen november 2020 en nu

Agema (PVV) asks why the projected nursing-home staff shortage fell sharply between the November 2020 forecast (31,700 in 2022) and the January 2022 forecast (17,900), and how the government will maintain care quality while a planned 350 million euro cut equivalent to 6,000 staff is made to the quality framework. The minister attributes the difference to updated data, revised COVID assumptions and a changed methodology, and says the cut is a redesign of the framework toward outcome-based norms with more informal care and technology.
For 2030 a shortage between 54,100 and 70,200 employees was expected.
Voor 2030 werd een tekort tussen de 54.100 en 70.200 werknemers verwacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over negen ernstig zieke MS-patiënten die voor een stamceltransplantatie vast zitten in een kliniek in Moskou

An MP asked the Minister of Health why nine seriously ill MS patients were stranded in a Moscow clinic for stem cell treatment and how they would be brought home, and why the therapy is not reimbursed in the Netherlands. The minister said one patient had returned via Turkey, referred others to the embassy, and explained the treatment is not yet covered because its effectiveness is not proven, while insurers and the professional body are discussing possible coverage for end-stage patients.
Stem cell transplantation for MS patients is currently not given or reimbursed in the Netherlands, because the effectiveness of this treatment has not (yet) been demonstrated.
Stamceltransplantatie bij MS-patiënten wordt op dit moment in Nederland niet gegeven en niet vergoed, omdat de effectiviteit van deze behandeling (nog) niet is aangetoond.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over de uitspraak van de Minister gedaan tijdens het plenaire debat van 24 februari jl. over de gelijktijdige opnamestops in de spoedeisendehulpposten van vier ziekenhuizen in het noo
