An MP asked the Minister of Health why he claimed during a February 2022 debate not to know how many emergency department intake stops occurred nationwide, and asked for a table of stops from 2015 to 2021. The Minister answered that only four regions consistently register stops, provided a table of stop counts for those regions, and promised to send an NZa information card on the topic.
Not all ROAZ regions consistently register stops or apply the same definitions for them.
Niet alle ROAZ-regio’s registreren consequent stops of hanteren hiervoor dezelfde definities.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het Duitse onderzoek naar de werking van mondkapjes tegen besmetting met corona

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister for the government's reaction to a German study on FFP2 mask protection and how it would affect the reproduction number, daily positive tests and transmission risk indoors. The minister answered that masks are one part of a broader measure package, that the effect of individual measures was not calculated, and that the OMT advises medical masks indoors in high-risk settings.
It was not calculated per measure and per setting how large the effect on the reproduction number is.
Er is niet per maatregel en per setting berekend hoe groot de het effect op het reproductiegetal is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over de werking van mondkapjes naar aanleiding van het coronadebat van 1 december jl.

An MP asked the health minister how much the face-mask rules and advice reduced the reproduction number in each setting according to RIVM modelling, and whether a single mask rule should replace the patchwork. The minister answered that the measures were assessed together, no per-setting effect was calculated, and the mask requirement was relaxed from 25 February while keeping advice on type II masks.
It was not calculated per measure and per setting how large the effect on the reproduction number is.
Er is niet per maatregel en per setting berekend hoe groot het effect op het reproductiegetal is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport 2G wil aanhouden

An MP from the PVV asks the health minister why the 2G coronavirus pass bill is being held back rather than scrapped, why the pass is being extended to education and work, and when all restrictions and passes will end, given that many adults lack a booster. The minister says the 2G bill was withdrawn following a parliamentary motion, the pass is a temporary tool reviewed on 15 March 2022, and the work-place bill is only postponed for further study.

On 10 February, your House adopted a motion by members Van der Staaij and Omtzigt requesting the government to withdraw the bill allowing a coronavirus pass based solely on vaccination or recovery (2G).
Op 10 februari jl. heeft uw Kamer een motie van de leden Van der Staaij en Omtzigt aangenomen, waarin de regering wordt verzocht om het wetsvoorstel in te trekken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over mondkapjes in de buitenlucht

Dutch MP Agema (PVV) asked the health minister for the scientific basis of the advice to wear face masks outdoors, the evidence that outdoor transmission occurred, and how many infections the measure prevents. Minister Kuipers answered that the advice rests on WHO and ECDC guidance, that masks were part of a package of measures not assessed individually, and that the advice stays while the mandate on public transport is lifted.
It has not been calculated per measure and per setting how large the effect on virus spread is.
Er is niet per maatregel en per setting berekend hoe groot het effect op virusverspreiding is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over geactualiseerde berekeningen van de TU Delft en het UMCU naar de effectiviteit van het coronatoegangsbewijs

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister of Health why updated TU Delft and UMCU calculations on the effectiveness of the COVID access pass were not obtained and shared with the House, despite a committee request. The Minister replies that the models were refreshed and presented orally to the OMT, that no written report exists, and that the government will not request or publish the updated calculations.
I do not consider it necessary to ask the researchers for the updated calculations.
Ik vind het niet nodig om de onderzoekers te vragen naar de geactualiseerde berekeningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat de winkelsluiting in ons land heeft geleid tot wel 300% meer omzet in België

An MP from the PVV asked the health and economic affairs ministers about reports that Dutch shops closed during lockdown boosted Antwerp sales, and whether this undermines the lockdown measures, including requests for mobility data, the scientific basis for closing shops, and the losses to Dutch retailers. The government answered that residents were not encouraged to shop in Belgium but were not barred, that compliance remained high, that the OMT advice underpinning the closures is available to parliament, and that the total lost retail revenue cannot be determined.
Breakdown of turnover figures for the lockdown period is not available.
Opgesplitste omzetcijfers voor de lockdownperiode zijn niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over de proportionaliteitstoets inzake de coronatoegangsbewijzen

An MP asked the minister whether he is aware of his earlier answer on the effectiveness of COVID certificate applications, and whether he will send the proportionality assessment to the House. The minister confirms awareness and states that the assessment was already included in the explanatory notes to the amended temporary measures regulation and sent to the House, as required by the Public Health Act.
The proportionality assessment was included in the explanatory notes to the amendments of the Temporary Measures Regulation and has therefore already been sent to the House.
Antwoord 2 De proportionaliteitstoets is in de toelichting bij de aanpassingen van de Tijdelijke regeling maatregelen opgenomen 2 en dus reeds naar de Kamer gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over de beantwoording van eerdere Kamervragen over code zwart

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Health why code black is declared only under strict conditions, whether it is merely a convoluted way of saying no ICU bed is available, and who should declare it given the minister's own responsibility for corona policy. The minister answered that code black (phase 3) follows a defined procedure via the LNAZ and supervisory verification, may be signalled from several sectors, and is declared by the Minister of VWS after a careful process.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over de uitspraak dat een boostervaccin een 30x lagere kans op een ziekenhuisopname geeft

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether his claim that a booster vaccine gives a 30 times lower chance of hospital admission applies to triple-vaccinated people, the unvaccinated, and age groups, and requested tables by age and vaccination status. The Minister confirmed the figure (33x, RIVM data) compares boosted people with the unvaccinated, explained the limits of the data, and gave age-specific tables, while declining to provide a breakdown of unvaccinated, double- and triple-vaccinated shares over one date due to methodological reasons.
I indicated that this chance is more than 30 times lower based on the most current figures on vaccine effectiveness at that time.
Ik heb aangegeven dat deze kans ruim 30 keer lager is op basis van de op dat moment meest actuele cijfers over vaccineffectiviteit.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat een zorgmedewerker die 10.000 pillen achterhield van verpleeghuisbewoners voor wie deze geneesmiddelen noodzakelijk zijn en dat de regering voornemens is het Waar

An MP asked the minister about a care worker who withheld 10,000 pills from nursing home residents and about the government's plan to abolish the Waarschuwingsregister Zorg en Welzijn, a warning register for abusive care workers. The minister replied that abolition was decided by the sector body RegioPlus, that the government supports it, that other instruments such as the vergewisplicht, VOG and BIG register remain, and that a broader analysis of instruments will follow.
Whether or not to abolish the Waarschuwingsregister is not up to me.
Het al dan niet opheffen van het Waarschuwingsregister is niet aan mij.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat een zorgmedewerker die 10.000 pillen achterhield van verpleeghuisbewoners voor wie deze geneesmiddelen noodzakelijk zijn en dat de regering voornemens is het Waar

MP Agema asked the government about a nurse who withheld 10,000 pills from nursing home residents and about the planned closure of the Waarschuwingsregister Zorg en Welzijn, a warning register for care workers. The minister answered that the closure was a decision by RegioPlus, supported by the government, that existing preventive and repressive instruments will be analysed and strengthened, and that the register was abandoned earlier because mandatory participation had legal and practical objections.
I am convinced that precisely the combination of preventive and repressive instruments contributes most strongly to safe care relationships.
Ik ben ervan overtuigd dat juist de combinatie van inzet van preventieve en repressieve instrumenten, het sterkst bijdraagt aan veilige zorgrelaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over mogelijke belangenverstrengeling bij de sluiting van de kinderhartchirurgie in Groningen

Agema (PVV) asked the Health Minister whether there was conflict of interest in closing paediatric heart surgery in Groningen, whether the minister's own earlier plan to keep three centres was overruled, and about survival of drowning victims and loss of regional expertise. Minister Kuipers denied any conflict of interest, defended the concentration into two intervention centres on quality and volume grounds, and said regional cardiology care would remain.
There is no conflict of interest and I firmly reject this accusation.
Van belangenverstrengeling is geen sprake en ik werp deze beschuldiging verre van mij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Agema over aerosole transmissie en het belang van ventilatie

Opposition MPs Kuzu and Agema asked the health minister about aerosol transmission of SARS-CoV-2, the role of ventilation, and why COVID policy did not focus more on it. The minister answered that transmission is mainly droplet-based at short range, that aerogenic transmission is addressed through ventilation advice and measures, and that existing ventilation rules and funding for schools remain the policy.
We have adjusted the government website for this specific passage, because it is not in line with current insights.
Wij hebben de website rijksoverheid.nl aangepast voor deze specifieke zinsnede, want dat is niet conform de huidige inzichten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het 137e OMT-advies over mondkapjes in de buitenlucht

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister about the 137th OMT advice on face masks outdoors, questioning the scientific basis and whether the advice frightens people away from fresh air. The minister answered that the advice applies to crowded outdoor public spaces where 1.5 metres cannot be kept, citing the more transmissible Omicron variant, and that the government adopted the advice from 15 January 2022.
The cabinet has decided to adopt the 137th and 138th OMT advice regarding face masks outdoors.
Het kabinet heeft besloten om het 137 e en 138 e OMT-advies met betrekking tot mondneusmaskers in de buitenlucht over te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en Maeijer over de Europese coronareispas

Opposition MPs Agema and Maeijer (PVV) asked the Minister of Health why the EU COVID digital certificate was limited to nine months after full vaccination, questioning the scientific basis, the consistency with earlier promises of free travel for fully vaccinated people, and the logic of requiring boosters while outbreaks occurred among triple-vaccinated staff. Minister Kuipers defended the nine-month validity as an EU-wide uniform rule based on waning protection against omicron, said boosters improve protection, and acknowledged that policy must sometimes be reconsidered as circumstances change.
The Netherlands agreed on 16 December 2021 to the maximum validity of the EU digital COVID certificate (DCC) of 9 months after full vaccination.
Nederland heeft op 16 december 2021 ingestemd met de maximale geldigheid van het digitale EU-covidcertificaat (DCC) van 9 maanden na volledige vaccinatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht ‘Wat 61 positieve PCR-testen op Schiphol ons kunnen leren’

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister about 61 positive PCR tests among arriving passengers at Schiphol from South Africa, including the high share of vaccinated passengers, the testing rules, CT values and the GGD Kennemerland testing. The minister answered that the findings reflect reduced protection against Omicron, that the test rules were not a full 1G setting, that the testing and CT practices are not linked to the vaccine pass, and that research is ongoing.
These tests were not carried out for the purpose of the corona access certificate and therefore do not provide information about it.
Deze testen zijn niet gedaan ten behoeve van het coronatoegangsbewijs en geven hier dus ook geen informatie over.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Westerveld, Hijink, Kuiken, Agema, Tellegen, Bikker, Van der Laan en Werner over bescherming medische gegevens in de intensieve kindzorg

MPs asked whether insurers sharing medical data of chronically ill children with third parties for efficiency checks, without parental consent, complies with GDPR article 9, and whether a consent requirement is needed. The minister answered that insurers remain controllers responsible for processors, that the AVG applies, that the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens supervises compliance, and that no consent requirement is planned.
It is not for me to assess a specific data processing operation. That is for the Dutch Data Protection Authority.
Het is niet aan mij om te treden in de beoordeling van een specifieke gegevensverwerking. Dit is aan de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat de voorzitter van de Nederlandse Vereniging van Intensive Care en tevens OMT-lid stelt dat de modellen van de modelleurs nu veel optimistischer zijn terwijl Neder

An MP asked the minister whether she knew of the NVIC chair and OMT member's claim that modeller projections were now much more optimistic, whether she was aware of the severe lockdown, and whether she would send the new models to parliament immediately. The minister confirmed awareness of the interview and of the measures, and explained the RIVM's two models and that the advice based on the 135th and 136th OMT meetings had already been sent to parliament.
I sent your House the advice based on this 135th OMT on 24 December.
Ik heb uw Kamer het advies dat gebaseerd is op dit 135e OMT op 24 december doen toekomen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en Maeijer over het bericht dat de Minister van VWS de interne fitnessclub in het Erasmus MC openhield terwijl sportscholen gesloten zijn

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport why the internal gym at Erasmus MC stayed open while public gyms were closed under the lockdown, and whether all gyms would reopen. The minister answered that the gym is a closed indoor space for staff, permitted under the rules with group-size and distancing limits, and that gyms were reopened on 14 January.
As for the fitness room at Erasmus MC, it is a closed indoor space.
Voor wat betreft de fitnessruimte in het Erasmus MC is sprake van een besloten binnenruimte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over de brief Overwegingen 1G

An MP asks the Health Minister about the modelling behind the 1G, 2G and 3G coronavirus access-pass options, questioning the assumed vaccine effectiveness and whether the figures are up to date. The minister answers that effectiveness figures are based on the latest studies, that the TU Delft modelling will be shared early 2022, and that the data will be updated regularly, without agreeing to a fixed two-week limit.
I aim to share that research with your House early 2022, before the parliamentary debate on the bills on the broader use of the coronavirus access pass and 2G.
Ik streef ernaar dat onderzoek begin 2022 met uw Kamer te delen, voor de behandeling van de wetsvoorstellen over de bredere inzet van het coronatoegangsbewijs en 2G.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Agema over de Kamervragen die op 29 november jl. werden beantwoord

The PVV MP Agema asked the health minister about vaccine effectiveness against hospital admission for people aged 80 and over, and the share of vaccinated patients admitted in November 2021. The minister answered with RIVM figures for those aged 70 and over, showing a slight decline in effectiveness from 86% to 84%, and noted that the RIVM reports over at least 8-week periods.
The RIVM cannot determine how strong this decline exactly is, due to uncertainties and the confidence intervals used.
Het RIVM kan niet bepalen hoe sterk deze afname exact is, vanwege onzekerheden en de betrouwbaarheidsintervallen die gebruikt worden.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Agema over de Franse aanbevelingen ter bescherming van mensen die niet of onvoldoende op coronavaccinatie reageren

Agema (PVV) asked the minister about French recommendations for people who respond poorly to COVID vaccination, including the antibody therapy Evusheld, and whether the Netherlands should pre-order it. The minister answered that the medical profession decides on use, data are insufficient, no pre-order is placed yet, and that the number of non-responders is unclear.
I remain in discussion with the professional group and the manufacturer.
Ik blijf met de beroepsgroep en fabrikant in gesprek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over code zwart

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister of Health whether statements by ICU leaders and the LCPS chair that ICU capacity is effectively exhausted and that triage on non-medical grounds (code black) is already occurring are accurate, and whether the ICUs are in phase 3a. The Minister answers that the ICU capacity remains available, that phase 3 has not been declared since the criteria are not yet met, that the system is in phase 2d, and that the existing phase-3 policy framework is reiterated to care providers.
Therefore there cannot yet be a declaration of phase 3, because a phase 3 declaration only occurs once all care capacity is fully used.
Daarmee geldt dat er nog geen sprake kan zijn van (afkondiging van) fase 3, want van (afkondiging van) fase 3 is pas sprake als alle zorgcapaciteit volledig is benut
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over de brief waarin de Minister schrijft dat het klassieke Valneva-vaccin geen onderdeel uitmaakt van de vaccinportefeuille en de aangenomen motie Bikker c.s

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister about the classic Valneva protein vaccine, which the minister said was not part of the vaccine portfolio and was only reserved pro forma, and about a motion urging faster availability of protein vaccines. The minister answered that such vaccines await EMA approval, no steps can be skipped, and no faster route exists, while promising to ask the Health Council for advice once approved.
No steps may be skipped and will not be skipped. I currently see no possibilities to speed up this process.
Er mogen en worden geen stappen overgeslagen. Ik zie op dit moment geen mogelijkheden om dit proces te versnellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over de beantwoording van de Kamervragen van de begroting Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport voor het jaar 2022

An MP asks the Minister of Health why the answer to an earlier written question did not contain the calculation behind the claim that a 'code black' (ICU capacity shortage) remained possible, and requests the underlying sums with sources. The Minister says the figures come from RIVM occupancy projections, describes the method and points to the technical briefing slides, but does not provide a full written calculation.
Can you have the calculation written out in full and provided with source references?
Kunt u de som helemaal uit laten schrijven en voorzien van bronvermeldingen?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over de beantwoording van de Kamervragen van de begroting Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport voor het jaar 2022

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister of Health about earlier answers on the 2022 budget, including whether ICU expansion to 1,700 beds needs extra nurses, vaccination rates and a claimed ICU maximum of 680 COVID patients, and why elective surgery must still be postponed. The Minister confirms the earlier answers, explains that ICU expansion to 1,150-1,350 beds requires scaling back planned care because of staff shortages, and points to the existing temporary policy framework and the LNAZ contingency plan.
To enable scaling up ICU bed capacity and the associated scaling up in the clinic, regular care, including planned operations, must be scaled down.
Om opschaling van de beddencapaciteit op de IC en de bijbehorende opschaling in de kliniek mogelijk te maken moet reguliere zorg, waaronder geplande operaties, worden afgeschaald.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het tweetbericht dat de kans dat een volledig gevaccineerd persoon door corona in het ziekenhuis moet worden opgenomen twintig keer kleiner is dan iemand die niet volledig gevacc

An MP asked the Health Minister about his tweet claiming vaccinated people are twenty times less likely to be hospitalised with COVID, and why Belgian figures show a much smaller gap. The minister acknowledged the tweet, explained the Belgian comparison covered only one week and used different methods, and cited RIVM data showing lower but still substantial protection over longer periods.
For determining vaccine effectiveness it is better to look at a longer period, as the RIVM also does.
Voor de bepaling van de vaccineffectiviteit is het beter te kijken naar een langere periode, zoals het RIVM ook doet.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over de tabel gebaseerd op NICE-data waaruit blijkt dat er nu meer tachtigplussers met corona zijn opgenomen in onze ziekenhuizen dan vóór de start van de vaccinatiecampagne

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister to explain a tabulated NICE dataset showing more elderly COVID-19 hospital admissions than before vaccination began, and why the Chamber must rely on citizens for such data. The minister argued the rise reflects high infection pressure and waning vaccine effectiveness, denied the age-80 figure is higher than before vaccination, refused to share the table daily since the data are publicly available and incomplete, and said the 48-hour deadline was too short.
The RIVM has no information on whether a person is a nursing home resident in the hospital and IC admission data from Stichting NICE.
Het RIVM heeft geen informatie over of een persoon een verpleeghuisbewoner is in de data over ziekenhuis- en IC-opnames van Stichting NICE.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Wilders, Agema, Hijink, Westerveld, Kuiken, Pouw-Verweij, Van der Staaij, Gündoğan, Van Esch, Simons en Den Haan over de uitspraken van dhr. Gommers dat hij over 10 dagen code zwa

MPs asked the Minister of Health whether the November measures were working, given expert warnings of a 'code black' hospital crisis, and questioned testing, boosters, staffing, supplies, security and a medium-term strategy. The Minister answered that pressure on care is rising, phase 2d was declared with planned care being scaled down, and that no indication yet exists for phase 3, while defending booster timing and deferring some points to earlier letters.
I am in constant contact with field parties in order to maintain a sharp view of the current situation on the shop floor in various care sectors.
Ook ben ik constant in gesprek met veldpartijen, om scherp zicht te houden op de actuele situatie op de werkvloer in verschillende zorgsectoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat de Britse toezichthouder een coronapil heeft goedgekeurd

An MP asked the health minister about the UK approval of molnupiravir, the expected EMA decision timing, reported UK and US order volumes, EU joint procurement, and why the Netherlands does not buy directly. The minister said the EMA rolling review has started, could not confirm the order volumes, stated that the terms of the EU procurement are confidential, and justified joint procurement as securing a stronger negotiating position and fair distribution.
The agreements made on this are confidential.
De afspraken die hierover gemaakt zijn, zijn vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over een mogelijke griepprik voor alle kinderen

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Health why the government is not offering flu vaccination to all children, and about child flu hospitalisation, hospital capacity during a flu and COVID wave, and needed investment. The minister answered that the Health Council sees no reason to extend flu vaccination to healthy children given low disease burden, gave estimated child hospitalisation rates, described capacity-planning measures with a review due in November, and said staffing investment is being addressed through existing and planned instruments.
There is no registration of the number of children hospitalised with flu each year.
Er vindt geen registratie plaats van het aantal kinderen dat met griep opgenomen wordt in het ziekenhuis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat een borstkankerpatiënt naaktfoto’s van zichzelf moest opsturen naar de zorgverzekeraar

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care whether it is acceptable that a breast cancer patient had to send nude photos to her health insurer, and whether insurers will be told not to request such photos. The minister said photos should be shared only in a secure environment with patient consent, that the insurer must verify claims without judging treatment, and that Menzis and other insurers will review their procedures and inform providers.
I will also ask the other health insurers to review their procedures for exchanging photos in the context of authorisations and to actively bring them to the attention of care providers.
Ik zal ook de andere zorgverzekeraars vragen om hun procedures rondom het uitwisselen van foto's in het kader van machtigingen te bezien en bij zorgaanbieders actief onder de aandacht te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en Wilders over het bericht dat een farmaceut zijn zakken vult met de hulp van minister De Jonge

MPs Agema and Wilders asked the Health Minister about a report that pharmaceutical firm Roche profited from ministry help with COVID self-test procurement, including the lack of tendering for a 46.5 million euro order and the choice of tests. The minister denied Roche gained an unfair head start, explained the exemption procedure and the urgent direct orders, and acknowledged two procurement irregularities that were reported to parliament.
I have informed you of the irregularities in the procurement.
Van onrechtmatigheden bij de inkoop heb ik u op de hoogte gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Agema over het aanbieden van een alternatief vaccin voor 60-plussers

Two PVV MPs asked the health minister whether he would offer a non-AstraZeneca vaccine to over-60s who wanted one, after he had promised an answer within two weeks. The minister acknowledged the delay and said the 60-64 group who had not yet been vaccinated could book a mRNA vaccine at a GGD from 5 June, while those already given AstraZeneca would get their second dose from the GP.
Unfortunately I did not manage this within those two weeks, but today I have informed you about an alternative vaccine for over-60s
Helaas is het mij niet binnen die twee weken gelukt, maar heb ik u vandaag geïnformeerd over een alternatief vaccin voor 60-plussers
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Agema over het testprotocol COVID-19 bij kinderen onder de 13 jaar

PVV MPs Wilders and Agema asked the health minister whether his earlier answers on COVID-19 testing for children under 13 wrongly implied a testing obligation, since no such obligation exists. The minister confirmed there is no testing obligation, said 'must' was used as a very urgent recommendation, and declined to publicise a correction beyond assuming the public understands it.
There is indeed no testing obligation in force.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en Verhoeven over de stand van zakenbrief digitale ondersteuning pandemiebestrijding

MPs Agema and Verhoeven asked the health minister about security vulnerabilities in GGD COVID testing and tracing IT systems, whether risk analyses will be published, and data deletion and vaccination communication. The minister answered that mitigating measures reduced vulnerabilities, that risk analyses will not be published now on security advice but will be reconsidered when the audit is delivered, and that monitoring and continuous security actions are in place.
As previously promised, when the audit is delivered I will reconsider whether it is possible to make this analysis or parts of it public.
Zoals eerder toegezegd zal ik bij het opleveren van de audit heroverwegen of het mogelijk is deze analyse of delen van deze analyse openbaar te maken.

Antwoord op vragen leden Wilders en Agema over het bericht dat de heer Bouali geld kreeg van het ministerie van VWS voor een coronacampagne en ook een promo maakte voor de minister voor zijn CDA-lijsttrekkersverkiezing

PVV MPs Wilders and Agema asked Minister De Jonge whether Ali B received Health Ministry money for a coronavirus influencer campaign and whether he was paid for a promo video backing De Jonge's CDA leadership bid. The minister answered that the campaign was run via agency Roorda with artists Boef and Famke Louise and that the agency paid SPEC EUR 42,350 plus EUR 24,224 for concept work, and that Ali B was not paid for the video.
Ali B. expressed his support in a short video message for my leadership election for the CDA.
Ali B. heeft in een korte videoboodschap zijn steun betuigd voor mijn lijst0trekkersverkiezing voor het CDA.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Agema over het bericht dat de coronatestlocatie op Schiphol alweer gesloten wordt wegens gebrek aan testcapaciteit

PVV MPs Wilders and Agema asked why the Schiphol COVID test site was closing for lack of capacity, how many risk-area travellers were tested and how many were positive, what happened to the promise to test travellers before boarding, and why there was insufficient test capacity. Minister De Jonge answered that the site was a pilot to test asymptomatic people, that about 1.6% of 19,012 tested were positive, that pre-departure testing is legally hard to mandate and is being explored at EU level, and that test capacity shortages stem from material constraints and higher demand, with sufficiency expected by early October.
I have previously indicated that this is being further explored, including at European level.
Ik heb eerder aangegeven dat dit verder verkend wordt, ook in Europees verband.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Agema over het bericht dat een meneer na 123 dagen op de IC overleed aan corona

MPs Wilders and Agema asked the Minister for Medical Care about a reported COVID-19 patient who died after 123 days in intensive care, and about current ICU numbers and long ICU stays. The minister confirmed awareness of the report, gave the number of COVID ICU patients on 16 September (54), and provided a table of COVID admissions lasting over 21 days by period, but did not answer before the deadline.
On 16 September there were 54 COVID patients in the ICU
Op 16 september lagen er 54 COVID-patiënten op de IC
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Agema over het bericht dat de corona-teststraat op Schiphol ’s avonds dicht is, ook al landen er duizenden reizigers uit risicogebieden

PVV MPs Wilders and Agema asked why the Schiphol COVID test site closes in the evening while thousands of travellers from risk areas arrive, and about a 2003 SARS study showing aircraft transmission. Minister De Jonge answered that the site was a research setting, lab capacity is strained, it has been temporarily closed, EU coordination on pre-departure testing is ongoing with no mandatory testing in the Netherlands, and aircraft transmission risks appear limited.
The test site at Schiphol was a research setting examining the effect of testing people without symptoms, in this case travellers.
De teststraat op Schiphol was een onderzoeksetting waarin werd gekeken naar het effect van het testen van mensen zonder klachten, in dit geval reizigers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Agema over het bericht dat het aantal besmettingen met corona de afgelopen twee weken is gedaald.

PVV MPs Wilders and Agema asked the Health Minister why the reproduction number stayed above 1 even though weekly infections fell by 2.5 and 3.5 percent. Minister De Jonge explained how R is calculated over the preceding two weeks by RIVM, confirmed infections fell in weeks 33 and 34 but rose again from September, and noted that recent R estimates are not shown on the dashboard due to insufficient reliability.
The reliability of R estimates less than two weeks ago is insufficient and they are not shown on the dashboard.
De betrouwbaarheid voor R schattingen minder dan twee weken geleden is onvoldoende en wordt niet op het dashboard weergegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Agema over het bericht dat het RIVM het protocol voor bron- en contactonderzoek aanpaste na een telefoontje van VWS

PVV MPs Wilders and Agema asked whether RIVM changed its contact-tracing protocol after a call from the Ministry of VWS, why, and for a full list of protocol changes prompted by the ministry. The minister confirms the mid-quarantine call was dropped after RIVM and GGD GHOR consulted, citing the shortened quarantine and burdensome calls, and says protocol changes are made regularly with expert input and listed publicly.
Following this report, the Ministry of VWS inquired with RIVM whether sufficient account had been taken, in this consideration, of the upcoming adjustment to the GGD GHOR Nederland scaling-up plan.

Naar aanleiding van deze berichtgeving is er vanuit het Ministerie van VWS navraag gedaan bij het RIVM of in deze afweging voldoende rekening gehouden werd met de aanpassing van het opschalingsplan van GGD GHOR Nederland dat aanstaande was.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Agema over de uitspraak van de directeur van het RIVM gedaan tijdens de technische briefing van 11 augustus 2020 dat de besmettingen met corona in Dokkum “evident“ buiten gebeur

Opposition MPs Wilders and Agema asked the health minister whether the RIVM director's claim that Dokkum COVID infections were evidently transmitted outdoors was based only on media reports, and whether he should have investigated first. The minister confirmed awareness of the remarks, denied that the claim rested only on media reports, and said the GGD considered outdoor transmission very plausible but not certain, the director using the case as an illustration.
Mr Van Dissel used this case as an illustration that transmission outdoors is indeed possible.
De heer van Dissel heeft deze casus als illustratie gebruikt dat overdracht ook buiten wel degelijk mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Agema over het bericht dat van 70 procent van de coronabesmettingen onbekend is waar men het heeft opgelopen.

PVV MPs Wilders and Agema asked the Minister of Health about reports that for 70 percent of COVID-19 infections the source is unknown, and whether this means contact tracing is failing and whether the home-visitor limit of six persons is proportionate. The minister replied that the 70 percent figure does not mean the source is unknown, that the home is the most common setting, and that the measure is proportionate.
However, this does not mean that in all other cases we have no idea what the setting of the infection was.
Dit wil echter niet zeggen dat we in alle andere gevallen geen idee hebben wat de setting van de besmetting is geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Agema over het bericht dat de onderzoeker stelt dat bij de uitbraak van corona in een zorginstelling de ventilatie vrijwel zeker een rol heeft gespeeld.

MPs Wilders and Agema asked the Minister of Health how he responds to a researcher's claim, broadcast on Op1, that ventilation very likely contributed to a corona outbreak at a Maassluis care home, and why GGD conclusions were published before the underlying studies. The minister disputes the claim, says viral traces on ventilation equipment were very low, and attaches the public version of the study.
I have attached the public version of the study, which was published on the website of the GGD Rotterdam-Rijnmond.
Ik heb de publieksversie van het onderzoek, die op de website van de GGD Rotterdam-Rijnmond is gepubliceerd, bijgevoegd
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Agema over het twitterbericht van de minister van VWS waarin hij schrijft dat we pas veilig zijn voor het coronavirus wanneer er een vaccin is

MPs Wilders and Agema asked Minister De Jonge to justify his tweet that we are only safe from the coronavirus once a vaccine exists, and questioned why medicines, ventilation, or preparedness would not suffice, plus the Mexican flu vaccine compensation. The minister argued vaccines are the most effective preventive tool, that medicines and preparedness play supporting roles, and that the narcolepsy compensation process is still ongoing.
The process aims to reach an amicable settlement. This process is still ongoing.
Het proces is erop gericht om te komen tot een minnelijke regeling. Dit proces is nog gaande.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Agema over het bericht dat er nog steeds een tekort is aan handschoenen in de verpleeghuizen.

MPs Wilders and Agema asked the minister about reports that nursing homes still lack gloves, and why the government cannot secure protective equipment while imposing corona measures. The minister acknowledged a temporary shortage, said it has now eased, and described the ordering channels available to care providers.
There was temporarily a tight supply, but meanwhile so many gloves have arrived and are available that the situation has eased.
Er was tijdelijk een krappe voorraad maar inmiddels zijn er dusdanig veel handschoenen binnengekomen en leverbaar dat die situatie is ingelopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over de uitzending van het televisieprogramma Op1 over ouders die hun meervoudig gehandicapte kind verzorgen en verplegen en worden gekort op hun pgb-budget

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister to respond to an Op1 broadcast about parents caring for severely disabled children who see their PGB budgets cut, including which care tasks count as usual parental care and how many families are affected. The minister said he cannot judge individual cases or specific nursing tasks, pointed to nurses, the SKGZ dispute body and insurers for case-level decisions, and committed to ongoing talks with insurers and to informing parliament further.
Moreover, it does not fit the division of roles and powers for the Ministry of VWS to take a position on individual casuistry.
Bovendien past het niet in de rol- en bevoegdheidsverdeling om als Ministerie van VWS een standpunt in te nemen in individuele casuïstiek.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht van de Vereniging van Ouderengeneeskundigen (Verenso) dat stelt dat het voorkomen van een nieuwe lockdown in verpleeghuizen bij een tweede coronagolf vraagt om een an

MPs Wilders and Agema asked the Minister of Health about a Verenso statement that preventing a renewed nursing-home lockdown requires a different organisation of care, and about protective equipment, testing, deaths and the use of sedating medication in nursing homes during the lockdown. The minister answered that lessons are being drawn from the bezoekregeling, that protective equipment and testing are secured, and that IGJ is verifying signals on sedative medication use.
There are currently no hard figures available on the use of sedating medication in nursing homes.
Er zijn op dit moment geen harde cijfers beschikbaar over de toepassing van rustgevende medicatie in verpleeghuizen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Agema over het artikel ‘Helpt ventileren tegen corona? Nederland negeert Duits advies frisse lucht’

MPs Wilders and Agema asked the Health Minister about a newspaper article on ventilation against COVID-19, requesting OMT advice, Dutch research on aerogenic transmission, current infection and hospital figures, IFR, the PIENTER study and an evaluation of PCR tests. The minister mostly provided requested figures and referred to RIVM publications and a technical briefing, while declining to answer the question on the unidentified evaluation report as unclear.
For the answers to these questions, I refer you to the letter to the House of 24 June 2020 and its annex: the OMT advice.
Voor de antwoorden op deze vragen, verwijs ik u naar de Kamerbrief van 24 juni 2020 en de bijlage van de Kamerbrief: het OMT-advies.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Agema over de discrepantie tussen de berichtgeving over bestellingen en leveringen van beschermingsmiddelen en de tekorten die nog steeds worden ervaren door zorgmedewerkers

PVV MPs Wilders and Agema asked the health ministers about the gap between reports of protective equipment orders and deliveries and continuing shortages for care workers, referencing an adopted motion and the state of affairs letter, and asked whether supplies are adequate across hospitals, nursing homes, GP practices, home care, and disability/youth/mental health settings. The government answered by referring to its COVID-19 state of affairs letter of the same date rather than answering the questions separately.

The written questions from MPs Wilders and Agema (both PVV) to the Ministers of Health, Welfare and Sport and for Medical Care (2020Z06296) have been answered by letter 'COVID-19 Update state of affairs'.

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Wilders en Agema (beiden PVV) aan de Ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en voor Medische Zorg ( 2020Z06296 ) zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Westerveld, Agema, Hijink en Van der Staaij over de mogelijke doorstart van de Hoenderloo Groep

MPs Kuiken, Westerveld, Agema, Hijink and Van der Staaij asked the Minister of Health about the Hoenderloo Groep closure, his contacts with parents, steps toward a possible restart and its consistency with the Chamber's motion. The Minister replied that he visited the site, held talks with Pluryn, gemeenten and the IGJ, asked KPMG to test restart plans, and that Pluryn has offered placements for all youths while the IGJ oversees the transfer process.
I informed your House on 20 February 2020 about this, in line with my commitment in the committee debate on financial problems at youth care institutions and the Hijink et al. motion.
Ik heb uw Kamer, conform mijn toezegging in het AO «financiële problemen bij diverse jeugdzorginstellingen» en motie Hijink cs, hierover op 20 februari 2020 geïnformeerd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Agema over het bericht dat hoogbejaarden in woonzorgcentrum Mariaoord te Rosmalen dekens moeten omdoen omdat de verwarming in de gangen uitgezet is wegens CO2-gekte

PVV MPs Wilders and Agema asked the minister whether he shares the view that frail elderly residents of nursing home Mariaoord should not be left cold because heating in corridors was switched off for CO2 reasons, and what he will do about it. The minister answered that a comfortable indoor climate matters, that the Kwaliteitskader Verpleeghuiszorg applies, that the home's measures are evaluated with residents and the client council, and that the IGJ supervises quality and safety and can intervene.
That is why the measures taken are evaluated with residents and the client council so that residents' comfort is not compromised.
Daarom worden ingezette maatregelen geëvalueerd met bewoners en de cliëntenraad opdat het comfort van de bewoners niet in het geding komt.

Antwoord op vragen het lid Agema over het bericht dat het succesvolle project waarin huisartsen door meer tijd te nemen voor patiënten minder hoeven door te verwijzen, niet mag uitbreiden van de zorgverzekeraar omdat dit

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister for Medical Care why the VGZ insurer paused a successful GP project of more time per patient, which reduced referrals, allegedly because it costs hospitals revenue. The minister answered that the pilot continues into 2020 and possible expansion will be discussed later, and that regional coordination of Juiste Zorg op de Juiste Plek must weigh all parties' interests.
VGZ has informed me that it is not stopping the Positive Health pilot; they are waiting with the rollout.
VGZ heeft mij laten weten niet te stoppen met de pilot «Positieve Gezondheid», zij wachten met de uitrol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht 'Turkse appartementen gebouwd met Nederlandse zorgmiljoenen: gemeente onderzoekt rol 47 Utrechters'

An MP asked the health minister about a case in which Utrecht residents defrauded care funds to build apartments in Turkey, including whether the fraudsters would be registered in a warning register and how the 6.5 million euros would be recovered. The minister answered that a bill to allow registration of fraudsters in the Warning Register Care Fraud is being prepared for end of Q2 2020, that recovery is being pursued by the municipality and insurer, and that he will inform the House of further findings.
While the investigation is ongoing, the Public Prosecution Service cannot make statements about the means it deploys against suspects.
Lopende het onderzoek kan het OM geen mededelingen doen over de middelen die het inzet jegens verdachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en Graus over het bericht dat een zeer gevaarlijke reuzenteek aangetroffen is nabij Nederland

PVV MPs Agema and Graus asked the state secretary and ministers about reports of the dangerous Hyalomma tick near the Dutch border, its Crimean-Congo virus risk, public information, monitoring and vaccines. The minister answered at length that the risk to Nederland is currently very low, that monitoring and public information are being expanded, and that a separate tick hotline is of limited added value.
Because of the recent findings in Germany, the RIVM and the CMV will expand monitoring together with partners.
Vanwege de recente bevindingen in Duitsland gaan het RIVM en het CMV met partijen de monitoring uitbreiden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en Van Aalst over het mensonterende voorval in Zeist

PVV MPs asked ministers about a degrading incident involving a regional taxi driver filmed on Facebook, and whether low tariffs in insurer tenders cause work pressure. The minister denied a link to tariffs, said the contract with the province of Utrecht sets realistic rates and quality requirements, and will ask the NZa to explore the issue with stakeholders.
For that reason he will ask the NZa to carry out an exploration by talking with all parties (insurers, taxi unions and patient associations) about the possible problems.
Om die reden zal hij aan de NZa vragen om een verkenning uit te voeren door met alle partijen (verzekeraars, taxibonden en patiëntenverenigingen) in gesprek te gaan over de mogelijke problemen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema, Van Aalst en Madlener over de acute zorg op Voorne-Putten met het oog op aankomende wegwerkzaamheden (en afsluitingen) en de wens in de regio om het Spijkenisse Medisch Centrum op t

PVV MPs asked the ministers about acute hospital care on Voorne-Putten, given road works and bridge closures, and about reopening the Spijkenisse Medisch Centrum as a full hospital with an emergency department, acute obstetrics and weekend stay. The minister replied that care should be provided in the right place, that the 45-minute norm is the relevant standard and is under study, that bridge disruptions are managed with contingency plans, and that the hospital is not a sensitive hospital and cannot be designated as a system hospital.
Before the summer I will inform you further about my vision on developments in the hospital landscape and my role in it.
Voor de zomer zal ik u nader informeren over mijn visie op de ontwikkelingen in het ziekenhuislandschap en mijn rol hierin.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en Kops over het bericht dat een bejaard Nieuwegeins stel dat al vanwege huisuitzetting uit het leven wilde stappen vrijdag opnieuw op straat staat

MPs Agema and Kops asked about an elderly Nieuwegein couple facing eviction and homelessness, questioning priority for status holders in social housing and the closure of care home places. The minister rejected the link to status holders, stated that no one should have to live on the street, and said the couple had found temporary housing.
The couple has thus not ended up on the street.
Het echtpaar is daarmee niet op straat komen te staan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht 'Directeur Victorie vergokte ruim 1,5 miljoen euro zorggeld in Enschedees casino'

The PVV MP Agema asked the Minister of Health about reports that the director of a care provider in Almelo gambled over 1.5 million euros of care funds in a casino over five years, asking how this could happen and how the money would be recovered. The minister called it shocking, explained that the municipality and the Social Investigation Service Twente investigated, that the provider lost its contract, that the municipality filed a fraud report, and that recovery of the money is the municipality's responsibility and still being pursued.
The responsibility for recovering the 1.5 million euros of care funds lies with the municipality of Almelo.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor het terughalen van de 1,5 miljoen euro aan zorggeld ligt bij de gemeente Almelo.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat het ministerie van VWS de grootste stijging aan communicatiemedewerkers van alle ministeries heeft

An MP asked the Minister of VWS about the growth in communications staff at the ministry, its costs, campaigns on healthcare, and whether staff are used for party-political election activities. The government answered that staff work on policy communication, the growth was driven by public engagement needs, and election-campaign use is ruled out, while providing figures and campaign overviews.
No. The communications staff of VWS work on communication about policy, not on election activities.
Antwoord 18 De communicatiemedewerkers van VWS werken aan communicatie over beleid, niet aan verkiezingsactiviteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over de bizarre ontwikkelingen in de strijd om patiënten na het faillissement van het MC Zuiderzee in Lelystad

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about curators' conduct after the bankruptcy of MC Zuiderzee, including the removal of specialists, patient records handling, and whether the Inspectorate should investigate. The minister declined to intervene in the dispute between curators and specialists, said the Inspectorate saw no safety indication, and described safeguards for patient records and free choice of doctor.
I do not interfere in a matter between curators and two individual medical specialists.
Ik meng mij niet in een zaak tussen curatoren en twee individuele medisch specialisten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over een ziekenhuis in Amsterdam dat statushouders wil inzetten bij de verpleging

An MP asked the minister about a recruitment agency seeking refugees (statushouders) for an Amsterdam hospital, whether hospitals should train them, who pays for language training, whether Dutch candidates get trial placements, and whether priority schemes for refugees should end. The minister answered that hospitals choose their own recruitment, that candidates bear their own training and language costs, that Dutch candidates also qualify for trial placements, and that there is no priority scheme, while promising to draw employers' attention to underrepresented groups.
There is therefore no question of a priority scheme.
Van een voorrangsregeling is dan ook geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat apothekers schaarse medicijnen doorsluizen naar het buitenland

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care whether pharmacies are exporting scarce medicines abroad, how many patients were affected, and what measures will stop it. The minister said such export during shortages is undesirable, that the Inspectorate (IGJ) is investigating supply problems including the contraceptive pill, and that further measures will depend on those findings.
The scale on which medicines are exported abroad is unknown.
Het is onbekend op welke schaal geneesmiddelen naar het buitenland worden geëxporteerd.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat wanneer een terminale cliënt slaapt of gesedeerd is, de uren niet worden vergoed door Zilveren Kruis, waardoor waken bij iemand die dood gaat niet kan

An MP asked whether a tweet claiming Zilveren Kruis does not reimburse night-time waking for dying patients who are asleep or sedated is correct and how the minister will stop it. The minister answered that the tweet is incorrect: waking is reimbursable under the Zorgverzekeringswet when the district nurse indicates it on nursing grounds and documents it in the care plan, and volunteers can support relatives.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat wanneer een terminale cliënt slaapt of gesedeerd is, de uren niet worden vergoed door Zilveren Kruis, waardoor waken bij iemand die dood gaat niet kan

An MP asked whether health insurer Zilveren Kruis refuses to reimburse nursing hours when a terminal patient is asleep or sedated, making deathbed watching impossible. The minister answers that care indicated by the district nurse, including watching, is reimbursable when justified in the care plan, that VWS will clarify the rules via a Zorginstituut factsheet in Q1 2019, and that a palliative care campaign will follow.
If there are questions in a specific situation about the indicated hours and/or the nature of the care, it is important and advisable that a care provider contacts the health insurer to discuss this.

Mochten er in een specifieke situatie vragen zijn over de geïndiceerde uren en/of de aard van de zorg, dan is het belangrijk en raadzaam dat een zorgaanbieder contact opneemt met de zorgverzekeraar om dit door te spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht 'Grote onrust: ouderen in deze aanleunwoningen betalen bijna de helft meer voor hun maaltijd'

An MP asked the minister whether ending municipal subsidies for communal meals harms the fight against loneliness, why meal prices rose sharply in a care facility's sheltered housing, and what the extra costs of losing the social activity would be. The minister answered that responsibility lies with municipalities under the Wmo 2015, that the provider raised the price to cover costs after consultations, and that talks between the alderman, residents and provider are ongoing.
Under the Wmo 2015, municipalities are legally responsible for ensuring a suitable range of support based on the personal situation of residents.
Het is op basis van de Wmo 2015 de wettelijke verantwoordelijk van gemeenten om te zorgen voor een passend aanbod van de ondersteuning gebaseerd op de persoonlijke situatie van inwoners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat VGZ-verzekerden niet meer terecht kunnen bij het Zuyderland ziekenhuis

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care for his reaction to reports that VGZ-insured patients could no longer be treated at Zuyderland hospital, whether patient stops are unacceptable, what measures prevent budget disputes being passed on to patients, and whether the stop will be ended. The Minister answered that insurers and providers share responsibility, insurers must ensure alternative care within Treeknorm waiting times, the NZa supervises the duty of care and can intervene, and that the NZa reports VGZ has contracted enough elective care elsewhere.
The NZa supervises that health insurers comply with their duty of care and intervenes where necessary.
De NZa ziet erop toe dat zorgverzekeraars de zorgplicht naleven en grijpt indien nodig in
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en Beertema over MRI-onderzoek door het Spinoza Centre

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers whether a Spinoza Centre MRI study recruiting people with strong views on refugees, paid 25 euros, was acceptable, whether studying brain activity via political topics was bizarre, what its purpose and subsidy were, and whether such practices should end. The minister defended the recruitment as standard for attitude research, said the study was ethically approved and fundamental rather than medical, and that the equipment is not available for medical use.

The recruitment method, alongside the research methods themselves, was approved by the Standing Committee for Science and Ethics of the Faculty of Behavioural and Movement Sciences of the Vrije Universiteit.

De methode van werving is, naast de onderzoeksmethodes zelf, goedgekeurd door de Vaste Commissie voor Wetenschap en Ethiek van de Faculteit der Gedrags- en Bewegingswetenschappen van de Vrije Universiteit.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Agema, De Graaf en Markuszower over de door een prediker gedane uitspraak in een online cursus van de As Soenah moskee te Den Haag, te weten: ‘Vrouwenbesnijdenis is niet verplicht

MPs Wilders, Agema, De Graaf and Markuszower asked about a preacher's statement that female genital cutting is recommended though not mandatory, and how many girls were cut, how many cases were prosecuted, and what subsidised organisations do. The minister answered that prevalence research is under way with results expected mid-2019, that cutting is prosecuted as assault, that cases are not registered separately, and that the government funds an integrated chain approach and will report on it in a progress letter.
It therefore cannot be retrieved from the registers how many court cases of genital mutilation there are.
Het is daarom niet uit de registers te halen om hoeveel rechtszaken van genitale verminking het gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht ‘Schrik bij hoogbejaarde: Leiden halveert huishoudelijke hulp’

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether it is acceptable that Leiden reduced a 90-year-old's personal budget for domestic help by half without consultation, and whether this would be reversed. The minister replied that Leiden introduced a new, needs-based regime after case law, the budget was lowered after a call and a decision letter, and after new information the municipality raised the budget.
In this contact it did not appear that circumstances had since changed.
In dit contact is niet gebleken dat er inmiddels sprake was van gewijzigde omstandigheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat volgens experts een halvering van het aantal tabaksdoden mogelijk is

An MP asked the state secretary for health about reports that halving tobacco deaths may be possible via e-cigarettes, and whether e-cigarettes are less harmful and should be accessible to smokers. The state secretary answered that e-cigarettes are less unhealthy for individuals only if smokers fully switch, that long-term effects and population-level effects are unknown, and that proven quit-smoking methods (coaching plus nicotine replacement) are the most effective, with e-cigarettes not the first choice but not to be discouraged in specific cases.
Whether the e-cigarette leads to a net decline in the number of smokers at population level is unknown.
Of de e-sigaret op populatieniveau leidt tot een netto-daling van het aantal rokers is onbekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht ‘Managers Careyn oorzaak diepe crisis Tuindorp-Oost’

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister of Health whether mismanaging managers caused the crisis at care provider Careyn in Tuindorp-Oost, how relocation of elderly residents, high sick leave and Careyn's finances are being addressed. The Minister answers that care providers are primarily responsible themselves, that IGJ supervision of Careyn is ongoing, that 22 residents must move for safety reasons, and refers to the annual report for finances.
Care organisations are primarily responsible themselves for the quality of care and business operations as well as for continuity of governance.
Zorgorganisaties zijn in de eerste plaats zelf verantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit van de zorg en de bedrijfsvoering alsmede voor de continuïteit in het bestuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat vrijwilligers in de zorg vaak taken uitvoeren waarvoor een opleiding is vereist

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister how he responds to a report that a fifth of volunteers in care perform medical tasks requiring training, and whether it is unacceptable that municipalities expect such tasks from volunteers. The minister says such situations are incidental, reaffirms the Wet BIG rules on reserved acts and supervision, and promises a further letter on volunteer-professional cooperation by year end.
I am not aware of situations in which volunteers structurally perform medical acts for which they have not been trained.
Ik ben niet bekend met situaties waarin vrijwilligers structureel medische handelingen uitvoeren waarvoor zij niet zijn opgeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht 'Wijkzorg sjoemelt tegen ondervoeding'

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister about reports that district nurses misreport hours to get meal assistance approved for elderly people at risk of malnutrition, and who is responsible when both insurer and municipality refuse. The minister acknowledged the problem, said responsibility is clear within each system but unclear at the Wmo/Zvw boundary, and promised a joint factsheet with VNG, ZN, V&VN and ZIN before Christmas.

Furthermore, I believe it is up to care professionals, health insurers and municipalities to arrange behind the scenes that help is provided as smartly and timely as possible and is financed in the right way.

Daarnaast vind ik het aan zorgprofessionals, zorgverzekeraars en gemeenten om achter de schermen te regelen dat de hulp zo slim en tijdig mogelijk wordt geleverd en op de juiste manier wordt bekostigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het advies om de Mammaprint niet te vergoeden vanuit de basisverzekering

An MP asked why the Health Care Institute advised against reimbursing the MammaPrint breast cancer test from basic insurance, whether cost played a role, and whether the method should be independently reviewed. The minister replied that the Institute judged MammaPrint lacks proven added clinical value over the standard test, that cost played no role, and that the Institute's own scientific advisory council and joint European assessment provide sufficient safeguards, so no independent review is planned.
The Health Care Institute reassessed whether adding the MammaPrint test to the standard Adjuvant! Online (AO!) test in women with early-stage breast cancer leads to health gain.
Het Zorginstituut heeft opnieuw beoordeeld of het toevoegen van de test MammaPrint aan de standaardtest Adjuvant! Online (AO!) bij vrouwen met een vroeg stadium borstkanker leidt tot gezondheidswinst
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat kankermedicijn nivolumab niet meer vergoed wordt

An MP asked why the cancer drug nivolumab is no longer reimbursed after a medical society judged its newer melanoma indication not proven effective, and how the government squares this with patients and the drug's recognition. The minister replied that reimbursement requires proven effectiveness under the law, that the government will not second-guess the scientific judgement of the professional body, and that existing melanoma indications remain covered.
The law states that care is only reimbursed if it is proven effective.
In de wet is aangegeven dat zorg alleen vergoed wordt als deze bewezen effectief is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht ‘Zeeuwse zorginstelling is in nood maar toezichthouders verhogen eigen beloning’

MP Agema asks why supervisory board members of Arduin, a Zeeland care institution in distress and closed by the Inspectorate, raised their own pay by 66%, and whether sanctions will be taken against its board. The minister answers that pay of supervisory boards is set under the WNT, that he asked CIBG to check for a violation and enforce if found, and that the decision was unwise given Arduin's situation.
I have asked CIBG to investigate whether there is a violation of the WNT.
Ik heb het CIBG gevraagd te onderzoeken of hier sprake is van overtreding van de WNT.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat de gemeente Eindhoven huishoudelijke hulp niet levert (wat al erg is) maar dat er daarenboven notabene een verplichte eigen bijdrage moet worden betaald

An MP asks the health minister whether it is acceptable that Eindhoven suspends home-help (Wmo) care for three weeks in summer and makes clients pay a fixed contribution anyway, and whether the law should change. The minister answers that reducing care unilaterally is not allowed, that the matter is a local responsibility handled by the municipal council, that a subscription-rate contribution is planned from 2019, and that no legal amendment is needed.
A unilateral (temporary) reduction in the scope of support, such that it can no longer be regarded as appropriate, must not occur.
Van het eenzijdig (tijdelijk) terugbrengen van de omvang van de ondersteuning, met als gevolg dat deze niet langer als passend kan worden aangemerkt, mag geen sprake zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht 'VVD onder vuur om Wmo-advies'

An MP asked whether VVD senator Anne-Wil Duthler voted on a bill containing advice from her own firm, how much work the firm received, and whether the tender would be disclosed. The minister answered that the firm was hired in 2013 for a privacy impact assessment at a total cost of EUR 78,400 via a single-tender procurement, and that part of its advice was adopted.
Bureau Duthler was asked to carry out this privacy impact assessment.
Bureau Duthler is aangezocht om deze pia te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower, De Roon en Agema over het beleid van Jeugdbescherming Rijnmond inzake reisadviezen naar Israël

PVV MPs asked whether the Rotterdam youth protection agency JRR gives children under supervision a negative travel advice for Israel, why it differs from Turkey or Morocco, and whether it should allow travel to such areas when accompanied by an adult. The minister answered that the certified institution assesses each trip case by case for every destination, that the ministry's advice is only one factor, and that it will not restrict the institution's power to refuse travel when child development is at risk.
There is no general negative travel advice for any country.
Er is daarbij geen sprake van een algemeen negatief reisadvies voor welk land dan ook.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Agema en De Roon over de arrestatie van de Britse activist en islamcriticus Tommy Robinson

PVV MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the government would protest to the UK over the arrest and sentencing of Tommy Robinson, citing free speech and his safety in prison, and whether the government accepts that suppressing Islam critics fuels public anger. The minister replied that free speech applies to everyone, that Robinson reportedly breached his earlier parole conditions, and that the government trusts the UK legal process and sees no reason to comment further.
The cabinet has confidence in the legal process in the United Kingdom and sees no reason to comment further on this.
Het kabinet heeft vertrouwen in de rechtsgang in het Verenigd Koninkrijk en ziet geen aanleiding zich hierover nader uit te spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht ‘Langer in kliniek door tekort aan thuiszorg’

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister about reports of patients staying longer in clinics due to a shortage of district nurses, including how many could not die at home and when the shortage would be resolved. The minister gave rough shortage estimates, said no figures on deaths at home were known, pointed patients to their insurer and the Nza for care gaps, and referred to a workforce action programme with a target of near-zero shortages by 2022.
Regarding this requested data, I am not aware of any figures.
Ten aanzien van deze gevraagde gegevens zijn mij geen cijfers bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht ‘Doorstroming van oudere in ziekenhuis ligt plat door griep’

MP Agema asks whether the minister knows of a report that elderly patient flow from hospitals is blocked by flu, and how large the shortage of nursing-home places is. The minister acknowledges the report, corrects the terminology, says he has no figures on needed extra capacity per region, and describes agreements with providers and insurers, including a promised letter on coordination points.
I have no overview of whether, and if so how much, extra capacity was needed per region
Ik heb geen overzicht over of en zo ja, hoeveel extra capaciteit er per regio nodig was
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat thuiszorgorganisaties cliënten van Zilveren Kruis weren

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether home-care providers excluding Zilveren Kruis clients reflects restrictive contracting, why a minimum turnover blocks small providers, and how patient choice is protected. The minister denied any compromise of choice, said he will report on stimulating multi-year contracting before summer 2018, and said Zilveren Kruis has a duty of care to its insured.
I have no insight into that in this specific pilot.
Daar heb ik in deze specifieke pilot geen zicht op.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht ‘Enorm tekort aan wijkverpleegkundigen: “Mijn zoon slaapt op de bank”’

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether a shortage of district nurses leaves terminally ill patients waiting for care, how large the shortage is, and what will be done before year end. The Minister answered that insurers have a duty of care, the NZa has received no signals of non-compliance, workforce figures will follow in spring, and regional action plans and extra funding are being pursued.
People who experience problems accessing district nursing care can contact their insurer.
Mensen die problemen ondervinden met de toegang tot wijkverpleegkundige zorg kunnen contact opnemen met hun verzekeraar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops, De Graaf en Agema over het bericht dat senioren in Apeldoorn overdonderd zijn door de komst van Turkse leeftijdsgenoten

MPs from the PVV asked ministers whether it is acceptable that a housing corporation in Apeldoorn plans to let vacated flats in a senior complex to Turkish elderly receiving home care, without consulting current residents, and asked for the plans to be stopped. The minister replied that corporations are free to set allocation policy within the Housing and Tenancy Acts, that the corporation appears to have followed the legal consultation procedure, and that residents can complain to the independent complaints committee or the courts, but that the minister has no role in individual allocation policy.
As far as I can tell, the housing corporation has acted within the framework of the law.
Voor zover ik kan nagaan heeft de woningcorporatie binnen de kaders van de wet gehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat de gemeente Eindhoven met het criterium ‘schoon huis’ wil gaan werken, terwijl jurisprudentie aangeeft dat dit niet mag

An MP asks whether Eindhoven's plan to use a 'clean house' performance criterion for home help, and a court ruling against a similar criterion, is lawful and how the government will respond. The minister answers that the approach fits the Central Council for Appeal ruling if the agreed steps are recorded in the municipality's decision, that the municipality must still ensure the service is financially feasible for residents, and that no action is needed.
Legal certainty is guaranteed because the support plan forms part of the decision.
De rechtszekerheid is gewaarborgd doordat het ondersteuningsplan onderdeel is van de beschikking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en Gerbrands over wel of geen deal met Vertex Pharmaceuticals inzake het geneesmiddel Orkambi

PVV MPs Agema and Gerbrands asked the health minister whether the refusal to reimburse Orkambi reflected a price dispute with Vertex, questioning the cost-effectiveness assessment, the delay and the negotiation tactics. The minister defended the delay on price and cost grounds, said she had now reached an acceptable price and would add Orkambi to the basic package from 1 November, while answering many points by referring to the Zorginstituut or to other countries.
Vertex, however, has not given insight into its development costs.
Vertex heeft echter geen inzage gegeven in hun ontwikkelingskosten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht ‘Het nieuwe product van kinderbeschermers is intimidatie’

An MP asked the government whether 'drang' (pressure within voluntary child-protection support) is used as a product, whether it lowers coerced measures, how often it is applied, and whether organisations profit from it. The Minister answered that drang is a professional attitude within voluntary support, that no national figures exist, that only a judge may order out-of-home placement, and that the Jeugdwet interim evaluation may examine its use.
Yes, I share this view and this is also legally arranged. A child judge decides on a coerced out-of-home placement.
Ja, deze mening deel ik en dit is wettelijk ook zo geregeld. Een kinderrechter beslist over een gedwongen uithuisplaatsing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat de wachttijden voor een plaats in een verpleeghuis toenemen

An MP asked the state secretary whether rising waiting times for nursing home places are caused by acute placements, whether people avoid Wlz applications because of higher co-payments, and what will be done. The secretary replied that most applicants get an offer within six weeks and waiting figures are stable, and that a study requested by a motion will examine whether people delay Wlz applications for financial reasons.
During the thirty-member debate on acute care on 13 September, MP Ellemeet submitted a motion asking the government to investigate this.
Tijdens het dertigledendebat over acute zorg van 13 september jl. heeft mevrouw Ellemeet een motie ingediend, waarin zij de regering verzoekt om hier onderzoek naar te doen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat een vertrekkend bestuurder een zorginstelling vier ton kost

An MP asked the state secretary about a Scheidsgerecht Gezondheidszorg ruling awarding a departing executive EUR 400,000, questioning its appropriateness given the organisation's losses and supervision, and whether legal options exist to prevent such payments. The secretary confirmed the ruling, said the Raad van Toezicht is responsible for a careful dismissal process, noted the ruling is binding and that the amount reflects salary, severance and costs under the WNT norms.
The ruling of the Scheidsgerecht Gezondheidszorg is binding.
De uitspraak van het Scheidsgerecht Gezondheidszorg is bindend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat zorginstellingen verontrustend vaak verlies leiden

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that care institutions often make losses, including bankruptcies of home-care organisations due to low tariffs, staffing costs, use of the extra funds for minimum staffing in nursing homes, and whether banks charge higher interest to institutions missing a profit norm. The state secretary said he has no overview of bankruptcies, pointed to municipal duties and the price regulation AMvB, explained the cost rise was a relative decline due to incidental factors, said EUR 275 million is available for staffing with inspection levers via care offices, and said banks weigh strategy more than short-term results.
I have no overview of home-care organisations that went bankrupt in 2015 and 2016 (due to low tariffs).
Ik heb geen overzicht van thuiszorgorganisaties die in 2015 en 2016 failliet zijn gegaan (door te lage tarieven).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gerbrands en Agema over het bericht dat stervende patiënten overgeplaatst worden om het sterftecijfer laag te houden

Two PVV MPs asked the minister whether hospitals moving dying patients to keep mortality rates low, as reported in a column, is shocking and whether the Inspectorate will act. The minister replied that the column contains no concrete evidence of substandard care, that hospital mortality ratios need nuance, and that she sees no reason for further action or sanctions.
Concrete indications of substandard care for dying patients cannot be derived from the article.
Concrete aanwijzingen voor tekortschietende zorg bij stervende patiënten zijn aan het artikel niet te ontlenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gerbrands en Agema over het bizarre bericht 'In de zorg is gevoel belangrijker dan taalkennis'

PVV MPs asked whether it is acceptable that 37,000 care workers were dismissed while recruitment of refugees and status holders is pushed, and whether language and VOG (certificate of conduct) standards are being lowered. The State Secretary replied that care quality standards apply equally to all, that language requirements remain in law (Wkkgz, BIG), that a VOG can be requested for status holders, and that no standards change for new recruits.
The standards and requirements that care workers must meet are the same for everyone in the Netherlands.
De gestelde normen en eisen waaraan medewerkers in de zorg moeten voldoen zijn in Nederland voor iedereen hetzelfde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gerbrands en Agema over het bericht dat verpleeghuizen Careyn bijna kopje-onder gaan

MPs Gerbrands and Agema asked whether a Careyn internal guide for IGZ inspection visits, the use of unqualified holiday staff, and the size of the organisation endanger oversight and resident safety. The State Secretary answered that IGZ is not being hindered, inspections are unannounced, the guide is only facilitating, and an organisational break-up is not an IGZ power but a matter for the board if quality is at stake.
The IGZ must of course never be hindered in carrying out its tasks.
De IGZ mag vanzelfsprekend nooit in de uitvoering van haar taken belemmerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gerbrands en Agema over het bericht 'bezuiniging ouderenzorg nutteloos'
