PVV MPs Gerbrands and Agema asked whether journalistic calculations showing that cuts to elderly care achieved nothing are correct, why earlier objections were dismissed, and whether the government will restore care cuts for older people. The Secretary of State rejected the calculations as incorrect, argued that the cuts were needed to bend spending growth and shifted responsibilities to insurers and municipalities, and said the government has invested in nursing home quality without committing to reverse the cuts.
The conclusion that the cuts to elderly care were useless is incorrect.
De conclusie dat de bezuinigingen op de ouderenzorg nutteloos zijn geweest is incorrect.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gerbrands en Agema over het bericht 'Tekort aan handjes: zorg smeekt ontslagen werknemers terug te keren'

PVV MPs Gerbrands and Agema asked the state secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport whether the government's care reforms caused unnecessary job losses, why refugees and migrants are being recruited into care, why some nursing programmes still have admission stops, and when staff will stop being used as pawns. The state secretary answered that reforms caused job losses but measures were taken to manage them, that recruitment plans and a 72 million euro boost aim to address shortages, and that care quality remains guaranteed.
The cabinet has in recent years carried out necessary reforms, because the demands we place on the organisation of care changed and care grew faster than society could afford.

Antwoord 2 De afgelopen jaren heeft het kabinet noodzakelijke hervormingen doorgevoerd, omdat de eisen die we stellen aan de organisatie van de zorg veranderden en de zorg harder groeide dan we als maatschappij aan konden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat zorgketens voor kwetsbare ouderen aan alle kanten kraken

An MP asks why care chains for frail elderly people are still failing, whether the closure of nursing homes was wrong, and how many elderly people are not in the right place. The minister answers that regional work is ongoing, that the government does not register such cases nationally, and that short-stay residential care was moved into the Zvw from 2017.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht 'Opa Penning overlijdt door inschattingsfout'

The PVV MP Agema asked why improvement points after an earlier death in a care facility were not implemented in time for Mr Penning, whether the IGZ failed in its oversight, and whether staffing shortages contributed. The State Secretary answered that the IGZ followed its usual procedure, found the measures adequate after inspections, saw no reason to investigate the IGZ, and that staffing was not a factor.
I see no reason at this time to investigate the IGZ's conduct in this case.
Ik zie nu geen aanleiding om het handelen van de IGZ in deze casus te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gerbrands en Agema over het niet vergoeden van een medicijn tegen taaislijmziekte

Two PVV MPs asked the minister why Orkambi, a cystic fibrosis drug, is not reimbursed despite a petition, and about alternatives, price negotiations and reimbursement elsewhere. The minister answered that the price of around 170,000 euros per year and the budget impact make reimbursement not responsible at present, while offering to reconsider a new proposal and to hold talks with the manufacturer on 20 June.
I have a meeting with the manufacturer on 20 June to discuss a possible continuation of the talks together with the Netherlands and Belgium.
Ik heb op 20 juni aanstaande een gesprek met de fabrikant om te praten over een mogelijk vervolg van de gesprekken tezamen met Nederland en België.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en Helder over twijfels bij het overlijden van een jongen in een instelling

MPs Agema and Helder asked about the death of a boy in an institution, the discontinued NODO procedure for investigating child deaths, its funding and responsibility, and 20 reported suspicious deaths submitted by relatives. The government answered that NODO was ended in 2014 after evaluation, replaced by the NODOK scheme focused on parents' grief, that in this case a non-natural death was established, and that further investigation would follow regular criminal procedures, without giving case details for privacy reasons.
Regarding further investigation in this specific situation, we cannot make any statements, in view of the privacy of the next of kin.
Over nader onderzoek in deze specifieke situatie kunnen wij, in het kader van de privacy van de nabestaanden, geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat de zorgkantoor niet weten wie zorg nodig heeft

An MP asks whether care offices (zorgkantoren) really do not know who needs long-term care and how many people, acute or otherwise, are waiting, and how this split between active and non-active waiters can be justified. The State Secretary responds that care offices actively mediate active waiters, that non-active waiters depend on signals from clients or providers, and that five concrete measures, including intensified NZa supervision, have been announced with an action plan report due this spring.
I will inform the House of the outcomes of the action plan, including structural improvement measures, this spring.
Ik informeer uw Kamer over de uitkomsten van het actieplan, inclusief structurele verbetermaatregelen, dit voorjaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Agema over het toch niet beschikbaar komen van canules voor de heer Vercoutre, waarmee hij kan praten en hij minder benauwd is

Two PVV MPs asked the health minister why a manufacturer no longer produces custom tracheostomy cannulas for ventilated patient Rene Vercoutre, leaving him unable to speak and more breathless, and what the government can do. The minister answered that the original mould no longer exists, that tailored replacements were supplied with insurer funding, that a suitable solution has not yet been found, and that alternatives are being explored.
I have learned that efforts are currently still being made to look for possible alternatives.
Ik heb vernomen dat men momenteel nog verder zoekt naar mogelijke alternatieven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Agema over het bericht dat De Zonnebloem fors moet bezuinigen op zorgvakanties voor gehandicapten en minder valige ouderen wegens teruglopende donaties

PVV MPs asked the state secretary about reports that De Zonnebloem must cut holiday places for disabled people and frail elderly due to falling donations, and whether the ministry could cover the 4 million euro shortfall. The state secretary said De Zonnebloem is an independent organisation that decides how to spend its donations, that it is cutting most of its holiday offer, and that the ministry will not fund the shortfall from its budget because that would make volunteer organisations too dependent on government subsidies.
De Zonnebloem is an independent organisation that makes its own decisions about how donations and gifts are spent.
De Zonnebloem is een zelfstandige organisatie die zelf besluiten neemt over de besteding van giften en donaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat een hoogbejaard echtpaar na 70 jaar, door hun zorgsituatie, tegen hun wil in, gedwongen niet meer samenwoont

An MP asked whether an elderly couple separated after 70 years by care needs, and whether previous government promises that couples would not be separated still hold. The state secretary said partner admission under the Wlz is legally possible, that the care office must mediate, that the couple had been offered it but did not take it up at the time, and that a solution is being worked on.
Following the 2014 parliamentary debate on this subject, I undertook to discuss with care offices how clients can be better informed about their rights and options regarding partner admission.

Naar aanleiding van het debat met de Kamer over dit onderwerp in 2014 heb ik toegezegd dat ik met zorgkantoren zal bespreken op welke wijze cliënten beter kunnen worden geïnformeerd over hun rechten en mogelijkheden ten aanzien van de partneropname.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht van Actiz dat de Inspectie niet altijd de goede vragen stelt als het gaat om de kwaliteit in verpleeghuizen en dat de IGZ hierop via een reactie in de media stelt dat

An MP asked the state secretary about a media dispute between Actiz and the Inspectorate (IGZ) over who set quality indicators for nursing homes, and whether the government should take the lead. The government answered that the sector, including Actiz, IGZ and client organisations jointly set the safety indicators under an administrative agreement, and that the Care Institute has stepped in to develop a quality framework.
Within this process the IGZ has explicitly taken on the executing role.
Binnen dit proces heeft de IGZ nadrukkelijk de uitvoerende rol op zich genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat de indicaties voor zware verpleeghuiszorg zijn gehalveerd

The MP asks whether the halving of severe nursing home care indications in 2015 reflects tighter eligibility or under-indication, and about the tariffs and zorgzwaartepakketten. The State Secretary answers that unique-client figures for VV7-VV10 have stabilised rather than fallen, that the CIZ applies statutory criteria without steering, and that he is examining whether the VV10 profile should continue to be indicated by the CIZ.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat zorgcentrum Huis in de Duinen onder verscherpt toezicht is gesteld

An MP asked why the inspectorate had not placed care centre Huis in de Duinen under heightened supervision earlier despite repeated shortfalls, and whether ministers had allowed a danger to residents to persist. The State Secretary answered that the inspectorate found improvement efforts in January 2016 but stagnation in August 2016 led to heightened supervision from 12 October 2016, and that board appointment decisions rest primarily with supervisory boards.

On the basis of these findings the inspectorate has insufficient confidence in lasting improvement at Huis in de Duinen and therefore placed it under heightened supervision for six months from 12 October 2016.

De inspectie heeft op basis van deze bevindingen onvoldoende vertrouwen in duurzame verbetering van Huis in de Duinen en heeft Huis in de Duinen daarom met ingang van 12 oktober 2016 voor een periode van zes maanden onder verscherpt toezicht gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat een stichting in Emmen fraude heeft gepleegd met persoonsgebonden budgetten (pgb’s) van gedetineerden

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about reports that a foundation in Emmen defrauded personal care budgets (pgb) of prisoners, asking how such fraud was possible, when it occurred relative to the trekkingsrecht, and how the money would be recovered. The government answered that a criminal investigation by the Inspectie SZW and the Public Prosecution Service is ongoing and declined to comment on the case, but said it would pursue asset confiscation and support victims if fraud is proven.
Pending this investigation, I cannot make any statements about this case.
Hangende dit onderzoek kan ik geen uitspraken doen over deze casus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat de ouderenzorg verstopt raakt

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that elderly care is becoming blocked, including the shrinking growth room for long-term care budgets since 2010 and waiting lists for nursing home places. The state secretary answered that the decline is overstated because personal budgets were added and extra funds were provided, that the 2.4% growth room aligns with CPB projections, and that the cabinet will set growth room for 2018–2021.
This picture is not correct for a number of reasons.
Dit beeld is om een aantal redenen niet terecht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over de open brief aan mevrouw De Jong-Verspeek van BrabantZorg

An MP asked the state secretary whether he contacted the BrabantZorg representative named in an open letter before answering earlier questions, why he did not investigate further, and whether he would ask the NZa to examine the provider and check how often critical relatives are dismissed as mentors. The secretary said the matter is primarily between the complainant and the provider, pointed to legal safeguards and IGZ oversight, said mentors are appointed and dismissed by the court rather than the institution, and declined to order an NZa investigation or further research.
I see no reason to instruct the NZa to conduct further investigation into the working methods of this institution.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de NZa opdracht te geven om nader onderzoek te doen naar de werkwijze van deze instelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat aanbieders van wijkverpleging nu al op budgetplafonds stuiten

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that home-care providers are already hitting budget ceilings, raising concerns about care continuity, waiting lists, job losses and bankruptcies. The state secretary said there is more budget in 2016, that insurers must ensure access to care and offer alternatives when ceilings are reached, and that regional consultations were being arranged, while declining to provide provider-level figures on cliënten stops, layoffs or bankruptcies.
I have no insight into the number of client stops or the number of institutions where waiting lists threaten to arise.
Ik heb geen zicht op het aantal cliëntenstops dan wel het aantal instellingen waar wachtlijsten dreigen te ontstaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht 'Ouderen zitten aantal keren zonder maaltijd'

An MP asked whether a warm meal is basic care under the Wlz and why elderly residents at a care facility were going without warm meals, despite high fees. The State Secretary replied that the case concerns Zvw home-care with an additional meal service by Wielborgh, not Wlz care, that the disruption came from a switch to volunteers, and that extra staff have since been arranged.
Contrary to what the article suggests, this does not concern Wlz care but Zvw care with additional services provided by home-care provider de Wielborgh.
Anders dan het artikel suggereert, gaat het hier niet om Wlz-zorg, maar Zvw-zorg met aanvullende dienstverlening door thuiszorgaanbieder de Wielborgh.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht “Gemeenten verhullen optie extra huishoudelijke hulp”

An MP asks whether municipalities are holding back the extra Huishoudelijke Hulp Toelage funds for domestic help and why, and whether the government will ensure the money is used for its intended purposes. The State Secretary says the conditions were loosened in December 2015, municipalities decide how to spend the money within the aims, monitoring shows gains but realisation lagging, and he has no signals of misuse.
I have no signals that municipalities are not using this money for the agreed purposes.
Ik heb geen signalen dat gemeenten dit geld niet voor de afgesproken doelen inzetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat de continuïteit van zorg in gedrang komt door krappe budgetten wijkverpleging

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that budget ceilings for district nursing threaten continuity of care, including expected waiting lists and service stops, and whether the 600 million euro cut is responsible. The state secretary answered that insurers have a duty of care and must contract additional care, that existing clients keep their right to continue treatment, that regional consultations will be set up, and that the 2015 overrun of 37.7 million euro is limited, with 180 million euro more available in 2016.
I have already agreed with health insurers and care providers to hold regular regional consultations between care purchasers and providers starting in September.
Ik heb ook al met zorgverzekeraars en zorgaanbieders afgesproken om vanaf september regionaal periodieke overleggen te beleggen tussen zorginkopers en zorgaanbieders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraars aanbieders van wijkverpleging straffen

An MP from the PVV asks the State Secretary for Health whether insurers clawing back 51 million euros from home-care providers that exceeded their 2015 volume caps is appropriate, given claimed savings and a budget underspend, and about resulting care continuity risks. The State Secretary replies that use of the macro-budget instrument is his decision and was not applied for 2015, that revenue clawback is a private contractual matter between insurer and provider, and that he has no data on affected clients, closures or layoffs.
That is a private-law matter between the health insurer and the care provider.
Dat is een privaatrechtelijke kwestie tussen zorgverzekeraar en zorgaanbieder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraars verbaasd zijn over de reactie van Actiz over de wijkverpleging

An MP asks the State Secretary about insurers' reaction to Actiz on home nursing funding, questioning the shift of wijkverpleging to insurers, the 600 million euro budget cut, and the risk to patients. The State Secretary defends the transfer to the Zvw, reports a 37.7 million euro overrun for 2015 with no overrun yet in 2016, notes extra funds for 2016, and refers to the dispute-resolution body and a separate answer for the gambling question.
I still stand behind the transfer of wijkverpleging to the Zvw.
Ik sta nog steeds achter de overheveling van de wijkverpleging naar de Zvw.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over De brandbrief van Actiz over de wijkverpleging

An MP asked the state secretary about Actiz's warning that home-care providers face serious pressure from insurers' contracting, with fears of client stops and financial failures. The state secretary responded that insurers must meet their duty of care, budgets are adequate, and regional consultations will be organised, while rejecting most concerns.
I have agreed with health insurers and care providers that from September they will hold periodic regional consultations between care purchasers and care providers.
Ik heb met zorgverzekeraars en zorgaanbieders afgesproken dat zij vanaf september regionaal periodieke overleggen beleggen tussen zorginkopers en zorgaanbieders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat gemeenten de juridische grenzen van de WMO opzoeken

An MP asks the state secretary about municipalities seeking legal limits to avoid complying with a Central Appeals Tribunal ruling on domestic help under the WMO, and about VNG guidance on not restoring cut hours. The secretary rejects non-compliance, says he can intervene under article 2.6.8 if municipalities deviate structurally, and asks municipalities to review their policy with VNG support, while denying the cuts should be reversed.

When I find that a municipality deviates more than incidentally from the legal framework, as partly defined by the CRvB, and the municipal council does not take its responsibility, I have the option to use the powers under article 2.6.8 of the Wmo 2015.

Op het moment dat ik constateer dat een gemeente meer dan incidenteel afwijkt van de wettelijke kaders, zoals mede ingevuld door de CRvB, en de gemeenteraad haar verantwoordelijkheid niet neemt, heb ik de mogelijkheid om van de bevoegdheden in het kader van artikel 2.6.8 van de Wmo 2015 gebruik te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat er angst is voor het overlijden van bewoners van verpleeghuis Westhoff

An MP asks the state secretary for health about reports that a care home's board plans to relocate residents, and that staff and relatives fear residents may not survive the move, plus the board's claims about staff shortages and policy. The answers say the board is responsible for hiring and has enough budget, the relocation is unrelated to funding shortages, and the minister is willing to meet the board chair.
Inquiries with Florence indicate that the board sees itself responsible for hiring enough higher-educated staff and that Florence has sufficient budget for this.
Navraag bij Florence leert dat de bestuurder zich verantwoordelijk weet voor het aannemen van voldoende hoger opgeleid personeel en dat Florence hiervoor voldoende budget heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over de open brief van een mevrouw over haar tante die mogelijk door BrabantZorg kaalgeplukt wordt

An MP asked the state secretary whether care provider BrabantZorg was wrongly debiting a resident's account for voluntary contributions and hairdressing, and what would be done about it, including whether a sample investigation would be carried out. The state secretary said the matter falls to the inspectorate, the NZa and the courts' appointed guardians, saw no need for a new investigation, and considered existing enforcement powers sufficient.
It is the task of the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGZ) to supervise this.
Het is de taak van de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) om daarop toe te zien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht "Een beetje hulp totdat het te laat is"

An MP from the PVV asks the state secretary about a news report on youth care, whether acute out-of-home placements have risen since municipalities took over youth care, and whether children face dangerous waiting times for specialist help. The secretary says no data yet shows a rise, a study will be published in October 2016, he agrees children must get the right help, and promises to discuss waiting times with municipalities and sector bodies, reporting in the autumn progress letter.
I have committed to further discuss the state of affairs regarding waiting times and the necessary improvements with municipalities and the sector organisations.
Ik heb toegezegd dat ik met gemeenten en de brancheorganisaties de stand van zaken rondom de wachttijden en de verbeteringen die er nodig zijn verder zal bespreken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat de top van de slecht presterende verpleeghuizen meer verdient dan de norm

An MP asks the state secretary for health about reports that top executives at poorly performing nursing homes earn more than the Balkenende norm, whether high pay is justified, and what action will be taken. The secretary says the WNT sets maximum pay, supervisory boards must set a fitting pay within those limits, and the CIBG will enforce the WNT if violations occur.
The CIBG supervises the WNT. If there is a violation, the CIBG will take enforcement action.
Het CIBG ziet toe op de WNT. Indien er sprake is van en overtreding, zal het CIBG handhavend optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat familieleden van dementerenden acuut te hulp moeten schieten in een verpleeghuis omdat er geen personeel is

An MP asked the state secretary whether families of dementia patients being pressed into service at a nursing home lacking staff contradicts the Waardigheid en Trots programme, and questioned the funding of long-term care and a planned cut. The state secretary answered that family may not be structurally used for professional care, that the case was an exceptional force-majeure situation, and that the extra 500 million euro cut has been withdrawn.
That can, however, never go so far that family members are structurally deployed for professional care tasks.
Dat kan echter nooit zover gaan dat familieleden structureel worden ingezet voor professionele zorgtaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en De Graaf over de brief van het Haagse college van B&W over de huisvesting van asielzoekers in een vleugel van verpleeghuis De Lozerhof

MPs Agema and De Graaf asked about housing asylum seekers in a wing of nursing home De Lozerhof, including expected work by residents, staffing impacts and who is responsible for care quality and safety. The Secretary of State said the arrangement is voluntary-work oriented with careful consultation, that the nursing home itself is responsible for care quality, and that the Inspectorate is following up on previously identified shortcomings.
Care institutions are themselves responsible for the quality and safety of the care provided and for the staff and volunteers in their institution.
Zorginstellingen zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit en veiligheid van de geleverde zorg en voor het personeel en vrijwilligers in hun instelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht ‘Kind ligt onnodig lang in het ziekenhuis’

An MP asked whether a child staying unnecessarily long in hospital was caused by the 600 million euro cut to home care, why there is a shortage of children's nurses, and what the extra costs are. The state secretary said he supports moving child care from hospital to home, will convene parties to discuss the nurse shortage, and could not give the extra costs because they are not registered separately.
The V&VN signal that there are too few children's nurses is reason for me to invite the parties involved in the short term to discuss this signal.
Het signaal van V&VN dat er te weinig kinderverpleegkundigen zijn is voor mij aanleiding op korte termijn de betrokken partijen uit te nodigen om dit signaal te bespreken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en Wilders over het bericht dat een 74-jarige verlamde poliopatiënt al 60 jaar afhankelijk is van een buisje voor ademen en praten, dat al 20 jaar niet meer gemaakt wordt en deze nu

MPs Wilders and Agema asked the health minister whether the government would act, including sending an official to China, after a 74-year-old polio patient faced losing his decades-old latex breathing tube that is no longer manufactured. The minister answered that over a thousand tracheostomy tubes exist, that medical devices must meet EU CE rules, and that the supplier Teleflex, with the German manufacturer, is restarting production of the old tube with delivery expected within weeks.
Even before the media coverage, Teleflex was busy working with the manufacturer to find a solution.
Al voor de berichtgeving in de media was Teleflex druk doende om in overleg met de fabrikant voor een oplossing te zorgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Agema over het TV-programma ‘Geer en Goor zoeken een hobby’ waarin de minister-president oproept iets voor eenzame ouderen te doen

PVV MPs Wilders and Agema asked the Prime Minister whether he is ashamed to call for help for lonely elderly while cutting elderly care, and whether the government will reverse cuts to home help and reopen care homes. The Staatssecretaris answered that loneliness is not primarily solved by more professional care, that the reforms aim to detect loneliness early, and that the government is pursuing a loneliness action plan with local cooperation until 2016.
Admission to a care home or additional care at home, however, is not a solution to loneliness.
Opname in een verzorgingshuis of extra zorg thuis is echter geen oplossing voor eenzaamheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat zorginstelling Huis in de Duinen te Zandvoort uit het dal zou zijn

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Health about the Inspectorate's (IGZ) findings that more than half of the care criteria at Huis in de Duinen in Zandvoort were still not met, questioning the Inspectorate's oversight, staffing, whistleblowing, sick leave and past political influence. The State Secretary answered that the IGZ has an intensive supervision trajectory with improvements noted, no current signs staff fear reporting, the whistleblower scheme remains in force but was unused, and the IGZ will take further measures if quality falls short again.
Should the IGZ again find that the quality of care is not yet secured, the IGZ will take further measures.
Mocht de IGZ opnieuw constateren dat de kwaliteit van zorg nog niet geborgd is, dan zal de IGZ nadere maatregelen nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat er geen plek in een verpleeghuis is voor de nazorg voor een hoogbejaarde mevrouw van 102 jaar oud die nog zelfstandig woont

An MP asked why a frail 102-year-old woman was discharged from hospital without a nursing home place and without contact with family, and questioned the cuts to care homes. The Secretary of State said care content is for the Inspectorate (IGZ) to judge, pointed to hospital-to-community handover improvements, and defended the shift toward home care while citing extra funding for short-stay places.
On care content, it is not for me to judge whether the care providers and hospital involved in this case acted correctly.
Zorginhoudelijk is het niet aan mij om te beoordelen of er in deze casus juist is gehandeld door de zorgverleners en het ziekenhuis die betrokken zijn geweest bij de zorg aan de mevrouw.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over de TV-commercial van Sire: ‘XTC-facts’

An MP asked the state secretary whether a Sire TV commercial on XTC ('XTC-facts') that appears to normalise testing-before-use would discourage youth drug use, and whether the government should use shock imagery instead. The state secretary replied that Sire is an independent foundation so the government is not responsible for the spot, that such campaigns may stimulate interest, so the government does not use mass-media drug prevention, and that the cost is unknown.
SIRE has no ties with the government or other organisations, so the government is not responsible for this video.
SIRE heeft geen banden met de overheid of andere organisaties
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht "Zilveren kruis smeert verstandelijk beperkten wurgcontract aan"

MPs from nine parties asked the State Secretary about a Zilveren Kruis settlement agreement offered to persoonsgebonden budget holders, and whether it should be withdrawn and whether the motion to halt recovery was being implemented. The State Secretary answered that the zorgkantoren act on agreements made with them, that the settlement need no longer be signed pending a good-faith assessment, that recovery of alleged improperly paid budgets is suspended until good faith is assessed by 1 May 2016, and that other zorgkantoren operate under the same agreements.
By 1 May 2016 or as soon as possible, zorgkantoren will have assessed in all currently open individual cases whether the budget holder acted in good faith.
Uiterlijk 1 mei 2016 of zoveel eerder als mogelijk, hebben zorgkantoren in alle op dit moment openstaande individuele casuïstiek beoordeeld of de budgethouder te goeder trouw heeft gehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Agema over het bericht dat nabestaanden het Haagse verzorgingshuis Florence aanklagen: ‘Mijn moeder wilde niet dood’

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that relatives are suing a The Hague care home over poor care, whether the Inspectorate will investigate, and whether basic residents' rights should be codified in law. The secretary said the Inspectorate has taken up a first citizen report and cannot comment on findings while the investigation is ongoing, and argued that residents' rights are already set out in the Besluit langdurige zorg.
Following the report, the Inspectorate will investigate whether the care given to the woman concerned at the Loosduinse Hof care centre was of responsible quality.
De inspectie gaat naar aanleiding van de melding onderzoeken of de zorg aan de desbetreffende mevrouw in woon-zorgcentrum Loosduinse Hof van verantwoorde kwaliteit was.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht 'Verzorgingshuis zet Erik op straat'

An MP from the PVV asked the state secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport how many people had been evicted from care homes after their care indication was lowered, and whether this was desirable. The state secretary replied that policy aims for appropriate care, that the care office must offer a suitable alternative when a client's preferred institution is unavailable, and referred back to that answer for the second question.
How many people have been put out on the street since your policy was introduced after their indication was lowered?
Hoeveel mensen zijn er sinds uw beleid is ingevoerd op straat gezet nadat hun indicatie was verlaagd?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over gesjoemel met keukentafelgesprekken

An MP asks the State Secretary about a care coordinator reporting that keukentafelgesprekken (kitchen-table assessments) are shortened for commercial reasons, and whether a 30-minute cap and unreplaced sick staff amount to fraud. The State Secretary says assessments must be tailored and that municipalities bear primary responsibility, will address municipalities showing systematic non-compliance, and will hold providers to contractual replacement duties, without announcing a new national measure.
If I receive signals that a municipality is not carrying out the prescribed assessment in accordance with the requirements, other than in isolated cases, I will address that municipality.

Indien ik signalen ontvang dat een gemeente het voorgeschreven onderzoek, anders dan in incidentele gevallen, niet overeenkomstig de daaraan gestelde eisen uitvoert, spreek ik deze gemeente daarop aan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht ‘Oudere staat er alleen voor’

MP Agema (PVV) asked whether the safety of elderly people is endangered by their staying independent longer and whether they are left alone, citing a newspaper report. The Secretary of State answered that the trend toward independent living raises quality of life though it brings risks, and that the long-term care reform, district nursing, and the Wmo 2015 aim to support people at home with institutional care as a fallback.
The long-term care reform is precisely aimed at enabling people to stay at home longer.
De hervorming langdurige zorg is er juist op gericht om het mogelijk te maken dat mensen langer thuis kunnen blijven wonen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en Agema over de geheugenpoli voor immigranten

MPs Klever and Agema (PVV) asked the health minister whether a memory clinic for immigrants is undesirable, whether autochthonous patients can attend, who pays for interpreters and social work, and why it should not be ended. The minister saw it as strengthening regional dementia care, said such targeted services can be acceptable if financially viable, and stated that access is guaranteed for all and that she has no intention of changing the Health Insurance Act.
I do not intend to amend the Health Insurance Act on these points.
Ik ben niet voornemens de Zorgverzekeringwet op deze punten te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over geweigerde terminale thuiszorg aan 23 mensen die thuis wilden sterven

MP Agema asks why the Secretary of State addressed the refusal of terminal home care for 23 people wishing to die at home only by a phone call with one hospital, and why he does not act to break the funding impasse in community nursing. The Secretary replies that he contacted the hospital and insurer, that the problem was incidental, that insurer CZ made new working agreements, and that he stressed regional agreements and promised a letter on specialist community nursing before year-end.

As I promised in the committee debate of 10 November, following a motion by MP Bergkamp, I will inform the House before the end of the year about the state of affairs regarding procurement of specialised community nursing functions.

Zoals ik heb toegezegd in het voortgezet algemeen overleg van 10 november jl., naar aanleiding van een motie van het Kamerlid Bergkamp 3 , informeer ik de Tweede Kamer nog voor het eind van het jaar over de stand van zaken rond de inkoop van de gespecialiseerde functies van de wijkverpleging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Agema en Wilders over het artikel 'Ouderen op zwart zaad'

PVV MPs asked the government to respond to an article on elderly people's poor finances, calling the situation a disgrace and accusing the government of undermining elderly care, the state pension and pensions. The minister replied that elderly purchasing power has declined due to pension fund problems and budget measures, that low incomes were protected, that long-term care was reformed, and that purchasing power will be reviewed annually with measures in the budget if needed.
Each year the integrated purchasing power picture, including that of the elderly, is weighed for the coming year and the cabinet takes measures where necessary, within the available budgetary room.
Jaarlijks wordt het integrale koopkrachtbeeld, waaronder die van ouderen, voor het komende jaar gewogen en treft het kabinet zo nodig, binnen de beschikbare budgettaire ruimte, maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over de verslechterde sfeer in de zorginstelling ‘s Heeren Loo in Noordwijk

An MP asked the state secretary whether mixing severely disabled residents with mildly disabled residents with behavioural problems at ’s Heeren Loo Noordwijk harmed the original residents, and whether patient rights are adequately guaranteed under the Wlz. The state secretary acknowledged the mixing caused problems, said the composition has changed and the situation stabilised, placed composition responsibility with the provider, and pointed to existing quality rules and a pending Wkkgz bill.
It is the care provider's own responsibility to compose the client population on a residence, and equip staff, so that residents can feel safe and live pleasantly there.

Het is een eigen verantwoordelijkheid van een zorgaanbieder de cliëntenpopulatie op een woning zodanig samen te stellen, en het personeel zodanig toe te rusten, dat de bewoners zich daar veilig kunnen voelen en prettig kunnen wonen.
Antwoord op vragen van het llid Agema over het bericht: 'Achmea: rust of slaapt u tijdens de sterffase, dan geen professionals aan uw bed'

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary whether insurer Achmea's policy of not paying for professional presence at the bedside of dying patients who are resting or sleeping was acceptable, and called for it to be reversed. The State Secretary replied that Zilveren Kruis (an Achmea insurer) has no hour cap on terminal care, that the professional decides what care is needed, and that the current domain-based arrangement for terminal care is appropriate, so no reversal is needed.
Enquiries with Zilveren Kruis show there is no tightening of the policy.
Navraag bij Zilveren Kruis leert dat er geen sprake is van aanscherping van het beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en De Graaf over het reclamespotje van Stichting Moslimpleegkind

PVV MPs asked whether the government would stop a recruitment ad by Stichting Moslimpleegkind that implies white parents are poor foster carers and promotes Islam. The state secretary replied that foster placements are carefully screened and that the Jeugdwet requires considering a child's religious and cultural background, and that diversification campaigns exist, but declined to judge the interpretation of the ad and did not commit to stopping it.
Furthermore, it is not for me to judge the interpretation of a commercial by Stichting Moslimpleegkind.
Verder is het niet aan mij om een oordeel te hebben over de interpretatie van een reclamespotje van de Stichting Moslimpleegkind.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over de uitzending van Radar “ouderen rustig gehouden met medicatie”

An MP asked the state secretary about a broadcast reporting that elderly nursing-home residents are sedated with psychotropic drugs to keep them calm, and about cost, institutional differences and possible sanctions. The state secretary acknowledged the problem, pointed to a culture change programme and the pending Zorg en Dwang bill, and said the Inspectorate can act, but committed to no new sanctions or specific study.
The inspectorate supervises this care and can, where necessary, also take measures against institutions.
De inspectie ziet toe op deze zorg en kan zo nodig ook maatregelen nemen tegen instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht “Hoe Buurtzorg miljoenen misloopt door willekeur zorgverzekeraars”

An MP from the PVV asked the state secretary for Health about reports that Buurtzorg loses millions because health insurers arbitrarily cap its productive output, and whether this penalises success and blocks growth. The state secretary said care access is central, that insurers contract on price-quality, that demand growth is partly explained by ageing and chronic illness, and that a doelmatigheid study will report in autumn; he also explained that unagreed overproduction does not automatically lead to budget adjustment.
A study into the cost-effectiveness of care provided by Buurtzorg is currently underway.
Op dit moment vindt een onderzoek plaats naar de doelmatigheid van de zorglevering door Buurtzorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht ‘Het wordt chaos; zorgpersoneel slaat alarm over werkdruk’

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Health about mass layoffs at care provider Amstelring, alongside its hiring of temporary staff, and whether this endangers resident safety and care quality. The State Secretary answered that the layoffs follow from the policy of longer independent living, that the care provider is responsible for safe organisation of care under IGZ supervision, and that no sanctions against the board are warranted.
Given this situation, imposing sanctions is not an issue.
Gezien deze situatie is het treffen van sancties niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht ‘Noodplan moet leegloop bij jeugdzorg voorkomen’

An MP from the PVV asked the state secretary how to retain professional youth-care staff ahead of the 2015 transition, whether national intervention is needed rather than leaving it to municipalities, and whether minimum quality criteria and accrued rights of staff can be secured. The government pointed to existing measures (a 3.8 million euro sector plan, the Transition Authority for Youth, quality criteria in the Youth Act, and a staff-takeover consultation duty) and said it monitors municipal procurement, with a possible instruction to municipalities if preparation proves seriously deficient.
We monitor the care procurement carried out by municipalities.
Wij monitoren de zorginkoop die door gemeenten plaatsvindt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht 'Zorg: 81 miljoen aan open rekeningen’

An MP from the PVV asked the state secretary whether care offices must still pay institutions 81 million euros for care clients had a legal right to, and whether unspent AWBZ funds end up with health insurers. The state secretary denied any outstanding payment, stating that overproduction is excluded by NZa rules, that no AWBZ funds were left unused in 2013, and that any leftover would return to the AWBZ fund.
No, that is incorrect. The contract between the care office and the institution specifies the reimbursement the institution is entitled to.
Nee dat is onjuist. In het contract tussen het zorgkantoor en de instelling is vastgelegd op welke vergoeding de instelling recht heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en Fritsma over het bericht met spoed gezocht: 100.000 seniorenwoningen

MPs Agema and Fritsma asked about reports of a shortage of 100,000 senior housing units and whether the government will postpone the ZZP 1-3 extramuralisation measure until enough suitable housing exists. The State Secretary replied that extramuralisation will keep 30,000-35,000 people at home longer, that existing stock is largely sufficient, and pointed to a regional transition agenda for living independently longer.
In our view, housing people who face an increase in limitations is therefore well feasible.
Naar onze mening is daarmee het huisvesten van mensen, die met een toename van beperkingen te maken krijgt, goed uitvoerbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat verzekeraars Buurtzorg Nederland weigeren te betalen

An MP from the PVV asked the ministry whether insurers refusing to pay Buurtzorg Nederland for care already delivered was justified, and why Buurtzorg had not been compensated for overproduction. The State Secretary answered that care should be paid only within agreed contracting frameworks, that a doelmatigheidsonderzoek into Buurtzorg's efficiency would be commissioned, and that the AWBZ was almost fully spent in 2013.
The NZa policy rules establish that the care provider is not reimbursed more than what has been agreed in advance.
Het is in de NZa beleidsregels vastgelegd dat de zorgaanbieder niet meer vergoed krijgt dan op voorhand afgesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat Zorggroep Oude en Nieuwe Land honderdduizenden euro's verspilt aan zweverige managementcursussen

An MP asks whether a care group spent public money on management courses by a consultancy whose board-member spouse and affiliated firm raise conflict-of-interest concerns, and whether the supervisory board approved this. The state secretary answers that the care group spent about 285,000 euros a year on advice and coaching, that the supervisory board found no conflict of interest, and that such spending and interim pay are primarily matters for the care institution and its supervisory board.
The assessment of whether there is (the appearance of) a conflict of interest lies primarily with the Supervisory Board.
De beoordeling of hier sprake is (schijn) van belangverstrengeling ligt primair bij de Raad van Toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat de wijkverpleegkundige onvoldoende is voorbereid op wijk

An MP asks whether the district nurse (wijkverpleegkundige) should act as the hub for care users, including preventive planning and coaching, and whether she is prepared for the role before the January 2015 transfer. The State Secretary answers that the district nurse is primarily a care provider with added coordinating and signalling tasks, that training measures and funding are in place, and that the role is not a solo one but works with GPs and social teams.
I am of the view that the district nurse is primarily a care provider and additionally performs extra tasks such as coordinating care and support.
Ik ben van mening dat de wijkverpleegkundige in eerste instantie een zorgverlener is en daarnaast extra taken doet zoals de coördinatie van zorg en ondersteuning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat de bewoners van aanleunwoningen in Nieuw Heeswijk actie voeren nu hun verzorgingshuis gesloten is

An MP asked the state secretary about residents of independent apartments in Nieuw Heeswijk protesting the closure of their adjacent care home, the reported celebration during demolition, the loss of neighbourhood care functions under national closure policy, and whether the policy would be reversed. The secretary answered that the residents live independently, that the care home provider offers replacement facilities and community alternatives, that the cuts are offset by extra funding for district nurses and social teams, and that closing care homes is an institutional decision.
Closing (a location of) a care home is a decision taken by the institution itself.
Het sluiten van (een locatie van) een verzorgingshuis is een beslissing die door een instelling zelf wordt genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en Tony Van Dijck over het bericht dat zzp-ers in de zorg geen VAR-WUO (Verklaring Arbeidsrelatie Winst Uit Onderneming) meer krijgen van de belastingdienst

MPs Agema and Tony Van Dijck asked whether the Tax Authority's refusal to issue VAR-WUO declarations to self-employed care workers, which hurts patients who rely on agency-placed carers, is known and how it will be addressed. The government acknowledged the problem, said the Tax Authority reclassified 257 cases and issued 900 VAR-loon decisions after review while stressing genuine self-employment must still be recognised, and pointed to direct contracting pilots and ongoing labour-market attention.
I see the problem that is connected to this, although it is not a scale suggested in the broadcast.
Ik zie de problematiek die hier mee samenhangt, hoewel het niet om een schaal gaat die in de uitzending werd gesuggereerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over de boete voor mensen die gebruik maken van Valysvervoer

An MP asked whether a €3 late-booking charge, a rising commercial tariff of €1.31 from 2014 and the kilometre budget for Valys transport are fair compared with ordinary public transport. The Secretary of State said the late-booking charge is a planning measure, not a fine, that the commercial tariff is indexed under the programme of requirements and still below taxi fares, and referred the question on scrapping the kilometre limit to a letter of 19 December 2013.
There is no question of a penalty scheme.
Er is geen sprake van een boeteregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het financieren van dure hobby’s met zorggeld

The MP asks whether the government condemns care executives spending care funds on private hobbies, whether the affected care provider's disabled children are protected, whether fines should benefit the institution, and whether fraudulent executives should be barred from care governance. The Secretary answers that such spending is very wrong and fraud is a priority, that the care office ensured continuity, that fines go to general revenue while the institution can reclaim money separately, and that a bill will require board members to present a certificate of conduct.
The letter 'Good governance in care' of 19 September 2013 announces that members of a management board must submit a certificate of conduct (VOG).
In de brief «Goed bestuur in de zorg» van 19 september 2013 staat aangekondigd dat leden van een raad van bestuur een verklaring omtrent gedrag (VOG) moeten overhandigen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat er toch werklozen ingezet worden als thuishulp

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that unemployed people would be deployed as home-care helpers, and whether this would replace dismissed care workers at lower pay. The state secretary said that personal care requiring qualifications must stay with qualified professionals, that municipalities may use volunteers and job-seekers for non-qualified support within their Wmo discretion, and that the national government does not collect data on this.
No. Municipalities account to their municipal council for the implementation of the Wmo. The national government does not collect information on this.
Nee. Gemeenten leggen aan hun gemeenteraad verantwoording af over de uitvoering van de Wmo. Het Rijk verzamelt hierover geen informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat ambtenaren de toegang tot jeugdpsychiatrie gaan bepalen

An MP asked whether municipal officials completing a six-day youth psychiatry course could decide on access to youth mental health care, how children would be protected from gaps in care, and whether decentralisation should be postponed. The state secretary rejected the premise that the course qualifies officials to diagnose, stated that diagnosis and referral remain with doctors or specialists, and declined to postpone decentralisation.
That does not mean they will be authorised to diagnose in future.
Dat wil nog niet zeggen dat zij daarmee bevoegd zijn om straks te kunnen gaan diagnosticeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht ‘Mantelzorgers mishandelen uit stress’

An MP asked the state secretary whether rising elder abuse by overburdened informal carers, combined with cuts to home help and day care, shows the government's policy is at fault, and whether municipalities can provide respite care despite budget cuts. The secretary denied a causal link, pointed to better support for carers and a respite-care guide being drafted with the VNG, and announced a study into improving the handling of 'derailed' informal care.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over een falende zorgbestuurder die nu weer bestuursvoorzitter is van een woonzorg centrum waar een 91-jarige mevrouw op dubieuze wijze overleden is

An MP asked the state secretary about a care executive who again chairs a care home where a 91-year-old woman died under dubious circumstances, and asked how to stop such executives moving between care providers and whether people convicted of elder abuse can be barred from care work. The state secretary said responsibility for governance lies with providers, pointed to planned measures and an autumn letter on good governance, said the IGZ and police investigations prevent further comment on this case, and said convicted elder abusers should not work in care, referring to the pending Wkkgz bill and its VOG requirement.
In the interest of these investigations I cannot make any further statements.
In het belang van deze onderzoeken kan ik geen verdere mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het onderzoek naar de inzet van mystery guests

An MP asked the state secretary about the IGZ pilot using mystery guests in elderly care, which produced few results and was criticised for limited scale and use of non-inspectors. The state secretary answered that the pilot's limited design explains the thin results, that the evaluation found added value but needed a better approach, and that a decision on future use will follow the 2014 evaluation.
However, the research also shows that the approach chosen in the pilot led to too few concrete results for the inspectorate.
Uit het onderzoek blijkt echter ook dat de in de pilot gekozen invulling tot te weinig concrete resultaten heeft geleid voor de inspectie
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht ‘Spullen overledenen gedumpt in vuilniszak; Verzorgingshuizen ontruimen kamers veel te snel’

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that care homes clear deceased residents' rooms too quickly and bag belongings, and why the NZa did not act. The state secretary said the 7-day clearance rule in the Algemene Voorwaarden is not always followed, will raise it with the sector, asked the NZa to investigate mutation days, and said Actiz will warn members and sanctions run through the complaints scheme.
I have asked the NZa to examine the matter of mutation days more closely, take action where necessary, and inform me about it.
Ik heb de NZa gevraagd de materie van mutatiedagen nader te onderzoeken, zo nodig actie te ondernemen en mij hierover te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Agema over gesegregeerde ouderenzorg

MPs Van Klaveren and Agema (PVV) asked whether a care centre for dementia patients organised by cultural background (De Beukelaar, Laurens) is acceptable, how much public money it receives, and whether it should be stopped. The minister said the centre is funded like any AWBZ provider, that cultural background matters for dementia care, that residents mix, and that he will not stop the project.
No, I am not going to do that.
Nee, dat ga ik niet doen.
Antwoord vragen Agema over het bericht ‘200 medewerkers weg bij Pleyade’

MP Agema asked the state secretary about reported layoffs of 200 staff at care provider Pleyade, linking them to AWBZ funding for extra staff and to risks for elderly care and inspection. The state secretary attributes the reorganisation to falling client demand, says care access is guaranteed through AWBZ indications and the care office, and sees no reason to intensify inspection.
I see no reason to intensify the inspection task at Pleyade.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de controletaak bij Pleyade te intensiveren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht ‘Verdriet en angst in verzorgingstehuizen’

An MP asked the state secretary about reports of elderly residents being forced to leave care homes and how existing clients' rights are protected. The state secretary says existing clients keep their right to stay, that relocation can occur only through closure or renovation, and that the NZa and insurer Achmea have confirmed existing clients' rights will be respected.
existing clients retain the right to residence in a care institution
bestaande cliënten recht behouden op verblijf in een zorginstelling
Antwoord vragen Agema over het bericht dat er meer gevallen van ouderenmishandeling gemeld worden

An MP asked the state secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about rising reports of elder abuse, the likely hidden scale of the problem, the plan to keep care-dependent elderly at home, and tougher penalties. The state secretary answered that the Action Plan 'Ouderen in veilige handen' and the reporting code are being implemented, that the estimated prevalence is about one in twenty elderly, and that the Justice Minister sees no need to raise sentences since vulnerability is already weighed.
Yes, I certainly do not rule out that this concerns the tip of the iceberg.
Ja, Ik sluit zeker niet uit dat het hier gaat om het topje van de ijsberg.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Agema over slechts een waarschuwing bij het veroorzaken van ernstige brandwonden door een verpleegkundige

An MP asked the state secretary whether a nurse receiving only a tuchtrechtelijke waarschuwing for causing severe burns to a disabled girl was too lenient, and whether the warning and reprimand should be abolished. The state secretary declined to comment on the specific case, stated that disciplinary measures aim at correcting professional conduct rather than punishment, and said he would not abolish warnings or reprimands.
it is not appropriate for me as State Secretary to make statements about the imposed measure
ligt het niet in de rede dat ik als Staatssecretaris uitspraken doe over de opgelegde maatregel
Antwoord vragen Agema over het bericht ‘Vertrek bestuurder kost ZuidZorg 170.000 euro’

An MP from the PVV asked the state secretary for Health whether a hospital/care board member's 170,000 euro departure payment for seven weeks of work at ZuidZorg is acceptable, whether the money can be recovered, and what will be done about excessive severance payments. The state secretary acknowledged a poor appointment procedure and regretted the costs, said recovery is not possible legally, and pointed to the Wnt pay-cap law and the supervisory board as the responsible party.
I deeply regret that this Supervisory Board did not act carefully enough in this matter.
Ik betreur het zeer dat deze Raad van Toezicht hier niet zorgvuldig genoeg heeft gehandeld.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht ‘Ontslagen en faillissementen dreigen in de zorg’

An MP from the PVV asks the state secretary of Health whether his policy, including budget cuts, job losses and bankruptcies in care, will weaken care, and questions the transition of youth care and cuts to home-care tariffs. The state secretary rejects the claim that care is being dismantled, argues that bankruptcies make room for better providers, says continuity of youth care will be safeguarded through regional arrangements and Rijk instructions, and disputes the 50,000 job-loss figure.
By 31 October 2013 regional transition arrangements will be in place in all regions, setting out how cooperating municipalities will ensure continuity of care.
Op 31 oktober 2013 zullen er regionale transitiearrangementen liggen in alle regio's waarin uitgewerkt is hoe de samenwerkende gemeenten de zorgcontinuïteit realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat ouderen wekenlang verstoken zijn van thuiszorg

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that elderly people went weeks without home care after Rotterdam's new domestic care contract started, and whether this was linked to hour cuts. The state secretary answered that about 2% of clients got no help in the first week, that the municipality arranged help within days, and that no link to budget cuts was found.
I asked the municipality of Rotterdam how it ensures that the people who need it receive support again.
Ik heb nagevraagd bij de gemeente Rotterdam op welke wijze zij ervoor zorgen dat de mensen die dit nodig hebben weer ondersteuning ontvangen.
Antwoord vragen Agema over de brandbrief tegen de overhevelingen van zorgtaken naar de gemeenten

An MP asks the state secretary for Health about a letter from the Wmo councils' umbrella body warning that transferring long-term care tasks to municipalities will harm patients and municipalities, and whether the timetable is justified. The state secretary rejects the criticism, says the transfer is a reform with savings, cites the regiegroep and VNG consultation, and promises further talks with parliament without committing to a changed timetable.
I am continuously in discussion with all parties to examine in what way and at what pace the reforms in long-term care can be realised.
Ik ben voordurend met alle partijen in gesprek, om te bezien op welke manier en in welk tempo de hervormingen in de langdurige zorg gerealiseerd kunnen worden.
Vragen van de leden Helder en Agema (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Ouderen steeds banger op straat» (ingezonden 22 maart 2013).

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a Plus Magazine survey showing older people increasingly fearful on the street, questioning its representativeness, its claimed link to crime, and whether tougher sentences for elder abuse and other measures are planned. The minister answered that the survey is not representative, that the national Veiligheidsmonitor shows most older people feel safe, that no tripling of sentences for elder abuse is warranted since prosecutors have room within existing maxima, and referred to the budget debate for other measures.
I see no reason, and the figures given in the previous answers do not provide one either, to introduce a measure such as you propose.
Ik zie geen aanleiding, en de in de voorgaande antwoorden gegeven cijfers bieden die evenmin, om een maatregel zoals u voorstelt in te voeren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Fritsma en Agema over het rapport ‘Verloren tijd’

PVV MPs Fritsma and Agema asked whether the government agrees that asylum seekers should not receive day-care, education or recreation while cuts hit care for the elderly and disabled, and asked for the ACVZ report 'Verloren tijd' to be destroyed. State Secretary Teeven confirmed receipt of the advice and said a full government response will follow within three months, without taking a position on the substance yet.
As is customary, a government response to the report of the Advisory Committee on Migration Affairs (ACVZ) will be sent to the House of Representatives within three months of publication.
Zoals te doen gebruikelijk wordt binnen drie maanden na verschijning van een rapport van de Adviescommissie voor Vreemdelingenzaken (ACVZ) een kabinetsreactie aan de Tweede Kamer aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat ouderen steeds vaker een fatale val maken en de kans hierop door dit kabinetsbeleid toeneemt

An MP asked whether the rise in fatal falls among elderly people, and the removal of the rollator from the basic insurance package and cuts to home care, would increase falls, and what measures the government will take. The state secretary answered that the rollator is a personal responsibility, that the removal was decided in the Budget Agreement 2013, and pointed to local and national fall-prevention initiatives and a vitamin D supplement recommendation without committing to new national measures.
For that reason, the Budget Agreement 2013 decided that simple mobility aids, including the rollator, would no longer be reimbursed under the Zvw package from 1 January 2013.

Om die reden is in het Begrotingsakkoord 2013 besloten de eenvoudige mobiliteitshulpmiddelen, waaronder de rollator, met ingang van 1 januari 2013 niet langer te vergoeden uit hoofde van het Zvw-pakket.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Agema over de absurde Turkse inmenging in aangelegenheden van pleegzorg in Nederland

PVV MPs De Roon and Agema asked whether Turkey may interfere in placement of Turkish foster children in the Netherlands and whether Bureau Jeugdzorg should stop contact with a Turkish inquiry commission. The state secretary answered that Dutch law already sets careful placement rules, that Turkey has no authority over Turkish-national foster children here, and that the Netherlands will explain its procedures if Turkish authorities ask.
The Turkish government has no authority over foster children in the Netherlands who have Turkish nationality.
De Turkse regering heeft geen zeggenschap over pleegkinderen in Nederland met de Turkse nationaliteit.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht ‘Na de commissie blijft het akelig stil rond seksueel misbruik’

An MP from the PVV asked the state secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about criticism of the ministry over sexual abuse in youth care after the Samson commission report, and about the number of recommendations adopted. The state secretary answered that 26 of 28 recommendations are adopted, that a quality framework by Jeugdzorg Nederland is being prepared, and that Parliament will be informed in May 2013.
26 of the 28 recommendations are adopted by the government.
26 van de 28 aanbevelingen neemt de regering over.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht ‘Megasalaris van 180.000 euro voor adviseur thuiszorgorganisatie ZuidZorg’

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that a former ZuidZorg board member received a 180,000 euro salary as an adviser, and why the full board could not do the work. The state secretary answered that the arrangement stemmed from existing contract terms, that the organisation claims the adviser's expertise was needed for property files and financial risks, and that overhead is about 15%, while he cannot independently verify the organisation's claims.
I can of course not assess whether what Zuidzorg states is correct.
Ik kan uiteraard niet beoordelen of hetgeen Zuidzorg aangeeft juist is.
Antwoord vragen Wilders, Helder en Agema over het bericht Aanrander bejaarden vrij

PVV MPs Wilders, Helder and Agema asked the Justice minister about reports that a 15-year-old suspect of sexually assaulting elderly women was released, and how victims and nearby residents would be protected. The minister confirmed the reports, explained that the court lifted the pre-trial detention suspension, said further investigation and neighbourhood police contact are underway, and noted that vulnerability can be weighed in sentencing.
During this period neighbourhood police officers remain in contact with those involved.
Gedurende deze periode houden wijkagenten contact met de betrokkenen.

Antwoord vragen van de leden Fritsma en Agema over het bericht dat de gemeente Smallingerland opvang voor uitgeprocedeerde asielzoekers wil betalen met geld dat bedoeld is voor mensen met een beperking

MPs Fritsma and Agema asked whether the government will stop the municipality of Smallingerland from providing shelter to rejected asylum seekers using funds meant for people with disabilities, and how it will ensure return policy is not undermined. The state secretary said the municipality's plans were not yet clear, that municipalities have discretion over their own funds, and that the government will keep pursuing active return policy, without committing to any new concrete step against the municipality.
It is not yet clear whether and how the municipality will actually provide (emergency) shelter to these people and how this will be financed.
Het is nog niet duidelijk of en hoe de gemeente daadwerkelijk (nood)opvang gaat bieden aan deze mensen en op welke wijze een en ander gefinancierd gaat worden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht ‘Klokkenluidster op non-actief’

The MP asks whether the health inspectorate (IGZ) disclosed the names of complainants at care home De Luchte to management, whether whistleblowers should fear for their jobs, whether complaints may be passed on to institutions, and whether board members can be held jointly liable as per the Gerbrands motion. The State Secretary answers that the IGZ received an anonymous report, did not pass names on, can only forward complaints with written consent, notes the new Whistleblowers Advice Point, and says board liability is for a private legal person to pursue, with a governance vision to follow.
The IGZ never submits a report to the care institution without the written consent of the reporter.
De IGZ legt een melding nooit zonder schriftelijke toestemming van de melder voor aan de zorginstelling.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over het artikel ‘Eigen zorgcentrum Marokkanen absurd’

PVV MPs Van Klaveren and Agema asked about a news report on a care centre (Julianastaete) that may cater to Moroccan residents, asking how much public money it receives, whether such centres undermine integration, and whether Moroccan elderly should be advised to return. The government answered that the centre's total public funding cannot be isolated from the parent organisation's accounts, that care providers may target specific groups but may not exclude anyone on grounds protected by the equal treatment act, and that returning home is an individual choice it will not advise.
Since this concerns a consolidated income statement, it is not known how much of the above funds were received in connection with services at the Julianastaete location.
Aangezien het hier een geconsolideerde resultatenrekening betreft, is niet bekend hoeveel van bovengenoemde middelen zijn ontvangen in verband met de dienstverlening op de locatie Julianastaete.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Agema over het bericht “Woning oudere steeds vaker overvallen”

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice why burglaries of elderly people's homes are rising while overall robberies fall, and what will be done to protect seniors. The minister says the risk of victimisation is lower for the elderly but impact is greater, cites existing prosecution guidelines and sentencing considerations, and lists preventive measures such as information meetings, video doorbells and a toolkit for municipalities.
Precisely because of that great impact, tackling robberies is a national priority for the police and the Public Prosecution Service.
Juist vanwege die grote impact is de aanpak van overvallen een landelijke prioriteit voor politie en Openbaar Ministerie.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Agema en Gerbrands over het nieuwe softwaresysteem van zorgaanbieder HWW Zorg te Den Haag

MPs Agema and Gerbrands asked the state secretary about HWW Zorg's investment in new software while staff were allegedly dismissed for lack of money, and about the use of the Agema funds and care shortages. The state secretary said the investment amount is not known to the ministry, that no staff were dismissed for lack of money according to HWW, that the 2.8 million euro was spent on staff training and team leaders, and that the zorgkantoor and IGZ supervise the institution.
The amount is not known to me because it concerns an individual investment by an institution.
De hoogte van het bedrag is mij niet bekend omdat het gaat om een individuele investering van een instelling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Agema en Gerbrands over het bericht dat verplicht thuis wonen in plaats van in een verzorgingshuis slecht uitpakt bij een proef in Neede

PVV MPs asked the state secretary about a Neede pilot in which very old people required to live at home instead of in a care home reportedly became lonely and needed more care, and whether the Kunduz accord plan to close care homes should be reversed. The state secretary acknowledged loneliness as a concern, argued that hybrid home-and-institution arrangements already exist, said the trend toward care at home predates the plan, and promised to elaborate the measure and its property effects.

I indicated in my second progress report on the Long-Term Care Reform of 25 June that I will further elaborate the measure from the budget agreement and also take the effects on property into account.

Ik heb in mijn tweede voortgangsrapportage Hervorming Langdurige Zorg van 25 juni jl. aangegeven de maatregel uit het begrotingsakkoord verder uit te werken en daarbij ook de effecten op het vastgoed te betrekken.
Antwoord vragen Agema en Gerbrands over het bericht ‘Ouderen drogen uit in zorgcentrum’

MPs Agema and Gerbrands asked whether elderly residents at care centre Klepperwei were dehydrated due to cost-cutting, whether materials were missing, and why the Inspectorate did not act on a complaint. The state secretary replied that the Inspectorate found no reason for further inquiry in 2010, that the complaint is pending the care provider's external investigation, and that the Inspectorate will decide on action after that outcome.
Only once this report has also been adequately investigated can I give a judgement on whether elderly people were dehydrated at care centre Klepperwei.
Pas als ook deze melding adequaat is onderzocht, kan ik een oordeel geven over de vraag of er ouderen uitgedroogd zijn in zorgcentrum de Klepperwei
Antwoord vragen Agema over een hoogbejaarde vrouw met rollator die is bestolen

An MP asked whether the government finds it appalling that very elderly people are robbed on the street, whether this targets vulnerable elderly, and whether offenders targeting them should receive a threefold higher sentence. The minister condemns such robberies, points to performance agreements with the police, says no separate registration of victims with walking aids is kept, and states that victim vulnerability is already weighed within existing statutory maxima.
No separate registration is kept of the characteristics mentioned in the question.
Van de kenmerken die in de vraag worden genoemd, wordt geen aparte registratie bijgehouden.
Antwoord vragen Agema over het bericht dat een verzorgster steelt van een hoogbejaarde bewoner van een verzorgingshuis

An MP asks whether the minister is aware of a report that a care worker stole from an elderly resident of a care home, and whether further such reports would prompt an investigation, and whether a national registry for misconduct staff should be set up immediately. The state secretary acknowledges the report, says theft is the responsibility of the client to report and the care institution to prevent, declines to launch an investigation, and says she will explore whether a 'black list' or national registry is possible, including legal aspects.
I am looking into whether a 'black list', which the National Elderly Fund asks for, or a 'national registration point' is possible.
Ik zoek uit of een «zwarte lijst» waar het Nationaal Ouderenfonds om vraagt of een « landelijk registratiepunt» mogelijk is.
Antwoord vragen Agema en Gerbrands over het bericht dat voor diefstal veroordeelde bejaardenverzorgers zonder problemen terecht kunnen in anderen tehuizen

Two PVV MPs asked whether a national registry or blacklist should be set up to stop convicted carers from theft moving to other care homes, and whether care managers who do not report theft are complicit. The state secretary said a registry is still being examined with industry and the Inspectorate, that reporting is primarily the client's responsibility while care homes should support it, and that sentencing falls under the Justice minister.
Antwoord vragen Agema over diefstal van bewoners in verpleeghuizen

An MP from the PVV asked the state secretary for Health about theft of residents' valuables in nursing homes, whether staff who steal should be dismissed and barred from care work, and why a manager advised removing valuables. The state secretary said theft must be reported to police, that a blacklist for staff is being examined, and that institutions must have anti-theft policies while keeping an open climate.

As part of the project 'preventing financial exploitation' under the Action Plan 'Elderly in Safe Hands', I want to examine whether a so-called blacklist for employees who have committed wrongdoing is desirable and feasible.

In het kader van het project «voorkomen van financiële uitbuiting» van het Actieplan «Ouderen in veilige handen» wil ik nagaan of een zogenaamde zwarte lijst (voor medewerkers die de fout zijn in gegaan) wenselijk en mogelijk is
Vragen van het lid Agema (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Spaarcenten demente oudere vergokt» (ingezonden 17 november 2011).

An MP asks whether police have failed to act on a complaint about a dementia patient's savings being withdrawn by an unknown person, and whether this constitutes elder abuse warranting a tripled sentence. The minister answers that the complaint was filed late, camera footage had been deleted, the investigation was closed for lack of leads, and that financial exploitation by an unknown offender is ordinary theft, with the victim's vulnerability weighable within existing sentencing maxima.
For lack of sufficient other investigative leads, the police investigation has since been ended.
Bij gebrek aan voldoende andere opsporingsindicaties is het politieonderzoek inmiddels beëindigd.

Vragen van het lid Agema (PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat een bejaardenverzorgster die een tiental ouderen bestolen heeft, slechts een werkstraf heeft gekregen (ingezonden 1 december

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a care worker who stole from elderly clients and received only a community service sentence, and whether such offenders should be registered and face harsher penalties. The minister said the court also imposed a 99-day prison term (90 suspended), a compensation order and 180 hours of community service, declined to judge the court's ruling, and pointed to a planned mandatory VOG for paid care staff and existing sentencing discretion.
It is not appropriate for me to comment on a judicial ruling.
Het past mij niet om in een rechterlijk oordeel te treden.
Vragen van het lid Agema (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Verpleeghuis vraagt geld voor oppompen van banden» (ingezonden 2 december 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary about a report that a nursing home charged residents for tyre inflation, and about unlawful co-payments in AWBZ institutions, including NZa enforcement, the CVZ brochure on residents' rights, and sanctions against board members. The secretary says the NZa has issued orders to 3 providers after 56 reports, that residents must be compensated, and that board members are liable to supervisory board action.
In 3 cases the NZa found that there was a violation.
In 3 gevallen heeft de NZa geconstateerd dat er sprake was van een overtreding.
Vragen van het lid Agema (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Fusie tussen BerneZorg en Zorggroep Dorus» (ingezonden 24 november 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary for health whether the planned BerneZorg and Zorggroep Dorus merger would be subject to a fusion impact report and a fusion test by the NZa and IGZ, and how a moratorium on care mergers would be enforced.
