The state secretary replied that fusion reviews will be tightened through upcoming legislation, that until then parties cannot be obliged to do impact reports, and that the regulators lack powers to block the merger now.
The legislation I referred to in my answer to question 2 will also anchor the obligation to draw up a fusion impact report.
In de wetgeving, waar ik in het antwoord op vraag 2 naar verwijs, zal ook de verplichting tot het opstellen van een fusie-effectrapportage worden verankerd.

Vragen van de leden Agema en Gerbrands (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Medicijnkastjes ouderen jaarlijks doorgelicht» (ingezonden 29 september 2011).

PVV MPs asked the state secretary about a report that elderly people's medicine cabinets are checked yearly, including whether elderly patients are wrongly prescribed medicines and whether GPs check medication use often enough. The minister said better monitoring is positive, cited national hospital-admission research and a forthcoming polypharmacy guideline, and said yearly comprehensive medication review is advisable while rejecting extra funding for GPs.
I do not have such specific research results at national level.
Ik beschik niet over dergelijke specifieke onderzoeksresultaten op landelijk niveau.

Vragen van de leden Gerbrands en Agema (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Verpleegkundigen doen zelden aangifte van geweld» (ingezonden 29 september 2011).

PVV MPs asked the state secretary about a report that nurses rarely file police reports after violence, including how often violence occurs in hospitals and care homes, whether patients should pay for care when they are violent, cultural causes, reporting obstacles, self-defence courses and attractiveness of care work. The minister answered that violence against care workers is unacceptable, reporting rates are rising, the government will stimulate reporting and damage recovery, and points to its labour market letter for measures.
The willingness to report is increasing.

Vragen van het lid Agema (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat een hoogbejaarde mevrouw uit een verpleeghuis wordt gezet omdat haar zoon klaagde over de kwaliteit van zo

An MP asked the state secretary about a report that an elderly woman must leave nursing home Vivaldi after her son complained about care quality, and about related complaints and oversight of the home's management. The secretary confirmed the move, said the court found Vivaldi had grounds to terminate the care contract, and said the Inspectorate found no misconduct and no reason for extra supervision.
Both the Inspectorate and the court have ruled that there is no question of misconduct here.
Zowel de IGZ als de Rechtbank heeft geoordeeld dat hier geen sprake is van misstanden.
Vragen van het lid Agema (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Schone was onbetaalbaar voor zorgcliënt» (ingezonden 2 augustus 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary about a news report that care clients pay far above the NZa average of EUR 36 per month for laundry, and whether maximum fees and public price lists should be imposed. The state secretary said the sum is set in consultation between provider and client council, that a Nibud guideline amount is being commissioned, and that mandatory price disclosure would be disproportionate.
I have no data available on how many clients pay more than this average amount.
Ik heb geen gegevens beschikbaar hoeveel cliënten meer dan dit gemiddelde bedrag betalen.

Vragen van de leden Agema en Lucassen (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht dat hoogbejaarde ouderen in D

PVV MPs asked why elderly residents in Delft were confined to their homes for weeks during lift renovation and urged action against housing corporation Woonbron. The minister said the renovation was necessary, temporary measures were taken, a stairlift was not feasible, and the matter is a dispute between tenant and landlord, so no further action is planned.
It is correct that Woonbron is renovating the building's only lift over fifteen working days.
Het klopt dat Woonbron de (enige) lift van het woongebouw in vijftien werkdagen renoveert

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Helder, Agema en Wilders (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Justitie over de aanhoudende ellende door Marokkaanse straatterro

PVV MPs asked the Interior and Justice ministers about recurring youth disturbances by Moroccan-background youths, including proposals to cut benefits to parents, a criminological study on Islam and violence, making offenders pay for police deployment, and snelrecht. The minister rejected cutting parents' benefits and police cost recovery, cited a study of German youths with caution, and said no prosecution arose in the Zandvoort case.
I do not share that view. Withdrawing a welfare benefit or allowances does not contribute to solving the problem.
Die visie deel ik niet. Het intrekken van een bijstandsuitkering of toeslagen draagt niet bij aan de oplossing van de problematiek.
Vragen van het lid Agema (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de berichten over sterfte door medicijnen (ingezonden 6 juni 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary about reports of deaths from antipsychotic medication in dementia patients and whether the inspectorate monitors this use and adherence to treatment guidelines. The secretary declines to confirm the British estimate, rejects an immediate stop to antipsychotic use, points to training, guideline adherence and improvement programmes, and says the inspectorate is examining how to monitor guideline compliance and will include the issue in its questions.
Yes, I will include this in my questions to the IGZ as part of a sharper focus on proper care for people with dementia.
Ja ik zal in dit in mijn vragen aan de IGZ opnemen als deel van een scherpere focus op de juiste goede zorg aan dementerenden.

Vragen van het lid Agema (PVV) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over een vanuit de AWBZ bekostigde luxe studiereis

An MP asked the ministers of Health and Economic Affairs why AWBZ funds and ministry money paid for a luxury study trip for care executives, whether the ministry initiated it, and why it was not cancelled. The minister replied that the trip was a benchmarking visit, that participants paid their own travel costs with organisations deciding co-payment, that VWS paid organisational costs, and that the trip was too far advanced to cancel, while promising more frugality in future.
It is up to the care institutions whether and to what extent the participant pays for the trip themselves.
Het is aan de zorginstellingen of en in welke mate de deelnemer zelf meebetaalt aan de reis.

Vragen van het lid Agema (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de vertrouwenscrisis tussen ondernemingsraad en bestuur bij Thuiszorg Groningen, en de sponsoring door deze organisatie va

An MP asks the state secretary whether a governance conflict between the works council and board of Thuiszorg Groningen could harm home-care quality, whether IGZ supervision should be tightened, and whether the organisation's sponsorship of FC Groningen is acceptable. The secretary says the conflict carries risks, IGZ sees no reason for tighter supervision but is monitoring developments, and the sponsorship contract has been ended from the 2011/2012 season.
The IGZ informs me that tightened supervision is not yet appropriate. However, developments at TZG are being closely monitored.
De IGZ laat mij weten verscherpt toezicht nog niet aan de orde te vinden. Wel worden de ontwikkelingen bij TZG nauwlettend gevolgd.

Vragen van het lid Agema (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat ouderen wegens lange wachtlijsten hun kamer in hun verpleeghuis kwijt kunnen raken als ze langer dan 14 da

An MP asks the state secretary whether nursing homes may give away residents' rooms after 14 days of hospital admission and why the 2 billion euro building programme did not deliver single rooms. The secretary confirms the sector's voluntary terms guaranteeing a room for at least 14 days, defends the sector initiative and says the NZa study on absence rules will be awaited before any change.
I want to await the results of this study and then look at a possible solution.
Ik wil de resultaten van dit onderzoek afwachten om daarna te kijken naar een mogelijke oplossing.

Vragen van het lid Agema (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat naar schatting vijftig boodschappenbegeleidingsdiensten voor ouderen komen te vervallen door bezuinigingen

An MP asked the state secretary whether she would act to prevent about fifty grocery-shopping services for elderly people from disappearing due to municipal budget cuts, and whether the Wmo budget should be earmarked for target groups. The secretary said municipalities are responsible for local welfare services and she would not intervene, while clarifying the Wmo budget cut composition and rejecting earmarking as contrary to the law's purpose.
That decision is for the municipalities. Under the Wmo framework they are fully responsible for welfare services, such as grocery services, so that they can tailor local arrangements.
Die beslissing is aan gemeenten. Zij zijn in het Wmo-kader volledig verantwoordelijk voor welzijnsvoorzieningen, zoals boodschappendiensten, zodat zij lokaal maatwerk kunnen verrichten.
Vragen van de leden Venrooy-van Ark (VVD), Agema (PVV) en Uitslag (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het pgb (ingezonden 24 december 2010).

MPs from VVD, PVV and CDA asked the state secretary about confusion over personal budgets (pgb) for care packages and whether the 2010 budget guarantee applies to people staying at home versus moving to a housing initiative. The state secretary answered that the motion will be implemented, the new tariff calculation is paused for existing budget holders until the spring memorandum, and the CVZ will be asked to clarify the distinction in the subsidy regulation.
The motion means for existing budget holders with a residence indication that the new tariff calculation method does not apply to them for the time being.
De motie betekent voor bestaande budgethouders met een verblijfsindicatie dat de nieuwe berekeningswijze van de pgb-tarieven vooralsnog niet op hen van toepassing is.

Vragen van het lid Agema (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat dementerenden in een verpleeghuis over een langere periode voedsel voorgeschoteld kregen dat (ver) over de datum wa

An MP asked the health minister how she reacts to reports that dementia patients in a nursing home were served food long past its expiry date, whether the director's response is adequate, whether the Inspectorate will investigate, and whether the home will be given a directive or placed under enhanced supervision. The minister regrets the incidents, says the board is addressing the problem and staff have been instructed, that the Inspectorate and VWA are investigating with a VWA visit finding no violations, but that there is currently no reason for a directive or enhanced supervision.
The investigation by the IGZ has been initiated in cooperation with the Food and Goods Authority (VWA).
Het onderzoek door de IGZ is in gang gezet in samenwerking met de Voedsel en Waren Autoriteit (VWA).

Vragen van de leden Agema en Wilders (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat steeds meer zorginstellingen kosten aan bewoners doorrekenen voor zaken die vallen onder de AWBZ (inge

PVV MPs Agema and Wilders asked the health minister about reports that care institutions charge residents for AWBZ-covered services and whether residents have enforceable rights comparable to prisoners. The minister answered that such charges are unlawful, that the NZa has written to providers and expects 50 to 100 cases of improper payments, and that client rights are adequately protected under existing laws and a new client rights bill.
Charging supplementary payments for services that belong to insured care is not permitted.
Het vragen van bijbetalingen voor diensten die tot de verzekerde zorg behoren is niet geoorloofd.
Vragen van het lid Agema (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat ouderen bij een zorginstelling wekenlang niet gewassen worden (ingezonden 23 juli 2010).

An MP asks the health minister about reports that elderly residents at care facility Cordaan go unwashed for weeks, along with other alleged failures such as missed medication and residents absconding from a locked ward, and whether supervision is lacking. The minister says the IGZ is investigating the reports, rejects the claim that supervision falls short, and will act on the outcome of the investigation.
The Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGZ) is conducting an investigation into these reports.
De Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) doet een onderzoek naar deze meldingen.

Vragen van het lid Agema (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat de traagheid van het ministerie van VWS leidt tot woekerprijzen voor medisch isotopen (ingezonden 1 juli 2010).

An MP asks the health minister whether slow ministry decision-making caused tripled medical isotope prices, whether a TU Delft back-up reactor proposal should be funded, and why TU Delft has not received promised money. The minister denies that decision-making caused the price rise, says an OECD review is ongoing, and says he is considering the TU Delft proposal without having committed the funds.
No general or official data are known about this.
Hierover zijn geen algemene of officiële gegevens bekend.

Vragen van het lid Agema (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat een crisismanager van een GGZ-instelling een megasalaris heeft ontvangen (ingezonden 4 juni 2010).

MP Agema (PVV) asks the health minister about reports that an interim crisis manager at GGZ Delfland earned about 65,000 euro per month, more than double the sector salary cap. Minister Klink answers that the annual report shows about 2 million euro for four months including employer costs and fees, that the Wet normering topinkomens (WNT) is being prepared to set pay norms, and that appointing executives is the responsibility of the supervisory boards.
To ensure that the pay of executives of care institutions reaches a socially responsible level, this cabinet has prepared a bill, the WNT (Wet normering topinkomens).

Om te bewerkstelligen dat de honorering van bestuurders van zorginstellingen op een maatschappelijk verantwoord niveau komt, heeft dit kabinet een wetsvoorstel voorbereid, de WNT (wet normering topinkomens).

Vragen van het lid Agema (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over invoering van de Balkenendenorm voor zorgbestuurders door weer een megavertrekbonus van vier ton (ingezonden 18 juni 2010).

An MP asks the health minister whether she knows that a care-institution director received a four-million-euro severance bonus and whether the Balkenende norm for top salaries should apply to care executives. The minister refers to earlier answers, noting that the WNT pay-norm bill has been drafted, places healthcare under the code regime, and is awaiting Council of State advice before it is sent to parliament.
In brief, the answers to questions 3, 4 and 6 amount to the statement that the cabinet has meanwhile drafted a bill for norming top incomes, the WNT.
Kort samengevat komen die antwoorden op de vragen 3, 4 en 6 neer op de mededeling dat het kabinet inmiddels een wetsvoorstel voor de normering van topinkomens heeft opgesteld, de WNT
Vragen van het lid Agema (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat in Nederland jaarlijks zeker 200.000 ouderen mishandeld worden (ingezonden 16 juni 2010).

An MP asked the health minister about reports that at least 200,000 elderly people are abused in the Netherlands each year, and whether the minister would implement previously proposed measures such as mandatory certificates for care workers, municipal reporting points, a national register, and a higher maximum penalty. The minister responded that abuse is already a priority, pointed to existing and planned measures such as the reporting code and regional reporting points, said the costs and benefits of the registry and mandatory certificates will be examined, and declined to raise the maximum penalty.
As for the suggestions of a national registry, the need for a mandatory certificate and the question of disciplinary law, I want to have the pros and cons mapped out.
Voor wat betreft de suggesties van een landelijke registratiepunt, de noodzaak van een verplichte VOG en de kwestie van tuchtrecht wil ik de voors en tegens daarvan in kaart laten brengen.

Vragen van het lid Agema (PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht dat directeur Lodewijk de Waal van Humanitas goedpraat dat PVV-raadslid René Eekhuis wordt uitgesloten terwijl

MP Agema (PVV) asked the Minister of Interior whether the government would stop subsidising Humanitas after its director appeared to defend excluding a PVV councillor while he himself stands on the PvdA list, and how the minister would reprimand Humanitas. The minister confirmed awareness of the facts but declined to judge the dispute, saying it is a matter between Humanitas and the councillor and for the courts or the Commissie gelijke behandeling, and that subsidy relations would not change that.
It is not for me as Minister to make any substantive ruling on that.
Het is niet aan mij om daar als Minister enige inhoudelijke uitspraak over te doen.

Vragen van het lid Agema (PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht dat Humanitas PVV-gemeenteraadslid René Eekhuis buitensluit van het organiseren van kindervakantieweken vanweg

An MP asks the Minister of the Interior whether it is unacceptable that Humanitas, a subsidised organisation, excluded a PVV councillor from organising children's holiday weeks for his political views, and what sanctions could be imposed. The minister gives the subsidy amounts Humanitas received and states it is not for him to judge the matter, which falls to the subsidising administrative bodies under the General Administrative Law Act.
It is for the relevant administrative bodies to assess whether action has been taken within the legal framework of the law and the subsidy decision.
Het is aan de desbetreffende bestuursorganen om te beoordelen of binnen de juridische kaders van de wet en de subsidiebeschikking is gehandeld.

Vragen van het lid Agema (PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht dat Humanitas wil dat bestuurslid Rene Eekhuis opstapt nu hij raadslid voor de PVV is geworden in de gemeente

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether Humanitas may demand that a board member step down because he became a PVV councillor, whether this breaches its non-discrimination rules, what the government will do, how many board members hold party political posts, and how much subsidy Humanitas receives. The Minister replied that discrimination complaints belong to the courts or the Commission for Equal Treatment and declined to comment on the substance, saying subsidy relations change nothing.
If a person concerned believes there is discrimination, that person can go to the courts or the Equal Treatment Commission to obtain a ruling or judgment.

Als een betrokkene van mening is dat er sprake zou zijn van discriminatie, staat voor betrokkene de weg naar de rechter of de Commissie gelijke behandeling open om daar een uitspraak dan wel oordeel over te verkrijgen.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Six Dijkstra over de groeiende afhankelijkheid van Amerikaanse techgiganten

MPs Kathmann and Six Dijkstra asked the ministers how government bodies, including RIVM and the NZa, depend on US cloud providers, what would happen if access were cut, and whether migrations would be halted. The government answered that some migrations were reconsidered or paused, that a revised Rijksbrede cloud policy is being prepared, and that continuity risks and concentration risks will be addressed, but gave no firm halt to US dependence.
Migrations have been reconsidered following, among other things, the Kathmann motion.
Er zijn migraties heroverwogen naar aanleiding van onder meer de motie Kathmann.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Van Nispen over het belang van verslavingsartsen en de resultaten van een enquête hierover

SP MPs Dobbe and Van Nispen asked the health minister about a VVGN survey showing addiction doctors want the two-year training extended by one year with interdisciplinary placement, and whether that is needed. The minister acknowledges the signals, will ask the CGS for its view on necessity, and says extension would require NZa recalculation of funding if deemed necessary for starting competence.
That is why I will also ask the College Geneeskundige Specialismen (CGS) of the KNMG to give its view on this necessity in the short term.
Daarom zal ik ook het College Geneeskundige Specialismen (CGS) van de KNMG op korte termijn verzoeken om zijn visie te geven op deze noodzakelijkheid.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dral, Van den Hil en Tielen over het artikel '‘Ik heb zelfs een huis opgeblazen’; Malafide medewerkers in de jeugdzorg maken misbruik van de positie van kwetsbare jongeren’

MPs Dral, Van den Hil and Tielen (VVD) asked the State Secretaries about a Telegraaf report that malicious youth-care workers exploit vulnerable youths for crime, and about fraud with EVC certificates and training points in the youth-care register. The government answered that it does not know the numbers, is sampling 274 of about 3,500 EVC-based registrations, has suspended 490 pending applications, and is pursuing wider anti-fraud measures.
Therefore the SKJ started with a sample of 274 files to determine the content and pace of the follow-up on that basis.
Daarom is de SKJ gestart met een steekproef van 274 dossiers om op basis daarvan de inhoud en het tempo van het vervolg te kunnen bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Sneller over medicinale cannabis

MPs Paulusma and Sneller asked the Health Minister about delays to the medicinal cannabis policy, supply continuity for patients, the closing of the procurement for a second grower, reimbursement and inspection capacity. The Minister said the policy rule and law change will proceed on schedule, supply will come from existing stock with a fallback import plan, and no new plans exist to change the current variety offer or reimbursement.
The Ministry of VWS will then proceed to import medicinal cannabis as a finished product.
Het Ministerie van VWS zal dan overgaan tot import van medicinale cannabis als «gereed product».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht 'Antonius Sneek trekt stekker uit plan voor nieuw ziekenhuis in Joure'

An SP MP asked the health minister about Antonius Sneek withdrawing from a planned merger and new hospital in Joure, including concerns about staff and local patients, and whether a moratorium on closing hospital units should be imposed. The minister said the hospital has withdrawn from the merger but remains committed to cooperation, that hospital boards bear responsibility for service provision, and that she declined a moratorium while pointing to existing legal consultation requirements.
I will continue to closely monitor the situation and will ask to be informed about the consequences of these recent developments.
Ik blijf de situatie nauw volgen en zal mij laten informeren over de gevolgen van deze recente ontwikkelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het dreigende verlies van zorgaanbod in Zeeuws-Vlaanderen

An SP MP asked the health minister how she will respond to signals that Zeeuws-Vlaanderen may lose hospital care, whether it is acceptable for emergency and acute obstetric care to disappear, and how local voices are included. The minister answers that she is in contact with the hospitals, that 24/7 acute care will not disappear under the planned cooperation, that stakeholders will be involved later, and that she is preparing regulation and a handreiking on changes to regional care.
My aim is to start the public consultation on this legislation in September 2025.
Mijn inzet is erop gericht om de consultatie van deze wetgeving in september 2025 te starten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Dobbe over het bericht 'Winstnorm kan niet voorkomen dat zorggeld naar Porsches en paarden gaat'

MPs Dijk and Dobbe asked the minister whether profit-making in healthcare should be legally limited, whether a total ban on profit distribution is the answer, and whether oversight and transparency of care providers should be improved. The minister rejects a blanket profit ban, points to the pending Wibz bill, a planned exploration of licensing for subcontractors and solo providers, a Wmo oversight improvement trajectory and expanded annual reporting, while promising further assessment rather than immediate new rules.
I therefore want to carry out an exploration of a licensing requirement for subcontractors and solo practitioners.
Ik wil daarom een verkenning uitvoeren naar een vergunningplicht voor onderaannemers en solisten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Claassen over het bericht dat de traumaheli niet gestationeerd mag worden op vliegveld Teuge en nu mogelijk op vliegveld Twente gestationeerd gaat worden

An MP asked the Minister of Health why a trauma helicopter may not be based at Teuge airport and whether it might go to Twente instead, and about the pros and cons of each site. The Minister confirms the 'white spot' in trauma care in eastern Netherlands, says the LNAZ research favours a 24/7 helicopter MMT at Teuge, and gives no firm deadline because funding, regulation, licensing and the province's airport decision still need to be settled.
I cannot give a deadline for when a helicopter MMT in eastern Netherlands can be operational, because realisation and implementation depend on many variables and several parties are involved.

Ik kan geen deadline geven waarop een helikopter-MMT in Oost-Nederland operationeel kan zijn, omdat realisatie en implementatie van veel variabelen afhankelijk is en hier verschillende partijen bij betrokken zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht ‘Gemeente Almelo zeer teleurgesteld na vrijspraak’

An MP asked the health minister how to strengthen criminal prosecution of healthcare fraud after an acquittal of a care provider the Almelo municipality had accused of misusing care funds, and whether a weak point in the rules exists. The minister answered that criminal law requires a higher burden of proof than civil and administrative law, that civil and administrative rulings already ordered repayment, that the Wibz bill and other measures are underway, and that the Ministry keeps no register of such cases.
The Ministry of VWS does not keep a register of court cases against healthcare fraudsters.
Het Ministerie van VWS houdt geen registratie bij van rechtszaken tegen zorgfraudeurs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Dobbe over het bericht dat ongediplomeerd personeel in dienst is bij zorgverleners

MPs Dijk and Dobbe (SP) asked the minister about reports that unqualified staff, including agency workers, were deployed in care roles requiring diplomas, and about the role of agency Allround Care. The minister said care providers are responsible for checking staff competence, declined to create new routes for unqualified staff, and noted the IGJ lacks nationwide incident data and cannot supervise staffing agencies directly, though it has reported individuals for fraud.
The IGJ has informed me that there have been incidents and calamities due to the deployment of unauthorised and incompetent staff, but that it does not keep figures on this.
De IGJ heeft mij laten weten dat er incidenten en calamiteiten zijn geweest door het inzetten van onbevoegd en onbekwaam personeel, maar dat zij daarover geen aantallen bijhoudt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Claassen over het bericht dat er ongediplomeerde krachten worden ingezet in zorginstellingen

An MP asked the health minister whether care providers would stop using unqualified staff supplied by agency Allround Care after Gemiva ended its contract, and whether this affected care quality. The minister said the IGJ has spoken with the providers, who have ended or suspended the arrangement and tightened screening, and that the IGJ keeps no national figures on incidents caused by unqualified staff.
A nationwide overview of incidents and calamities in care directly attributable to the deployment of unauthorised and incompetent staff does not exist.
Een landelijk dekkend overzicht van incidenten en calamiteiten in de zorg die rechtstreeks zijn toe te schrijven aan de inzet van onbevoegd en onbekwaam personeel is er niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht 'Noodkreet GGZ-instelling de Waag: wachtlijsten plotseling nog langer door aanpassing van beleid'

MP Westerveld asks the minister why roughly 1,000 child and youth psychologists are no longer getting BIG registration as health psychologists despite comparable training, and asks about the impact analysis, the motion on consultation, and possible transitional arrangements. The minister defends not proceeding with the draft bill after negative internet consultation, says child and youth psychologists can keep working in youth care without BIG registration, and rejects a transitional arrangement because of higher costs.
At this moment I see no reason to change the professional structure of mental health care in the BIG Act.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om de beroepenstructuur van de geestelijke gezondheidszorg in de Wet BIG te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht ‘Utrechts tandartsechtpaar vecht miljoenenruzie uit met keten die praktijk kocht’

An SP MP asks the health minister about reports that a dental practice was bought by a chain (Fresh) that allegedly charged excessive fees, and whether investor ownership of dental practices should be curbed. The minister says the matter is for supervisors, that no signals were received by NZa or IGJ, and points to pending legislation (Wibz, tightened merger test) while rejecting a ban on private equity as disproportionate.
I am not aware of the contractual arrangements made between the parties. Nor is it up to me to judge this.
Ik ben niet op de hoogte van de contractuele afspraken die tussen partijen zijn gemaakt. Het is ook niet aan mij om hier een oordeel over te hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht dat fysiotherapie buiten het basispakket zal vallen

The SP MP Dijk asked whether physiotherapy would be excluded from the basic health insurance package, with questions on access, costs, and evidence. The Minister answers that no decision has been taken to remove physiotherapy from the basic package, that access is not changing, and that the Health Care Institute has assessed the evidence for several indications.
No, this is not correct. There are no planned changes that would remove physiotherapy from the basic package.
Nee, dit klopt niet. Er zijn geen wijzigingen gepland waarmee fysiotherapie uit het basispakket wordt gehaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Claassen over het bericht 'Nieuwe behandeling? Alleen nog vergoeden als die klimaat en zorgpersoneel spaart'

MP Claassen (PVV) asked whether using CO2 reduction and healthcare staffing as criteria for reimbursing new treatments is acceptable and how the three-year Zorginstituut experiment testing these criteria is set up. Minister Van Hijum answered that effectiveness remains the primary criterion, that workforce and sustainability may sometimes weigh more, and described the Zorginstituut plan and Mackenbach commission follow-up, while committing to a plan of action for the trial period.
I have asked the Zorginstituut to prepare a plan of action for the trial period in the short term.
Ik heb het Zorginstituut gevraagd om op korte termijn een plan van aanpak te maken voor de proefperiode.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Daniëlle Jansen over het bericht dat op 16 mei 2025 de Algemene Leden Vergadering van het College Adviserend Tandartsen (CAT) heeft besloten de vereniging na 76 jaar op te heffen

An MP asked the health minister about the dissolution of the College Adviserend Tandartsen (CAT) after 76 years, and whether dental treatment assessment for insurance is independent and uniform now that the CAT is gone. The minister said the CAT was a members' association, that insurers' in-house dental advisers still assess claims, that no signals of unjustified differences were known, and that insurers are setting up a knowledge centre, with uniformity guaranteed via assessment guidelines and complaints to SKGZ.
It is not for the Minister of VWS to judge how health insurers organise their advisory functions.
Het is niet aan de Minister van VWS om een oordeel te hebben over de wijze waarop zorgverzekeraars hun advisering inrichten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Tielen over het bericht ‘Zorgverleners steeds vaker slachtoffer van agressie van patiënten én hun naasten. ‘Ik durfde niet meer voor de patiënt te zorgen’’

Two MPs from the VVD asked the health minister about reports that healthcare workers increasingly face aggression from patients and their relatives, and about progress on their party's anti-aggression plan, the KNMG guideline on ending treatment relationships, motions on anti-aggression programmes and prison sentences, and privacy rules limiting information-sharing between hospitals. The minister acknowledged the problem, reported that most plan points have been implemented or are underway (including an anti-aggression campaign and a planned bill on sentencing exemptions), explained the limited scope of the KNMG guideline and privacy constraints, and referred the motion follow-up to the justice minister.
Aggression against healthcare workers is never acceptable.
Agressie tegen zorgmedewerkers is nooit acceptabel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het aantal inzetten van ambulances, rapid responders en first responders

An MP asked the Minister of Health for totals of ambulance, rapid responder and first responder deployments from 2017 to 2024 and an explanation for rising numbers. The minister supplied figures up to 2023, attributed the rise in rapid responders to more mobile care consultations, admitted no clear explanation yet for the 2023 jump in first responders, and promised data for 2024 after the summer.
These figures are available up to and including 2023.
Deze cijfers zijn beschikbaar tot en met 2023.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht 'Alleen garantie op gescheurde borstimplantaten als je ze laat vervangen

MPs Tielen and Slagt-Tichelman asked the minister about reports that breast implant manufacturers' warranties only cover torn implants if the patient gets replacements, and whether this misleads patients and whether oversight is adequate. The minister said such contract terms are for the civil courts to judge, noted removal may be covered by the basic health package when medically necessary, reported very few complaints, and said she is reviewing the reporting structure for implant complaints.
Ultimately it is for the civil judge (on the claim of the injured party) to decide.
Dat is uiteindelijk aan de civiele rechter (op vordering van de benadeelde).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Dijk over het bericht 'Na vier maanden strengere zzp-handhaving knelt het vooral nog in de zorg'

SP MPs Dobbe and Dijk asked the Minister of Health about strict enforcement against bogus self-employment in care, and about making employment in care more attractive. The minister said the Tax Authority will not impose fines on 2025 and will talk with businesses first, promised to pursue both tracks, and pointed to existing programmes on autonomy and a new workforce platform, but ruled out extra funds for pay increases.
I do not have figures on the number of self-employed workers who took up employment with care providers last year.
Ik beschik niet over cijfers over het aantal zzp'ers dat afgelopen jaar in loondienst is getreden bij zorgaanbieders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het opiniestuk 'Er is geen verband tussen geitenboerderijen en longontstekingen bij omwonenden'

Christianne van der Plas (BBB) asked the Minister of Health about a published opinion piece claiming no consistent link between goat farms and pneumonia in residents, and about the limited access to VGO-III study data and the number of patients included. The minister answered that the data were made available to MPs in anonymised form subject to privacy law, that the pneumonia conclusion rests on large electronic patient record studies, and that the independent Health Council will assess the full VGO-III report.
Sharing data of individual patients, however, is bound by privacy legislation, which is why the database was not simply made public.
Het delen van data van individuele patiënten is echter gebonden aan privacywetgeving en daarom is de database niet zondermeer openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op van het lid Dekker over de NAVO-verplichtingen

An MP from FVD asked why briefings on NATO obligations for cabinet members were classified and not shared with parliament, who organised them, and what the NATO Resilience Objectives are and whether the government is bound by them. The Minister answered that the briefings were classified Departementaal Vertrouwelijk, that the drafters set the classification, that some briefings have been declassified on request, that the commitments are politically binding, and that the NATO Resilience Objectives are a non-public document, with some questions answered only by reference.
The NATO Resilience Objectives are set out in an underlying document that is not public.
De NAVO Resilience Objectives zijn weergegeven in een onderliggend document dat niet openbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht: ‘Meer seksueel grensoverschrijdend gedrag door zorgverleners dan gedacht’

An MP asks the health minister about reports of sexual boundary violations by care workers and the Inspectorate's estimate of their prevalence, reporting thresholds, sanctions and action plans. The government acknowledges the problem and its underreporting, points to existing reporting channels, the national action programme and a government commissioner, and states that the Inspectorate's findings are being incorporated into current policy with a progress update next spring.
Care providers must report sexual boundary-crossing behaviour to the inspectorate.
Zorgaanbieders moeten seksueel grensoverschrijdend gedrag melden bij de inspectie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de ondersteuning van organisaties die zich inzetten voor mensen met een beperking

Westerveld asks about support for organisations working with people with disabilities, including a loneliness-prevention group at risk of closing, funding for ethnic and disability research versus practice, involvement of experience experts in campaigns, and municipal involvement of lonely people. Staatssecretaris Maeijer answers by listing existing subsidies and programmes, explains that research funds are mostly for research with limited compensation pilots, and says municipal engagement has not declined but the survey question changed.
There is no complete government-wide overview available of subsidies that specifically support organisations working for people with a disability.
Er is geen volledig Rijksbreed overzicht beschikbaar van subsidies die specifiek organisaties ondersteunen die zich inzetten voor mensen met een beperking.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oostenbrink en Rikkers-Oosterkamp over het bericht ‘Kabinet zet streep door nieuwe tandartsopleiding in Rotterdam, Zeeland teleur gesteld; Absoluut onwenselijke situatie

MPs Oostenbrink and Rikkers-Oosterkamp asked why the cabinet dropped a new dental training programme in Rotterdam and kept the six-year dental course, despite the shortage of dentists in Zeeland. The ministers answered that the decision concerns keeping the six-year duration, that starting a new programme is up to institutions and the field under a fixed procedure, that 31 places are being realised now with a new capacity forecast expected at year end, and that shortening the course would only free funds from 2033.
At the end of 2025 the next integral forecast of the Capacity Body is expected.
Eind 2025 wordt de eerstvolgende integrale raming van het Capaciteitsorgaan verwacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thiadens over het bericht: ‘Recordaantal gedwongen opnames gevraagd voor verpleeghuis: ‘Vooral alleenstaande demente ouderen vormen een groot gevaar’'

An MP asked the Health Minister about news reports of record numbers of compulsory admissions of elderly people with dementia and whether restoring old-age care homes would prevent these. The minister acknowledged the dangers, defended the Wzd safeguards and said care homes would not have prevented compulsory admissions, while a study on their return and housing targets are ongoing.
In the extreme case it is possible to admit an elderly person with dementia against their wishes if they are a danger to themselves or others.
In het uiterste geval is het mogelijk om een oudere met dementie tegen zijn wens in op te nemen als hij een gevaar voor zichzelf of anderen is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk, Paulusma, Bikker en Krul over het beëindigen van de VWS-subsidie aan het IKNL Trialbureau

MPs asked why the minister is ending the VWS subsidy for the IKNL trial bureau, its amount, timing, alternatives and impact. The minister confirmed the subsidy for trial activities ends on 1 January 2026 on state aid grounds, stated the 2025 amount, and declined substantive answers on alternatives and timing because an objection by IKNL is pending.
Because of this ongoing objection procedure, I cannot make any further substantive statements.
Vanwege deze lopende bezwaarprocedure kan ik daarom verder geen inhoudelijke uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over onderzoek naar oversterfte

An FVD MP asked the Minister of Health whether she would ask Lareb to release data requested by Professor Meester for research into excess mortality. The Minister answered that she will pass the question to Lareb but that Lareb, as an independent foundation, decides for itself how to respond, and noted privacy and data-suitability concerns.
I am willing to share the question from MP Van Houwelingen with the foundation Lareb.
Ik ben bereid de vraag van lid Van Houwelingen te delen met stichting Lareb.
Antwoord op op de vragen van het lid van Houwelingen over het artikel ‘Kanker door mRNA-prikken’

An FVD MP asked the Health Minister about a media article and several studies linking mRNA COVID-19 vaccines to cancer, immune effects and calls to halt vaccination, and asked for independent research and more public information. The state secretary answered that there is no scientific evidence for a link to cancer, that the cited studies are hypotheses or do not show what is claimed, that no further independent research or halt is planned, and that existing information will be kept transparent and updated.
I see no reason to commission additional research.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om extra onderzoek te laten uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over het massale gebruik van glyfosaat voor de productie van veevoer

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the ministers whether glyphosate use for feed crops, its proximity to homes, possible health and Parkinson's risks, and bee losses justify a ban or tighter measures. The minister replied that the EU re-approval rests on independent science, that a legal ban on glyphosate uses is not possible, that a draft decree to make alternatives mandatory is with the Raad van State, and that RIVM research on glyphosate and Parkinson's will report in 3-5 years.
Partly because of your House's wish, I have taken steps to make alternatives to the use of crop protection products mandatory.
Mede vanwege de wens van uw Kamer heb ik wel stappen gezet om alternatieven voor het gebruik van gewasbeschermingsmiddelen te verplichten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Daniëlle Jansen over de documentaire ‘Crowdfunding: vloek of zegen?’ gemaakt door Omroep Gelderland

MPs Tielen and Daniëlle Jansen asked the health minister about a documentary on crowdfunding for stem cell therapy in MS, the status of a promised review of when the therapy can be covered, why other countries use it more, how many patients go abroad, and whether it is clear to patients who qualifies. The minister answered that the Zorginstituut covers the therapy only for very active RRMS since December 2022, that an evaluation with safeguards is ongoing, that it does not track patients going abroad, and that the Zorginstituut can re-assess if new evidence emerges.
It is unknown how many MS patients have gone abroad for stem cell therapy and how many of them were cured after this therapy.
Het is onbekend hoeveel MS-patiënten naar het buitenland zijn gegaan om stamceltherapie te ondergaan en hoeveel van hen zijn genezen na deze therapie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht dat de lagere vergoeding vanuit de zorgverzekeraars leidt tot de sluiting van hospices

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether the lower reimbursement from health insurers, which is said to force hospices to close, is acceptable, and what concrete steps are being taken to keep hospices from failing. The State Secretary answered that talks with care providers, insurers and branch organisations are ongoing, that seven Bijna Thuis Huizen cases are being examined, that no hospice should close because of lower tariffs, and that further steps to improve palliative care access are planned, with a promise to inform parliament of the outcome.

I have invited care professionals, care providers, health insurers and branch organisations to sit down together to examine what exactly is happening here and to what extent this requires a targeted solution.

Zoals ik eerder heb aangegeven, heb ik zorgprofessionals, zorgaanbieders, zorgverzekeraars en branches uitgenodigd om aan tafel te gaan om samen te bezien wat hier nu precies aan de hand is en in hoeverre dit een gerichte oplossing vraagt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP asked multiple ministers about diversity, gender and inclusion policy, budgets, training, quotas and evaluation within implementing agencies. The answers, given for RVO and TNO, describe small budgets, existing training programmes, targets for gender and cultural diversity and no external consultants.
No external organisations or consultants have been hired.
Er zijn geen externe organisaties of consultants ingehuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

MP Eerdmans asked ministers about the budget, content, training, monitoring and external advisers of diversity, gender and inclusion policy in implementing agencies. The government answered for the NVWA, estimating about €70,000 for 2025, listing planned priorities and training, and stating it has no external consultants and no removal of artworks; it also said it would answer per agency separately.
Question 8: Could you provide the answers per implementing agency separately? Answer 8: Yes.
Vraag 8 Zou u de beantwoording per uitvoeringsinstantie afzonderlijk kunnen aanleveren? Antwoord 8 Ja.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Paulusma over regulering van bestrijdingsmiddelen

Two D66 MPs asked about the difference between low- and high-risk pesticides, health risks to farmers, residents and children, and whether municipalities can regulate pesticides and set spray-free zones. The minister explains the EU categories (candidates for substitution are approved for 7 years with comparative assessment), states that no carcinogenic substances are approved and that the RIVM is researching Parkinson, COPD and leukaemia, promises to improve municipal knowledge and information, but declines to set a national spray-free zone rule pending a research plan.
I maintain close contact with the VNG on the pesticide policy field.
Ik onderhoud nauw contact met de VNG over het beleidsterrein gewasbescherming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Claassen over het artikel 'Vijf punten die onderbelicht bleven rondom het debat ‘medisch zorglandschap’ van 20 maart 2025'

A PVV MP asked the health minister whether stakeholders such as emergency physicians, regional hospitals, GPs, midwives and mayors are involved in the move of emergency care out of market competition, how the introduction of budget funding will avoid further delay, how regional hospitals are affected by volume norms, whether budget funding should precede volume norms, and when the Heerlen hospital will be kept fully open. The minister answered that the NZa is consulting relevant parties and budget funding for emergency departments will start in 2027 subject to a second NZa advice, that regional redistribution plans are due before summer, that volume norms and budget funding are separate tracks, and that the provision of care in Heerlen is the responsibility of the hospital itself.
I will shortly send the NZa a directive to make all preparations to introduce budget funding for all emergency department units by 2027.
Ik zal de NZa spoedig een aanwijzing sturen om alle voorbereidingen te treffen om per 2027 budgetbekostiging in te voeren voor alle afdelingen SEH.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over ontwikkelingen en Europese samenwerking op het gebied van postcovid, mede n.a.v. het bericht ‘Postcovidklinieken boeken eerste resultaten’

An MP asked the Minister of Health about results and expansion of post-COVID expertise centres, referral to primary and secondary care, European cooperation and research overviews. The minister answered that the centres are a first step, further centres will open at academic hospitals, knowledge will later spread to general hospitals and GPs, and that research updates and European network work are ongoing.
In a next state-of-affairs letter on post-COVID I will send your House the report of the IVM.
In een volgende stand van zakenbrief over post-COVID zal ik uw Kamer het rapport van het IVM doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas en Pierik over de onafhankelijkheid en transparantie van de review op het VGO-III-onderzoek

MPs Van der Plas and Pierik asked whether the peer review of the VGO-III goat-farm health study was independent and transparent, and whether a new independent review will be commissioned. The minister answers that the study was peer reviewed in journals, two independent epidemiologists reviewed it in 2020, the Gezondheidsraad is advising on its evidence, and no new independent review is planned.

As indicated in the letter to Parliament accompanying the VGO-III final report, the Health Council has been asked to provide further interpretation of the evidence on health effects for residents near goat farms.

Zoals in de Kamerbrief bij het eindrapport VGO-III is aangegeven, is de Gezondheidsraad gevraagd om een nadere duiding te geven van de bewijslast met betrekking tot gezondheidseffecten voor omwonenden van geitenhouderijen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vijlbrief en Paulusma over de gevolgen van het halveren van het eigen risico op de hoogte van de zorgpremies

MPs Vijlbrief and Paulusma (D66) asked the health and finance ministers about the premium rise, longer waiting lists, and income and poverty effects from halving the mandatory deductible (eigen risico). Minister Agema answered that the premium rise (about 199 euro in 2027) is a financing effect partly offset by compensation, that the rise in care demand is estimated at about 64 euro, and that the bill was in internet consultation and would reach the House after the Raad van State advice.
It is customary for a bill to first go to internet consultation and then be submitted via the Council of Ministers to the Council of State for advice, before it is submitted to the House.
Het is gebruikelijk dat een wetsvoorstel éérst in internetconsultatie gaat en daarna via de ministerraad aan de Raad van State wordt aangeboden voor advies, voordat het bij de Kamer wordt aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slagt-Tichelman en Westerveld over het bericht 'Ruim honderd vrouwen met spiraaltje van Ballerine tóch zwanger, gros klachten niet gemeld bij inspectie'

Two GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the health minister about reports that over a hundred women with a Ballerine IUD became pregnant and that most complaints were not reported to the inspectorate, asking about information, certification, reporting and oversight. The minister answered that the EU certification system functioned adequately, that the 2021 IGJ review found no need for further action, and that she will explore a clearer reporting structure for users and providers.

I want to look into how I can arrive at as clear a reporting structure as possible for users and healthcare providers, so that they always know where to go for complaints and side effects of medical devices.

Ik wil kijken hoe ik tot een zo helder mogelijke meldstructuur kan komen voor gebruikers en zorgverleners, zodat zij altijd weten waar zij terecht kunnen voor klachten en bijwerkingen bij medische hulpmiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over het bericht 'Zorgen bij ziekenhuizen over tekorten aan middelen voor chemokuren' en de WNL-aflevering Stand van Nederland van 21 maart

An MP asked the health minister about reports of shortages of cancer drugs (chemokuren) and supply chain vulnerabilities, including dependence on China and whether Dutch and EU production should be increased. The minister said shortages in 2024 fell by 30%, described monitoring and measures for oncolytics, and outlined EU and national plans such as the Critical Medicines Act, stockpiling and IPCEI support, while not quantifying affected patients.
It is not possible to state how many patients are affected, but through close monitoring the effect on patients is limited as much as possible.
Het is niet mogelijk om aan te geven hoeveel patiënten geraakt worden, maar door de nauwkeurige monitoring wordt het effect op de patiënt zo goed als mogelijk beperkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over problemen met de Persoonlijke Gezondheidsomgeving (PGO)

MP Bushoff asks the minister about the troubled Persoonlijke Gezondheidsomgeving (PGO) patient record system, including the redesigned tender, supplier bankruptcies, and spending. The minister acknowledges delays, explains the new regulatory approach, and answers most questions while promising a new public overview service.
In addition, I am working on improving awareness of the PGO in close cooperation with the Patient Federation of the Netherlands.
Daarnaast werk ik aan het verbeteren van de bekendheid van de PGO in nauwe samenwerking met de Patiëntenfederatie Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rikkers-Oosterkamp over het bericht 'Artsen zien dagelijks gevaar voor patiëntveiligheid door ICT-problemen' van NOS

An MP asked the Minister of Health about reports that most medical specialists see patient safety risks from electronic health records that do not communicate, and about the government's plans, timelines and commitments to fix this. The minister answered that VWS is steering a national health information strategy with phased goals, a Wegiz implementation, a sector ICT-market action plan, and temporary fixes such as image availability, but declined to appoint a kwartiermaker with power to compel parties.
I take the lead and oversee the implementation of the NVS by the Ministry of VWS in cooperation with the care sector.
Ik neem regie en zie toe op de uitvoering van de NVS door het Ministerie van VWS en in samenwerking met het zorgveld.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Krul en Vedder over het bericht 'Zie de mens, niet het getal'; Senioren lopen aan tegen 'discriminatie op basis van leeftijd', ouderenorganisatie luidt noodklok'

MPs Inge van Dijk, Krul and Vedder (CDA) asked the government to respond to reports and a survey by ANBO-PCOB showing widespread age discrimination against seniors, and to set out measures across finance, labour, vehicle rental and volunteering. The minister answered that age discrimination is serious, that the government will discuss the survey with ANBO-PCOB, and that existing policies such as the Offensief Gelijke Kansen apply, but that no specific action plans exist for finance and no concrete new measures were announced beyond a planned study on vehicle rental insurance.
The fact that so many older people experience age discrimination is a reason for me to discuss the results of this research further with ANBO-PCOB.
Het gegeven dat zoveel ouderen leeftijdsdiscriminatie ervaren is voor mij aanleiding om met ANBO-PCOB verder te spreken over de resultaten van dit onderzoek.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Aartsen over de ontwikkelingen rondom zelfstandige zorgprofessionals (zzp’ers in de zorg) onder andere zoals beschreven in het artikel van RTL ’In maand tijd ruim 4000 minder zzp

MPs Tielen and Aartsen (VVD) asked ministers of Health and Social Affairs about the drop in self-employed care workers and the enforcement against bogus self-employment, asking for definitions, examples, signals from the sector, and flexibility options such as regional employment and VAT-exempt pools. The ministers answered that the legal test is the Civil Code employment definition applied to all circumstances, that model agreements remain valid until 2029, that the sector has so far reported limited effects, and that they are working with the sector on regional employment models and VAT clarification.
The cabinet will respond in the short term on the case examples drawn up by the LHV, as far as possible before the committee debate on self-employed workers of 3 April.
Over de hiervoor door de LHV opgestelde casuïstiek zal het kabinet op korte termijn reageren, voor zover mogelijk voor het commissiedebat zzp van 3 april a.s.

Antwoord op vragen van het het lid Daniëlle Jansen over het bericht ‘Hoe lager de sociaaleconomische positie en hoe groter de reisafstand, des te kleiner de kans op het gebruik van geavanceerde oncologische behandelingen

An MP asked the Health Minister how to address inequality in access to advanced cancer treatment, such as Durvalumab, linked to socioeconomic position and travel distance, and what the government will do about it. The minister acknowledges the inequality, points to existing reduction policies, regional oncology networks and the ongoing volume-norm process under the Integraal Zorgakkoord, but gives no regional breakdown and no new concrete measures beyond these existing plans.
I think it is important that everyone in the Netherlands has equal access to good care, including the broad accessibility of oncology care.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat iedereen in Nederland gelijkwaardige toegang heeft tot goede zorg, inclusief de brede toegankelijkheid van de oncologische zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over een betere glucosesensor die niet vergoed wordt

Bushoff asks why closed-loop glucose sensors are not reimbursed for all diabetes patients, whether cost and benefit justify this, and whether DIY closed loop risks are known. Minister Agema answers that reimbursement depends on individual medical need and the Zorginstituut indication criteria, that long-term studies are lacking, and that DIY systems are undesirable.
It is up to the healthcare provider, in consultation with the patient, to indicate the medical necessity for a rt-CGM sensor.
Het is aan de zorgverlener om in overleg met de patiënt de medische noodzaak voor een rt-CGM-sensor aan te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slagt-Tichelman over het bericht 'Veerle (27) wil nooit meer een spiraaltje zonder verdoving: ‘Deze pijn is het niet waard’'

An MP asks the health minister and state secretary about reports that women experience severe pain when a coil is inserted without anaesthesia, and about options such as cervical spray, guidance and information. The government says it is aware of the concerns, refers pain management decisions to clinicians, notes NHG guideline revision and existing information channels, and declines to take further concrete steps beyond what it already committed to.
At the same time, the Minister of VWS is not responsible for how healthcare providers deliver care, insofar as medical-substantive considerations are concerned.
Tegelijkertijd gaat de Minister van VWS niet over de manier waarop zorgverleners zorg verlenen, voor zover het medisch-inhoudelijke overwegingen betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP asked several ministers about diversity, gender and inclusion policy in executive agencies; this answer from the Education minister covers DUO and NWO. The minister says there are no plans to intensify or scale back the policy, explains the budget and training offered, and states that the set of questions concerns internal personnel policy rather than checks on executive power.
OCW has no specific diversity or gender policy.
OCW heeft geen specifiek diversiteits- of genderbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht ‘Fysio om de hoek redt het vaak niet meer’

An SP MP asked the Minister and State Secretary of Health about reports that around half of self-employed physiotherapists and speech therapists are considering closing their practices, and what measures will prevent this. The State Secretary acknowledged the concern, said the NZa has no concrete signals of insufficient care by insurers, and committed to an NZa market study with results expected in autumn 2025, while declining to endorse minimum tariffs or a 20% logopedia tariff increase before that study.
That is why I have asked the NZa to research how the market for paramedical care functions in its entirety.
Daarom heb ik de NZa gevraagd onderzoek te doen naar het functioneren van de markt voor de paramedische zorg in de volle breedte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over de paramedische zorg, o.a. naar aanleiding van het bericht ‘De paramedische zorg wankelt’

MP Tielen asks the Minister and State Secretary of Health about unprofitable tariffs for paramedical care, the effects of the DBA law, digital and hybrid care, and the sector's exclusion from the Integraal Zorgakkoord. The State Secretary answers with references to NZa market research, a COPD bundled-payment experiment and ZIN advice, while stating that paramedic tariffs are free-pricing and largely a matter for providers and insurers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over het omzeilen van de wet door webwinkels die medicijnen verkopen

MP Bushoff asks the Health Minister about online shops selling prescription medicines without a prescription, foreign doctors prescribing without patient contact, the KNMP's earlier calls for law changes, IGJ's responsibility, online pharmacies, and IGJ capacity. The minister answers that online prescribing is desirable if good care is provided, that IGJ acts against illegal sales and has closed sites, that existing law suffices, that a clarification of professional norms for pharmacists is asked from the KNMP, and that IGJ has sufficient capacity.
The IGJ is currently investigating this. If it turns out that quality and safety are insufficient, the IGJ will take action against it.
De IGJ doet hier momenteel onderzoek naar. Wanneer blijkt dat de kwaliteit en veiligheid onvoldoende zijn zal de IGJ hiertegen optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over de alternatieve dekking door geld uit de wijkverpleging te halen

An MP from D66 asks Minister Agema why the wijkverpleging (district nursing) budget was chosen to cover a €165 million shortfall, what the consequences are for care and staffing, and whether the Integraal Zorgakkoord is put at risk. The minister replies that the underspending is structural and reallocating it does not affect district nursing services or IZA commitments, and that consultation with stakeholders took place.
This is explicitly not a cut to the funds needed for district nursing.
Het betreft nadrukkelijk géén bezuiniging op de benodigde middelen voor wijkverpleging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Tielen over het bericht 'Geen 'kerst', maar wel ramadan mét scheiding mannen en vrouwen bij overheidsorgaan'

Two VVD MPs asked the health minister about reports that the CAK replaced Christmas with a winter party, planned an iftar, and used gender-separated prayer rooms, and asked about its funding and governance. The minister answered that the CAK does not offer separated prayer rooms and still held a Christmas breakfast or lunch, that staff can use internal channels, and that a ministry-wide survey found no separated prayer rooms.
Following the article in HP/De Tijd, I spoke with the CAK's director.
Naar aanleiding van het artikel in HP/DeTijd heb ik gesproken met de bestuurder van het CAK.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Claassen over het artikel 'Geen ‘kerst’, maar wel ramadan mét scheiding mannen en vrouwen bij overheidsorgaan'

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister about a CAK iftar event and whether separate prayer arrangements occur in public bodies under her ministry, questioning their neutrality. The minister replied that the CAK is an independent body, costs were €920 from its regular budget, a survey found no separate prayer rooms at major VWS organisations, and she acknowledged the Jewish Yom Kippur facts.
The CAK is an independent administrative body (zbo). Zbo's are independent and hierarchically not under the minister's responsibility.
Het CAK is een zelfstandig bestuursorgaan (zbo). Zbo's zijn onafhankelijk en vallen hiërarchisch gezien niet onder de verantwoordelijkheid van de Minister.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over het bericht 'Fysio om de hoek redt het vaak niet meer'

An MP asked the Minister of Health about reports that many physiotherapy practices are struggling or closing due to administrative burden and low pay, and about shortages, student enrolment, wait lists and market studies. The state secretary acknowledged concern, said no concrete NZa signals of shortages exist, and pointed to ongoing NZa market research and policy programmes with results expected later in 2025.
Before the committee debate on the health insurance system on 19 June, the House will be informed of a first NZa analysis of market functioning and accessibility in physiotherapy.

Voor het Commissiedebat over het zorgverzekeringsstelsel op 19 juni a.s. wordt uw Kamer geïnformeerd over een eerste analyse van de NZa met inzichten rondom het functioneren van de markt en de toegankelijkheid binnen de fysiotherapie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de dreiging van vrouwelijke genitale verminking in Nederland

MP Dobbe (SP) asked about the scale and threat of female genital mutilation (FGM) in the Netherlands, prevention measures, UK-style protection orders, prosecution, and reimbursement of reconstructive surgery. The government answers that a new prevalence study is underway, lists current prevention measures, says additional measures are being explored, notes one prosecution but no convictions, and promises a study extending exemption from the own risk for reconstructive surgery.
The cabinet intends to take additional (preventive) measures aimed at female genital mutilation.
Het kabinet is voornemens aanvullende (preventieve) maatregelen te nemen gericht op vrouwelijke genitale verminking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en De Korte over het NIVEL rapport over oversterfte

Two MPs (Omtzigt and De Korte) asked the state secretary for health about cancer and other cause-specific mortality risks after COVID-19 vaccination, and why unvaccinated groups had much higher excess mortality in a NIVEL report. The state secretary answered that the requested probability tables cannot be built from the report, which describes cause-of-death distributions, and declined new research on cost and priority grounds, while explaining the healthy-vaccinee effect and the small size of the unvaccinated groups.
A table with this content cannot be constructed from the indicated tables in the report.
Een tabel met deze inhoud is niet te construeren uit de aangegeven tabellen in het rapport.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over het bericht 'Zorgverzekeraars vinden thuis sterven vaak te duur'

An MP asks the health minister about a report that health insurers consider dying at home too costly, including a utilisation test for terminal home care and a reported 12-hour monthly limit. The state secretary disputes the specific case, states no insurer has refused such requests in 2024 or earlier, says no hour limits are applied, and commits to agreements in the Aanvullend Zorg- en Welzijnsakkoord and the palliative care transformation programme.
I am working towards making additional agreements on this in the Aanvullend Zorg- en Welzijnsakkoord (AZWA).
3 , erop in om hierover in het Aanvullend Zorg- en Welzijnsakkoord (AZWA) aanvullende afspraken te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boon, Wilders en Blaauw over de benoeming van de ambassadeurs van de vrijheid door het Nationaal Comité 4 en 5 mei

MPs Boon, Wilders and Blaauw asked whether the National Committee 4 and 5 May's choice of Freedom Ambassadors, including a performer alleged to have joined an antisemitic fundraiser, was acceptable and whether the government would intervene. The State Secretary answered that the Committee is independent, that the selection process was careful, and that the government respects its choices and will not intervene.
The National Committee 4 and 5 May is independent and independently determines how the National Commemoration on 4 May and Liberation Day on 5 May are shaped.
Het Nationaal Comité 4 en 5 mei is onafhankelijk en bepaalt zelfstandig hoe de Nationale Herdenking op 4 mei en Bevrijdingsdag op 5 mei worden vormgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP asked the ministers about diversity, gender and inclusion policy in implementing agencies, including budgets, training, art removal, quotas, success metrics and consultants. The government answered for the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf, saying the spending is about EUR 60,000 within normal operations, no artworks were removed, the statutory disability quota applies, and no external consultants were hired.
External organisations or consultants are not hired to advise on the above-mentioned themes.
Externe organisaties of consultants worden niet ingehuurd voor advisering op het gebied van bovengenoemde thema’s.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over de ernstige vogelgriep-situatie

An MP asks the ministers about the severe avian influenza situation, including the need for financial support for animal rescue organisations handling wild birds, the risk to humans, and the government's refusal so far to fund them. The minister answers that human risk is low to moderate, that animal rescue groups have no formal task in removing dead wild birds, that no financial support is needed for now, and that the situation will be reassessed if it worsens.
Financial support is currently not something I consider necessary.
Financiële ondersteuning acht ik op dit moment niet noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rikkers-Oosterkamp over de steeds langer wordende aanrijtijden van ambulances

An MP from BBB asked the Minister of Health about ambulance response times that increasingly exceed the 15-minute norm, especially in rural villages, and about transparency per municipality. The minister acknowledged the concern, pointed to a planned review of the urgency classification, the Ambulance Care Act evaluation and talks with Ambulancezorg Nederland, but declined to publish response times per municipality, citing that the data belong to individual regional services and that the norm is set at safety-region level.
However, I do not have free disposal over this information.
Ik heb echter geen vrije beschikking over deze informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Daniëlle Jansen over het bericht 'Ambulance met spoed steeds langer onderweg: 'In ons dorp bijna nooit op tijd''

An MP asks the Health Minister about reports that ambulances, especially in border regions, are taking longer to reach emergencies, and about cross-border ambulance use and AI for dispatch. The minister acknowledges regional differences, cites the 97%-within-12-minutes regulatory norm and sector data, says cross-border ambulance use is not counted, and commits to talks with insurers and the ambulance sector on improvement measures.
I will therefore enter into talks with Zorgverzekeraars Nederland and Ambulancezorg Nederland about which improvement measures have already been taken and which can still be taken.
Ik ga daarom in gesprek met Zorgverzekeraars Nederland en Ambulancezorg Nederland met de vraag welke verbetermaatregelen inmiddels genomen zijn, en nog genomen kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Claassen over het bericht dat mensen in levensbedreigende situaties nog te lang op een ambulance moeten wachten

An MP asked the health minister about reports that ambulances often take too long to reach life-threatening emergencies, including the Nunspeet post, cross-border cases, dispatch triage and the 15-minute norm. The minister answered that the post is a strategic (VWS) location, that cross-border data are excluded from performance figures, that emergency runs rose 40.5% over ten years versus 30% growth in ambulances, and that the Wet ambulancezorgvoorzieningen will be evaluated by year end.
How often a foreign ambulance is deployed in the Netherlands is not included in the performance figures.
Hoe vaak een buitenlandse ambulance ingezet wordt in Nederland, wordt niet meegenomen in de prestatiecijfers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht 'Ziekenhuisbaas: als we niet oppassen, verdwijnen behandelingen uit Fryslân'

The SP MP Dijk asked the Minister of Health about reports that Frisian hospitals may lose cancer treatments and reduce from four locations to three, including the use of transformation funds and the role of municipalities. The Minister answered that hospitals and insurers must manage the process with regional involvement, that budget financing for the SEH is being prepared, and that the transformation funds are not decisive, though she gave only partial answers and declined to assess some matters.
With this view I am following the decision-making process, which is scheduled for the end of March. I will inform you about it then.
Met deze blik volg ik de besluitvorming die volgens planning eind maart plaatsvindt. Ik zal u hier dan over informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht dat bij GGZ Veenendaal het omzetplafond van Zilveren Kruis/Achmea al in januari bereikt is

An SP MP asked the government to respond to reports that GGZ Veenendaal reached Zilveren Kruis/Achmea's revenue cap in January, leaving insured patients without access to mental health care for most of the year, and whether the government would hold the insurer to account. The State Secretary answered that insurers remain bound by the duty of care and must mediate patients to other providers, that the NZa supervises this duty, and that the government is considering broader measures to improve mental health care access, with a letter to parliament expected.
It is not for me to call an health insurer to account for its duty of care. The NZa independently supervises health insurers' duty of care.
Het is niet aan mij om een zorgverzekeraar aan te spreken op hun zorgplicht. De NZa houdt onafhankelijk toezicht op de zorgplicht van zorgverzekeraars.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP asked several ministers about diversity, gender and inclusion policy in implementing agencies. The Minister of Health answered for RIVM: a €50,000 budget for 2025, continuation of existing policy, a 2.76% quota plus government-wide targets, and a hired project leader costing €24,000.
RIVM currently has a Diversity & Inclusion policy budget of €50,000 reserved for 2025.
Het RIVM heeft momenteel een Diversiteit & Inclusie (D&I) beleidsbudget van € 50.000,– euro gereserveerd voor 2025.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Paulusma over veehouderij en gezondheid omwonenden (VGO-III)

MPs Podt and Paulusma asked the ministers of Agriculture and of Health about the health risks for residents living near goat farms, including the rising goat numbers despite earlier advice on distances, the lack of causal proof, and whether direct measures will follow. The ministers answered that the risks are taken seriously, that the Health Council has been asked to advise in two parts (June and November 2025) before any follow-up policy is decided, and that talks with provinces and a WUR advice on reducing pathogens in stables are underway.
We take the health risks shown in the VGO-III report very seriously.
De gezondheidsrisico’s die uit het VGO-III rapport blijken, nemen we heel serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eerdmans en Diederik van Dijk over het bericht 'Ambulance met spoed steeds langer onderweg: 'In ons dorp bijna nooit op tijd''

MPs Eerdmans and Diederik van Dijk asked the minister about large regional differences in ambulance response times and rising overruns of the 15-minute norm. The minister defended the current regional norm, pointed to a new urgency classification and care coordination, and promised annual transparency on response times at municipal level from 2026, while the 2024 figures are not yet available.
That is why I have formally asked Ambulancezorg Nederland to provide annual transparency on ambulance response times at municipal level from 2026 (reporting year 2025).

Daarom heb ik Ambulancezorg Nederland formeel verzocht om vanaf 2026 (dat wil zeggen rapportagejaar 2025) jaarlijks transparantie te verschaffen over de responstijden van de ambulance op gemeenteniveau
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Rooderkerk over het bericht 'De impact van vervuilende industrie op burgers en overheden'
