MPs Paulusma and Rooderkerk asked the Health Minister about health risks from polluting industry, climate change, air quality, housing, zoonoses, pandemic preparedness and budget cuts. The minister answered that climate change poses health risks, that industrial clusters are regulated regionally, that work on industry and residents is ongoing, and that funding decisions are still pending.
Much work has been done in recent years to improve our pandemic preparedness.
Er is in de afgelopen jaren hard gewerkt aan het verbeteren van onze pandemische paraatheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Daniëlle Jansen over het bericht ‘Zorgverzekeraars falen bij inkoopbeleid geneesmiddelen'

An NSC MP asked the Minister of Health about reports that health insurers prefer a costlier anastrozole product packaged in Italy without a barcode, and whether CBG and IGJ approval and insurers' procurement policy compromise safety. The Minister answers that a temporary deviating packaging was approved to prevent a critical shortage, that safety quality requirements are met, and that insurers' preferred-product choices reflect confidential price deals, while declining to tighten insurer rules.
Health insurers sometimes choose an apparently more expensive medicine as the preferred drug because of confidential price agreements with suppliers.
Zorgverzekeraars kiezen soms een ogenschijnlijk duurder geneesmiddel als preferent middel vanwege vertrouwelijke prijsafspraken met leveranciers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Slagt-Tichelman over het bericht dat de genderpoli van het Amsterdam UMC voorlopig geen nieuwe volwassenen in behandeling neemt vanwege overbelasting

MPs Westerveld and Slagt-Tichelman asked about reports that the Amsterdam UMC gender clinic stopped inviting new adult patients for intake due to overload, the long waiting times, staff shortages, the state's efforts to address them, and whether patients are being pushed abroad in breach of the duty of care. The minister confirms the pause for adults, says waiting times cannot be predicted, points to a coordinating platform, extra funding for mental health care and the duty of insurers, and says the revised quality standard is due in September 2025.
It is not possible to say anything about the overall duration of the waiting time.
Het is niet mogelijk om een uitspraak te doen over de algehele duur van de wachttijd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over opnamestops op SEH’s door de overbelasting van ziekenhuizen

MP Bushoff asked the health minister about emergency-department intake stops caused by hospital overload, including risks to patients, the rising demand from ageing, and the effect of planned long-term care cuts. The minister answered that SEH-stops are a logistical tool to redirect patients, that regional coordination and transfer improvements are underway, and that staffing shortages are the top priority, though she gave no overview of patients waiting for follow-up care and no specific new commitment on SEH staffing.
I do not have an overview of patients in hospitals who are waiting for follow-up care outside the hospital.
Ik heb geen overzicht van patiënten in ziekenhuizen die wachten op vervolgzorg buiten het ziekenhuis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Daniëlle Jansen over het bericht van apotheker Daan Boellen over het door Coöperatie VGZ aanwijzen van het dure Molaxole als het preferente merk voor macrogol

An MP asked the health minister about a pharmacist's report that VGZ designated the more expensive Molaxole as preferred macrogol despite cheaper generics and possible supply problems, and asked about secret price agreements, transparency, and oversight. The minister answered that the confidential couvert price makes Molaxole cheaper for the insurer, supply is confirmed, the NZa supervises preferential policy with no signals received, and she sees no reason to require disclosure of price agreements.
Such price agreements are not transparent, because suppliers, due to national and international competitive disadvantages, do not want the prices insurers pay to be made public.

Dergelijke prijsafspraken zijn niet transparant, omdat leveranciers vanwege nationale en internationale concurrentiële nadelen niet willen dat de prijzen die de zorgverzekeraars betalen bekend worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rikkers-Oosterkamp over het bericht 'Gronings UMC gaat met overheidssubsidie zelf een prijzig buitenlands kankermedicijn maken'

An MP asked the health minister about a €16.5 million subsidy to the Groningen UMCG to develop its own CAR-T cancer therapy despite an approved alternative, and whether this counts as market failure. The minister acknowledged the concern, said the subsidy conditions and market-failure assessment met the rules, and promised to review the subsidy scheme with the Zorginstituut before its expiry, but did not concede any wrongdoing.
I will discuss this with the Zorginstituut.
Ik zal dit bespreken met het Zorginstituut.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht ‘Rechter doet uitspraak over mondkapjesmiljoenen van Sywert van Lienden’

An MP asked the health minister for his reaction to a news report on a court case against Relief Goods Alliance over face-mask procurement, the role of product quality versus alleged free-of-charge dealing in the lawsuit, and whether crisis clauses should be introduced in procurement. The state secretary answered that the court ruled and the state may appeal, that quality plays no role in the lawsuit (which concerns fraud, error and unlawful conduct by RGA), and that existing emergency procurement rules and standard government purchase conditions are considered sufficient, without proposing a crisis clause.
Afterwards I will inform your House further insofar as this is possible given the procedural position of the State.
Daarna zal ik uw Kamer verder informeren voor zover dit mogelijk is gelet op de procespositie van de Staat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slagt-Tichelman over het NZa-rapport 'Tussen Wal en Voordeur'

MPs Slagt-Tichelman asked whether the government leaves choices on home care for the elderly to health insurers' care offices (zorgkantoren) rather than making future-proof decisions, and how it responds to NZa recommendations on the Wlz and the NZa report 'Tussen Wal en Voordeur'. The minister answers that the government is working on housing and care for older people, a Hoofdlijnenakkoord ouderenzorg and a study on returning verzorgingshuizen, agrees with the NZa conclusions while assigning zorgkantoren the task of concrete follow-up, and says the Wlz-related questions will be addressed in the Hoofdlijnenakkoord process without committing to specific legal changes yet.
We are therefore in discussion with parties, including the NZa, about a Hoofdlijnenakkoord ouderenzorg (HLO).
We zijn daarom met partijen, waaronder de NZa, in gesprek over een Hoofdlijnenakkoord ouderenzorg (HLO).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP asked eight ministers how much money, which policies, courses, quotas, KPIs and external consultants their implementing agencies use for diversity, gender and inclusion policy. The Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management refers to the answers already sent on 14 January 2025 for the whole ministry, including Rijkswaterstaat, as no other information is available.
As no other information is available, reference is made to the information already shared with the House on 14 January.
Aangezien er geen andere informatie beschikbaar is, wordt daarom verwezen naar de informatie die op 14 januari al met de Kamer is gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid van de ministeries

An MP asked several ministers how much is spent on diversity, gender and inclusion policy at executive agencies, how it is shaped, whether artworks were removed, and how success is measured. The Minister of Finance answered with budget figures, the continuation of current policy, quota and ambition targets, and confirmed separate answers per agency.
In the coming years the current diversity, gender and inclusion policy will be continued in its current form.
De komende jaren wordt het huidige diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid voortgezet zoals huidig vormgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht dat gezinnen de prijs betalen voor structurele tekorten in de kraamzorg

MP Dobbe asked whether the government will respond to reports that families pay the price for structural shortages in maternity care, including rising unaffordable co-payments, and whether co-payments and on-call allowances should be changed. Minister Agema answered that the shortage is a sector-wide labour problem being addressed through an insurer-provider convenant and acceleration agenda, that co-payments are not the only reason for forgoing care, that abolishing co-payments (about 25 million euros) is not funded, and that pay for on-call shifts is a matter for social partners.
At national level no figures are available on the number of people and the exact reasons why they forgo maternity care.
Op landelijk niveau zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal mensen en de exacte reden waarom zij afzien van kraamzorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over het personeelstekort in de kraamzorg

An MP asked the health minister about staff shortages in maternity care, gaps in the number of care hours, insurer duties, the own-contribution barrier, tariffs, funding, wages and training. The minister answered that the sector and insurers are responsible, that exact figures are not known, and pointed to a convenant, a vision, an agenda and existing funding and tariff mechanisms.
Exact figures are not known to me, even after inquiries with the NZa and IGJ.
Exacte aantallen zijn bij mij, ook na navraag bij de NZa en IGJ, niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht ‘Hoe zorginstellingen diplomafraude bestrijden: ‘Kwaadwillenden gaan ingenieus te werk’’

An MP asked the Minister of Health about press reports on diploma fraud in care institutions, including links to financial misuse, patient safety and criminality, and about the Information Hub Care Fraud, a ban on fraudsters returning to care, Bibob integrity checks and a consolidated fraud policy overview. The minister acknowledged the problem, described the three-pronged approach and planned letters, and pointed to the Wbsrz, the warning register and a preliminary talk with the Justice ministry, but gave no full policy overview or first meldingenoverzicht before summer.
Your House will be informed by letter about this approach in the short term.
Uw Kamer wordt op korte termijn per brief over deze aanpak geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Bevers over het bericht ‘Zorg Spoedeisende hulp loopt vast door ouderen, maar terug naar huis is vaak ook geen optie’

MPs Tielen and Bevers (VVD) asked the Health Minister and State Secretary about news that emergency departments are clogged by elderly patients who cannot safely return home, and how this relates to the Integraal Zorgakkoord (IZA) targets and the planned Hoofdlijnenakkoord Ouderenzorg. The ministers answered that they share the concern, cite measures such as strengthened primary care, care coordination, higher short-stay tariffs, a study on returning nursing homes, and monitoring of IZA goals, but could not give quantified effects.
After the first measurement of the monitor expected at the end of spring 2025, we can inform the House about the status of the monitor's outcomes.
Na de 1-meting van de monitor die einde voorjaar 2025 is voorzien, kunnen we uw Kamer informeren over de stand van zaken op de uitkomsten van de monitor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over de uitzending De onmisbaren: Huisartsen

MP Paulusma asked the Minister of Health about a broadcast on GPs, covering the number of people without a GP, GP numbers and regional shortages, practice premises, NZa tariffs, the shift towards locum work, and use of thuisarts.nl. The minister answered in detail with data from Nivel and the NZa, noting that a 0.3% share of adults lack a registered GP and that a national action plan is in progress, but gave few commitments beyond a forthcoming Nivel study on patient stops.
I expect to be able to inform your House about this soon.
Ik verwacht uw Kamer hier spoedig over te kunnen informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP asked several ministers about diversity, gender and inclusion policy in implementing agencies, including budgets, training, art removals and targets. The government answered per agency, stating UWV spends about €320,000 in 2025 and SVB about €340,967, with targets and training described and no external consultants hired.
UWV intends to continue monitoring this policy in the coming years.
UWV is voornemens dit beleid de komende jaren te blijven volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de uitzending van het NOS journaal over vrouwelijke genitale verminking in Nederland

MP Dobbe asked the ministers of Health and Education about a NOS broadcast on rising female genital mutilation in the Netherlands, prevalence estimates, new research, prevention measures, school and asylum-centre information, mandatory reporting, community engagement, victim support, and the deductible for reconstructive surgery. The government answered that it is researching prevalence (results expected end 2025), examining protective orders and foreign measures, running existing campaigns and training, and studying a reporting duty and deductible exemption, mostly describing ongoing work without firm new commitments.
The cabinet considers female genital mutilation (FGM) a barbaric and unacceptable practice against which girls and women must be protected.
Het kabinet vindt vrouwelijke genitale verminking (vgv) een barbaarse en onaanvaardbare praktijk waartegen meisjes en vrouwen beschermd moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht dat het plaatsen van een spiraaltje bij de helft van vrouwen voor hevige pijn zorgt

MP Dobbe asked the Minister of Health about reports that half of women experience severe pain when an IUD is inserted, and whether pain relief should be offered as with minor dental procedures. The minister acknowledged the signal, said the NHG is revising its contraception guideline with priority (expected mid-2026), and stated that clinical decisions on pain management rest with clinicians.
I think it is good that the Dutch College of General Practitioners (NHG) has informed me that they are looking at options to improve GP policy on IUD insertion and pain reduction.

Daarom vind ik het goed dat het Nederlands Huisartsengenootschap (NHG) mij heeft laten weten dat zij kijken naar mogelijkheden om het beleid van de huisarts ten aanzien van spiraalplaatsing en vermindering van pijn daarbij te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Dijk over het bericht ‘Studenten boos om uitblijven loon bij stages in zorg’

Two SP MPs asked the Health Minister whether UMCs excluding certain trainees from internship pay breaches the collective labour agreement, and whether the minister will act. The minister repeatedly answered that interpreting, enforcing and complying with the CAO is for the social partners (NFU and unions), and that she will not intervene.
Responsibility for enforcing and complying with the CAO lies with the CAO parties themselves.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de handhaving en naleving van de cao ligt bij cao-partijen zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht ‘Ook na de pandemie boekt Pfizer nog een miljardenwinst’

An SP MP asked the health minister and finance state secretary about reports that Pfizer made multi-billion profits after the pandemic, including questions on tax contributions, government payments to Pfizer, pricing and monopoly power, and domestic production. The minister declined to give tax and contract-price details citing secrecy rules and said she cannot steer company profits, but committed to a policy advice on acceptable drug prices, a proposal for a public drug fund, and continued work on domestic production.
I cannot share information on the tax position of an individual taxpayer under the tax secrecy obligation of article 67 of the General State Taxes Act.
Ik kan geen informatie delen over de fiscale positie van een individuele belastingplichtige op grond van de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht van art. 67 Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over twee onderzoeken van de Patiëntenfederatie en de FNV naar de problematiek rondom tekorten in de geboortezorg

MP Dobbe asked the minister about two reports on staff shortages in maternity care, covering patient experiences, the FNV finding on reduced care, a second barrier of co-payments, pay gaps and work-life balance. The minister acknowledged the problems and listed existing measures (collaboration, dashboards, convenants, staffing and pay budgets) but rejected the claim that pay gaps drive shortages and gave no firm assessment of whether the ova-budget closes the gap.
However, this research does not provide sufficient information to make firm statements about whether the ova contribution is sufficient to close the pay gap.
Dit en ander onderzoek geeft echter onvoldoende informatie om harde uitspraken te doen in hoeverre de ova-bijdrage voldoende is om de beloningsachterstand in te lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over het bericht 'Minister Fleur Agema (PVV) past haar bezuinigingsplannen voor de zorg voor onverzekerden aan na kritiek op haar uitspraken in Zembla'

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Health about press reports that she planned to cut the SOV scheme for uninsured care by lowering doctors' fees, and about related questions on access, acute care and international practice. The minister answered that the €40m cut is tied to reducing uninsured people, that a merged new scheme is being prepared, that a research trajectory with Rotterdam is planned, and that she shared no plans with the press beyond the 18 December letter.
I explained my plans in my letter of 18 December 2024. I have no plans other than those I shared with the press.
Ik heb mijn plannen toegelicht in mijn brief van 18 december 2024. Ik heb geen andere plannen dan deze gedeeld met de pers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de berichten dat criminelen op grote schaal actief zijn in de zorg

The SP's Dobbe asked the Ministers of VWS, OCW and Justice about reports that criminals operate on a large scale in healthcare, including fraudulent vocational certificates, unprosecuted DUO and KvK fraud reports, and whether the sector's underfunding enables abuse. The minister answered that the government is pursuing a broad integrated approach with concrete measures (stricter EVC handling, licensing extension, Wibz bill, DBA enforcement) while declining to address the underfunding claim directly and deferring follow-up info.
In line with the commitment made in earlier letters to your House, you will be informed shortly about follow-up actions by the relevant ministries to jointly curb the described abuses in healthcare.

Conform de in eerdergenoemde Kamerbrieven aan uw Kamer gedane toezegging, wordt u op korte termijn nader geïnformeerd over vervolgacties van onder andere de betrokken ministeries om gezamenlijk paal en perk te stellen aan de geschetste misstanden in de zorg.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rikkers-Oosterkamp over de artikelen 'Criminele zorgmedewerkers ronselen kwetsbare cliënten voor uithalen cocaïne' en ‘Drugshandelaren en plofkrakers 'op grote schaal' actief in de zorg, kw

An MP asked the Health and Justice ministers about reports that serious criminals are infiltrating the care sector, including recruiting vulnerable clients for drug runs, and what steps will prevent them and identify those already working there. The minister listed new rules (Wbsrz, expanded Wtza licensing, the forthcoming Wibz bill, Justis risk reports), said screening is the employers' responsibility, and declined to share a police signal document with parliament.
The signal document is therefore not suitable to share with the House.
Het signaaldocument is daarom niet geschikt om te delen met de Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Podt over de pandemische paraatheid van Nederland in het licht van recente internationale ontwikkelingen en aangekondigde bezuinigingen

MPs Paulusma and Podt asked the ministers about Dutch pandemic preparedness amid international outbreaks, planned budget cuts of 300 million euros, staffing, vaccination willingness, and bird flu risks. The government answered largely by describing existing EU frameworks and programmes, noting that cuts are phased in and clarity will come mid-2025, and committing to further analysis and studies on bird flu structural measures.
The Ministry of VWS expects to be able to provide more clarity on funding for 2026 and beyond by mid-2025.
Het Ministerie van VWS verwacht medio 2025 meer duidelijkheid te kunnen geven over de middelen voor 2026 en verder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Blaauw over het Project Nieuwbouw RIVM

An MP asked the Minister of Health about the WHO requirements behind the RIVM new-build delays, the influence of the WHO, consequences of non-compliance, whether the state can avoid paying 40.6 million euro to MEET Strukton, and how often the WHO sets similar requirements. The minister explained that the GAP poliovirus biosafety rules are needed for RIVM's accreditation as a polio reference laboratory, that the WHO has no direct influence on the project, that the dispute was settled by a settlement agreement so payment cannot be avoided, and that WHO guidance is generally not binding on building projects.
The dispute has thus been definitively settled.
Het geschil is daarmee definitief afgedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het beboeten van supermarkten vanwege te veel ongezond voedsel

MPs asked whether supermarkets should be fined for selling too much unhealthy food, whether advertising and pricing can be restricted, and what the costs of removing VAT on healthy food would be. The state secretary said supermarkets bear a responsibility, that concrete agreements and monitoring of healthy-sales shares will be pursued, that a broad ban on food advertising lacks support while child-directed marketing rules are being prepared, that a bonus-malus scheme is doubtful, and that VAT removal on healthy food is rejected as too costly and legally unworkable.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Krul over de uitzending van Radar 'De gevolgen van het verdwijnen van de restitutiepolis' van 16 december 2024

An MP asks the Minister of Health about the loss of restitution policies for community nursing and mental health care, the NZa's alleged orders against nine insurers over free choice of doctor, the insurers' duty of care and the 75% reimbursement threshold, and complaint numbers and handling times. The Minister says the NZa issued no order after insurers fixed their problems, insurers must meet their duty of care, the hardship criterion applies, and complaints fell in 2024 though mental health complaints rose.
After investigation the NZa found that eight health insurers must better inform their insured when they have to pay a high own contribution for uncontracted care.
Na onderzoek heeft de NZa vastgesteld dat acht zorgverzekeraars hun verzekerden beter moeten informeren als zij een hoge eigen bijdrage moeten betalen voor onverzekerde zorg
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over de mogelijke sluiting van Gezondheidscentrum Kanaleneiland

An MP asks the Minister of Health about the possible closure of the Kanaleneiland health centre and who is responsible for keeping primary care accessible. The Minister answers that the GP, health insurers and municipalities share responsibility, that she will not intervene in this individual case, and points to the national housing handreiking and planned follow-up work.
However, it is not my role to interfere in specific casuistry, such as the matter concerning the health centre in Kanaleneiland.
Het is echter niet mijn rol om mij te mengen in specifieke casuïstiek, zoals de kwestie bij het gezondheidscentrum in Kanaleneiland.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Dijk over de artikelen 'Er zijn genoeg leraren, maar ze staan niet voor de klas', 'The hidden reserve of nurses and teachers in the Netherlands' en 'Increasing the working hou

MPs Beckerman and Dijk (SP) asked why the hidden reserve of qualified teachers and nurses exceeds current shortages and what measures the government will take to activate it, including flexible working hours and reducing workload. The Staatssecretaris answered that taking up work is an individual choice, that the government pursues broader labour market policy (salaries, workload funding, a teacher campaign, admin reduction in care), and that several measures such as strategic personnel policy and a Monitor Zeggenschap are underway, but did not commit to a specific plan for the reserve.
Directly approaching or writing to the hidden reserve is technically not possible under the GDPR.
Het direct benaderen en/of aanschrijven van de stille reserve is AVG technisch niet mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over de mogelijke sluiting van de buitenpolikliniek van het Medisch Spectrum Twente in Haaksbergen

MPs Bushoff asked the Minister of Health about the possible closure of the Medisch Spectrum Twente outpatient clinic in Haaksbergen and the concerns of GPs, residents and elderly patients about access. The minister answered that no final decisions have been taken, that the hospital is exploring reorganisation with consultation of residents and GPs, and that the hospital board, with insurers, must decide how care is organised.
It is up to the hospital to shape this process carefully, together with the insurer, and to involve all relevant parties.
Het is aan het ziekenhuis om dit proces – samen met de verzekeraar – zorgvuldig vorm te geven en alle relevante partijen te betrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over de effectiviteit van medische genderbehandelingen bij kinderen

An SGP MP asked the government about the effectiveness of gender-affirming medical treatment for minors, citing an Amsterdam academic article questioning how such effectiveness should be judged, and asked how this fits with passende zorg criteria and the Zorgverzekeringswet. Minister Agema answered that treatment follows careful psychological evaluation and monitoring, that the Gezondheidsraad is advising on the matter, that coverage follows the 'stand van de wetenschap en praktijk' criterion, and that Zorginstituut work on the scope of transgender care is ongoing without a fixed end date.
It is legally stipulated that all insured care under the Health Insurance Act must meet the criterion of 'the state of science and practice'.
Het is wettelijk bepaald dat alle te verzekeren zorg in de Zorgverzekeringswet dient te voldoen aan het criterium « de stand van de wetenschap en praktijk ».
Antwoord op vragen van lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid van de ministeries

An MP asked all ministries about spending, design, training, quotas, success metrics, external consultants and the government's view of 'woke' policy on diversity and inclusion in the civil service. The government answered that diversity and inclusion policy aims at a representative civil service, sets numerical ambitions for gender and cultural diversity, and says no artworks were removed and no quota beyond the statutory banenafspraak applies.
For an overview of the money earmarked for diversity and inclusion policy per ministry for the coming year, as far as now known, I refer to the annexes.
Voor een overzicht van het geld dat het komende jaar geoormerkt is voor diversiteit en inclusiebeleid per ministerie, voor zover nu bekend, verwijs ik naar de bijlagen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over de Internationale Dag van de Migraine en het bericht 'Elke dag hebben 70.000 mensen een migraineaanval, maar de meeste gaan pas na een jaar naar de dokter'

An MP from D66 asks the health minister why migraine research is narrowed to hormonal causes rather than access-to-care bottlenecks, and about GP guidance, workplace reporting, and a public campaign. The minister says hormonal research is one part of a women's health programme, a Zorginstituut advice on reimbursement is pending, no data exist on workplace reporting, and a national campaign is not the ministry's role.
In response to these parliamentary questions I have asked ZonMw to at least put the issue of access to care on the agenda for this consultation.
Ik heb ZonMw naar aanleiding van deze Kamervragen gevraagd het vraagstuk van de toegang tot zorg in elk geval te agenderen voor deze consultatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over het bericht ‘Minister Agema 'heel erg bezorgd' over bezuinigingen zorg’

An MP asked the Health Minister how she was involved in negotiating health-sector budget cuts used as cover for an education budget amendment, and what information was exchanged. The minister answered that ministry officials discussed the health measures with the education and finance ministries, that the health ministry gave no information to negotiating parties, and that the finance ministry's information was sent to parliament; the cut plan was later changed by a parliamentary motion.
The Ministry of VWS has not provided any information regarding the cuts to the negotiating parties.
Het Ministerie van VWS heeft geen informatie met betrekking tot de bezuinigingen verstrekt aan de onderhandelende partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch, Westerveld, Paulusma, Dobbe, Koekkoek en Teunissen over de gevolgen van de overwinning van Trump voor vrouwen wereldwijd

Six MPs asked the ministers how Trump's return and the expanded Mexico City Policy (Global Gag Rule) would affect women's health and abortion access worldwide, and what the Netherlands would do to fill any gap. The minister confirmed awareness of the policy and Project 2025 but declined to speculate on US changes, pointing instead to a forthcoming development policy letter and continued Dutch commitment to partners.
The cabinet is not anticipating that.
Het kabinet loopt daar niet op vooruit.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de uitspraak van de Minister tijdens de plenaire vergadering van donderdag 24 oktober 2024 'Kort na mijn aantreden ben ik gebriefd over weerbaarheid'

MP Van Houwelingen asked the Minister of Health about a briefing on resilience she mentioned in plenary, the NATO obligations involved, and an inventory led by the NCTV, with 12 questions. The Minister answered that the briefings were held in July 2024 by the AIVD and NCTV, that presentations are classified and not shared, that the NATO Resilience Objectives are non-binding political commitments, and that the cabinet-wide resilience inventory will be sent to parliament at the end of 2024.
Question 7: Were presentations given and/or minutes made during this briefing? If so, can the House receive them? Answer 7: The presentations given cannot be shared because of their classification.

Vraag 7 Zijn er presentaties gegeven en/of notulen gemaakt tijdens deze briefing? Zo ja, kan de Kamer deze presentaties/notulen ontvangen? Antwoord 7 De gegeven presentaties kunnen vanwege de rubricering niet worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slagt-Tichelman en Piri over zorg voor zwangere vrouwen en baby’s in aanmeldcentrum en AZC’s

MPs Slagt-Tichelman and Piri asked the ministers about maternity care for pregnant asylum seekers in reception centres, citing the EGALITE report on higher stillbirth and birth complications, and asked about relocations, interpreters, hygiene, privacy and the status of the Ketenrichtlijn. The minister acknowledges the problems, points to the Musselkanaal wing, the strain on reception capacity and planned action (raising the guideline with professional bodies, reviewing the EGALITE recommendations), but declines to change birth registration rules and does not commit to new binding standards.
I will therefore ask the professional organisations in maternity care to bring the chain guideline again to the attention of their members.
Ik zal de beroepsorganisaties in de geboortezorg daarom verzoeken om de ketenrichtlijn opnieuw onder de aandacht te brengen bij hun achterban.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Ceder over het bericht 'Geboortezorg voor asielzoekers van 'onacceptabel' niveau, concluderen onderzoekers'

MPs Bikker and Ceder asked the ministers about a report finding worse birth outcomes (higher perinatal mortality and low birth weight) among asylum seekers, and about transport, transfers and medical handover for pregnant women in reception. The government acknowledges the disparities and the problems with emergency shelter, points to existing arrangements such as Musselkanaal and taxi transport, and promises further study of the report's recommendations without committing to new funding.
If so, do you consider this cause for serious concern and can you provide the House with a comprehensive response?
Zo ja, vindt u dit reden tot grote zorg en kunt u de Kamer van een uitgebreide reactie voorzien?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht ‘Toekomst Spaarne Gasthuis Haarlem nog ongewis: "Grote zorg dat Noord verdwijnt"?’

An SP MP asked the health minister how she views reports that Spaarne Gasthuis in Haarlem may close or hollow out its Haarlem Noord site, and whether she will intervene and act on staff shortages and local democratic involvement. The minister replied that the hospital says no locations will close, that the government lacks power to force services at specific sites, and that she will issue a handreiking on acute care consultation in summer 2025 and address staff shortages through planned measures.
The national government also has no authority to keep locations open and cannot force the hospital to provide certain care at certain locations.
De landelijke politiek heeft ook geen bevoegdheid om locaties open te houden en kan het ziekenhuis niet dwingen bepaalde zorg op bepaalde locaties te leveren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meijeren over het beboeten van huisartsen die Hydroxychloroquine en Ivermectine voorschreven

An FVD MP asked the Health Minister about fines imposed on GPs who prescribed hydroxychloroquine and ivermectine off-label, the MP's own past tweets, and the Minister's appeal against a court ruling annulling one fine. The Minister answered that the IGJ acts independently under its own mandate, that the appeal was decided by the IGJ, and that she will not withdraw it, leaving the matter to the Raad van State.
The IGJ has the mandate to file an appeal on behalf of the Minister within its field, without this having to be submitted to the Minister for a decision.
De IGJ heeft het mandaat om op haar werkterrein namens de Minister hoger beroep aan te spannen, zonder dat dit aan de Minister ter besluitvorming voorgelegd hoeft te worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Slagt-Tichelman over wachtlijsten voor genderzorg

Two GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the state secretary about waiting lists for gender care after the Mutsaersstichting restricted its gender care to Limburg, and whether budget cuts and service gaps would be addressed. The state secretary answered that gemeenten are responsible for youth gender care, national waiting-time data are not kept, the Mutsaersstichting has a continuity plan with added municipal and subsidy funding, and a Landelijk Platform Transgenderzorg is being set up with a work agenda expected in early 2025.
Municipalities are responsible for organising youth care, including gender care. Figures on the number of waiting lists and average waiting times are therefore not kept nationally.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor het organiseren van jeugdhulp, dus ook genderzorg. Cijfers over aantallen wachttijden en gemiddelde wachttijden worden daarom niet landelijk bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over het bericht dat vier op de tien vrouwen die abortus kiest niet deed aan anticonceptie

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about a report that 41% of women undergoing abortion had not used contraception, and about contraception access, sex education, support for pregnant women and wait lists. The State Secretary answered that the findings are not surprising, outlined existing sex-education and contraception programmes, said no extra policy on affordable contraception is needed, and promised a new approach to unintended pregnancy in spring 2025.
So I cannot say whether waiting times for this specific form of supervised housing have risen nationally.
Ik kan dus niet aangeven of wachttijden voor deze specifieke vorm van woonplekken met begeleiding landelijk gestegen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bushoff over passend onderwijs aan kinderen met Long COVID en andere infectieziekten

Two MPs asked the State Secretary for Education and the Minister of Health about schooling for children with Long COVID and other infections causing severe energy limitation, including lack of understanding, inadequate support, school ventilation and remote learning. The government answered that data on affected children are limited, it is investing in research, information and tailored education options, and is preparing legislation to expand flexible and digital schooling.
My goal is for digital distance learning to become a full part of the passend onderwijs system.
Mijn doel is dat digitaal afstandsonderwijs een volwaardig onderdeel wordt van het stelsel van passend onderwijs
Antwoord op vragen van lid Dijk over het bericht ‘Grote prijsverschillen aanvullende zorgverzekering en mes in vergoeding orthodontie’

An SP MP asks the Health Minister about large price differences and waiting periods in supplementary health insurance, including effects on children's orthodontics, competition between insurers, and income-dependent premiums. The minister replies that supplementary insurance is private and outside government control, that insurers set their own terms under DNB and ACM supervision, and that the government will discuss some services' inclusion in the basic package and send a letter on market competition in healthcare.
There is no framework for care in supplementary insurance and there are no statutory rules on waiting times.
Er is geen kader voor de zorg in de aanvullende verzekering en er zijn geen wettelijke regels over wachttijden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht ‘Ommelander Ziekenhuis vraagt uitstel rente tot 2027, provincie weigert’

MP Dijk (SP) asked the Health Minister how she views the report that Ommelander Ziekenhuis wants interest deferral on a provincial loan until 2027 while the province refuses, and whether the government will financially rescue the hospital, share its plans, and grant democratic control over hospitals. Minister Agema answers that the hospital bears primary responsibility for its finances, that no Early Warning notification has been received, that contracts for 2025 are in place and Menzis is working on a long-term plan due spring 2025, and that she will pursue sector reforms and a guidance document while rejecting direct democratic control of private hospitals.
The hospital first of all bears responsibility itself for the financial situation and business operations.
Het ziekenhuis draagt allereerst zelf verantwoordelijkheid voor de financiële situatie en bedrijfsvoering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Claassen over de onmiddellijke vacaturestop vanwege miljoenenbezuinigingen en concurrentie van zelfstandige behandelklinieken bij het OLVG

An MP asked the health minister about a hiring freeze at OLVG due to budget cuts and competition from independent treatment centres, including their effect on hospital finances and the health workforce. The minister acknowledged staff shortages, said hospitals decide their own vacancies, noted no data on clinics' financial impact, and promised agreements in the upcoming Zorg- en Welzijnsakkoord.
I do not have figures that give insight into the influence of independent treatment centres on the financial results of hospitals.
Ik beschik niet over cijfers die inzicht geven in de invloed van zbc's op de financiële resultaten van ziekenhuizen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dekker over het Nivel rapport inzake oversterfte en Covid-vaccinaties

An MP asked whether a Nivel report supports a claim that unvaccinated people aged 76-80 had 39 percent mortality in 2021, and why Nivel closed its X account. The Staatssecretaris answered that the report cannot support that figure because vaccination status was not reliably registered and timing varied, giving instead the 3- and 12-month mortality rates from the report, and said organisations may freely open or close accounts on X.
According to the researchers, based on the Nivel study this question cannot be answered.
Op basis van het onderzoek van het Nivel is deze vraag volgens de onderzoekers niet te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over het verdwijnen van de restitutiepolis

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Health whether the disappearance of restitution health insurance policies in 2025 threatens access to care, including the freedom of doctor choice under the Zvw, and whether the Minister would monitor the effects on mental health care waiting lists. The Minister acknowledged the disappearance, stated that insurers' duty of care and NZa supervision remain, that the Minister has no legal instrument to force insurers to offer restitution policies, and that monitoring and broader ggz measures will follow in a forthcoming accord.
I have no legal instruments to oblige health insurers to offer restitution policies.
Ik heb geen juridische instrumenten om zorgverzekeraars te verplichten om restitutiepolissen aan te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rikkers-Oosterkamp over de beantwoording van feitelijke vragen over de onthouding over het WHO-pandemieverdrag en de International Health Regulations

An MP asked the health minister to confirm that the Netherlands is not bound by the 2022 and 2024 International Health Regulations amendments, whether preparatory steps are being taken, and whether the government will oppose them as the motion required. The minister answers that the amendments are not binding until Parliament approves them, that a parliamentary approval procedure will be followed for both sets of amendments, and that the government will inform Parliament further by letter before the Christmas recess.
The cabinet wants this process to provide transparency and to give due weight to the view of a majority of the House of Representatives as expressed in the debate of 21 May 2024.
Het kabinet wil met dit proces transparantie bieden en recht doen aan het gevoelen van een meerderheid van de Tweede Kamer zoals uitgedragen tijdens het debat van 21 mei 2024.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Van den Hil over het bericht 'Opleiding die huisartsentekort had kunnen oplossen alweer weg uit Zeeland'

MPs Tielen and Van den Hil asked why a Physician Assistant training pilot in Zeeland is ending early and students must travel to Nijmegen, and how quality of distance education was assessed. The minister said the places were temporary, responsibility for quality lies with the hogeschool, and national PA training places are being expanded as advised by the capacity body.
Responsibility for the implementation and monitoring of the quality of this programme lies with the Hogeschool van Arnhem en Nijmegen.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de uitvoering en bewaking van de kwaliteit van deze opleiding ligt bij de Hogeschool van Arnhem en Nijmegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bushoff over het verdwijnen van de restitutiepolis en de gevolgen voor ggz-patiënten

MPs Westerveld and Bushoff asked about the disappearance of restitution policies for mental health care and the effects on patients, including waiting lists and contracting. The minister answered that insurers may replace these policies with in-kind combination policies with a one-year transition period, and that insurers' own decisions and contracting are outside her direct control while the NZa supervises the duty of care.
However, it is not for me to change this decision by health insurers; health insurers themselves determine which policies they offer and which they do not.
Het is echter niet aan mij om iets aan dit besluit van zorgverzekeraars te veranderen; zorgverzekeraars bepalen zelf welke polissen zij aanbieden en welke niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over de zorgelijke situatie van het ziekenhuislandschap in Friesland

An MP asked the Minister of Health about the strained accessibility of Frisian hospitals in light of the Gupta report and plans to reduce four hospitals to three, including staffing, acute care and finances. The Minister says the government will reform hospital financing and that the closure decision rests with providers and insurers under statutory procedures, with IGJ and NZa supervising, and promises a handreiking for regions and continued close monitoring.
I will continue to critically monitor the research into the feasibility of the Frisian plans.
Het onderzoek naar de haalbaarheid van de Friese plannen zal ik kritisch blijven volgen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eerdmans, Rikkers-Oosterkamp en Diederik van Dijk over slechte aanrijtijden in kernen van Nunspeet en het artikel dat een vrouw overleed die na een aanrijding drie kwartier moest wachten o

MPs Eerdmans, Rikkers-Oosterkamp and Diederik van Dijk asked about poor ambulance response times in villages around Nunspeet and a reported death after a woman waited three quarters of an hour for an ambulance. The minister expressed sympathy, defended the regional 15-minute norm, pointed to the new urgency triage and a pending dialogue with AZN on local transparency, but declined to publish local figures or accept location-specific accountability.
Monitoring or accounting at local level does not fit with that.
Monitoren of verantwoorden op lokaal niveau sluit daar niet op aan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Claassen over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraars medicijnen uit het buitenland niet altijd vergoeden

An MP asked the health minister whether insurers must reimburse Dutch-rate costs for medicines patients obtain abroad during shortages, how often this happens, and why the European Commission dropped its criticism. The minister said reimbursement depends on the chosen policy and advised patients to clarify coverage with their insurer beforehand, while stating no data are available and nothing changed since March.
I am not aware of any data on this.
Daarvan zijn mij geen gegevens bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over diverse post-COVID problematieken

An MP asks the ministers of health and social affairs about post-COVID problems: unfamiliarity and missing guidelines at agencies, Wajong eligibility for young people, bijstand rules, municipal Wmo support, occupational physicians' knowledge, and self-employed workers' income loss. The government answers that it funds research, guidelines and expertise centres, notes Wajong reassessment routes and fallback benefits, and sees no need for specific policy changes beyond ongoing knowledge-building with the VNG and C-support.
The cabinet regrets that post-COVID is still a (too) unknown condition to make a proper assessment during an investigation under the Wmo 2015.
Het kabinet betreurt het dat post-COVID nog een (te) onbekende aandoening is om tijdens een onderzoek in het kader van de Wmo 2015 een goede afweging te maken

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten, Krul, Paternotte, Stultiens, Kostić, Beckerman, Eerdmans, Dassen, Ergin, Stoffer en Ceder over het bericht 'Bezorgdheid om bezuinigingsplannen onderwijs: 'Maakt Nederland op lange

MPs from several parties asked the government about the education, research and innovation budget cuts, their effect on the economy, productivity, startups, internships in care and agriculture innovation. The minister answered that the cuts were a political trade-off, that the government cannot reliably model long-term growth effects, and that a number of impacts cannot be quantified in advance.
It is not possible to give a precise estimate of the consequences of this for welfare.
Het is niet mogelijk om een precieze inschatting te geven van de gevolgen hiervan op de welvaart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Daniëlle Jansen over het bericht ‘Meer ziekenhuizen in financiële problemen, bedreigt uitvoering Zorgakkoord’

An MP asked the health minister about hospitals' financial problems and the risk to the Integrated Care Agreement (IZA), including remedies, regional access and insurer roles. The minister answered that hospitals bear primary responsibility, pointed to planned budget-based funding for acute care, multi-year insurer contracts and a supplementary care agreement, but gave few concrete figures on effectiveness and deferred several points.
With the supplementary care and welfare agreement I want to make agreements with the IZA parties on a more targeted use of the transformation funds.
Met het aanvullend zorg- en welzijnsakkoord wil ik met de IZA- partijen afspraken maken over een gerichtere inzet van de transformatiemiddelen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Van Nispen over het bericht Frauderende Twentse zorgondernemer gaat «gewoon» door in Drenthe: «Het liep direct al uit de hand»

MPs Dobbe and Van Nispen asked the minister how a fraudster with a history of large-scale care-fraud could again run a care provider, and how care offices check providers' past. The minister replied that screening relies on VOG, Bibob checks and care office contracting, that the Wbsrz and expanded licensing from 2025 will help, and that a Wibz bill on profit distribution and integrity is planned.
It must not be possible that someone responsible for abuses in care simply becomes active in care again.
Het moet niet kunnen dat iemand die verantwoordelijk is voor misstanden in de zorg, zomaar weer actief wordt in de zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over het bericht ‘Ingrijpen bij Co-Med bleef uit na waarschuwingen over wanbestuur’

An MP asked the Minister of Health why supervisors, inspectorates, prosecutors and insurers did not intervene for years at Co-Med despite warnings of fraud and mismanagement, and whether insurers' fear of collapse made the chain 'too big to fail'. The Minister answered that an evaluation with the IGJ and NZa is underway, acknowledged the insurers' concern about continuity of care, and pointed to planned legislation (Wmg, Wibz) and stronger NZa powers.
A situation like Co-Med must not happen again. That is why I am having what happened here evaluated.
Een situatie als met Co-Med mag niet meer voorkomen. Daarom laat ik evalueren wat hier gebeurd is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over de loonruimte voor apotheekmedewerkers

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health how much of the government's labour-cost allowance for pharmacy care reached insurers' tariffs, whether the 368 million euro is available for wage negotiations, and who is responsible for failed wage increases for pharmacy staff. The Minister said the OVA index is the starting point for negotiations but cannot verify individual contracts, that the 368 million is an integrated part of the pharmacy-care budget mostly for material costs, and that VWS is not a party to tariff or collective bargaining.
To assess that, insight would be needed into all individual contract negotiations between health insurers and providers in pharmacy care. I do not have that insight.
Daarvoor zou inzicht nodig zijn in alle individuele contractonderhandelingen tussen zorgverzekeraars en aanbieders binnen de apotheekzorg. Dat inzicht heb ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe en Westerveld over de antwoorden op eerdere vragen over het opleggen van budgetplafonds aan Pro Persona door de zorgverzekeraars

MPs Dobbe and Westerveld asked the State Secretary whether budget caps imposed by health insurers on Pro Persona mental health care are effective, why the minister cites treatment-norm safeguards that are often breached, and what the effects of such caps are on patients served and on access. The State Secretary answered that caps help insurers allocate scarce staff, that safeguards exist but are insufficiently effective, that the NZa is monitoring insurers' duty of care, and that no detailed effect data exist, while committing to further measures and talks with the affected client councils.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over de postcovidexpertisecentra die per 1 november jl. zijn geopend, zoals aangekondigd in het bericht van de NOS ‘Eerste expertisecentra long covid openen in november’

MP Tielen asked the Minister of Health why only three university medical centres (Amsterdam, Rotterdam, Maastricht) open post-COVID expertise centres first, why no general hospitals are included, how this fits the needs of hard-hit provinces such as Noord-Brabant, and how expertise will be spread beyond academic hospitals. The Minister answered that UMCs were asked to lead expertise development as the field itself had not organised care adequately, that the start is deliberately small with other UMCs following within months, and that patients are allocated by randomisation from a national waiting list via GPs.
Within a few months the other UMCs in the Netherlands will also open their doors, after which this care will be broadened as quickly as possible to general hospitals and primary care.
Binnen enkele maanden zullen ook de overige umc’s in Nederland de deuren openen, waarna deze zorg zo snel mogelijk wordt verbreed naar de algemene ziekenhuizen en de eerste lijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff en De Hoop over de hoge parkeertarieven bij ziekenhuizen

MPs Bushoff and De Hoop asked about high hospital parking fees, public transport access for low-income patients, parking outsourcing, and the Rover report on hospital accessibility. Minister Agema answered that parking policy is the responsibility of hospitals and municipalities, pointed to existing transport and tax schemes, and committed only to forwarding the Rover report to sector bodies.
I do not have this information.
Ik beschik niet over deze informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over de compensatieregeling voor zorgmedewerkers met post-COVID

An MP asked the health minister why the post-COVID compensation scheme for care workers excludes those infected after 2020, whether the hardship clause could be used, how many applications were filed, granted or rejected, and why other essential workers are not covered. The minister answered that the cutoff is needed for legal consistency, the scheme is a gesture of recognition rather than compensation, employers are primarily liable, and figures on applications and budget are given, with a technical briefing planned.
Adopting this scheme is only possible with an objective delineation of the target group.
Het treffen van deze regeling is alleen mogelijk met een objectieve afbakening van de doelgroep.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over de Internationale Dag van de Migraine en het bericht ‘Elke dag hebben 70.000 mensen een migraineaanval, maar de meesten gaan pas na een jaar naar de dokter’

An MP asked the health minister about migraine, its underdiagnosis and undertreatment, and its large workplace costs, following a news report. The minister acknowledged the gap in care and research, pointed to planned women's health research, referred to existing guidance and funding, and said cross-ministry work on sickness absence is ongoing.
I therefore consider it important that more knowledge comes about this.
Ik vind het dan ook belangrijk dat hierover meer kennis komt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff, Slagt-Tichelman, Westerveld, Paulusma, Krul, Dijk, Dobbe, Bikker, El Abassi, Kostić, Koekkoek en Eerdmans over de Nota van Wijziging op de Ontwerpbegroting van het Ministerie van

MPs from multiple parties asked the health ministry, in a set of written questions on the 2025 budget amendment, about cuts to the Stagefonds Zorg, borstprothesen subsidy, SOV care for the uninsured, Veelbelovende zorg, sports funding and the generic staff cut. The minister's answers defend the cuts as efficient or minimal in impact, give partial figures, and state that several effects are still being examined.
It is not known for how many unique patients the subsidy scheme for medically necessary care for the uninsured (SOV) is used.
Het is niet bekend voor hoeveel unieke patiënten gebruik wordt gemaakt van de subsidieregeling medisch noodzakelijke zorg aan onverzekerden (SOV).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht ‘Voorrang geven aan mensen in ziekenhuis die er het ergst aan toe zijn: ’Voor andere patiënten is triage een drama''

An SP MP asks the Minister of Health about a report that triage in hospitals gives priority to the most urgent patients while others face long waits, with 46 percent of treatments exceeding the Treek waiting-time norm in 2023. The minister says waiting times are a concern, points to agreements with sector parties and a review of triage strengthening, and states there is no room for extra funding beyond the existing wage allowance.
Together with the field parties I am committed to keeping waiting times within the Treek norms, so that people can be helped as quickly as possible.
Samen met de veldpartijen zet ik mij ervoor in de wachttijden binnen de Treeknormen te houden, zodat mensen zo snel mogelijk geholpen kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht ‘Zorgcowboys worden nog nauwelijks aangepakt: verdacht hoge winst, meer dividend en minder controle’

MP Dijk (SP) asks the health minister about reports of high profits, dividend payouts and weak control among care providers ('zorgcowboys'), and about the Court of Audit's findings on fraud, information sharing and fraud-resistant regulation. The minister acknowledges the problem, points to the Wbsrz information-sharing law effective 1 January 2025, the planned Wibz bill with basic conditions on profit distribution, and new licensing and refusal grounds, but adds no extra inspection funding.
I do want to set limits on excessive profit distributions in healthcare, and protect healthcare against those entrepreneurs who put financial interest above patient interest.
Ik wil wel paal en perk stellen aan excessieve winstuitkeringen in de zorg, en de zorg beschermen tegen die ondernemers die het financieel belang in plaats van het patiënten belang vooropstellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over signalen van problemen met woon-zorginitiatieven

An MP asked the Minister of Health about signals that care-home residents face rent increases, whether they are vulnerable because housing and care are contractually linked, and about rent protection, care-level changes and quality of care in care-home initiatives. The Minister answered that rent disputes go to the Huurcommissie, that existing rent rules apply, that residents in Wlz institutions pay no rent and so lack rent protection, and that the IGJ supervises care quality, while committing only to existing measures on PGB-financed initiatives.
The Ministry of VWS has no signals of problematic rent increases for clients in a care home.
Er zijn bij het Ministerie van VWS geen signalen bekend over problematische huurstijgingen bij cliënten in een zorgwoning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht ‘Lange wachttijden voorkomen? Privé-kliniek aast op ’makkelijke’ patiënt’

An SP MP asked the health minister about private clinics (zbc's) drawing easy, planned care away from hospitals, profit leakage to shareholders, staff poaching, and risks to acute care, and asked for profit data and contacts with clinic representatives. The minister answered that zbc's are a valuable complement, that a balanced care landscape and equal starting positions are the aim, that a Wibz bill against excessive profit distribution will be sent in Q1 2025, that acute care will be moved to fixed budgets, and that a letter on market forces will follow this autumn, but she declined to provide clinic profit figures, saying the ministry does not hold them.
The Ministry of VWS does not have such an overview.
Het Ministerie van VWS beschikt niet over zo'n overzicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over het bericht ‘VWS negeert advies Raad van State bij regie over opleidingsplekken'

An MP from the SGP asked the Minister of Health why she adopted a decree capping training-place subsidies despite the Council of State's doubts about its legal basis, and whether she would introduce a repair law. The minister answers that the government re-examined the legal basis, concluded the power exists, sees no need for a statutory change, and will await a mid-2025 evaluation before deciding on amendments.

The government re-examined whether the chosen legal basis is sufficient in light of the advice and concluded that there is a power to set, by AMvB, conditions, requirements and restrictions for the NZa when granting availability contributions.

De regering heeft naar aanleiding van het advies opnieuw onderzocht of de gekozen grondslag volstaat. Zij heeft geconcludeerd dat er een bevoegdheid is om bij AMvB voorwaarden, voorschriften en beperkingen voor de NZa te stellen bij de toekenning van beschikbaarheidbijdragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over de uitspraak van de minister van VWS ‘Als het staatsnoodrecht in gaat, wil ik nog wel eens zien wie zo stoer is om het tegen te houden’

An MP asks whether a minister's remark that she would like to see who dares to stop emergency powers (staatsnoodrecht) from taking effect is a threat to parliament or the courts and whether it conflicts with collective cabinet responsibility and the rule of law. The minister says it was not meant as a threat, expresses respect for parliament, and states that parliament has the final word on emergency powers.
Parliament has the last word on the use of emergency powers.
Het parlement heeft het laatste woord over de inzet van het staatsnoodrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Claassen over het bericht ‘Wie stopt de zorgcowboys? Met slimme trucjes weten ze vaak ongezien megawinst te verstoppen’

An MP from the PVV asks the Health Minister how she will stop healthcare fraud, estimated at 10 billion euros a year, and whether she will act on Algemene Rekenkamer findings about the GDPR and on profit-hiding by care providers. The minister acknowledges fraud is hard to stop, lists measures such as the Wbsrz data-sharing law, the Wibz licensing bill and planned conditions on profit distribution, and promises a bill in early 2025.
That is why I intend to set basic conditions for profit distribution in those sectors where profit distribution in healthcare and youth care is permitted.
Daarom heb ik het voornemen om basisvoorwaarden aan winstuitkering te stellen in die sectoren waar winstuitkering in de zorg en jeugdhulp is toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Van Nispen over het bericht dat het OM de criminaliteit in de zorg niet meer aan kan en er jaarlijks voor 10 miljard wordt gefraudeerd

MPs Dobbe and Van Nispen asked the Health and Justice ministers how they respond to reports that the Public Prosecution Service cannot handle healthcare crime and that around 10 billion euros is defrauded yearly, and what they will do about it. The minister answers that tackling care fraud is a priority, lists planned measures (new licensing grounds, data sharing, profit-distribution conditions, a review of open-house contracting, and stricter inspection of diplomas), and promises further letters and a bill in 2025.
I agree with the questioners that commercial interests of care providers or investors must never take precedence over the public interest in care and youth assistance.
Ik ben het eens met de vragenstellers dat commerciële belangen van zorgaanbieders of investeerders nooit vóór het maatschappelijk belang van zorg en jeugdhulp mogen gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over het bericht ‘Het OM kan criminaliteit in de zorg niet meer aan: ‘Er wordt jaarlijks voor 10 miljard gefraudeerd’

Diederik van Dijk (SGP) asked the ministers of Health and Justice about reports that organised crime and fraud in healthcare cost around 10 billion euros a year and that prosecutors cannot cope, asking about cooperation, data sharing, inspection, fraud law and prioritisation. The minister answers that the Wbsrz (in force 1 January 2025) and a warning register will improve data sharing, that prosecution is already prioritised, and that she will not weaken the intent requirement or reverse the burden of proof but will review regulation with partners.
I am willing to enter into discussion with health insurers about how they check and reimburse claims for care provided in foreign clinics, and to inform your House about this in spring 2025.

Ik ben bereid het gesprek met zorgverzekeraars aan te gaan over de vraag op welke manier zij declaraties voor zorg – die geleverd is in buitenlandse klinieken – controleren en vergoeden, en uw Kamer daarover in het voorjaar van 2025 te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Dijk over het bericht «Blokkade in Amsterdamse zorgketen door omzetplafonds vvt»

MPs Dobbe and Dijk (SP) asked about Amsterdam care providers halting admissions after reaching turnover caps, and whether caps block access to geriatric rehabilitation and palliative care and conflict with insurers' duty of care. The State Secretary says caps are an insurer tool to allocate scarce capacity, that insurers must arrange alternative timely care under the duty of care supervised by the NZa, and that the government will examine legislative changes to make palliative care a regular part of care.
It is the task of health insurers to allocate this scarce staff capacity and scarce resources as well as possible and ideally to ensure they reach the people who need care most.

Het is de taak van zorgverzekeraars om deze schaarse personele inzet en schaarse middelen zo goed mogelijk te verdelen en idealiter terecht te laten komen bij de mensen die de zorg het hardst nodig hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht dat zorgzzp’ers de belastingdienst vrezen

An SP MP asks the health minister about reports that care freelancers fear the tax authority, whether enforcement will drive them out of care, and whether employers should be steered toward fixed staff and flexible-workforce limits. The minister answers that enforcement against false self-employment is intended to improve care continuity, that she does not expect mass exits, and that she is pursuing a fixed-staff-first approach via a leidraad, a campaign and dialogues with sector bodies, while declining to set a maximum share of flexible workers.
There is no "reasonable percentage" of an external flexible workforce that can be named.
Er is geen «redelijk percentage» van een externe flexibele schil te noemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Dijk over het bericht ‘Kwart verzorgenden denkt aan stoppen’

Two MPs from the SP asked the health minister about a survey showing a quarter of care workers considering quitting, covering workload, salaries, administrative burden, budget cuts and the staffing norm in nursing homes. The minister acknowledged the problem, outlined plans on administrative relief, digitalisation and a leidraad on work pleasure, but declined to raise salaries beyond existing OVA funds and said she cannot influence the quality standard's staffing norm.
It is therefore not within my power to carry out the wish to maintain the staffing norm.
Het ligt daarom niet binnen mijn mogelijkheid om de wens de personele bezettingsnorm te handhaven uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meijeren over de registratie van vaccinatie- en sterftegegevens en mogelijke impact op de gerapporteerde oversterfte

An MP asked the Minister about a research report claiming the RIVM's CIMS vaccination data are unreliable and that records of about 880,000 people who died or emigrated after vaccination were removed from the dataset given to external researchers, and whether this undermines excess-mortality research. The State Secretary rejected the claims, stating that CIMS records are not deleted except on request, that the data are available via CBS microdata, and that there is no basis for doubt or manipulation, so no further action was taken.
The RIVM does not delete data from CIMS unless people themselves request deletion of their own data (right to be forgotten).
Het RIVM verwijdert geen gegevens uit CIMS, tenzij mensen zelf vragen om hun eigen gegevens te laten verwijderen (recht op vergetelheid).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht dat er onvoldoende budget is in 2024 voor de langdurige zorg

MP Dobbe (SP) asked the Minister of Health about a report that the NZa projects insufficient 2024 long-term care (Wlz) budget, and whether the 310 million euro cut and the rejected restoration amendment were responsible. The state secretary denied a cut, said the Wlz budget was raised by 201 million euro structurally to cover the shortfall, and declined to guarantee that no further cuts would be made.
There is no question of extra cuts of 310 million on the Wlz budget.
Er is geen sprake van extra bezuinigingen van 310 miljoen op het Wlz-kader.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Westerveld over het opleggen van budgetplafonds aan Pro Persona door de zorgverzekeraars

MPs Dobbe and Westerveld asked the state secretary about budget caps imposed on Pro Persona GGZ by health insurers and whether this conflicts with insurers' duty of care amid long mental health waiting lists. The state secretary says caps are a legitimate tool for allocating scarce capacity, insurers retain a duty of care and must refer patients elsewhere, and he is discussing improvements with the sector without intervening in contracts.
Making agreements, including on budget caps, is a matter between individual providers and individual health insurers.
Het maken van afspraken, ook over budgetplafonds, is een zaak tussen individuele aanbieders en individuele zorgverzekeraars.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over het bericht ‘Fins onderzoek: Spijt bij geslachtsverandering neemt toe’

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Health about a Finnish study reporting rising regret after gender-affirming hormone treatment, and whether it would inform the Dutch transgender care quality standard and how many Dutch patients stop treatment. The minister answered that the Finnish findings will be considered in the ongoing standard update, that Dutch data on regret is limited, and that the Gezondheidsraad has been asked to review long-term effects.
I consider it important that the results of this study are taken into account in the revision of the Somatic Transgender Care Quality Standard.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat de resultaten van dit onderzoek meegenomen worden bij de herziening van de Kwaliteitsstandaard Transgenderzorg Somatisch
Antwoord op vragen van de leden White en Bushoff over de ziekenhuiszorg in Curaçao

Two MPs asked the State Secretary and Minister about the financial distress of Curaçao Medical Center, the continuity and access of healthcare on Curaçao, and what Dutch support is available. The government answered that healthcare is Curaçao's responsibility, that Curaçao has not requested or used offered Dutch support, and that a supplementary financing package and structural reforms are planned.
I do not have sufficient information to make a full assessment of this.
Ik beschik niet over voldoende informatie om een volledige inschatting hiervan te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Daniëlle Jansen over het bericht “Onderzoek: Hoe Nederland zijn vaccinkennis grotendeels ontmantelde. ‘Je gaat toch ook de brandweer niet verkopen?’”

An MP asked the health minister whether the Netherlands holds 20 million smallpox vaccines, their expiry date, and whether the ministry knows its stocks, following a report on dismantling vaccine knowledge. The minister confirmed about 20 million first-generation smallpox vaccines, said they are periodically retested and their shelf life extended, enclosed the package insert, and confirmed the ministry knows its stocks.
Yes, there are approximately 20 million first-generation smallpox vaccines.
Ja, er zijn ongeveer 20 miljoen eerste generatie pokkenvaccins.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff en Paulusma over de dreiging op een moedwillige uitbraak van het MPOX-virus door een agressor

MPs Bushoff and Paulusma asked the Minister of Health what underpins the claimed threat of deliberate spread of the mpox virus by an aggressor, and whether supporting documents exist and whether the threat has changed since the stockpile was built. The Minister corrects the framing to smallpox, says there is no specific threat of deliberate mpox spread, refers to the 2022 national security risk analysis for bioweapon threats, and states Dutch preparedness includes smallpox vaccine stocks and guidance on anthrax and plague.
Other services are responsible for assessing whether such a threat exists.
Voor een inschatting over het bestaan van een dergelijke dreiging zijn andere diensten verantwoordelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Dobbe over het bericht 'Zorgen over verkeerde hulp aan eenzame mensen door 'aanbestedingscircus'

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Health about reports that competitive tendering of loneliness support produces offers that do not really help lonely people and breaks care relationships, and about the status of a motion to abolish mandatory tendering. The Minister answered that municipalities choose how to finance such help, that tendering is not legally mandatory, that continuity can be safeguarded through contract design and monitoring, and that the Ketenbureau will be strengthened to support municipalities.
There is no general statutory obligation in the social domain to tender.
Er is geen algemene wettelijke verplichting in het sociaal domein om aan te besteden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht ‘Experts waarschuwen voor levensgevaarlijke afslankthee: ‘Je speelt echt met je gezondheid’

An MP asked the health minister about reports that slimming tea containing the banned substance sibutramine was sold online, and about enforcement by the NVWA and IGJ. The state secretary answered that the NVWA has acted against sellers, including an arrest and a public warning, while noting that regulating non-EU sellers online is legally difficult and that the company bears primary responsibility.
In such cases the NVWA can have the content removed if it does not comply with the legislation.
De NVWA kan in zulke gevallen wel de inhoud laten verwijderen, indien deze niet aan de wetgeving voldoet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Bushoff over het vogelgriepvirus dat overspringt van koeien op mensen

MPs Bromet and Bushoff asked the government about bird flu jumping from cows to humans, its receptor binding in human airways, and whether dense livestock farming in the Netherlands increases mutation and spread risks. Minister Wiersma answered that risks cannot be quantified, that no cow infections are known in the Netherlands, and that structural measures on poultry farms are still under impact analysis with results expected in 2025.
I expect the results of these analyses in the second quarter of 2025.
Ik verwacht de resultaten van deze analyses in het tweede kwartaal van 2025.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht ‘Veel Nederlandse tandartsen gaan binnenkort met pensioen, alleen in Italië studeren er minder nieuwe af’

An MP asked the Minister of Health about reports that the Netherlands trains fewer dentists than most of Europe, the shortage it creates, and private equity's role. The minister said the government is working towards the Capaciteitsorgaan's minimum advice of 345 places but has capped intake at 259 for 2024, and noted regional shortages and the high share of foreign-trained dentists.
Yes. Work is being done step by step towards the minimum advice of the Capaciteitsorgaan.
Ja. Er wordt stapsgewijs toegewerkt naar het minimumadvies van het Capaciteitsorgaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over het bericht 'Artsen zonder Grenzen: snel meer vaccins nodig tegen mpox Afrika'

Deputy Paulusma asked the Health Minister why the Netherlands would not send mpox vaccines to Africa as the WHO requested, and how this fits with pandemic preparedness lessons. Minister Agema agreed donations can help, but said Dutch stockpiles of about 100,000 doses must be kept for national preparedness and that outbreak control at the source comes first.
I therefore choose to keep the current stock of vaccines for the national preparedness of our country at the safe level of around 100,000.
Ik kies er daarom voor om de huidige voorraad vaccins voor de nationale paraatheid van ons land op het veilige niveau van ongeveer 100.000 te behouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Bushoff over het besluit van Nederland om vooralsnog niet in te gaan op de oproep van de WHO om mpox-vaccins naar Afrika te sturen

MPs Hirsch and Bushoff asked why the Netherlands is not donating mpox vaccines to Africa despite WHO's call and the international emergency, and how the risk trade-off was made. The Minister replies that the Netherlands keeps its national stockpile of about 100,000 doses, cannot donate because of its national safety buffer and expiring stock, and contributes EUR 3 million to WHO's response plan instead.
I am currently not making vaccines available for donation to other countries, because the stock in the Netherlands would then fall below the national safety buffer.
Ik stel op dit moment geen vaccins beschikbaar voor donatie aan andere landen, omdat de voorraad in Nederland daarmee onder de nationale veiligheidsbuffer zou zakken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Kamminga over de berichtgeving omtrent mpox-vaccins, o.a. op NU.nl ‘Geen Nederlandse mpox-vaccins naar Afrika vanwege ‘nationale paraatheid’’

MPs Tielen and Kamminga asked the Ministers of Health and of Foreign Trade and Development about reports that the Netherlands would not donate its mpox vaccine stock to Africa for national preparedness reasons, and about the stock size, donations, replenishment and expected use. Minister Agema answered that the stock of about 99,700 vaccines is a safety reserve, that donation is not ruled out but is currently declined, that replenishment depends on manufacturer delivery expected in early 2025, and that the Netherlands contributes EUR 3 million to the WHO response plan.
As I indicated earlier, I have decided not to donate mpox vaccines now because the 100,000 vaccines I have are our safety stock and delivery of new vaccines will only take place in 2025.
