Zoals ik eerder heb aangegeven, heb ik besloten nu geen mpox-vaccins doneren omdat de 100.000 vaccins die ik heb onze veiligheidsvoorraad zijn en levering van nieuwe vaccins pas in 2025 plaats zal vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma, Bamenga en Rooderkerk over het nieuws dat omwonenden van zware industrie structureel hogere zorgkosten hebben

MPs from D66 asked the government to react to news that residents near heavy industry have higher healthcare costs, and about health data, pollution, legal enforcement of permits and the Tata Steel negotiations. The government answered that health depends on many factors so the link to industry is not direct, that no specific national data exists but further research (RIVM studies, a health impact method for permits under the Omgevingswet) is underway, and that enforcement tools lie with provinces and municipalities.
No, such insight specifically for residents of industry does not exist, and this possible link cannot simply be demonstrated, because it depends on many factors.
Nee, dergelijk inzicht speciaal voor omwonenden van de industrie bestaat niet en dit eventuele verband is ook niet zomaar aan te tonen, omdat het afhangt van veel factoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meijeren over de recente onthullingen uit Duitsland betreffende misstanden rondom de totstandkoming van het coronabeleid

An FVD MP asked the Minister of Health about leaked German RKI documents alleging political influence on corona policy, and whether similar misconduct occurred at the RIVM, plus Dutch openness of OMT documents. The Staatssecretaris said the German documents' conclusions cannot be drawn from them, denied similar problems in the Netherlands, pointed to the open.minvws.nl platform, and refused full release of OMT notes citing the need to protect the functioning of the OMT.
As regards the OMT, the meeting of the OMT takes place in closed session.
Wat betreft het OMT geldt dat de vergadering van het OMT in beslotenheid plaatsvindt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het bericht Ministerie stopte acht ton subsidie in verlieslijdend festival: 'Zeer kwalijk’

An MP asked why the health ministry gave a one-off subsidy of about €597,000 to the Tong Tong Fair despite legal warnings, whether the decision was transparent, and why Indies war widows' backpay remains unresolved. The state secretary answered that the subsidy was lawful under the block exemption, that the irregularity was only in the payment schedule, that the Chamber was informed via the 2020 letter and annual report, and that backpay is a separate matter to be addressed in a written consultation.
Accepting an irregularity falls within the competence of ministers.
Het accepteren van een onrechtmatigheid behoort tot de bevoegdheid van bewindspersonen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bezoek aan het Zuyderland Ziekenhuis

An SP MP asked Minister Agema about her working visit to Zuyderland hospital in Heerlen, including the consultation process, whether Parkstad was sufficiently involved, the future of the emergency department, intensive care and obstetrics, and market-based financing. The minister answered that she listened to stakeholders, does not decide on the regional care organisation, pointed to the coalition agreement commitment to keep regional hospitals open, and promised further details in forthcoming letters and a meeting with the Limburg governor.
I do not decide on this.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht ‘Mevrouw Verheijden (88) moest halsoverkop weg uit verzorgingshuis’

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about an 88-year-old resident who had to move suddenly from a care home run by Zuyderland after staff sick leave, questioning staffing, cuts and the risk of repeated moves. The government answered that the unit was temporarily closed due to combined sick leave, that residents will return by end of October, and that the budget decision is deferred to the 2025 budget.
I have not received any concrete signals about this.
Ik heb hierover geen concrete signalen ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht ‘Acuut gebrek aan medicijn, probleem bij kinderkanker’

An MP asked the Health Minister about a shortage of etoposide affecting childhood cancer treatment, its patient impact, supply chain vulnerabilities and possible stockpiling or domestic production. The minister answered that alternative treatments and supply measures are in place, that new stocks are expected soon, and that a critical medicines list and possible regulation will follow once finances are clear.
I am certainly willing to make new laws and regulations, or to amend existing ones, if this can prevent shortages.
Ik ben zeker bereid nieuwe wet- en regelgeving te maken, of deze aan te passen als dit tekorten kan voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht dat private equity fors investeert in zorg en gezondheid en steeds vaker in gespecialiseerde klinieken investeren

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about private equity investment in healthcare, its motives, profit extraction, the Co-Med case, the share of private equity in care, and whether it should be curbed or banned. The minister answered that she sees risks when financial interests outweigh patient interests, will propose legislation in early 2025 on integrity of business operations and give the NZa stronger powers to assess mergers, but judges a full ban disproportionate.
I will present a bill in the first quarter of 2025 to safeguard integrity of business operations.
Ik kom in het eerste kwartaal van 2025 met een wetsvoorstel om integere bedrijfsvoering te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over de overdracht van patiëntendossiers door de curator van Co-Med

MP Bushoff asked the health minister about the handover of patient files after the bankruptcy of Co-Med, which left a new GP in Breezand unable to access records, and whether such transfers can be enforced. The minister answered that the IGJ imposed enforcement on Co-Med, a 21 August agreement with insurers and curators provides for bulk transfer once a successor practice is agreed, and current law is sufficient, with patients able to request individual files.
The Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGJ) imposed enforcement on 27 June 2024 to arrange the transfer of patient files.
De Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd (IGJ) heeft op 27 juni 2024 bestuursdwang opgelegd om de overdracht van patiëntendossiers te regelen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht dat het Zuid-Hollandse ziekenhuis Alrijne een deel van de spoedzorg sluit en operaties uitstelt

An SP MP asked the Health Minister about the temporary closure of parts of acute care and postponement of operations at Alrijne hospital after a laboratory provider switch, and whether government policy was to blame. The minister answered that the cause was operational problems at the new lab supplier Eurofins SCAL, that the IGJ was informed, acute care reopened fully by 23 July, and that the government bears no responsibility.
The problems were not caused by government policy.
De problemen zijn niet veroorzaakt door regeringsbeleid.
Antwoord op van de leden Bushoff en Patijn over het bericht ‘Erkenning van longcovid voor WIA-uitkering gaat vaak mis: “Beoordeling bij driekwart van de patiënten onvoldoende”

Two GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked whether incorrectly prepared long-COVID WIA disability assessments by UWV, reported as unsound in about 75% of a preliminary sample, are acceptable and what remedies exist. The minister acknowledged the concern, said the sample is not representative, announced a follow-up study by UWV expected by year-end, and outlined training and capacity measures, while not committing to reopening decisions.
Because the preliminary study is not a representative sample, UWV is starting a follow-up study.
Omdat het vooronderzoek geen representatieve steekproef betreft, start UWV een vervolgonderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over het bericht ‘Jonge huisartsen springen in gat dat Co-Med achterlaat, maar worden tegengewerkt door curator’

An MP asked the Minister of Health why the bankruptcy curator of Co-Med allegedly blocks young GPs from taking over practices by charging for patient files and withholding access. The Minister answers that IGJ has imposed enforcement to secure file access, that the curator must follow the KNMG handover guideline, that goodwill payments for practice takeovers are a matter between curator and buyer, and that the ministry will act if the supervisors identify a role for VWS.
I am kept informed by the supervisory authorities NZa and IGJ of all developments regarding the handling of the bankruptcy.

De voordracht voor een krachtens het vierde lid vast te stellen algemene maatregel van bestuur wordt niet eerder gedaan dan vier weken nadat het ontwerp aan beide Kamers der Staten-Generaal is overgelegd.
Amendement van de leden Van der Linde en Paternotte over een informatieplicht met betrekking tot het kostenkader
Requires ministers to inform both chambers in advance of setting or changing a cost framework for supervisors and promptly when a supervisor exceeds it.
Our Ministers inform both chambers of the States General in good time
Onze Ministers informeren beide kamers der Staten-Generaal tijdig
Amendement van de leden Van der Linde en Paternotte over een voorhangbepaling met betrekking tot artikel 15, vierde lid
Adds a clause requiring that a general administrative order on cost distribution be laid before both chambers for four weeks before it is submitted.
In this way control and accountability for the cost distribution and cost increases are guaranteed.
Zo wordt controle en verantwoording van de kostenverdeling en kostenstijging gewaarborgd.
Motie van het lid Van der Lee c.s. over meer transparantie over lidstaatopties
Asks the government to push for more EU-wide transparency on member states' implementation options and to fully inform the House when future bills are handled.
requests the government to work within the EU for more transparency about the member-state options chosen by other member states
verzoekt de regering om, zich in Europees verband in te zetten voor meer transparantie over de door andere lidstaten gekozen lidstaatopties
Motie van de leden Paternotte en Van der Lee over het aanscherpen van de definitie van UBO
Motion asks the government to lower the UBO ownership threshold definition from 25% plus one to 10%.
to tighten the definition of UBO from 25% plus one to 10%
om de definitie van UBO aan te scherpen van 25% +1 naar 10%
Motie van het lid Leijten c.s. over het UBO-register
Asks the government to ensure that trust office staff cannot be used to conceal the ultimate beneficial owner from tax authorities or justice in the UBO register design.
make it impossible for trust office staff to be used to keep the ultimate beneficial owner out of sight of the tax authorities or justice
onmogelijk te maken dat personeel van een trustkantoor gebruikt kan worden om de uiteindelijke belanghebbende uit het zicht van de fiscus of justitie te houden
Motie van de leden Paternotte en Leijten over de haalbaarheid van een marktbrede vergelijking
Asks the government, with the sector, to study whether a market-wide comparison should be the starting point for independent advice in insurance distribution and to report before summer.
of the opinion that independent advice can only exist when a market-wide comparison has been made
van mening dat er pas sprake kan zijn van een onafhankelijk advies wanneer er een marktbrede vergelijking is gemaakt
Motie van het lid Paternotte c.s. over belemmerende wetgeving voor 3D-geprinte producten
Motion asking the government to identify and tackle legislation that hinders the use of 3D-printed products.
requests the government to map and address obstructive laws and regulations regarding the use of 3D-printed products
verzoekt de regering om, belemmerende wet- en regelgeving ten aanzien van de toepassing van 3D-geprinte producten in kaart te brengen en aan te pakken
Motie van het lid Veldman c.s. over het tegengaan van de daling van Wbso-percentages
Asks the government to propose ways to counter the trend decline in Wbso R&D tax percentages within the existing fiscal framework.
calls on the government to come up with proposals to counter this trend decline in Wbso percentages
roept de regering op, om met voorstellen te komen om deze trendmatige daling van Wbso-percentages tegen te gaan
Motie van het lid Amhaouch c.s. over één openbaar digitaal register inbesteden
Asks the government, with MKB-Nederland, to explore a single public digital register where authorities must report insourcing decisions in advance, to improve transparency for businesses.
om de transparantie bij inbesteden te bevorderen
Motie van het lid Veldman c.s. over een jaarlijkse top over digitalisering
Asks the government to organise an annual digitalisation summit with science and market actors to set goals and share knowledge.
requests the government to organise, together with science and the market, an annual recurring digitalisation summit
verzoekt de regering om, samen met de wetenschap en de markt een jaarlijks terugkerende digitaliseringstop te organiseren
Motie van het lid Bruins c.s. over minimale tenderkosten
Asks the government to limit tender costs for businesses bidding on public contracts and to inform the House at least every three years.
requests the government to make efforts to limit tender costs in public procurement to a minimum
verzoekt de regering zich in te spannen de tenderkosten bij aanbestedingen tot een minimum te beperken
Motie van het lid Paternotte c.s. over het innen van toeristenbelasting
Motion asking the government to include tourist tax collection from holiday rentals in the instrument for municipalities and to report progress to the House in Q1 2018.
requests the government to inform the House in Q1 2018 about progress in talks with municipalities on this instrument
verzoekt de regering om, in het eerste kwartaal van 2018 de Kamer te informeren over de voortgang van de gesprekken met de gemeenten over dit instrumentarium
Motie van het lid Veldman c.s. over de inzet van de middelen voor innovatie in 2018
Motion asks the government to give clarity before the committee meeting on how innovation funds for 2018 will be deployed.
requests the government, prior to the committee meeting on Innovation of 8 February 2018, to provide clarity on the deployment of the funds for 2018
verzoekt de regering, voorafgaand aan het AO Innovatie van 8 februari 2018 duidelijkheid te bieden over de inzet van de middelen voor 2018
Motie van het lid Paternotte c.s. over de SBIR-oproepen
Asks the government to reserve part of extra applied research investment for SBIR innovation calls for start-ups.
requests the government to reserve part of the extra investments in applied research for SBIR calls
verzoekt de regering, een deel van de extra investeringen in toegepast onderzoek te reserveren voor SBIR-oproepen
Motie van het lid Paternotte c.s. over een SBIR-oproep op het gebied van serious gaming
Asks the government to launch an SBIR innovation call on serious gaming to address societal challenges.
requests the government to start an SBIR call in the field of serious gaming
verzoekt de regering, een SBIR-oproep te starten op het gebied van serious gaming
Motie van het lid Amhaouch c.s. over het betaalgedrag van overheden verbeteren
Asks the government to draw up a concrete plan, with stakeholders, so that governments pay their invoices within 30 days, and to report to the House yearly.
requests the government, in cooperation with the various parties involved, to draw up a concrete plan
verzoekt de regering om, in samenwerking met de verschillende betrokken partijen een concreet plan op te stellen
Motie van het lid Amhaouch c.s. over digitalisering door het brede mkb
Asks the government to speed up digitalisation among broad SMEs through regional practice tests, feasibility study of digitalisation scans and scaling best practices.
set in motion regional practice tests
regionale praktijktesten in gang te zetten
Motie van het lid Veldman c.s. over een plan van aanpak voor het mkb
Asks the government to send parliament a plan of action for small and medium enterprises before the spring memorandum.
requests the government to send the Chamber a plan of action for SMEs before the Spring Memorandum appears
verzoekt de regering om, voor het verschijnen van de Voorjaarsnota een plan van aanpak voor het mkb aan de Kamer toe te sturen
Amendement van het lid Van den Berg c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 10 over herstel van bestaande regels voor medegebruik van antenne-opstelpunten
Amends the telecommunications bill to restore specific rules on reasonable fees for shared use of antenna sites for broadcasting, with the burden of proof on the provider and ACM review.
In disputes, the provider meeting the sharing request bears the burden of proving the reasonableness of the fee.
Daarbij draagt de aanbieder die aan het verzoek tot medegebruik voldoet bij geschillen de bewijslast voor de redelijkheid van de vergoeding.
Amendement van het lid Van den Berg c.s. over herstel van  bestaande regels voor medegebruik van antenne-opstelpunten
Restores specific rules on reasonable fees for shared use of antenna sites for broadcasting, with the provider bearing the burden of proof on reasonableness in disputes.
The provider meeting the request bears the burden of proof for the reasonableness of the fee in disputes.
Daarbij draagt de aanbieder die aan het verzoek tot medegebruik voldoet bij geschillen de bewijslast voor de redelijkheid van de vergoeding.
Amendement van het lid Van den Berg c.s. over het alleen opruimen van aangelegde kabels na redelijk verzoek
Limits cable removal orders to reasonable requests, so that unused cables suitable for broadband are not removed in principle.
The amendment aims to ensure that only reasonable requests can give rise to removing laid cables
Het amendement heeft als doel dat alleen redelijke verzoeken aanleiding kunnen vormen voor het opruimen van aangelegde kabels
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Paternotte over het bericht 'Het kabinet wil twee Afghaanse vrouwen terugsturen ondanks vrouwonvriendelijk bewind van de Taliban'

MPs Podt and Paternotte asked the Asylum and Migration and Foreign Affairs ministers about a report that the cabinet wants to return two Afghan women despite Taliban oppression, citing a UN human rights warning and a court ruling against the IND. The minister answered that the IND assesses each case individually under the Vreemdelingencirculaire, that Afghan women facing discriminatory measures generally receive asylum permits, that Nederland co-initiated a Women's Convention liability claim against Afghanistan, and that no change to country policy is planned, while declining to comment on the individual case.
As your House is aware, I do not comment on individual cases.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend ga ik niet in op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Bamenga over de situatie in Soedan

Two D66 MPs asked the government about the situation in Sudan, El Fasher, RSF genocide designation, sanctions, arms exports via the UAE, fact-finding, journalist support and humanitarian aid. The government answered that it shares concern, applies a high bar for genocide qualification, pursues sanctions and engagement with the UAE, supports the fact-finding mission and humanitarian aid, and reviews export licences case by case.
The cabinet assesses all export licence applications for military goods case by case and carefully under the EU Common Position on arms export control.
Het kabinet toetst alle vergunningaanvragen voor de uitvoer van militaire goederen per geval en zorgvuldig conform het EU Gemeenschappelijk Standpunt inzake wapenexportcontrole
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Van der Werf over de beveiliging van de Israëlische delegatie door een voormalig legerofficier met illegale wapens

MPs Paternotte and Van der Werf asked about an armed private security guard, a former Israeli army officer, who was caught at Schiphol with illegal pistols while guarding an Israeli delegation, and about checks, prior notification, and possible training of Dutch police by him. The minister answered that armed guards require prior government permission, that no request was received for this visit, that individual cases are not discussed publicly, that police and army used the guard's company for training in the past, and that no other similar incidents are known.
I never make public statements about individual cases.
Ik doe in het openbaar nooit uitspraken over individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over de antiregeringsprotesten in Georgië

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about mass protests and arrests in Georgia, whether the Netherlands should protect European democracy against Russian influence, whether it should use all unilateral and multilateral tools against Georgia, and whether it could impose independent sanctions under the Sanctiewet 1977. The minister answered that Georgian cooperation programmes were suspended, the OSCE Vienna Mechanism was initiated, EU funds were halted and visa measures applied, but that the Sanctiewet 1977 does not allow independent Dutch sanctions and the joint ministerial statement is insufficiently concrete to serve as a basis.
Under the Sanctiewet 1977 the Netherlands cannot impose independent sanctions; sanctions are implemented only when they follow from international obligations.
Op grond van de Sanctiewet 1977 kan Nederland geen zelfstandige sancties opleggen, maar worden sancties uitgevoerd die voortvloeien uit internationale verplichtingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Boswijk over het bericht ‘Nederland laat Russische schaduwvloot ongemoeid, terwijl zeven landen wel controleren’

MPs Paternotte and Boswijk asked whether the Netherlands is doing enough to check Russian shadow-fleet vessels, given that other North Sea and Baltic states inspect them, and whether legal, technical or capacity barriers are being removed. The minister replied that Dutch jurisdiction on the high seas is limited, that inspections are being prepared with the Coast Guard and ILT, and that capacity expansion is a priority but its funding is still under discussion.
It is impossible to check all shadow-fleet ships, especially since the Netherlands has no jurisdiction over ships sailing on the open sea.
Het is onmogelijk alle schepen uit de Russische schaduwvloot te controleren, temeer daar Nederland geen rechtsmacht heeft bij schepen die varen op open zee.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Inge van Dijk en Paternotte over het bericht ’UEFA gaf clubs in Rusland 10,8 miljoen euro, maar weigerde steun aan Oekraïense clubs’

MPs asked whether the UEFA should stop paying solidarity money to Russian clubs and whether Ukrainian clubs should receive the same support as others, given Russia's war against Ukraine. The government answered that UEFA is not a state body and sanctions compliance is UEFA's responsibility, that it will use informal channels and contact the KNVB, and that UEFA says it never refused Ukrainian clubs but bank blockages prevented payments.
The cabinet will use all available informal channels to bring its position on this matter to the fore and will also be in contact with the KNVB about it.
Het kabinet zal alle beschikbare informele kanalen aangrijpen om zijn standpunt in deze voor het voetlicht te brengen en hierover ook contact hebben met de KNVB.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over het bericht ‘Unicef: duizenden ondervoede kinderen dreigen te sterven in belegerde stad in Sudan’

Paternotte (D66) asked the foreign minister about UNICEF warnings of starving children in besieged El Fasher, Sudan, and whether Netherlands could add sanctions on the RSF, aid, evidence-gathering for war crimes, and funding for humanitarian relief and tracing missing persons. Minister Van Weel answered that the Netherlands backs EU sanctions and a third package, funds humanitarian aid and the Fact Finding Mission, and supports the ICRC, but that national sanctions are of limited effect and access to El Fasher remains blocked.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bamenga, Paternotte en Paulusma over opnemen van Palestijnse patiënten uit Gaza

MPs Bamenga, Paternotte and Paulusma (D66) asked why the Netherlands has not admitted any Palestinian patients from Gaza for treatment, while many Western European countries have, and whether this breaches international obligations, including the ICJ ruling and the WHO appeals. The government answers that it prioritises regional treatment and financial and diplomatic support for medical evacuations, cites funding amounts, and says it will continue pressing Israel to allow more evacuations, without committing to bring patients to the Netherlands.
The cabinet focuses on treating seriously ill patients in the region.
Het kabinet zet in op behandeling van ernstig zieke patiënten in de regio.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bamenga, Paternotte en Paulusma over medische evacuaties uit Gaza

D66 MPs asked the government to release a study by two former ambassadors on medical evacuations from Gaza, to explain why the Netherlands does not take patients while many European states do, and to take in a contingent of patients. The government refused to share the study, said it prioritises support for care in the region over evacuation to the Netherlands, and listed financial contributions and a contact point for medical professionals.
The exploration discussed during the RDINEV is confidential and will not be shared with your House to protect the unity of Cabinet policy.
De verkenning die tijdens de RDINEV werd besproken is vertrouwelijk, en wordt niet met uw Kamer gedeeld ter bescherming van de eenheid van Kabinetsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Boswijk over het artikel Schaduwvloot onder valse vlag

Two MPs asked the government about reports that tankers in Russia's shadow fleet sail under flags of Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten, and what the Kingdom will do to stop sanctions evasion. The minister answered that the Kingdom is working on the issue through maritime administrations, the Coast Guard and IMO, that Kustwacht has contacted sanctioned vessels, and that legal and operational options are being explored.
Preparations are being made to enable inspections at anchorages of ships under the non-existent ship registers of countries in the Kingdom.
Voorbereidingen worden getroffen om inspecties op ankerplaatsen mogelijk te maken van schepen onder de niet-bestaande scheepsregisters van landen in het Koninkrijk.
Antwoord op de leden Dassen en Paternotte over het artikel ‘Baudet ontkent contact met Rusland, maar FVD-Kamerlid Ralf Dekker videobelt met Poetins partij Verenigd Rusland’

Dassen (Volt) and Paternotte (D66) asked the government whether contacts between Forum voor Democratie MPs and sanctioned Russian politicians from Putin's party pose security risks, whether such contacts will be condemned, and whether financial ties and election interference can be ruled out. The government answered that MPs are free to maintain contacts, that Russian influence and the risk of covert interference are recognised, that AIVD awareness briefings and warnings exist, that absolute certainty about sanctions compliance cannot be given (investigation would follow signals), and that election-security measures and EU cooperation are in place.
MPs, like everyone else, are free to maintain contact with anyone.
Kamerleden, net als iedereen, vrij zijn om met eenieder contact te onderhouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Piri over de dood van Al Jazeera-journalist Anas al-Sharif in Gaza

MPs Paternotte and Piri asked the government about the killing of Al Jazeera journalist Anas al-Sharif in Gaza, Israel's claim he was a Hamas member, and press freedom and journalist access to Gaza. The minister said Israel has not substantiated its allegations, that Nederland calls for evidence to be shared and for independent investigations, and listed diplomatic steps and support for press freedom.

For this reason the Netherlands wants Israel to share evidence with the international community in cases where attacks on journalists are justified by claims of membership of a terrorist organisation.

Nederland wil daarom dat Israël bewijs deelt met de internationale gemeenschap in het geval dat aanvallen op journalisten worden onderbouwd met claims van lidmaatschap van een terroristische organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Paternotte over het bericht “Jongvolwassen Oekraïners tussen wal en schip: geen recht op onderwijs, geen toekomstperspectief”

MPs Podt and Paternotte (D66) asked ministers about reports that young adult Ukrainians lack access to education and prospects, including tuition and student finance parity with EU/EEA students, lower institutional tuition, Piri motion follow-up, Dutch language provision and support for vulnerable newcomers. The government replied that temporary protection runs to 4 March 2027, that tuition-level decisions rest with institutions, and that details of a return programme and transition document will be sent to parliament in September 2025, without changing current rules in the meantime.
Pending final decision-making on this temporary national status for displaced persons from Ukraine, I do not intend to amend current laws and regulations in advance.
In afwachting van finale besluitvorming over deze tijdelijke nationale status voor ontheemden uit Oekraïne ben ik niet voornemens om vooruitlopend daarop de huidige wet- en regelgeving aan te passen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Piri, Van der Burg en Diederik van Dijk over de uitvoering van de motie-Sjoerdsma c.s. ten aanzien van erkenning en schadevergoeding voor Indische slachtoffers van Nederlandse

Four MPs asked the Foreign Minister why the promised local disclosure of the NIMH victims list and claims handling for Indonesian victims of Dutch abuses has not yet happened two years after the Sjoerdsma motion. The minister answers that privacy assessments under the GDPR are slow, that a foundation has been funded to promote the scheme locally, and that the list is expected to be shared this autumn.
It is expected that the data overview can be shared with the Indonesian foundation this autumn.
Naar verwachting kan het gegevensoverzicht dit najaar worden gedeeld met de Indonesische stichting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Van Der Werf en Bamenga over de mobilisatie in Venezuela en de veiligheidsontwikkelingen nabij Curaçao, Aruba en Bonaire

Three D66 MPs asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about US naval deployment near Venezuela, its implications for the ABC islands (Cooperative Security Location, Kustwacht, NOTAMs, travel advice, involvement of Aruba and Curaçao) and whether Parliament would be informed. The government answered that the US deployment is nationally directed and the Kingdom is not involved, that existing defence and aviation arrangements remain unchanged, and that it will inform Parliament promptly if the security situation changes.
If the situation in the region leads to a different security situation in the Caribbean part of the Kingdom, the government will inform your House without delay.
Indien de situatie in de regio leidt tot een andere veiligheidssituatie in het Caribisch deel van het Koninkrijk zal de regering uw Kamer daarover onverwijld informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Paulusma en Bamenga over een mogelijk naderend staakt-het-vuren in Gaza

MPs from D66 asked the government about a possible Gaza ceasefire, humanitarian access, the Gaza Humanitarian Foundation model, medical evacuations and dual-use restrictions on prosthetics. The minister answered that Nederland demands unhindered humanitarian access through UN-led channels, rejects the GHF model, and will support medical capacity in the region and the WHO, but does not consider evacuation to the Netherlands desirable at present.
The cabinet cannot verify these figures.
Het kabinet kan deze cijfers niet verifiëren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf, Paternotte en Podt over stikstofbelemmeringen op defensielocaties

MPs from D66 asked the government about nitrogen (stikstof) rules blocking expansion of Dutch military training sites and air bases, including the consequences for NATO readiness and the specific permit barriers at each location. The State Secretary for Defence answered that a TNO study finds the impact on operational readiness 'enormous', that defence sites mostly lack nature permits, that permit procedures are slow and complex with no generic defence exemption under the Habitat and Birds Directives, and that the ministerial commission and an EU defence readiness omnibus are being used to find solutions.
The management summary of the TNO study and the Haskoning research report were sent to your House on 3 July 2025.
Het managementuittreksel van het onderzoek van TNO en het onderzoeksrapport van Haskoning zijn op 3 juli 2025 aan uw Kamer verzonden

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Paternotte, Boswijk, Dassen, Dobbe en Teunissen over het artikel 'Europese Unie stelt in gelekt rapport zèlf oorlogsmisdaden in Gaza vast, toch blijft het stil over sancties tegen Is

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about a leaked EU report on alleged war crimes in Gaza and the lack of sanctions against Israel. The minister answered that the report does not itself draw the conclusions, but the government considers bombing civilian objects and starvation as methods of warfare violations of humanitarian law, has initiated an evaluation of Israel's compliance with Article 2 of the Association Agreement, and supports suspending the trade part of the agreement.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Piri, Boswijk, Dobbe, Teunissen en Dassen over het bericht ‘EU-ministers nemen geen maatregelen tegen Israël, houden opties op tafel’

MPs asked the Foreign Minister what the Netherlands pushed for at the 15 July EU Foreign Affairs Council on Israel, whether it proposed sanctions, what concrete humanitarian aid commitments were agreed with Israel, and what action follows if Israel fails to comply. The minister answered that the Netherlands backed implementation of the EU-Israel humanitarian access deal, announced national measures (ambassador summoned, two ministers declared persona non grata, support for trade measures and a third sanctions package), and listed the agreed access commitments, though the answer on the source of the truck figures was vague and did not address military operations.
As announced in the letter to the House of 28 July, the cabinet has decided to proceed to concrete measures.
Zoals aangekondigd in de Kamerbrief van 28 juli jl. heeft het kabinet besloten over te gaan tot concrete maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Paternotte en Boswijk over een lijst met mogelijke sanctiemaatregelen tegen Israël

MPs Piri, Paternotte and Boswijk asked the government about a list of possible sanctions against Israel leaked to the press, including whether arms and national boycott options were considered, whether the list would be shared with parliament, and why the military export reporting was delayed and which dual-use licences remain valid. The minister confirmed the list was shared with participants, refused to disclose the internal note citing cabinet unity and diplomatic interests, said the export reports were delayed by workload and published up to May 2025, and argued that a boycott of settlement goods is more effective at EU level.
The cabinet will not share the note prepared for the ministerial consultation with the House and invokes the protection of the unity of cabinet policy and the protection of diplomatic interests.

Het kabinet zal de opgestelde notitie voor het bewindspersonen overleg niet met de Kamer delen en beroept zich daarbij op de bescherming van de eenheid van kabinetsbeleid en de bescherming van diplomatieke belangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe, Piri, Teunissen, Van Baarle, Paternotte en Dassen over het Nederlandse busbedrijf EBS en banden met de illegale bezetting van de Palestijnse Gebieden

MPs asked the government about Dutch bus operator EBS, owned by Israel's Egged Transportation, which the UN lists in connection with settlements, and whether Dutch public money paid through student travel products and provincial concessions amounts to assistance to the occupation. The government confirmed the facts, restated its discouragement policy on economic ties with settlement businesses, said it has no insight into the financial flows between EBS and Egged, and declined to take concrete steps beyond encouraging decentralised authorities to follow the policy.
The cabinet has no insight into the business relationship and financial flows between EBS and Egged Transportation Ltd. and therefore cannot make statements about them.
Het kabinet heeft geen zicht op de zakelijke verhouding en financiële stromen tussen EBS en Egged Transportation Ltd. en kan hier dus geen uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Paternotte over de nieuwe EU strategie voor de Zwarte Zee regio

MPs Boswijk and Paternotte asked about the new EU Black Sea strategy and whether Dutch ports, notably Rotterdam, should build ties with Black Sea ports including Odessa, including on security and a Denmark-style partnership. The minister affirms the strategy's importance, says port cooperation is mainly for port companies and EU channels, and states willingness to facilitate exploratory talks, noting an exploratory meeting already took place and that Dutch support for Ukraine uses bilateral and multilateral channels.
It is further up to the port companies themselves to give shape to port cooperation, such as in the context of port development or pursuing green shipping corridors between ports.
Het is verder aan havenbedrijven zelf om invulling te geven aan havensamenwerking zoals in het kader van havenontwikkeling of inzet op green shipping corridors tussen havens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Boswijk, Van der Lee, Van der Burg en Dassen over Chinese spionage via diplomatieke posten

MPs from several parties asked whether US concerns about Chinese espionage linked to the large Chinese embassy in London also affect the Netherlands, including via financial infrastructure, internet hubs and diplomatic expansion, and whether the EU should adopt joint risk-analysis guidelines for diplomatic buildings. The government answered that it shares the concerns, points to existing measures such as DORA, the Wbni and the forthcoming Cbw, says no Chinese embassy expansion request is pending in the Netherlands and no increase in Chinese diplomats has occurred, and states it will raise China-related issues within the EU.
The cabinet makes no public statements about the investigations or working methods of the services.
Het kabinet doet in het openbaar geen uitspraken over de onderzoeken of werkwijze van de diensten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vijlbrief en Paternotte over het tekort aan studentenhuisvesting in Delft en elders

MPs Vijlbrief and Paternotte asked about a shortage of student housing in Delft and elsewhere, including the threatened loss of student rooms, the effect of the rent freeze, the exclusion of students from the rent allowance (huurtoeslag), falling student purchasing power and rent-regulation rules. The minister responds by pointing to the national student housing action plan, a 25% rise in the WWSO point price, planned temporary contracts and hospitality rental incentives, a new subsidy scheme, and reasons why rent allowance extension is not currently feasible, while deferring several items to future reports.
The current cabinet is continuing this approach.
Het huidige kabinet zet deze aanpak voort.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Piri, Boswijk, Dobbe en Dassen over het bericht ‘Trump wil duizenden illegalen naar Guantánamo Bay sturen, ook Nederlanders’

MPs from D66, GroenLinks-PvdA, CDA, SP and Volt asked the Foreign Minister whether the Dutch government knew of US plans to detain illegal immigrants, including Dutch nationals, at Guantánamo Bay without due process, whether it had contacted the US, whether consular assistance was given, and whether EU partners would press the US. The minister replied that the report appeared premature, that the US had no apparent plans to detain Dutch citizens there, and deferred the remaining questions to the answer to question 1 while promising a reply within the deadline.
There are also no indications that the United States intends to deport Dutch nationals via Guantánamo Bay.
Er zijn ook geen indicaties dat de Verenigde Staten voornemens is Nederlandse staatsburgers uit te zetten via Guantánamo Bay.
Antwoorden op vragen van de leden Dassen, Piri, Paternotte, Dobbe, Teunissen en Van Baarle over het gehouden rondetafelgesprek over de situatie in Gaza en bijbehorende position papers

MPs from Volt, GroenLinks-PvdA, D66, SP, PvdD and DENK asked the Foreign Minister whether there is a serious risk of genocide in Gaza, when the Dutch state became aware of it, and what concrete steps the Netherlands has taken to prevent or end it under the Genocide Convention, including on arms exports, sanctions and an EU association agreement review. The minister answered that the Netherlands is cautious about qualifying situations as genocide, that the duty to prevent arises upon knowledge of a serious risk without a court ruling, and listed diplomatic steps taken such as the EU review of Israel's association agreement, sanctions on two ministers, and the arms export policy, while declining to join the South Africa case.
The Netherlands is generally cautious about qualifying situations as genocide.
Nederland is in de regel terughoudend met het kwalificeren van situaties als genocide.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Dassen, Van der Burg, Paternotte en Piri over het bericht dat Nederland de Russische oorlogskas spekt en mogelijk spionnen binnenlaat

MPs asked the government whether it would press the EU for a full ban on Russian LNG and condensate imports, and act against vessels with Russian crews or ties that may carry Russian intelligence officers into Dutch ports. The minister answered that the EU lacks unanimity for an import ban, that the Commission's RePowerEU roadmap phases out Russian LNG by end-2027, that a national ban is opposed, and that Russian-flagged ships are already barred while sanctioned ships are refused and inspected, but declined to comment on intelligence use of crews.
The cabinet cannot make statements on whether Russia uses the crews of LNG and condensate tankers as cover for Russian intelligence officers.
Het kabinet kan geen uitspraken doen over of Rusland gebruik maakt van bemanning van LNG- en aardgascondensaattankers als dekmantel voor Russische inlichtingenofficieren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Paternotte en Van der Burg over een Nederlands monument ter nagedachtenis aan de Holodomor

MPs asked whether the government would support a Dutch memorial to the Holodomor and attend the annual commemoration, citing Russian denial and the Kremlin's historical revisionism. The minister answered that Russian historical revisionism is opposed where it arises in international fora, that a memorial is not a core task of the ministry and would more likely be an initiative of the Ukrainian community via municipal decision, and that the ambassador in Kyiv represents the Netherlands at the commemoration.
Realising a memorial is not a core task of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
Het realiseren van een monument is geen kerntaak van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Rooderkerk over onverwachte bezuinigingen van een half miljard euro extra op onderwijs in de Voorjaarsnota.

Two D66 MPs asked the education minister why nearly half a billion euros in extra cuts to education were introduced in the spring budget memorandum, given pressure on basic skills, and asked about the effects on pupils losing the education opportunities scheme, higher education funding, vocational practical training, and consistency with earlier parliamentary deals. The minister answered that the net budget rises structurally by about 2 billion euros, that the cuts are offsets within the OCW budget, that the education opportunities scheme is abolished (about 177 million per year) with the government pointing to other basic-skills programmes, and that institutions can absorb the higher education and practical-training reductions.
With this spring budget memorandum, the OCW budget is structurally increased by a net of about 2 billion euros, largely as a result of the fully paid-out wage adjustment.
Met deze Voorjaarsnota wordt er per saldo structureel circa € 2 miljard toegevoegd aan de OCW-begroting, grotendeels als gevolg van de loonbijstelling die volledig wordt uitgekeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over het aangekondigde onderzoek naar de naleving van artikel 2

An MP asks the Foreign Minister why no deadline has been set for the EU review of Israel's compliance with Article 2 of the EU-Israel Association Agreement, what consequences follow if a breach is found, and how credible Dutch positions are without a timeline. The minister replies that the review is for the High Representative and Commission, that the Netherlands will press for urgency ahead of the 23 June Foreign Affairs Council, and that follow-up measures would be proposed to member states if a breach is confirmed, without committing to a fixed deadline.
It is up to the High Representative and the European Commission to carry out the evaluation.
Het is aan de Hoge Vertegenwoordiger en de Europese Commissie om de evaluatie uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Dobbe, Hirsch, Bamenga en Paternotte over het bericht 'Pentagon chief scraps program from first Trump term to boost women in security'

MPs asked the Dutch government whether it would press the United States and other partners to uphold UN Women, Peace and Security resolutions and related treaties after the US scrapped its own WPS programme, and what Netherlands itself will do to fund and implement them. The minister confirmed awareness, said the Netherlands raises these principles bilaterally and multilaterally, noted the US has not ratified CEDAW or the Arms Trade Treaty, and listed existing commitments including a small Syria grant and Defence gender-integration activities without committing to new funding.
The Netherlands speaks out in favour of implementing and complying with international agreements and treaties, both publicly and behind closed doors.
Nederland spreekt zich voor en achter gesloten deuren uit over het belang van implementatie en naleving van internationale afspraken en verdragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Van der Werf en Boswijk over het samen met de Denen direct investeren in de Oekraïense defensie-industrie

MPs Paternotte, Van der Werf and Boswijk asked why the Netherlands did not join Denmark's mechanism for funding Ukrainian defence-industry investment, how much has been contracted, and how it ensures alignment with Ukraine's needs. The minister answered that the Dutch direct-procurement model gives the Netherlands control over the process, that over EUR 1.4 billion has been allocated, that contracts are still in negotiation with no amounts yet, and that answers to individual questions were not provided in time.
It is not yet possible to indicate which amounts are involved.
Het is nog niet mogelijk om aan te geven welke bedragen hiermee gemoeid zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Stultiens en Heite over een vragenlijst van de Amerikaanse overheid

MPs Paternotte, Stultiens and Heite asked the Dutch government about a US federal questionnaire sent to Dutch researchers, probing cooperation with communist or totalitarian parties, gender ideology and benefits to American industry, and about possible US influence on academic freedom. The minister expressed concern, said Dutch institutions must protect academic freedom and that the government would raise the matter with the US and inform parliament before summer, but gave no detail on how many researchers were affected.
Before the summer I will inform your House by letter about academic freedom.
Voor de zomer zal ik uw Kamer informeren middels een brief over academische vrijheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Sneller over de aflevering “Gaby overlijdt, maar familie kan niet rouwen door onze overheid”

MPs Paternotte and Sneller asked about delays in foreign death certificates for Dutch citizens dying abroad and municipalities refusing to register deaths without them. The government answered that municipalities may register deaths on lower-ranked source documents under the BRP Act, that case-by-case judgment is needed, and that guidance will be reiterated to municipalities, without new rules.
Following the broadcast and these parliamentary questions, the NVVB has already brought this to the attention of its members in its newsletter.
Naar aanleiding van de uitzending en deze Kamervragen heeft de NVVB dit in haar nieuwsbrief al onder de aandacht gebracht van haar leden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over het bericht 'EU to roll back Ukraine trade perks to protect its farmers'

An MP asked whether the minister knows of reports that the EU will roll back Ukraine trade concessions to protect its farmers, and whether the minister will press at the Foreign Affairs Council to avoid weakening trade liberalisation as the motion Paternotte/Kamminga requests. The minister confirms awareness, supports deeper reciprocal tariff liberalisation under the Association Agreement as more durable support, and calls for a smooth transition from the autonomous trade measures.
The cabinet supports Ukraine, including economically and in reconstruction.
Het kabinet steunt Oekraïne, ook op economisch gebied en in de wederopbouw.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen, Piri, Boswijk, Teunissen, Paternotte, Dobbe en Van Baarle over het bericht 'No humanitarian aid will enter Gaza, Israel defence Minister says'

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister whether she condemns Israel's blocking of humanitarian aid to Gaza, whether this constitutes collective punishment or a war crime, whether UN Resolution 2417 is being ignored, whether Israel violates the ICJ provisional measures, and whether she will push for EU sanctions. The minister condemns the blockade as contrary to international law, notes the legal framework and Dutch diplomatic steps, and says a review of Israel's compliance with Article 2 of the EU-Israel Association Agreement has been requested, while stating that sanctions require EU unanimity.
The cabinet condemns the blocking of humanitarian aid and basic services such as electricity.
Het kabinet veroordeelt het blokkeren van humanitaire hulp en basisvoorzieningen zoals elektriciteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Paternotte, Boswijk, Dobbe, Dassen, Van Baarle en Teunissen over de catastrofale humanitaire situatie in Gaza

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about the humanitarian catastrophe in Gaza, including whether Israel is starving the population, the risk of famine, the proposal for US-linked security firms to distribute aid, and what the government is doing. The minister answered that Israel's blockade violates international humanitarian law, that the Netherlands has repeatedly urged Israel to lift it and has asked the EU to review Israel's compliance with the Association Agreement, but that it cannot deliver aid by sea or air without Israeli consent.
Pending this, the Netherlands will not agree to extending the EU-Israel Action Plan.
In afwachting hiervan zal Nederland niet instemmen met verlenging van het EU-Israël Actieplan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Paternotte over het leveren van gebruikte visnetten aan Oekraïne

MPs Boswijk and Paternotte asked whether the government would support and remove regulatory obstacles to collecting and exporting used fishing nets to Ukraine for drone protection. The minister replied that defence does not fund civilian initiatives but is open to facilitating transport if Ukraine's defence ministry states a need, and that EU waste rules and extended producer responsibility cannot be unilaterally changed, though nets that reach end-of-waste status may be exported.
The Ministry of Defence is nevertheless open to examining how a contribution could be facilitated, for example for the transport of used fishing nets.
Het Ministerie van Defensie staat evenwel open voor het onderzoeken op welke manier wel een bijdrage gefaciliteerd kan worden, bijvoorbeeld voor het transport van gebruikte visnetten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Burg en Paternotte over het overleg tussen de Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken met de Indiase Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken

MPs Van der Burg and Paternotte asked whether the Foreign Minister's social media post about the meeting with India's foreign minister omitted discussion of critical minerals cooperation, and how India could help limit Chinese influence on critical raw material supply chains. The minister answered that the post was only a fragment, that cooperation on economic security and diversifying dependencies was discussed, that details are confidential, and that the topic will continue to be raised with India.
The confidential nature of such conversations does not sit well with full public disclosure.
Het vertrouwelijke karakter van dergelijke gesprekken verdraagt zich niet goed met een volledige publieke weergave.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Paternotte over de gevolgen van bezuinigingen op onderwijsinstellingen en de gevolgen van de aanpak internationalisering

MPs Jetten and Paternotte asked about layoffs and department closures at Dutch universities (Twente, UCR, Open Universiteit, UvA) linked to budget cuts, the effects on regional functions and technical labour shortages, and the rules on English-language programmes. The minister answers that the layoffs are not directly tied to the cuts, that institutions have autonomy over their choices, that the cuts will not be reconsidered, and that a regional criterion in the internationalisation law and a broader approach to student numbers are planned.
The cabinet stands behind the choices made and considers the budget cuts realistic and feasible.
Het kabinet staat achter de gemaakte keuzes en beschouwt de bezuinigingen als realistisch en uitvoerbaar.
Antwoord op de vragen van leden Van der Werf, Paternotte en Bamenga over het bericht ‘Bonaire bezorgd om militaire dreiging vanuit Venezuela’

Three D66 MPs asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about reports that Bonaire fears a military threat from Venezuela, including whether activity was observed, threat levels, contacts with Venezuela and Bonaire, and protective measures. The minister answered that no recent Venezuelan military activity near Bonaire has been observed, that there is no reason to assume a heightened threat, that routine intelligence monitoring and regional Defence presence continue, and that Parliament will be informed if the situation changes.
If the situation in Venezuela leads to a different security situation in the Caribbean part of the Kingdom, I will, also on behalf of the Minister of Foreign Affairs, inform your House about it.
Indien de situatie in Venezuela leidt tot een andere veiligheidssituatie in het Caribisch deel van het Koninkrijk zal ik mede namens de Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken uw Kamer daarover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Piri over het bericht ‘Netanyahu ondanks arrestatiebevel van strafhof naar Orban in Hongarije’

MPs Paternotte and Piri asked the Foreign Minister whether Hungary breached its Rome Statute duty by not arresting Netanyahu after hosting him despite an ICC warrant, and what consequences and actions the government would take. The minister replied that Hungary remains bound until any withdrawal takes effect, that the matter is for the ICC to decide under Article 87(7), that the government respects ICC independence and will not prejudge it, and that it has already raised the issue with Hungary and in the Foreign Affairs Council.

As the cabinet already reported in its letter of 9 October 2024, all States Parties to the Rome Statute are obliged under the Statute to consider requests for cooperation regarding the arrest and surrender of suspects to the International Criminal Court (ICC).

Zoals het kabinet reeds meldde in de Kamerbrief van 9 oktober 2024, zijn alle verdragspartijen bij het Statuut van Rome op basis van het Statuut verplicht om verzoeken tot samenwerking ten aanzien van de aanhouding en overlevering van verdachten aan het Internationaal Strafhof (ISH) in behandeling te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over het verdwijnen van Radio Free Europe / Radio Liberty

An MP asked the government about the US decision to stop funding Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty and its consequences for independent media and disinformation. The minister acknowledged the loss as a setback, said Russia-controlled media may gain room, and pointed to joint EU and Czech efforts to find alternative funding, without committing to a specific Dutch funding step.
The cabinet is working with other EU member states and like-minded countries to find financial resources that enable RFE/RL and other free media to continue their important work.

Het kabinet zet zich, in samenwerking met andere EU-lidstaten en gelijkgezinde landen, in voor het vinden van financiële middelen die RFE/RL en andere vrije media in staat stellen hun belangrijke werk voort te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over het bericht 'Journalisten die verslag deden onder de ruim 1.100 gearresteerden in Turkije'

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about arrests and attacks on journalists covering protests in Turkey, account blocking, and what the government is doing on press freedom, including Media Freedom Coalition action and emergency visas. The minister answered that press freedom is important, that Dutch diplomatic and multilateral efforts (Council of Europe, bilateral talks, existing funding) are ongoing, that emergency visas are possible only case by case under the Visa Code, and that the requested separate answers before the 10 April debate could not be provided.
Unfortunately, that last part did not succeed.
Dat laatste is helaas niet gelukt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over steun aan Oekraïne

Paternotte (D66) asked the defence and foreign affairs ministers about Dutch medical, training and drone support for Ukraine, including field hospitals, blood plasma, Sanquin knowledge-sharing and an aquadrone. The government answered that it has supplied medical equipment and 33 field hospitals, declined a hospital 'adoption' model and in-country training for now, and said it would not acquire the aquadrone.
We do not intend to organise the support in an 'adoption' form.
Wij zijn niet voornemens om de steun te organiseren in een «adoptie»-vorm.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bamenga, Paternotte, Sneller en Bromet over het voorgenomen staatsbezoek aan Kenia

MPs from D66 and GroenLinks-PvdA asked whether the planned Dutch state visit to Kenya, amid serious human rights violations under President Ruto, would legitimise his government and what concrete steps the government would take. The minister replied that a state visit is not a personal endorsement, that human rights concerns were raised privately with Kenyan authorities and in public signals, and that Nederland will continue joint EU and partner statements.
During the visit I conveyed my concerns about the human rights situation in discussions with my counterpart.
Tijdens het bezoek heb ik mijn zorgen over de mensenrechtensituatie overgebracht in de gesprekken met mijn ambtsgenoot.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Dassen, Boswijk, Paternotte, Teunissen en Ceder over de aanhouding van de burgemeester van Istanbul

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the detention of Istanbul mayor Imamoglu and about a hundred others appears politically motivated, whether it should have consequences, and whether the Netherlands will raise it with Turkey and push for EU measures. The minister supports the EU statement calling for transparency and rule of law, says he raised concerns by phone with his Turkish counterpart and via the ambassador, and notes the EU has postponed thematic consultations with Turkey while it considers whether further measures are appropriate.
It is crucial that the legal process against mayor İmamoğlu and others takes place with transparency.
Het is cruciaal dat het juridische proces tegen burgemeester İmamoğlu en anderen in transparantie plaatsvindt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Boswijk, Van der Burg en Van der Lee over de geheime deportatie van 48 Oeigoeren naar China door de regering van Thailand

MPs from D66, CDA, VVD and GroenLinks-PvdA asked the Foreign Minister about the reported secret deportation of Uyghurs from Thailand to China and what the Dutch government had done to prevent it. The minister confirmed the deportation, said Thailand breached non-refoulement, described diplomatic outreach to Thai and Chinese authorities and EU and UN statements, and said the Dutch embassy in Beijing would monitor the situation.

From the Dutch embassy in Bangkok, the Dutch Permanent Representation to the UN in Geneva and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in The Hague, active outreach was made to the Thai authorities up to the day of deportation.

Vanuit de Nederlandse ambassade in Bangkok, de Nederlandse Permanente Vertegenwoordiging bij de VN in Genève en vanuit het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken in Den Haag is actief outreach gedaan naar de Thaise autoriteiten tot op de dag van uitzetting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Paternotte over de Nederlandse aanwezigheid bij de vergadering van het Verdrag inzake het verbod op kernwapens

MPs Piri and Paternotte asked whether the Netherlands, a non-signatory to the Treaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons, would attend the TPNW states-parties meeting as an observer, as requested by a parliamentary motion. The Minister answered that the Netherlands has no added value from attending, given its strong diplomatic position and existing NPT exchanges, and does not intend to attend.
No. As explained in the cabinet's response to the Van Dijk/Sjoerdsma motion, the cabinet does not consider renewed participation in a TPNW states-parties meeting meaningful.

Nee. Zoals toegelicht in de reactie van het kabinet op de motie Van Dijk/ Sjoerdsma (Kamerstuk 21 501-02, nr. 2497 ), acht het kabinet hernieuwde deelname aan een vergadering van statenpartijen van het TPNW niet zinvol.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Paternotte over het bericht dat westerse scheepseigenaren miljarden verdienden met de verkoop van olietankers aan de Russische schaduwvloot

MPs Boswijk and Paternotte asked the Foreign Minister how Western shipowners could profit billions from selling old tankers to Russia's shadow fleet, how many such ships are sanctioned, and whether sellers face liability. The minister called the sales worrying, said only 19 of the 230 ships are sanctioned, noted that proving sanctions evasion in advance is difficult, and referred enforcement to prosecutors while promising to press for further EU measures.
It is up to the relevant enforcement bodies to determine whether companies have carried out sufficient due diligence.
Het is aan de relevante handhavingsentiteiten om vast te stellen of bedrijven voldoende due-dilligence hebben uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Piri, Boswijk, Dobbe, Teunissen en Eerdmans over het nieuws dat Russische geheim agenten met vissersschepen naar Nederland kunnen reizen

MPs asked whether the NVWA can fully inspect Russian fish imports, impose fines or seize cargo, and whether the government will push for a ban on Russian whitefish, sanctions on Norebo, restrictions on Russian crews and measures against financing of Russia via Dutch ports. The minister answered that inspections are risk-based within EU benchmarks, that the NVWA lacks powers over catch quotas, that no fines were issued, and that the government favours exploring a whitefish import ban while leaving options open and withholding details of its negotiating position.
It is not in the interest of the Dutch negotiating position, nor of the surprise effect necessary for sanctions to be effective, to go into more detail on the Dutch negotiating position.

Het is niet in het belang van de Nederlandse onderhandelingspositie en van de voor de effectiviteit van sancties noodzakelijke verrassingseffect om in meer detail op de Nederlandse onderhandelingspositie in te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Van den Burg, Teunissen, Ceder, Boswijk, Van der Lee en Kahraman over de acuut dreigende uitzetting van Oeigoeren in Thailand

Seven MPs asked the ministers about the imminent deportation of 48 Uyghurs held in Thailand to China and what the Netherlands was doing to prevent it. The Foreign Minister answered that the Netherlands has urged Thailand, bilaterally and within the EU, to respect non-refoulement and not deport the group, and is monitoring third-country resettlement options.
The Netherlands has made the urgent appeal to the Thai authorities, orally and in writing, both bilaterally and within the EU, not to extradite the 48 Uyghurs.

Nederland heeft op verschillende manieren, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk en zowel bilateraal als in EU-verband de dringende oproep aan de Thaise autoriteiten gedaan om de 48 Oeigoeren niet uit te leveren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Paternotte over het ontzeggen van toegang aan de Brits-Palestijnse dokter Ghassan Abu-Sittah tot het Schengengebied

MPs Piri and Paternotte asked why the government did not grant an exception to the German entry ban for British-Palestinian surgeon Ghassan Abu-Sittah, and whether Dutch obligations under the host-state agreements with the ICC and OPCW apply to him as a witness or expert. The government declined to share information on individual cases, said he is no longer listed in the SIS, and stated that the ICC and OPCW alone decide who qualifies as a witness or expert, so it commits to no action.
On behalf of the Minister of Asylum and Migration, the cabinet as a rule does not share information about individual cases with the House.
Namens de Minister van Asiel en Migratie deelt het kabinet in de regel geen informatie over individuele zaken met de Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Van der Wal, Diederik van Dijk en Mohandis over de digitale openbaarmaking van het Centraal Archief Bijzondere Rechtspleging

MPs from D66, VVD, SGP and GroenLinks-PvdA asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science when and how the Central Archive of Special Jurisdiction (CABR) can be searched online by name of war victims and suspected collaborators, and why only names but not the underlying dossiers were published. The Minister answers that a temporary searchable facility at the National Archives is being prepared, a bill creating a legal basis for balancing privacy against access will go to consultation by end of March, and that the name index must be public as the only way to request dossiers, despite Data Protection Authority concerns.

I intend to put a draft bill out for consultation before the end of March that will create the legal basis, missed by the Data Protection Authority, for access to archives containing ordinary, special and criminal personal data.

Ik wil vóór eind maart een conceptwetsvoorstel in consultatie brengen die de door de Autoriteit persoonsgegevens (AP) gemiste grondslag zal creëren voor toegang tot archieven met gewone, bijzondere en strafrechtelijke persoonsgegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Klaver en Boswijk over de voorgenomen krimp van EU-vertegenwoordigingen in het buitenland

MPs Paternotte, Klaver and Boswijk asked whether the planned Commission cut of EU delegation staff abroad, and the Dutch cuts, weaken EU diplomatic reach. The minister declined to comment on leaked documents, said the HR/VP decides on delegations, and said the Dutch cuts stay with specifics to be sent in spring.
For this reason, the cabinet does not wish to make substantive statements about the leaked document to which POLITICO refers.
Het kabinet wenst om die reden geen inhoudelijke uitspraken te doen over het gelekte document waarnaar POLITICO verwijst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over de tegemoetkoming studievoucher voor leenstelstelstudenten

An MP asks why university students with only a bachelor's degree under the loan system are excluded from the roughly 2,000 euro study voucher compensation while HBO students are not, and whether this is fair. The minister replies that the master's-degree requirement was set in 2015 and confirmed in 2023, that widening it would cost about 44 million euros and need legislation, and rejects changing it for policy stability reasons.
Reweighing the target group definition (for a third time) I consider undesirable in the context of stable government policy.
Het opnieuw wegen van de afbakening van de doelgroep (voor een derde keer) vind ik in het kader van stabiel overheidsbeleid onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Sneller over de beantwoording van vragen over het bericht over gedoe rond vergadering van pro-Palestinastudenten

MPs Paternotte and Sneller asked whether universities and universities of applied sciences must keep security measures within fundamental rights, including photographing protesting students, covert listening and guards at meetings. Minister Bruins answered that institutions bear primary responsibility, that the minister has a stelselverantwoordelijkheid, that existing law and the joint protest guidelines suffice, and that complaints should go to the institution or the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens.
As the minister responsible for the system, I have no involvement in the institution-specific considerations institutions make when developing and implementing their security policy.
Als stelselverantwoordelijk Minister heb ik geen bemoeienis met de instellingsspecifieke afwegingen die instellingen maken bij het ontwikkelen en uitvoeren van hun veiligheidsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Van der Burg, Van der Lee en Boswijk over de situatie van Oeigoeren in Thailand

MPs from D66, VVD, GroenLinks-PvdA and CDA asked the Foreign Minister about the detention in Thailand of over 48 Uyghurs fleeing China, and whether Thailand's threatened deportation breaches non-refoulement. The minister replied that the Netherlands urges third countries to respect non-refoulement, raises the case with UNHCR and Thai authorities privately rather than publicly, and answered every question on substance.
For now, the considered approach is not to publicly address UNHCR and to continue regular contacts with UNHCR on this matter.
Vooralsnog is de afweging om UNHCR niet publiekelijk aan te spreken en in te blijven zetten op de regelmatige contacten met UNHCR hierover.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Boswijk over het bericht dat scheepsbouwer Damen schepen opknapt die Russisch gas vervoeren

Two MPs from D66 and CDA asked ministers whether Dutch shipbuilder Damen's maintenance of Russian LNG-transport vessels breaches EU sanctions and how the government will tighten measures against Russian LNG imports. The ministers answered that sanctions prohibit servicing vessels linked to Russian entities unless they are used to evade sanctions, that enforcement follows signals of breaches, that the Netherlands pushes for an EU roadmap to phase out Russian gas and LNG, and that it will press for stronger measures in the next sanctions package, but they gave no case-specific details.

The cabinet cannot go into individual cases, but in general supplying parts and/or carrying out maintenance (technical assistance) to vessels of Russian persons and entities or vessels used in Russia is prohibited.

Het kabinet kan niet ingaan op individuele gevallen, maar in zijn algemeenheid geldt dat het leveren van onderdelen en/of uitvoeren van onderhoud (technische bijstand) aan schepen van Russische personen en entiteiten of schepen die in Rusland gebruikt worden verboden is
Antwoord op vragen vragen de leden Kostić, Ram, Graus, Hirsch, Paternotte, Dobbe, Koekkoek en Eerdmans over de wrede jacht op kangoeroes en de Nederlandse betrokkenheid daarbij

MPs from several parties asked the government about the cruel kangaroo hunt, Dutch imports of kangaroo meat and leather, and calls for an import ban. The Staatssecretaris answered that animal welfare concerns are shared, that Australia regulates its own hunting, that an import ban can only be set at EU level and must comply with WTO rules, and that a plan under a prior motion is being prepared; several answers were deferred.
Banning the import of a product from a country outside the European Union, in this case Australia, can only be arranged at European level.
Import van een product verbieden dat uit een land komt van buiten de Europese Unie, in dit geval Australië, kan alleen op Europees niveau geregeld worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over het bericht dat Viktor Orbán premier Netanyahu wil uitnodigen in Hongarije

An MP asked the government whether Hungary's announced invitation to Netanyahu and its stated intention to ignore ICC arrest warrants undermines the Court, and whether the Netherlands would raise this at the Assembly of States Parties. The Minister answered that the Rome Statute does not prohibit such invitations, that the government leaves Orbán's statements to him, and that the Netherlands has repeatedly urged all states parties to cooperate with the Court, without committing to a formal step against Hungary.
The authority of the ICC is firmly established and the obligations under the Rome Statute are clear.
Het gezag en de autoriteit van het ISH zijn stevig gevestigd en de verplichtingen onder het Statuut van Rome zijn helder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Paternotte over VN-onderzoek in Libanon

MPs Dobbe and Paternotte asked the Foreign Minister about the November 2024 Israel-Hezbollah ceasefire and compliance, promoting justice and independent international monitoring in Lebanon, and whether the Netherlands would back a UN Human Rights Council special session on violations by all parties. The minister described the ceasefire terms and monitoring mechanism, said Nederland would raise investigating alleged violations of humanitarian law at the Foreign Affairs Council, and declined for now to initiate a special session because Lebanon had not requested one.

In accordance with the Paternotte et al. motion, I will stress at the Foreign Affairs Council of Monday 16 December 2024 the importance of thorough investigation into alleged violations of international humanitarian law.
26 ) zal ik tijdens de Raad Buitenlandse Zaken van maandag 16 december 2024 het belang van gedegen onderzoek naar vermeende schendingen van het humanitair oorlogsrecht onderstrepen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Sneller over het bericht ‘Gedetineerde uit De Westereen mocht niet in het Fries met beppe bellen’

MPs Paternotte and Sneller asked whether a detainee was wrongly barred from calling his dementia-stricken grandmother in Frisian, and whether Frisian speakers' language rights are being respected in detention. The minister declined to comment on the individual case, said language restrictions can apply for security monitoring reasons, and noted that the appeals judge found refusing a Frisian interpreter reasonable.
I will not go into individual cases.
Ik ga niet in op individuele gevallen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten, Krul, Paternotte, Stultiens, Kostić, Beckerman, Eerdmans, Dassen, Ergin, Stoffer en Ceder over het bericht 'Bezorgdheid om bezuinigingsplannen onderwijs: 'Maakt Nederland op lange

MPs from several parties asked the government about the education, research and innovation budget cuts, their effect on the economy, productivity, startups, internships in care and agriculture innovation. The minister answered that the cuts were a political trade-off, that the government cannot reliably model long-term growth effects, and that a number of impacts cannot be quantified in advance.
It is not possible to give a precise estimate of the consequences of this for welfare.
Het is niet mogelijk om een precieze inschatting te geven van de gevolgen hiervan op de welvaart.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Paternotte over de aanbesteding van rechtsbijstand aan Nederlandse ter doodveroordeelden

MPs Ellian and Paternotte asked why the tender for legal aid to Dutch nationals facing the death penalty abroad was split into lots, why a English organisation could win, and whether a Dutch organisation should be required. Minister Veldkamp answered that the split aims at more expertise and redundancy, that local foreign lawyers are essential for death penalty cases, and that the Dutch-language support role lies with consular staff and Dutch-speaking subsidy partners.
Specific knowledge, experience and a network relating to that local legal area and good communication channels in the detention country were the primary considerations in this tender.
Specifieke kennis, ervaring en een netwerk met betrekking tot dat lokale rechtsgebied en een goede communicatielijn in het betreffende detentieland, hebben voorop gestaan bij deze aanbesteding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Podt over het kidnappen van Turkse burgers in Kenia

MPs Paternotte and Podt asked about the abduction of seven Turkish refugees in Nairobi, risks of refoulement and political punishment in Turkey, transnational repression of Gülen movement members, and whether a new country report on Turkey would be requested. The minister condemned the refoulement, said the ambassador raised it with Kenya, noted Gülen-linked profiles are treated as a risk profile in asylum policy, and committed to a new Algemeen Ambtsbericht Turkije by end of February 2025.
I cannot make statements about individual cases.
Ik kan geen uitspraken doen over individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Boswijk en Paternotte over de massadeportatie van Krim-Tataren door de Sovjet-Unie in 1944 als genocide erkennen

MPs Boswijk and Paternotte asked whether the Netherlands will recognise the 1944 Soviet deportation of Crimean Tatars as genocide, citing Estonia's parliamentary recognition and other countries' positions. Minister Veldkamp answered that the government is cautious about labelling events genocide, that international courts and UN findings are leading, and that he will not ask the CAVV for further advice, though he acknowledges the suffering.
In light of the above, the Dutch government takes a cautious stance when qualifying certain events as genocide.
In het licht van het bovenstaande stelt de Nederlandse regering zich terughoudend op bij het kwalificeren van bepaalde gebeurtenissen als genocide.
