Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Paternotte en Van der Burg over het bericht dat Nederlandse landbouwbedrijven die subsidie ontvangen om Oekraïne te helpen met de wederopbouw tegelijkertijd zakendoenin Rusland

MPs Boswijk, Paternotte and Van der Burg asked whether Dutch farm firms receiving Ukraine reconstruction subsidies also trade with Russia, and whether RVO checks this and should exclude such firms. The government says it does not comment on individual firms, that unsanctioned trade with Russia is not currently grounds for exclusion, and that it is studying adding such an exclusion to the Ukraine Partnership Facility subsidy scheme and considering further EU sanctions on agricultural goods.
In addition, the cabinet is examining whether unsanctioned trade with Russia can be added as a ground for exclusion from the subsidy scheme for the Ukraine Partnership Facility (UPF).
Daarnaast onderzoekt het kabinet of ongesanctioneerde handel met Rusland als uitsluitingsgrond toegevoegd kan worden aan de subsidieregeling voor de Ukraine Partnership Facility (UPF)
Antwoord op van de leden Boswijk en Paternotte over het bericht dat “stokoude, slecht verzekerde tankers met Russische olie meermaals per dag langs de Nederlandse kust varen”

MPs Boswijk and Paternotte asked about reports that old, poorly insured tankers carrying Russian oil pass the Dutch coast hundreds of times, raising pollution risk, possible sabotage use, liability, legal options, sanctions effectiveness and oil refining loopholes. The minister replied that the Netherlands cannot block such vessels in international waters and relies on port state control, IMO and IOPC Fund measures, EU sanctions listings and continued work on sanctions evasion, while giving only general answers on future sanctions proposals.
It is not in the interest of the negotiations or the Dutch negotiating position to go further into detail on concrete proposals.
7 Het is echter niet in het belang van de onderhandelingen en de Nederlandse onderhandelingspositie om verder in detail te gaan over concrete voorstellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rooderkerk en Paternotte over de niet ingevulde bezuiniging op het basis- en voortgezet onderwijs en het mbo

D66 MPs Rooderkerk and Paternotte asked why the education subsidy cut (subsidietaakstelling) was booked on primary, secondary and vocational education budgets without concrete measures, which initiatives are affected, and why the cut was not allocated in detail. Minister Bruins explained the provisional booking was a deliberate technical choice, confirmed that several named organisations and internship funding are not cut in substance, but declined to give some details, deferring them to a forthcoming letter and amendment note.
The fact that subsidy budgets in the draft budget were reduced by such large amounts, ahead of an amendment note with the structural allocation of the cut, raises many questions.

Het feit dat subsidiebudgetten in de Ontwerpbegroting met dergelijke grote bedragen zijn verlaagd, vooruitlopend op een nota van wijziging met structurele invulling van de taakstelling, roept veel vragen op.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Krul, Stultiens, Kostić en Beckerman over het bericht 'Juristen: regeerprogramma op meerdere punten niet rechtsstatelijk'

Five MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how he views a legal commission's finding that cutting higher-education funding agreements unilaterally breaches the rule-of-law principle of a reliable government, and whether he would share the internal advice and memos behind the coalition programme before a committee debate. The minister rejects the commission's view, says the budget legislature sets annual funding and the agreement is not the legal basis, and refuses to share internal advice and memos under the principle of cabinet unity.
I am not, because the cabinet does not share internal advice and memos relating to the drafting of the coalition programme, on the basis of cabinet unity.
Dat ben ik niet, omdat het kabinet geen ambtelijke adviezen en nota’s deelt die zien op het opstellen van het Regeerprogramma, op grond van eenheid kabinetsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf, Paternotte en Sneller over het bericht «Rusland bespioneert systematisch onze wateren»

Three D66 MPs asked the government about reports of systematic Russian espionage and sabotage preparation in the North Sea, including legal options, coordination, protection measures, AIS switch-offs and oversight. The government answered that the threat is current, cited new protection measures and international cooperation, but declined to share intelligence assessments, case numbers or diplomatic communications.
The cabinet does not make public statements about the knowledge level, methods or sources of the MIVD and AIVD.

Over het kennisniveau, de werkwijze of de bronnen van de Militaire Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdienst (MIVD) en de Algemene Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdienst (AIVD) doet het kabinet in het openbaar geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over het bericht ‘Palestine to seek end to ‘unlawful’ Israeli occupation within 12 months at UN

MP Paternotte asked the Foreign Minister whether he knows of the Palestinian plan for a UN General Assembly resolution demanding Israel end its unlawful occupation within twelve months, how the Netherlands views this in light of the ICJ advisory opinion, and whether voting against would undermine Dutch credibility, and asked for answers before the vote. The minister confirmed awareness, said the ICJ opinion requires Israel to end its unlawful presence while the Netherlands calls on Israel to comply, explained that the Netherlands abstained for several reasons with reference to an explanation of vote, said the government values the ICJ opinion, and stated that answers could not be given within the shortened deadline.
It has not proven possible to answer the questions within a shortened deadline.
Het is niet mogelijk gebleken om de vragen binnen een verkorte termijn te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over de gang van zaken bij omroep Ongehoord Nederland, naar aanleiding van antwoorden op eerdere vragen

An MP asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science when the media regulator (Commissariaat voor de Media) informed her that it was closely investigating Ongehoord Nederland, which elements are involved, when the regulator can intervene if a supervisory board fails to act, and whether the MP's information right covers reported changes in the duties of a former managing director's daughter. The minister answers that the regulator notified her on 14 August 2024, lists the integrity, social safety, journalistic quality and governance issues, says the regulator decides on intervention and that the ledenraad also has a role, and declines to confirm the factual question because the regulator is still investigating, while promising to request the information from the regulator and inform parliament.
I could not and cannot answer the factual question because I simply did not know and still do not know exactly what happened.
Ik kon en kan u geen antwoord geven op de genoemde feitelijke vraag omdat ik gewoonweg niet wist en ook nu niet weet wat er precies is gebeurd.
Antwoord op de leden Paternotte en Bamenga over het bericht ‘Chinese luchtvaartmaatschappijen stunten met goedkope vliegtickets op de Europese markt omdat zij over Rusland kunnen blijven vliegen.’

D66 MPs asked whether Chinese and other non-EU airlines flying over Russia gain cost advantages over EU carriers, whether this poses a safety risk, and whether the government will restrict such overflights or seek EU or ICAO action. The minister confirmed these airlines use Russian airspace and an unfair advantage is possible, but said EU law does not allow banning them, that non-discriminatory charges are barred under the Chicago Convention, and that ICAO cannot impose such sanctions.
However, it turns out that it is legally not possible to prohibit airlines from countries that may still operate via Russian airspace from conducting flights to and from the European Union (EU).

Het blijkt echter juridisch niet mogelijk om luchtvaartmaatschappijen uit landen die nog wel via het Russisch luchtruim mogen opereren te verbieden om vluchten van en naar de Europese Unie (EU) uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Vijlbrief over de financiële positie van studenten

MPs Paternotte and Vijlbrief asked the government about student financial pressure: whether to lower interest on student loans, avoid cutting the basic grant, drop the long-study fine, and extend the supplementary grant to mbo students. The minister answered that there is no room for further measures, that the temporary grant increase ends and a higher basic grant cannot be applied retroactively, and that a second loan compensation of 1.4 billion euro is planned.
That is why this cabinet has chosen to invest 1.4 billion euro one-off to raise the compensation for student-loan-system students.
Daarom heeft dit kabinet ervoor gekozen om incidenteel € 1,4 miljard in te zetten voor het verhogen van de tegemoetkoming van leenstelselstudenten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over het bericht ‘West funding Putin’s soldiers with growing Russian fuel purchases'

An MP asked whether EU and Dutch imports of Turkish-refined Russian oil undermine sanctions and whether the minister would press Turkey, sanction Turkish refineries and investigate Dutch buyers. The minister answered that the data are unverified, that Turkish refining of Russian crude does not breach EU sanctions, and that no Dutch-buyer investigation or refinery listing is planned, while the cabinet keeps pushing economic pressure on Russia.
Turkish companies and the refineries involved that buy crude oil products of origin, refine them into oil products and then sell them do not thereby violate EU sanctions.
Turkse bedrijven en betrokken raffinaderijen die van oorsprong ruwe aardolieproducten inkopen, deze raffineren tot aardolieproducten en vervolgens verkopen, overtreden daarmee geen EU-sancties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Piri, Boswijk en Ceder over de interne communicatie en adviezen met betrekking tot de overbrenging van Afghaanse bewakers.

MPs from D66, GroenLinks-PvdA, CDA and ChristenUnie asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs, Defence and Asylum and Migration to send all internal communication and advice on the decision not to transfer Afghan guards to the Netherlands. The ministers respond that they partially meet the request by providing the official advice drafted since the new cabinet took office.
We partially meet your request by providing the official advice drafted since the new cabinet took office regarding the transfer of Afghan guards.

Wij komen gedeeltelijk tegemoet aan uw verzoek door de ambtelijke adviezen te verstrekken die zijn opgesteld sinds het aantreden van het nieuwe kabinet met betrekking tot de overbrenging van Afghaanse bewakers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over het artikel “UT grijpt rigoureus in, mogelijk ruim 500 banen op de tocht”

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the University of Twente's cost-cutting reorganisation, minimum enrolment thresholds, programme closures, research impacts, regional positioning, the long-study fine and crisis organisations at other institutions. The minister answered that institutions have spending autonomy and are accountable to their internal supervisory and participatory bodies rather than to him, gave partial substantive answers on language rules and research funding, and declined to monitor other institutions' reorganisations.
They do not account for this to me, but to the participatory bodies and internal supervision.
Hierover verantwoorden zij zich niet richting mij, maar richting de medezeggenschap en het intern toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Van der Burg, Boswijk, Dobbe, Teunissen en Dassen over het bericht “Rusland zet onafhankelijke krant The Moscow Times op zwarte lijst”

MPs from several parties asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Asylum and Migration about Russia placing the independent Moscow Times on a blacklist and the risks to Russian journalists working for it. The minister confirmed awareness of the report and said that emergency visas are possible in exceptional cases within existing policy frameworks, reaffirming support for press freedom.
This entails that within existing policy frameworks, and carefully tested against the Visa Code, visas can in exceptional cases be issued where there are compelling or humanitarian reasons.

Daar hoort bij dat binnen de bestaande beleidskaders, en daarbij zorgvuldig getoetst aan de Visumcode, het in uitzonderlijke gevallen mogelijk is visa te verstrekken als daar zwaarwegende of humanitaire redenen voor zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Piri, Kahraman, Paternotte, Dobbe, Van Campen en Ceder over het vredesproces tussen Armenië en Azerbeidzjan

MPs asked the government about the Armenia-Azerbaijan peace process, including the trilateral meeting in Washington, Azerbaijan's demand to amend Armenia's constitution, and what the Netherlands could do to speed up a deal. The minister said the government urges both sides toward a durable agreement based on mutual recognition of territorial integrity, declined to comment publicly on negotiating positions, and noted EUMA's de-escalating role and a mandate running to February 2025.
However, it is not in the interest of the negotiating parties to publicly address their negotiating positions in this answer.
Het is echter niet in het belang van de onderhandelende partijen om in deze beantwoording publiekelijk in te gaan op de onderhandelingsposities van de partijen bij de vredesbesprekingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Paternotte over het nieuws dat de Israëlische regering Noorse diplomaten gaat uitwijzen na de Noorse erkenning van Palestina

MPs Paternotte and Piri asked Foreign Minister Veldkamp about Israel's decision to withdraw accreditation from Norwegian diplomats after Norway recognised Palestine, including whether it obstructs ICC proceedings and whether the Netherlands will raise it at the EU Foreign Affairs Council. The minister called the Israeli decision unwise, said he had raised concerns bilaterally with Israel's foreign minister, and gave substantive but largely non-committal answers on Israel's compliance with international law.
It is not for me to explain why Israel has taken this step.
Het is niet aan mij om uit te leggen waarom Israël hiertoe is overgegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vijlbrief, Paternotte, Rooderkerk, Paulusma en Sneller  over de btw-verhogingen op boeken, cultuur, sport en logies

D66 MPs asked the government what it aims to achieve by raising VAT on books, newspapers, culture, sport and accommodation, and about impact analyses, exemptions, legal risks, household purchasing power, sector and education effects, regional effects and the 40-organisation appeal. The state secretary answers that the rate change yields about 2.3 billion euros structurally, that no specific impact analysis was done and none is planned (only monitoring), that some reduced-rate categories are kept for policy-weighing reasons, and that most distributional, sectoral and regional effects cannot be quantified.
I do not intend to carry out a further impact analysis, but the effect of the tariff increase will be monitored.
Ik ben niet voornemens om een nadere impactanalyse uit te voeren, wel zal het effect van de tariefsverhoging worden gemonitord.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal, Boswijk, Paternotte en Rooderkerk over de stijgende invoer van Russisch gas

MPs asked whether EU imports of Russian gas are rising, whether this creates dependence and vulnerability, whether cheap Russian gas undermines alternatives, and what measures the EU could take. The minister acknowledged a slight rise in early 2024 but said Russian shares have fallen sharply since 2021, outlined EU phase-out steps and Dutch proposals for a roadmap, while declining to provide a list of affected projects because the government lacks access to market parties' data.
Such an overview cannot be provided, because the Dutch government has no insight into the projects of market parties and their economic feasibility.
Een dergelijk overzicht is niet te geven, omdat de Nederlandse overheid geen inzage heeft in de projecten van marktpartijen en de economische haalbaarheid daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Bamenga, Becker en Brekelmans over het bericht 'Rwandese ambassade in Den Haag intimideert en bedreigt critici van regime-Kagame in Nederland'

MPs from D66 and VVD asked the ministers about reports that the Rwandan embassy in The Hague intimidated and threatened critics of the Kagame regime, including allegations of plotted assassinations, surveillance of demonstrators, and the role of the 1F procedure and Dutch rule-of-law aid. The minister answered that the ambassador enjoys immunity, that the government condemns foreign interference and has summoned the ambassador, that OM and police handle prosecution, that Dutch rule-of-law aid totalled EUR 144 million and was positively assessed, and that a more intensive anti-interference approach is underway with further letters promised.
It should be noted that the ambassador in the Netherlands enjoys inviolability and immunity, which stands in the way of (supporting) an investigation.
Daarbij moet worden opgemerkt dat de ambassadeur in Nederland onschendbaarheid en immuniteit geniet hetgeen (het ondersteunen van) een onderzoek in de weg staat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Vijlbrief over het bericht ‘Influencers zamelen via Nederland geld in voor uitrusting Russische militairen’

Two D66 MPs asked whether crowdfunding via Dutch platform Boosty for equipping Russian soldiers constitutes sanctions evasion, about the corporate ownership chain, and what the government will do to deter sanctions evasion via the Netherlands. Minister Veldkamp replied that the government cannot comment on individual cases, that sanctions enforcement is for courts, supervisors or the prosecutor, and that the government raises signals with authorities and works through existing coordination platforms, without committing to new concrete measures.
The cabinet cannot publicly comment on individual cases.
Het kabinet kan in het openbaar niet ingaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Van der Burg en Van der Lee over het proces tegen Jimmy Lai, hoofdredacteur van de voorheen grootste vrije krant in Hongkong

MPs Paternotte, Van der Burg and Van der Lee asked the Foreign Minister about delays in the trial of Jimmy Lai, the erosion of rights in Hong Kong under the 1984 Sino-British Declaration and the ICCPR, and whether the Netherlands would join calls for his release, the Council of the EU agenda, and the matter being raised. The minister answered that Netherlands shares concern and speaks out with the EU and like-minded states, attends the trials, but will not issue a separate statement or put the case on the Foreign Affairs Council agenda for now.
At this moment I therefore do not intend to put this case on the agenda of the Foreign Affairs Council.
Op dit moment ben ik daarom niet van plan deze zaak op de agenda van de Raad Buitenlandse Zaken te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans, Becker, Erkens, Paternotte en Bamenga over ‘het bericht dat de nieuwe partij NL Plan steunt op organisaties verbonden aan de Chinese Communistische Partij’

MPs from VVD and D66 asked ministers about reports that the new party NL Plan received support from organisations linked to the Chinese Communist Party, and about foreign interference and the effectiveness of the ban on foreign donations under the Dutch party financing law. The minister answered that NL Plan reported no donations above the threshold, that enforcement and oversight of the ban are still being assessed, and that a study on Chinese interference and a new political parties law are in preparation.

I would like to refer to the extensive media coverage of the recently arrested employee of German AfD lead candidate Maximilian Krah, who allegedly spied for China, and to the Belgian politician Filip de Winter, who allegedly worked for years on behalf of the Chinese Communist Party.

Ik verwijs hier graag naar de uitgebreide berichtgeving in de media over de recent gearresteerde medewerker van de Duitse AfD-lijsttrekker Maximilian Krah die gespioneerd zou hebben voor China en over de Belgische politicus Filip de Winter die jarenlang in opdracht van de Chinese Communistische Partij gewerkt zou hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over de gang van zaken bij omroep Ongehoord Nederland

An MP asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how she views mutual accusations of racism, antisemitism, and misconduct at Ongehoord Nederland, and about the director's conduct, the appointment of a relative, the board's role and alleged editorial instructions. The minister mostly declines to act, saying the Raad van Toezicht and the Commissariaat voor de Media are responsible and that the broadcaster must handle its own investigations.
It is up to the Supervisory Board as employer to act, and up to the Commissariaat voor de Media to supervise.
Het is hier aan de Raad van Toezicht als werkgever om op te treden en aan het Commissariaat voor de Media (hierna: commissariaat) om toezicht te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Bamenga over de procedure van Nederland en Australië tegen Rusland bij ICAO ten gevolge van de aanslag op vlucht MH17

MPs Paternotte and Bamenga asked whether Russia's withdrawal from the ICAO proceedings over MH17 is sabotage, what steps the government will take, whether Russia's voting rights should be suspended, and whether the issue will be raised at the current ICAO Council meeting. The government regrets Russia's withdrawal, says the Netherlands and Australia will pursue the case and asked the Council to decide in their favour, and states that suspending voting rights requires a finding of a Chicago Convention violation, which the withdrawal alone is not, though the claim already requested such suspension.
The Netherlands and Australia are determined to pursue the proceedings in order to achieve truth-finding, justice and accountability.
Nederland en Australië zijn vastbesloten de procedure door te zetten, om waarheidsvinding, gerechtigheid en rekenschap te bewerkstelligen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Van der Werf en Paternotte over het bericht dat producten van in Nederland gevestigde fabrikanten nog steeds worden aangetroffen in Russische wapens

MPs Boswijk, Van der Werf and Paternotte asked the government about reports that microchips from Dutch manufacturers such as NXP and Nexperia still appear in Russian weapons, and how this can happen despite sanctions. The minister confirms the scale of the problem, explains that diversion occurs through intermediaries in third countries, and outlines EU sanctions measures and Dutch enforcement efforts while withholding recent trade data for sensitivity reasons.
Because of the sensitivity, the cabinet makes no public statements about its current information position on Russian imports of sanctioned goods.
Omwille van de gevoeligheid doet het kabinet in het openbaar geen uitspraken over de huidige informatiepositie rondom Russische import van gesanctioneerde goederen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Boswijk over de olieramp door een Houthi-aanval op olietanker Chios Lion

MPs Paternotte and Boswijk asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers about the potential environmental damage from a Houthi attack on the tanker Chios Lion, its effect on Operations Prosperity Guardian and Aspides, and whether the EU or Netherlands should send a cleanup vessel. The minister replied that the risk of damage was limited, no military obstruction exists, Aspides has no mandate for oil cleanup, and no EU contribution appears necessary.
Cleaning up an oil spill does not fall within the mandate of EU operation Aspides.
Het opruimen van een olievlek behoort niet tot het mandaat van EU-operatie Aspides.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Piri, Boswijk, Teunissen en Dassen over het bericht ‘Nederland stuurt toch minister naar Hongarije’

MPs from D66, GroenLinks-PvdA, CDA, PvdD and Volt asked whether the government would send ministers to informal EU Council meetings in Hungary after PM Orbán's Moscow visit, and how this relates to EU sanctions and Hungary's presidency. Minister Veldkamp answered that the government condemned Orbán's visit, that Nederland does not undermine sanctions, and that after the Hoge Vertegenwoordiger moved the informal meetings to Brussels no ministerial delegation will go to Budapest.
The Netherlands is not undermining sanctions.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over het bericht 'Medewerkers Ongehoord Nederland ’stiekem gefilmd’ op redactie: ’Het overschrijdt alle grenzen’'

An MP asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reports that staff at public broadcaster Ongehoord Nederland were secretly filmed in the newsroom, and about integrity and social safety in public broadcasting. The minister calls covert filming unacceptable, says employers are responsible, and points to the Commissariaat voor de Media, which has the signal under consideration, and to the NPO's action plan, without committing to a direct conversation with the broadcaster.
The Commissariaat voor de Media supervises compliance with the Mediawet 2008, the Beleidsregels governance en interne beheersing 2017 and the Gedragscode Integriteit Publieke Omroepen.
Het Commissariaat voor de Media houdt toezicht op de naleving van de Mediawet 2008, de Beleidsregels governance en interne beheersing 2017 en de Gedragscode Integriteit Publieke Omroepen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Podt over het bericht 'Hoger onderwijs onbereikbaar: Oekraïense studenten struikelen over collegegeld'

Two D66 MPs asked whether Ukrainian displaced students can access higher education on equal terms with EU/EEA students, given high institutional tuition fees up to 15,000 euro, and about student finance eligibility. The minister answered that Ukrainians are not automatically entitled to statutory tuition, that changing this would require legislation with wide policy consequences, that the cabinet will meet universities and hogescholen and urges them to lower institutional tuition for other displaced Ukrainians, and that student finance for Ukrainians is not extended because Ukraine is outside the EEA.
The cabinet regularly speaks with universities and universities of applied sciences about Ukrainian displaced persons.
Het kabinet spreekt regelmatig met de universiteiten en hogescholen over de Oekraïense ontheemden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over de gevolgen van de apparaattaakstelling voor het postennet

An MP asked whether the 22 percent cut to the ministry's operating budget would close 34 diplomatic posts and weaken Dutch security, prosperity and international position. The minister replied that the effects are still unclear, that the government aims to keep an adequate network, that 34 closures will not happen, and that choices will follow later.
It is still unclear what the effects of this cut are
Het is nog onduidelijk wat de effecten zijn van deze taakstelling
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Piri, Boswijk, Teunissen en Dassen over het bericht 'U.S. expected to sanction IDF unit for human rights violations in West Bank'

Five MPs asked the Foreign Minister how she assesses the IDF Netzah Yehuda battalion, which the US planned to sanction over human rights abuses in the West Bank, and whether the Netherlands would follow suit. The minister called the reports very concerning, said Israel must prevent settler violence, and declined to follow the US measure, which she described as a Leahy Law restriction rather than a sanction, while pointing to EU settler sanctions the Netherlands supports.

Because the Netherlands only cooperates with Israel within the internationally recognised 1967 borders, the Netherlands has no relationship with the Netzah Yehuda battalion and there is no sanction in the sense of entry bans or asset freezes, the Netherlands does not follow the American example.

Omdat Nederland alleen met Israël binnen de internationaal erkende grenzen van 1967 samenwerkt, Nederland geen relatie met het Netzah Yehudabataljon heeft en er geen sprake is van een sanctie in de zin van inreisverboden of tegoedbevriezingen, volgt Nederland het Amerikaanse voorbeeld niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Paternotte over het bericht 'Zeker 29 doden bij Russische aanval op Oekraïne, kinderziekenhuis in Kyiv geraakt'

Two D66 MPs asked the health and foreign ministers how the Netherlands responds to a Russian strike that hit a children's hospital in Kyiv, including whether Dutch care for injured Ukrainian children could be arranged. Minister Agema answered that Dutch care is provided through the EU Medevac route, that care is first sought within Ukraine, and that the national patient-allocation centre will screen and match patients once Ukraine requests evacuations.

Once the Ukrainian government requests medical evacuations, the National Patient Distribution Centre (LCPS) will immediately arrange screening and matching of patients with care capacity in the Netherlands.

Zodra de Oekraïense regering verzoekt om medische evacuaties, zal het Landelijk Centrum Patiëntenspreiding (LCPS) per omgaande zorgdragen voor screening en matching van patiënten met de zorgcapaciteit in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Piri, Brekelmans, Veldkamp en Paternotte over mogelijkheden om bevroren Russische tegoeden te gebruiken voor hulp aan Oekraïne

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Estonia's law enabling use of frozen Russian assets for Ukraine could serve as a basis in the Netherlands and the EU, and about the state of the Brekelmans motion and a possible 'Navalny Act'. The minister answered that Dutch sanctions law does not allow confiscation of private assets outside criminal proceedings, that no international consensus exists on using the underlying assets, and that the government remains ambitious in exploring options.
Without this criminal-law framework, confiscation on the basis of sanctions raises serious questions about safeguarding individual rights such as property rights.
Zonder dit strafrechtelijk kader roept het overgaan tot confiscatie op basis van sancties serieuze vragen op omtrent de waarborg van individuele rechten zoals het eigendomsrecht.
Antwoord op Vragen van het lid Paternotte en Sneller over de Twintigste Penning in Emmer–Compascuum

MPs Paternotte and Sneller asked about the twentieth penny, a perpetual erfpacht condition requiring 5% of sale value to be paid to the bare owner in Emmer-Compascuum, including its legal basis, market effects, possible abolition like the thirteenth penny, other support for residents, and similar arrangements elsewhere. The minister answered that the condition rests on the Burgerlijk Wetboek and acquired rights, sees no market distortion, rejects legislative abolition as impractical given EVRM compensation duties, and treats the matter as a private civil-law issue with no government advisory role.
This concerns a matter between the private bare owner(s) and private erfpachters over a possible adjustment of the erfpacht conditions.
Het gaat hier om een zaak tussen de particuliere bloot-eigenaar(s) en de particuliere erfpachters over een eventuele aanpassing van de erfpachtvoorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Piri, Brekelmans, Veldkamp, Paternotte en Teunissen over de Tent of Nations in de buurt van Bethlehem

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about the Tent of Nations peace farm near Bethlehem, including land registration delays, a road built on the family's land, restricted access, and whether the government will press Israeli authorities. The minister answered that the access restrictions and road works are illegal under international law and should stop, that the Dutch mission raises the matter regularly and will keep pressing, and that the case is typical of pressures on Palestinian farmers in Area C.
The Netherlands will continue to press on this.
Nederland zal hier op blijven aandringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over het bericht 'Surveillance and interference: Israel’s covert war on the ICCexposed'

An MP asked the government about reports that Israeli officials conducted surveillance of the ICC and Palestinian rights groups to obstruct investigations, and about the safety of ICC staff and witnesses. The government said it is aware of foreign interference risks, is in ongoing contact with the ICC, and summoned the Israeli ambassador, but declined to give details of individual cases or its own investigation for security reasons.
For security reasons, the nature of these discussions or the specific matters raised cannot be discussed in detail.
Uit veiligheidsoverwegingen kan er niet in detail worden getreden over de aard van deze besprekingen of de specifieke zaken die daar aan de orde komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over ombouwen van onzelfstandige studentenkamers

The MP asks whether private landlords are converting shared student rooms into studios, whether studio rents are lower net of rent allowance, and why rent allowance is unavailable for shared rooms, plus related questions on welfare and eligibility. The minister acknowledges signals of conversion but lacks national data, says shared rooms should be preserved for welfare and cost reasons, and explains that rent allowance for shared rooms is blocked by missing BAG registration and budget costs, with an ongoing study of a rental register and a promised letter on new shared-room housing.
I am of the view that shared (non-self-contained) units must be realised and preserved.
Ik ben van mening dat onzelfstandige eenheden moeten worden gerealiseerd en behouden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Paternotte over de berichten 'EU biedt Egypte miljardensteun om stabiliteit in de regio te waarborgen' en 'Egypte ontvangt 7,4 mrd van EU voor bestrijden-migratie’

Two D66 MPs asked about the EU's EUR 7.4 billion package for Egypt, including whether the spending was approved before parliamentary consent, concerns about migration routes and detention, legal migration options, and human rights and civil society space. The government answered that the EU's urgent procedure bypasses the European Parliament for EUR 1 billion, that the rest follows the regular procedure, and that human rights conditions will be monitored, while the Commission holds the disbursement decision and member states have no formal role.
Authority to disburse tranches lies with the Commission. Member states have no formal role in this process.
Bevoegdheid tot uitbetaling van tranches ligt bij de Commissie. Er is voor lidstaten geen formele rol weggelegd in dit proces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bamenga en Paternotte over het bericht 'Etnische zuiveringen in Darfur en mogelijk zelfs genocide, stelt Human Rights Watch'

MPs Bamenga and Paternotte asked the government about Human Rights Watch's findings of possible ethnic cleansing and genocide in West Darfur, including sanctions, ICC cooperation, fact-finding access, humanitarian access and resettlement. The minister responded that the government is very concerned, is working with the EU on expanded sanctions, supports the ICC and the FFM, and explains the current asylum moratorium that blocks resettlement of Sudanese refugees.
The cabinet is very concerned about the situation in Darfur.
Het kabinet is zeer bezorgd over de situatie in Darfur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over verduurzamen van VvE’s lijkt onmogelijk door kosten en rompslomp

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of the Interior whether greening owners' associations (VvE) is stalling due to costs and bureaucracy, and about financing options, surélévation and building-linked finance. The minister answered that the VvE acceleration agenda addresses the barriers, outlines subsidy and loan improvements, and promises further work on simplifying amendments to the deed of division and a building-linked finance arrangement with conclusions expected later in the year.
I am looking into the possibilities for a robust legal basis for building-linked financing.
Ik ben bezig met het onderzoeken van de mogelijkheden voor een robuuste juridische basis voor gebouwgebonden financiering.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Podt over de uitspraken van Commandant der Strijdkrachten van Estland over Russische activiteiten in de Baltische regio met betrekking tot GPS-verstoringen.

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers about Estonian military remarks on Russian GNSS jamming and spoofing and the resulting risks to aviation, NAVO operations and critical infrastructure, including measures, airspace safety and cyber/electronic warfare strategy. The government acknowledges the threat as a destabilising hybrid one, points to existing rules (Wbni), sector-led protection, NAVO policy and Galileo PRS work, and answers each question without committing to new oversight or parliamentary reporting.
The cabinet is aware of this statement.
Het kabinet is bekend met deze stelling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Bamenga, Becker en Brekelmans over de beantwoording van eerdere schriftelijke vragen over door de Chinese overheid gefinancierde weekendscholen

MPs Paternotte, Bamenga, Becker and Brekelmans asked whether the government has oversight of Chinese state-funded weekend schools and their teaching materials, and about the delayed bill on supervising informal education. The minister says the government has no full overview of informal education, will seek talks with China and consider signal-based supervision, but gives no firm timeline beyond consultation before Prinsjesdag.
I will make efforts to enter into consultation with the Chinese government and will ask whether they can provide the transparency you desire.
Ik zal mij inspannen om in overleg te treden met de Chinese overheid (zie mijn antwoord op vraag 9) en zal daar vragen of zij de door u gewenste transparantie kunnen bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over de uitlatingen van de woordvoerder van het Russische ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Russian MFA spokesperson Zakharova's accusation that the EU civilian mission in Armenia (EUMA) conducts espionage, its implications for staff safety, the number of Dutch personnel, and whether the Netherlands would push for armed protection. The minister rejected the espionage claim as false and a disinformation tactic, stated six Dutch experts serve in the mission, and explained that most patrols proceed unarmed while risk assessments are ongoing with armed escort used where military presence is strong.
The claim that EUMA mission personnel carry out espionage activities is categorically untrue and is presumably aimed at stoking tensions and undermining the credibility of EUMA and the EU as a whole.

De stelling dat het missiepersoneel van EUMA spionageactiviteiten uitvoert is pertinent onjuist en heeft als vermoedelijk doel het aanwakkeren van spanningen en het ondermijnen van de geloofwaardigheid van EUMA en de EU als geheel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over de huidige ontwikkelingen rondom Gaza

Paternotte (D66) asked about a French proposal for UN monitoring of a Gaza ceasefire, humanitarian access, the World Central Kitchen deaths, and evacuation of Dutch nationals from Gaza. The minister said no French text exists yet and Nederland is not on the Security Council, promised diplomatic pressure on access and safety of aid workers and on faster evacuation, but gave no concrete parliamentary accountability step.
There is currently no final resolution text presented by France on which the members of the UN Security Council can vote.
Er is op dit moment nog geen definitieve resolutietekst gepresenteerd door Frankrijk waar de leden van de VN-Veiligheidsraad over kunnen stemmen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Bamenga en Piri over het bericht ‘UNRWA Chief Tells Haaretz: We Take Israel's Claims of Hamas Infiltration Seriously, but Yet to See Evidence Against Gaza ‘Employees’

MPs Paternotte, Bamenga and Piri asked the Dutch ministers about UNRWA staff allegedly involved in the 7 October attacks, whether Israel had shared evidence, and whether Dutch aid to UNRWA should be resumed during the investigation. The minister replied that the UN OIOS is investigating, that Israel has shared public information without it being independently verified, and that donors will decide individually on resuming funding while referring to a letter of 26 April 2024.
The cabinet and other donors therefore call on all parties to fully cooperate with the investigation.
Het kabinet en andere donoren roepen alle partijen daarom op tot volledige medewerking aan het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Sneller en Veldkamp over het artikel 'Gemeenten bereiden zich voor op ‘paspoortpiek’, vacatures staan open en noodplannen liggen klaar'

MPs Paternotte, Sneller and Veldkamp asked about a expected peak in passport renewal applications, its effect on applications from abroad and voting in the European elections, and whether a French digital passport renewal experiment could be adopted in the Netherlands. The State Secretary answered that demand will be two to three times higher through 2028, capacity and information campaigns have been expanded, voters need only a valid ID by 31 May, and remote biometric renewal is not yet secure enough, with the government monitoring developments.
The French government website states that from 1 March 2024 an experiment takes place in Canada and Portugal.
Antwoord 8 Op deze website 3 van de Franse overheid is te lezen dat met ingang van 1 maart 2024 een experiment plaatsvindt in Canada en Portugal.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bamenga en Paternotte over de berichten 'Vitens: mogelijk geendrinkwateraansluiting bij nieuwe woningen' en 'Al tientallen bedrijven krijgengeen aansluiting op drinkwater'

D66 MPs Bamenga and Paternotte asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that drinking water shortages may prevent new housing and businesses from getting connections, and whether the crisis affects schools, hospitals and infrastructure. The minister acknowledged the shortage, said Rijk intervention is not excluded but not preferred, outlined an action programme with provinces, and committed to a national drinking-water saving plan and further information, while giving partly general answers on guarantees and the human-right angle.
I do not rule out intervention by the national government, but given the administrative relationship this is not the preferred option.
Ingrijpen door het Rijk sluit ik niet uit, maar dit heeft gezien de bestuurlijke verhouding niet de voorkeur.
Antwoord op vragen van  het lid Paternotte over de doelgerichte aanvallen door Israël op journalisten

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about Israeli strikes on journalists in Lebanon and Gaza, including calls for independent investigation, protection of journalists, and access for foreign journalists to Gaza. The minister says Netherlands expects compliance with international law, supports UNESCO and Media Freedom Coalition efforts, and funds protection programmes, but gives no commitment to call for specific investigations or to press Israel on access.
In the first instance, it is up to the parties themselves to investigate alleged violations of international humanitarian law.
Het is in eerste instantie aan partijen zelf om onderzoek te doen naar vermeende schendingen van het humanitair oorlogsrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over achterblijvende investeringen in onderwijshuisvesting

An MP asked the minister about poor acoustics in gymnasiums causing hearing damage to gym teachers, the share of non-compliant gyms, school boards' capacity to meet their duty of care, and progress on the IBO school-building recommendations. The minister answered that employers bear the duty of care, that the ministry cannot map non-compliant gyms because municipalities own many of them, and listed ongoing measures such as a housing-planning bill and a programmatic approach.
The Ministry of OCW therefore cannot show how many gyms do or do not meet the noise standards.
Het Ministerie van OCW kan daarom niet inzichtelijk maken hoeveel gymzalen wel of niet voldoen aan de geluidsnormen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over de arrestatie van de NOS-correspondent in China

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether a Dutch NOS correspondent was pushed to the ground and detained during a Chengdu demonstration, what steps the government took, and whether it would summon the Chinese ambassador and raise the issue in the Media Freedom Coalition. The minister confirmed the incident, said the embassy engaged with the correspondent and would protest on his behalf if he wished, declined to summon the ambassador, and said individual cases are raised in multilateral fora only at the journalist's request.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs cannot publicly address individual cases.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken kan publiekelijk niet ingaan op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Bamenga over 438 studentenwoningen op Kronenburg

MPs Paternotte and Bamenga asked why only about 438 student homes will be built at Kronenburg instead of the planned 2,500-plus, and about short-stay and self-contained housing. The minister says 438 is a first phase chosen for noise and safety reasons under the Schiphol flight path, that short-stay units may be added, and that a new plan and an adjustment of the LIB are still needed, with progress reported by mid-2024.
The aim is to inform the House of progress by mid-2024.
Het streven is uw Kamer medio 2024 over de voortgang te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Bamenga, Becker en Brekelman over het nieuwsbericht 'Chinese overheid sponsort weekendles Chinees-Nederlandse kinderen'

MPs from D66 and VVD asked the government about RTL reporting on Chinese state-funded weekend schools for Chinese-Dutch children, including oversight, visas for Chinese teachers, foreign interference and possible visitation of schools. The government answered that it has no data on these informal schools, that it is working on a bill for signal-based oversight, and that it sees no reason yet to raise the matter with the Chinese government.
The cabinet does not have figures on informal education institutions, where they are located, how many pupils attend them, or what their funding structure is.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over cijfers van instellingen voor informeel onderwijs, waar zij zich bevinden, hoeveel leerlingen deze instellingen bezoeken of hoe de financieringsstructuur eruit ziet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Veldkamp over het omzeilen van sancties op Rusland via geografische U-bochtconstructies

MPs Paternotte and Veldkamp asked the government about Dutch goods reaching Russian weapons and surging exports to Russia's neighbours used to evade sanctions. The ministers answered that circumvention is a shared concern, cited EU measures and enforcement, but declined to give a definitive account of the export-surge cause and said the answer to question 10 could not be provided in time.
The cabinet is committed to taking restrictive measures against companies in third countries that circumvent EU sanctions, also in line with the Van der Lee motion.
Het kabinet is gecommitteerd aan het nemen van beperkende maatregelen tegen bedrijven in derde landen die EU-sancties omzeilen, ook in lijn met de motie Van der Lee
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over het bericht ‘Werkgroep moet scherven van geflopte BES –top bijeenvegen’

MP Paternotte asked the State Secretary for Interior and Kingdom Relations about reports that a working group must clean up the failed BES top meeting and about the timeline, involvement of the public bodies, and financing of the Caribbean Netherlands islands. The State Secretary answered that the WolBES/FinBES revision is still in consultation, that the consultation was extended at the islands' request with a working conference planned for March 2024, that islands' input is formally anchored in article 209 WolBES, and that the IdeeVersa study on island funding is under review with a follow-up discussion and ROB advice pending.
I aim to submit the bill to your House by the end of the year.
Ik streef ernaar om het wetsvoorstel voor het eind van het jaar bij uw Kamer in te dienen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over Woningdeling door meerdere eenouderhuishoudens

MP Paternotte asked the Minister of Interior about co-housing by single-parent households, the Tax Office treating two friends sharing a home as a partnership for allowances, and the effects on families and the housing market. The Minister acknowledged the housing shortage, said the partner definition in allowance rules is objectified and that changes for first-degree relatives apply from 2025, and committed to reviewing barriers and sending the Toekomst Toeslagen report to parliament.
I am aware that there is household dilution in the Netherlands.
Het is mij bekend dat er in Nederland sprake is van huishoudensverdunning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Podt over de uitspraken van de Duitse minister van Defensie

D66 MPs Paternotte and Podt asked the Defence Minister about German Defence Minister Pistorius's warnings of possible military confrontation with Russia and related Dutch scenario planning, public communication, the NATO Baltic response, and continued support for Ukraine. The minister confirmed shared concern about Russia, said scenario planning occurs within NATO and nationally but details will not be published for security reasons, and affirmed continued military support to Ukraine.
For security reasons, the details of the scenarios are not communicated publicly.
Omwille van de veiligheid wordt in het openbaar niet over de details van scenario's gecommuniceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Paternotte over het rapport van Don’t Buy into the Occupation (DBIO) aangaande investeringen in nederzettingen op de Westelijke Jordaanoever

MPs Piri and Paternotte asked the Foreign Minister about a DBIO report finding European financial institutions, including Dutch ones and Booking.com, active in Israeli settlements, and why the Dutch discouragement policy is not working. The minister reaffirmed that settlement activity is undesirable, pointed to the existing discouragement policy and OECD guidelines, said the government will approach Dutch financial institutions and study the report's recommendations, and declined to say why Booking.com was not approached earlier beyond stating it had been in discussion with the ministry.
The cabinet will carefully study the recommendations in the report.
Het kabinet zal de aanbevelingen in het rapport zorgvuldig bestuderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Paternotte over het bericht 'Mbo’er Sem (20) zoekt al drie jaar een studentenwoning in Amsterdam: ‘Ik wil hier mijn eigen leven beginnen’'

MPs Beckerman and Paternotte asked whether it is acceptable that MBO students are refused student housing and how the government will ensure access, including whether this counts as housing discrimination and whether landlords will be engaged. The minister answered that MBO students should have access, that a Human Rights Institute advice on banning distinction by education level is being requested, and that 11 of 13 Kences corporations admit MBO students, with the rest being asked to change.

On behalf of the Minister of Education, Culture and Science, I will shortly request advice from the Netherlands Institute for Human Rights on the desirability of a ban on distinction by education level in the General Equal Treatment Act.

Mede namens de Minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap zal ik op korte termijn advies vragen aan het College voor de Rechten van de Mens over de wenselijkheid van een verbod op onderscheid naar opleidingsniveau in de Algemene wet gelijke behandeling (Awgb).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over het bericht 'Varkensboer die voor miljoenen is uitgekocht, wil op andere plek uitbreiden'

The MP Paternotte asked the minister whether a bought-out pig farmer may expand on another, family-owned site and whether the national buyout schemes can prevent this, including the ban on restarting elsewhere and the unused permit space. The minister answered that the ban only covers new locations, that the subsidy can be used for expansion on an existing permitted site, that the schemes are not designed around other sites of the same company, and that extra budget is needed to honour all applications.
I will inform your House more fully in the short term.
Ik zal uw Kamer op korte termijn nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Van der Lee over de gevangenschap van en de rechtszaak tegen journalist en uitgever Jimmy Lai in Hongkong

Two MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the government would condemn the national security trial of journalist Jimmy Lai in Hong Kong as an attack on press freedom, whether it would act against the breach of the 1984 Sino-British Joint Declaration, and whether it would join the US and UK in calling for his release. The minister answered that the Netherlands, with 23 other countries in the Media Freedom Coalition, has voiced serious concern and will keep raising the issue and monitoring the trials, but did not commit to calling for release or dropping the case.
The Netherlands will continue to raise attention to this together with this coalition of like-minded countries, including the US and the UK.
Nederland zal hier in samenwerking met deze coalitie van gelijkgezinde landen, waaronder de VS en het VK, aandacht voor blijven vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Paternotte over het onderzoek naar het overlijden van een Nederlandse staatsburger in Gaza

D66 MPs asked the Foreign Minister how long the government had pressed Israel for an explanation of the death of a Dutch national in Gaza, how many Dutch citizens remain in Gaza, and what steps were taken to evacuate them. The minister answered that Israel has promised information but not yet delivered it, that the government will keep pressing, and that evacuation efforts depend on the security situation.
Israel reportedly also draws up battle damage assessments after military operations. However, these documents are confidential and are not shared with other countries.
Daarnaast stelt Israël na afloop van militaire operaties naar verluidt «battle damage assessments» op. Deze stukken zijn echter vertrouwelijk en worden niet met andere landen gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet, Ploumen en Paternotte over het recht op abortus in Polen

MPs Ellemeet, Ploumen and Paternotte asked the government about the abortion ban in Poland, prosecutions of activists, the lack of access for Polish and Ukrainian refugee women, and what the Netherlands can do. The minister stated that Dutch clinics can treat foreign women without state financial support, that funding goes to rights organisations rather than individual abortions, and that the government shares concern over regressive pressure in Poland.
However, this is not a right and the Dutch state does not provide financial support to these individual women.
Dit is echter geen recht en de Nederlandse staat biedt deze individuele vrouwen geen financiële ondersteuning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Paternotte en Van der Laan over sporters van teamNL, die met corona besmet zijn geraakt

MPs Omtzigt, Paternotte and Van der Laan asked whether lessons were drawn after TeamNL athletes caught COVID-19 on the Tokyo flight, what measures China imposes, and whether flying on a single pre-departure test is safe. The minister replied that NOC*NSF evaluated the trip and adopted adjusted travel measures for Beijing, that no approach can reach zero risk, and that the cabinet considers a single test sufficiently safe while leaving the operational responsibility with NOC*NSF.
It is up to NOC*NSF to ensure that the TeamNL delegation can be sent to the Games in a safe manner.
Het is aan NOC*NSF om ervoor te zorgen dat de TeamNL-delegatie op een veilige manier kan worden uitgezonden naar de Spelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over het verkrijgen van een coronatoegangsbewijs voor Nederlanders die niet de optie hebben zich te laten vaccineren

MPs Paternotte asked the minister how people who cannot be vaccinated for medical or trial-participation reasons can obtain a COVID access certificate, and whether serology could serve as proof. The minister answered that a medical exemption route is being developed, that testing remains an alternative, that serology is not yet accepted, and that trial participants can receive certificates after vaccination with an approved vaccine.
How people who cannot be vaccinated for medical reasons can become eligible for a QR code is currently being worked out.
Hoe mensen die zich om medische redenen niet kunnen laten vaccineren in aanmerking kunnen komen voor een QR-code wordt op dit moment uitgewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Aukje de Vries en Kuiken over boostervaccinaties voor Nederlanders die met AstraZeneca of Janssen gevaccineerd zijn

MPs Paternotte, Aukje de Vries and Kuiken asked why booster vaccination for people vaccinated with AstraZeneca or Janssen was not prioritised, and whether the Health Council and EMA positions justify delay. The minister answered that the Health Council found no medical grounds for prioritising by vaccine type, that mRNA boosters are preferred, and that the booster campaign is being accelerated, while several questions about Europe-wide certificate validity were answered only in outline.
The RIVM does not have data on people belonging to a risk group and recipients of a 'waste-bin vaccine' and their vaccination status at the time of a positive test.
Het RIVM beschikt niet over data van personen die behoren tot een risicogroep en ontvangers van een «prullenbakvaccin» en de vaccinatiestatus op het moment van een positieve test.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over de berichten dat studenten met coronaklachten toch naar tentamens komen uit angst om een toetskans te missen

An MP asks whether students with corona symptoms or in quarantine are pressured to attend in-person exams for fear of losing a test chance, and whether online exams or extra resits should be offered. The minister answers that institutions must offer tailored solutions and that new service documents set agreements, but declines to commit to a standard online-exam choice, leaving the decision to institutions.
It is up to the institution to shape resit policy in practice and provide tailored solutions in such cases.
Het is aan de instelling om het herkansingsbeleid in de praktijk vorm te geven en in dergelijke gevallen maatwerk te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over de voorraad vaccins en de inzet van boosters in 2022

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Health why the Dutch vaccine stock is no longer shown on the corona dashboard, how many vaccines are in stock and whether they suffice for possible additional booster rounds and the Omicron variant, and whether Janssen could be used as booster. The Minister answered that the stock chart was archived because it is less relevant to the public, that stock is sufficient for the current booster campaign with preparations for further rounds and adapted vaccines expected at the earliest in late April 2022, and that the Janssen vaccin will be used only for individual health reasons.
That is why we have made agreements with BioNTech/Pfizer and Moderna on the need to adapt their vaccines, should protection prove insufficient.
Daarom hebben we afspraken gemaakt met BioNTech/Pfizer en Moderna over de noodzaak om hun vaccins aan te passen, mocht blijken dat de bescherming niet afdoende is.
Antwoord op de vragen van  het lid Paternotte over het verschil in regelgeving tussen een evenement op een terras of op een andere locatie

An MP from D66 asked the Health Minister why a small outdoor event with ticketed access and loud music was permitted under one COVID rule set on a terrace but not under another at other locations, and whether this was intended. The minister answered that the difference followed from the terrace-versus-event distinction rather than location, explained the applicable conditions, and largely deferred on municipal permitting, with the answer delayed and no separate consultation held.
At the time of the reported news, these measures were not linked to the difference in location, but followed from the distinction between a terrace and an event.
Ten tijde van het aangehaalde bericht hingen deze maatregelen niet samen met het verschil in de locatie, maar volgden deze uit het onderscheid tussen een terras en een evenement.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Van Meenen en Boulakjar over coronamaatregelen in het funderend onderwijs

Three D66 MPs asked the education minister why the government departs from OMT advice on school COVID measures, including testing, the Christmas holiday timing, masks, CO2 meters and air purifiers. The minister confirmed the departures, explained the reasons and pointed to ventilation funding and existing measures, without committing to new national devices.
Naturally the epidemiological situation is monitored and the Cabinet takes the decisions that are necessary.
Vanzelfsprekend is de epidemiologische situatie gemonitord en neemt het Kabinet besluiten die nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Paternotte over het bericht dat de toename van coronabesmettingen in Goes veroorzaakt is door een uitbraak in de noodopvang

MPs Podt and Paternotte asked the Health Minister, on behalf of the Justice State Secretary, about reports that a rise in COVID-19 cases in Goes was caused by an outbreak in an emergency asylum reception centre, and about vaccination, quarantine, distancing and information in asylum locations. The minister answered each question in general terms, stating that current measures and protocols are in place, vaccination is offered and quarantine capacity is sufficient, and admitted that answering each question separately before the plenary debate was not achieved due to workload.
Unfortunately, that has not been achieved due to busy schedules.
Dat is vanwege drukte helaas niet gelukt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Laan en Paternotte over de diplomatermijn in combinatie met topsport

Two D66 MPs asked how the ten-year diploma deadline for student finance is extended for elite athletes, including the criteria, definition of top sport, the role of DUO and NOC*NSF, and COVID effects. The minister explained that extensions depend on special circumstances, top sport is narrowly defined as international competition, and DUO will explore broadening the definition, but she gave no data on past extensions and did not answer by the requested deadline.
The reason for granting the extension of the diploma deadline is not registered in DUO's systems.
De reden van de toekenning voor de verlenging van de diplomatermijn wordt niet in de systemen van DUO geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Van den Berg over de blijvende problemen van het ophalen van de QR-code voor het coronatoegangsbewijs

MPs Paternotte and Van den Berg asked the health minister about persistent problems obtaining QR codes for the coronavirus access certificate, including helpdesk volumes, unresolved cases, staffing, and access for people vaccinated abroad. The minister answered that about 7% of helpdesk calls concerned QR-code problems, most are resolved, capacity is sufficient, and expansion of foreign-vaccination services is under discussion without firm commitments on new locations.
Precise numbers and percentages of the types of problems occurring are not recorded.
Precieze aantallen en percentages van de soorten voorkomende problemen worden niet bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Kuiken en Aukje de Vries over de uitvoering van de boostervaccinatiecampagne

MPs Paternotte, Kuiken and Aukje de Vries asked the health minister about booster vaccination rollout: uptake numbers, speeding up the campaign, whether relatives can book appointments for elderly people, consent procedures for residents in care homes, eligibility of partners, and vaccinating the wider population. The minister answered that booster figures were provided, that relatives may book only with the person's own consent by phone, that consent practices are workable in care homes, and that the campaign follows age-based priorities per Health Council advice, with a December offensive being prepared.
I will receive the plan for this offensive at the end of this week.
Het plan voor dit offensief ontvang ik aan het eind van deze week.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Paternotte over een corona-uitbraak in een gevangenis en de vaccinatie van gevangenen

MPs Sneller and Paternotte asked about a COVID-19 outbreak in Zaanstad prison, the vaccination rate among prisoners, and current measures in detention facilities. The minister answered that outbreak protocols were followed, the exact vaccination rate is unknown because prisoners need not disclose status, and DJI follows RIVM advice on measures.
The exact vaccination rate among prisoners is not known, because prisoners are not obliged to disclose their vaccination status.
De exacte vaccinatiegraad onder gedetineerden is niet bekend, omdat gedetineerden niet verplicht zijn om de vaccinatiestatus door te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Paternotte en Hagen over de snelle opmars van een nieuwe virusvariant in Zuid-Afrika

Two D66 MPs asked the health and transport ministers about a new COVID variant spreading fast in South Africa, including monitoring, travel testing, vaccine donations and border checks. The minister answered by referring the parliament to a separate letter on the omicron measures, without answering the questions directly.

The written questions from MPs Paternotte and Hagen to the ministers of Infrastructure and Water Management and of Health, Welfare and Sport about the rapid rise of a new virus variant in South Africa (2021Z21733) have been answered by way of a letter.

De schriftelijke vragen van leden Paternotte en Hagen aan de ministers van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de snelle opmars van een nieuwe virusvariant in Zuid-Afrika ( 2021Z21733 ) zijn beantwoordwoord middels brief
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Aukje de Vries over de beschikbaarheid van testcapaciteit buiten de randstad

MPs Paternotte and Aukje de Vries asked the health minister why COVID test locations outside the Randstad had closed and whether accessibility within 30 minutes' travel was guaranteed, as coronavirus access passes expanded. Minister De Jonge answered that coverage had reached 99.9%, that the new per-test payment system had tripled locations, that the government would monitor and prepare for new gaps, and that pharmacies could join the scheme.
Stichting Open Nederland, however, can no longer require that a test provider establish itself at a particular location.
Stichting Open Nederland kan echter niet meer eisen dat een testaanbieder zich op een bepaalde plek vestigt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Aukje de Vries en Kuiken over internationale ontwikkelingen rond boostervaccinaties en vaccinatie van kwetsbaren

MPs Paternotte, Aukje de Vries and Kuiken asked the Minister of Health about EU and German decisions on booster vaccinations, Janssen and AstraZeneca booster eligibility, booster age groups, children aged 5-11 and off-label use for vulnerable children, and school absence due to COVID risk. The Minister answered that the Gezondheidsraad was asked for additional advice by 2 November on boosters and on Pfizer for children, and that the Dutch child-vaccination and school-absence questions are being monitored or left to advisory and EMA processes.
I asked the Health Council on 15 October to provide additional advice on using mRNA vaccines as a booster
Ik heb de Gezondheidsraad op 15 oktober jl. is gevraagd een aanvullend advies te geven over het inzetten van mRNA-vaccins als booster
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over coronatoegangsbewijzen en de deltavariant

The MP asks the health minister how to interpret infections linked to events admitted with a COVID certificate, whether the 116th and 117th OMT advice accounted for certificate or testing failures, which scientific source supports issuing certificates immediately after a Janssen dose, and for quantified risk reasoning behind the Janssen waiting period. The minister admits enforcement and technical problems, says the OMT was not informed of these failures in its advice, and reports that the 14-day rule was adopted (28 days for Janssen) without a specific scientific source, after reconsideration.

No, in the 116th and 117th OMT advice on accelerating step 5 of the reopening plan, the combined effect of the then almost absent more contagious delta variant, changed behaviour at 1.5 metres, the attack on the SON systems and its consequences, poor enforcement at the door and its supervision, and young people avoiding valid QR codes, was not taken into account.

Nee, bij het 116e en 117e advies van het Outbreak Management Team (OMT) aangaande het versneld zetten van stap 5 van het openingsplan, was de optelsom van de (toen nog vrijwel afwezige) besmettelijkere delta-variant, de verandering in het gedrag van mensen op de 1,5m in het algemeen, de aanval op de systemen van SON en de gevolgen daarvan, de slechte handhaving aan de poort en het toezicht daarop, het ontwijken van het gebruik van geldige QR codes door met name jongeren, niet verdisconteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Aukje de Vries, Kuiken en Van den Berg over doelgroepen die aanzienlijke moeite hebben met het verkrijgen van een coronatoegangsbewijs

MPs from D66, VVD, PvdA and CDA asked the health minister which groups struggle to obtain a COVID certificate, including people vaccinated abroad, people without a BSN, and those medically unable to test, and about waiting times and access at GGD Utrecht. The minister answered that the Utrecht service is limited to non-EU vaccinees resident in the Netherlands or Dutch nationals, that solutions for other groups are being explored, and that additional locations (such as Groningen) are being prepared.
It is currently being explored whether people from this group who can make it plausible that they live in the Netherlands and do not yet have a BSN can also be helped.
Er wordt momenteel verkend of mensen uit deze groep die aannemelijk kunnen maken dat zij woonachtig zijn in Nederland en nog geen BSN hebben, ook geholpen kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Hagen over de quarantaineplicht voor gevaccineerde reizigers

Two D66 MPs asked why vaccinated travellers from very-high-risk areas without a variant of concern must quarantine while vaccinated household contacts of positive cases need not, and whether the government will reconsider. The minister answers that from 22 September vaccinated travellers from such areas are exempt from quarantine (a negative test is still required), that quarantine remains for unvaccinated travellers, and that the amendment Paternotte/Kuiken provides the legal basis.

Given the strongly increased vaccination rate in the Netherlands and the limited risk that vaccinated travellers pose to public health for transmission of the coronavirus, the cabinet has decided to exempt vaccinated travellers from the quarantine obligation from 22 September.

Gezien de sterk toegenomen vaccinatiegraad in Nederland en het beperkte risico dat gevaccineerde reizigers voor de volksgezondheid vormen voor de transmissie van het coronavirus, heeft het kabinet besloten gevaccineerde reizigers per 22 september uit te zonderen van de quarantaineplicht
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Van der Laan over de capaciteit bij de GGD’en

Two D66 MPs asked the health minister about GGD capacity, outbreak preparedness, staffing shortages, contact tracing gaps, and the public-private testing and appointment arrangements during the COVID-19 period. The minister responded that GGDs had been assessed as generally capable, that preparedness was coordinated via RIVM and existing programmes, and that capacity and scheduling were adequate, though he gave limited detail on some preparedness contacts and did not commit to new concrete steps.
The GGD appointment system functions adequately.
Het afsprakensysteem van de GGD'en functioneert adequaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte en Aukje de Vries over de CoronaCheck voor toeristen en andere buitenlanders of Nederlanders die in het buitenland hun vaccinatie hebben gehaald

MPs Paternotte and Aukje de Vries asked how non-EU vaccinated travellers and Dutch citizens vaccinated abroad can obtain a Dutch CoronaCheck, given that in-person identification in Utrecht is required. The minister answered that GGD Utrecht issues digital certificates after in-person identification, that other locations and an online solution are being explored, and that Dutch residents without a certificate are being looked into.
I am in discussion with GGD GHOR Nederland to see whether this service can also be offered at a number of other GGD locations.
Ik ben met GGD GHOR Nederland in gesprek om te kijken of het mogelijk is om deze service ook op een aantal andere GGD-locaties te kunnen bieden.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Laçin, Paterenotte, Kröger, Van Brenk, Öztürk en Gijs van Dijk over de openstelling van de coronateststraat op Schiphol voor werknemers

MPs from SP, D66, GroenLinks, 50PLUS, DENK and PvdA asked why Schiphol workers who develop symptoms cannot be tested at the airport's test facility, whether the government will talk with the GGD and Schiphol, and how often the labour inspectorate checks Covid measures at Schiphol. The answer is a reference to a separate letter on the Covid situation, so the substance is not answered in this document.
The written questions ... have been answered by means of the letter <Status of COVID-19> (Parliamentary paper 25 295, no. 1422).
De schriftelijke vragen ... zijn beantwoord middels brief <Stand van zaken COVID-19> (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 1422 ).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over testaanbieders die alsnog geld vragen voor een reizigerstest of te laat een uitslag doorgeven

An MP asked the government about private COVID test providers charging for travel tests or delivering results late, and about contractual deadlines, customer service and enforcement. The minister answered that contracts require results within 24 hours for PCR and 3 hours for antigen tests, that enforcement occurs via complaints and possible non-payment, and that a standard contract will be provided.
Test providers that do not deliver the test result on time or at all must offer an appropriate solution to the traveller concerned.
Indien testaanbieders de testuitslag, niet op tijd of niet leveren moeten zij een passende oplossing bieden aan de betreffende reiziger.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Paternotte over het gele boekje en de berichtgeving hierover op www.minvws.nl

MPs Kuiken and Paternotte asked the health minister about the legal status of the yellow vaccination booklet for international travel, its recognition abroad, and whether it can be used for COVID-19 vaccination proof. The minister answered that the booklet has official status only for yellow fever under the IHR, that other vaccination records are not governed by IHR standards, and that the EU digital certificate (DCC) with a paper version is the official COVID-19 proof, while acknowledging a late reply.
The yellow booklet has no official status for other vaccinations, in accordance with the International Health Regulations (IHR) (incl. Annex 6 and 7).
Het gele boekje heeft voor andere vaccinaties, conform de regelgeving van de International Health Regulations (IHR) (o.a. Annex 6 en 7) geen officiële status.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over vaccinatiebeleid van Nederlanders in het buitenland

MP Paternotte asked whether Dutch nationals living outside the EU without a BRP registration can be vaccinated in the Netherlands, what options exist where vaccines are unavailable, how other EU states handle this, and what happens to second doses. Minister De Jonge answered that since 18 June 2021 Dutch nationals with a passport and BSN can be vaccinated in the Netherlands without a one-month stay, that vaccine supply is limited so donations via COVAX are the primary route, and that other member states' rules are for them to decide.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Paternotte en Bikker over de zogenoemde mondkapjesdeal

MPs Kuiken, Paternotte and Bikker asked the Minister about the face-mask deal with Relief Goods Alliance, including stock levels, objections raised by the LCH, alternative suppliers, contacts between ministers and RGA, and advance payments. The Minister answered mostly by pointing to a forthcoming Deloitte review, shared some documents, withheld details of the other large contracts pending receipt, and committed to passing many questions to the researchers.
I will ask the research bureau to include this question in the supplementary investigation and also to address the reason why protest was lodged where this happened.
Ik zal het onderzoeksbureau vragen om deze vraag mee te nemen in het aanvullende onderzoek en dan ook in te gaan op de reden waarom er protest werd aangetekend indien dit gebeurde.
Antwoord op  vragen van de leden Paternotte en Kuiken over het besluit het AstraZeneca-vaccin alleen in te zetten bij 60-plussers

MPs Paternotte and Kuiken asked why the government restricted AstraZeneca vaccination to people aged 60 and over, given the Health Council's risk comparison and EMA's benefit-risk conclusion, and asked about related rollout, risk and supply questions. Minister De Jonge answered at length, defending the age limit with mortality risk figures, stating that alternative vaccines were arranged for under-60s, and describing vaccine supply and donation plans.
After advice from the Health Council, the cabinet decided to use the AstraZeneca vaccine only for people aged 60 and over.
heb aangegeven heeft het kabinet na advies van de Gezondheidsraad besloten het AstraZeneca-vaccin enkel te gebruiken bij mensen van 60 jaar en ouder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Yeşilgöz-Zegerius, Paternotte en Van der Werf over het incident bij de corona-vaccinatielocatie Amsterdam
