Four MPs asked the health and justice ministers about reported harassment of people queuing for COVID vaccination at a vaccination site in Amsterdam during a demonstration march, asking about police response, arrests, GGD instructions, reporting, and safety guarantees. The minister answered that police found no confirmed intimidation, no complaints or reports were registered, police urged victims to file complaints, and vaccination site safety is a decentralised responsibility under existing protocols and support networks.
The police are aware of a social media report that people were harassed. The police were visibly present but could not confirm this.
De politie is op de hoogte van een bericht op social media dat mensen zijn lastiggevallen. De politie was zichtbaar aanwezig, maar heeft dit niet kunnen constateren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over uitwisseling van studenten tijdens corona

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether student exchanges could go ahead during COVID, including whether universities should decide per region, whether a taskforce is needed, and whether travel advice treats study abroad as essential. The minister gave a substantive answer on participation numbers and travel advice, but stated that institutions decide on exchanges and declined to set up extra support or a taskforce.
The decision on participation in exchange programmes is up to the institutions themselves.
Het besluit over deelname aan uitwisselingsprogramma’s is aan instellingen zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Hammelburg, Boucke, Sjoerdsma en Ceder over de oproep uit Suriname om hulp te bieden met vaccineren

MPs from D66 and the ChristenUnie asked the ministers of Health and Foreign Affairs about Suriname's request for vaccination help amid a COVID-19 surge and the Indian export ban. The minister answered that Nederland has responded with oxygen containers, medical supplies, 90,000 AstraZeneca doses and a planned 500,000 to 750,000 doses, sent a special envoy, and donated EUR 70 million to COVAX.
The Netherlands has also committed that from week 25, provided supplies allow, vaccines will be delivered to Suriname.
Nederland heeft tevens toegezegd dat er vanaf week 25, mits de leveringen het toelaten, vaccins worden geleverd aan Suriname.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Hammelburg, Boucke, Sjoerdsma en Ceder over het aanbod van het Diaspora Medisch Team Nederland om steun aan het vaccinatieprogramma in Suriname te faciliteren

MPs from D66 and ChristenUnie asked the health and foreign affairs ministers about the Diaspora Medical Team's offer to support Suriname's vaccination programme, whether the minister had contacted Suriname's health minister, and whether vaccines would be supplied. The minister replied that talks with Suriname's health minister had taken place, that 90,000 AstraZeneca doses were sent with further deliveries promised from week 25, and that a coordinator was deployed to match Surinamese needs with Dutch medical staff offers.
Furthermore, the Netherlands has committed that from week 25, provided deliveries allow it, vaccines will be supplied to Suriname.
Verder heeft Nederland toegezegd dat er vanaf week 25, mits de leveringen het toelaten, vaccins worden geleverd aan Suriname.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat Rusland en China twijfel zaaien over Europese vaccins

MPs Paternotte and Sjoerdsma asked whether Russia and China are spreading doubt about European vaccines, whether the government will push back against such disinformation in the EU and bilaterally, and about the quality and regulatory status of Sinopharm, Sinovac and Sputnik V vaccines. The minister acknowledges the disinformation is condemnable but judges its impact small, describes EU and Dutch counter-disinformation efforts and the Chinese and Russian contacts, and says Sputnik V's EMA review is still ongoing with no date for a formal application.

At the same time, the cabinet has confidence in the pluriform Dutch and European media landscape, in which the free press assesses this kind of reporting on its merits and the impact of this kind of disinformation is so far small.

Tegelijkertijd heeft het kabinet vertrouwen in het pluriforme Nederlandse en Europese medialandschap, waarin de vrije pers dit soort berichtgeving op z’n merites beoordeelt en de impact van dit soort desinformatie vooralsnog klein is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over een coronatoegangsbewijs voor Nederlanders die in het buitenland gevaccineerd worden

An MP asked the health minister about COVID vaccination certificates for Dutch nationals vaccinated abroad, including registration in the CIMS system and eligibility for the EU digital certificate. The minister gave partial answers, saying registration is still being explored and that EU-approved foreign vaccinations will be facilitated once residents can request a Dutch certificate, with more information to follow later.
I will inform your House when more is clear.
Ik informeer uw Kamer hier over wanneer meer duidelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Paternotte, Hagen, Boucke, Grinwis en Ceder over niet-EU-familieleden van expats, die geen toegang hebben tot Nederland

MPs from D66 and ChristenUnie asked whether non-EU family members of expats and residents are barred from entering the Netherlands under the EU entry ban and Dutch flight bans, whether this breaches Article 8 ECHR, and whether exceptions can be made for Suriname and other regions. The government answered that family of Dutch residents with residence permits are exempt, that individual exceptions exist for urgent family reasons, that the flight bans were lifted on 1 June 2021, and that generic exceptions for first- and second-degree relatives were not desirable.
The cabinet notes that the right to private and family life in Article 8 ECHR does not constitute an absolute right of access to the Netherlands.
Daarbij merkt het kabinet op dat het in artikel 8 EVRM opgenomen recht op privé en familieleven geen absoluut recht tot toegang tot Nederland behelst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Hagen over het bericht dat Duitsland reisbeperkingen instelt voor het Verenigd Koninkrijk vanwege de opmars van de Indiase virusvariant B.1617

MPs Paternotte and Hagen asked about Germany's travel restrictions on the UK over the Indian B.1617 variant, the adequacy of contact tracing and genomic surveillance, and whether further measures are needed. Minister De Jonge replied that the RIVM advises no additional measures now, that surveillance meets ECDC norms with about 1500 sequences weekly, and that the RIVM will keep monitoring.

At my request, the RIVM will continue to closely monitor the situation and will advise me, both on request and unsolicited, if additional measures for travellers from the UK turn out to be needed at a later time.

Op mijn verzoek blijft het RIVM de situatie nauwgezet monitoren, waarbij zij mij gevraagd en ongevraagd zal adviseren indien aanvullende maatregelen voor reizigers uit het VK op een later moment alsnog nodig blijken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot en Paternotte over de brandbrief van de Ondernemingsraad KDS en het FNV over het stijgend aantal besmettingen in slachthuizen en het niet naleven van de coronamaatregelen

MPs De Groot and Paternotte asked ministers about a works council letter reporting rising COVID-19 infections in slaughterhouses, non-compliance with measures, and weak NVWA oversight. The minister answered that the NVWA and inspectorates use an escalation ladder, including halting inspections, and that the Apeldoorn slaughterhouse was closed temporarily and restarted under conditions, while stating she finds the reported conduct undesirable and commits to continued close monitoring.
I do not recognise that these concerns are widely shared among employees in the food industry.
Ik herken niet dat die zorgen breed gedeeld worden bij medewerkers in de voedingsmiddelenindustrie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Paternotte en Bikker over de mondkapjesdeal

Three MPs (Kuiken, Paternotte, Bikker) asked the Minister for Medical Care about the face mask purchase deal with Relief Goods Alliance, including overpayment, contacts with the initiators, disclosure of documents, and the role of the minister and secretary-general. The minister answered that the prices fell within the reasonable range at the time, shared a timeline of contacts and two purchase orders, but declined to publish the general conditions and deferred disclosure of the initiators' presentation to the company.
I have no objection to sharing this, but VWS is not the owner of this document.
Ik heb er geen bezwaar tegen om deze te delen, maar VWS is niet de eigenaar van dit document.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Paternotte over de berichtgeving dat arbeidsmigranten niet allemaal een vaccin krijgen en de maatschappelijke opvang voor ongedocumenteerden wordt afgebouwd

Opposition MPs Paulusma and Paternotte asked why migrant workers and undocumented people not registered in the BRP may not receive vaccination invitations and why emergency shelter is being wound down. Minister De Jonge answered that unregistered groups are being reached via GGD regional plans and outreach, and that the shelter wind-down timing remains appropriate.

The Ministry of VWS asked the GGD regions, together with regional partners such as municipalities, shelter organisations and street doctors, to draw up a regional implementation plan for vaccinating homeless people, people in women's shelters and undocumented people.

Het Ministerie van VWS heeft GGD-en verzocht – in samenwerking met regionale partners zoals gemeenten, opvanginstellingen en straatdokters – een regionaal uitvoeringsplan te maken voor de vaccinatie van dakloze mensen, mensen die verblijven in de vrouwenopvang en ongedocumenteerde mensen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Paternotte over het artikel ''Dit is oorlog': het internationale netwerk van christelijke fundamentalisten achter het Poolse abortusverbod'

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about foreign-funded Christian fundamentalist networks active in Europe and the Netherlands, including Civitas Christiana, and whether this amounts to undesirable foreign influence and how the EU supports feminist movements. The minister confirmed such organisations operate in the Netherlands and that Civitas Christiana receives foreign funding, said this may constitute undesirable influence but with limited societal effect, pointed to a transparency bill, and noted the EU Rights and Values programme may support women's and LGBTI rights organisations.
Regarding Civitas Christiana, there could be a case of undesirable influence.
Omtrent Civitas Christiana zou sprake kunnen zijn van ongewenste beïnvloeding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wuite en Paternotte over het bericht 'Europees vaccinatie-certificaat ook goed nieuws voor de eilanden'

Two D66 MPs asked the health minister about the progress, timing and invention issues for introducing the EU digital green (vaccination) certificate in the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom, and whether travel between overseas territories and countries would be possible. The state secretary answered that working groups are preparing, the target date of 21 June also applies, residents without a BSN/DigiD face a special route that is being discussed, and travel between territories will be possible.

Currently it is being examined what the technical and legal requirements of the certificate are and whether introducing the digital green certificate is deemed opportune by the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom.

Momenteel wordt bekeken wat de technische en juridische vereisten zijn van het certificaat en of het in gebruik nemen van het digitale groen certificaat opportuun wordt geacht door de Caribische delen van het Koninkrijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Groothuizen en Verhoeven over de intimidatie van historicus Nadia Bouras

MPs from D66 asked the Justice and Security minister how the government views intimidation of historian Nadia Bouras by the anonymous group Vizier op Links, whether doxing should be tackled specifically, whether the Trade Register should better protect addresses of entrepreneurs, and whether platforms should bear more responsibility. The minister condemned the intimidation, said police and the Public Prosecution Service have tools, that a criminal-law option for doxing is being explored, that a proposal to shield sole-trader home addresses is in preparation, and that he intends further agreements with platforms.
I will examine this together with the internet bullying policy framework that has been developed and whose various steps are currently being implemented.
Ik ga dit onderzoeken in samenhang met het beleidskader internetpesten dat is ontwikkeld en waarvan de verschillende stappen momenteel worden uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Laan en Paternotte over het bericht 'Hoe vrouwen vergeten werden in het Covid-19-onderzoek'

MPs Van der Laan and Paternotte asked the Minister for Medical Care about reports that women were overlooked in Covid-19 research, including whether sex differences should be studied in treatments and medication and whether the Netherlands will push this at EU level. The minister agrees sex should be considered in research, says the CBG review results do not directly require changes to regulatory guidelines, and states that the Gender and Gezondheid programme continues with 3 million euro proposed for 2021 and diversity requirements added to ZonMw funding.
Where appropriate, the Netherlands will emphasise the importance of including relevant diversity characteristics, including sex, in research.
Waar opportuun zal vanuit Nederland het belang worden onderstreept dat bij onderzoek relevante kenmerken van diversiteit, waaronder sekse, worden meegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Aukje de Vries over het bericht dat Denemarken stopt met het Janssen-vaccin in hun vaccinatieprogramma

MPs Paternotte and Aukje de Vries asked the health minister how he views Denmark dropping the Janssen vaccine from its programme, what Denmark plans for surplus Janssen and AstraZeneca doses, and what EU rules govern redistributing or exporting surplus vaccines. The minister said the Netherlands will await the new data and EMA advice, that Denmark is still deciding, that EU rules on surplus are still under discussion, and that he would buy surplus doses if offered.
I think it is important to first carefully find out on the basis of what new data Denmark reached this decision.
Ik vind het belangrijk om eerst goed uit te zoeken op basis van welke nieuwe gegevens Denemarken tot dit besluit komt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte  over het bericht dat Azerbeidzjan kritische politieke opponenten in het buitenland laat deporteren om ze vervolgens in gevangenschap te nemen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Azerbaijan has had critical opponents deported from abroad and imprisoned, specifically the case of Elvin Isayev, and whether the government would raise it with Azerbaijan's ambassador. The minister answered that the government follows the case closely but cannot independently verify the reports, notes the conviction is not final and under appeal, and says human rights are raised bilaterally and in EU and Council of Europe channels, including a planned case discussion in the EU-Azerbaijan dialogue.
The Dutch government closely follows the situation of Mr Isayev. I cannot independently verify the media reports on this.
De Nederlandse regering volgt de situatie van de heer Isayev nauwgezet. De mediaberichtgeving hierover kan ik niet op eigenstandige wijze verifiëren.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Sneller, Paternotte, Snels en Westerveld ver de financiële middelen voor toegangstesten

MPs Sneller, Paternotte, Snels and Westerveld asked the Health Minister about the roughly 925 million euro for access testing, its legal basis, the outsourcing to a private foundation, board pay, and whether funds were committed before parliamentary authorisation. The minister answered that spending is phased with go/no-go decisions, that funds were committed before formal authorisation under Comptabiliteitswet article 2.27, and that contract texts were shared with parliament, while offering to seek Auditdienst Rijk advice.
Your House was informed of the funds for phase 0 through the fourth supplementary budget of VWS on 12 March.
Uw Kamer is door middel de vierde incidentele begroting van VWS op 12 maart geïnformeerd over de middelen voor fase 0.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Kuiken, Paternotte, Aukje de Vries, Bikker en Westerveld over AstraZeneca en een nieuw advies van de Gezondheidsraad

Five MPs asked the Health Minister about EMA and other countries' age-limit decisions for AstraZeneca, vaccination gaps among vulnerable groups, and a RIVM official's remarks about surplus doses. The minister answered that the Health Council was asked urgently to reconsider, that outreach to vulnerable groups is ongoing, and that the remarks were unfortunately worded, but did not answer the final question on submitting answers by 29 April.
I asked the Health Council on 26 April to urgently advise whether the new EMA information leads to a reconsideration of the use of the AstraZeneca vaccine.
Ik heb de Gezondheidsraad op 26 april jl., gevraagd met spoed te adviseren of de nieuwe informatie van het EMA tot een heroverweging van de inzet van het AstraZeneca-vaccin leidt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Hammelburg over Europese hulp aan het zwaar door het coronavirus getroffen India

MPs Paternotte and Hammelburg asked whether the government would help India during its severe COVID-19 wave with medical supplies, vaccine production support, genome sequencing and lifting US export restrictions. The minister answered that Nederland is sending oxygen concentrators, ventilators and antivirals, funding Red Cross and Global Fund support, and that US export restrictions were lifted on 25 April.
In response, the Netherlands is sending oxygen concentrators, ventilation equipment and antiviral medicines.
In reactie daarop stuurt Nederland zuurstof-concentratoren, beademingsapparatuur en anti-virale middelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Buitenweg over het advies van de politie om na intimidatie online onder een andere naam verder te gaan

MPs Paternotte and Buitenweg asked the Justice Minister whether police advised a local politician to change his Twitter name after reporting intimidation, and how that fits with protecting free expression and with police policy on reporting online intimidation. Minister Grapperhaus confirmed the case, said police may advise victims to adjust their behaviour to end a threatening situation quickly, that the victim decides whether to follow it, and that such advice is consistent with putting victim safety first.
This advice is given on the consideration that the safety of the victim comes first or may be at risk.
Dit advies wordt gegeven uit de overweging dat de veiligheid van het slachtoffer voorop staat of mogelijkerwijs gevaar loopt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over vliegverboden en de coronasituatie in India en Zuid-Amerika

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers about travel bans and the COVID situation in India and South America, including whether the B.1.617 variant justified a flight ban on India. The minister answered that the RIVM advised no ban on India for now, that the list of banned countries is reviewed regularly, and that the government is preparing mandatory quarantine for travellers from very high-risk areas.
The RIVM has also recently indicated that it currently sees no reason to advise imposing a flight ban.
Het RIVM heeft ook recent aangegeven op dit moment geen aanleiding te zien om te adviseren een vliegverbod in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Diertens en Kuiken over het dubbele testbeleid voor vliegreizen

MPs from D66 and PvdA asked the ministers about the double testing regime for flights into the Netherlands, including data on positive tests, crew testing, quarantine compliance, airport test availability and EU coordination. The government answered that it holds no data on positive tests before departure, said compliance and crew results are not registered or are low, and maintained that pre-departure testing is more effective, while committing to extend the rapid test validity to 24 hours.
The cabinet has no data on the number of travellers who tested positive with a PCR test before they wanted to travel to the Netherlands.
Het kabinet heeft geen data over aantallen reizigers die positief zijn getest met een PCR-test voordat zij naar Nederland wilden afreizen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over het bericht ‘Vallende brokstukken in Meerssen: vliegt de luchtvaart te lang door met oude toestellen?’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about recent aircraft debris incidents involving Boeing aircraft, the age of cargo planes, and whether the government will act on fleet age and safety. The minister answered that investigations by the Dutch Safety Board and US authorities are pending, no increasing trend is observed, and no additional measures are currently warranted.
Pending the completion of the investigations by the NTSB and the OvV respectively, I cannot say anything about possible parallels.
Vooruitlopend op de afronding van de onderzoeken door respectievelijk de NTSB en de OvV kan ik niets zeggen over eventuele paralellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Westerveld over 'De tentamenzaal in ná de sneltest'

MPs Paternotte and Westerveld asked the Minister of Education about the COVID-19 rapid-test pilots that would allow more in-person education and exams, covering participating institutions, start dates, testing numbers, data sharing with the GGD and timelines. The minister answered in detail that eight regional pilots are starting, results are due by 1 May 2021, data sharing with the GGD is limited to positive results, and the cabinet will decide later on expanding in-person education.
The pilot regions have been asked to deliver results by 1 May 2021.
De pilotregio’s is gevraagd om uiterlijk 1 mei 2021 resultaten op te leveren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Paternotte over het bericht 'Ombudsman wil meer aandacht voor obstakels Caribische studenten'

MPs Diertens and Paternotte asked the ministers about the Ombudsman's report on obstacles faced by Caribbean students in Dutch higher education, including study results, healthcare, BSN numbers and loan repayment. The minister answered that the government is working on improvement measures, has commissioned research and a regional steering group, and promised further letters and investigations on several points.
I have pointed out the Ombudsman's report to my fellow education ministers in the Kingdom.
Ik heb mijn collega-ministers van onderwijs in het Koninkrijk gewezen op het rapport van de Ombudsman.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Schonis over de kosten die Transavia in rekening brengt aan consumenten die hun vlucht willen omboeken

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether Transavia's rebooking fees (up to €35 per flight) penalise passengers who follow travel advice, and whether the Flex package and the 2020 advice changes justify this. The minister answered that fees reflect Transavia's business decision, that many destinations were orange rather than yellow, that the government urged people not to travel, and that the minister has no plans to push Transavia for flexibility.
Transavia makes a business-economic assessment to charge passengers who want to rebook their flight.
Transavia maakt een bedrijfseconomische afweging om kosten in rekening te brengen aan passagiers die hun vlucht willen omboeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis, Paternotte en Veldman over de handhaving van de negatieve PCR-testuitslag en verklaring voor inreizen of transit in Nederland

MPs Schonis, Paternotte and Veldman asked how compliance with the mandatory negative PCR test requirement for travellers entering the Netherlands is enforced, including spot checks, bus and train stations, testing on arrival, and exemptions for vaccinated travellers. The minister answered that carriers must check 100% of passengers with sanctions available, veiligheidsregio's perform spot checks, arrival testing and vaccination exemptions were not adopted, and enforcement is via fines and orders under administrative coercion.
The safety regions carry out spot checks among arriving passengers to see whether the airline and ferry companies comply sufficiently.
De veiligheidsregio's doen steekproeven onder aankomende passagiers om te zien of de naleving door de luchtvaart- en ferrymaatschappijen voldoende is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Verhoeven, Van Helvert en Van der Molen over het bericht dat er tientallen communistische partijcomités binnen Nederlandse bedrijven in China bestaan

MPs from D66 and CDA asked the government whether it knew of Chinese Communist Party committees in Dutch companies in China, what economic or strategic effects this has, whether the government has agreements with these firms, and whether intellectual property is being stolen. The minister answers that the government is aware of such committees and offers general advice to firms, cites an EU Chamber survey suggesting limited influence, says precise numbers of party-linked board members are not held, and declines to comment on intelligence investigations.
The cabinet does not publicly comment on specific investigations by the Dutch intelligence and security services.
Over specifieke onderzoeken van de Nederlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten doet het kabinet in het openbaar geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over discriminerend beleid binnen studentenorganisaties

An MP asked the education minister about discriminatory membership and officer policies at student organisations and whether they should lose public funding. The minister said no national criteria exist for subsidies or board grants, gave grant figures for Navigators branches, and stated that discrimination on sexual orientation is prohibited, but saw no reason for new measures beyond institutional dialogue.
I therefore see no reason to take further measures at this time.
Ik zie derhalve geen reden nu nadere maatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Diertens over besmetting aan boord van vliegtuigen

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers of Infrastructure and Water Management and of Health about in-flight COVID-19 transmission on a Dubai to Auckland flight, the role of APUs and masks, and the status of the NLR/RIVM study. The minister acknowledged that some measures were not fully applied on the flight, explained APU use and mask exceptions, pointed to layered measures and new flight bans, and said the study report is expected around March.
The aviation committee debate of 4 February has been postponed.
Het AO Luchtvaart van 4 februari jl. is uitgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Paternotte over het bericht 'VK scherpt inreisregels aan'

MPs Kröger and Paternotte asked the minister how the Netherlands would prevent spread of the new Brazilian COVID-19 variant, including flight numbers from affected areas, rapid tests before departure and quarantine compliance. The minister answered that flight bans were imposed on the UK, South Africa, Brazil and other countries, that travellers need negative PCR or rapid test results, that a quarantine obligation is being examined, and that Schiphol flights from Brazil were zero per day while Portugal averaged three.
The cabinet is currently examining whether a quarantine obligation can be introduced.
Het kabinet onderzoekt momenteel of er een quarantaineplicht kan worden ingevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Diertens over het bericht dat het reisadvies van Curaçao naar oranje is bijgesteld

Two D66 MPs asked why the travel advice for Curaçao was changed to orange only on 8 December 2020 despite a record number of infections, how many Dutch travellers had booked trips, and why returning travellers from Curaçao were not tested while Atlanta flights were. Minister De Jonge answered that the advice followed rising infections and that Curaçao is no longer a high-risk area since 8 January, so no PCR or antigen test is required, while giving partial figures on travel volumes and declining to address booking numbers directly.
Can you answer these questions within a week, given the start of the Christmas holiday next week?
Vraag 12 Kunt u, vanwege de start van de kerstvakantie volgende week, deze vragen binnen een week beantwoorden?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Diertens over reizen tijdens de coronacrisis

Two D66 MPs asked ministers why travel advice for Curaçao and other Caribbean and Canary Island destinations seemed inconsistent with the Prime Minister's call not to travel abroad, and why airlines were promoting trips. The ministers answered that a worldwide orange travel advice now applies, that airlines and tour operators agreed to limit package holidays and add PCR and rapid testing requirements, and that testing of arriving travellers is being assessed for capacity.
On 15 December 2020 the travel advice was adjusted worldwide to orange.
Op 15 december 2020 is het reisadvies wereldwijd aangepast naar oranje.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Paternotte over het bericht 'Belgen krabbelen terug: eis negatieve test alleen voor wie langer dan 48 uur in België blijft'

MPs Schonis and Paternotte (D66) asked ministers about Belgium's COVID-19 negative-test requirement for travellers staying over 48 hours, its consultation with the Netherlands and border municipalities, and whether the Netherlands could impose a similar test requirement. The minister answered that consultation with Belgian and Dutch authorities took place, that the 48-hour rule benefits cross-border workers, that the Netherlands extended negative-test requirements to certain high-risk arrivals from 29 December, and that extending it to car traffic would require legislative change.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Bouali over het bericht '5 things to know about Post-Brexit aviation'

D66 MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the effects of a no-deal Brexit on aviation, including emergency measures, route permits, border checks and a possible return to the 1946 bilateral air agreement. The minister answered that an EU emergency measure would serve as the fallback, that a bilateral agreement is not currently needed, and that several matters remain undecided.
It is not precisely clear what Minister Shapps means by his remark about 'sensible additional flexibilities' and I do not want to anticipate this at this stage.
Het is niet precies duidelijk wat Minister Shapps met zijn opmerking over «sensible additional flexibilities» bedoelt en ik wil daar in dit stadium ook niet op vooruitlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Kröger, Bruins, Remco Dijkstra, Amhaouch, Gijs van Dijk, Van Brenk, Laçin, Stoffer, Krol, Van Kooten-Arissen en Van Raan over een overvol Schiphol

Opposition MPs asked the government about overcrowding and queues at Schiphol, adherence to COVID-19 distancing rules, travel advice, the Brexit and testing effects on arrivals, and whether flight bans or test facilities would be used. The ministers answered that Schiphol is required to prevent queues and enforce rules, that a flight ban is currently undesirable, and that testing and an air corridor pilot are being developed, with several questions combined.
We asked Schiphol for clarification and said they must take action to ensure the measures are complied with.
Wij hebben Schiphol om opheldering gevraagd en gezegd dat zij actie moeten ondernemen om te zorgen dat de maatregelen worden nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Van Helvert en Paternotte over het bericht ’Internationale steun voor Einstein Telescope groeit; 'Toponderzoeksproject met een wereldwijde impact'

Three MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about international support for the Einstein Telescope, including Italian and German funding, the Recovery Fund, and whether the project can be submitted to the National Growth Fund. The minister confirmed a meeting with North Rhine-Westphalia, declined to comment on Italian budget financing, said the bid process and criteria are still being designed, and that no project announcements will be made before the Growth Fund review.
I am aware that funds are being made available in both locations, in Italy and the Euregio, for research into the suitability of the site.
Het is mij bekend dat op beide locaties, zowel in Italië als de Euregio, middelen ter beschikking worden gesteld voor het onderzoek naar de geschiktheid van de locatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Diertens over het plots sluiten van de teststraat op Schiphol

MPs Paternotte and Diertens (D66) asked the Health Minister why the Schiphol testing facility for travellers from high-risk areas was suddenly closed, whether it was a trial, and related questions on testing policy. The minister answered that the facility was a voluntary sample-based trial, closed because of pressure on lab capacity, and provided some figures but gave only partial answers on the trial design and did not commit to reopening.
The intention to close the test facility once the trial results came in is indeed something I did not mention.
Het voornemen om de teststraat weer te sluiten nadat de resultaten van de proef binnen zouden komen, heb ik inderdaad niet genoemd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Paternotte over de mogelijkheid tot sneltesten op Schiphol

MPs Bruins and Paternotte asked the government about testing at Schiphol airport, including implementing the motion on comprehensive airport testing, discouraging air travel to risk areas, introducing rapid tests and a Dutch-style mandatory testing model, and charging travellers for tests. The minister answered that mandatory negative tests for necessary travel from risk areas are planned, that testing on day 5 after arrival is being examined, and that rapid tests cannot yet be validated for asymptomatic testing, while the Israeli gargle test is still under evaluation.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens, Paternotte en Pia Dijkstra over de kabinetsreactie op het 73e OMT COVID-19 advies en de berichten over het testbeleid van Duitsland en Frankrijk, respectievelijk het bericht over

MPs from D66 asked the health and infrastructure ministers about testing of travellers from high-risk countries, airport contact tracing, air cargo capacity and pricing for vaccine distribution, and EU vaccine negotiations. The ministers answered that testing and quarantine measures are being developed, that contact tracing follows RIVM guidance, and that logistics preparations and EU negotiations are ongoing, but declined to answer each question separately.
Unfortunately, this has not proven possible.
Dit is helaas niet mogelijk gebleken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot en Paternotte over het artikel ‘Losser wil pilotgebied worden voor uitwisseling duurzame energie met Duitsland’

MPs Sienot and Paternotte asked whether cross-border medium-voltage electricity exchange between Dutch, German and Belgian border municipalities could be enabled, and whether Losser, Emmen and Kerkrade could be designated pilot Local Energy Communities. Minister Wiebes answered that EU rules on interconnection must be kept, that he will not change them, and that he will not designate pilot areas because communities can be set up by residents and municipalities themselves.
These European rules and principles I cannot and will not change.
Deze Europese spelregels en principes kan en wil ik niet veranderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over het bericht 'Radboud Universiteit en Radboudumc in Nijmegen mogen zich niet langer 'katholiek' noemen'

An MP asked the Minister of Education about the Radboud University and Radboudumc losing the 'Catholic' label, the Bishops' Conference's role in appointing supervisory board members, and whether church-based appointment rules are compatible with constitutional and equal-treatment law. The Minister answered that the Bishops' Conference rejected five nominations, that the foundation's governance codes apply, that the institutions' freedom of religion permits such requirements within equal-treatment limits, and that no Inspectorate investigation is planned.
On the basis of this case, but also in general, I see no reason to question the independence and composition of the supervisory boards of universities and colleges.

Ik heb op grond van de onderhavige casus, maar ook in zijn algemeenheid, geen aanleiding om de onafhankelijkheid en samenstelling van de raden van toezicht van universiteiten en hogescholen ter discussie te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Raemakers over het artikel ‘Buitenlandse Artsen in Nederland: ‘Ik denk dat niemand mij zal bellen’

MPs Paternotte and Raemakers asked the ministers about a press article on foreign-trained doctors facing long, costly re-qualification procedures and about the abolition of the supervised-practice scheme. The minister said patient safety comes first, promised to explore streamlining the procedure with the CBGV and VBGA, and gave historical and procedural explanations.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Bruins over het tekort aan luchtverkeersleiders op Eindhoven Airport en Groningen Eelde Airport

MPs Paternotte and Bruins asked the minister about air traffic controller shortages at Eindhoven, Groningen Eelde and Maastricht airports, and about accelerating integration of military and civilian air traffic control. The minister acknowledged staffing shortages and outlined recruitment and harmonisation steps, but declined to speed up integration and said reassignment of controllers to other airports is not currently feasible.
Accelerating the full integration, planned for the third quarter of 2023, is not possible given the scale and necessary care of the integration process.
Een versnelling van de volledige integratie, die voorzien is in het derde kwartaal van 2023, is niet mogelijk gegeven de omvang en noodzakelijke zorgvuldigheid van het integratie proces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg, Paternotte en Raemakers over het tekort aan virusremmer remdesivir tegen corona

Three MPs asked the Health Minister how many remdesivir doses the EU allocated to the Netherlands, when shortages became clear, how the EU distributes supply, and whether shortages would persist. The minister answered that the Netherlands received 24,000 doses for October, that EU allocation follows hospital admission incidence, and that a monthly supply contract with Gilead now applies, though precise longer-term supply and the effect of shortages remain unknown.
The Netherlands was allocated 24,000 doses (for about 4,000 patients) for the month of October.
Nederland heeft voor de maand oktober een hoeveelheid van 24.000 doses (voor ongeveer 4000 patiënten) toegewezen gekregen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Paternotte over het anticiperen op de testcapaciteit in Nederland en het plotseling stoppen met testen van reizigers uit oranje gebieden op Schiphol

MPs Diertens and Paternotte (D66) asked the Health Minister about anticipating testing capacity and the sudden halt of testing travellers from orange-zone countries at Schiphol. The minister's answers describe RIVM capacity estimates, expansion steps, the Schiphol test-street pilot, and its temporary suspension due to lab capacity pressure.
The research on asymptomatic testing in the context of the Schiphol test street will soon be shared with the House.
Het onderzoek naar asymptomatisch testen in het kader van de teststraat op Schiphol wordt binnenkort gedeeld met Uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Diertens over drie studies over besmettingen aan boord van het vliegtuig

MPs Paternotte and Diertens asked the minister about three studies on COVID-19 transmission aboard aircraft and whether they justify concern, pre-flight screening and whether RIVM's literature review will be shared. The minister replied that the cases date from before the sector's measures, that existing protocols and RIVM advice remain in place, that testing cannot be mandated under current law, and that a literature report will be shared around mid-October.
I will inform your House about this.
Ik zal uw Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Kröger en Paternotte over de stikstofberekeningen 2014 Lelystad Airport

MPs Bruins, Kröger and Paternotte asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why the 2014 nitrogen deposition calculations for Lelystad Airport's environmental impact report (MER) were corrected, covering routes, study area, time units, deposition summation and software. The minister answered in detail, attributing the discrepancies to a units error, an enlarged study area, a summation error on a computer system, and stating that the corrected deposition is at most 0.4 mol/ha/year and that the result files have been made public under the Wob.
This correction led to an increase in emissions by a factor of 5 (rounded).
Dit herstel heeft geleid tot een toename van de emissies met een factor 5 (afgerond).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Wiersma, Paternotte en Bruins over het bericht 'NWO lijkt haar jonge onderzoekers te zijn vergeten'

Four MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how the government will protect Rubicon fellows researching abroad whose projects were delayed by the COVID-19 crisis and who fall outside Dutch institutions' support measures. The minister answered that a limited earmarked amount of up to 20 million euros will be allocated to NWO via a policy rule for researchers in the final phase of temporary contracts, while declining to commit additional funds from her own budget and noting the number of affected fellows is not yet known.
However, I will give NWO a general directive in the form of a policy rule of up to 20 million euros, to be deducted from the next funding round of the National Science Agenda.
Wel zal ik NWO een [algemene] aanwijzing geven in de vorm van een beleidsregel van maximaal € 20 miljoen, in mindering te brengen op de volgende financieringsronde van de Nationale Wetenschapsagenda.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Paternotte over overschrijdingen van de geluidsnormen bij Schiphol

MPs Kröger and Paternotte asked the minister why Schiphol exceeded noise norms in 2019 under the new standards, whether enforcement is possible, and how the new regime will be legally anchored. The minister answered that exceedances at 6 of 35 enforcement points stem from strict preferential runway use under the new regime, that the ILT will not sanction such exceedances, and that legal anchoring awaits environmental and nature assessments.
Enforcement of the rules and limit values of the NNHS as such is only possible after they are legally anchored in the LVB.
Handhaving van de regels en grenswaarden van het NNHS als zodanig is pas mogelijk na wettelijke verankering daarvan in het LVB.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over het bericht 'Studentenorganisaties vrezen hogere studie-uitval door coronamaatregelen'

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Education about student organisations' fears that COVID measures would raise dropout, and about support for first-year students, the use of study-deal funds, the ETHO expert group and a joint handbook. The Minister replied that institutions are maintaining student bonding with online and offline programmes, pointed to a welfare handbook and to institution-level quality agreements that allow local adjustments, confirmed the ETHO group will be housed at NRO, and agreed to discuss the handbook with stakeholders.
I appreciate the efforts and contribution of LSVb and ISO to create good bonding for new students with their study, city and fellow students.
Ik waardeer de inzet en bijdrage van LSVb en ISO om een goede binding te creëren voor de nieuwe studenten met de studie, stad en medestudenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Paternotte over de beantwoording van eerdere vragen over het bericht dat een Amerikaanse farmaceut een Nederlands coronamedicijn in productie neemt

MPs Paternotte and Pia Dijkstra asked why the government was not involved in negotiations between an American pharmaceutical firm and Dutch research institutions over a Dutch COVID-19 drug licence, despite public funding, and whether the MVL licensing principles guarantee affordability and availability, including under possible US export restrictions. Minister De Jonge answered that IP ownership lies with the universities, that the government has expectations but no direct role, that the MVL principles will be applied but are not legally binding, and that a licensing toolbox will be delivered by late August.
As long as we do not know what the actual provisions are on which the described collaboration is based, any statement from me on this would be speculative.
Zolang we niet weten wat de daadwerkelijke bepalingen zijn waarop de beschreven samenwerking is gebaseerd zou elke uitspraak mijnerzijds hierover speculatief zijn.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Diertens over de berichten 'Coronateststraat Schiphol voorlopig maar beperkt open voor hoog risicopassagiers' en 'Mandatory coronavirus testing at airports in Germany off to

Two D66 MPs asked the health minister about reports that the Schiphol testing facility was only partly open to high-risk arrivals and why not all travellers from risk areas are tested, unlike in Germany, asking about capacity, prioritisation, and missing entry controls. The minister's reply, sent by letter on testing and tracing, is referenced but the substantive answers are not reproduced in the text provided.
Questions from MPs Paternotte and Diertens (both D66) to the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about the reports
Vragen van de leden Paternotte en Diertens (beiden D66) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de berichten
Antwoord op ragen van de leden Kröger, Paternotte, Gijs van Dijk, Van Raan, Öztürk, Bruins, Amhaouch, Laçin, Van Kooten-Arissen, Van Brenk en Stoffer over de teststraat op Schiphol

Eleven MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the Schiphol COVID-19 test facility should be scaled up and extended to match arrivals from orange-code countries such as Spain and France, and whether all travellers from those areas could be tested on arrival at Dutch airports. The answer, sent via a letter from Minister De Jonge, refers to the broader testing and tracing letter and does not address the specific questions.

The written questions from the eleven MPs to the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management, submitted 27 August 2020, have been answered by a letter titled 'Testing and tracing: together strategically combating the Corona pandemic'.

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Kröger (GroenLinks), Paternotte (D66), Gijs van Dijk (PvdA), Van Raan (PvdD), Öztürk (Denk), Bruins (ChristenUnie), Amhaouch (CDA), Laçin (SP), Van Kooten-Arissen (Van Kooten-Arissen), Van Brenk (50PLUS) en Stoffer (SGP) aan de Minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat ingezonden 27 augustus 2020, zijn beantwoord middels brief «Testen en traceren: samen strategisch de Corona-pandemie bestrijden».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Diertens over het stijgend aantal besmettingen met COVID-19 i.r.t. terugkerende vluchten

Two D66 MPs asked the Ministers of Health and of Infrastructure about rising COVID-19 infections linked to returning flights, including how many infected travellers came from which regions, whether there is insight into flights' contribution, whether arriving travellers with symptoms are tested, whether fellow passengers are tested, and what measures would follow if infections keep rising. The government answered that flight-linked cases appear to be a limited share of total new infections, that testing and symptom checks at airports exist, that close contacts are traced, and that a quarantine obligation for travellers from high-risk areas is being prepared through a change to the Public Health Act.
The reason for the trip is not passed on to the GGD.
De reden van de reis wordt niet doorgegeven aan de GGD.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Paternotte over het bericht ’Groningen Airport Eelde soms dicht door tekort luchtverkeersleiders’

MPs Bruins and Paternotte asked the minister whether Groningen Airport Eelde is sometimes closed due to a shortage of air traffic controllers, whether a medical flight was cancelled, and how controller capacity is distributed across airports. The minister denies closures and cancellations on the ground, acknowledges tight staffing at GAE and Maastricht, and says LVNL has adequate staff during official opening hours and will keep monitoring the situation.
That is not correct. Air Traffic Control Netherlands (LVNL) makes agreements with Groningen Airport Eelde (GAE) and other parties concerned about the services provided at the airport.
Dat klopt niet. Luchtverkeersleiding Nederland (LVNL) maakt samen met Groningen Airport Eelde (GAE) en andere betrokken partijen afspraken over de dienstverlening op de luchthaven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over de ballonvaartsector

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the balloon aviation sector, which has been shut down during the coronavirus crisis, including support schemes for small commercial aviation, the NOTAM restrictions, and the difference in corona rules between general and small commercial aviation. The minister answered that balloon firms can use generic schemes and Tozo, that a budget for balloon aviation is being worked out, that the NOTAM exception was lifted on 10 July 2020, and that differences reflect sector-specific protocols.
Due to the easing measures the cabinet adopted on 10 July, balloon pilots can fly under the established protocols and the exceptional position has been lifted.
Door de versoepelingsmaatregelen die het kabinet heeft genomen op 10 juli jl. kunnen de ballonvaarders volgens de vastgestelde protocollen varen en is de uitzonderingspositie opgeheven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg, Groothuizen en Paternotte over het bericht ‘Geef kennismigranten en internationaal talent meer zekerheid tijdens de coronacrisis’

Three D66 MPs asked whether knowledge migrants and international students in the Netherlands should get more legal certainty during the COVID-19 crisis, including relaxed study-progress rules, extended job-search periods, and deadlines. The government answered that it will not impose consequences on temporary salary-criterion breaches under the Wtv scheme, offers flexibility on study progress and language tests, and is only exploring a broader interpretation of job-search rules, with no firm extension of the search period.

When insufficient study progress is caused by the coronavirus crisis, institutions can treat this as an excusable reason for the study delay, and this has no consequences for the student's residence permit.

Wanneer onvoldoende studievoortgang is veroorzaakt door de coronacrisis, kunnen instellingen dit aanmerken als een verschoonbare reden voor de studievertraging en heeft dit geen gevolgen voor de verblijfsvergunning van de student.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Diertens en Kröger over niet-essentiële reizen naar risicogebieden tijdens de coronacrisis

MPs Paternotte, Diertens and Kröger asked why Dutch nationals may still travel for holidays to non-EU risk areas while residents of those countries cannot enter the Netherlands, and how the travel advice and quarantine recommendation are enforced. The minister answered that the entry ban was lifted for 15 countries from 1 July, that holiday travel is treated as non-essential but the decision is left to the traveller under the principle of own responsibility, and that enforcement relies on airlines and border checks while quarantine advice cannot be enforced.
Quarantine at home after visiting a risk area is indeed an urgent recommendation and in that sense cannot be enforced.
Thuisquarantaine na bezoek aan een risicogebied is inderdaad een dringend advies en is in die zin niet handhaafbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat een Amerikaanse farmaceut een Nederlands coronamedicijn in productie neemt

Two D66 MPs asked the health minister about reports that an American pharmaceutical firm would mass-produce a Dutch COVID-19 antibody drug, including the government's role, licensing terms, export risks and European production. The minister answered that he was not involved in licensing talks, that UMC licensing principles would apply, and that export-restriction questions were premature.
Conversations of this kind are usually confidential, and I have no further information about them.
Dit type gesprekken verloopt in de regel vertrouwelijk, ik heb hier verder geen informatie over.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Paternotte en Kröger over het rapport Evaluatie stikstofberekeningen Lelystad Airport (advies 3456) van de Commissie voor de m.e.r. d.d. 31 maart 2020

Three MPs asked the ministers whether AERIUS applies SRM2 to road traffic deposition and OPS to other sectors, and why SRM2 is cut off at 5 km, given the Commission's evaluation and TNO's 2015 audit. The minister confirmed the SRM2/OPS split and defended the 5 km cut-off as consistent with the NSL tool and past Raad van State acceptance, while promising a broader cabinet response after the summer.

The cabinet will come after the summer with a more extensive substantive cabinet response to both the final advice of the Nitrogen Problem Advisory Committee and the final report of the Nitrogen Measurement and Calculation Advisory Committee.

Het kabinet komt na de zomer met een uitgebreidere inhoudelijke kabinetsreactie op zowel het eindadvies van het Adviescollege Stikstofproblematiek als het eindrapport van het Adviescollege Meten en Berekenen Stikstof.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Schonis over het besluit om de ILT te verzoeken tot handhaving Verordening (EG) 261/2004 passagiersrechten luchtvaart

MPs Paternotte and Schonis asked whether the government's instruction to the ILT not to enforce EU passenger refund rules for COVID-era flight vouchers, and the planned withdrawal of that instruction, leaves consumers exposed to delayed refunds and airline insolvency. The minister answered that the instruction is withdrawn so the ILT resumes enforcing Regulation 261/2004, that the ILT can act against systematic non-compliance but not individual refund delays, and that the government has lobbied the European Commission for an EU guarantee on vouchers.
With this, the ILT will again enforce Regulation (EC) 261/2004.
Daarmee gaat de ILT de Verordening (EG) 261/2004 weer handhaven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Diertens over veiligheidsmaatregelen voor vliegtuigpassagiers en -personeel

MPs Paternotte, Diertens and Bruins asked about aircraft transmission risks of COVID-19 (drawing on SARS-1 evidence), EASA/ECDC guidance, and whether the OMT should advise on flying. Minister De Jonge answered that protocols were drafted by the sector based on RIVM advice, measures are indefinite, evidence on in-flight transmission is limited, and the OMT has not been asked but RIVM has advised twice.
On the basis of existing literature, no sound comparison can be made between transmission of SARS-CoV-1 and SARS-CoV-2 on aircraft.
Er kan op basis van bestaande literatuur geen goed vergelijk worden gemaakt tussen overdracht van SARS-CoV-1 en SARS-CoV-2 in vliegtuigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer, Paternotte en Van Eijs over de berichten dat studenten boetes ontvangen voor groepsvorming in eigen huis

MPs from D66 asked the Justice Minister whether fines for student house gatherings under emergency COVID-19 ordinances are proportionate, consistent and correctly applied. The minister answered that the ban applies only to public space, that the Leiden fines were withdrawn, that enforcement guidance is national but allows local discretion, and that a bill is being prepared to clarify household definitions.
The fines imposed in Leiden mentioned above have been withdrawn, because it later became clear that the emergency ordinance was not applied correctly.
De bovengenoemde boetes die zijn opgelegd in Leiden zijn ingetrokken, omdat achteraf is gebleken dat de noodverordening niet op juiste wijze is toegepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Paternotte, Bruins en Van Raan over het basisjaar van CORSIA

Four MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether moving CORSIA's baseline year to 2019, possibly delaying offsetting obligations until 2023, is desirable given climate goals, and what the Dutch position is. The Minister answered that Netherlands prefers keeping the current baseline, treats baseline change as a fallback, that the Council decision is only a negotiating mandate, and that the 2019 baseline would be evaluated in 2022.
The starting point for the Netherlands is preserving the current ambition.
Het uitgangspunt voor Nederland is behoud van de huidige ambitie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Paternotte, Bruins, Van Raan en Stoffer over het basisjaar voor CORSIA

MPs from GroenLinks, D66, ChristenUnie, PvdD and SGP asked whether the Netherlands agreed to move the CORSIA baseline to 2019, how that fits earlier ambitious commitments, and why the government did not follow a motion requiring coordination with the House. The minister denied agreeing to a baseline change, saying the EU instruction only allows adjustment if needed to preserve global support, and promised to inform the House of further developments.
Of course I will keep the House continuously informed about new developments.
Uiteraard zal ik de Kamer blijvend informeren over nieuwe ontwikkelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Schonis over het uitreiken van 'coronavouchers' door reisorganisaties en het bericht 'Europese Commissie handhaaft recht op geld terug bij annulering'

MPs Paternotte and Schonis asked whether consumers must still pay travel-operator deposits and accept vouchers instead of refunds for cancelled trips, and whether the minister's instruction to the ILT not to enforce refund rules for airline vouchers conflicts with EU law. The minister answered that consumers keep a legal refund right enforceable in court, that the ILT's instruction was withdrawn so Regulation 261/2004 is enforced again, and that the government supports voucher attractiveness and a possible EU voucher guarantee while promising further letters.
A passenger has a statutory right to a refund and can enforce it through the court, possibly with help from a claims bureau.
Een passagier heeft een wettelijk recht op terugbetaling en kan dat afdwingen via de rechtbank, eventueel met hulp van een claimbureau.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Paternotte over het in gevaar brengen van Nederlanders door het in brand steken van zendmasten

MPs Verhoeven and Paternotte asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate and the Minister of Justice and Security about arson attacks on mobile telecom masts linked to 5G conspiracy theories, including the number of incidents, impact on emergency services, protective measures and EU coordination. The government reported 29 registered arson incidents, no prior precedent in the Netherlands, that emergency number 1-1-2 was affected at least once, that the most critical C2000 masts will be secured within about three months, and that the matter was raised at an informal EU Telecom Council.
For security reasons I will not go into the specific protective measures.
Vanuit veiligheidsoogpunt ga ik niet in op de specifieke beveiligingsmaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Van der Molen over het bericht 'Oplossing voor onderzoekers aan universiteiten hard nodig'

MPs Paternotte and Van der Molen asked the minister about the precarious funding and temporary contracts of university researchers during the COVID-19 crisis, including NWO call delays and extensions. The minister gave data on project funding shares, said NWO is restarting procedures and handling extensions case by case, and said universities can resume on-site research within RIVM rules, without committing to new structural measures.
The aim is to not let any researchers fall between two stools.
Doel is om geen onderzoekers tussen wal en schip te laten vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot, De Groot, Van Eijs, Paternotte en Schonis over het bericht ‘Dutch spell out green ideas for EU recovery fund’

D66 MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Climate and of Agriculture about a Dutch non-paper proposing a green EU recovery, including conditioning state aid on the national climate plan, early energy and circular investments, and an exclusion list for the Just Transition Fund. The government said the non-paper was an informal civil-servant document, declined to share such papers routinely, and gave largely non-committal answers, deferring concrete national plans until after the Commission's proposals and an August decision.
However, the cabinet considers sharing all such informal civil-servant lobbying documents at all times neither opportune nor desirable for effective Dutch advocacy in Brussels.
Echter, het kabinet acht het te allen tijde delen van al deze ambtelijke beïnvloedingsdocumenten niet opportuun noch wenselijk voor effectieve Nederlandse belangenbehartiging in Brussel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Nijboer en Sneller over het uitblijven van resultaten na de aankoop van aandelen van Air France – KLM

MPs asked the Finance Minister about the state's stake in Air France-KLM, IATA board seats, the Franse pilot agreements and KLM dividend policy. The minister answered that IATA matters are for airlines, that the Franco-Dutch talks are ongoing without interim detail, and that KLM's dividend is decided by its supervisory board and priority shareholders.
Besides the fact that Air France-KLM is a listed company, it is also not constructive to share interim information about these talks.
Naast het feit dat Air France-KLM een beursgenoteerde onderneming is, is het ook niet constructief om tussentijds iets te delen over deze gesprekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Paternotte over het bericht ‘Belangenverstrengeling zaait twijfels over giftig zaad’

MPs De Groot and Paternotte asked whether industry co-funding of research on bee decline, pesticide approval studies and Wageningen University & Research (WUR) funding compromise independence, and whether pesticide studies should be public. The minister answered that the 2011 bee study was fully publicly funded, that WUR's private co-funding is limited and governed by integrity rules, that pesticide approval relies on company-funded but quality-checked studies with some publication, and that open access is a policy goal.
Underlying studies can be made public on request, within the limits of European and national legislation.
Onderliggende studies kunnen op verzoek openbaar worden gemaakt, binnen de grenzen van Europese en nationale wetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Verhoeven over het bericht 'Studenten protesteren tegen tentamensoftware die beelden van hun huiskamer opslaat'

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Education about student protests against online exam proctoring software that records images of students' homes, asking which institutions use it, whether providers comply with the GDPR, whether students can be excluded for refusing extra personal data, and whether alternatives can be offered. The minister answered that institutions are responsible for GDPR compliance and transparency, that refusing proctoring is allowed but alternatives are limited during the Covid crisis, and that the government is exploring easing measures so on-site examinations can resume.
It is up to the educational institutions to properly inform students about the use and functioning of the proctoring software, for example through a privacy statement.
Het is aan de onderwijsinstellingen om de studenten goed te informeren over het gebruik en de werking van de proctoring software, bijvoorbeeld middels een privacyverklaring.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Paternotte over het openhouden van vliegroutes van en naar Spanje ondanks snelle toename aantal besmettingen

D66 MPs asked why flight routes from Spain stayed open while infection numbers rose quickly, comparing this with the ban on flights from Italy and asking for a stricter flight ban and monitoring. The minister answered that multiple factors inform flight restrictions, pointed to EASA high-risk country measures and RIVM advice, and said monitoring continues without committing to a ban on Spain.
We are continuously monitoring and advising on whether additional measures for air traffic are needed.
Wij zijn continu bezig met het monitoren en advies of er aanvullende maatregelen voor het luchtverkeer nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Verhoeven over luchtvaart tijdens de Coronacrisis

MPs Paternotte and Verhoeven asked the ministers about aviation crew and passenger safety during COVID-19, including RIVM distancing compliance, empty middle seats, service restrictions, crew hotel conditions, arrival advice, flight bans and Schiphol rent relief. The ministers largely answered by pointing to EASA guidance, airline responsibility and existing measures, committing only to monitoring the crew hotel situation.
Airlines are best placed themselves to organise maximum spacing in aircraft, and it does not seem wise for us to determine which specific seats may or may not be occupied.

Luchtvaartmaatschappijen zijn zelf het beste in staat om maximale spreiding in vliegtuigen te organiseren en het lijkt ons niet verstandig dat wij gaan bepalen welke specifieke stoelen wel of niet bezet kunnen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Paternotte over de uitgifte van vouchers door luchtvaartmaatschappijen bij vluchtannuleringen vanwege Covid-19

MPs Schonis and Paternotte asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about airline vouchers issued instead of refunds for Covid-19 cancellations, including validity periods, credit card chargebacks, insolvency protection and whether non-enforcement by the ILT deviates from EU rules. The minister answered that vouchers are valid at least twelve months with refund available after six months on request, that enforcement is waived by directive, that she is pursuing an EU guarantee scheme and a fund, and that she has informed the Commission and transport ministers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Gijs van Dijk en Bruins over het bericht in The Guardian ‘Heathrow third runway ruled illegal over climate change’

Three MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the UK Court of Appeal ruling that Heathrow's third runway plan was unlawful under climate commitments affects Dutch aviation policy, including CO2 assessment in environmental impact reports for Schiphol and Lelystad Airport and progress on the sector's emissions targets. The minister answered that the Netherlands is bound by the Paris Agreement, that the UK ruling concerns UK law and is not for the Dutch government to judge, that CO2 from landing and take-off cycles is assessed in the Lelystad and Schiphol reports, and that the sector's targets and the Sustainable Aviation Roundtable process are still being developed.
It is not for me to form a judgement on the ruling of the British judge and on whether it is appropriate and desirable.
Het is niet aan mij om een oordeel te vormen over de uitspraak van de Britse rechter en in hoeverre deze al dan niet passend en wenselijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Peters, Paternotte en Segers over het zo snel mogelijk invoeren van de inburgeringsplicht van Turkse asielstatushouders

Four MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether Turkish asylum status holders can be made subject to civic integration duties from 1 May 2020 before the new law takes effect, and how COVID-19 measures apply to civic integration. The minister confirmed the duty will apply from 1 May 2020, the opt-in scheme will lapse for new holders, and the civic integration deadline is extended by two months for everyone due to the crisis.
Yes, I will act on this from 1 May 2020.
Ja, ik zal hier per 1 mei 2020 gevolg aan geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Sienot over het bericht “CO2-compensatie is misleidend en ‘nattevingerwerk’” gepubliceerd in Trouw van 13 februari 2020

MPs Paternotte and Sienot asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that CO2 offsetting is misleading and unreliable, and whether this distorts aviation emissions claims and consumer choices. The minister answered that CORSIA's internationally set eligibility criteria and the Technical Advisory Board govern certificate quality, that the voluntary market is not supervised, and referred consumer and voluntary-market questions to a separate letter from the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate.
No supervision takes place over the quality of certificates that airlines voluntarily buy on the market.
Op de kwaliteit van certificaten die luchtvaartmaatschappijen vrijwillig kopen in de markt vindt geen toezicht plaats
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Sjoerdsma over hulp voor Nederlandse uitwisselingsstudenten, stagiairs en instellingen voor hoger onderwijs met de situatie rond het coronavirus

Two D66 MPs asked the education and foreign affairs ministers how universities and universities of applied sciences help exchange students and interns stranded abroad by COVID-19 travel restrictions, including repatriation, study delay funding and whether countries are expelling students. The minister says institutions are supporting students, gives partial abroad counts and points to existing DUO loan and funding options, and says that contacts with foreign affairs and airlines continue, without new binding commitments.
Because developments keep changing and differ by country, it is difficult to determine at this moment exactly how many students abroad are involved.
Vanwege de steeds veranderende ontwikkelingen die ook nog eens per land verschillen is het lastig om op dit moment precies in kaart te brengen om welke aantallen studenten in het buitenland het gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht 'Consumentenorganisaties: hef 25 cent per vliegticket voor garantiefonds'

MPs Paternotte and Gijs van Dijk asked whether Dutch consumers have legal guarantees when buying flight tickets compared with package holidays, and whether a Danish-style guarantee fund should be introduced. The minister answered that package travel is legally protected against insolvency while loose flight tickets are not, pointed to private protections such as credit cards, insurance and rescue fares, and declined for now to investigate a guarantee fund.
I see no reason for now to examine a guarantee fund for flight tickets in the Netherlands further.
Zie ik vooralsnog geen aanleiding om een garantiefonds vliegtickets in Nederland nader te onderzoeken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Remco Dijkstra, Amhaouch en Bruins over ongewenste effecten van de werking van historische rechten op slots in relatie tot de disruptie veroorzaakt door het coronavirus (IATA r

MPs asked whether the minister would press the European Commission to suspend slot 'use-it-or-lose-it' rules for 2020 at the request of IATA, given coronavirus disruption to air travel and the risk of empty flights. The minister agreed in principle, said the Commission would be asked to extend the existing waiver for the summer season and widen it to all severely affected countries, but declined to provide load-factor data citing commercial confidentiality.

I have asked the European Commission to extend its current waiver of the slot rules for preserving historic rights for the IATA winter season 2019/2020 in connection with the coronavirus into the upcoming IATA summer season

Ik heb de Europese Commissie verzocht om haar huidige ontheffing van de slotregels ten behoeve van het behoud van historische rechten voor het IATA winterseizoen 2019/2020 in verband met het coronavirus te verlengen voor het aankomend IATA zomerseizoen

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Paternotte over ontwikkelingen coronavirus naar aanleiding van het bericht 'Two Beijing hospitals quarantined amid fears coronavirus infections will spike in the capital'

Two D66 MPs asked the Ministers of Health and of Infrastructure and Water Management about rising COVID-19 cases in Beijing, Chinese airlines still flying to Amsterdam, and KLM selling tickets on those routes, and whether they would restrict or withdraw air transport permits. The government answered that the case numbers do not compare to Wuhan, that airline restrictions are not currently at issue on WHO advice, that airlines are responsible for their schedules, and that it will reconsider only if WHO advice changes.
I have not currently taken any decisions that lead to restrictions on aviation.
Ik heb op dit moment geen besluiten genomen die leiden tot restricties voor de luchtvaart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over het bericht ‘AIVD blokkeert terugkeer tientallen Nederlandse piloten’

MP Paternotte asked whether Dutch pilots who worked more than four years in countries without an AIVD cooperation arrangement are effectively barred from working in the Netherlands, and whether the four-year rule and the security-clearance (VGB) policy will be revisited. The government answers that pilots, as crew of a Dutch aircraft, need a VGB, that the AIVD/MIVD cannot clear applicants when the assessment period is insufficiently verifiable, that the policy was loosened in 2018 and will be reviewed with a letter before Q1 2020, but that past decisions will not be reopened.
If the assessment period is insufficiently transparent, the UVO cannot assess whether the person poses a risk to national security.
Als de beoordelingsperiode onvoldoende inzichtelijk is, kan de UVO niet beoordelen of betrokkene een risico vormt voor de nationale veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Laçin over de berichten dat Ryanair passagiers toch een schadevergoeding moet betalen

MPs Paternotte and Laçin asked the minister about reports that Ryanair must still pay compensation to passengers, and about the ILT's role in enforcing EU Regulation 261/2004, including whether it can act on systematic refusal of claims. The minister confirmed the ILT is responsible for enforcement against systematic violations, explained that after the Ruijssenaars ruling it no longer rules on individual complaints (passengers go to civil courts), gave complaint statistics for Ryanair, and declined to share airline delay data from third parties as confidential.
Following the Ruijssenaars ruling, the ILT is not permitted to enforce on individual passenger complaints about compensation.
Het is de ILT als gevolg van de Ruijssenaars-uitspraak niet toegestaan te handhaven op individuele passagiersklachten over compensatie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Omtzigt, Van Helvert, Paternotte en Sjoerdsma over het feit dat Nederlandse luchtvaartmaatschappijen tot 8 januari over Irak en Iran bleven vliegen en over de opvolging van aanbe

MPs asked why Dutch airlines kept flying over Iran and Iraq until 8 January 2020, what information was shared, and how the OVV's MH17 conflict-zone recommendations have been implemented. The minister answered that KLM stopped flying there about 1.5 hours after the US FAA ban, that EASA and ICAO advisories were issued and the status of each OVV recommendation was described, while stating that airspace sovereignty and closure duties lie with states and promising further international and national follow-up.
Following the attack on the Iranian general on 2 January, the situation was actively monitored by the Netherlands (Expert Group of the Convenant on sharing threat information for civil aviation).
Naar aanleiding van de aanslag op de Iraanse generaal op 2 jan jl. is de situatie door Nederland (Expertgroep van het Convenant deling dreigingsinformatie burgerluchtvaart) actief gemonitord.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Paternotte over de aflevering van Zondag met Lubach «de slacht & NVWA» van 24 november 2019

D66 MPs asked the ministers about shortages of veterinary staff at the NVWA, the training and selection of large-animal vets, and whether slaughter volumes endanger food safety, following a Zondag met Lubach episode. The minister answered that the shortage raises workload but does not directly affect inspections, outlined training figures and recruitment steps, and said capacity gaps do not automatically mean food-safety risk.
The mentioned shortage of veterinarians has no direct consequences for the execution of the inspections carried out on the slaughter process.
Het genoemde tekort aan dierenartsen heeft geen directe consequenties voor de uitvoering van de keuringen die worden uitgevoerd op het slachtproces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Paternotte over de correctiebrief op de brief Luchtvaart van 15 oktober

MPs Bruins and Paternotte asked the minister, after a correction letter on Lelystad Airport noise calculations, whether the noise appendices underlying the MER were externally validated, and how atmospheric attenuation and screening were handled. The minister answered that the appendices were not based on the original unvalidated 1990s versions, that external validation was done for Lelystad inputs by To70 and Adecs and a counter-expertise by dBvision, and refused to commission further independent validation of the appendices on attenuation and screening.
Findings are fed back by the validating firm to the NLR, which incorporates them into a definitive version of the (amended) appendices.
Bevindingen worden door het bureau dat de validatie uitvoert teruggekoppeld aan het NLR, dat de bevindingen vervolgens verwerkt in een definitieve versie van (de wijziging van) de appendices.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Paternotte over het bericht ‘Onderzoek: een op de drie vluchten vanaf Schiphol zou ook per trein kunnen’

Two D66 MPs asked about a report suggesting a third of flights from Schiphol could be replaced by train, about the role of tourism in flights, its economic value, and how to make rail more attractive. The minister says the report draws no conclusions, outlines an action plan with rail partners, cites tourism data and welfare estimates, and commits to talks with the travel industry and NS International.
I am aware of the study.
