Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Paternotte en Bruins over het artikel 'Vliegveld Lelystad onveiliger door komst luchtverkeersleiding'

MPs Kröger, Paternotte and Bruins asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports of two near-collisions at Lelystad Airport after air traffic control arrived, and whether aviation safety has worsened. The minister answered that the incidents are being investigated, that monitoring is ongoing, that the route design meets international standards, and that the airport will only open to commercial traffic once the break-in period is complete, without committing to new independent investigation.
There is no reason for additional investigation.
Er is dus geen aanleiding voor aanvullend onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Kröger en Paternotte over het bericht 'Vliegers Lelystad slaan alarm'

MPs Bruins, Kröger and Paternotte asked about reports that general aviation firms at Lelystad Airport face job losses and forced flight cuts, and whether the cost-benefit analysis accounts for them. The minister denies that 300 jobs are at risk or that flights will be halved, says at most 30 jobs could move, and states the MKBA was done from a national perspective with job figures of about 2,000 direct jobs at the airport.
There is no question of halving the number of aircraft movements or of 300 jobs being at risk.
Van de halvering van het aantal vliegtuigbewegingen of 300 banen die op de tocht zouden staan is geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berge, Paternotte en Van den Hul over het manifest van de beurspromovendi

MPs Van den Berge, Paternotte and Van den Hul asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the manifesto of PhD candidates on scholarships, who lack employee rights, face pressure to teach, and receive weaker protections than employed PhD students. The minister largely defended the experiment, saying promotion students have no teaching duty and that the RUG has been urged to better inform supervisors, while promising an independent review and an evaluation in 2021.
In the policy response to the interim evaluation I have therefore already called on the RUG to continue focusing on informing the supervisors.
In de beleidsreactie op de tussenevaluatie heb ik daarom de RUG reeds opgeroepen om onverminderd in te zetten op het informeren van de supervisors.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Gijs van Dijk, Paternotte, Groothuizen, Van den Berge en Özütok over geweld tegen de actiegroep Kick Out Zwarte Piet

MPs from several parties asked the Prime Minister and the Justice and Interior ministers how violence against the Kick Out Zwarte Piet congress was allowed, whether local authorities knew in advance, and how demonstrations and the Sinterklaas processions will be protected. The ministers condemned intimidation and violence, said police and prosecutors are investigating, and said local authorities (mayor, police, prosecutor) decide within legal limits, with a handreiking offered to municipalities; several answers were evasive about advance knowledge.
In our constitutional state it is unacceptable that (groups of) individual citizens disrupt a gathering of other citizens with violence and intimidation.
Het is in onze rechtsstaat ontoelaatbaar dat (groepen van) individuele burgers een bijeenkomst van andere burgers verstoren met geweld en intimidatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘KLM moet krimpen ten faveure van Franse piloten’

MPs Nijboer and Paternotte asked the Finance Minister whether a production-balance agreement between Air France, KLM and pilot unions forces KLM to shrink, whether the state as shareholder was informed, and how it will use its stake to prevent agreements against Dutch interests. The minister answered that the agreement is an operational matter for company management, the state has no formal role as shareholder, but it discusses the issue with KLM and will protect the Dutch public interest through its board representation.
Agreements on operational activities, however, are the responsibility of the company's executive management.
Afspraken over de operationele activiteiten zijn echter een verantwoordelijkheid van het uitvoerend bestuur van de onderneming.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Diertens en Paternotte over het racisme tijdens de voetbalwedstrijd FC Den Bosch – Excelsior

MPs Diertens and Paternotte asked the ministers about racist abuse of Excelsior player Ahmad Mendes Moreira at the FC Den Bosch match, the club's initial reaction, the extent of racism in sport, existing policy, sanction powers of the KNVB and clubs, and related matters. Minister Bruins answered that the abuse was unacceptable, described the monitoring figures and existing programmes, and promised to report on a joint action plan after 31 January.
At the end of January I will come together with my colleagues of J&V and SZW and the KNVB with an action plan to better combat racism and discrimination in sport.
Eind januari kom ik samen met mijn ambtsgenoten van J&V en SZW en de KNVB met een aanvalsplan om racisme en discriminatie in de sport nog beter te bestrijden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Paternotte over het bericht ‘Schiphol is niet de enige: ook 5 andere Nederlandse vliegvelden missen natuurvergunning’

MPs Bruins and Paternotte asked the minister, after reports that five other Dutch airports lack nature permits, how use permits relate to other required permits such as nature permits, and about the permitting history of Rotterdam, Lelystad and Maastricht airports. The minister answered that operators bear responsibility for obtaining other permits, that the ministry does not verify them, and that the Ministry of LNV is the competent authority for nature permits and handhavingsverzoeken, while promising to inform parliament further on the motion on high-altitude nitrogen emissions.
It is the responsibility of the operator to apply for these.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de exploitant om deze aan te vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Bruins over het bericht ‘Qatar Airways operates 9-minute flights between Maastricht and Liège’

Two MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reported 9-minute Qatar Airways cargo flights between Maastricht and Liège and whether such short cargo flights should be banned. The minister confirmed the flights, said there are no other comparable cases, said the route choice is commercial, and stated that short cargo flights are undesirable from an environmental view but that no legal instrument to ban them exists, so the government will only encourage rail/road alternatives where realistic.
The Cabinet is working to encourage the use of ground transport as an alternative to air travel on routes where that is realistic.
Het Kabinet zet zich in om het gebruik van grondvervoer als alternatief voor luchtvaart te stimuleren op routes waarvoor dat reëel is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Paternotte over de Kerncijfers asiel en migratie, juni 2019

Two D66 MPs asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about language provision for asylum seekers from several countries (Yemen, Syria, Eritrea, Turkey, Iran, Iraq), the link to long IND waiting times, and whether same-day language lessons are possible as the coalition agreement promises. The State Secretary answered that Syrians, Eritreans and stateless people already receive NT2 lessons at procedure centres, that the eligible group will be widened by 1 January 2020 based on recognition rates and numbers, and that the Flexibilisering Asielketen programme is developing a framework to prioritise likely-admissible claims.
As soon as possible for implementation, and at the latest by 1 January 2020, the group of asylum seekers who receive an offer will be updated.
Zo snel als mogelijk voor de uitvoering, uiterlijk per 1 januari 2020 wordt de doelgroep van asielzoekers die een aanbod krijgen, geactualiseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Sneller over de berichten ‘Smith: Air France en KLM nog meer integreren’ en ‘France Hits Out at Dutch in Feud Over Air France-KLM Holdings’

Two D66 MPs asked the Finance and Infrastructure ministers about press reports that Air France-KLM's CEO wants further integration and about a French official's public demand that the Netherlands choose between its holding and KLM stakes, including how KLM's position, jobs, foundations and state guarantees are protected. The minister answered that the government will monitor the agreements and guarantees, that the Franch-Dutch working group is ongoing, and that he will not disclose talks or comment on specific operational matters because Air France-KLM is listed.
Beyond that, I will not go into the content of the talks, as in my view this does not serve the talks.
Verder ga ik niet in op de inhoud van de gesprekken in de werkgroep, dit komt mijns inziens de gesprekken niet ten goede.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Peters over het eindvonnis in zaaknummer UTR 18/3505

Two MPs asked the minister about a court ruling in case UTR 18/3505, where a Turkish refugee challenged being denied a loan available to other refugees for integration courses, and whether the EU-Turkey association law applies to refugees. The minister agreed that Turkish newcomers should integrate quickly and learn Dutch, and concluded that the integration obligation should have applied to Turkish asylum status holders from 2011, referring to a separate letter to parliament.
Based on the current situation, I conclude that the integration obligation should already have applied from 2011 to Turkish asylum status holders.
Op basis van de huidige situatie kom ik nu tot de conclusie dat de inburgeringsplicht reeds vanaf 2011 had moeten gelden voor Turkse asielstatushouders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj, Van Weyenberg en Paternotte over het bericht ‘Een ongeluk waar je niets van leert’

Three D66 MPs asked the Defence and Infrastructure ministers about a 2018 helicopter training accident involving the Coast Guard's SAR contractor, the unreported incident, and unclear inspection and safety responsibilities across ILT, Inspectie SZW and contractors. The government answered that the accident was reported by the worker, that an inspection into the employer's failure to report will be started, and that responsibilities are divided among several inspectorates, while rejecting claims of unacceptable shortcomings.
ISZW will launch an investigation into this.
Er wordt door ISZW een onderzoek hiernaar ingesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over het bericht 'Randstad bij vuilste gebieden Europa: 'Ik zou wonen in Amsterdam zeker niet aanraden''

MPs Paternotte asked whether residents near Schiphol face three times the health risk from air pollution and noise of residents in Groningen and Drenthe, what measures address this, and whether groei should wait for health measures and a clean-air action plan. The minister answered that the relative risk difference is about 1.6, outlined existing noise and emission criteria, the Hinderbeperking convenant, RIVM ultrafine dust research, and that growth is tied to demonstrable reduction of hindrance in the LVB-2 and an action plan expected by end 2019.
In addition, in 2017 the Ministry of IenW commissioned RIVM to carry out a research programme into the health effects of exposure to ultrafine particles from aviation.

Daarnaast heeft het Ministerie van IenW in 2017 aan het RIVM opdracht gegeven om een onderzoeksprogramma uit te voeren naar de gezondheidseffecten van blootstelling aan ultrafijn stof uit de luchtvaart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over de Nederlandse participatie in de Event Horizon Telescope

An MP asked the education minister about the Dutch participation in the Event Horizon Telescope, its scientific importance, and NWO's decision not to fund follow-up research, plus researchers' grant-application workload. The minister said she does not intervene in NWO decisions, granted a one-off 200,000 euro for science communication, noted new funding applications are pending, and promised to speak with the lead professor.
I have great respect for the Dutch scientists who made an important contribution to this and thereby put Dutch science on the map.
Ik heb groot respect voor de Nederlandse wetenschappers die hieraan een belangrijke bijdrage hebben geleverd en daarmee de Nederlandse wetenschap op de kaart hebben gezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Bruins over het bericht ‘Schiphol heeft al jaren geen natuurvergunning: '100.000 vluchten illegaal'’

MPs Paternotte and Bruins asked whether Schiphol lacks a nature permit under the Wet natuurbescherming, how NOx from flights is calculated, which Natura 2000 areas are unaffected, and whether a 2008 growth decision and flight increases required an appropriate assessment under the Habitats Directive. The minister answers that Schiphol has no Wnb permit because the framework predates the 2004 reference date, that a new nitrogen recalculation and MER are pending, and that the LVB procedure is ongoing, with the enforcement question referred to LNV.

The Ministry of LNV, as the competent authority under the Wet natuurbescherming, received an enforcement request concerning Schiphol and the question of whether, and to what extent, Schiphol must hold a Wnb permit.

Het Ministerie van LNV heeft, als bevoegd gezag voor de Wet natuurbescherming, een handhavingsverzoek gekregen met betrekking tot Schiphol en de vraag of, en zo ja, in hoeverre Schiphol over een Wnb-vergunning dient te beschikken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Amhaouch en Paternotte over het bericht ‘Schiphol is niet de enige: ook 5 andere Nederlandse vliegvelden missen natuurvergunning’

MPs Bruins, Amhaouch and Paternotte asked whether five regional Dutch airports lack the nature permit (natuurvergunning) for their activities, and what that means for their operation. The minister answered that four of the airports have no Wnb permit while Groningen Eelde has a 2009 permit, that enforcement requests are pending at the Ministry of LNV, and that she will not anticipate those outcomes, referring to the environmental impact assessments and prior decisions for each airport.
These enforcement requests have been taken up by the Minister of LNV, the competent authority under the Wnb, and are being handled under the usual procedure.
Deze handhavingsverzoeken zijn door de Minister van LNV, het bevoegd gezag voor de Wnb, in behandeling genomen en worden volgens de gebruikelijke procedure afgehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Paternotte, Amhaouch en Remco Dijkstra over het gestaakte overleg tussen het ministerie en Noord-Veluwse gemeenten over vliegroutevarianten

MPs asked why the Noord-Veluwe municipalities stopped consultation on Lelystad Airport flight-route variants, and whether any variant avoids overflying the largest towns. The minister rejects the claim of a stopped consultation, says the variants do reduce overflown residents, and states a preference for route variant N for runway 23, though the document is cut off before its final answers are complete.
There is therefore no question of a halt to the consultation.
Van het staken van overleg is dan ook geen sprake.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Sneller over het uitblijven van een akkoord met de Franse Staat over het waarborgen van de Nederlandse publieke belangen na de aandelenaankoop van Air France-KLM

Two MPs (D66) asked why the agreed June 2019 target for a deal with the French state on guarantees and protecting Dutch public interests after the Air France-KLM share purchase was missed, and about the Aigle Azur bid and convertible bond. Minister Hoekstra replied that a working group is in place, talks are complex and confidential, the state exercises shareholder rights, it declined to discuss the Aigle Azur case as price-sensitive, and it did not subscribe to the convertible bond.
This may concern price-sensitive information, so the substance of this case cannot be addressed.
Dit betreft mogelijk koersgevoelige informatie, dus op de inhoud van deze casus kan niet worden ingegaan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Van Raan, Laçin, Gijs van Dijk, Paternotte, Bruins, Stoffer en Van Brenk over  het  bericht 'L’UE refuse d’abandonner sa souveraineté sur  les émissions de CO2 de l’aviation'.

Eight MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a report that the EU refuses to give up sovereignty over aviation CO2 emissions, and about the Dutch position and a draft ICAO resolution making CORSIA the only permitted global aviation emissions system. The minister confirmed Dutch support for the EU line, said the Netherlands will enter a reservation if the text could limit EU climate measures (including via the EU ETS), and said a kerosene excise is a fiscal measure outside the resolution's scope.

At the same time, the Netherlands will make a reservation against texts in the final resolution if they could politically limit the freedom in Europe to take the measures needed to achieve the climate goals.

Tegelijkertijd zal Nederland een voorbehoud maken tegen teksten in de uiteindelijke resolutie, wanneer die politiek gezien een beperking zouden kunnen betekenen van de vrijheid om in Europa de maatregelen te nemen die nodig zijn om de klimaatdoelstellingen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over het bericht 'Brexit-alarm: koop svp inwisselbaar vliegticket'

Member Paternotte (D66) asked the minister whether travellers around the Brexit date should be advised to buy refundable tickets, what a no-deal Brexit would mean for passengers, whether a bilateral aviation agreement is needed, and about preparations and information provision. The minister declined to advise refundable tickets, pointed to EU contingency regulation and existing passenger refund rights, said no bilateral aviation treaty is needed, and left traveller information to the travel sector.
Your House has been informed several times about the contingency measures taken at EU level and by the Netherlands.
Uw Kamer is verschillende malen geïnformeerd over de contingency maatregelen die in EU-verband en door Nederland zijn getroffen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Paternotte over het rapport Actualisatie AEOLUS 2018 en geactualiseerde luchtvaartprognoses

MPs Bruins and Paternotte asked the minister about the Lelystad Airport MER update, including the use of Doc29 versus the Dutch NRM noise model, noise-table conditions, and whether the MER is conservative enough. The minister answered each question, arguing that NRM is the statutory method for regional airports, that Doc29 is not yet implemented there, and that the MER uses realistic assumptions with sensitivity and worst-case analyses, without committing to changes.
The ANP database contains noise data for a large number of aircraft, including most of the Boeing and Airbus fleet.
De ANP-database bevat geluidsgegevens voor een groot aantal toestellen, waaronder het grootste deel van de vloot van Boeing en Airbus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Paternotte over de problemen bij Boeing

Two MPs (Amhaouch, CDA, and Paternotte, D66) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that Boeing knew of problems with the 737 MAX long before the crashes, whether regulators were informed, EASA versus FAA certification rules, and possible pressure on engineers and oversight of Boeing's 787 production. The minister answered that the reports could not be confirmed and that the US matters are for investigation there, pointed to existing ICAO and EU rules, EASA's stop of the 737 MAX, the ILT's and OVV's oversight powers, and that the ILT received no formal or informal signals.
This is a matter for further investigation in the United States.
Dit is een onderwerp voor nader onderzoek in de Verenigde Staten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Paternotte over het rapport Actualisatie AEOLUS 2018 en geactualiseerde luchtvaartprognoses

Two opposition MPs (Bruins and Paternotte) asked the minister whether the Lelystad Airport noise assessments used an outdated calculation model (NRM rather than Doc29), questioning the commitment to the most current insights. The minister answered that the calculations used the legally prescribed method, that Doc29 is not yet legally available for regional airports, and that no new noise maps are required for Lelystad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj en Paternotte over het bericht 'In paniek naar de grond om 'vreemde' actie met Boeing en F-16’s'

D66 MPs Belhaj and Paternotte asked the Defence Minister about a surprise F-16 flyby over Amsterdam with a Boeing 777 and whether it was deliberately kept quiet, including its safety assessment and costs. The minister said no secrecy was intended, the flight stayed within minimum altitudes, safety was guaranteed under existing procedures, and the costs were standard training, while leaving the future use of fighter jets for societal events to case-by-case judgement.
There is no question of secrecy regarding the air show.
Er is geen sprake van geheimhouding van de luchtvaartvertoning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Bruins over het bericht ‘Aantal klachten over Eindhoven Airport stijgt sterk’

MPs Paternotte and Bruins asked about the sharp rise in noise complaints about Eindhoven Airport, whether the environmental impact assessment's runway split was breached, how the government will reduce complaints and enforce the MER, and how complaints feed into the Eindhoven Airport pilot case. The State Secretary answered that complaints rose to about 45,000 in 2018, that the MER contains no enforceable norms (the enforceable standard is the 35 Ke noise contour in the airport decree), that 63 percent of departures went south in 2018 due to wind conditions, and that route adjustments and a pilot case are underway.
The percentage of 65 to 75 percent used is therefore not a legal norm, and there is accordingly no obligation to have aircraft take off and land according to this percentage from the MER.
Het gebruikte percentage van 65 à 75 procent is dus geen wettelijke norm en er bestaat dan ook geen verplichting om vliegtuigen te laten opstijgen en landen volgens dit percentage uit de m.e.r.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Sneller over het bericht ‘Franse staat koopt nieuwe aandelen Air France-KLM’

Two D66 MPs asked the Finance and Infrastructure ministers whether the French state was increasing its Air France-KLM stake, how the Dutch state protects its voting and governance position, and whether the stake purchase affects existing guarantees and cooperation arrangements. The minister answered that the French state is only participating in a convertible bond whose conversion would raise its stake by about 1%, that the Dutch state chose not to participate, and that no consequences follow for governance, guarantees or the 2003-2004 agreements, while cooperation talks are ongoing.
We cannot anticipate the outcomes of this.
Wij kunnen op de uitkomsten hiervan niet vooruitlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Paternotte over de twee vliegtuigongelukken met de Boeing 737 MAX

MPs Amhaouch and Paternotte asked the minister about the two Boeing 737 MAX crashes, the FAA's and EASA's grounding decisions, the Dutch airspace closure, certification and software-fix timelines, and passenger compensation. The minister answered that the Dutch closure followed EASA's binding order, that EASA and the Dutch decision do not differ substantively, and that the crash cause and software fix were still under review, with no firm timeline given.
Together with EASA it is being considered whether and when my decision to close Dutch airspace can be withdrawn.
Met EASA wordt afgestemd of en wanneer mijn besluit om het Nederlandse luchtruim te sluiten kan worden ingetrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Paternotte over de twee vliegtuigongelukken met de Boeing 737 MAX

MPs Amhaouch and Paternotte asked the minister about the Boeing 737 MAX crashes, including flawed FAA certification, the MCAS system, Boeing's role in certification, and the EASA ferry-flight exemption that let TUI aircraft return to the Netherlands. The minister answered that certification is primarily the FAA's and EASA's responsibility, that the Netherlands has no role or insight in it, that ferry flights were allowed under EASA rules, and that investigations are still ongoing.
Certification of Boeing aircraft is primarily the responsibility of the FAA.
Certificatie van Boeing-vliegtuigen is primair de verantwoordelijkheid van de FAA.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Bergkamp en Paternotte over het bericht ‘Deze gastarbeiders zijn oud in een land dat een tussenstop had moeten zijn’

D66 MPs asked the ministers of Health and Social Affairs about reports that older guest workers face poorer health, reduced AOW pensions, and low remigration uptake, and what support or follow-up is planned. The government answered that it cannot precisely estimate pension counts, that AOW reductions average about 32.5% falling to 27.8%, that care is meant to be person-centred with programmes like Langer Thuis and Een tegen Eenzaamheid, and that remigration uptake may be affected by pension levels, family ties and health care in the origin country.
I have instructed that the knowledge gained about what works and what does not be bundled.
Ik heb opdracht gegeven om de geleerde kennis over wat werkt en wat niet te bundelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Verhoeven over het bericht 'EU waarschuwt luchtvaart voor verlies vliegrechten bij Brexit zonder deal'

MPs Paternotte and Verhoeven asked whether Online Travel Agencies should warn consumers about no-deal Brexit effects on flights to and via the UK, and what the government would do about passenger rights and air connectivity. The minister said the EU proposal for contingency measures on basic air connectivity is supported, a provisional agreement was reached, a bilateral fallback is possible, EU passenger rights regulation 261/2004 still applies, and that OTAs' communication is not something the government can assess.
How communication between Online Travel Agencies and their customers proceeds, I cannot assess.
Hoe de communicatie tussen Online Travel Agencies en hun klanten verloopt, kan ik niet beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Paternotte over het bericht 'Huizen zijn er wel, statushouders niet'

MPs Groothuizen and Paternotte asked the State Secretary why about 3,000 refugee status holders were housed less than the 22,000 target in 2018, why Den Bosch received fewer matches than its target, and whether municipalities are blamed for shortfalls caused by COA allocation. The State Secretary acknowledged the shortfall of 2,934, attributed it mainly to the housing market, COA matching criteria and family reunification, and said municipalities are not penalised for unmet targets that carry over to the next period.

I rely on effective enforcement by the supervisory body toward the municipalities concerned and on COA deploying smart allocation of the available permit holders to those municipalities that received too few matches in 2018.

Ik reken daarbij op effectieve handhaving door de toezichthouder ten aanzien van bedoelde gemeenten en de inzet van het COA bij het slim verdelen van de beschikbare vergunninghouders over die gemeenten die in 2018 te weinig koppelingen hebben gekregen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Paternotte over de behandeling van assistentiehonden door luchtvaartmaatschappijen

MPs Bergkamp and Paternotte asked the ministers how airlines such as KLM may verify and treat assistance dogs, including the lack of an official accreditation system and differences between hulphonden and emotional assistance dogs. The minister replied that Dutch law allows refusal only for disproportionate burden or safety reasons, that no accreditation system exists yet pending a European standardisation process, and that the government will remain involved in that process.
It is therefore not an absolute right.
Het is daarmee geen absoluut recht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Paternotte over het bericht dat het COA te kampen heeft met overcapaciteit aan AZC's in Nederland

MPs Groothuizen and Paternotte asked about reports of overcapacity at COA reception centres and the criteria for closing them, including integration and municipal consultation. The State Secretary listed eleven affected locations, described COA's closure criteria and consultation with municipalities, and said a review of integration aspects is underway, though without committing to a specific new step.
To align reception capacity with the forecasts at the time, COA decided on 29 March 2018 to reduce reception capacity to 27,000 places.
Om de opvangcapaciteit in lijn te brengen met de toenmalige prognoses heeft het COA op 29 maart 2018 het besluit genomen de opvangcapaciteit terug te brengen tot 27.000 plaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Jetten over de gevolgen van de Brexit voor de Nederlandse luchtvaart

MPs Paternotte and Jetten asked the government about the consequences of a no-deal Brexit for Dutch aviation, including Airbus contingency plans, flight permissions, licences and a future air services agreement with the UK. The minister answered that companies are responsible for their own preparations, that the government will work with the EU and sector partners on contingency measures, and that aviation rights with the UK will be sought at EU level.
It is not the role of the cabinet, certainly not for individual companies, to speculate about the possible relocation of activities.
Het is niet de rol van het kabinet, zeker niet bij individuele bedrijven, om te speculeren over de mogelijke verplaatsing van activiteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over de storing in het communicatiesysteem van Luchtverkeersleiding Nederland

An MP from D66 asked the minister about a communications failure at air traffic control LVNL on 15 August 2018, which diverted flights and raised questions about the back-up system, communication and the investigation. The minister answered that the back-up system was used to land aircraft safely, that a further system will be introduced in two years, that LVNL is investigating the cause and will report within three months.
LVNL has indicated that it will inform me within three months about the cause of the failure.
LVNL heeft aangegeven mij binnen drie maanden te zullen informeren over de oorzaak van de storing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Weverling over het bericht ‘Multibandveiling zou ook 2021 kunnen worden’

MPs Paternotte and Weverling asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about reports that the multiband spectrum auction might slip to 2021, and about the timing dependence on the European Commission's decision on the T-Mobile/Tele2 merger. The State Secretary answered that the auction still aims for late 2019 but may slip a few months, depending mainly on the Commission's merger decision and the ACM advice, and declined to speculate on scenarios.
In this matter I must be cautious and restrained toward the European Commission, given its independent position as regulator.
Ik dien me in deze zaak overigens behoedzaam en terughoudend op te stellen richting de Europese Commissie gegeven diens onafhankelijke positie als toezichthouder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Paternotte over het bericht in het FD ‘Fintechs nog langer buitenspel door discussie tussen toezichthouders’

MPs Van der Linde and Paternotte asked the Finance Minister whether the delayed PSD2 implementation, linked to a dispute between the Dutch data protection authority and DNB over supervision, harms Dutch fintechs and what the ministry is doing to resolve it. The minister admitted the deadline was missed, explained a amendment making the AP the supervisor for the privacy consent requirement, and said there are no concrete signals of fintechs relocating abroad.
In addition, to better safeguard privacy protection, I have prepared an amendment to the bill implementing PSD2.
Daarnaast heb ik, om de bescherming van de privacy beter te borgen, een aanpassing van het wetsvoorstel ter implementatie van PSD2 voorbereid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over wetgeving voor particulier en professioneel dronegebruik

An MP from D66 asks the ministers of Infrastructure and Water Management and of Justice and Security about privacy violations by drones over Kinderdijk, the regulatory balance for drone innovation, geofencing and no-fly zones. The government says it cannot confirm or deny privacy violations in general, supports a safety-based approach with EU rules expected by 2019, and points to complaints to the Dutch data protection authority and civil suits as remedies.
If someone believes that processing personal data with a drone infringes this regulation, a complaint can be lodged with the Dutch Data Protection Authority.
Wanneer iemand van mening is dat de verwerking van persoonsgegevens met behulp van een drone inbreuk op deze verordening maakt, kan een klacht worden ingediend bij de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Belhaj over het bericht “Schiphol teruggefloten door rechter”

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers about a court ruling that Schiphol must release about 2,500 slots, and about its consequences for passenger flows, border control queues, security and the 500,000-movement cap. The minister replied that the ruling has no policy consequences for the 2017/2018 season, that the cap through 2020 stands, and that Marechaussee capacity is being expanded, while declining to comment on Schiphol's reasoning.
I do not consider it appropriate to comment on the justification of this decision by Schiphol, because the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management is not a party in this case.
Ik vind het niet opportuun om commentaar te geven op de onderbouwing van dit besluit door Schiphol omdat het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat geen partij is in deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Paternotte over incassofraude bij banken

Two D66 MPs asked the Finance and Justice ministers about a reported gap in bank direct-debit systems that allows incasso fraud, including whether banks pre-fund transfers from intermediate accounts and whether they warn creditors of possible reversal. The minister replied that the system complies with EU rules, that incasso fraud is very small in value, that police do not register it separately, and that banks will be asked via the MOB to renew attention to the rules.
Via the Maatschappelijk Overleg Betalingsverkeer (MOB) I will ask the banks to give renewed attention to this in the coming period.
Via het Maatschappelijk Overleg Betalingsverkeer (MOB) zal ik de banken verzoeken hier de komende tijd hernieuwde aandacht aan te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over het ontbreken van incidenten in het jaarverslag van ABN AMRO

An MP from D66 asked the Finance Minister whether ABN AMRO's 2016 annual report omitted an incident in which traders failed to report a loss in time, and about the availability and enforcement of the Trading Mandate. The minister confirmed one such incident involving two traders, said the bank dismissed them and a disciplinary body reprimanded them, and stated that reporting of the incident is the bank's responsibility under applicable rules.
It is up to ABN AMRO to prepare its annual report in accordance with the relevant laws and regulations.
Het is aan ABN AMRO om haar jaarverslag op te stellen in overeenstemming met de relevante wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Jetten over een mogelijk 'klimaatakkoord' voor de luchtvaart

D66 MPs asked the ministers about the ICAO CORSIA aviation emissions scheme, including its effectiveness, transparency, enforcement, offset quality, biofuel sustainability criteria, participation and Dutch lobbying. The government answered every question on substance, acknowledged concerns on offset quality and biofuel criteria, and committed to raising them in future EU and ICAO evaluations.
The Netherlands will use these and other evaluation moments to further improve the system on sustainability, effectiveness and environmental integrity.
Nederland zal van deze en andere evaluatiemomenten gebruik maken om het systeem verder te verbeteren op punten als duurzaamheid, effectiviteit en milieu-integriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Sneller over het bericht 'Kabinet huurt tijdelijk regeringstoestel'

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the government's temporary leased aircraft after a news report, questioning the ad-hoc availability and quality, the operator's security compliance, possible links to royal family use, and funding. The minister answered that KLM arranged a third party to operate a permanently available, suitably equipped aircraft, that the 6.7 million euro budget may be exceeded with details to follow in the Voorjaarsnota, and denied any link between lease costs and royal use.
As indicated in the earlier letter to your House, I will further inform your House about the additional costs and their coverage within the IenW budget at the Spring Memorandum.
Zoals aangegeven in de eerdere brief aan uw Kamer zal ik uw Kamer ten aanzien van de additionele kosten en de dekking daarvan binnen de begroting van IenW nader informeren bij de Voorjaarsnota.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Paternotte over de verhuizing van het Galileo Security Monitoring Centre naar Spanje

MPs Amhaouch and Paternotte asked why the Galileo Security Monitoring Centre back-up was moved to Spain, whether the Netherlands bid, and the consequences for Dutch and British space sectors and future EU-UK cooperation. The state secretary answered that the Netherlands considered but declined to bid, Spain's bid scored best on objective criteria, and future EU-UK space cooperation is part of the ongoing Brexit negotiations.
The European Commission assessed the bids of the various member states on the basis of objective criteria.
De Europese Commissie heeft op basis van objectieve criteria de biedingen van de verschillende lidstaten beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Belhaj en Weverling over de berichten 'Spionnenjacht blokt 5G' en 'Arena geen proeftuin voor nieuwste generatie mobiel internet'

MPs Paternotte, Belhaj and Weverling asked about press reports that intelligence services are blocking 5G rollout in the 3.5 GHz band and that the Amsterdam Arena cannot serve as a 5G testbed. The State Secretary says the rollout is important, that talks with intelligence services and neighbouring countries are ongoing, and that a solution and options will be sent to parliament around mid-2018.

Both the ministers of Defence and of the Interior and the State Secretary of Economic Affairs and Climate are working to find, on the basis of technical research, solution options for making the 3.5 GHz band available.

Zowel de ministers van Defensie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijkrelaties als de Staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken en Klimaat zetten zich in om op basis van technisch onderzoek tot oplossingsmogelijkheden te komen voor de beschikbaarstelling van de 3,5 GHz-band.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Paternotte over de continuïteit van DBFM(O)-projecten na faillissement van de private aanbieder

Two D66 MPs asked the Finance Minister how DBFM(O) public-private projects stay continuous if a private contractor goes bankrupt, following the collapse of a large British construction firm. The minister answered that no Dutch DBFM(O) contractor has ever gone bankrupt, that continuity is secured through project company structures, contracts and direct agreements with financiers, and that the state is not responsible for projects of subnational governments.
The central government is not responsible for DBFM(O) at subnational governments because they are autonomous and responsible for their own projects, budgets and the choice of contract form.
Het Rijk is niet verantwoordelijk voor DBFM(O) bij medeoverheden omdat deze autonoom zijn en verantwoordelijk voor hun eigen projecten, budgetten en de afweging over de beste contractvorm.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Paternotte over het bericht ‘PostNL nog steeds bezig met bezorgen kerstpost’

MPs Weverling and Paternotte asked the State Secretary about reports that PostNL was still delivering Christmas mail in January 2018, including delivery standards, oversight of peak periods, causes of the delays, and whether additional requirements would be set. The State Secretary answered that the existing delivery norms and ACM oversight are adequate, attributed the delays to weather, staffing shortages and a new sorting code rule, declined to impose extra requirements for now, and said ACM is investigating.
Imposing additional requirements now therefore seems premature to me.
Het nu stellen van aanvullende eisen vind ik daarom prematuur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Paternotte over het bericht 'Rolstoelgebruikers hekelen gebrekkige assistentie op vliegvelden'

MPs Bergkamp and Paternotte asked about reports that wheelchair users criticise poor assistance at airports, the rising demand for assistance, liability for compensation, rules on carrying mobility aids, and the funding of assistance. The minister acknowledges problems at Schiphol, states that airports bear primary responsibility under EU Regulation 1107/2006, notes the ILT supervises through inspections and complaints, and explains that the per-passenger PRM charge applies to departing passengers only.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Paternotte over het monopolie van sportbonden

D66 MPs asked whether the European Commission's ruling against the ISU's eligibility rules for skaters racing outside federation structures affects Dutch athletes, whether pro football clubs could play outside the Dutch pyramid, whether other federations sanction athletes similarly, and whether Dutch law should change. The minister replied that the ruling concerns the ISU alone, that FIFA rules allow pro clubs to play outside the calendar with federation permission, that no comparable federation sanctions are known, and that no change to Dutch law is needed.
In light of the above, I see no reason to amend laws and regulations.
In het licht van bovenstaande zie ik geen aanleiding om wet- en regelgeving aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over de grote achterstanden bij het Kifid

An MP asked the Minister of Finance about long processing delays at Kifid, the financial complaints body, including assignment times, staff turnover and the 180-day internal target. The Minister acknowledged that delays rose in 2017, attributed them to complexity, capacity and staff turnover, said Kifid is independent but the Minister approved its budget, and promised a progress report around summer.
I will therefore report to the House around the summer on developments at Kifid.
Ik zal de Kamer dan ook rond de zomer rapporteren over de ontwikkelingen bij Kifid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Paternotte over het bericht 'Medewerkers maken zwartboek discriminatie'

MPs Den Boer and Paternotte asked the Justice Minister about reports of discrimination within the police, including by supervisors, and what measures, diversity efforts and monitoring are in place. The minister acknowledged that such conduct occurs, described leadership training, diversity recruitment and the Medewerkersmonitor, and promised an exit-interview exploration and an update in spring 2018 but declined to commission broader new research.
There is no legal basis for the police to register ethnicity.
Voor registratie van etniciteit door de politie is geen wettelijke grondslag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Nijboer over de waarschuwing van AFM voor digitale beursgangen (ICO’s)

MPs Paternotte and Nijboer asked the Finance Minister about the AFM warning on ICOs, including whether the regulator can do more than warn, how ICOs work, which rules apply, and how investors are warned. The minister answered that the warnings are appropriate, that many ICOs fall outside financial supervision law, that consultation with AFM and DNB took place, and that he sees no need for further measures beyond existing warnings.
The supervisory authorities informed me in advance about the publication of these warnings.
De toezichthouders hebben mij van tevoren geïnformeerd over de publicatie van deze waarschuwingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Ziengs over de toegang tot het handelsregister van de Kamer van Koophandel

MPs Paternotte and Ziengs asked the State Secretary about the abolition of volume discounts for large buyers of Chamber of Commerce register data, its link to a controversial amendment to the Trade Register Act, and the KvK's data strategy. The State Secretary answered that the tariff change is separate from the bill, that the KvK and commercial users have distinct roles, and that the KvK is modernising data access with stakeholder involvement.
The bill amending the Trade Register Act 2007 is separate from the mentioned tariff change.
Het wetsvoorstel tot wijziging van de Handelsregisterwet 2007 staat los van de genoemde tariefwijziging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over giftige dampen aan boord van vliegtuigen

An MP asks the minister about a ZEMBLA broadcast on toxic cabin air in aircraft, the reporting duties of airlines, the independence of the advisory group NAC, and whether the government took the problem seriously enough. The minister replies that no causal link has been proven, that pilots are responsible for declaring unfitness, that the NAC was set up and EASA research is ongoing, and that a further NAC advisory report is awaited before any additional action.
The NAC has also been tasked with advising on taking any additional actions. I am awaiting that report.
De NAC heeft ook de opdracht gekregen te adviseren over het nemen van eventuele aanvullende acties. Ik wacht deze rapportage af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Paternotte over de radiouitzending 'Schimmige praktijken bij ZonMw' en de Kamerbrief van Minister Schippers van 3 oktober 2017 (Kamerstuk 30850-45)

Two D66 MPs asked the health and education ministers about a radio report on conflict-of-interest practices at ZonMw, including whether its 2016-2017 evaluation checked compliance with the Awb and codes of conduct, and whether exceptions to the conflict-of-interest code exist elsewhere. The minister replied that the evaluation did not cover these aspects, acknowledged a legal exception clause was removed after a 2015 appeal ruling, found a single NWO case of insufficiently strict application, announced a joint code evaluation that will delete the exception clause, and promised further measures and to send the answers to the Chamber.
Following that, the application of and supervision of compliance with the code of conduct has been tightened for all ZonMw committees.
Naar aanleiding daarvan is de toepassing van en het toezicht op naleving van de gedragscode voor alle ZonMw-commissies verscherpt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Paternotte, Remco Dijkstra, Bruins en Kröger over Lelystad

Five MPs asked the minister about press reports that former state secretary Dijksma criticised the ministry's capacity to handle the complex Lelystad Airport dossier, including the environmental impact assessment (MER). The minister acknowledged the reports, said the ministry has capable staff but needs extra expertise, and said the remarks do not affect the planned new MER assessment.
The ministry has competent and committed staff.
Het ministerie beschikt over kundige en betrokken medewerkers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Van Engelshoven en Groothuizen over het in de cel gooien van een Nederlandse journalist

MPs from D66 asked why an NRC photographer was detained and his equipment seized for refusing to hand over photos, and whether this was lawful. The Minister answered that the journalist was wrongly treated as a suspect, the seizure was wrong, the Public Prosecution Service apologised, and the case will be discussed within the OM.
The journalist was wrongly treated as a suspect.
De journalist is ten onrechte als verdachte aangemerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over NPO Start

An MP asks the State Secretary about the NPO Start Plus paid on-demand service: expected subscribers, the basis for the 2.95 euro price, competition with commercial services, whether it should face a renewed new-services test, which programmes move behind the paywall, and why HD is paid-only. The government answers that the service was approved under a completed procedure, is cost-based, will be evaluated and reported on annually, and that HD upgrading carries costs of up to 10 million euro per year.
The NPO must evaluate the tariff after two years and report every year on developments regarding NPO Start Plus.
De NPO dient na twee jaar het tarief te evalueren en elk jaar te rapporteren over de ontwikkelingen ten aanzien van NPO Start Plus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Engelshoven en Paternotte over het bericht '112 bij ramp? In de wacht' naar aanleiding van het onderzoek naar de stroomstoring in Amsterdam op 17 januari 2017

MPs Van Engelshoven and Paternotte asked about 112 emergency call failures during the January 2017 Amsterdam power outage, prior recommendations, telecom obligations and the lack of a norm for continuous 112 access. The minister answered that most earlier recommendations were implemented, that a risk analysis and new technical infrastructure in 2018 address remaining gaps, and that a norm for uninterrupted access awaits a cost-benefit analysis.
That is therefore the reason why the Ministry of Economic Affairs first wants to have a cost-benefit analysis carried out before moving to a norm for uninterrupted access to 1-1-2.
Dat is dan ook de reden dat het Ministerie van Economische Zaken eerst een kosten en baten analyse wil laten uitvoeren voordat overgaan wordt tot een norm voor onderbroken toegang tot 1-1-2.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Fox IT houdt zeggenschap staat af’

MPs Paternotte and Verhoeven asked whether the government secured co-control over Fox Crypto after NCC Group's takeover, dropped its first right of purchase, and what safeguards protect state secrets. The minister confirms ICT separation and contract transfers are done, says co-control and ownership terms are still under discussion, and gives only partial, procedural answers on secrecy safeguards, declining operational details for security reasons.
For security reasons I will not go into specific questions about the protection of state secrets.
Om veiligheidsredenen ga ik niet in op specifieke vragen over de beveiliging van staatsgeheimen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weyenberg en Paternotte over het bericht ‘Rijken mijden fiscus langs nieuwe route’

Members Weyenberg and Paternotte (D66) asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that wealthy individuals use open funds for joint account (fonds voor gemene rekening) to avoid tax, and whether these funds sit outside the UBO register and enable access to allowances. The State Secretary answered that the tax saving depends on actual returns, that UBO registration for such funds is under study with the UBO register planned for summer 2018, that registrations rose to about 550 by mid-August 2017 with over 25% rejected, and that no legislative measures were taken for now given the caretaker cabinet.
At present it is being examined whether the obligation to register UBO information should also apply to funds for joint account.
Op dit moment wordt onderzocht of de verplichting tot het registreren van UBO-informatie ook moet gaan gelden voor fondsen voor gemene rekening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Sjoerdsma over gendergelijkheid in vergoedingen en salarissen bij de publieke omroep

MPs Paternotte and Sjoerdsma asked whether men and women are paid equally for equal work at the Dutch public broadcasters, following reports on BBC pay gaps and DWDD guest fees, and what concrete action the government has taken. The State Secretary says equal pay is required, that no evidence of unjustified pay gaps was found, that the NPO will raise the issue with broadcasters, possibly with a voluntary quick scan, and that the Code of good governance may address it.
There is no indication that there is unjustified unequal pay between men and women at the public broadcasters.
Er is geen aanwijzing dat er sprake is van ongerechtvaardigde ongelijke beloning van mannen en vrouwen bij de publieke omroep.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Diertens over de gebrekkige beschikbaarheid van uitzendingen van NPO in het buitenland en op de BES-eilanden

MPs Paternotte and Diertens asked why NPO programmes are often unavailable abroad and on the Caribbean Netherlands islands, and whether residents there can watch NPO websites. The State Secretary answered that availability depends on broadcast rights, that geo-blocking has been relaxed for the BES islands where rights and technology allow, and that distribution agreements were made with providers there.
Geo-blocking of NPO websites based on the user's location is no longer applied to the BES islands, insofar as broadcast rights allow and it is technically possible.

Het blokkeren van toegang tot websites van de NPO op basis van de geografische locatie van de gebruiker wordt, voor zover uitzendrechten dat toestaan en het technisch mogelijk is, niet meer toegepast voor de BES-eilanden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over het bericht dat bij een aspirant-omroep meerdere medewerkers boven de Balkenende-norm verdienen

An MP asks the State Secretary whether senior and presenter pay at aspiring broadcaster PowNed, above the WNT pay norm, is lawful and why presenters can be exempted, and what criteria apply. The State Secretary answers that the director's pay exceeds the norm under transitional rules, presenters fall under the separate BPPO norm with limited exceptions, and the NPO plans to stop granting exceptions.
If a broadcaster intends to pay a presenter above the current BPPO norm, that intention must be submitted to the NPO executive board.
Indien een omroep voornemens is een presentator te gaan belonen boven de huidige BPPO-norm, dan dient dat voornemen voorgelegd te worden aan de raad van bestuur van de NPO.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Paternotte over het bericht dat medicijnenproductie verdwijnt uit Nederland

Two D66 MPs asked the health and economic affairs ministers about reports that medicine production is leaving the Netherlands while thriving abroad, and what the government will do to keep research and production in the country. The minister answers that the number of firms has been stable, that production is under pressure due to specialisation, that the government supports life sciences policy and IMI participation, and that it is working to attract the European Medicines Agency, without committing to new concrete measures.
The research has not declined, but there are signals that production is under pressure.
Het onderzoek is niet afgenomen, maar er zijn signalen dat de productie onder druk staat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Paternotte over het grote aantal gunningen van infrastructuurprojecten aan buitenlandse bouwers

MPs Jetten and Paternotte asked why foreign builders won a large share of major infrastructure contracts and how this fits the Marktvisie. The minister replied that most GWW contracts went to Dutch firms, that foreign partners add expertise and better price-quality, and that the government and market will jointly implement the Marktvisie.
The large majority of the contracts went to Dutch construction firms: 49 of the 53 GWW contracts in the study were awarded to (combinations of) companies with no foreign involvement.

Het overgrote deel van de opdrachten is naar Nederlandse bouwbedrijven gegaan: 49 van de 53 GWW opdrachten uit het onderzoek zijn gegund aan (combinaties van) bedrijven waar geen sprake is van buitenlandse inbreng.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over het bericht dat de Autoriteit Consument & Markt een rekenhulp introduceert voor roamingkosten

The MP asks whether consumers are adequately informed about limits on the EU roam-like-at-home rules, whether intra-EU calls to other member states should be regulated, and whether the minister will push for EU regulation. The minister says consumers are sufficiently informed through contract terms and notifications, that cross-border calling pricing is market-driven and not generically out of proportion to cost, and that he does not wish to advocate EU regulation of intra-EU calls.
I am of the view that consumers are sufficiently informed about these limitations under the EU roaming rules.
Ik ben van mening dat consumenten op grond van de roamingregels in de EU voldoende worden ingelicht over deze beperkingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Paternotte over het niet in kaart brengen van bepaalde regeldruk

MPs Mulder (CDA) and Paternotte (D66) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why regulatory burden from ministry, agency and supervisor policy rules is not measured, whether it counts toward the 2.5 billion euro reduction target, and what the Actal advisory council's findings on policy rules imply. The minister replied that policy rules are not formally legislation and are not counted, that no follow-up research is needed, that he is not convinced of additional costs from policy rules, but that bottlenecks will be tackled through case-by-case work and invites businesses to report problems.
Policy rules are formally speaking not legislation.
Beleidsregels zijn formeel gezien geen wetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Bruins over het bericht ‘Unilever is straks misschien niet meer Nederlands'

MPs Paternotte and Bruins asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about Unilever possibly ceasing to be Dutch, the protection mechanisms other countries use against foreign takeovers, the tax benefits Unilever receives, and the AkzoNobel takeover dispute. The government replied that it keeps an open stance on takeovers, outlined protection mechanisms in other countries and the Netherlands, said it is talking to Unilever, refused to disclose individual tax benefits citing tax secrecy, and said the AkzoNobel dispute is a private matter for the courts.
Under the tax secrecy provision of article 67 of the General Tax Act, no statements can be made about the tax position of an individual taxpayer.

Op grond van de fiscale geheimhoudingsbepaling van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen kunnen immers geen mededelingen worden gedaan over de fiscale positie van een individuele belastingplichtige.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over het bericht dat ‘Nederland minder nieuwe glasvezelverbindingen krijgt’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that the Netherlands is getting fewer new fibre connections, including whether a two-player market is the cause and what speed needs exist. The minister attributed the decline to high existing network quality and low uptake, said supply broadly matches demand, and noted continued attention to rural gaps and EU competition rules.
I therefore work at European level to ensure that the new regulatory framework promotes competition.
Ik zet me daarom Europees in om te zorgen dat het nieuwe regelgevend kader concurrentie bevorderend werkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Van Meenen over de berichten ‘Turkse spionage in Duitsland’ en ‘Terrorist vanwege interview met Rutte’

Two D66 MPs asked whether Turkish intelligence espionage reported in Germany also occurs in the Netherlands, including watch lists, whether Turkish-Dutch citizens are warned, whether Dutch services have enough Turkish language capacity, and how the government responds to threats against a journalist after an interview with PM Rutte. The government declined to say publicly whether such activity occurs or what services know, citing that no public statements can be made about investigations or service expertise, condemned threats against press freedom, and urged the journalist to file a police report.
No public statements can be made about investigations into activities these services might carry out without Dutch government permission, or about any resulting course of action.

Over onderzoek naar activiteiten die deze diensten zonder toestemming van de Nederlandse overheid zouden uitvoeren en over het eventuele handelings-perspectief dat uit een dergelijk onderzoek zou voortvloeien, kunnen in het openbaar geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Paternotte over een gemeentelijke meldplicht voor verhuur van woningen via digitale platforms

MPs Van Eijs and Paternotte (D66) asked the Minister of the Interior whether a planned consultation with Amsterdam on a municipal reporting obligation for platform rentals would take place, whether results would be shared with Parliament and other municipalities, and whether a reporting duty would reduce the enforcement burden. The minister replied that no consultation is scheduled yet because Amsterdam must first add its day-count criterion to its housing ordinance, that existing law suffices and enforcement is a municipal matter, and that a reporting obligation would be disproportionately burdensome and ineffective, promising to inform Parliament only if concrete steps are taken.
If concrete steps have been taken, I will inform your House about this.
Als er concrete stappen zijn genomen, zal ik uw Kamer hierover informeren.

m: Amendement van het lid Jan Vos c.s. over een rendementseis van tenminste 48% voor kolencentrales vanaf 2031
Requires coal-fired power plants to reach a net electrical efficiency of at least 48% from 2031, effectively phasing out the last five coal plants, with the minister able to request efficiency data.
The net electrical efficiency of a large production installation fired with coal or a combination of coal and one or more other fuels is at least 48% from 1 January 2031.

Het netto elektrisch rendement van een grote productie-installatie die met steenkool of een combinatie van steenkool en een of meer andere brandstoffen wordt gestookt, is vanaf 1 januari 2031 ten minste 48%.
Amendement van het lid Jan Vos c.s. over een rendementseis van tenminste 45% voor kolencentrales vanaf 2021
Sets a minimum net electrical efficiency of 45% for coal-fired plants from 2021 and lets the minister request efficiency data, aiming to phase out two coal plants.
The net electrical efficiency of a large production installation fired with coal, or a combination of coal and one or more other fuels, is at least 45% from 1 January 2021.

Het netto elektrisch rendement van een grote productie-installatie die met steenkool of een combinatie van steenkool en een of meer andere brandstoffen wordt gestookt, is vanaf 1 januari 2021 ten minste 45%.
Motie van het lid Jan Vos over onderzoek naar de wijze waarop Nederlandse bedrijven hun CO2-uitstoot significant kunnen reduceren
Asks the government to investigate how Dutch companies can significantly reduce their CO2 emissions over the next 25 years, including via CCS.
requests the government to investigate how Dutch companies can significantly reduce their CO2 emissions over the next 25 years
verzoekt de regering, te onderzoeken hoe de Nederlandse bedrijven hun CO 2 -uitstoot de komende 25 jaar significant kunnen reduceren
Motie van het lid Van Tongeren c.s. over prioriteit geven aan de ratificatie van de overeenkomst van Parijs
Asks the government to prioritise ratification of the Paris Climate Agreement and secure parliamentary approval of the implementing laws before the next elections.
requests the government to give priority to the ratification of the Paris Agreement
verzoekt de regering, prioriteit te geven aan de ratificatie van de overeenkomst van Parijs
Motie van het lid Van Tongeren c.s. over een top tien-positie op de index voor sociaal ondernemerschap
Motion asks the government to aim for a top-ten Dutch position on the global social entrepreneurship index.
requests the government to strive for a top ten position for the Netherlands on the global social entrepreneurship index
verzoekt de regering, te streven naar een top tien-positie voor Nederland op de mondiale index voor social entrepreneurship
Motie van de leden Van Tongeren en Jan Vos over het gasvrij maken van bestaande wijken
Motion asking the government to examine giving municipalities the lead role (regie) in plans to make existing neighbourhoods gas-free.
requests the government to map the desirability of giving municipalities the lead role in plans to make existing neighbourhoods gas-free
verzoekt de regering, de wenselijkheid in kaart te brengen om gemeenten de regie te geven om te komen tot plannen voor het gasvrij maken van bestaande wijken
Motie van de leden Van Tongeren en Jan Vos over geen gasaansluitplicht voor nieuwbouwwijken
Asks the government to remove the gas connection obligation for new-build neighbourhoods from relevant laws and regulations as soon as possible.
requests the government to remove the gas connection obligation for new neighbourhoods from relevant laws and regulations as soon as possible
verzoekt de regering, de gasaansluitplicht voor nieuwbouwwijken zo snel mogelijk te schrappen uit de relevante wet- en regelgeving

Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Jan Vos c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 97, dat regelt dat geen omgevingsvergunningen meer worden verleend voor het oprichten van mijnbouwwerken voor het opsporen of winne
Bars environmental permits for seabed mining structures in the Wadden islands, Wadden Sea and Natura 2000 areas, and restricts permits in the North Sea coastal zone.
This amendment provides that no environmental permits are granted for constructing mining works for exploring or extracting minerals on the Wadden islands
Dit amendement regelt dat geen omgevingsvergunningen meer worden verleend voor het oprichten van mijnbouwwerken voor het opsporen of winnen van delfstoffen op de Waddeneilanden

Dit amendement zorgt voor aanvullend budget voor innovatief MKB.
Motie van het lid Jan Vos over herziening van het investeringsmodel en incubatorfondsen
Asks the government to examine an investment model with incubator funds backed by public money for startups and SMEs.
requests the government to further examine this investment model
verzoekt de regering, dit investeringsmodel nader te bezien
Motie van het lid Jan Vos over onderzoek naar de obstakels voor transparantie van de brandstoffenmix
Motion asks the government to investigate legal and economic obstacles to full transparency of the fuel mix and inform the House within six months.
requests the government to map the legal and economic obstacles to full transparency of the fuel mix and to inform the House within six months

verzoekt de regering om, in kaart te brengen welke juridische en economische obstakels er zijn om volledige transparantie van de brandstoffenmix te realiseren en de Kamer daarover binnen zes maanden te informeren
Motie van het lid Voordewind c.s. over eeen breed convenant met de Nederlandse kledingbranche voor risicolanden
Asks the government to reach a broad covenant with the Dutch clothing sector on risk countries with a concrete step plan, measurable targets and annual progress reports.
requests the government, together with the Dutch clothing sector, to reach a broad covenant for risk countries
verzoekt de regering om, samen met de Nederlandse kledingbranche tot een breed convenant te komen voor risicolanden
Motie van het lid Jan Vos c.s. over de borging van privacy in het handelsakkoord tussen de EU en de VS
Asks government to ensure the EU-US trade deal does not undermine citizens' privacy, keeps national privacy measures possible, and informs the House regularly.
also requests the government to regularly inform the House about the progress of the negotiations
verzoekt de regering tevens, de Kamer regelmatig te informeren over de voortgang van de onderhandelingen
Motie van het lid Jan Vos c.s. over een verplichting voor energiebedrijven om inzicht te geven in de herkomst van steenkolen
Asks the government to require Dutch energy companies to disclose the origin, mine by mine, of the coal they use.
requests the government to oblige energy companies in the Netherlands to separately disclose the origin, per mine, of the coal they use
verzoekt de regering, de energiebedrijven in Nederland te verplichten om afzonderlijk inzicht te geven in de herkomst per mijn van door hen gebruikte steenkolen
Motie van het lid Van Ojik c.s. over gevolgen van opname van het ISDS in het handelsakkoord tussen de VS en de EU
Asks the government to study the risks of ISDS arbitration in the EU-US trade deal, including bypassing national courts, and to inform the House and push for changes in Europe.
offering internationally operating companies the possibility to bypass the national legal process
het bieden van de mogelijkheid aan internationaal opererende bedrijven om de nationale rechtsgang te omzeilen
Motie van het lid Jan Vos over met de NAM in overleg treden over het advies van de commissie-Meijer
Motion asking the government to respond to the Meijer committee report on Groningen gas-extraction damage and to consult the NAM on it.
requests the government to draft a response to the Meijer committee report
verzoekt de regering, een reactie op te stellen op het rapport van de commissie-Meijer
Motie van de leden Jan Vos en Jacobi over geen vergunning voor zoutwinning bij twijfel aan effecten op de natuur
Asks the government to apply the Nature Conservation Act strictly and grant no salt-mining permit in the Wadden Sea at the slightest doubt about significant effects on nature.
not to grant a permit for salt extraction at the slightest doubt about significant effects on nature
geen vergunning te verlenen voor zoutwinning bij de geringste twijfel aan significante effecten op de natuur
Amendement van het lid Jan Vos over het invoegen van een voorhangbepaling
Adds a pre-consultation (voorhang) requirement of four weeks before parliament for the general administrative order setting a transport tariff for electricity feed-in.

Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Jan Vos ter vervanging van nr. 18 over de mogelijkheid om eenmalig een onafhankelijk onderzoek te laten instellen naar de juistheid van de kostenverdeling bij woningen

Amends the heat law to give consumers, in cases without individual meters, the right to a one-time independent investigation of the cost allocation system and of heat cost allocators, paid proportionally by supplier and consumer.
At the request of one or more consumers, the supplier has an independent expert carry out a one-time investigation
Op daartoe strekkend verzoek van één of meer verbruikers laat de leverancier éénmalig door een onafhankelijke, voor zowel verbruiker als leverancier aanvaardbare deskundige onderzoek uitvoeren
Motie van de leden Klever en Jan Vos over gratis beschikbaar stellen van informatie over benzineprijzen
Motion asking the government to oblige fuel station operators to make petrol price information freely available by 2014.
requests the government to oblige fuel station operators to make petrol price information freely available before 1 January 2014
verzoekt de regering om, pomphouders te verplichten informatie over benzineprijzen gratis beschikbaar te stellen voor 1 januari 2014
Amendement van het lid Jan Vos over de mogelijkheid een eenmalig een onafhankelijk onderzoek te laten instellen naar de juistheid van de kostenverdeling bij woningen met geen aparte meter
Amendment giving heat consumers without individual meters the right to a one-time independent investigation of cost allocation, with half the cost paid by the supplier.
At the request of one or more consumers, the supplier reimburses once to those consumers half the costs of an independent expert investigation

Op daartoe strekkend verzoek van één of meer verbruikers vergoedt de leverancier éénmalig aan die verbruiker of verbruikers de helft van de kosten van door een onafhankelijke deskundige uitgevoerd onderzoek
Amendement van het lid Jan Vos over een kosteneffectieve noodleverantie
Lets the minister order connected heat producers to supply a designated emergency supplier, with the option of agreed alternative conditions, aiming for the most cost-effective solution.
the Minister may order one or more producers connected to the heat network who supplied a certain amount of heat in the two preceding years to supply it to a designated emergency supplier

Onze Minister kan één of meer op het warmtenet aangesloten producenten die in de twee voorafgaande jaren via dat net al dan niet onder bepaalde voorwaarden een bepaalde hoeveelheid warmte leverden opdragen
Amendement van het lid Jan Vos over een verduidelijking van artikel 6, eerste lid, van de Warmtewet t.a.v. een onvoorziene aansluiting
Clarifies in the Warmtewet that the article 6 connection rule covers unforeseen connections of individual consumers to existing heat networks.
However, the proposed article 6(1) of the Heat Act does not explicitly state that the article covers an unforeseen connection of an individual consumer.
In het voorgestelde artikel 6, eerste lid, van de Warmtewet staat echter niet met zoveel woorden dat het artikel ziet op een onvoorziene aansluiting van een individuele afnemer.
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Nijboer en Jan Vos over het initiatief van de Stichting Meent van der Sluis voor de oprichting van Het Andere Monument

Three MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Social Affairs about a proposed monument ('Het Andere Monument') for victims of Groningen gas-extraction earthquake damage, including municipal land availability and funding for a youth work-learning project. The minister confirmed awareness, expressed appreciation, noted the National Coordinator Groningen mediated, and said the Social Affairs minister would explore a work-learning route.
The Minister of SZW will explore the possibilities for a work-learning project and will contact the foundation about it.
De Minister van SZW zal de mogelijkheden voor een leer-werktraject onderzoeken en daarover in contact treden met de stichting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries, Van Dekken en Jan Vos over het bericht ‘Bouwregels Stad genegeerd’

MPs asked whether a Groningen builder ignored earthquake-resistant design rules, whether earthquake-proof building should become the norm with funding, why the NPR 9998 standard is not yet in the Building Decree, and whether NAM will generously apply the new-build compensation scheme. The minister answered that NPR use is not mandatory and cannot be excluded for some buildings, that the government is exploring regulation so NAM keeps covering reasonable extra costs with a decision expected by end 2017, and that the scheme's percentage compensation will be raised with the ongoing review.
Application of the NPR is not mandatory.
De toepassing van de NPR is niet verplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Jan Vos over illegale gaswinning in Heerenveen

MPs Jacobi and Jan Vos asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about gas extraction under Heerenveen without an approved winning plan, the council's advisory rights, the lack of baseline measurements and whether extraction should be halted. The minister answered that he had consented to the plan in 2012, that a 2015 amendment was under review with a draft decision expected in July 2017, that the municipality's advisory rights were not bypassed, and that he sees no acute risk justifying an immediate halt.
I have the authority to intervene at the moment there is or threatens to be a serious impairment of interests.
Ik heb de bevoegdheid in te grijpen op het moment dat er sprake is of dreigt van een ernstige aantasting van belangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leenders en Jan Vos over SDE+ subsidie voor de gedupeerden van de hevige hagelstormen in Zuid-Oost Nederland afgelopen zomer

MPs Leenders and Jan Vos asked whether the government would guarantee SDE+ subsidy availability for hail-storm victims in south-east Netherlands, and whether it would consult the province, municipalities and sector. The minister answered that SDE+ is competitive and cannot give individual developers advance certainty, pointed to increased 2017 budgets and NIA support for Noord-Brabant, and referred back to his answer on question 2 for questions 3 and 4.
The SDE+ scheme offers no possibility to give individual project developers advance certainty about project applications.
De SDE+ regeling biedt geen mogelijkheid om individuele projectontwikkelaars vooraf zekerheid te bieden over projectaanvragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Jan Vos over de berichtgeving over het langer openhouden van Belgische kerncentrales Tihange en Doel

MPs Fokke and Jan Vos asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about Belgian plans to extend the Tihange and Doel nuclear reactors beyond 2025, the Belgian response, and whether the Dutch government had pressed Belgium to close them. The minister answered that the lifetime decision is a Belgian national matter for the FANC regulator, that he had relayed parliament's wish for closure to Belgian minister Jambon, and that he would monitor the process.
I have conveyed the wish of your House to Minister Jambon and informed your House of this.
Ik heb de wens van uw Kamer overgebracht aan Minister Jambon en uw Kamer hierover geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Çegerek, Albert de Vries en Jan Vos over het project Brouwerseiland

MPs Cegerek, De Vries and Vos asked the minister whether the Brouwerseiland coastal project fits her earlier stance against building up the coast, and whether she would refuse a derogation under the Barro that would block it. The minister said the Kustpact will set zoning, that the derogation decision will be made carefully under the legal test without pre-judging outcomes, and that local procedures and the municipal council will weigh local views.
I will take a decision on the derogation request as soon as possible, carefully weighing the presence of special circumstances and the national interests to be served.
Ik zal zo spoedig mogelijk een besluit nemen over het ontheffingsverzoek, waarbij ik de aanwezigheid van bijzondere omstandigheden en de te dienen nationale belangen zorgvuldig zal wegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Jan Vos en Wolbert over de bezinningsperiode in de Drentse Veenkoloniën

Three PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether he would insert a reflection period in the Drenthe wind park decision, pending the Council of State appeal, and pause irreversible steps while exploring alternatives with local stakeholders.
