The minister refused to withdraw or suspend the permit, citing the provincial renewable energy target, but committed not to start placing turbines before the Council of State ruling and to explore solar alternatives with local authorities.
Pending the Council of State ruling, no start will be made on placing the wind turbines.
In afwachting van de uitspraak van de Raad van State zal geen begin met de plaatsing van de windmolens worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jan Vos over de compensatie van emissierechten

An MP asked whether the state's roughly 89 million euro in indirect ETS emissions-cost subsidies, paid to firms that already receive free allowances, amounts to a double benefit and weakens carbon pricing incentives, and whether the ECB could buy ETS allowances. The minister answered that the subsidy compensates competitive disadvantage from electricity costs, is budgetarily separate from auction revenue, and that ECB purchases of allowances fall outside its mandate, while committing to pursue ETS strengthening via EU negotiations.
However, these subsidy expenditures are budgetarily decoupled from the revenue from the auction of emission allowances.
Deze subsidie-uitgaven zijn echter budgettair losgekoppeld van de inkomsten uit de veiling van emissierechten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leenders en Jan Vos over de toenemende drukte op Schiphol en de overlast die dat oplevert voor de omgeving

MPs Leenders and Jan Vos asked the State Secretary about Schiphol nearing its 500,000 flight-movement cap, rising noise complaints from Bussum, low-altitude climb practices, ultrafine particles, and whether surrounding municipalities outside the Omgevingsraad Schiphol are heard. The State Secretary answered that the 50/50 rule and any new caps require agreement with the community, that complaints come from a stable number of about 24 residents per year, that noise stays well within legal limits, and that research on ultrafine particles is ongoing.
The agreed volume ceilings are not sacred, provided new agreements are made in good consultation with the surroundings.
De afgesproken volumeplafonds zijn niet heilig, mits er in goed overleg met de omgeving nieuwe afspraken worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jan Vos over de doelstellingen voor wind op land

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why 2016 wind-on-land capacity additions were low, whether the 6,000 MW target for 2020 will be missed, and whether a motion on higher SDE+ subsidy rates for small wind projects and an improved postcode scheme would be implemented quickly. The minister answered that the 2020 target remains achievable with provincial cooperation, that a supplementary study on small-scale wind will be commissioned and reported before the autumn SDE+ round, and that the postcode scheme evaluation will occur in 2017.

As I indicated in my letter of 3 January 2017, I am implementing the Jan Vos motion by commissioning additional research into the conditions and possible costs and returns associated with stimulating small-scale wind turbines.

250 ) heb aangegeven, geef ik uitvoering aan de motie Jan Vos door een aanvullend onderzoek te laten doen naar de randvoorwaarden en mogelijke kosten en opbrengsten die samenhangen met de stimulering van kleinschalige windmolens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jan Vos over het productieplafond voor de bij- en meestook van biomassa

An MP asks whether the 25 PJ cap on biomass co-firing in coal plants under the Energy Agreement covers total final energy including heat, and whether the SDE+ scheme is consistent with that agreement. The minister answers that the cap applies to subsidised renewable electricity (or electricity plus heat), that compensation for heat produced adds roughly 3–4 PJ unsubsidised, and that the SDE+ 2016 and 2017 schemes are in line with the agreement.
It is correct that the 25 PJ is a maximum.
Het is correct dat de 25 PJ een maximum is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over de versterkingsoperatie die nu ineens tien jaar kan gaan duren

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked why the Groningen reinforcement operation now may take ten years instead of five, whether residents are left in uncertainty too long, how many homes must be reinforced, and why the new compensation scheme took a year. The minister replied that the approach has the support of all administrative parties, that a block-by-block inspection-then-reinforcement method is used with work starting in Q4 2017, and that the total scope and resident displacement cannot yet be determined, deferring to ongoing inspections.
No statement can currently be made about the scope of the total reinforcement task.
Over de omvang van de totale versterkingsopgave is op dit moment geen uitspraak te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren, Dik-Faber, Ouwehand, Smaling en Jan Vos over het WOB-verzoek van Milieudefensie over gaswinningsbesluit 2016

Five MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the NAM's influence on the 2016 Groningen gas extraction decision, including a pre-sent expectations letter, consultations with NAM and Shell, and the withholding of an SodM advice from parliament. The minister answered that a draft expectations letter was shared with NAM only to test interpretation and feasibility, that the SodM advice was not actively sent but was later provided and published, and that the extraction ceiling was set on safety grounds at 24 billion m3 per year.
Since the SodM advice only confirmed that the process communicated to your House could proceed, I did not find it necessary to actively inform your House about it.
Aangezien het advies van SodM slechts bevestigde dat het met uw Kamer gecommuniceerde proces doorgang kon vinden, heb ik het niet nodig gevonden uw Kamer hier actief over te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jan Vos over een rapport over de waarde van kolencentrales

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs whether he accepts a report arguing that three new Dutch coal plants are worth far less than the operators claim and risk becoming stranded assets, and whether he will push for their closure. The minister says he took note of the report but has no opinion on the plants' value, sees no need to brief the companies, and will inform parliament shortly on phasing out coal, without committing to it now.
I will inform your House more fully on this in the short term.
Ik zal uw Kamer hierover op korte termijn nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Nijboer over het klimaatbeleid van banken

MPs Jan Vos and Nijboer asked the Finance Minister about poor climate scores of Dutch banks, their climate commitments, supervision and standards for non-financial reporting. The minister acknowledged the criticism, said banks should be more transparent and do more, and pointed to existing platforms and EU rules, committing to support international standards and to an accountant audit of non-financial information.
Unambiguous and enforceable international standards for presenting non-financial information, without too much discretion, would be an important step forward.
Eenduidige en afdwingbare internationale standaarden voor de weergave van niet-financiële informatie, zonder te veel vrijheidsgraden, zouden een belangrijke stap voorwaarts zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over het niet oplossen van schade door de NAM in Termunterzijl

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the minister about NAM's refusal to resolve damage to a house in Termunterzijl, including whether it is linked to gas extraction, the family's forced relocation on NAM's advice, and reversal of the burden of proof. The minister declined to go into substance because of pending litigation against NAM and the State, noted rising non-earthquake damage reports, and said the burden-of-proof bill is pending in the Senate with entry into force expected before year-end.

A court case concerning this file is pending before the Northern Netherlands District Court, in which NAM and the State are defendants. Against that background I will not go into the substance of this file.
Over dit dossier is een procedure aanhangig bij de rechtbank Noord-Nederland, waarin NAM en de Staat zijn gedaagd. Tegen die achtergrond ga ik niet inhoudelijk in op dit dossier.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over het KNMI, dat aardbevingen niet goed zou registreren

Three PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the KNMI misrepresents Groningen earthquakes by naming quakes after the nearest village, so that eleven quakes are attributed to Garmerwolde rather than Groningen city, and whether this distorts regional spread and should be corrected. The minister answered that the KNMI never claimed only one quake hit Groningen city, that the naming procedure was changed on 1 December 2016 to use municipal boundaries, and that the regional picture is unaffected since analyses use coordinates.
On 1 December 2016 the KNMI retroactively introduced a new naming procedure that looks at the distance between the epicentre and a municipal boundary.
Op 1 december 2016 heeft het KNMI met terugwerkende kracht een nieuwe naamgevingsprocedure geïntroduceerd waarbij wordt gekeken naar de afstand tussen het epicentrum en een gemeentegrens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Jan Vos over het bericht dat waterschappen risicovolle buitenlandse projecten aangaan.

MPs Jacobi and Jan Vos asked about reports that water boards invest in risky foreign projects via the NWB Fund, including coco loans, export credit insurance, OECD guidelines, and the Cali (Colombia) evacuations. The minister answered that water boards do not undertake commercial activities abroad, that the NWB Fund made an AT1 loan to NWB Bank rather than a coco loan, that export credit insurance is unavailable to public bodies, and that the Cali situation is being followed by the embassy.
Under the Decentralised Governments Financing Act (wet FIDO), water boards do not undertake commercial activities abroad.
Conform de Wet Financiering Decentrale Overheden (wet FIDO) ondernemen waterschappen geen commerciële activiteiten in het buitenland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Maij over Europese subsidie voor nieuwe kolencentrales in Griekenland

Two MPs asked the State Secretary why Greece should receive 1.75 billion euro in EU ETS allowance-based support for two new lignite plants, how this fits EU climate goals, and what can be done. The State Secretary said she opposes extending the derogation group, will push for CO2-free-only subsidy criteria and competitive bidding, but cannot stop the Greek request directly.
I therefore focus on strict criteria for the use of the funds.
Ik richt me daarom op scherpe criteria voor het gebruik van de middelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Jan Vos over kinderarbeid en uitbuiting op gecertificeerde palmolieplantages in Indonesië

MPs Van Laar and Jan Vos asked the minister whether certified palm oil plantations in Indonesia using child labour can be called sustainable, how RSPO and due diligence failures should be addressed, and what steps Unilever and Indonesia should take. The minister acknowledged the Amnesty report, said child labour makes palm oil unsustainable, pointed to RSPO complaint mechanisms and OECD contact point options, and committed to talks with Unilever and to working through multi-stakeholder forums and the Indonesian government.
The cabinet is of the view that products made with child labour are not sustainable.
Het kabinet is van mening dat producten die met kinderarbeid tot stand zijn gekomen niet duurzaam zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Fokke over veiligheidsrisico’s van de Belgische kerncentrales

MPs Jan Vos and Fokke asked the minister about safety risks at the Belgian Doel and Tihange nuclear plants, including reports of lax conduct by the operator and the government's response to a parliamentary motion urging Belgium to close them. The minister said the Netherlands would press Belgium for measures and, in the extreme case, closure if risks to Dutch residents are shown, while noting the Belgian regulator found no direct safety problem and that joint inspections were carried out.
I implemented your motions by contacting my Belgian counterpart Jambon by telephone at the time.
Ik heb uw moties uitgevoerd door hierover destijds telefonisch contact op te nemen met mijn Belgische ambtsgenoot Jambon.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek, Albert de Vries en Jan Vos over het project Brouwerseiland

MPs Cegerek, Albert de Vries and Jan Vos asked the minister about the Brouwerseiland recreation project, covering Natura 2000 protection, nitrogen limits, the Kustpact, recreation oversupply, noise barriers, displaced recreation and participation. The minister replied that the Barro exemption and Nb-wet permit are handled by the competent authorities, with the Kustpact still pending and remaining decisions left to the province and municipality.

Beyond the national interests named in the Structuurvisie Infrastructuur en Ruimte and the Barro, it is the responsibility of decentralised governments, for good spatial planning, to determine the need for space and weigh it.

Buiten de in de Structuurvisie Infrastructuur en Ruimte en in het Barro benoemde rijksbelangen is het ten behoeve van de goede ruimtelijke ordening de verantwoordelijkheid van de decentrale overheden om de ruimtebehoefte te bepalen en hiervoor een afweging te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over de bemoeienis van NAM met bouwprojecten in Groningen

Three PvdA MPs asked the minister whether NAM's involvement in new-build projects in Groningen, including the absence of a new-build scheme in the multi-year programme, causes delays and should be curbed. The minister answered that the NPR 9998 standard is being made legally binding, that a revised new-build scheme will be proposed by year end, and that the NCG is discussing NAM's role with NAM and municipalities, without committing to stop NAM's involvement.
The draft multi-year programme 2017–2021 provides that a revised scheme must be established, agreed with the administrative and societal steering committee.
In het concept Meerjarenprogramma Aardbevingsbestendig en Kansrijk Groningen 2017–2021 is opgenomen dat een herijkte regeling tot stand dient te komen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jan Vos over de import van groen gas

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about importing green gas, including a pilot, foreign green-gas certificates, the European registry, and how the renewable energy target is calculated. The minister says a small pilot is undesirable, a European platform is being developed instead, Vertogas is asked to take a larger role, and the energy agenda will address conflicting targets.
I will examine whether it is desirable and possible for Vertogas to still sign this letter of intent.
Ik zal onderzoeken of het alsnog ondertekenen van deze «letter of intent» door Vertogas gewenst en mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Samsom, Jan Vos en Hoogland over de komst van een Tesla-fabriek naar Nederland

Three PvdA MPs asked the Prime Minister and Minister of Economic Affairs whether the government would do everything possible to attract a Tesla Gigafactory to the Netherlands for green jobs and manufacturing. Minister Kamp answered that the Netherlands is a suitable location and the cabinet will make efforts, but that Tesla alone decides on location and he cannot yet estimate investments or jobs.
The cabinet will certainly make efforts to bring the production plant to the Netherlands.
Het kabinet zal zich zeker inspannen om de productiefabriek naar Nederland te halen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jan Vos over windmolens die afgebroken worden maar niet meer worden vervangen, waardoor het Energieakkoord in gevaar komt

MP Jan Vos asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether dismantled wind turbines not being replaced endangers the 6,000 MW onshore wind target of the Energy Agreement, and asked about subsidy loss, RVO risk estimates, SDE+ 2017 adjustments, postcode scheme continuation, provincial zoning constraints and a roundtable with industry. The Minister confirmed the risk (up to 1,330 MW) but said most owners keep turbines running, rejected special higher subsidies for small turbines, committed to an early evaluation of the postcode scheme and to raising the issue with provinces, and noted it is on the wind-on-land core team agenda.
I will consult with the State Secretary of Finance to carry out this evaluation as soon as possible in 2017.
Ik zal in overleg treden met de Staatssecretaris van Financiën om deze evaluatie zo spoedig mogelijk in 2017 uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Dik Faber en Van Tongeren over schade aan huurwoningen in Middelstum

MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about damage to rental homes in Middelstum caused during reinforcement works, including months of drainage problems and loose structural bolts, and whether the Centrum Veilig Wonen and the NCG could intervene. The minister confirmed it concerns one dwelling, declined to detail an individual damage case, said a repair plan exists, and agreed that the corporation will check bolts in all Middelstum homes soon.
It does not befit me as Minister to go into the details of an individual damage case at length.
Het past mij als Minister niet om uitgebreid in te gaan op de details van een individueel schadegeval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jan Vos over het importeren van groen gas

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why imports of green gas certificates (garanties van oorsprong) are not allowed, whether this can be lifted, what role Vertogas could play, and whether green gas can reduce Groningen gas extraction. The minister answered that there is no import ban as such, but imports cannot be verified without a shared European platform, that a pilot is undesirable, and that green gas can reduce demand for Groningen gas while safety and supply security remain leading.
There is no import ban for green gas.
Er is geen importverbod voor groen gas.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over de invloed van NAM op bouwprojecten  in Groningen

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether NAM is interfering in new construction projects in Groningen, causing delays and overreaching on design and location, and whether the minister will intervene. The minister acknowledges the NAM compensation schemes and that the Boterdiep parking-garage project was delayed, says an exception was made after mediation by the National Coordinator Groningen, and states that delay is undesirable and that the NCG is working to revise the scheme.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jan Vos over een onderzoek van CE Delft naar de vraag over hoe recht gedaan kan worden aan de Urgenda-rechtszaak

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a CE Delft study on how to comply with the Urgenda court ruling (25% CO2 cut by 2020) and whether closing coal plants would be needed and what the costs would be. The government answered by referring to a separate letter (Kamerstuk 32 813, nr. 123) answering the same questions.

The written questions from MP Jan Vos (PvdA) to the Minister of Economic Affairs about a CE Delft study on how to give effect to the Urgenda court case, question number 2016Z16273, have been answered in the letter 'Response to questions and request regarding the Urgenda case and CBS figures on greenhouse gas emissions' (Parliamentary paper 32 813, no. 123).

Antwoord 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Jan Vos (PvdA) aan de Minister van Economische Zaken over een onderzoek van CE Delft naar de vraag over hoe recht gedaan kan worden aan de Urgenda-rechtszaak, vraagnummer 2016Z16273 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Reactie op vragen en verzoek inzake de Urgenda-zaak en CBS-cijfers over broeikasgasuitstoot» (Kamerstuk 32 813, nr.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jan Vos over de berichten rondom de veiligheid van de reactor in Petten

An MP asked the ministers whether financial pressure on NRG, the operator of the Petten reactor, has subordinated nuclear safety, whether management pressures staff to keep the reactor running, and whether an independent investigation (e.g. by the Safety Board) and phasing out nuclear installations are warranted. The government answers that the regulator ANVS found no compromise of safety, that it has conducted intensified oversight and will host IAEA missions in October 2016 and early 2017, and that the financial questions will be addressed in a decision in Q4 2016, without committing to phasing out.
The ANVS exercises independent supervision over NRG.
De ANVS houdt onafhankelijke toezicht op NRG.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over de NAM die niet meer wil samenwerken met een onafhankelijk contra-expertisebureau

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether NAM may end cooperation with the independent counter-expertise firm Vergnes Expertise, and whether this undermines residents' trust and calls for moving damage assessment to the NCG. The minister answered that NAM stopped reimbursing new Vergnes counter-expertises after failed quality improvement talks, that NAM may terminate such private contracts without NCG consent, and that the NCG will take a supervisory role over the CVW.
It is important that experts deliver quality and that residents are adequately helped.
Het is van belang dat experts kwaliteit leveren en dat bewoners adequaat worden geholpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over ‘de Groninger Bodembeweging en het Groninger Gasberaad, die niet meer praten met Nationaal Coördinator Groningen’

MPs Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the minister about Groningen residents' refusal to talk with the National Coordinator Groningen over the NAM damage protocol, including the rise in rejected c-damage claims, NAM's and CVW's influence, and the damage contour line. The minister acknowledged the problems, pointed to ongoing audits and research due in early 2017, and agreed to individually assess claims without a contour line, though he declined to give the NCG the power to set the protocol itself.
The damage protocol, established by NAM, is intended to achieve rapid and low-threshold handling of damage claims by the CVW.
Het schadeprotocol, dat is vastgesteld door NAM, is bedoeld om tot snelle en laagdrempelige afhandeling te komen van schadeclaims door het CVW.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over het validatieonderzoek van de TU Delft

MPs Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a TU Delft validation study finding that NAM's Arcadis-based damage contour around the Groningen gas field is not tenable, and whether NAM and the CVW will drop it and compensate damage outside it. The minister agreed the contour is not tenable, said NAM and CVW accept that all reported damage must be assessed individually via a pilot overseen by an independent steering committee, and said a supervisory role for the NCG on the CVW will be detailed later.
Based on the results of the TU Delft study, the NCG concludes that the damage contour set by NAM is not tenable and all reported damage must be individually assessed.

Op basis van de uitkomsten van het onderzoek van de TU Delft concludeert de NCG dat de door NAM vastgestelde schadecontourlijn niet houdbaar is en alle aangemelde schade alsnog individueel moet worden beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jan Vos over het bericht dat het Transatlantisch Handels- en Investeringspartnerschap (TTIP) mogelijk de klimaatdoelstellingen in gevaar kan brengen

An MP asked the ministers whether the published TTIP negotiating texts could endanger climate targets, including provisions on non-discrimination in energy infrastructure, shale gas imports, Arctic oil and environmental policy space. The government denied that TTIP threatens climate goals, said renewable priority rules remain possible, and pointed to explicit policy-space and climate cooperation provisions.
TTIP creates no obstacle to taking measures to protect the environment.
TTIP creëert geen belemmering voor het nemen van maatregelen ter bescherming van het milieu.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Van Dekken over het bericht “LTO Noord: op basis van dit onderzoek kun je toch geen conclusies trekken?”

MPs Jan Vos and Van Dekken asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that LTO Noord calls a Sweco study on uneven land subsidence in Groningen agricultural fields too thin to support conclusions, and whether gas extraction is excluded as a cause and whether independent research and dialogue with LTO Noord will happen. The minister answered that the Sweco report is not yet public and that he has asked the NCG to review it with the commission and LTO Noord, after which he will inform parliament.
The Sweco report is not yet public.
Het rapport van onderzoeksbureau Sweco is nog niet openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over schade aan huurwoningen door gaswinning

MPs asked why housing corporation Woongroep Marenland refuses to repair gas-extraction damage to tenants' homes in Appingedam and what the minister and the NCG will do about it. The minister declined to comment on an individual case, citing a pending court dispute, but reported that the damage was repaired under NAM supervision and during an NCG inspection, and agreed tenants must be taken seriously.
As a rule I do not go into individual cases. There is a conflict between a tenant and a housing corporation involving a pending court ruling.
In de regel ga ik niet in op een individuele casus. Er is hier sprake van een conflict tussen een huurder en een woningcorporatie waarbij een gerechtelijke uitspraak aan de orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jan Vos over de heropstart van de oliewinning in Schoonebeek en de hervatting van de injectie van productiewater in Twente

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about resuming injection of production water in Twente, including whether pipelines cross Natura 2000 and water-protection areas, public unrest, a petition of 30,000 signatures, and whether permits are in place. The minister said the water is classified as non-hazardous, pipelines are mostly 800 to 2,500 metres from Natura 2000 areas with three exceptions, NAM holds the correct permits, and SodM supervises compliance through systemic, risk-based inspection.
Supervision of the correct implementation of the permits falls under the responsibility of SodM.
Toezicht op de juiste uitvoering van de vergunningen valt onder de verantwoordelijkheid van SodM.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Recourt over het mogelijke verlies van 4000 banen bij Tata Steel in IJmuiden

MPs Jan Vos and Recourt asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports of possible loss of 4,000 jobs at Tata Steel IJmuiden, whether merger talks with ThyssenKrupp are under way, whether government is kept informed, and what it will do to protect jobs. The minister confirmed the reports, said Tata Steel has started talks with strategic European partners including ThyssenKrupp, that the ministry is informed and in regular contact with the company, and that he values the plant highly, without committing to a specific intervention.
The ministry was directly informed by Tata Steel Netherlands of the talks with strategic partners in the steel industry, and there is regular contact about any further developments.

Het ministerie is direct door Tata Steel Nederland op de hoogte gesteld van de gesprekken met strategische partners in de staalindustrie en er is regelmatig contact over eventuele verdere ontwikkelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over het wel produceren van rapporten maar niet repareren van de schade

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether NAM and the Centrum Veilig Wonen produce costly reports without repairing gas-damage, including claims of 25,000 euro in reports, that these exceed the actual damage, and that they rarely call back. The minister declined to discuss the individual case in detail, said agreement had been reached so repairs can start, noted the CVW is improving its communication, and said handling speed depends on repair complexity.
It does not befit me as Minister to go into the details of an individual damage case at length.
Het past mij als Minister niet om uitgebreid in te gaan op de details van een individueel schadegeval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over schadetaxaties door het Groninger Taxatie Bureau

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about allegations that the Groninger Taxatie Bureau, acting for the Centrum Veilig Wonen, routinely rejects earthquake damage claims, makes counter-expertise dependent on NAM-set limits and underreports damage, and whether NAM and CVW prioritise keeping compensation costs low. The minister denied these allegations, stating that experts follow the NAM protocol and Handboek Aardbevingsschade, that residents may choose a counter-expert and the Arbiter Aardbevingsschade, and that he has no signals of a gap between management and the workfloor.
No. The resident is free to choose their own counter-expert, who is paid by the CVW at a set hourly rate.
Nee. De bewoner is vrij om zelf een contra-expert te kiezen die wordt betaald door het CVW volgens een vastgesteld uurtarief.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Gesthuizen over uitblijven van genoegdoening aan (indirecte) slachtoffers van mijnbouwactiviteiten in Colombia

MPs Jan Vos and Gesthuizen asked whether the government would urge Dutch energy firms to halt coal purchases from Colombian suppliers linked to paramilitary violence until victims receive redress, and how it would address victims' access to remedy in the peace process. The minister answered that the government favours an inclusive transitional justice approach within the FARC peace deal, encourages companies to use supplier leverage and due diligence rather than suspension, and says the Cesar victims exploration will not proceed because the peace agreement is now the vehicle.
The cabinet encourages energy companies to use their trading relationship with mining companies to achieve these improvements, so that the option of temporary suspension does not have to be invoked.

Het kabinet moedigt de energiebedrijven aan om hun handelsrelatie met de mijnbouwbedrijven in te zetten voor deze verbeteringen om te voorkomen dat de optie van een tijdelijke opschorting ingeroepen moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Van Tongeren over het gebruik van de term aardbevingsschade in plaats van mijnbouwschade

MPs Jan Vos and Van Tongeren asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why the Arbiters Aardbevingsschade decrees still use the narrower term earthquake damage instead of the broader mining damage that the minister had promised. The minister replied that the NCG follows the Civil Code concept, that the decrees will be amended only once all relevant parties commit to the arbiter's rulings, and that the arbiter adds a low-threshold dispute mechanism distinct from the Mijnraad and Tcbb, which remain in place.
Once this is the case, amending the establishing decree can be considered.
Wanneer dit het geval is, kan aanpassing van het instellingsbesluit worden overwogen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Albert de Vries over de ontmanteling van kerncentrale Borssele

MPs Jan Vos and Albert de Vries asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the Borssele nuclear plant is loss-making and needs a 200 million euro capital injection, and whether a nuclear decommissioning strategy and study could be completed within two months. The minister replied that EPZ makes no loss because shareholders must buy its electricity at cost, that a study of the nuclear knowledge infrastructure is under way and will conclude in autumn, and that the cabinet will inform parliament on the plant's future shortly.
As I previously promised, the cabinet will inform your House shortly about the future of the nuclear plant in light of DELTA's financial situation.
Zoals ik eerder heb toegezegd, zal het kabinet uw Kamer op korte termijn informeren over de toekomst van de kerncentrale in het licht van de financiële situatie van DELTA.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Jasper van Dijk, Dijkgraaf, Grashoff, De Roon, Jan Vos en Agnes Mulder over de voorlopige inwerkingtreding van het handelsakkoord tussen de EU en Canada (CETA)

Seven MPs asked the trade minister whether the Commission's plan to provisionally apply the EU-Canada CETA would be put to parliament, how the parliamentary reservation demanded by an earlier motion would be implemented, and whether CETA will be a mixed agreement. The minister answered that the Commissioner's commitment to consult the European Parliament is noted, that the government will formally register a parliamentary reservation in the Council once a proposal is tabled and inform the Tweede Kamer promptly, and that which parts would apply provisionally is not yet known.

If the Commission has submitted a proposal for a Council decision on signature and provisional application, the cabinet will formally implement the motion by stating in the Council that the Netherlands cannot agree to the proposal before it has been discussed with the House of Representatives.

Als de Commissie een voorstel heeft gedaan voor een Raadsbesluit voor ondertekening en voorlopige toepassing, zal het kabinet formeel uitvoering geven aan de motie door in de Raad kenbaar te maken dat Nederland niet kan instemmen met het voorstel voordat het voorstel is besproken met de Tweede Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over gezondheidsklachten als gevolg van meervoudige mijnbouwschade

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about health complaints linked to repeated gas-extraction damage in Groningen, the RUG Gronings Perspectief findings, and how policy would respond. The minister confirmed the interim findings, said the NCG already prioritises relieving affected residents and will use the results to improve procedures, and declined to speculate on the study's final conclusions about underlying causes.
In response to this report, the NCG has already indicated that the results will be used to improve the damage protocol and the working method of the Centre for Safe Living (CVW) in that respect.
In reactie op dit rapport heeft de NCG reeds laten weten dat de resultaten zullen worden benut om het schadeprotocol en de werkwijze van het Centrum Veilig Wonen (CVW) in dat opzicht te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over de waardedalingsregeling

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why the Groningen value-decline compensation scheme applies in some municipalities but not Oldambt, whether value-increase rules also exclude Oldambt, and about the status of a motion for a similar scheme. The minister confirmed awareness, explained the value-increase scheme now covers all earthquake damage above 1,000 euro, said the motion will be considered in the spring memorandum, and justified the value-decline geographic boundary by a CBS study of housing-market functioning.
The cabinet will take this motion into account in the decision-making for the spring memorandum and will then inform the House of Representatives about it.
Het kabinet betrekt deze motie bij de besluitvorming in het kader van de voorjaarsnota en zal uw Kamer hierover vervolgens informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Jacobi en Nijboer over afvalwater van NAM in de Waddenzee

Three PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about media reports that NAM would discharge treated production water into the Wadden Sea via the Eems, and why NAM does not simply choose the purification-and-discharge option. The minister replied that the re-injection alternatives are still under evaluation with a decision expected in December 2016, that composition monitoring classifies the injection water as non-hazardous, and that he does not recognise the portrayal of NAM as cost-evading.
The supervisory committee's task is to check whether the research process is transparent and that the questions and concerns in the region are taken into account in the study.
De begeleidingscommissie heeft als taak om te controleren of het onderzoeksproces transparant verloopt, en dat de vragen en zorgen die leven in de regio worden meegenomen in het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over de afhandeling van meldingen van aardbevingsschade door het Centrum voor Veilig Wonen (CVW) buiten de contour

Three PvdA MPs asked why claims for earthquake damage outside the damage contour are not being processed by CVW while a validation study is pending, and whether registration and provisional payments could proceed now. The minister replied that NAM's Arcadis study finds such damage negligible, that an independent validation is due around summer and the minister will inform parliament then, and that NAM will visit all reporters but wants the validation results first; a judgement now would almost certainly mean rejection.
I will inform your House at that moment.
Ik zal uw Kamer op dat moment informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Van Tongeren over sluiting van kolencentrales

Two MPs asked whether a previously announced CCS obligation for coal plants should reduce any compensation owed to operators if coal plants are phased out, and whether a 2007 ministerial statement implied such an obligation. The minister answered that compensation depends on many factors still being studied, that the 2007 minister did not state a binding CCS requirement within ten years, that operators were not clearly told of a CCS obligation, and that the financial consequences are still under investigation.
At present I am investigating what the possible financial consequences of measures concerning coal-fired power plants would be.
Op dit moment ben ik aan het onderzoeken wat de mogelijke financiële consequenties zouden zijn van maatregelen rond kolencentrales.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Servaes over de nalatigheid van de Europese Commissie bij het uitvoeren van mensenrechtenanalyses bij handelsverdragen

Two Labour MPs asked the ministers about the European Commission's failure to carry out a human rights analysis for trade agreements, including the delayed TiSA impact study and the EU-Vietnam FTA. The ministers answered that the Commission has committed to including human rights in future Sustainability Impact Assessments, that the Netherlands will push this during its EU presidency, and that the EU-Vietnam agreement already contains human rights links.
Following the Ombudsman's call, one of these ambitions concerns including a human rights analysis in the usual Sustainability Impact Assessments.
In navolging van de oproep van de Ombudsman betreft één van deze ambities het opnemen van een mensenrechtenanalyse in de gebruikelijke Sustainability Impact Assessments.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren en Jan Vos over de waardevermeerderingsregeling

MPs Van Tongeren and Van Vos asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why no applications for the value-increase scheme (waardevermeerderingsregeling) were processed since December 2015, whether missing information from the Centrum voor Veilig Wonen causes delays, how this fits with the budget running out, and how the government will act on motions. The minister denied that no applications were processed, explained the sequencing rule and privacy-based data handling, and said the government will inform parliament in the spring budget memorandum.
The cabinet will take the motions into account in the spring budget memorandum and will then inform the House.
Het kabinet betrekt de moties bij de behandeling van de voorjaarsnota en zal uw Kamer dan informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Servaes over kritische rapporten over Nederlandse betrokkenheid bij de verbreding van het Egyptische Suezkanaal

MPs Jan Vos and Servaes asked ministers about critical reports (SOMO and One World) alleging that Dutch dredging firms and the state-backed export credit insurer Atradius DSB failed to apply due-diligence standards to the Suez Canal widening, and whether commercial interests outweighed human and environmental rights. The government rejects the conclusion that economic interests prevailed, says it gathered sufficient information for an environmental and social assessment, and explains the differing findings of the SOMO report and the Witteveen & Bos study.
The cabinet has taken good note of the SOMO report in question and takes its observations and findings seriously.
Het kabinet heeft goede nota genomen van het betreffende SOMO-rapport en de observaties en bevindingen nemen wij serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek, Hoogland en Jan Vos over het bericht ‘Luchtkwaliteit in gevaar door 130 kilometer per uur’.

MPs Cegerek, Hoogland and Jan Vos asked the minister whether RIVM and TNO criticism of raising motorway speed limits to 130 km/h, and of the air-quality modelling, was taken into account and whether the forecasts were sound. The minister replied that the methodology follows the legal framework and Raad van State practice, that monitoring will track NO2 and PM10 annually, and that some route boundaries were adjusted after objections.
In the annual NSL monitor it is checked whether the air quality limit values are exceeded.
In de jaarlijkse NSL-monitor wordt getoetst of de grenswaarden voor luchtkwaliteit worden overschreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over de afschaffing van de contourenregeling

Three PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether he welcomed NAM director Schotman's call to abandon the contour map (contourenkaart) for gas-extraction damage, and how this fits with the proposed evidentiary presumption law that still relies on the earthquake contour. The minister answered that NAM must compensate damage regardless of location, that the map plays no role, and that the presumption is limited to the Groningen field effect area because a broader presumption would be disproportionate.
The bill aims to strengthen the evidentiary position of those harmed, without leading to a disproportionate situation.
Het wetsvoorstel beoogt de bewijspositie van benadeelden te versterken, zonder tot een onevenredige situatie te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en Jan Vos over de waardevermeerderingsregeling

MPs Bosman and Jan Vos asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the Groningen value-increase compensation scheme budget (about 125 million euro) had been exceeded and whether applicants would be refused. The minister answered that 85 million euro had been paid on approved claims, that the cap will likely be substantially exceeded if all pending claims are approved, and that the government will address the motion on the scheme in the spring memorandum.
If all submitted applications and applications that may still follow on the basis of damage reports are approved, the subsidy ceiling will be substantially exceeded.
Als alle ingediende aanvragen en aanvragen die op basis van schademeldingen nog kunnen volgen worden goedgekeurd zal het subsidieplafond ruim worden overschreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer, Albert de Vries en Jan Vos over de aankondiging van ING om te stoppen met het aanbieden van hypotheken voor woonboten

MPs asked the Finance Minister whether ING's decision to stop offering mortgages for houseboats, leaving only Rabobank, would harm buyers and owners and what would be done about it. The minister confirmed the decision, said existing customers are unaffected, and said the market is complex and new entrants may appear, with consultation of the Dutch banking association planned.
Consultation will be held with the Dutch Banking Association and they will be asked whether they have ideas on how more providers of houseboat mortgages can enter the market.

Er zal overleg worden gevoerd met de Nederlandse Vereniging van Banken en worden gevraagd of zij ideeën hebben over hoe ervoor kan worden gezorgd dat er meer aanbieders van woonboothypotheken op de markt kunnen komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Van Tongeren over sluiting van kolencentrales en de mogelijke kosten hiervan

MPs Jan Vos and Van Tongeren asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about an op-ed claiming closing Dutch coal plants would cost little, about the link to a 2018 CCS obligation, emissions-rights costs, the Urgenda ruling, and SDE+ subsidies for biomass co-firing. The minister disagreed that a 2018 CCS obligation would reduce state costs, said compensation depends on factors still under study, and promised a cabinet response to the IBO CO2 report in the first half of 2016.
The IBO CO2 will provide building blocks for additional measures to implement the Urgenda ruling.
Het IBO CO 2 zal bouwstenen aandragen voor aanvullende maatregelen om het vonnis in de Urgenda-zaak uit te voeren.
Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de Staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht «Grote steden kiezen massaal voor kolenstroom» (ingezonden 23 december 2015).

An MP asked the state secretary about a report that large cities buy coal-based electricity, and how splitting green-electricity purchases into commodity power and separate guarantees of origin fits government sustainable procurement policy. The government answered that the split still supports green electricity consumption, pointed to more impactful alternatives, described pilots and studies on area-based procurement, and listed the state's guarantee-of-origin purchases by source 2010-2015.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Jan Vos over over de bosbranden in Indonesië en het streven naar duurzame palmolie

MPs Van Laar and Jan Vos asked the minister about a Friends of the Earth report alleging that palm oil producers Wilmar and Bumitama Agri fail their no-burning commitments and Indonesian law, and about implications for RSPO credibility and the 2020 sustainable palm oil ambition. The minister replied that the companies have reaffirmed no-burning policies, that RSPO has monitoring and sanctions mechanisms though not waterproof, and that Indonesian enforcement is difficult but the government supports capacity building and partnerships.
Possible breaches of the agreements must be taken seriously, but do not undermine the ambitions and concrete actions in this area.
Eventuele schendingen van de afspraken moeten serieus worden genomen, maar ondermijnen niet de ambities en concrete acties op dit terrein.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Van Tongeren over de bij- en meestook van duurzame biomassa in kolencentrales

MPs Jan Vos and Van Tongeren asked whether the approximately 3 billion euro subsidy for biomass co-firing in coal plants is cost-efficient, whether alternatives like wind or solar should be chosen, and whether the subsidy should be reconsidered in light of the Urgenda ruling. The minister defended the co-firing subsidy as needed to meet the 2020 renewable energy target, said no realistic alternative exists for 25 PJ by 2020, and deferred the Urgenda cost questions to a forthcoming study.
At this moment it is not possible to state the societal costs and the costs per household and for SMEs for the mentioned policy packages.
Op dit moment is het niet mogelijk om voor de genoemde beleidspakketten de maatschappelijke kosten en de kosten per huishouden en voor het MKB aan te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over een snel stijgend aantal beschadigingen aan boerderijen en drainagesystemen door bodemdaling in Groningen

Three PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why NAM and the Commissie Bodemdaling dismiss rising damage to farms and drainage systems from subsidence in Groningen as mere settlement damage, whether NAM will pay, and when the Grontmij study is due. The Minister confirmed complaints have risen, explained that the official studies find uniform subsidence with no absolute effect on water levels, noted NAM must pay damage caused by gas extraction, gave a spring 2016 timeline for the study, and pointed to a case-manager arrangement while negotiating with NAM.
Yes, I am aware that the number of damage reports has increased.
Ja, het is mij bekend dat het aantal meldingen van schade is toegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over de onderlinge samenwerkingsovereenkomst tussen de Nederlandse Aardolie Maatschappij (NAM) en het Centrum Veilig Wonen (CVW)

Opposition MPs asked the minister whether the cooperation agreement between NAM and the Centrum Veilig Wonen (CVW) is public, whether CVW is independent of NAM, and how contra-expertise hours are allocated. The minister said the agreement is private and not public, but was reviewed by the Commission of Toezicht, which found CVW independent and the relationship critical but sound, and promised to amend the damage protocol on contra-expertise.
This agreement is not public, but it has been reviewed by the Supervisory Committee on the Centrum Veilig Wonen, set up by me, in order to assess the working relationship between NAM and CVW.
Deze overeenkomst is niet openbaar, maar wel ingezien door de door mij ingestelde Commissie van Toezicht op het Centrum Veilig Wonen om de werkverhouding tussen NAM en CVW te kunnen beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Nijboer en Van Dekken over massale schade door gaswinning bij Delfzijl

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about widespread gas-extraction damage in villages near Delfzijl and whether he would press the Nationaal Coördinator Groningen for a fast investigation and speedy settlement. The minister confirmed the reports, said an investigation into the causes of high damage rates at the edges of the earthquake area starts in the first quarter of 2016, and promised attention to speedy, careful settlement of damage claims.

The National Coordinator Groningen (NCG) will start an investigation in the first quarter of this year into the causes of the high percentages of damage cases located at the edges of the earthquake area.

De Nationaal Coördinator Groningen (NCG) start in het eerste kwartaal van dit jaar met een onderzoek naar de oorzaken van de hoge percentages schadegevallen die gelokaliseerd zijn aan de randen van het aardbevingsgebied.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Nijboer en Van Dekken over de gelijke behandeling van aardbevingsschade in alle gemeenten

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked whether earthquake damage in Oldambt villages such as Nieuwolda, 't Waar and Nieuw-Scheemda mirrors the situation in Delfzijl, and asked the Nationaal Coördinator Groningen to extend its investigation to the whole area. Minister Kamp answered that the NCG will start in early 2016 an investigation into causes of high damage percentages at the edges of the earthquake area, including the municipalities named.

The Nationaal Coördinator Groningen (NCG) will start in the first quarter of this year an investigation into the causes of the high percentages of damage cases located at the edges of the earthquake area.

De Nationaal Coördinator Groningen (NCG) start in het eerste kwartaal van dit jaar met een onderzoek naar de oorzaken van de hoge percentages schadegevallen die gelokaliseerd zijn aan de randen van het aardbevingsgebied.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over het aardbevingsbestendig maken van de chemiesector in Delfzijl

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked why the Groningen National Coordinator's programme lacks a concrete plan for making Delfzijl's chemical sector earthquake-resistant, when it will come and when binding standards will exist. The minister answered that an industry table chaired by the coordinator will develop a joint approach expected in Q1 2016, that a Deltares/TNO guideline exists while standards are still under discussion, and that much of the research lies with industry itself.
Companies and competent authorities will jointly develop, via the so-called Industry Table, a comprehensive approach linking existing and planned methods and studies.
Bedrijven en bevoegde instanties zullen via de zogenaamde Industrietafel samen een sluitende aanpak ontwikkelen, die bestaande en voorgenomen methodieken en onderzoeken verbindt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Jan Vos over de vernieling van drie Nederlandse bedrijven in Ethiopië

MPs Van Laar and Jan Vos asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the destruction of three Dutch companies in Ethiopia, including the causes, land-grab concerns, government response and safety of Dutch entrepreneurs. The minister answered that two Dutch firms were affected, that the embassy is in close contact with them, that the attacks likely stemmed from fears over land rights linked to Addis Ababa's expansion, and that the Ethiopian government will prosecute perpetrators and facilitate compensation talks.
The Dutch embassy is in almost daily contact with the two affected Dutch companies, Solagrow and Grazeland.
De Nederlandse ambassade staat in bijna dagelijks contact met de twee getroffen Nederlandse bedrijven, Solagrow en Grazeland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over een verschuiving van de aardbevingen naar de randen van het gaswinningsgebied

MPs asked whether earthquakes are shifting to the edges of the Groningen gas field after production cuts at Loppersum, and whether closure sequencing could worsen the situation and be included in the gas-extraction decision. The minister answered that faults do not move, that quakes in the edge areas follow local pressure decline and production, and that NAM has been asked to optimise production allocation across the field, with SodM supervising the work.

In line with SodM's advice of 1 December 2015, I have asked NAM what the optimal production distribution across the entire field (including the Loppersum area) is, in order to further reduce the risk now and in the future.

Conform het advies van SodM van 1 december 2015 heb ik NAM gevraagd wat de optimale productieverdeling over het gehele veld (inclusief het Loppersumgebied) is, om het risico nu en in de toekomst verder te verkleinen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Nijboer en Van Dekken over de onafhankelijkheid van het Centrum Veilig Wonen

MPs Jan Vos, Nijboer and Van Dekken asked the minister whether the Centrum Veilig Wonen (CVW), which handles earthquake damage claims for NAM, is truly independent of NAM, and raised concerns about the oversight commission, the damage assessment process, pressure towards demolition, the Handboek Aardbevingsschade and the reversal of the burden of proof. The minister replied that NAM remains legally liable, that CVW is operated at arm's length under a tender, that the oversight chair is independent, that damage assessments and contra-expertise are handled properly, and that a bill on a statutory presumption of causation will be submitted after Council of State advice.
I have asked the Council of State for urgent advice on the bill concerning the statutory presumption of evidence.
Ik heb de Raad van State gevraagd om spoedadvies over het wetsvoorstel omtrent het wettelijk bewijsvermoeden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt, Van Dekken en Jan Vos over het onderzoek van RTV-Noord dat Groningers uit een bepaald gebied geen rechtsbijstandverzekering kunnen afsluiten

MPs Recourt, Van Dekken and Jan Vos asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether residents of the Groningen earthquake area can obtain legal expenses insurance, whether insurers should offer alternatives for non-quake disputes, and about insurers' deal with the Stichting WAG. The minister replied that the claim is inaccurate, that some insurers accept new clients from the area and others do not, that the NCG will examine whether conditions are disproportionate, and that insurers decide how to inform clients about the WAG agreement.
The Minister of Economic Affairs has additionally asked the NCG to conduct further research into the conditions insurers impose for taking out legal expenses insurance within the earthquake area.

De Minister van Economische Zaken heeft daarnaast de NCG gevraagd om nader onderzoek te doen naar de voorwaarden die verzekeraars stellen om een rechtsbijstandsverzekering af te sluiten binnen het aardbevingsgebied.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Albert de Vries over bouwkeurmerken in relatie tot aardbevingsbestendigheid

Two MPs asked whether earthquake risk in Groningen is factored into construction certification (KOMO, KIWA) and CE marking, and whether the sector can build earthquake-resistant. The minister answered that certificates cover material strength independent of load type, earthquake resistance is assessed through project-specific structural calculations, and a Groningen-specific regulation (NPR) is planned to be designated in the Bouwbesluit in early 2016.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken en Jan Vos over het bericht dat Nederlandse banken een megakippenbedrijf in Oekraïne financieren

Two PvdA MPs asked whether Dutch banks financing a huge Ukrainian poultry company, export credit guarantees for intensive livestock systems, and Dutch versus Ukrainian animal welfare standards were acceptable. The minister answered that Ukrainian standards are currently lower but the EU association agreement requires convergence, that export credits are assessed under IFC standards including animal welfare, and that the government sees no reason to refuse credits on the basis of herd size.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Jan Vos over de invloed van grote bedrijven op het duurzaamheidsbeleid

MPs Cegerek and Jan Vos asked whether large companies unduly influence sustainability policy, citing a PhD study on business lobbying, and whether small players are disadvantaged in schemes such as SDE+, the postcode rose scheme and the energy savings fund. The minister answers that government policy is now shaped jointly with stakeholders, that the cabinet weighs interests itself, that most innovation funds go to SMEs, and that the postcode rose and energy savings fund rules have been simplified, with a further review promised.
In doing so, the cabinet is responsible for a balanced weighing of the various interests.
Daarbij is het kabinet verantwoordelijk voor een evenwichtige afweging van de verschillende belangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Albert de Vries over de splitsing van DELTA en de positie van kerncentrale Borssele

MPs Jan Vos and Albert de Vries asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the planned split of DELTA, the one-year transition period set by the regulator ACM, and the future ownership of the Borssele nuclear plant, including the Van Gent motion and nationalisation options. The minister answered that the ACM will decide on a enforcement order with a transition period by year-end, that the state retains tools (Electricity Act, nuclear law, Borssele covenants) to block unwanted changes of control, and that he will not comment on nationalisation beyond referring to the earlier answers.
I aim to ensure that the position of the Borssele nuclear power plant remains well safeguarded in all cases.
Ik streef ernaar dat de positie van de kerncentrale Borssele in alle gevallen goed geborgd blijft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Servaes over gasdeals van Gasunie en Shell met Russisch staatsbedrijf Gazprom, alsmede over de politieke onafhankelijkheid van gasproductie in de Noordzee

MPs Jan Vos and Servaes asked whether the Gasunie and Shell/BASF gas deals with Gazprom comply with EU sanctions, public interest duties and efforts to reduce Russian energy dependence. The minister answered that the government is not party to private deals, sees no conflict with sanctions in principle, that Gasunie must still weigh public interest in concrete projects, and that no separate impact study is planned.
The cabinet does not consider this necessary.
Het kabinet acht dit niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jan Vos over het windpark op de NDSM-werf in Amsterdam-Noord

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about an 18 MW wind project on the NDSM wharf in Amsterdam, questioning why the province of Noord-Holland blocked it despite local support and whether the minister could intervene. The minister answered that no formal application exists yet, that the province rejected the principle request for not meeting spatial rules (including a 600 m distance from housing), and that the province is on track for its wind target and will discuss the distance norm with the municipality, but he sees no role for himself.
The province has informed the municipality of Amsterdam and the initiator Coöperatie NDSM Energie U.A. that the current principle application does not meet the set spatial frameworks.
De provincie heeft de gemeente Amsterdam en de initiatiefnemer Coöperatie NDSM Energie U.A. laten weten dat de huidige principe-aanvraag niet voldoet aan de gestelde ruimtelijke kaders
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jan Vos over de verplichte energie-audit

MP Jan Vos asked the minister about the mandatory energy audit under the EU Energy Efficiency Directive, its implementation status, sanctions for non-compliance, awareness, and sanctions in neighbouring countries. The minister answered that existing MJA3/MEE plans and certified systems largely satisfy the audit duty, that municipalities/provinces enforce it with sanctions available under the Environmental Management Act, and that lists and clearer criteria are being prepared.
The competent authority (municipalities and provinces) assesses whether the audit obligation has been met.
Het bevoegd gezag beoordeelt of is voldaan aan de auditverplichting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over het bericht ‘NAM mag druk onder Langelo opvoeren, ondanks kans op zwaardere bevingen’

Three PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the NAM's plan to increase gas storage at Norg despite the risk of stronger earthquakes, and why residents were not informed. The minister said the storage expansion approval dates from June 2014, the August 2015 change only lifts a compartment-level pressure restriction, municipalities and province were informed but residents were not, and seismic risk remains very limited according to SodM and TNO, with a monitoring network planned.
The residents were not separately informed.
De omwonenden zijn niet separaat geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over het bericht ‘Geef premie van 4000 euro aan alle inwoners aardbevingsgebied’

MPs asked whether all residents of the Groningen earthquake area should receive a 4,000 euro premium, as proposed by the Groninger Bodem Beweging, and whether this was promised in the earlier administrative agreement. The minister said no such promise exists, that the waardevermeerdering scheme covers only homeowners, and that the National Coordinator is reviewing all schemes, with the current scheme reopened retroactively for damage cases outside the 11 municipalities.
The administrative agreement 'Trust in Recovery and Recovery of Trust' provides that homeowners will be offered a value-increasing package.
In het bestuursakkoord «Vertrouwen op Herstel en Herstel van Vertrouwen» is afgesproken dat aan woningeigenaren een waardeverhogend pakket beschikbaar wordt gesteld
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Jan Vos over personen die wedstrijdinformatie doorspelen via de telefoon vanaf voetbaltribunes

MPs asked whether people relaying match statistics by phone from football stands are a growing problem, what powers clubs have to remove them, and whether gambling restrictions are needed. The minister answered that clubs set house rules and can remove people for misconduct or nuisance, that there is no increase in complaints, and that the gambling questions are addressed in a separate bill answer.
It is up to the clubs themselves to determine the level of nuisance.
Het is aan de clubs zelf om de mate van overlast te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Tongeren en Van Veldhoven over het vermeende manipuleren van de prognoses voor zonne- en windenergie

MPs Jan Vos, Van Tongeren and Van Veldhoven asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about allegations that the IEA manipulated its wind and solar growth forecasts, and whether its outlook is accurate. The minister denied any bias, explained that the WEO presents scenarios rather than forecasts, said the IEA's methodology is careful, and argued the scenarios help inform policy choices.
However, the IEA does not present growth forecasts in the sense of predictions in its annual World Energy Outlook.
Het IEA presenteert in de jaarlijkse World Energy Outlook echter geen groeiprognoses in de zin van voorspellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jan Vos over bosbranden voor palmolie in Indonesië

An MP asked the minister about the Indonesian palm oil forest fires, Dutch policy, Unilever's role and EU and IMVO measures. The minister answered that Indonesia is taking steps but enforcement is needed, that Dutch support runs through IDH, Solidaridad and EU market initiatives, and that Unilever's commitments are positive.

Secondly, I encourage the Indonesian authorities to be open to international market developments and to give companies that commit to sustainability measures and standards, nationally and internationally, room to put them into practice.
Ten tweede moedig ik de Indonesische autoriteiten aan open te staan voor de internationale marktontwikkelingen en bedrijven die zich verplichten aan duurzaamheidsmaatregelen en standaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Jan Vos over fossiele reserves die mogelijk zullen worden afgeschreven

MPs Nijboer and Jan Vos asked the Finance and Infrastructure and Environment ministers about 'stranded assets' from fossil fuel reserves, the Citigroup valuation, DNB and FSB work on climate risk, annual reporting of climate risk and Chevron dividends. The government answered that a Paris agreement's effects are premature to judge, that the carbon bubble concept is still debated, and promised to inform parliament on FSB results and to ask DNB for a broad climate-risk analysis by early next year.

During the AFB of 1 October it was also promised that DNB will be asked to look broadly at the risks of climate change for the financial sector in light of a recent speech by Mark Carney and the FSB's plans.

is tevens toegezegd dat DNB verzocht zal worden om in het licht van een recente speech van Mark Carney 5 en de plannen van de FSB, in brede zin te kijken naar de risico’s van klimaatverandering voor de financiële sector.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jans Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over de toepassing van fracking bij gaswinning in Saaksum

MPs Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about NAM's plan to use fracking to recover remaining gas near Saaksum, the risks, alternatives and consultation with local authorities. The minister answered that fracking here is a routine, safety-checked stimulation within the existing plan, that SodM reviews the risk documents before work starts, that no alternative exists for this rock type, and that NAM has consulted local authorities, but declined to ask NAM to refrain.
However, regarding the upcoming work, I see no reason and no possibility to ask NAM not to carry it out.
Ten aanzien van de aanstaande werkzaamheden zie ik echter geen reden en geen mogelijkheid om NAM te verzoeken deze niet uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Kerstens over het niet aanpassen van de clausule voor het beslechten van investeringsgeschillen in het handelsverdrag met Canada, genaamd CETA

Two MPs asked why the ISDS investor-state dispute clause in the CETA trade deal with Canada has not been changed, and whether the Commission should reopen the CETA negotiations given work on an alternative for TTIP. The minister says the Commission does not want to reopen CETA but will align the investment chapter with TTIP reforms through technical changes in legal revision, that CETA already contains improvements, and that the text may still be adjusted before European Parliament approval.
Once the legal revision process is concluded, the agreement will be submitted to the Council for approval and signature and will also have to be approved by the European Parliament.

Als het proces van juridische revisie is afgesloten, zal het akkoord ter goedkeuring en ondertekening worden voorgelegd aan de Raad en zal het ook moeten worden goedgekeurd door het Europees parlement.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jan Vos over de misstanden op en rondom Indiase theeplantages

An MP asked the minister about labour abuses (including child labour and poor wages) on Indian tea plantations supplying Unilever, and whether the Dutch government can oversee multinationals' compliance with OECD guidelines. The minister answered that companies and governments have distinct duties, pointed to a food-sector CSR covenant, transparency benchmarks, the EU non-financial reporting directive and the National Contact Point, and said Indian local enforcement is often lacking.
The CSR covenant for the food sector may possibly contribute to this.
Het IMVO-convenant van de voedingsmiddelensector kan daaraan mogelijk bijdragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Nijboer over het bericht over een ingestorte boerderij in Bedum

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs what steps had been taken in the Bedum farmhouse collapse case, why the counter-expertise took so long, and whether NAM's lack of communication and support for residents was adequate. The minister declined to comment on the individual case in detail, described the procedural steps and the municipality's coordinating role, acknowledged that long silences are undesirable, and asked the National Coordinator Groningen to examine the adequacy of support for residents.
In general I am reluctant to respond to individual cases.
Ten algemene ben ik terughoudend met het reageren op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Van Tongeren over de sluiting van de kerncentrale Tihange

MPs Jan Vos and Van Tongeren asked whether the government would act on Dutch municipal motions urging closure of the Belgian Tihange plant, press Belgian counterparts, and clarify iodine tablet distribution and emergency planning. The minister replied that nuclear safety is a Belgian national responsibility handled by FANC, that cooperation with FANC is being strengthened, and described the regional emergency plans and iodine tablet stocks without giving an exact distribution radius.
Nuclear safety is a national responsibility and it is therefore the Belgian regulator that decides whether the plant is safe or must be closed.
Nucleaire veiligheid is een nationale verantwoordelijkheid en het is dan ook de Belgische toezichthouder
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jan Vos over de berichtgeving over gasexplosies in Noord-Siberië die grote kraters veroorzaken en leiden tot grote methaanemissies

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports of gas explosions creating craters and methane emissions in Siberian permafrost, whether they could trigger feedback loops, and whether the issue could be raised at the Paris climate conference. The government answered that the IPCC AR5 does not discuss crater formation, estimated permafrost emissions as a feedback to be assessed in the next IPCC report, and said the issue would be weighed in UNFCCC talks if new findings emerge.
These and future publications on permafrost emissions will be assessed in the next (sixth) IPCC report.
Deze en toekomstige publicaties op het gebied van permafrostemissies zullen in het volgende (zesde) IPCC rapport worden beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over het bericht ‘CdK haalt ongemeen fel uit naar de NAM’

PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that the Groningen Commissioner of the King criticised NAM's slow handling of complex earthquake damage claims, including a case in Nieuwolda where work stopped despite safety concerns. The Minister declined to comment on individual cases, pointed to the damage protocol, the transfer of new claims to the Centrum Veilig Wonen, and agreements with NAM to finish complex cases by year-end.
As Minister, it is not appropriate for me to respond to individual cases.
Als Minister past het mij niet om op individuele gevallen te reageren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Jan Vos over de handelsmissie naar India en het verzoek van een aantal NGO’s om te pleiten voor de vrijheid van organisatie en meningsuiting

MPs Servaes and Jan Vos asked the Prime Minister and ministers whether the government would press India during the trade mission to protect freedom of association and expression, given reported restrictions on NGOs such as Greenpeace and visa refusals. The minister answered that the government shares concern about shrinking space for international NGOs in India, raised it with Indian officials and agreed to discuss NGO cooperation in coming months, but left constitutional judgments to Indian courts and only promised reporting in the quarterly letter.

During my meeting with Minister of State Mr Haribhai P. Chaudhary I emphasised that a free, independent, active and critical civil society, through dialogue with businesses and governments, can contribute greatly to inclusive growth and development.

Ik benadrukte tijdens mijn onderhoud met Minister of State, Mr Haribhai P. Chaudhary dat een vrij, onafhankelijk, actief en kritisch maatschappelijk middenveld via een dialoog met bedrijven en overheden veel kan bijdragen aan inclusieve groei en ontwikkeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Jan Vos naar aanleiding van het bericht ‘Onderzoek naar bodem Wijnaldum’ in de Leeuwarder Courant

MPs Jacobi and Jan Vos asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports on soil subsidence in Wijnaldum, whether the Tcbb only examines mining-related causes, and whether residents get timely compensation and burden-of-proof reversal. The minister explained the Tcbb's legal mandate and compensation procedure, said damage to public infrastructure is handled faster through agreements, and referred to earlier letters on reversing the burden of proof.
It is in the interest of both the citizen and the mining company that the correct cause of the damage is established.
Het is zowel in het belang van de burger als van de mijnbouwonderneming dat de juiste oorzaak van de schade wordt vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Kerstens over het Trans-Atlantic Trade and Investment Partnership (TTIP) en arbeidsnormen, REACH, REFIT en chemische ontsmetting van kippenvlees

MPs Jan Vos and Kerstens asked the government about TTIP and labour standards (ILO conventions, enforcement), REACH and REFIT, and chemical decontamination of chicken with peracetic acid. The minister answered that ILO core conventions are an essential element of the trade chapter, that REACH and national labour rules are not on the table, that REFIT runs separately from TTIP, and that any peracetic acid approval must follow EU risk assessment and member state voting.
I will ask the Social and Economic Council (SER) for advice on this.
Ik zal de sociaaleconomische Raad (SER) hierover om advies vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over de waardedaling van woningen door aardbevingen

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a VU study finding house values drop 1.2 to 1.9 percent per earthquake above 2.2 on the Richter scale, and about the adequacy of the compensation scheme and its trust and complexity. The minister disputes the VU finding based on Ortec Finance studies, describes the compensation scheme and planned market measures, and promises to pass the findings to the National Coordinator Groningen.
I will bring the outcomes of this study and of the study commissioned by the Dialogue Table to the attention of the National Coordinator Groningen.
Ik zal de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek en het onderzoek dat gedaan wordt in opdracht van de Dialoogtafel onder de aandacht brengen van de Nationaal Coördinator Groningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over het herstel van aardbevingsschade in Groningen

MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether NAM and CVW control contractor choice for earthquake damage repair in Groningen, and how the government responds to criticism of CVW's expert assessments and WOZ valuations. The minister answered that residents can choose among three options including their own contractor, that the procedure protects choice and counter-expertise, and that WOZ valuation is a municipal responsibility.
The Supervisory Committee of CVW oversees the proper execution of CVW's work.
De Commissie van Toezicht van CVW ziet toe op een gedegen uitvoering van de werkzaamheden door CVW.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over de impact van aardbevingsschade in Groningen

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about earthquake damage in Groningen, including whether induced quakes are comparable in impact to Southern European quakes and the safety of primary schools such as CBS De Regenboog in Bedum. The minister replied that induced quakes have a different impact than natural ones, that shake-maps will be published after the new seismic network is operational in summer 2015, and that school buildings are being inspected and reinforced by NAM, with a final report on the Bedum school expected in a few weeks.
Yes. With the new seismological network in Groningen, currently being built, it will become possible to make ground acceleration visible directly after an earthquake in the form of shake-maps.

Ja. Met het nieuwe seismologische netwerk in Groningen, dat op dit moment wordt opgebouwd, wordt het mogelijk om ook de grondversnelling direct na de beving inzichtelijk te maken in de vorm van «shake-maps».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over de aardbevingsbestendigheid van het Chemiepark in Delfzijl

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the minister about a 2015 letter from Delfzijl's mayor on earthquake resistance of the Delfzijl chemical park, whether a study was promised in 2013, and whether research has been done and the municipality will be informed. The minister confirms the letter and a working group with a methodology by Deltares and TNO, but says the research is run by individual companies, funded by NAM, takes up to two years, and results will only be shared through the regular permitting process with the municipalities.
