I will ask the National Coordinator Groningen to discuss with the parties involved whether, and if so how, the research process can be accelerated.
Ik zal de Nationaal Coördinator Groningen vragen om met de betrokken partijen te bespreken of, en zo ja, hoe het onderzoeksproces versneld kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teeven en Jan Vos over het anti-dumping onderzoek naar de import van Transformatorstaal in de EU

MPs Teeven and Jan Vos asked whether EU anti-dumping duties on grain-oriented electrical steel (GOES) are justified and whether they threaten Dutch jobs, and what the government will do. The minister answered that the Commission found dumping and injury, that recent world price rises and quality issues need clarification, that Netherlands asked the Commission for clarity and will take a critical stance in the consultation, but that the government does not compensate firms for anti-dumping measures.
The Netherlands has asked the Commission to provide clarity on the basis for the anti-dumping duties.
Nederland heeft de Commissie verzocht duidelijkheid te verschaffen over de grondslag voor de antidumping heffingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Jan Vos over de brandveiligheid van windmolens

Two PvdA MPs asked about fire safety of wind turbines after a fire at Ooltgensplaat, and whether investigations were still pending. The government answered that forensic, fire brigade and labour inspectorate investigations are ongoing, with results expected around summer 2015, and that the Chamber will be informed of outcomes.
Publication of the reports will follow as soon as possible, insofar as the Public Prosecution Service does not object because of criminal law aspects.
Publicatie van de rapportages volgt zo spoedig mogelijk, voor zover het Openbaar Ministerie dit niet bezwaarlijk acht vanwege de strafrechtelijke aspecten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Albert de Vries over een 100%-controle in de reactor van kerncentrale Borssele

Two MPs asked the minister whether hairline cracks in the Borssele reactor vessel can be excluded, whether a 100% inspection and equally sensitive equipment as in Belgium can be required, and whether the research report and standards used are adequate. The minister replied that cracks found in Belgian vessels were not present in Borssele, that the inspection was qualified in advance under ENIQ and assessed by Lloyd's Register and the regulator, and that the report is publicly available via EPZ though not physically held by the regulator.
The NRG research report is not physically in the hands of the ANVS but has been made public by the licence holder EPZ.
Het onderzoeksrapport van NRG is fysiek niet in handen van de ANVS maar is door de vergunninghouder EPZ openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Jacobi en Van Dekken over de gaswinningsplannen op en rond Terschelling

MPs from the PvdA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about Tulip Oil's gas extraction plans near Terschelling, including CO2 content, risks to the island's freshwater supply, use of harmful substances, and how national interest is weighed against nature and water protection. The Minister answered that the CO2 share (about 14%) and the feasibility of reinjection await TNO and Energiebeheer Nederland advice, that risks to freshwater and substances will be assessed in the EIA after permit approval, and that further decisions under the national coordination regime will follow.
I first await these advices before I can address concrete quantities of gas (or CO2).
Ik wacht eerst deze adviezen af, alvorens ik kan ingaan op concrete hoeveelheden gas (of CO 2 ).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Albert de Vries over “Scheurtjes Kerncentrale Doel groter”

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether cracks in the reactor vessels of Belgian plants Doel 3 and Tihange 2 were larger than before, whether the Borssele plant had been checked with equally sensitive equipment, and whether Dutch regions had been informed. The minister confirmed larger hydrogen flakes were found after more sensitive testing, stated Borssele's 2013 tests used qualified equipment and that nuclear safety is a national responsibility, and said the plants are shut down so no new Dutch safety implications arise.
Nevertheless, the ANVS will continue to closely monitor developments in Belgium and other countries regarding hydrogen flakes.
Desondanks blijft de ANVS de ontwikkelingen in België en in andere landen omtrent waterstofvlokken nauwkeurig volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Jan Vos over het bericht ’Hoe een illegale windmolen blijft doordraaien’

Two MPs asked whether an illegal wind turbine that the Council of State ruled must be stopped should be enforced by the municipality, and how wind energy is sited with local residents. The minister answered that the Council of State confirmed enforcement was required but the decision now rests with the municipality, which the national government has no role in, and that participation will be anchored in the Omgevingswet.
It is up to the municipality to take a new decision. The national government has no role in this.
Het is aan de gemeente om een nieuw besluit te nemen. Het Rijk heeft hierin geen rol.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Van Dekken over de mogelijkheden voor sportverenigingen om te investeren in zonnepanelen

Two MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether sports clubs can contribute to decentralised renewable energy, whether they must pay VAT on solar power that other small consumers do not, and what fiscal incentives could make solar panels or energy saving attractive for them. The minister confirmed the VAT position under EU case law, noted that clubs can deduct input VAT only for taxable supplies, listed existing energy tax schemes, and announced a subsidy scheme for sports clubs effective 1 January 2016.
To implement this motion, I am currently drafting a subsidy scheme together with the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport, which will take effect on 1 January 2016.
Ter uitvoering van deze motie stel ik momenteel samen met de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport een subsidieregeling op die per 1 januari 2016 effectief zal worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Dekken en Nijboer over het bericht ‘Dit kan echt niet’

MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a Groninger residents' case where a family with two children allegedly had been waiting two years in a replacement home, and whether NAM could reopen a valuation despite earlier commitments, and whether such cases belong before the Commission for Exceptional Cases. The minister said the family was not in a replacement home for two years but in its own home, that a temporary home became available in December, that NAM has offered options, and that individual cases are not shared for privacy reasons, while referring to the handover of claims to the CVW and the role of the ombudsman-type raadsman.
Furthermore, as Minister of Economic Affairs I want to be restrained in sharing information about individual cases, for privacy reasons.
Verder wil ik als Minister van Economische Zaken terughoudend zijn met het delen van informatie over individuele gevallen, omwille van de privacy.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Kerstens over de gevolgen van het Trans-Atlantic Trade and Investment Partnership voor de werkgelegenheid

MPs Jan Vos and Kerstens asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about a Tufts working paper claiming TTIP would cause large job losses and a negative trade balance, and about related methodological criticism. The minister rejected the paper's key assumptions, argued the CGE model is the best available tool, cited Commission and Ecorys estimates of positive effects, and agreed to invite its author for a meeting.
I will invite Capaldo for a conversation.
Ik zal Capaldo uitnodigen voor een gesprek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Jan Vos over de Maatlat Duurzame Veehouderij

MPs Van Dekken and Jan Vos asked whether the Maatlat Duurzame Veehouderij (sustainability scale for livestock farming) wrongly excludes energy-saving cooling systems like ECO200 that avoid high-GWP HFCs, and whether manufacturers are preparing for the 2020 HFC ban. The government answered that the scale does not exclude such systems but rates them by function, that ECO200 components were included in the energy theme, and that the new EU F-gas regulation provides sufficient incentive for innovation.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Jan Vos over ‘de belabberde kwaliteit van de indicatieve energielabels’

MPs Albert de Vries and Jan Vos asked the Minister for Housing about the poor quality of indicative energy labels, based on the WoON2006 median, the energy label atlas, and the calculation method. The minister defended the method as a cautious first indication, said the atlas is run by a private foundation, ordered an external second opinion, and explained how owners can convert the provisional label to a definitive one.
I have also decided to commission a second opinion from an external agency.
Tevens heb ik besloten een «second opinion» uit te laten voeren door een extern bureau.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermeij en Jan Vos over het in surseance verkerende staalbedrijf Nedstaal

MPs Vermeij and Jan Vos asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Social Affairs whether they would engage with Nedstaal, a steel company in suspension of payments, about a scaled-down restart, press for preserving regional jobs, and ensure UWV takes extra action for dismissed workers. The minister reports ongoing contact with management, the curator and the municipality, a takeover by Andus Group preserving 200 of 280 jobs, and a regional steering group with UWV and sector support for the 80 workers losing their jobs.
Together with the sector it is being examined whether support can be offered to Nedstaal's employees from the sector plan and what that support would consist of.
Samen met de sector wordt onderzocht of er ondersteuning geboden kan worden aan de werknemers van Nedstaal vanuit het sectorplan en waaruit deze ondersteuning bestaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jan Vos over het interview met Martin Christie (Bettercoal) waarin hij pleit voor een behoedzame kolendialoog met Colombia

An MP asks the minister about Bettercoal's coal-mine audits in Colombia, the independence of the assessments, how audit results feed into the Dutch energy sector coal covenant, and what makes a stakeholder dialogue inclusive. The minister describes the audit process and says the covenant will not be finalised on 1 October because the ACM review is pending, but aims to conclude it before a November trip to Colombia.
I do aim to finalise the covenant before the trip to Colombia.
Ik streef wel naar afronding van het convenant vóór de reis naar Colombia.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over het bericht dat er een aardbeving heeft plaatsgevonden bij Froombosch

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about two earthquakes near Froombosch, the historical frequency and magnitude of quakes there, whether seismicity has risen since the Loppersum well closures, and whether damage claims are being handled quickly. The minister confirmed the reports, listed seven earlier quakes above magnitude 1.5, said recent quakes show no change in seismicity, and reported about 400 related damage claims with most light cases resolved within three months.
Contact has already been made with 75% of residents, and appointments for a visit by the damage expert have been made with half of them.
Er is inmiddels met 75% van de bewoners contact geweest en met de helft zijn afspraken gemaakt voor een bezoek van de schade expert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jan Vos over groene stroom uit het buitenland

MP Jan Vos asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that green electricity sold in the Netherlands is largely imported, and whether consumers expect new domestic renewable capacity to be built. The minister answered that in 2013, 74% of guarantees of origin used were from abroad, pledged clearer origin labelling on electricity labels from 2015, and explained that the GvO system is EU-based and functions as intended.
For the consumer, it must be clear what they are buying when they purchase renewable electricity.
Voor de consument moet helder zijn wat hij koopt wanneer hij hernieuwbare stroom inkoopt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Jan Vos over hoge vastrechtkosten in de energiesector

MPs Mei Li Vos and Jan Vos asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about high fixed connection charges (vastrecht) in the energy sector, which they said could mislead consumers, and about abolishing them, linearising tariffs and improving price transparency. The minister replied that tariff structure is left to suppliers in a free market, that fixed charges preserve consumer choice and competition so abolition would be undesirable, and that improving transparency via ACM-supervised 'Aanbod op Maat' and harmonised terminology is the preferred route.
I see making the tariff structure more transparent as the most effective way to safeguard consumer choice and to stimulate competition and market functioning in the energy sector.

Ik zie het transparanter maken van de tariefopbouw als de meest effectieve manier om de keuzevrijheid van de consument te borgen en de concurrentie en de marktwerking binnen de energiesector te stimuleren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jan Vos over het bericht dat de lange arm van de VS bestuurders nerveus maakt

An MP asked the government about reports that the US Foreign Corrupt Practices Act could hold Dutch executives liable for foreign bribery and whether the Netherlands should tackle corruption more effectively. The government answered that Dutch law and the OECD convention already criminalise foreign bribery, that the FCPA has no known link to US embargoes, and that enforcement capacity has improved through joint investigations, with a fuller policy response promised later.
For details on the follow-up to the OECD recommendations I refer to the integrated policy response promised to your House for the coming autumn.
Voor details over de opvolging van de OESO-aanbevelingen verwijs ik naar de aan uw Kamer voor aankomend najaar toegezegde integrale beleidsreactie
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jan Vos over het bericht dat kledingfabrieken in Bangladesh nog onveilig zijn

MP Jan Vos (PvdA) asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports that garment factories in Bangladesh remain unsafe, including whether Dutch brands sourced from factories ordered closed and what steps they and the Bangladesh Accord take. The minister answered by referring to a separate letter to parliament (Kamerstuk 33 625, nr. 121) that responds to these questions, without answering them in the document itself.

The written questions of MP Jan Vos (PvdA), question number 2014Z15028, have been answered by means of the letter 'Response to the report that textile factories in Bangladesh are still unsafe and answers to the written questions of MPs Jan Vos and Voordewind'.

De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Jan Vos (PvdA), vraagnummer 2014Z15028 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Reactie op het bericht dat textielfabrieken in Bangladesh nog onveilig zijn en beantwoording van de schriftelijke vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Voordewind»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Jan Vos over beloningen bij netbeheerder Liander

MPs Kerstens and Jan Vos asked the ministers about reports that 34 Liander staff, including eleven large severance payments, exceeded the WNT pay norm in 2013. Minister Plasterk answered that seven top officials and 17 others exceeded the maximum, that the top officials fall under transitional law, and that the sector will be judged on the WNT, with a report to parliament by end 2014.
The number of salaries above the WNT norm at present is a consequence of the historical development of salaries in the public and semi-public sector.
Het aantal salarissen boven de WNT-norm op dit moment is een gevolg van de historische ontwikkeling van salarissen in de publieke en semipublieke sector.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Jacobi over berichten over mogelijke opslag van kernafval onder de grond in Friesland

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether there is research into underground storage of nuclear waste in Friesland, what alternatives to final disposal exist, and when final disposal would apply. The minister answered that the OPERA bureau study on Boom clay does not identify suitable sites, that site-specific research is not on the agenda for decades, that a study of long-term options will be sent to parliament by year-end, and that waste is stored at COVRA for at least 100 years before deep disposal.
Site-specific research or a site selection is not on the agenda in the research or in policy for the coming decades.
Locatie specifiek onderzoek of een locatiekeuze is in het onderzoek én in het beleid de komende tientallen jaren niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Kerstens over het bericht dat kledingmerken nog steeds hongerloon betalen aan kledingarbeiders

MPs asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about a Schone Kleren Campagne report finding that none of 171 clothing brands pay a living wage in their supply chains, and what the government would do. The minister called the findings disappointing but not new, pointed to the national textile action plan, a planned living-wage conference and a future textile covenant, but offered no binding commitments on companies.
The report indicates that none of the companies examined currently pays a living wage in the supply chain concerned.
Het rapport geeft aan dat geen van de onderzochte bedrijven op dit moment leefbaar loon in de betrokken toeleveringsketen betaalt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Nijboer en Jan Vos over het bericht ‘Onduidelijkheid over ingestorte boerderij Bedum’

MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the collapse of a barn in Bedum, the evacuation of residents, why NAM and the municipality would not explain the cause, and how information on earthquake damage in the area is provided. The minister answered that the municipality commissioned an independent investigation into the cause, that residents were advised to leave on fire brigade advice, that several earlier evacuations were due to combined factors, and that information is shared via official consultations, the Dialoogtafel and NAM communications.
Because there was no clarity about the causes of the collapse at that time, the letter and press release did not go into possible causes, also to prevent speculation.
Omdat er toen geen duidelijkheid was over de oorzaken van de instorting is – ook om speculatie te voorkomen – in de brief en het persbericht niet nader ingegaan op mogelijke oorzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Jan Vos over de dubbeltellingregeling voor betere biobrandstoffen

MPs Bisschop and Jan Vos asked the government about the Corbey Commission's advice to simplify the double-counting scheme for advanced biofuels, including abolishing partial double counting, and about the lack of a level playing field in the EU. The Secretary of State agreed to adopt the advice on removing partial double counting using a 70/30% threshold, to be implemented by the NEa by year-end, and offered affected parties a choice about existing decisions.
I adopt this part of the advice and will swiftly amend the regulations accordingly.
Ik neem dit gedeelte van het advies over en pas de regelgeving daarop snel aan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jan Vos over het bericht dat Shell, Unilever en Philips de politiek oproepen het innovatiebeleid te moderniseren

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a call by CEOs of Shell, Unilever, Philips and others to align science and innovation policy with societal themes such as ageing and greening, and about concrete proposals and the forthcoming science vision. The minister answered that the government already links the top-sector policy to societal challenges, welcomed several CTO proposals as interesting, and committed to a workshop with business, science and government and to take the input into the science vision due around summer.
To that end, together with the ministers of Education, Culture and Science, I will contact the authors of the letter in the short term.
Ik zal daartoe samen met de bewindslieden van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap op korte termijn contact opnemen met de opstellers van de brief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jan Vos over de komst van een schip met Noordpoololie naar Rotterdam

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether he would act to stop a tanker of Arctic (Northern Pole) oil bound for Rotterdam, including lobbying EU ministers for an import ban, and whether his planned Yamal visit had a purpose. The minister confirmed the report, pointed to his letter on the Arctic balance, said no legal basis exists to block unloading and refining, and took no further action.
I will not take any further action on this point.
Ik zal op dit punt geen verdere actie ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jan Vos over het bericht dat lokale groene energie niet goed van de grond komt

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the reduced energy tax rate for local energy projects, in force since 1 January 2014, is inadequate because almost no projects have been realised, and whether uncertainty over net metering and the Vos motion has slowed them. The minister answered that no permits had yet been issued, that realising sustainable projects takes time, and that the Vos motion concerns only behind-the-meter generation, so it is unrelated to local projects.
This does not mean, however, that the conclusion must be drawn that the scheme in its current form is not adequate.
Dit betekent echter niet dat de conclusie moet worden getrokken dat de regeling in de huidige vorm niet toereikend is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dikkers en Jan Vos over het bericht “Alleen nog duurzame soja is stap te ver voor vleesindustrie”

Two MPs (Dikkers and Jan Vos, PvdA) asked the government whether the meat sector will meet its 2015 pledge to buy only certified sustainable soy, and what the state can do to help. Minister Ploumen answers that the 2013 target was missed, that the sector's ambition for 2015 remains, that RTRS supply exceeded Dutch needs, and that the government will keep urging industry to meet its commitments without taking binding measures.
The target for 2013 was therefore indeed not met.
De doelstelling voor 2013 is dus inderdaad niet gehaald
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Hamer over het bericht dat er weer veel banen verdwijnen bij MSD in Oss

MPs Jan Vos and Hamer asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Social Affairs about the loss of around 440 jobs at MSD in Oss, including how affected workers will be helped and what is being done with the municipality. Minister Kamp answered that a social plan with retraining support and an external job-placement firm is in place, that he is already in talks with MSD, Oss and the province, and that the Pivot Park offers opportunities for starters.
In cooperation with the municipality, province, Brabant Development Agency and MSD, I will examine what the possibilities are.
In samenwerking met de gemeente, provincie, Brabantse Ontwikkelingsmaatschappij en MSD zal ik bekijken wat de mogelijkheden zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jan Vos over het ROAD CCS demonstratie project

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether E.ON and GDF SUEZ made firm commitments to invest in the ROAD CCS demonstration project and why they are not being honoured, and asked for talks to secure a quick investment decision. The minister said the national government was not the competent authority for the coal plant permits, is not aware of firm commitments, backs CCS in principle, and expects a decision shortly after 31 January 2014.
In this matter the national government is not the competent authority.
In deze is het Rijk niet het bevoegd gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Jan Vos, Gesthuizen, Agnes Mulder, Thieme, Baay-Timmerman en Van Ojik over kinderarbeid bij de katoenproductie in Turkije

Seven MPs asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about child labour in Turkish cotton production, the follow-up to a Dutch-funded study, pressure on Turkish authorities and the ILO, the textile sector's responsibility, traceability of Turkish cotton, the MVO risk analysis, ILO child labour figures and child labour raised on trade missions. The minister answered that projects, workshops and a sector action plan are underway, that no EU action plan is needed given ILO efforts, that traceability is not feasible, and that the sector selection will be presented in summer 2014.
The Turkish government is primarily responsible for eliminating child labour.
De Turkse overheid is primair verantwoordelijk voor de uitbanning van kinderarbeid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jan Vos over het bericht dat Brazilië weigert Van Oord te betalen

An MP asked whether Brazil's refusal to pay Van Oord for a dredging job in Suape port is a trade dispute, what the government is doing, and whether an environmental fine is linked to the non-payment. The Staatssecretaris answered that the payment arrears are an insurance matter under the state export credit guarantee rather than a trade dispute, that diplomatic talks are ongoing, that no link to the fine is known, and that the arrears may be raised in the Paris Club within months.
I can confirm that payment arrears have arisen regarding work carried out by Van Oord in Brazil.
Ik kan bevestigen dat er betalingsachterstanden zijn ontstaan ten aanzien van door Van Oord uitgevoerde werkzaamheden in Brazilië.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jan Vos over het rapport van Amnesty International over het verspreiden van valse informatie over olielekkages in de Nigerdelta door Shell

An MP asked the minister about an Amnesty International and CEHRD report alleging that Shell manipulated oil spill investigations in the Niger Delta and spread false information, and asked whether Shell should pay compensation, whether the Netherlands would push for independent oversight, and whether the minister would talk to Shell. The minister acknowledged the report, said the spill-cause investigations are run by a Nigerian joint team, offered technical assistance on oversight, and committed to a meeting with Shell and a Nigeria visit with a report to parliament.
I will report on this to your House.
Ik zal hierover verslag uitbrengen aan uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jan Vos over de veiligheid van de kerncentrale Borssele

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the Borssele nuclear plant still meets the agreed top-25% safety benchmark and how the IAEA unplanned capability loss indicator should be read. The minister answered that the benchmark commission found Borssele within the safest 25%, that UCL is not a safety measure, and that restart is expected in December.
At present the Borssele nuclear power plant therefore meets the safety requirement agreed in the 2006 covenant.
Op dit moment voldoet de kerncentrale Borssele dus aan de veiligheidseis zoals die in 2006 in het convenant is afgesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Hamer en Jan Vos over de situatie bij Aldel

MPs Van Dekken, Hamer and Jan Vos asked ministers whether they were aware of the precarious situation at chemical company Aldel in Delfzijl, its importance for regional employment, and what the government would do to keep it afloat and assist workers if jobs were lost. The government referred to an earlier letter for the first four questions and said that, if mass dismissals threatened, the social affairs minister would work with UWV on measures to preserve employment, which is not currently the case.
See my letter of 4 October 2013 with reference DGBI-TOP/13168246, which is attached.
Zie mijn brief van 4 oktober 2013 met kenmerk DGBI-TOP/13168246, welke is bijgevoegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Jan Vos over een dreigend tekort aan laadpalen voor elektrische auto's

MPs Kuiken and Jan Vos asked the state secretary and the minister of Economic Affairs about a looming shortage of public charging points for electric cars, including projected car numbers, charging infrastructure, and municipal support. Minister Kamp answered that around 20,000 EVs are expected by end 2013, that charging infrastructure will grow under the 'ladder van laden' approach, and that an agreement with stakeholders is expected by year end.
The hope and expectation is that this agreement can be signed before the end of this year.
De hoop en verwachting is dat deze afspraak voor eind van dit jaar kan worden ondertekend.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Servaes en Jan Vos over het EU-besluit het embargo tegen diamanten uit Zimbabwe op te heffen

MPs Servaes and Jan Vos asked the ministers whether the EU lifting the Zimbabwe diamond embargo was justified, given conditions at the Marange mine and possible ZMDC financing of ZANU-PF, and whether the Kimberley Process should be strengthened. Minister Timmermans answered that the Marange mine met Kimberley Process requirements since late 2012, that ZMDC was delisted for lack of evidence of financing violence, and that broadening the Kimberley Process to human rights had no consensus.

On 25 September 2013 ZMDC was removed from the EU list of restrictive measures, because there are no indications that the company was involved in financing the (limited) violence during the July 2013 elections.

Op 25 september 2013 is ZMDC van de EU-lijst van beperkende maatregelen verwijderd, omdat er geen aanwijzingen zijn dat het bedrijf betrokken is geweest bij het financieren van het (beperkte) geweld tijdens de verkiezingen van juli 2013.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Albert De Vries over het bericht dat Delta de afspraken uit het Energieakkoord dreigt te negeren

Two PvdA MPs asked the economics minister whether Delta's refusal to close its coal plant conflicts with the Energy Agreement, how compliance will be ensured, and whether he will negotiate with Delta. The minister answered that Delta, as an Energie Nederland member, is bound to the agreement, that the coal tax exemption returns in 2016 only if the plants close, and referred to a separate letter on ACM's view.
I assume these companies stand by their signature and will therefore, within the limits of competition law, work constructively towards closing their old coal plants.

Ik ga ervan uit dat deze bedrijven staan voor hun handtekening en dus – binnen de mededingingsrechtelijke mogelijkheden – op constructieve wijze zullen werken aan sluiting van hun oude kolencentrales.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Van Dekken over het bericht ‘Den Haag vindt de klachten over bevingen maar gezeur’

MPs Jan Vos and Van Dekken asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a report that The Hague dismisses complaints about earthquakes as nagging, and about the backlog of damage claims from gas extraction in Groningen. The minister replied that NAM has expanded its assessor capacity, that claims are being processed with a target of three months, that the Tcbb and an independent ombudsman have reviewed the process, and that research and communication with local authorities are ongoing.
From the outset it has been clear to me that the increase in the number of earthquakes, and their possible strength, is increasing unrest among residents.
Het is voor mij van het begin af aan helder dat de toename van het aantal aardbevingen, en de mogelijke sterkte ervan, de onrust bij de bewoners doen toenemen.

Antwoord vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Servaes over het bericht ‘Barrières terug van weggeweest. Nederlandse technologiebedrijven krijgen zelfs binnen EU met belemmeringen te maken’ zoals gepubliceerd in Trouw op 19 jun

MPs Jan Vos and Servaes asked ministers whether they agree that trade barriers facing Dutch tech firms, both inside and outside the EU, are a bad development and what the government will do about them. The government agreed barriers are undesirable, said most reported obstacles concern non-EU export markets, and pointed to EU initiatives, Solvit, the trade barrier complaint point and diplomatic posts as support tools.
I am happy to consult with FME-CWM to further clarify the identified problems.
Ik ga graag in overleg met FME-CWM om de gesignaleerde problemen nader te duiden
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kuiken, Jan Vos en Mei Li Vos over het onderzoek van de Europese Commissie (EC) naar een vermeend Europees oliekartel

MPs Kuiken, Jan Vos and Mei Li Vos asked the minister of Economic Affairs about the European Commission's investigation into a suspected European oil cartel, including its evidence, duration, scope, Dutch consumer harm, and the role of the ACM competition authority. The minister replied that the Commission has been very restrained and gave no concrete evidence beyond its press release, that the ACM can assist and must decide independently whether to investigate, and summarized Germany's Bundeskartellamt fuel-market study.
Because of the importance of the investigation, the European Commission is very restrained in giving statements that touch on the content of its investigations.
Vanwege het onderzoeksbelang is de Europee Commissie zeer terughoudend in het geven van mededelingen die de inhoud van haar onderzoeken raken.
Antwoord vragen Jan Vos en Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat er gesjoemeld zou worden met groene stroom

MPs Jan Vos and Agnes Mulder asked the minister of Economic Affairs about reports that green electricity was being sold using imported guarantees of origin, which may not reflect new domestic renewable capacity, and about consumer transparency. The minister confirmed the practice has been possible under EU rules for some time, said consumers can already differentiate products, and called on suppliers to state country of origin on energy labels while declining to create a single comparison system.
I think the country of origin is useful information for the consumer and I believe stating it contributes to transparency.
Ik denk dat het land van herkomst zinvolle informatie is voor de consument en vind dat het vermelden hiervan bijdraagt aan de transparantie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert, Jan Vos en Van Dekken over het aardbevingsbestendig maken van de olie- en gasopslag in Groningen

MPs asked whether oil storage in Eemshaven, licensed on older earthquake assumptions, must be made earthquake-proof, whether systematic risk studies cover licensed firms, and whether NAM should pay for upgrades. The government replied that Vopak is still assessing its terminal, that 11 studies including effects of quakes above 3.9 Richter are underway, that NAM will be approached if preventive upgrades are needed, and that COVA can rely on Vopak's licence compliance.
As part of the 11 studies mentioned, the possible surface effects of an earthquake larger than 3.9 Richter are also being examined.
Als onderdeel van de genoemde 11 onderzoeken wordt ook onderzocht wat de mogelijke effecten aan het oppervlak zijn van een aardbeving groter dan 3.9 Richter
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Wolbert over het bericht ‘Kernafval net over de grens’ in het Dagblad van het Noorden van 11 april 2011

Three PvdA MPs asked the economics minister whether plans exist to store nuclear waste in salt domes across the border from Vlagtwedde, and about health, drinking water and consultation with Groningen and Germany. The minister replied that Germany has no concrete site plans yet, only a renewed site search with a committee report due in 2015, and that Dutch policy favours geological disposal while contact with Germany would follow if a border site emerged.
There are no plans in Germany to store radioactive waste just across the border near Vlagtwedde.
Er zijn in Duitsland geen plannen om radioactief afval vlak over de grens bij Vlagtwedde op te slaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vos Mei Li en Vos Jan over het bericht ”Brandgevaar bij 650 duizend zonnepanelen”

MPs Mei Li Vos and Jan Vos asked about reports of fire hazards in 650,000 solar panels, whether all systems can be tested before summer, whether the company was obliged to report known defects, whether other manufacturers' panels are linked to fires, whether certification registers should be mandatory and linked to subsidies, and who is liable for buyers of a bankrupt manufacturer's panels. The minister answered that testing is the producers' responsibility, that the NVWA advises owners to switch off the affected system, that failure to report known dangers is an economic offence, that no other fires are known, that certification is voluntary and mandating it is not desirable, and that liability is a civil matter handled by the curator and insurer.
Testing of solar panel systems is the responsibility of the companies that place the products on the market, not of the NVWA.
Keuring van zonnepaneelsystemen is een verantwoordelijkheid van de bedrijven die de producten in de handel brengen en niet van de NVWA.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jan Vos met betrekking tot het bericht dat het onderzoek naar schaliegas niet onafhankelijk genoeg wordt uitgevoerd

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs whether criticism from the advisory reference group on the shale gas research, and reports that the research is not independent enough, is cause for concern and what will be done. The minister says the reference group is a constructive feedback channel, that the research will be transparent and reviewed by the EIA commission, and that the Ministry of Infrastructure and Environment will be involved through the Structuurvisie Ondergrond without accepting a bigger role in carrying out the research.
Insofar as these points fall within the scope of the research, they will be taken into account and incorporated.
Voor zover deze punten onder de scope van het onderzoek vallen, worden deze meegenomen en verwerkt.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Maij en Jan Vos over de Nederlandse inzet aangaande financiële transparantie in de grondstoffensector

MPs Van Ojik, Maij and Jan Vos asked the minister whether Dutch policy supports EU rules on financial transparency in the extractive sector, including whether a carve-out for countries with secrecy laws should be allowed. The minister answered that the Dutch government supports the EU transparency directive, opposes any carve-out, and notes that no such exception exists in US Dodd-Frank rules.
The cabinet considers an exception clause undesirable, partly because regimes could otherwise use a reporting ban or confidentiality obligations to evade European transparency provisions.

Het kabinet acht een uitzonderingsclausule niet wenselijk, mede met het oog op de mogelijkheid voor regimes om met een verbod op rapportage of met geheimhoudingsverplichtingen te ontkomen aan Europese transparantiebepalingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Jan Vos en het lid Klaver over mogelijke bijdrage van voedselproducenten aan mensenrechtenschendingen in ontwikkelingslanden

MPs Maij, Jan Vos and Klaver asked whether Dutch food and drink producers contribute to human rights abuses such as land grabbing, exploitation of women and farmers, and labour violations in developing countries, following an Oxfam report. The minister responded that she shares concerns, relies mainly on voluntary OECD guidelines, IFC standards and sector cooperation, will engage the industry federation, and will encourage companies to map gender and labour conditions in their supply chains.
From Dutch companies I ask that they comply with the OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises, which include the responsibility to prevent human rights abuses.
Van Nederlandse bedrijven vraag ik dat zij de OESO richtlijnen voor multinationale ondernemingen naleven, waarin de verantwoordelijkheid tot het voorkomen van mensenrechtenschendingen is opgenomen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Monasch over het bericht dat Nederland meer zonnepanelen wil

MPs Jan Vos and Monasch asked whether the government will engage with the energy and construction sectors to take firm steps toward more solar panels in new buildings, given public support. The minister welcomed the enthusiasm, said the market is growing well and that intervention would distort it, so he sees no reason for extra action.
I therefore see no reason to undertake additional activities.
Ik zie daarom geen reden om extra activiteiten te ondernemen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven, Jan Vos en Van Tongeren over de sterke daling van de CO2-prijs

Three MPs (Van Veldhoven, Jan Vos, Van Tongeren) asked the state secretary whether the sharp fall in the EU ETS carbon price after the ITRE vote was unexpected, whether confidence in the ETS is structurally at stake, and what the timetable is for backloading and structural reform. The secretary answered that the price drop was foreseeable given the emissions-rights surplus, that the ETS itself is not in question but needs strengthening, and gave a timetable (EP vote on backloading around 15 April, PBL follow-up study in April) and a count of member states' positions.
I recently informed you by letter about the input the government intends to provide
Ik heb u recentelijk bij brief geïnformeerd over de inbreng die de regering voornemens is te leveren
Antwoord vragen van de leden Monasch, Jan Vos en Albert De Vries over de milieuprestatieberekening bij aanvragen in het kader van de omgevingswet

Three PvdA MPs asked why some municipalities do not require environmental performance calculations under the Omgevingswet and what the minister will do about it. The minister answers that no thresholds exist yet at the request of industry, that municipalities must still check submitted documents, and that enforcement responsibilities are shared with the provinces, with binding requirements possibly set around 2015.
First-line supervision of building regulations still lies with the municipality.
Het eerstelijns toezicht op de bouwregelgeving ligt nog steeds bij de gemeente.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Servaes en Jan Vos over het bericht «European Commission defends privileged access for “big business”»

Two PvdA MPs asked whether the European Commission's sharing of information with big business but not other stakeholders in trade negotiations is undesirable, and whether transparency on EU trade agreements should be improved. The minister rejected the premise of disproportionate business influence, defended confidential stakeholder exchanges to protect negotiating positions, and said she will keep parliament informed in general terms without committing to concrete new steps.

It is therefore in the interest of the European Union to handle the specific interests of specific players (companies, civil society organisations or other stakeholders) as confidentially as possible.

Het is daarom in het belang van de Europese Unie om specifieke belangen van specifieke spelers (bedrijven, maatschappelijke organisaties of andere betrokkenen) zoveel mogelijk in vertrouwelijkheid te behartigen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Albert de Vries over het bericht «Geen doorstart voor fosforfabrikant Thermphos»

MPs Vos and De Vries asked the ministers about the failure to find a buyer for Thermphos's Vlissingen plant, job losses, and who bears liability for dismantling and remediating the site. The minister answered that no buyer or going-concern prospect exists, government actively supported the curators, job losses are being addressed regionally, and liability questions remain with the curators, with no commitment to new legal measures beyond exploring them with the infrastructure minister.
For licence holders of nuclear reactors there is currently a statutory obligation to ensure funds are available for dismantling and remediation under all circumstances.

Voor vergunninghouders van kernreactoren bestaat er op dit moment een wettelijke verplichting om ervoor te zorgen dat er onder alle omstandigheden gelden beschikbaar zijn voor ontmanteling en sanering.
Antwoord vragen Fokke en Jan Vos over het bericht 'niet ondertekenen verdrag export onbegrijpelijk'

Two PvdA MPs asked why the Netherlands is not ratifying ILO Convention 170 on chemical safety, and whether this endangers workers abroad and imposes low administrative costs on firms. The minister answered that the government will consult the social partners and the SER on ratification, pointed to alternative chemical information sources, and noted that five of 27 EU states have ratified.
Following the consultation between the Cabinet and the Labour Foundation on 19 December, I informed the House by letter.
Naar aanleiding van het overleg tussen Kabinet en de Stichting van de Arbeid op 19 december heb ik de Kamer per brief geïnformeerd
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Nijboer en Van Dekken inzake de stroomtarieven van aluminiumproducent Aldel

Three PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the electricity tariffs facing aluminium producer Aldel, a German grid-cost exemption for large consumers, and unfair European competition. The minister replied that a Dutch equivalent of the German rule is being studied within the STROOM legislative agenda, that the Commission's state-aid view is awaited, and that a concrete compensation scheme is under consideration.
Because of the redistribution effects, it is important to consider any large-consumer scheme in an integrated way within the broader revision of tariff regulation under the STROOM legislative agenda.

Vanwege de herverdelingseffecten is het van belang een eventuele grootverbruikerregeling integraal te bezien binnen de bredere herziening van de tariefregulering die plaatsvindt binnen de wetgevingsagenda STROOM.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Recourt, Jan Vos en Mei Li Vos over onredelijke schuldeisers waardoor er onnodig bedrijven failliet gaan

Three PvdA MPs asked whether the Dutch bankruptcy law gives creditors too strong a position, causing firms to fail unnecessarily or relocate abroad, and whether a court could bind unreasonable creditors before bankruptcy. Minister Opstelten acknowledged the problem, announced a bankruptcy law reform programme with stakeholder consultation and comparative research, but gave no firm commitment to a quick bill and said fraud prevention currently has priority.
That is why I have also announced legislation providing for the possibility of an agreement that can be imposed on individual creditors.
Daarom heb ik ook wetgeving aangekondigd die voorziet in de mogelijkheid van een akkoord dat dwingend opgelegd kan worden aan individuele schuldeisers
Antwoord vragen van de leden Maij en Jan Vos over bevorderen van duurzame biobrandstoffen

MPs Maij and Jan Vos asked about imports of biofuel feedstock, land grabbing in developing countries and the case for second and third generation biofuels. Minister Ploumen answered that the EU proposal limits food-crop biofuels and promotes advanced ones, that the government will press for responsible land governance, and that a national impact assessment and a Commission report are forthcoming.
The cabinet will also examine, together with industry and research institutions, how the innovation and production of advanced biofuels can be stimulated.
Het kabinet zal voorts samen met het bedrijfsleven en onderzoeksinstellingen bekijken op welke manieren de innovatie en productie van geavanceerde biobrandstoffen gestimuleerd kunnen worden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Dikkers en Recourt over het bericht dat er tritium in het grondwater is gekomen door een lek van de reactor in Petten

MPs Jan Vos, Dikkers and Recourt asked the minister of Economic Affairs about reports of tritium in groundwater from a leak at the Petten reactor, including how long the leak went unnoticed, the amount released, health risks, and prevention. Minister Kamp answered that the leak was found on 11 November 2012, roughly 10 GBq was estimated released, RIVM saw no direct health risk, and NRG is repairing the pipe and cleaning up under KFD supervision, with further inspection and tightened maintenance.
The KFD has instructed NRG to tighten and carry out the inspection and maintenance programme.
De KFD heeft NRG opgedragen om het inspectie- en onderhoudsprogramma aan te scherpen en uit te voeren
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jan Vos over het artikel «Innovatie stokt bij goede intenties»

MP Jan Vos asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about a newspaper report that innovation is stalling, questioning whether public-private research contracts worth about 500 million euros a year have been concluded and how this squares with earlier commitments, and about the broader top sectors policy. The minister answers that the innovation contracts are a broader agenda, that the 500 million euro TKI target for 2015 stands, and that the government is supporting SMEs and generic instruments alongside sector-specific policy.
I have no reason to assume that this ambition will not be realised.
Ik heb geen enkele reden om aan te nemen dat deze ambitie niet wordt gerealiseerd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jan Vos naar aanleiding van het openblijven van de kerncentrale Borssele

An MP asks the minister about the draft decision extending the operating life of the Borssele nuclear plant, including whether the convention's safety-ranking requirement still applies, how it will be verified, the reactor-vessel crack investigation timing, and the stress test and inspection options. The minister answers that the convention requirement remains, measurements will occur at the spring 2013 shutdown before the extension starts, the 10-year safety review is separate, stress test findings do not affect the permit, and the regulator can impose further requirements.
The investigation therefore takes place before the extended operating period starts on 1 January 2014.
Het onderzoek vindt dus plaats voordat de periode van verlengde bedrijfsduur op 1 januari 2014 ingaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven, Jan Vos en Schouw over geweld in de Braziliaanse sojateelt

MPs Van Gerven, Jan Vos and Schouw asked the government about violence against indigenous peoples and smallholders linked to Brazilian soy farming, and what Dutch action, embassy contact, bank financing and investigation follow-up exists. The minister answered that the Dutch embassy raises indigenous rights with Brazil and supports CIMI, that the Dutch soy sustainability initiatives are supported, that the embassy has no knowledge of a river-dredging study, and that one Dutch bank has a code of conduct and it will report on prosecutor investigations involving Dutch financiers.
Yes, insofar as this concerns Dutch banks and financiers.
Ja, voor zover dit Nederlandse banken en financiers betreft.
Antwoord vragen Jan Vos en Mei Li Vos over aardgasinkomsten en een staatsfonds

Two MPs asked whether the minister knew of a press report on a sovereign fund from gas revenues, what share of Groningen gas proceeds goes to Shell and ExxonMobil and whether the MOR agreement could be terminated, and how the government followed up a 2008 letter on studying the optimal design of wealth preservation. The minister replied that the MOR profit split gives the state about 90% of proceeds at current prices so no change is planned, and that the 13th Studiegroep Begrotingsruimte advised on the FES feeding mechanism, which the cabinet has frozen with the related bill withdrawn.
I therefore see no reason to terminate this agreement or change it.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om deze overeenkomst op te zeggen dan wel te veranderen.
Antwoord vragen Vos over het bericht dat Duitsland 300 miljard euro verdient met duurzame producten en diensten

Two MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that Germany earns large sums from green technology and whether the Netherlands should seek a fully renewable energy supply by 2050. The minister agreed that investment brings benefits, described the two-track energy and innovation policy, declined to ask the Algemene Energieraad for advice on the revenue side, and said the energy supply should be CO2-neutral by 2050 while keeping fossil fuels, emissions trading and all energy options open.
I therefore see no reason at this time to ask the Algemene Energieraad for advice on this.
Ik zie daarom op dit moment geen aanleiding de Algemene Energieraad om advies te vragen hierover.
Antwoord vragen Jan Vos en De Vries inzake de situatie bij Thermphos

Two PvdA MPs asked the economy minister about the Thermphos situation in Zeeland, including job losses, an anti-dumping case against Kazakh phosphorus, green investment support and help finding an investor. The minister answered that the Commission's anti-dumping decision is due by 16 March 2013, that several state instruments could support investments, and that the ministry is working with the province to help find investors.
I am actively involved in this file and therefore in consultation with the company, the Province of Zeeland and other parties to see where I can help, within my means, with a possible restart.
Ik ben actief betrokken in dit dossier en daarom in overleg met het bedrijf, Provincie Zeeland en andere partijen om te zien waar ik – binnen mijn mogelijkheden – kan helpen in een evtuele doorstart.

m: Motie van het lid Belhaj c.s. over na aanname van de Rijkswet per direct voorlichting starten
Asks the government to start information campaigns for Dutch nationals in the UK immediately after the Brexit nationality law takes effect.
ensure that after adoption of the Brexit consequences law, information about this change can start immediately for Dutch nationals in the UK
zorg te dragen dat na aanname van de Rijkswet inperking gevolgen Brexit in beide Kamers per direct de voorlichting over deze wetswijziging voor Nederlanders in het VK gestart kan worden
Motie van het lid Belhaj c.s. over in gesprek gaan met vertegenwoordigers van Britten in Nederland
Asks the government to consult representatives of British nationals in the Netherlands on Brexit-related arrangements and report to the House.
requests the government to enter into discussion with these representatives about their wishes
verzoekt de regering, met deze vertegenwoordigers in gesprek te gaan over hun wensen
Motie van het lid Anne Mulder over de effectiviteit van het re-integratiebeleid
Asks the government for an overview of proven re-integration instruments and to stop instruments found ineffective, citing doubts about re-integration effectiveness.
to come up with an overview of proven successful re-integration instruments
te komen met een overzicht van bewezen succesvolle re-integratie-instrumenten
Motie van het lid Van Weyenberg c.s. over niet met twee maten meten in het oordeel over personeelsbeleid
Asks the minister not to apply double standards when judging government and business personnel policy and requests a letter to the House on how the government will act in that spirit.
requests the government to send the House a letter by 1 May explaining how the central government will act in the spirit of the Work and Security Act
verzoekt de regering om, uiterlijk 1 mei een brief aan de Tweede Kamer te sturen, waarin wordt toegelicht op welke wijze de rijksoverheid naar de geest van de Wet werk en zekerheid zal handelen

Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Van Weyenberg en Anne Mulder ter vervanging van nr. 10 dat de mogelijkheid om de ketenbepaling voor AOW-gerechtigde werknemers bij cao te verlengen omzet in een wette
Replaces an earlier amendment so that the cao option to extend the contract chain for AOW-age employees becomes a statutory rule, allowing up to six contracts or 48 months.
This amendment provides that the possibility to extend the contract chain provision for AOW-entitled employees through a collective agreement is converted into a statutory regime.
Dit amendement regelt dat de mogelijkheid om de ketenbepaling voor AOW-gerechtigde werknemers bij cao te verlengen wordt omgezet in een wettelijke regeling.
Amendement van de leden Van Weyenberg en Anne Mulder dat de mogelijkheid om de ketenbepaling voor AOW-gerechtigde werknemers bij cao te verlengen omzet in een wettelijke regeling.
Amendment turns the option of extending the fixed-term contract chain rule for AOW-age workers via collective agreement into a statutory rule.
the option to extend the chain rule for AOW-entitled employees via collective agreement is turned into a statutory arrangement
de mogelijkheid om de ketenbepaling voor AOW-gerechtigde werknemers bij cao te verlengen wordt omgezet in een wettelijke regeling

Amendement van het lid Anne Mulder over het rapporteren door de Nza dan wel het adviseren door de IGZ met betrekking tot het opleggen van een structurele maatregel aan de zorgaanbieder ten einde voort
Amendment requires that the healthcare regulator's report and the IGZ's advice on imposing a structural measure (splitting a care provider) be positive before the minister may impose it.
Concretely, this means the healthcare authority should reach a positive judgment in its report on the consequences of using the measure.
Concreet houdt dit in dat de zorgautoriteit tot een positief oordeel zou moeten komen in haar rapportage ten aanzien van de gevolgen van de inzet van de maatregel.
Amendement van het lid Anne Mulder c.s over het delen van goede voorbeelden op het gebied van patiëntveiligheid
Adds a sentence requiring the Zorginstituut to promote dissemination of good practices on patient safety in two articles of the health law.
In this respect the Zorginstituut promotes the dissemination of good examples in the field of patient safety.
Hierbij bevordert het Zorginstituut de verspreiding van goede voorbeelden op het gebied van patiëntveiligheid.
Motie van het lid Anne Mulder c.s. over het openbaar maken van CPB-stukken
Asks the government to have the CPB publish the assumptions, models and vision on the health system it uses to assess health care measures, and to publish its ongoing visitation.
asks the government to request the CPB to make public the assumptions, models and vision it uses when assessing health care measures
verzoekt de regering, het CPB te verzoeken om de door het CPB gebruikte veronderstellingen, modellen en visie bij het beoordelen van maatregelen in de gezondheidszorg, openbaar te maken
Amendement van de leden Anne Mulder en Bouwmeester betreffende het toekennen van extra middelen aan de IGZ
Amendment shifts 5.5 million euro within the budget from the unallocated reserve to the Health and Youth Inspectorate (IGZ) for extra supervision and enforcement capacity in 2013.
send extra funds to the IGZ for extra supervision
extra middelen naar de IGZ laten gaan ten behoeve van: – Extra toezicht
Amendement van de leden Anne Mulder en Bouwmeester betreffende ongedaanmaking van de voorgenomen korting op het budget van de NVWA
Amendment reverses a planned budget cut to the food and product safety inspectorate NVWA by shifting funds from a reserve for price adjustments.
The submitters of this amendment want the planned 2013 cut to the NVWA budget not to be implemented.
De indieners van dit amendement willen dat de in 2013 voorgenomen korting op het budget van de NVWA niet wordt doorgevoerd.
Motie Mulder c.s. over onderzoek naar de no-shows

Asks the government to investigate the costs of hospital no-shows, measures taken and possible new measures, including whether the no-show fee obligation for providers adds value, and to inform the House by 1 April 2012.
requests the government to investigate the extent of these unnecessary costs
verzoekt de regering onderzoek te doen naar de omvang van deze onnodige kosten
Motie Smilde c.s. over de introductie van uitkomstfinanciering
Asks the government, in consultation with all parties, to reach a broadly shared vision leading to outcome-based funding in healthcare by 2020.
calls on the government, in consultation with all parties, to reach a broadly shared vision resulting in the introduction of outcome-based funding by 2020
roept de regering op, in overleg met alle partijen te komen tot een breed gedeelde en breed gedragen visie met als uitkomst de introductie van uitkomstfinanciering uiterlijk in 2020
Motie Mulder c.s. over doorstart epd
Asks the government to urge care organisations to ensure the electronic patient record goes ahead.
requests the government to promote, by calling on the organisations involved, that the electronic patient record still gets off the ground
verzoekt de regering te bevorderen, door de betrokken organisaties hiertoe op te roepen, dat het elektronisch patiëntendossier alsnog van de grond komt
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf en Anne Mulder over de Hongaarse noodwet ter bestrijding van het coronavirus

MPs Van der Graaf and Anne Mulder asked the Foreign Minister whether the Hungarian COVID-19 emergency law, which lifts the 15-day limit on decrees and lets the government decide when the state of danger ends, is compatible with EU rule-of-law standards, and what the EU can do. The minister answers that the law raises serious rule-of-law, democracy and fundamental-rights concerns, that the Netherlands raised it with EU partners and the Hungarian minister, and hopes international pressure will lead Hungary to reconsider, without committing to a specific formal step.
The cabinet hopes that international pressure will lead Hungary to reconsider the authorisation law.
Het kabinet hoopt dat de internationale druk Hongarije zal doen bewegen de autorisatiewetgeving te heroverwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yesilgöz-Zegerius en Anne Mulder over het bericht 'Romanian PM clashes with Commission over rule of law'

Two VVD MPs asked the Foreign Minister about Romanian PM Dăncilă's criticism of the EU Cooperation and Verification Mechanism on rule of law and the upcoming referendum redefining marriage in the constitution. The minister said the CVM remains necessary until Romania's reforms are irreversible, expressed concern that the referendum could discriminate against LGBTI people, and reported raising Dutch concerns during his visit to Romania.
The CVM makes an important contribution here and should therefore be maintained until the CIE recommendations are sustainable and irreversible.
Het CVM levert hier een belangrijke bijdrage aan en dient derhalve behouden te blijven totdat de CIE-aanbevelingen duurzaam en onomkeerbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Anne Mulder en Asscher over de gevolgen van het no deal-scenario voor Nederlandse en EU-burgers in het Verenigd Koninkrijk

MPs Omtzigt, Mulder and Asscher asked the government about the consequences of a no-deal Brexit for Dutch and EU citizens in the UK, including settled status, the need for a helpdesk, and timely information. The government answered that the UK's Settlement Scheme offers no hard guarantees, that a no-deal scenario is being prepared for, that information is provided via IND and the embassy, and that the Chamber will be briefed in September and a closed technical briefing in October.
However, this Statement of Intent offers no hard guarantees.
Dit Statement of Intent biedt echter geen harde garanties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Anne Mulder over de gedwongen sluiting van de Central European University in Hongarije

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Hungary's amended higher education law effectively forces out the Central European University and whether a bill on foreign-funded NGOs restricts civil society, and how the Netherlands would respond. The minister answered that the government is concerned, raised the matter with Hungary, noted the Commission's infringement procedure against Hungary over the higher education law, and said the NGO bill is still being monitored and not yet adopted.
The cabinet supports the European Commission in monitoring that member states comply with European rules and in safeguarding shared values, and will closely follow further steps.

Het kabinet steunt de Europese Commissie die er op toeziet dat lidstaten zich aan Europese regelgeving houden en als het gaat om het waarborgen van gedeelde waarden, en zal vervolgstappen nauwlettend in de gaten houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Anne Mulder over de cao Besloten Busvervoer 2015-2016

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the CAO for Private Bus Transport (article 48) should be amended and whether its general binding declaration should be withdrawn, given a court ruling on self-employed workers. The Minister replied that amendment and withdrawal were not necessary because article 48 was declared generally binding with the reasoning in the declaration decision, and that social partners should clarify the provision in a future request.

It is not necessary to withdraw the general binding declaration of article 48, because article 48 was declared generally binding taking into account the considerations made regarding that article in the declaration decision.

Het is niet noodzakelijk om de algemeenverbindendverklaring van artikel 48 in te trekken, omdat artikel 48 algemeen verbindend is verklaard met inachtneming van de overwegingen die ten aanzien van dat artikel in het avv-besluit zijn gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Anne Mulder en Duisenberg over de Wet werk en zekerheid

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister why the Wet werk en zekerheid prevents young researchers from carrying out their grant-funded research at their own university, and whether the law will be amended. The Minister attributes the problem to the growth of project funding, notes that the cao Universiteiten limits chained temporary contracts to four years, and says that UWV or mutual consent can end open-ended contracts when projects finish, so no amendment is planned and the issue will be raised with the VSNU.
We therefore see no reason to amend the Wwz, more specifically the so-called chain provision.
Wij zien dan ook geen aanleiding om de Wwz, meer in het bijzonder de zogenoemde ketenbepaling, aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Anne Mulder en Ziengs over het artikel 'Brede cao biedt zekerheid voor alle werkenden”

Two VVD MPs asked whether minimum rates for self-employed workers (zzp'ers) set in collective labour agreements, as proposed by FNV and agreed in the architecture sector, are acceptable and lawful under competition rules. The minister answered that such clauses likely fall under the cartel prohibition, that the ACM supervises this, and that the government is not aware of consultation with zzp'ers, without committing to any new action.

Collective labour agreement provisions concerning self-employed persons without staff who qualify as undertakings under competition law, and which contain tariff agreements for them, will most likely fall under the cartel prohibition of the Competition Act.

Cao-bepalingen die zien op zelfstandigen zonder personeel die kwalificeren als ondernemer in de zin van het mededingingsrecht en die afspraken bevatten over tarieven voor deze zelfstandigen zullen hoogstwaarschijnlijk onder het kartelverbod uit de Mededingingswet vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Anne Mulder en Straus over de vervangersproblematiek

MPs Mulder and Straus asked whether the minister knew of a Catholic primary school foundation's letter to parents saying children might be sent home because substitute teachers can now only be engaged three times for a half-day under the new law, and what the government would do. The minister says sending children home is undesirable, notes the sector's cao runs until 1 July 2016 so current rules still apply, and says the substitute problem will be addressed in cao negotiations.
That is why collective labour agreement parties can make agreements deviating from the law, both for on-call contracts (zero-hours or min/max contracts) and for temporary contracts.
Daarom kunnen cao-partijen van de wet afwijkende afspraken maken, zowel als het gaat om oproepcontracten (nuluren- of min/max contracten) als om tijdelijke contracten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van ’t Wout en Anne Mulder over de uitspraak van het Europees Hof van Justitie dat reistijd gezien moet worden als werktijd

Two VVD MPs asked whether the European Court of Justice ruling that travel time for workers without a fixed workplace counts as working time will raise labour costs and weaken employment, and how much room it leaves for social partners and member states. The minister answered that no significant employment effect is expected in the Netherlands, that the ruling covers only workers without a fixed or habitual workplace and does not regulate pay, and that wage-setting remains with the social partners, so no national action is planned.
The ruling does not in any way limit the possibilities social partners have to make further agreements on the pay for travel time.
De uitspraak vormt geen enkele inperking van de mogelijkheden die sociale partners hebben om nadere afspraken te maken over de beloning van reistijd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijkerken-de Haan en Anne Mulder over het bericht ‘Gemeenten gaan gratis geld uitdelen’

MPs Nijkerken-de Haan and Mulder asked whether municipal plans to hand out unconditional money, reported in the press, fit the experiment clause (art. 83) of the Participation Act and whether gemeenten know the rules on part-time and temporary work. The state secretary said no concrete proposals had been received, that details must be assessed first, and that an experiment would need an AMvB with parliamentary pre-consultation, while promising to inform municipalities again after a bill passes.
An experiment deviating from the statutory framework of the Participation Act can take place only if it is regulated by an AMvB under article 83(2).
Een eventueel experiment waarin wordt afgeweken van de wettelijke kaders van de Participatiewet kan plaatsvinden indien dit bij AMvB op grond van artikel 83 2 wordt geregeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Van der Linde en Anne Mulder over bericht “proef flexwerkershypotheek uitgebreid”

VVD MPs asked whether the perspective-statement pilot for flexworkers and self-employed mortgage applicants should be broadened and made permanent, and whether mortgage rules should change. The Minister replied that the pilot falls within existing rules (Tijdelijke regeling hypothecair krediet), that current rules already allow tailored assessments, and that no regulatory change is planned.
The approach taken with the perspective statement falls within the current possibilities of the Temporary Regulation on Mortgage Credit.
De gevolgde werkwijze met de perspectiefverklaring valt binnen de huidige mogelijkheden van de Tijdelijke regeling hypothecair krediet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lucas en Anne Mulder over het bericht 'Leerwerkplekken in de knel door ontslagregels'

MPs Lucas and Anne Mulder asked whether the transition payment (transitievergoeding) under the new dismissal rules would discourage employers from offering learn-work places (leerwerkplekken) in vocational education, and whether apprentices should be excluded. The government answered that the payment applies in principle to apprentices, but employers may deduct training costs from it under an order in council, and it promised to consult social partners on collective agreements and to evaluate a pilot combined learning route.
At the same time, it is of course not intended that the introduction of the transition payment leads to fewer learn-work places being offered.
Tegelijkertijd is het uiteraard niet de bedoeling dat de introductie van de transitievergoeding leidt tot het aanbieden van minder leerwerkplekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Anne Mulder over het bericht 'Klagende' Polen niet meer op bouwplaats'

An MP asked whether the minister would investigate why Polish construction workers who had complained about low wages at the Deventer city hall site no longer worked there, and whether they had been underpaid. The minister said an assessment requires fact-finding, that the Inspectorate SZW's special team on sham constructions will look into the situation and is considering an investigation, but will not comment on ongoing inspections.
The Inspectorate SZW will, with its special team dealing with sham constructions, look into the situation and is considering a possible investigation into the facts and circumstances.
De Inspectie SZW zal zich met het speciale team dat zich bezig houdt met de aanpak van schijnconstructies op de hoogte stellen van de situatie en beraadt zich op een eventueel onderzoek
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Straus en Anne Mulder over de gevolgen van de nieuwe Wet werk en zekerheid (Wwz) voor het onderwijs

MPs Straus and Anne Mulder asked whether the new Wwz limit of three flexible contracts would cause problems replacing teachers and substitutes in primary and secondary education, and whether a sector exception to the chain rule was needed. The minister answered that substitution remains feasible through internal flexibility, substitute pools, on-call and min/max contracts, and cao deviations, so no sector exception is needed, though he will provide information and help find solutions.
An exception for education is therefore not necessary.
Een uitzondering voor het onderwijs is daarom niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lucas en Anne Mulder inzake cao-belemmeringen van bbl-leerwerkplekken

MPs Lucas and Mulder asked whether sectoral collective agreement provisions on pay for bbl apprentices (vocational learning-work route) hinder the number of apprenticeship places, and what the minister would do about it. The minister replied that employers should agree pay with apprentices where needed, that she respects the social partners' agreements, listed measures to expand apprenticeship places, and gave figures on agreements and places.
As indicated in my response to questions 2 and 3, it is up to the social partners to make agreements on this.
Zoals aangegeven in mijn reactie op vraag 2 en 3 is het aan de sociale partners om hier afspraken over te maken.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Van Veen en Anne Mulder over het artikel "Meer nadelen dan voordelen"

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Health and Social Affairs about the effects of the new Wet werk en zekerheid's chain-contract rule on amateur sports clubs, and about an exemption for professional football. The minister explains the tighter chain rule, grants a cao-based exemption for professional football contract players and coaches by ministerial regulation, and says he does not expect amateur clubs to struggle to recruit staff.
For the time being I do not expect amateur sports associations to experience more difficulty in recruiting staff.
Vooralsnog verwacht ik niet dat amateursportverenigingen meer moeite zullen ondervinden bij het aantrekken van personeel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Anne Mulder over de effectiviteit van Voor- en vroegschoolse educatie (vve)

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education about claims by Prof. Fukkink that VVE early-childhood programmes are ineffective, and about the evidence on their effectiveness and suggested improvements. The Secretary rejects the claim, cites international and CPB evidence and the ongoing Pre-COOL study, and says the views of researchers will be considered in the government's policy response.
In January 2015 OCW is inviting Prof. Fukkink and other scientists to discuss the evaluation results of the Oke Act.
OCW nodigt in januari 2015 prof.dr. Fukkink en andere wetenschappers uit om te praten over de evaluatieresultaten van de wet Oke.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Anne Mulder over de premiekortingsregeling voor oudere werknemers

An MP asked the minister whether employers abuse the premium discount for hiring older workers by having staff leave via termination agreements and be rehired, and whether the rules should be tightened. The minister acknowledged signals of such abuse, called it an unintended loophole, and committed to amending the regulations as soon as possible.
I therefore intend to amend the regulations as soon as possible in response to this signal and to hold employers to account.
Ik ben daarom voornemens om naar aanleiding van dit signaal de regelgeving zo spoedig mogelijk aan te passen en de werkgevers hierop aan te spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Anne Mulder over de transitievergoeding voor seizoenwerkers

An MP asked whether the transition payment (transitievergoeding) for seasonal workers would be inflated by applying it retroactively to pre-July 2015 employment periods and a 6-month break rule, and why no transitional law applied. The minister answered that the scheme has immediate effect, that pre-July 2015 service counts by design to avoid worsening existing entitlements, and that the 6-month rule is intended, so no change is planned, though he will publicize the rules via government websites and social partners.
Yes. I will do that via government websites, as well as via and in consultation with social partners.
Ja. Dat zal ik doen via websites van de rijksoverheid, alsmede via en in samenspraak met sociale partners.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Anne Mulder over de rechterlijke uitspraak dat de FNV vakbondsleden voortrekt.

MPs Van Weyenberg and Anne Mulder asked whether a court ruling that FNV unfairly gave union members higher severance under a social plan breaches good employer conduct, whether the Postcodeloterij comparison is apt, what legal framework allows union-member benefits, whether courts or the Inspectie SZW should review such agreements, how the government acted on a motion against disadvantaging non-members, and what measures it would take. The minister answered that contractual freedom permits distinctions only within limits of good employer conduct and equal pay, that courts rather than the government review such clauses, that social partners say existing law suffices, and that no measures are planned.
A ruling on the legal validity of a collective agreement provision such as in the above-mentioned lawsuit is reserved for the civil court.
Een oordeel over de rechtsgeldigheid van een cao-bepaling zoals bedoeld in de bovengenoemde rechtszaak, is voorbehouden aan de burgerlijke rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over het bericht dat behandelingen tegen vliegangst vergoed worden uit de basisverzekering

MPs Bouwmeester and Anne Mulder asked whether treatment for fear of flying, offered by PsyQ, can be charged to the basic health insurance, and how transparency of care billing could be improved. Minister Schippers answered that such treatment is not insured GGZ care unless provided as GP care, and announced more detailed invoices from 2014 and a NZa study on showing diagnoses on invoices.
Health insurers may only charge care to the Zvw that is actually insured under the Zvw.
Zorgverzekeraars mogen alleen zorg ten laste van de Zvw brengen die ook daadwerkelijk verzekerd is onder de Zvw.
Antwoord vragen Mulder over de normtijd van 45 minuten voor ambulances
