An MP asked the health minister whether the 45-minute ambulance response norm, which has no scientific basis, should be revised given better ambulance equipment, and whether it will be reviewed. The minister acknowledges better ambulances but insists on keeping the 45-minute norm for access to a basic emergency department and has no plans to update or study it.
I continue to adhere to the 45-minute accessibility norm.
Ik blijf hechten aan de bereikbaarheidsnorm van 45 minuten.
Antwoord vragen Hennis-Plasschaert en Mulder over christelijke homotherapie

Two VVD MPs asked the health minister whether insurers are legally obliged to pay for Christian 'homotherapy' and what measures would end this. The minister answered that such therapy is not covered by the basic insurance package, insurers may not reimburse it, and no such obligation exists.
Insurers are not permitted to reimburse care that does not belong to the package.
Het is zorgverzekeraars niet toegestaan zorg te vergoeden die niet behoort tot het pakket.

Vragen van het lid Mulder (VVD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het omzeilen van de acceptatieplicht en het verbod op premiedifferentiatie door zorgverzekeraars (ingezonden 21 december 2011).

An MP asked the health minister whether Promovendum and Besured group insurance premium discounts and their Achmea/Avéro involvement breach the Health Insurance Act's acceptance duty and ban on premium differentiation, and whether Blue's daily cancellability shifts costs to other insurers. The minister answered that collective discounts up to 10% are permitted, that Achmea/Avéro shows no sign of breaching the acceptance duty, that the NZa will explicitly monitor compliance, and that the NZa found no cost-shifting from the similar Zekur policy.
I have no reason to assume that Achmea/Avéro does not comply with the acceptance duty.
Ik heb geen reden aan te nemen dat Achmea/Avéro zich niet aan de acceptatieplicht houdt.

Vragen van het lid Mulder (VVD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over medische fouten doordat artsen niet goed kunnen omgaan met medische technologie (ingezonden 2 september 2011).

Mulder (VVD) asked the minister about medical errors caused by doctors' poor handling of medical technology, citing a newspaper report, and asked about the status of an earlier action plan and whether it needs updating. Minister Schippers said progress would be reported to parliament this autumn, pointed to an expert group report, and promised a further response on the related monitoring study.
On the progress of implementing that action plan, I will inform the House this autumn.
Over de voortgang van de uitvoering van genoemd plan van aanpak zal ik de Kamer nog dit najaar informeren.
Vragen van het lid Mulder (VVD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het artikel «De dokter bewijst meestal niet waarom» (ingezonden 10 juni 2011).

MP Mulder asked the health minister about a newspaper article proposing that doubtful medical treatments be systematically studied and that such research be funded by savings from those treatments. The minister supports effectiveness research, points to existing ZonMw programmes, and commits to inventorying treatments doubted by the profession and having them studied with funds freed by stopping them.

After this inventory I will have these treatments examined for their effectiveness, with the research funded by the money freed up by not carrying out the treatments about which there are strong doubts regarding effectiveness.

Na deze inventarisatie zal ik deze behandelingen laten onderzoeken op hun effectiviteit waarbij het onderzoek wordt bekostigd met het geld dat vrijkomt door de behandeling, waarover sterke twijfels zijn over de effectiviteit, niet uit te voeren.
Vragen van de leden Mulder en Lodders (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de vaatchirurg die spoor van calamiteiten achterlaat (ingezonden 4 april 2011).

VVD MPs asked the health minister why an IGZ investigation into a vascular surgeon has lasted 3.5 years, whether he could practise in the Netherlands meanwhile, and why hospitals and the inspectorate failed to flag his problems earlier. The minister acknowledged delays and ex-inspector errors, said there was no patient risk since the surgeon no longer works in the Netherlands, and promised to conclude the investigation by mid-May and to address reference-checking in a forthcoming letter on disciplinary law.
That the investigation took longer than planned is careless toward both the doctor involved and the people who complained about him.
Dat het onderzoek meer tijd in beslag heeft genomen dan voorzien, is onzorgvuldig naar zowel de betrokken arts als naar de personen die over de arts hebben geklaagd.
Vragen van het lid Mulder (VVD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over onnodig beroep op de spoedeisende eerste hulp (ingezonden 11 maart 2011).

MP Mulder asks the health minister whether she recalls earlier answers on non-urgent patients at emergency departments, knows the reported EUR 169 million annual cost, and will act to curb it. The minister confirms awareness, says predecessor measures will continue, and outlines triage standards, NZa surcharges for GP posts, and talks on cheaper pricing and ED concentration.
I will carry out these measures in full.
Ik zal deze maatregelen onverkort doorvoeren.

Vragen van de leden Mulder (VVD) en Smilde (CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het laagdrempelig inzetten van ambulances door de ambulancedienst Brabant-Midden-West-Noord (ingezonden 7 maart

MPs Mulder and Smilde ask the health minister about a regional ambulance service director's memo urging low-threshold ambulance dispatch to avoid budget cuts. The minister finds this unacceptable, says the convenant's incentives were never meant to cause low-threshold dispatch, and says the zorgverzekeraar and IGZ will investigate if needed.

Vragen van de leden Mulder en Ziengs (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over uiteenlopende eisen voor drogistenexamens en over het feit dat het Drogisterijcollege geen toezicht houdt op he

Two VVD MPs asked the health minister about differing exam and quality requirements for drogist diplomas and the lack of supervision by the Drogisterijcollege over how the exam is administered online, including identity checks. The minister replied that the ministry has no say over training and exams under self-regulation, that she will push for a minimum standard and a policy framework for examining bodies, and that exam bodies must ensure identity verification and publish lists of certified graduates.
I will strongly urge that this consultation now proceeds promptly.
Ik zal er met klem op aandringen dat dit overleg nu voortvarend tot stand komt.
Vragen van de leden Mulder en Leegte (beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Infrastructuur en Milieu en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de brand bij Moerdijk. (ingezonden 11 januari 2011).

MPs Mulder and Leegte asked ministers about the smoke and odour spread from the Moerdijk fire, the health and environmental studies under way, and their coordination and timing. The government answered that the plume affected areas up to and beyond 10 km, described the GGD questionnaires and RIVM/MOD environmental measurements, and gave expected report dates, with a health-related decision postponed to eight weeks.
In the debate on 13 January the Minister of VWS committed to decide on follow-up steps after four weeks in light of the health study.
In het debat op 13 januari heeft de minister van VWS toegezegd na vier weken een beslissing over vervolgstappen te nemen naar aanleiding van het gezondheidsonderzoek.
Vragen van de leden Straus, Venrooy-van Ark , Mulder en Van der Burg (allen VVD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de zorg voor autisten (ingezonden 9 november 2010).

Four VVD MPs asked the health minister about the quality of care for people with autism, including misdiagnosis, separation and long admissions, and whether the government can pressure institutions. The minister acknowledged specialist knowledge is scarce, pointed to good practices and early-detection initiatives, said she cannot directly pressure institutions but the IGZ can investigate complaints, and agreed diagnosis must improve.
I cannot directly exert pressure on institutions to improve care for autistic people. If there are complaints about care, the IGZ can launch an investigation on that basis.
Ik kan niet direct druk uitoefenen op de instellingen om de zorg voor autisten te verbeteren. Als er klachten zijn met betrekking tot de zorg dan kan de IGZ op basis hiervan een onderzoek instellen.

m: Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Depla c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 9 tot het invoegen van de bepaling dat geen meerjarige onderhoudscontracten mogen worden gesloten zolang niet tweederde deel van de a
Amendment barring new homeowners' associations from signing maintenance contracts longer than one year until two-thirds of apartments are transferred.
the homeowners' association will not enter maintenance agreements with a term longer than one year
gaat de vereniging van eigenaars geen overeenkomsten voor onderhoud aan met een langere looptijd dan een jaar
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Paulus Jansen en Depla ter vervanging van nr. 13 over de mogelijkheid van een aan een VvE op te leggen verplichting tot uitbesteden van het beeer ingeval van opnieuw
Lets the municipality require a homeowners' association to outsource management to a professional manager if mismanagement recurs within five years of a previous authorization.
the competent authority may require the association of owners to outsource management to a professional manager.
kan het bevoegd gezag de betrokken vereniging van eigenaars verplichten tot het uitbesteden van het beheer aan een professionele beheerder.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Paulus Jansen c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 12 over het zenden van afschrift van het onderhoudsplan aan  burgemeester en wethouders
Requires the owners' association to send the municipality a copy of its maintenance plan within four weeks so the authority can check it is carried out.
The owners' association sends a copy of the maintenance plan to the competent authority within four weeks of drawing it up.
De vereniging van eigenaars zendt binnen vier weken na het opstellen van het onderhoudsplan, bedoeld in het eerste lid, een afschrift van het plan aan het bevoegd gezag.
Amendement van het lid Paulus Jansen c.s. over het betrekken van elektronische communiciatiemiddelen bij vergaderingen van de vereniging van eigenaars

Amends the Civil Code for owners' associations so that electronic communication and voting rules apply to apartment owners' associations, letting their house rules set voting eligibility and electronic use conditions.
The amendment restores this evident omission and provides that the owners' association can communicate with its members electronically.
Het amendement herstelt deze klaarblijkelijke omissie en regelt dat de Vereniging van Eigenaars via het elektronisch verkeer met hun leden kan communiceren.
Amendement van het lid Paulus Jansen c.s. over voldoende bijdragen aan het reservefonds voor het uitvoeren van het onderhoudsplan
Requires owners' associations to fund their maintenance reserve adequately and send the maintenance plan and contributions to the mayor and aldermen, who could then use sanctions.
The owners' association sends a copy of the maintenance plan and the agreed contributions to the reserve fund to the mayor and aldermen.
De vereniging van eigenaars zendt afschrift van het onderhoudsplan en van de overeengekomen bijdragen aan het reservefonds aan burgemeester en wethouders.
Amendement van het lid Van Bochove c.s. over het opnemen in het onderhoudsplan van een schatting van de benodigde jaarlijkse reservering na afloop van het onderhoudsplan
Requires maintenance plans for owners' associations to include an estimate of the annual reserve needed for large costs beyond the plan period.
an estimate of the annual reserve needed for costs other than ordinary annual costs after the period covered by the maintenance plan
een schatting van de benodigde jaarlijkse reservering voor andere dan de gewone jaarlijkse kosten na de periode waarop het onderhoudsplan betrekking heeft
Amendement van de leden Paulus Jansen en Depla over de mogelijkheid van een voorstel van de gemeente aan een VvE om het beheer uit te besteden aan een professionele beheerder
Adds to the municipal proposal power for owners' associations the option of outsourcing management to a professional manager, while owners keep the right to accept or reject.
outsourcing management to a professional manager
het uitbesteden van het beheer aan een professionele beheerder
Amendement van het lid Depla c.s. tot het invoegen van de bepaling dat geen meerjarige onderhoudscontracten mogen worden gesloten zolang niet het tweederde deel van de appartementen is verkocht
Bars owners' associations of apartments from concluding maintenance contracts longer than one year until two-thirds of the apartments are sold.
As long as two-thirds of the apartment rights have not yet been sold, the owners' association will not conclude maintenance agreements with a term longer than one year.
Zolang het tweederde deel van de appartementsrechten nog niet is verkocht, gaat de vereniging van eigenaars geen overeenkomsten voor onderhoud aan met een langere looptijd dan een jaar.

Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Biskop en Depla ter vervanging van nr. 8 over  het stroomlijnen van de keuzevrijheid van leerlingen in alle leerwegen van het vmbo om de aansluiting bij vervolgopleid
Amends secondary education rules on compulsory subject choices in vmbo sectors to give pupils more freedom and better preparation for follow-on training.
With this amendment the submitters ensure that pupils in the technology sector across all vmbo tracks
Met dit amendement bewerkstelligen de indieners dat leerlingen in de sector techniek van alle leerwegen in het vmbo
Amendement van de leden Biskop en Depla inzake het stroomlijnen van de keuzevrijheid van leerlingen in alle leerwegen van het vmbo om de aansluiting bij vervolgopleidingen te bevorderen
Amendment restructuring vmbo sector subject choices (techniek and landbouw) to broaden pupils' choice and improve transition to further vocational training; no bearing on executive checks.
With this amendment the submitters ensure that pupils in the technology sector of all vmbo pathways can choose one compulsory subject besides mathematics.
Met dit amendement bewerkstelligen de indieners dat leerlingen in de sector techniek van alle leerwegen in het vmbo, naast het verplichte sectorvak wiskunde één verplicht vak kunnen kiezen
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Jasper van Dijk c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 15 over de instemming met fusie in WEB en WHW
Introduces a fusion check in education laws requiring consultation and agreement of staff and student councils before mergers, with an appeal committee for disputes.
In case of an intended merger, the competent authority, the participants council, the works council and, where applicable, the parents council meet to discuss the intention.

In geval van een voornemen tot een fusie als bedoeld in artikel 2.1.8 komen het bevoegd gezag, de deelnemersraad, de ondernemingsraad en, in voorkomende gevallen, de ouderraad bijeen om dat voornemen te bespreken.
Amendement van de leden Depla en Biskop over het omdopen van de vakken natuur- en scheikunde I en II tot natuurkunde en scheikunde
Amendment renames the science subjects natuur- en scheikunde I and II to natuurkunde and scheikunde in the secondary education act.
with this amendment the submitters bring about that the subjects are renamed natuurkunde and scheikunde.
met dit amendement bewerkstelligen de indieners dat de vakken natuur- en scheikunde I en natuur- en scheikunde II worden omgedoopt
Amendement van het lid Depla c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 12 over het toevoegen van advies van b&w over een fusie als onderdeel van de fusie-effectrapportage
Adds an advice from the municipal executive of the affected municipalities on the desirability of a proposed school merger to the merger effect report.
an advice from the mayor and aldermen of the municipalities concerned on the desirability of the proposed merger
een advies van burgemeester en wethouders van de betrokken gemeenten over de wenselijkheid van de voorgestelde fusie

Amendement van het lid Jasper van Dijk c.s. dat indien sprake is van een fusie, de gezamenlijke vergadering van de deelnemersraad, ondernemingsraad en, in voorkomende gevallen, de ouderraad bijeengero
Requires a joint meeting of participants council, works council and parents council to consent to school mergers, with a merger effect report made available beforehand.
This joint meeting is asked to consent to the merger.
Deze gezamenlijke vergadering wordt gevraagd in te stemmen met de fusie.
Amendement van de leden Depla en Jan Jacob van Dijk over het toevoegen van advies van b&w over een fusie als onderdeel van de fusie-effectrapportage
Adds a municipal executive (B&W) advice on the desirability of a proposed school merger to the required merger-effect report.
advice from the mayor and aldermen of the municipalities concerned on the desirability of the proposed merger.
een advies van burgemeester en wethouders van de betrokken gemeenten over de wenselijkheid van de voorgestelde fusie.
Amendement van het lid Jan Jacob van Dijk c.s. betreffende het vaststellen van beleidsregels over de goedkeuring van een fusie door de minister
Requires the minister to adopt binding policy rules on how the power to approve a merger is used, moving the decision away from political judgement.
Our minister shall adopt policy rules on the exercise of the power referred to in the first paragraph.
Onze minister stelt beleidsregels vast omtrent de uitoefening van de bevoegdheid, bedoeld in het eerste lid.
Amendement van het lid Jan Jacob van Dijk c.s. betreffende instemming van de medezeggenschapsraad met de fusie-effectrapportage
Requires explicit works council consent to the merger effect report in education, making it part of the works council's consent right.
that the works council must explicitly consent to the merger effect report
dat de medezeggenschapsraad expliciet moet instemmen met de fusie effectrapportage
Motie-Depla/Van Bochove over ongedaan maken van overgebleven bezuiniging op de huurtoeslag
Motion asking the government to reverse remaining budget cuts to the rent allowance (huurtoeslag) and to propose measures reducing the poverty trap it creates; no check on executive power.
requests the government in spring 2010 to come with proposals that undo the remaining budget cut on the rent allowance for 2011 and 2010.
verzoekt de regering in het voorjaar van 2010 te komen met voorstellen die de overgebleven bezuinigingstaakstelling voor de huurtoeslag in 2011 en 2010 ongedaan maken
Motie van het lid Ortegea-Martijn c.s. over het probleem dat grote gezinnen geen extra huurtoeslag kunnen krijgen
Asks the government to analyse and find a solution, with housing associations, for large families being unable to receive extra rent allowance.
requests the government, after further analysis of the problem, to work with housing associations towards a solution
verzoekt de regering na een nadere analyse van het probleem, samen met woningcorporaties tot een oplossing te komen
Motie-Van Bochove c.s. over een integrale aanpak van de krimpproblematiek
Asks the government to present integrated proposals on fair distribution of funds and coordinated regional responsibilities for population decline.
requests the government, when presenting the note on shrinkage, also to present proposals leading to a fair distribution of available funds
verzoekt de regering om bij de presentatie van de nota over krimp tevens voorstellen te presenteren die leiden tot een eerlijke verdeling van beschikbare middelen
Amendement van de leden Van Bochove en Depla over het maximeren van het (plaatsvervangend) voorzitterschap op 12 jaar
Caps the chair and deputy chair of the national rent commission at two six-year terms, i.e. a maximum of 12 years.
The chair and deputy chair are appointed for a period of six years and may be reappointed once for a consecutive period of six years.

De voorzitter en de plaatsvervangend voorzitter worden benoemd voor een tijdvak van zes jaar en kunnen voor een aansluitend tijdvak van zes jaar eenmaal als voorzitter onderscheidenlijk plaatsvervangend voorzitter worden herbenoemd.
Amendement van de leden Depla en Van Bochove over het mogelijk maken van een collectief verzoek bij vergelijkbare zaken
Allows tenants in a housing complex to file collective requests with the rent commission for comparable service-cost or renovation rent disputes, with the ruling binding on all units.
these requests may be submitted collectively by at least half of the residents of a housing unit within that housing complex
kunnen deze verzoeken door ten minste de helft van de bewoners van een woonruimte binnen dat wooncomplex of deel van dat wooncomplex collectief worden ingediend
Amendement van de leden Van Bochove en Depla over het maximeren van het zittingsvoorzitterschap op 8 jaar
Caps the term of rent commission chairpersons (zittingsvoorzitters) at eight years total, with one renewal of four years.
The chairpersons are appointed for a period of four years and can be reappointed once for a consecutive four-year period.
De zittingsvoorzitters worden benoemd voor een tijdvak van vier jaar en kunnen voor een aansluitend tijdvak van vier jaar eenmaal als zittingsvoorzitter worden herbenoemd.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Jan Jacob van Dijk c.s. ter vervanging van dat gedrukt onder nr. 14 over het slechts vaststellen van een aanwijzing, opheffing, of een bekostigingsmaatregel, als daar
Requires the inspectorate's investigation and inspection report, plus a four-week school hearing, before the minister can issue an instruction or end funding or a school type.

that an instruction by the minister, and the closure of a school, school type or study route at a public school, or the ending of funding for a school, school type or study route at a special school, may only take place if an inspection report underlies it

dat een aanwijzing door de minister, en een opheffing van een school, schoolsoort, of leerweg bij een openbare school, dan wel een beëindiging van de bekostiging van een school, schoolsoort, of leerweg bij een bijzondere school, slechts kan geschieden als daar een inspectierapport aan ten grondslag ligt

Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Depla c.s. ter vervanging van dat gedrukt onder nr. 24 omtrent het doen van een bindende voordracht voor een lid van de raad van toezicht door de medezeggenschap
Amends education governance laws so that a school's participation council may make a binding nomination for a member of the supervisory board.

qa: Vragen van de leden Heijnen en Depla (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de minister voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie over fraude op de huizenmarkt (ingezonden 28 april

MPs Heijnen and Depla asked why housing fraud still requires a sample study when municipalities can already share GBA data with housing corporations, and why corporate data are not systematically linked to population, cadastre, telephone and postal records. Het stelselmatig koppelen van gegevens kan inderdaad een goede methode zijn om woonfraude aan te pakken.

not to use the ODE proceeds for CO2 storage but for genuine transition to a sustainable energy supply
de opbrengst van de ODE niet in te zetten voor de opslag van CO 2 maar in te zetten voor daadwerkelijke transitie naar een duurzame energievoorziening
Motie van het lid Van der Lee c.s. over de 50-50-verhouding in de opslag duurzame energie
Asks the government to study the effects on purchasing power, competitiveness and energy use of changing the 50-50 split of the sustainable energy levy between households and businesses.
requests the government to have studied what the effects are on the purchasing power of citizens
verzoekt de regering te laten onderzoeken wat de gevolgen zijn voor de koopkracht van burgers
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin, Kröger, Moorlag, Schonis en Van Esch over het vervangen van de Paddepoelsterbrug en de aangenomen motie-Laçin c.s. (Kamerstuk 35570-A, nr. 30)

MPs asked the minister about the replacement of the Paddepoelsterbrug in Groningen, including whether agreements for a low movable bridge still stand after a 2021 motion. The minister said talks with residents and stakeholders continue, that a 2020 MIRT agreement provides for a fixed bridge at 9.10 metres with ramps and a €8.6 million federal contribution, and that the agreement is on hold pending the motion, while defending the drawbacks of a low bridge.
After concluding an administrative agreement, I will transfer the financial resources and implementation by the municipality of Groningen can begin.
Na het sluiten van een bestuursovereenkomst zal ik de financiële middelen overdragen en kan de uitvoering door de gemeente Groningen beginnen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Moorlag over sociale ondernemingen die niet alle coronasteun ontvangen

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers whether social enterprises such as De Oude Keuken, which may have an incorrect SBI code, are excluded from COVID support and whether extra aid will be given. The State Secretary replied that TVL support is now open to all sectors regardless of SBI code, that the HVA surcharge applies only to SBI code 56, and that businesses can appeal to RVO.nl, while noting ongoing consultation with Social Enterprise Nederland.
From the fourth quarter of 2020, all sectors can use the TVL (except financial institutions) regardless of the SBI code.
Vanaf het vierde kwartaal 2020 kunnen alle sectoren gebruik maken van de TVL (met uitzondering van de financiële instellingen) ongeacht de SBI-code.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over de steunmaatregelen voor schoonheidsspecialisten

MPs Moorlag and Gijs van Dijk asked whether the government will give extra COVID support to beauty specialists, many of whom face bankruptcy, and whether the partner test in the Tozo excludes self-employed beauticians from aid, and asked to meet their trade body Anbos. The government replied that the sector benefits from the TVL and NOW expansions, that self-employed beauticians may apply for Tozo, that the new TONK may help those excluded by the partner test, and that it is willing to talk with Anbos.
I am of course willing to talk with Anbos about the support and recovery package and the specific situation of beauty specialists within it.
Ik ben uiteraard bereid om met de Anbos in gesprek te gaan over het steun- en herstelpakket en de specifieke situatie van de schoonheidsspecialisten daarin.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer, Gijs van Dijk en Moorlag over ondernemers in Groningen en Fryslân die knel komen te zitten

MPs Nijboer, Gijs van Dijk and Moorlag asked whether start-up businesses hit by COVID-19 measures, such as hairdressers and hospitality firms without a reference turnover, are adequately compensated and whether the schemes could be changed. The State Secretary replied that a new Tegemoetkoming Starters scheme will cover start-ups' fixed costs, that monthly turnover calculations are not feasible, and that fully closed sectors get up to 85% fixed-cost subsidy.
With the new Tegemoetkoming Starters scheme, the cabinet wants to give these entrepreneurs a reasonable subsidy for their fixed costs.
Met de nieuwe regeling Tegemoetkoming Starters wil het kabinet deze ondernemers een redelijke subsidie bieden voor hun vaste lasten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Moorlag over het bericht ‘Ruzie tussen Nederland en Frankrijk bedreigt banen in Roden’

MPs Nijboer and Moorlag asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports of a dispute with France over Photonis and the threat to jobs in Roden, and what the government would do to protect them and prevent the company falling into the wrong hands. The minister denied a dispute, said the Netherlands is in close contact with France, expressed a preference for a sale by the current owner, and gave general commitments to protect jobs and R&D without concrete new steps.
The cabinet has no indication that an undesirable takeover of the company is currently at issue.
Het kabinet heeft geen indicatie dat een onwenselijke overname van het bedrijf op dit moment aan de orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over opslag van nucleair afval net over de grens

MPs Moorlag and Gijs van Dijk asked whether the government would raise with Germany the concerns of residents near the border about possible nuclear waste storage in salt caverns in Emsland, and how Dutch citizens and authorities can take part in German siting decisions. The state secretary answered that Germany has no concrete plans yet, that Dutch citizens would be informed and have participation rights under the Espoo Convention if a border-near site is considered, and that a Rathenau-led participatory process is underway in the Netherlands.
I consider it important that Dutch citizens also have a say in decision-making on a German final repository if it were to be located near the Dutch border.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat ook Nederlandse burgers inspraak hebben bij besluitvorming over een Duitse eindberging als die in de buurt van de grens met Nederland zou komen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand, De Groot, Graus, Bromet, Futselaar en Moorlag over het opnemen van de haas en het konijn op de lijst bedreigde zoogdieren, terwijl beide nog steeds bejaagd worden

MPs from six parties asked the minister why the hare and rabbit, newly listed as threatened on the Red List of mammals, may still be hunted, and whether they will be removed from the huntable species list. The minister answered that both are listed as 'sensitive' rather than threatened, that the hunting season for hares has ended and for rabbits ends in January, and that research on population decline and hunting effects will be commissioned, with possible further protection measures to follow.
Next year I will have further research carried out into the decline of these species.
Het komende jaar zal ik verder onderzoek laten uitvoeren naar de afname van deze soorten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland, Van den Berg, Gijs van Dijk en Moorlag over het bericht 'Misstanden bij koeriers zijn eerder regel dan uitzondering'

MPs asked the Social Affairs minister about reports of widespread abuses at parcel and courier firms, including WW recipients working as couriers, workers without valid residence papers and sham constructions, and how these can persist. The minister acknowledged the serious findings from Inspectie SZW, described its sector programme and enforcement, and said the Inspectorate will confront major clients and evaluate in 2022 whether further measures are needed.
I attach great importance to fair, healthy and safe work for all employees.
Ik hecht groot belang aan eerlijk, gezond en veilig werk voor alle werknemers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het bericht ‘Onafhankelijk onderzoek pro-kernenergie blijkt van oud directeur Borssele’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether a pro-nuclear study (ENCO report) was compromised because one of its authors was a former director of the Borssele nuclear plant and chairs a nuclear-promotion organisation, and whether it should be reviewed by an independent body such as PBL. The minister answered that the author's involvement ended about ten years earlier, that expertise rather than conflict of interest drove the selection, that ENCO also works for anti-nuclear governments, and that there is no reason to distance the government from the report or to have it independently reviewed.
In my view, conflict of interest is not at issue here.
Volgens mij is belangenverstrengeling hier niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Moorlag over onderbetaling bij de RVO

MPs Van Dijk and Moorlag asked why externally hired staff at RVO, via detacher USG Legal, receive lower pay than colleagues doing the same work, and what the government will do about it. The minister says RVO is not the formal employer, the contractor's own terms apply under a results-based contract, the Inspectie SZW found the wage-ratio norm was breached, and that the government will respond to the advisory team's recommendations on temporary work agencies.
However, article 27 of the General Government Terms for Services (ARVODI), which apply to the framework agreement, provides that the staffing agencies as formal employers must act as good employers.

Wel is in artikel 27 van de Algemene Rijksvoorwaarden voor Diensten (ARVODI) die van toepassing zijn op de raamovereenkomst bepaald dat de detacheringsbureaus als de formele werkgevers zich als goed werkgever gedragen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over de berichten over een gebrekkig bereik van mobiele telefonie en internet in Termunten/Termunterzijl

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about poor mobile and internet coverage in Termunten/Termunterzijl, including risks for emergency calls, and whether providers would be pushed to fix it. The State Secretary answered that emergency-call success is high, that a provider and the municipality are working toward a new site, and that the 700 MHz licence coverage conditions apply, while acknowledging some locations will always lack full coverage.
I therefore see no need to bring parties together at the table (unsolicited).
Ik zie dan ook geen noodzaak om partijen (ongevraagd) met elkaar aan tafel te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Nijboer over het bericht 'Miljarden vliegen weg bij Tata'

MPs Moorlag and Nijboer asked the ministers whether reports that billions of euros flowed from Tata Steel Netherlands to its Indian parent show unpaid corporate tax, mismanagement, or threats to investment. Minister Wiebes answered that tax secrecy (art. 67 AWR) prevents comment on an individual taxpayer, that the Tax Authority supervises on a risk basis, that he sees no grounds for intervention, and that Tata Steel's investment plans are sound, while rejecting new rules restricting profit transfers.
Under article 67 of the General Tax Act (AWR) I cannot discuss the tax position of an individual taxpayer.
Op grond van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan ik niet ingaan op de fiscale positie van een individuele belastingplichtige.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Nijboer en Moorlag over de slechte toegankelijkheid van huisartsenspoedzorg in Noordoost-Groningen

Three PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Medical Care about the reduction of night-time GP emergency car visits in Noordoost-Groningen, the loss of the Delfzijl post, and the erosion of acute care in the region. The minister replied that GPs and insurers are responsible for 24-hour care, that the inspectorate found no patient-safety breach so far, that a draft AMvB on acute care would require careful process if closures were decided, and that no signals of unacceptable care had been received.
I have currently received no signals from the relevant supervisory bodies that the quality or availability of care is at stake.
Ik heb op dit moment geen signalen ontvangen van de betreffende toezichthouders dat kwaliteit of beschikbaarheid van zorg in het geding is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van den Berg en Moorlag over pakketbezorging in de ‘last mile’

MPs Van den Berg and Moorlag asked the State Secretary about ACM and TNO findings on last-mile parcel delivery, its sustainability, the share of e-commerce in traffic, the expansion of pickup points, and further research. The government answered that the market functions well, that pickup points can reduce CO2 if consumers collect on foot or by bike, that the matter is largely left to market parties and municipalities, and that existing research and pilots are ongoing.
I am willing to initiate this research.
Bent u bereid dit onderzoek te initiëren?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het bericht dat de cijfers over de uitstoot van stikstof door de veestapel niet kloppen

An MP asked the minister whether reports that manure ammonia emissions from livestock barns are underestimated and that farmers may be cheating on animal numbers hold, and what would be done about possible fraud. The minister acknowledged the emission model underestimates some barn types, argued licensed capacity does not prove fraud, and pointed to risk-based enforcement and inter-agency data sharing as ongoing improvements, without committing to new concrete measures.
By increasing the chance of getting caught and confronting offenders with strict (financial) consequences, the incentive to commit fraud decreases.
Door de pakkans te vergroten en met stevige (financiële) consequenties te confronteren neemt de fraudeprikkel af.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg , Futselaar, Bromet, De Groot, Moorlag en Graus over de onderbouwing voor de Nederlandse inzet voor de bescherming van honingbijen, hommels en wilde bijen in het bijenrichtsnoer

MPs asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality for the scientific basis behind the Dutch position on protecting honeybees, bumblebees and wild bees in the EU bee guidance, including the BEEHAVE model, percentile choice, EFSA test runs and consultation of independent experts. The minister answered that the chosen option keeps colony size within natural variability, that the protection goal is still to be set, that a technical meeting is expected in late October, and that documents will be made public beforehand.
I will inform your House about this in advance of the meeting.
Ik zal uw Kamer voorafgaand aan deze bijeenkomst daarover informeren.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het onderzoek ‘Maatschappelijke kosten-batenanalyse naar toekomstige inpassing van drie alternatieven voor opwek van zonne-energie’ van Berenschot en Kalavasta

MP Moorlag asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a cost-benefit study by Berenschot and Kalavasta, which concluded that rooftop solar should be promoted more from a societal perspective, and about whether subsidies should favour projects with higher social value and whether solar parks have a better business case than rooftop solar. The minister said the conclusion fits existing policy, rejected the need for better business cases beyond the SDE++ subsidy, and argued the SDE++ does not currently favour ground-mounted parks over rooftops because of differing assumptions on self-consumption.
I therefore do not believe that solar parks have a better business case than rooftop solar projects.
Ik ben daarom niet van mening dat zonneweides een betere businesscase hebben dan zonprojecten op daken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Moorlag over internationale drugshandel per post

MPs Kuiken and Moorlag ask about the growing international trade in hard drugs by post, foreign complaints about Dutch mail shipments, the scale of detections, enforcement gaps, and whether sender identification or opening powers should be introduced. Minister Grapperhaus answers that data are limited, customs pilots show positive results, public-private cooperation is being mapped, and a planned reform would let investigators open parcels without a rechter-commissaris.

After the modernisation of the Code of Criminal Procedure, investigating officers will be authorised to independently seize postal parcels and then open them and examine the contents, without needing authorisation from the rechter-commissaris.

Na de modernisering van het wetboek van Strafvordering zullen opsporingsambtenaren bevoegd worden om zelfstandig postpakketten in beslag te nemen en om het postpakket vervolgens te openen en kennis te nemen van de inhoud.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over met corona besmette nertsen

An MP asked the ministers whether new Covid-19 infections at mink farms show that earlier measures failed, whether workers are tested, and whether all mink farms should be preventively culled before the autumn harvest. The minister answered that the risk is not minimised, announced intensified screening and enforcement, and argued preventive culling is not the most effective measure, instead planning an accelerated end to fur farming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over met corona besmette nertsen

An MP asked whether recent COVID-19 infections on mink farms show that measures have had little effect, why a new OMT-Z advice was needed before culling, whether economic interests are overriding public health as in the Q fever case, and why mink are not culled preventively. The minister answered that the measures were insufficient and were tightened, that the OMT-Z advised against preventive culling as the most effective route, and that the fur farming sector will be phased out faster.
For that reason, in my letter of 28 August 2020 I announced a tightening of the current measures and several additional measures.
Om die reden heb ik in mijn brief van 28 augustus 2020 een aanscherping van de huidige maatregelen en enkele aanvullende maatregelen afgekondigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het bericht dat de NVWA nalatig is bij corona in slachthuizen

MP Moorlag asked the ministers about a report that the NVWA was negligent in responding to internal warnings about COVID-19 risks in slaughterhouses, including whether 1.5m distancing was enforceable, whether an external reporting point is needed for NVWA staff, and how health would be prioritised over economic interests. The minister responded that the NVWA took protective measures such as masks for vets from 11 May, that working conditions in slaughterhouses fall under the Inspectie SZW and the companies themselves, that an external reporting route via Inspectie SZW exists, and that public health was always leading in local decisions.
I do not recognise the picture that the NVWA acted indifferently or negligently.
Ik herken mij niet in het beeld dat de NVWA onverschillig of nalatig heeft geopereerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over vechthonden uit dierenasielen

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether dangerous fighting and high-risk dogs are being rehomed from shelters, whether owners and new keepers are informed of bite history, and whether stricter breeding, trade and keeping rules are needed. The minister answered that dogs are not known to be trained fighters or high-risk on arrival, that bite history is usually unknown, and pointed to a welfare-based breeding rule, a risk-assessment test under development, and a planned standalone keeping ban.
I have no insight into how many dogs in a shelter have been assessed by an expert as posing a high risk of dangerous behaviour and serious injury.
Ik heb geen inzicht bij hoeveel honden in een asiel aan de hand van een deskundige beoordeling een hoog risico op gevaarlijk gedrag en ernstig letsel is vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg, Bromet, Futselaar, Moorlag en Madlener over de Nederlandse inzet voor het bijenrichtsnoer

MPs asked the minister whether the Netherlands would back a proposed bee guidance option based on natural colony variability, which the Ctgb and minister favour over the 2013 fixed 7% mortality threshold, and asked for postponement of the July 2020 SCoPAFF discussion. The minister answered that the discussion is non-binding, that she follows the Ctgb advice on the scientific basis for protection goals, and that she has pushed for rapid implementation of the bee guidance while refusing to postpone the meeting.
I consider it important that the way in which the protection goal is set is scientifically justified.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat de wijze waarop het beschermdoel wordt vastgesteld wetenschappelijk verantwoord is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Kuiken over de aangeboden petitie/brandbrief draf- en rensport

MPs Moorlag and Kuiken asked the ministers whether there is sound justification to keep banning trotting and racing selection trials, given a tested protocol, outdoor activities, no spectators and permission elsewhere in Europe, and whether the ban can be lifted soon. Minister Schouten answered that the planned easing of measures from 1 July removes any medical reasons to ban races, including selection trials, and that she sees no need for further action now.
With the announced easing of measures from 1 July, there are no longer any medical-substantive reasons to prohibit races.
Met de aangekondigde versoepeling van maatregelen per 1 juli zijn er geen medisch-inhoudelijke redenen meer om wedstrijden te verbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over corona onder het personeel van het vleesbedrijf Vion in Boxtel

MPs Moorlag and Gijs van Dijk asked whether measures at Vion's Boxtel meat plant are effective after new COVID-19 cases among staff, whether labour and food inspectorates oversee the plant and temporary agency workers, and why the plant stayed open when Vion's Apeldoorn site was closed. The government answered that the new cases were found at health checks at the gate, that the Inspectorate SZW enforces the Working Conditions Act and has started inspections of slaughterhouses, and that the NVWA and safety region monitor the measures, while noting the causes of infections are still under study.
The Inspectorate SZW will deploy additional inspections at slaughterhouses in the coming period.
De Inspectie SZW zal de komende tijd extra inzetten op inspecties bij slachthuizen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over de aanleg van glasvezel in buitengebieden

An MP asks the state secretary whether KPN's partial fibre roll-outs in towns with existing full-network plans, and the market's fairness more broadly, hinder fibre reaching rural areas. The secretary agrees KPN's approach can cause delays, defers to the ACM on competition, rejects glass fibre as the only route to 100 Mbps, and promises an update in autumn 2020.
In autumn 2020 I will inform the House about the progress of these talks, as I committed to the House in the General Consultation of 11 June.
In het najaar van 2020 informeer ik uw Kamer over de voortgang van deze gesprekken, zoals ik uw Kamer in het Algemeen Overleg van 11 juni jl. heb toegezegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Moorlag over drugssmokkel op zee

MPs Kuiken and Moorlag asked the Justice, Agriculture and Transport ministers about drug smuggling by fishing vessels, including subsidies, detection odds, licence withdrawal and Bibob screening. The government acknowledged the financial pressure link, said subsidies should exclude convicted fishers while EU rules limit this, and promised investigations into licence withdrawal and Bibob use while noting limited data on detection.
The Minister of LNV will investigate what options exist to exclude fishers who have committed criminal offences from these funds.
De Minister van LNV zal onderzoeken welke mogelijkheden er zijn om vissers die strafbare feiten hebben gepleegd uit te sluiten van deze middelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop, Geurts, Baudet en Moorlag over de tariefverhogingen van Rendac

MPs Bisschop, Geurts, Baudet and Moorlag asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about Rendac's 2020 carcass-collection tariff increases, the lack of transparency in tariff calculations, and the status of the destruction-market review. The minister defended the tariffs as cost-based, said the ADR and the external auditor check compliance, and withheld Rendac's confidential figures from the Chamber while promising renegotiated agreements with Rendac.
The confidential business information obtained cannot be shared with third parties.
De verkregen bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie kan ik niet delen met derden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer, Gijs van Dijk en Moorlag over ondernemers die tussen wal en schip vallen bij het aanvragen van de NOW-regeling

MPs asked whether entrepreneurs who changed legal form, took over a business or started in early 2020 fall through the cracks of the NOW wage-subsidy scheme, and whether affected firms can be compensated and included in a second package. The minister acknowledges the problem, says the scheme cannot be adapted to every case, refuses to quantify affected firms, and declines to extend eligibility to businesses without a full reference month of turnover.
I am aware of the problem of businesses that had not yet generated a full month of turnover before March.
Ik ben op de hoogte van de problematiek van bedrijven die voor maart nog geen hele maand omzet hebben gedraaid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Moorlag over het ontbreken van overeenstemming tussen winkeliers en vastgoedeigenaren

MPs Nijboer and Moorlag asked whether landlords and retail tenants are reaching rent-relief agreements, whether the Steunakkoord agreements are binding and could be declared generally binding, and whether legislation is needed. The State Secretary replied that most tenants and landlords have made case-by-case agreements, that a legal basis for generally binding private agreements does not exist, and that no legislative proposal is planned.
To declare private agreements generally binding, a legal basis is required. That does not currently exist.
Om private afspraken algemeen verbindend te verklaren, is een wettelijke grondslag nodig. Die bestaat nu niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over vouchers voor geannuleerde vluchten voor Nederlandse klanten

An MP asked the government whether Dutch passengers with cancelled flights are entitled to refunds rather than vouchers, and how this compares with Israel, where refunds were paid, and whether vouchers are safeguarded if airlines go bankrupt. The Minister answered that passengers are entitled to refunds under EU Regulation 261/2004, that the government tolerated vouchers only temporarily, has withdrawn that tolerance, and is pushing for a European voucher guarantee, while stating that vouchers are an acceptable alternative in the crisis and that voucher holders rank as unsecured creditors.
On 14 May I informed the House that I had withdrawn the instruction to the ILT early.
Op 14 mei heb ik uw Kamer geïnformeerd dat ik de aanwijzing aan de ILT vroegtijdig heb ingetrokken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over overheidssteun aan Tata Steel

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs whether siphoning roughly 100 million euro a year of profit from Tata Steel's Dutch subsidiary, while it receives Covid aid and CCS subsidy, harms Dutch steel employment, and whether conditions or industrial policy can keep profits in the Netherlands. The minister answers that shareholder profit distribution is a company matter constrained by EU law, that Covid support may carry conditions such as no dividends and job retention, and that a profit-earmarking industrial policy would deter investment; he declines to share the content of stakeholder talks citing confidentiality.
Due to the confidential nature of all these conversations, I do not feel free to share the content and outcomes of these conversations with the House.
Vanwege het vertrouwelijke karakter van al deze gesprekken voel ik mij niet vrij om de inhoud en uitkomsten van deze gesprekken met de Kamer te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van den Hul en Moorlag over het bericht “13.000 mbo’ers hebben geen stageplek of leerbaan: ‘Mogelijk voorbode van werkloosheid’”

MPs Van den Hul and Moorlag asked how the government will ensure a sound internship (beroepspraktijkvorming) approach in vocational education given a shortage of 13,000 placements, and whether affected students will avoid study delays and whether the shortage signals future unemployment. The Minister answered that SBB is acquiring new placements with extra funds, that schools may assess learning goals without full placement hours, and that the labour market risk is acknowledged with a progress letter promised before the summer recess.
The shortage of internship places and apprenticeships may indeed be an indication of labour market problems for school leavers.
Het tekort aan stageplaatsen en leerbanen kan inderdaad een indicatie zijn van knelpunten op de arbeidsmarkt voor schoolverlaters.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over nertsen met corona

An MP from the PvdA asked the ministers of Agriculture and of Health about mink farms with coronavirus, including whether all farms were checked, whether more research was underway, and how the virus could spread. The ministers answered that all mink farms are being screened by blood test, the virus has been found on nine sites, the affected sites will be culled under new policy, and further research and an OMT-Z advice are underway.
The number of infected mink per farm is not precisely known because a sample is taken to establish whether the infection is present or not.
Het aantal besmette nertsen per bedrijf is niet precies bekend omdat een steekproef wordt genomen om aan te tonen of de infectie aanwezig is of niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over stroomlevering door zonnepanelen

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about grid capacity and voltage problems preventing households with solar panels from feeding electricity into the grid, including whether grid operators must guarantee feed-in and compensate affected households. The minister acknowledged the problem, said guaranteeing feed-in everywhere would be disproportionately costly, noted grid operators must resolve issues within a reasonable time, and rejected a compensation scheme analogous to outage compensation.
However, I cannot guarantee that grid operators will in all cases have capacity available in time or be able to prevent voltage problems.
Ik kan echter niet garanderen dat netbeheerders in staat zijn in alle gevallen ook tijdig de capaciteit beschikbaar hebben of spanningsproblemen kunnen voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Aukje de Vries en Moorlag over het bericht over watercrassula op Terschelling en de bestrijding van invasieve exoten

MPs Weverling, Aukje de Vries and Moorlag asked the minister about the spread of water crassula on Terschelling, its financial and legal responsibilities, control methods, and coordination among authorities. The minister confirmed the threat to protected dune habitat, described provincial spending of about 4.3 million euros, noted the difficulty of control, and rejected a central knowledge platform while promising an evaluation and a meeting on this case.
For this specific problem I will organise a consultation.
Ik zal voor deze specifieke problematiek een overleg organiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk, Moorlag en Nijboer over de voorwaarden voor steun aan bedrijven

MPs Gijs van Dijk, Moorlag and Nijboer asked whether Booking.com's dividends and share buybacks should bar it from state support, whether NOW wage subsidies allow dismissals, what conditions apply to support, and whether it uses tax schemes. The state secretary answered that companies are responsible for their dividends, that support will generally exclude dividends, bonuses and buybacks, and that tax secrecy prevents comment on Booking.com's tax position, while promising further anti-avoidance work.
Due to the statutory tax secrecy obligation, the cabinet cannot make statements about the tax position of an individual taxpayer such as Booking.com.
Door de wettelijke fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht kan het kabinet geen uitspraken doen over de fiscale positie van een individuele belastingplichtige als Booking.com.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over formule 1 wil coureurs door zeehondenreservaat laten pendelen

Two PvdA MPs asked whether F1 teams should be shuttled over the beach past a seal reserve, questioning the nature, safety and municipal regulation of the plan. The minister replied that the Grand Prix was postponed due to Covid-19 and the beach route dropped, so no negative effects are expected, and said the province is the competent authority for nature.
The organiser has also announced that the Formula 1 teams will not drive over the beach from Noordwijk to the circuit in Zandvoort during the Grand Prix.
Ook heeft de organisator bekendgemaakt dat de Formule 1-teams tijdens de Grand Prix niet over het strand van Noordwijk naar het circuit in Zandvoort gaan rijden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand, Bromet, Moorlag en Futselaar over het uitgelekte plan voor de aanpak van de stikstofproblematiek

MPs Ouwehand, Bromet, Moorlag and Futselaar asked the minister how leaks about the nitrogen plan reached the media before parliament was informed, and when parliament would receive the plan. The minister regrets the media coverage, says parliament will be informed once cabinet decides, and states the cabinet has now concluded its decision and sent the structural approach letter to parliament.
I attach importance to informing your House once the discussions with the parties involved have taken place and cabinet decision-making is complete.
Ik hecht eraan uw Kamer te informeren zodra de besprekingen met betrokken partijen hebben plaatsgevonden en de besluitvorming in het kabinet is afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het opkopen van stikstofrechten

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether Noord-Brabant's purchase of farms to acquire nitrogen rights for an industrial project is lawful, and how it fits with the area-based nitrogen approach and national priority for housing. The minister answered that the provincial rules permit the purchase agreements as preparation, that interprovincial cooperation and transparency rules are being agreed, and that the provinces hold regional responsibility.
I intend to agree with the provinces that for external netting, an initiator (both public and private) notifies the province in advance of a planned purchase.
Ik ben voornemens om met de provincies af te spreken dat bij extern salderen een initiatiefnemer (zowel publiek als privaat) zich vooraf meldt bij de provincie over een voorgenomen aankoop.
Antwoord op vragen van van het lid Moorlag over stikstofemissie ten gevolge van houtstook

An MP (Moorlag, PvdA) asked the ministers whether Dutch emission limits for NOx and dust from biomass power plants in the Activiteitenbesluit comply with EU rules and whether they should be tightened, citing a Mobilisation for the Environment letter. The state secretary replied that the limits meet EU requirements, that TNO is studying tightening them under the Schone Lucht Akkoord, and that provinces and municipalities will apply Best Available Techniques in permitting.
In the context of the Clean Air Agreement I am having TNO research the possibilities for tightening these emission limit values
In het kader van het Schone Lucht Akkoord laat ik TNO onderzoek doen naar de mogelijkheden van aanscherping van deze emissiegrenswaarden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over de omgang van grote ondernemingen met betaaltermijnen in verband met het coronavirus

MP Moorlag asked whether large companies may unilaterally extend payment terms to suppliers during the coronavirus crisis, and what the government will do to prevent this. The state secretary answered that payment terms above 60 days for SMEs are void under Dutch civil law, that the government has spoken to companies that signalled such extensions and they committed to legal terms, and that a shorter 30-day limit is planned.
I have received signals that some large companies want to stretch payment terms due to the economic situation caused by the coronavirus.
Ik heb signalen gekregen dat enkele grote ondernemingen de betaaltermijnen naar aanleiding van de economische situatie als gevolg van het coronavirus willen oprekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Kuiken over gevaarlijke honden

Two MPs asked whether a mayor can neutralise a dangerous dog and whether a mayor may have a biting dog euthanised, and whether a dog-keeping ban should be created for owners of repeatedly aggressive dogs. The government answers that mayors have existing powers under the Gemeentewet, local bylaws and bestuursdwang, that euthanasia is only possible in extreme cases after seizure, and that a standalone dog-keeping ban is being prepared with the Justice Minister.
In addition, a bill is being prepared with the Minister of Justice and Security to introduce a dog-keeping ban as a standalone measure.
In aanvulling hierop wordt in samenwerking met de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid een wetsvoorstel voorbereid waarmee een houdverbod als zelfstandige maatregel wordt geïntroduceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over regels voor campings en recreatieparken ten aanzien van de coronamaatregelen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate and the Minister of Health how the 1.5-metre rule at campsites is enforced, how shared facilities should be handled, and whether people are moving to northern campsites and holiday homes during the COVID-19 crisis. The government answered that enforcement rests mainly on people themselves and operator communication, with municipal enforcement under regional emergency ordinances, that shared sanitary facilities were closed from 31 March, and that the sector has been informed of the rules.
If people do not comply with the rules, municipal enforcement officers can enforce them on the basis of the emergency ordinance each safety region has adopted.
Als mensen zich niet aan de voorschriften houden, kunnen gemeentelijke handhavers handhaven op basis van de noodverordening die elke veiligheidsregio heeft vastgesteld.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag, Beckerman en Agnes Mulder over het rapport van de Noordelijke Rekenkamer ‘Herverdeling onder Hoogspanning, een onderzoek naar de verdeling naar de kosten en baten rondom wind- en

MPs asked the ministers about the Northern Audit Office report on how costs and benefits of wind and solar parks are distributed, including whether provinces can enforce compensation for residents and whether uniform national rules are needed. The minister said financial participation is important, that provinces' legal powers are being mapped with the interbestuurlijk level and will be reported after summer 2020, and that he opposes uniform national legal norms because projects differ.
Within interbestuurlijk consultation, it is currently being mapped which legal possibilities and powers decentralised governments have to set requirements on financial participation.
Binnen interbestuurlijk verband wordt momenteel in kaart gebracht welke juridische mogelijkheden/bevoegdheden decentrale overheden hebben om eisen te stellen aan financiële participatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Kerstens, Van Dijk, Moorlag en Kuiken over de gevolgen van het Coronavirus

MPs from the Labour party (PvdA) asked the ministers of health, social affairs, economic affairs and the state secretary of justice about IC bed capacity, care for budget holders, immigration detention during the coronavirus crisis, temporary worker and self-employed income support, Schiphol security staff conditions, childcare leave and state support for firms. The minister answered most questions substantively, describing measures and plans, while declining to commit to a fixed IC bed scenario beyond referring to earlier letters and saying the 40-hour norm and PBM supplies were still under review.
I refer you to that for brevity.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher, Gijs van Dijk, Moorlag en Nijboer over ‘de economische gevolgen van het coronavirus’

MPs from the PvdA asked the government about the economic effects of the coronavirus, including supply and demand shocks, short-time work, public investment, support for small businesses, and comparisons with Germany and Italy. The government answered that it is monitoring the situation, has announced a noodpakket of support measures (NOW wage subsidy, BMKB loan guarantees, tax deferrals, self-employed support), says a robust forecast is not yet possible, and defers further details to a CPB scenario publication.
The cabinet of course closely monitors economic developments.
Het kabinet houdt de economische ontwikkelingen vanzelfsprekend nauwlettend in de gaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over de plannen voor ‘grootste windpark ter wereld‘ boven Eemshaven

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about plans for a very large offshore wind park above Eemshaven, its link to the Climate Agreement, hydrogen production and the economy of the North, and what the government could contribute. The minister welcomed the initiative as potentially useful, said it is too early to assess its effects since it is still at the feasibility stage, and promised to study any concrete plans later.
The project itself is, after all, not much more than an idea for which the feasibility study still needs to be carried out.
Het project zelf is immers nog niet veel meer dan een idee waarvoor de haalbaarheidsstudie nog uitgevoerd moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Moorlag  en Mulder over de compensatieregeling voor omwonenden van de windparken N33 en Oostermoer

MPs Beckerman, Moorlag and Mulder asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about compensation for property value loss near the N33 and Oostermoer wind farms, including how many homes lost value and whether a 2019 VU/UvA study on turbine size and house prices calls for fairer compensation. The Minister replied that no compensation for value loss was promised, residents can apply for planning damage (planschade) compensation via the municipality or RVO, a rijksbijdrage of 2.1 million euro was added to the Drentse Monden and Oostermoer area fund, and the N33 request will be assessed similarly while no direct compensation is planned.
I do not have an overview of the number of homes in the areas of the N33 and De Drentse Monden en Oostermoer wind farms that have lost value, or the amount of value lost.
Ik heb geen overzicht van het aantal woningen in de gebieden van de windparken N33 en De Drentse Monden en Oostermoer dat in waarde is gedaald en wat de waardedaling van deze woningen is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Moorlag over onbegrijpelijk hoge rekeningen bij blokverwarming

MPs Nijboer and Moorlag asked about very high bills for communal (block) heating, the Warmtewet's coverage of owner-occupiers and VvE members, the cost of checking heat meters, and how residents can challenge high bills. The minister answered that VvE-supplied heat is now excluded from the Warmtewet, that VvE members have rights under Book 5 BW and access to civil courts, and that the procedure is reasonable.
It is therefore not necessary to open the route to a complaints committee for this.
Het is dus niet nodig om hiervoor de weg naar een geschillencommissie open te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Moorlag over het gebruik van warmtenetten

Two MPs from the Labour party asked the ministers why district heating costs differ from gas heating, what legal and technical barriers exist to disconnecting from heat networks, and related questions on tariff linkage, fixed versus variable costs, and temperature-based pricing. The minister replied that maximum heat tariffs are based on the gas reference so costs are on average equal, that disconnection is governed by the Warmtewet and civil law with some exceptions, and that tariff regulation is being reformed.
In my progress letter on Heat Act 2 I concluded that the current tariff system based on a gas reference is not sustainable in the long term.
In mijn voortgangsbrief over Warmtewet 2 heb ik geconcludeerd dat de huidige tariefsystematiek op basis van een gasreferentie op de lange termijn niet houdbaar is
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het doorfokken van honden

An MP asked the minister about breeding practices for Nova Scotia Duck Tolling Retrievers and Saint Bernards that spread hereditary epilepsy, and whether the Raad van Beheer, breed clubs and a shared database will be pushed to change. The minister acknowledged the problem, said the Raad van Beheer will present breeding policy later this year, that the NVWA enforces the breeding ban on known carriers via complaints, and that PETscan and the ECGG are being used to collect data.
It is important that the Raad now takes swift steps, and I expect concrete agreements to be made in the short term with breeders of Saint Bernards and Toller Retrievers.
Het is wel van belang dat de Raad nu snel stappen zet en ik verwacht dat op korte termijn concrete afspraken worden gemaakt met fokkers van sint-bernardhonden en toller retrievers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het ondersteunen van lokale initiatieven voor duurzame energie

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether small local renewable energy initiatives, such as a village windmill, face disproportionate barriers in the SDE+ subsidy application process and whether RVO could help them and tolerate minor errors. The minister agreed local initiatives matter and explained that applicants can correct errors within the tender system, that RVO offers information sessions and help, but declined to add a hardship clause and did not answer the question about a faster timetable.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over een containerschip dat 5 containers boven Ameland verliest en een containerschip dat tijdens de storm Ciara de risicovolle route boven de Waddeneilanden vaart

Two PvdA MPs asked the minister about a container ship that lost seven containers above Ameland and a container ship that took the risky southern route past the Wadden islands during storm Ciara, asking about recovery, damage, the Kustwacht's warnings, the permanent closure motion and possible IMO proposals. The minister answered that the owner is responsible for recovery with Rijkswaterstaat as fallback, that the captain has final route authority, that a permanent closure cannot be imposed unilaterally and needs an IMO proposal with Germany, and that consultations with Germany will follow the OVV report.
The choice of route is ultimately the responsibility of the captain.
De keuze voor de route is uiteindelijk de verantwoordelijkheid van de kapitein.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Nijboer over het stoppen met zoutwinning in de Waddenzee

MPs Moorlag and Nijboer asked whether the advisory committee found the baseline measurements for salt mining in the Wadden Sea insufficient for monitoring, and whether all preparatory activities should stop given the World Heritage status. Minister Wiebes confirmed the committee's finding, rejected stopping preparatory work, and said the revised baseline would be submitted to the audit committee, with no mining allowed until monitoring is in order.
I currently see no reason for further measures.
Ik zie nu geen aanleiding voor verdere maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over het initiatief van scholen en ondernemers op Terschelling en Vlieland om een veerdienst tussen beide eilanden te onderzoeken

MPs asked the minister whether she knows of and will support an initiative for a direct ferry between Terschelling and Vlieland, including via the concession for the West Frisian ferries. The minister acknowledged the initiative and the travel-time benefits, but said the ferry is a matter for local parties and that she has no role beyond the concession for mainland links, which the current operator also partly serves.
These parties are currently investigating the feasibility. I have no role in this.
Deze partijen onderzoeken momenteel de haalbaarheid. Ik heb hier geen rol in.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over een belasting op luchtvervuiling in de Nederlandse industrie

An MP asked the ministers whether a tax on industrial air pollution, as proposed by the CPB, is effective and feasible, and what its production and emissions effects would be. The government agrees pricing is a useful instrument, notes modelled production declines of about 4-8% by 2030 with wide uncertainty, and says further study is needed before deciding, preferably at European level.
Should emission reductions fall short of the targets in the future, it would make sense to explore the costs and benefits of additional instruments.
Mocht in de toekomst de emissiereductie achterblijven bij de doelen, dan ligt het in de rede om de kosten en baten van aanvullende instrumenten te verkennen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Nijboer over de verzekering van zonnepanelen

PvdA MPs Moorlag and Nijboer asked whether high insurance premiums are hindering solar panel installation, whether the government should intervene if private parties do not solve the insurance problem, and what rules govern fire safety and location choice. Minister Wiebes answered that the effect of premiums is unknown but likely small, that talks with insurers are constructive so no larger government role is planned, that fire safety rules exist and a standards review has started, and that the government supports prioritising rooftops in regional planning.
I have no information on the extent to which the level of insurance premiums hinders the installation of solar panels.
Ik heb geen informatie over in hoeverre de hoogte van verzekeringspremies belemmerend werkt op de aanleg van zonnepanelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over apen als proefdieren

An MP asked the minister about reports of a police raid on a Tilburg primate laboratory, the origin of monkeys imported from a German breeder suspected of animal abuse and fraud, and whether trade in wild-caught or poorly documented primates should be curbed. The minister replied that the NVWA checked documents and inspections found no irregularities, that the EU ban on wild-caught primates applies, and that she sees no need for a further ban though she welcomes the Dutch labs' commitment to domestic breeding.
Based on the protection of business and manufacturing data, I cannot provide the information on the number of monkeys.
Op grond van de bescherming van bedrijfs- en fabricagegegevens kan ik de informatie over het aantal apen niet verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het bericht dat er gebrek aan ruimte in de ondergrond is voor het aansluiten van wind- en zonneparken

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether a shortage of underground space for cables threatens connecting wind and solar projects, how long the problem has existed and what is being done. The minister acknowledged local scarcity, pointed to cable pooling and regional energy strategies, and declined to see a general under-recognition of the problem.
It is true that, depending on the local situation, a shortage of underground space for cables can arise.
Het is waar dat er afhankelijk van de lokale situatie schaarste kan ontstaan aan ruimte in de ondergrond voor kabels.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Moorlag over korten op de bijstand vanwege zonnepanelen

MPs asked whether returns from home solar panels count as means under the Participatiewet and could lead to benefit reductions, and whether municipalities differ in applying this. The State Secretary answered that such returns for private use are a saving on energy use, not income, so they do not affect benefit entitlement, while noting the ministry does not know whether municipalities take them into account.
Whether, and if so to what extent and in which municipalities, the return from solar panels is taken into account when assessing entitlement to benefit is not known to the Ministry of SZW.

Of en zo ja, in welke mate en bij welke gemeenten er bij de beoordeling van het recht op bijstand wél rekening wordt gehouden met de opbrengst van zonnepanelen is bij het Ministerie van SZW niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het dreigende verlies bij Postnned Stadskanaal

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about job losses among postal deliverers at franchisees of Sandd after the PostNL takeover, including whether deliverers of franchisees can be kept employed and whether the government will intervene. The State Secretary answered that PostNL offers Sandd deliverers employment and priority in applications, that franchisee staff fall outside the binding social arrangements, and that the government encourages PostNL and franchisees to talk about alternative work.
I am contacting the Association of Sandd Franchisees to see whether they can and will provide further data on the people working at the franchisees.
Ik treed met de Vereniging Franchisenemers Sandd in contact om te bezien of zij nadere gegevens kan en wil verschaffen over de mensen die bij de franchisenemers werken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het dreigende verlies van banen bij Sandd

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about hundreds of job losses at Sandd franchisees after Sandd is absorbed into PostNL, and whether the merger conditions and franchisees' legal protection could be changed. The State Secretary answered that the merger licence contains conditions protecting workers, that efficiency gains will likely cost some jobs, that no specific legal protection for franchisees exists, and that PostNL will be urged to talk with franchisees about alternative work.
I therefore do not intend to amend the conditions and restrictions attached to the licence under Article 47.
Ik ben dan ook niet voornemens om de voorschriften en beperkingen die zijn verbonden aan de vergunning op basis van artikel 47 aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over de moeizame aansluiting van zonnepanelen op het elektriciteitsnetwerk

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the difficulty of connecting solar panels for a football club in Nieuw Buinen, including grid capacity, the division of roles between the network operator and the ACM, and the risk of losing SDE+ subsidy. The minister said no connection can be guaranteed, pointed to a pending ACM exemption request and a general decree (AMvB) planned for 1 July 2020, and noted that the subsidy deadline can be extended by one year.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over een stijgende energierekening voor huishoudens

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about rising household energy bills, including whether TenneT's tariff increase would be passed on to households via regional grid operators. The minister confirmed that household network tariffs rise by about 5 euro per year in 2020, that TenneT's increase only reaches regional tariffs in 2022 under the current method, and that the ACM will review grid costs, while noting energy tax cuts offset the rise, though he declined to give the full 2022 impact.
At this moment it is therefore not possible to make statements about the overall development of network tariffs in 2022 and beyond.
Het is op dit moment dus niet mogelijk om uitspraken te doen over de totale ontwikkeling van de nettarieven in 2022 en daarna.
