Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over een eerlijke prijs voor voedsel

An MP asked the agriculture minister whether consumers should pay a fairer, environmentally priced price for meat with proceeds used to compensate low incomes and farmers, and whether cheaper vegetables and fruit would follow. The minister answered that a True Cost Accounting programme will study which instruments work, that information and awareness are emphasised over price, and that other parties will be invited to join the programme.
This summer the multi-year True Cost Accounting in Agri&Food programme started.
Deze zomer is het Meerjarenprogramma True Cost Accounting in Agri&Food van start gegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over handhaving van wet- en regelgeving, onder andere met betrekking tot kustvissers

MP Moorlag asked the ministers of Agriculture and Justice about enforcement of engine-power limits for coastal fishing vessels, following reports of tolerated overpowered engines and a 2019 EU study on electric-motor manipulation. Minister Schouten answered that inspections by NVWA, ILT and RVO take place year-round, that the government takes the EU study's signals seriously and will look at improving oversight, but withheld the internal protocols and signal details on control-technical grounds.
I take the signals identified in the report seriously, and based on the recommendations I will look at how oversight can also be improved for this type of engine.
De door het rapport geconstateerde signalen neem ik serieus, en op basis van de aanbevelingen ga ik kijken hoe toezicht ook voor dit type motoren kan worden verbeterd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het bericht dat vermeend schone stallen net zo vervuilend als traditionele stallen zouden zijn

An MP asked the agriculture minister whether CBS research showed that low-emission stables emit more ammonia than assumed, and what public subsidies went to such stables. The minister answered that low-emission floors for dairy cattle may not work well, that luchtwassers show no new indication of poor performance, that subsidies are withheld if techniques prove ineffective, and that the CDM advice and CBS report will be sent to parliament before year end.
I will share the CDM advice with your House before the end of the year.
Ik zal het CDM-advies voor het eind van het jaar met uw Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Nijboer over het verzekeren van zonnepanelen tegen hagelschade

PvdA MPs asked whether insurers dropping cover for invisible hail damage to solar panels leaves homeowners unprotected, and what the government will do about it. The Minister of Finance answered that some insurers have excluded this risk in their terms, that the share of uninsured owners is unknown, and that the matter is primarily for insurers and the market, with no concrete government action committed.
I consider this primarily a matter between insurers, market parties and owners of solar panels.
Ik beschouw dit primair als een zaak tussen verzekeraars, marktpartijen en eigenaren van zonnepanelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht 'Medewerkers onbeschermd blootgesteld aan landbouwgif'

MPs Moorlag and Gijs van Dijk asked about a broadcast report showing farm workers exposed to pesticides without protection, including inspection and enforcement figures, health studies, and whether the Labour Inspectorate has acted. The minister answers that the situation is unacceptable, cites NVWA inspection data for 2018, notes the Labour Inspectorate cannot establish violations from footage alone, and promises a Health Council advice on residents' health risks expected in summer 2020.
I have no information on whether the health of the workers involved in this case has been examined.
Ik heb geen informatie over het feit of de gezondheid van betrokken medewerkers in dit geval is onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over de gevolgen van stikstofcrisis voor projecten in olie- en gassector

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about reports that dozens of oil and gas projects have stalled due to the nitrogen crisis, and about the consequences for gas imports, the Groningen field phase-out and possible temporary exemptions. The minister confirmed at least 33 stalled projects, said the Groningen phase-out is not delayed, and outlined permitting routes and a forthcoming package of measures.
According to a list from NOGEPA, at least 33 projects are known to be stalling due to the nitrogen issue.
Uit opgave van NOGEPA blijkt dat voor zover nu bekend zeker 33 projecten stilvallen door de stikstofproblematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over de bescherming van consumenten bij een faillissement van een energieleverancier

An MP asked the ministers whether consumers have enough insight into an energy supplier's financial health, whether the regulator ACM can intervene earlier and stricter entry rules should apply, and whether consumers should be compensated from a guarantee fund after a supplier's bankruptcy. The minister answered that supply security is already guaranteed, that stricter licensing and supervision are being examined for the new Energy Act, and that a compensation fund is not proportionate given its risks.
This may lead to tightening of the licensing requirements and of ACM's supervision of them.
Dit zal mogelijk tot een aanscherping van de vergunningseisen en het toezicht door ACM daarop leiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over ‘de app Nextdoor’

An MP asked the ministers whether the neighbourhood app Nextdoor leaks data, whether the Data Protection Authority has started an investigation, whether police complaints were filed, and whether government should refrain from promoting such apps. The ministers acknowledged leak risks, declined to comment on the AP investigation and individual complaints, said government should be restrained in recommending privately developed apps, and declined to commission research into safer alternatives.
The Dutch Data Protection Authority has informed me that in principle it does not make statements about possible and ongoing investigations.
De Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens (AP) heeft mij bericht in beginsel geen uitspraken over mogelijke en lopende onderzoeken te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over het verband tussen landbouwgif en de ziekte van Parkinson

MPs Moorlag and Gijs van Dijk asked whether pesticide risks for Parkinson's disease are adequately assessed, whether moratoria, reporting duties, inspection checks and occupational-disease recognition should apply. The minister answered that EU approval procedures already test neurotoxicity, that the EU will be asked to strengthen procedures for neurological effects, and that a moratorium or reporting duty is unnecessary, while the inspectorate monitors risk-based and Parkinson's is not a recognised occupational disease in the Netherlands.
I support this recommendation and will ask the European Commission to take this up promptly.
Ik ondersteun deze aanbeveling en zal de Europese Commissie vragen dit voortvarend op te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over de mobiele slachthuizen

An MP from the PvdA asked the Minister of Agriculture about reports that NVWA staff see mobile slaughterhouses worsening animal suffering and withholding of veterinary care, and asked for an independent evaluation. The minister answered that the ongoing pilot evaluation covers these signals, that animal welfare must not be harmed, that the food safety inspection regime still applies, and that the evaluation will be finished soon and shared with parliament.
I have no information on how many NVWA employees share the concerns.
Ik heb geen informatie over hoeveel NVWA-medewerkers de zorgen delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het verdwijnen van XS4ALL

An MP asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about the planned disappearance of XS4ALL, its customers' concerns about losing high-quality service, and whether the government can guarantee that service and ease switching providers. The state secretary replied that the government lacks legal instruments to force telecom providers to continue specific services, relying on market forces and ACM regulation, and that the sector has been asked to agree on longer email forwarding periods.
I lack the legal instruments to force telecom companies to continue specific services.
Mij ontbreekt het wettelijk instrumentarium om telecompartijen te dwingen specifieke dienstverlening te continueren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over de verbetering van de spoorlijn naar Zandvoort

MPs Moorlag and Gijs van Dijk asked whether the rail upgrade to Zandvoort would proceed without the Formula 1 race, how it fits with the Council of State's PAS nitrogen ruling, whether nitrogen can be offset or an ADC-test applied, and who pays for the upgrade and nearby residents' noise concerns. The Secretary of State answered that the upgrade responds to a motion and is partly co-financed by the Rijk, that nitrogen permitting will be assessed only once a request is filed, that noise stays within existing limits, and that the Grand Prix organiser pays only event-specific costs.
Nitrogen deposition on rail mainly occurs during the construction of a project, such as from incoming freight traffic.
Stikstofdepositie komt bij spoor vooral voor bij de aanleg van een project, zoals door aanvoerend vrachtverkeer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het bericht ‘Netbeheer Nederland verwacht op veel meer plaatsen problemen met netcapaciteit’,

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate why grid operators may use reserve capacity for large projects but not for small initiatives such as VV Nieuw Buinen, and whether temporary use of reserve systems should be allowed for small projects. The minister answered that exemptions from the redundancy requirement are granted temporarily by the ACM regardless of project size, that a general exemption decree is planned for early 2020, and that a TenneT exemption application for the Stadskanaal area is pending.
The size of the project is not a determining factor in whether an exemption from the redundancy requirement is granted.
De grootte van het project is geen bepalende factor voor het wel of niet verlenen van een ontheffing van de redundantie-eis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over een onderzoek naar kernenergie als vermeend klimaatvriendelijke energievoorziening

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether the government agrees with a German DIW study concluding that nuclear power is too costly and dangerous to be a climate-friendly option, and asked about construction cost overruns, public financing, private plans for a Dutch plant and the policy stance. The minister rejected the study's conclusions, citing standardisation, recent cost-effectiveness analyses and the need to keep all low-carbon options open, while acknowledging cost overruns and that no private firm has concrete plans for a Dutch plant.
I also refer you to my recent answers to questions from Member Yeşilgöz-Zegerius (VVD), in which I indicate that the transition to low-CO2 energy production poses a major international challenge.

Ik verwijs u tevens naar mijn recente antwoorden op vragen van het lid Yeşilgöz-Zegerius (VVD) waarin ik aangeef, dat de overgang naar een CO 2 -arme energieproductie internationaal tot een grote opgave leidt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over een falend warmtepompsysteem in Duindorp

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether residents of Duindorp should bear costs from a failing experimental heat pump heat network, how they can secure reliable heating, and who is responsible for fixing faults. The minister answered that heat network users must be protected under the Warmtewet, that disputes go to the independent complaints committee, the ACM or the courts, and that the warmtepomp damage is not expressly compensated but the general supply obligation suffices.
It is for the complaints committee or, in case of rent, the Rent Tribunal, and ultimately the court, to rule on such conflicts and, related to that, on who is responsible for costs.

Het is aan de geschillencommissie of – ingeval van huur – de Huurcommissie en uiteindelijk aan de rechter om uitspraken te doen over dergelijke conflicten en in samenhang daarmee de vraag wie verantwoordelijk is voor kosten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over de gevolgen van een harde Brexit voor de Nederlandse werkgelegenheid.

MPs Moorlag and Gijs van Dijk asked whether the government would take extra measures, such as short-time work, to cushion a hard Brexit's job losses, after a KU Leuven study estimated 73,200 Dutch jobs at risk. The ministers replied that existing contingency measures, support tools and social security are sufficient, that the study has important caveats, and that the government will not intervene in UK policy.
For these reasons, the cabinet currently sees no reason to deploy additional instruments to absorb the negative consequences of a no-deal Brexit.
Het kabinet ziet om die redenen op dit moment geen aanleiding voor de inzet van additionele instrumenten om de negatieve gevolgen van een no deal Brexit op te vangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het betalen van invoerrechten en btw voor pakketjes die aan de deur worden afgeleverd

MP Moorlag asked the State Secretary how PostNL may refuse universal postal service under the Postal Act and whether people with disabilities who must collect parcels at PostNL points, to pay import duties and VAT, are adequately served, and whether a home-delivery request option is possible. The State Secretary answered that PostNL is exploring home delivery via an online payment pilot, that the one-stop-shop portal will later help, that PostNL's general terms are checked by the Consumentenbond, and that the broad network of over 3,000 points is accessible to people with disabilities.
PostNL is investigating the possibilities to still deliver postal items to the home address of addressees.
PostNL onderzoekt de mogelijkheden om poststukken alsnog af te leveren op het huisadres van geadresseerden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Nijboer over mijnbouwactiviteiten in het waddengebied

MPs Moorlag and Nijboer asked whether the government shares concerns about mining in the Wadden Sea World Heritage area, whether UNESCO's letter signals concern, and whether a moratorium on new mining is needed. Minister Wiebes replied that strict conditions, monitoring and an independent audit committee apply, that UNESCO's letter is a standard procedural request, and that no moratorium is considered necessary.
Nederland expects to send the reply letter to UNESCO in September 2019. The Minister of LNV will inform your House about this.
Naar verwachting zal Nederland de antwoordbrief aan UNESCO in september 2019 versturen. Uw Kamer zal hierover door de Minister van LNV worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Moorlag over de gevolgen van lachgasgebruik voor het Klimaat

PvdA MPs asked whether recreational nitrous oxide use and its climate impact are known to users and how much it adds to emissions. The government answered that users are not aware of the climate effects, estimated the emissions as small relative to national totals, and said a risk assessment due in November will guide any health measures, while no specific climate policy is planned.
Pending the advice, the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport is examining various policy options so that appropriate national measures can be taken quickly once the assessment is final.

In afwachting van het advies worden door het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport diverse beleidsopties bekeken zodat wanneer de beoordeling definitief is, snel passende landelijke maatregelen kunnen worden getroffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Ploumen over de aanpak van de overlast door de eikenprocessierups

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers how the government will tackle the large-scale nuisance from the oak processionary caterpillar, including whether a national approach is needed. The minister acknowledges the increased nuisance, points to a new knowledge platform and RIVM/GGD information, and states that municipalities bear a duty of care, so the response is decentralised, with the ministry providing national coordination.

At national level I also take the lead, among other things through knowledge dissemination, research that is being set up and carried out, and sharing insights on controlling the oak processionary caterpillar.

Landelijk wordt ook regie genomen door mij, onder andere via kennisverspreiding, onderzoek dat wordt opgezet en uitgevoerd en het delen van inzichten ten aanzien van de bestrijding van de eikenprocessierups.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het betalen van invoerrechten en btw aan de deur

An MP asked why PostNL only lets recipients collect parcels with import duties or VAT at a PostNL location rather than paying at the door, and whether this conflicts with universal postal access rules. The state secretary confirmed the policy, citing efficiency and courier safety, and maintained that PostNL's conditions comply with the Postal Act 2009 and universal service remains accessible.
PostNL is therefore not acting in breach of laws and regulations.
PostNL handelt hiermee niet in strijd met wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Ploumen over de voorgenomen uitbreiding van een geitenhouderij in Hurwenen

MPs Moorlag and Ploumen asked whether the expansion of a goat farm in Hurwenen from 7,000 to over 13,000 goats was acceptable, given a RIVM link to pneumonia risk, and whether the minister would impose a national expansion ban or intervene in this case. The minister replied that land-use and environmental decisions rest with municipalities and provinces, that a flawed permit application led to the permit being granted by operation of law, that follow-up health research is expected in 2021, and that no national ban is being considered.
The municipality concerned acknowledged, according to the Zembla broadcast, that the permit application was not handled properly and that errors were made.
De betreffende gemeente heeft, blijkens de uitzending van het programma Zembla, erkend dat op de vergunningaanvraag niet goed is gereageerd en dat er fouten zijn gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het bericht dat Google de Android-licentie voor Huawei intrekt

MP Moorlag asked the State Secretary whether Google's revocation of Huawei's Android licence would degrade or stop updates on existing Huawei phones, whether this breaches consumer contracts, what the ACM could do, and how consumers can be informed. The State Secretary answered that Huawei expects no loss of functionality or security updates for existing devices, that any non-conformity would be a matter for the seller and ultimately the courts, that the ACM sees no consumer-law violation, and that sellers must inform buyers.
From this it appears that no consequences are foreseen for the functionality for current owners of Huawei phones.
Hieruit blijkt dat er geen gevolgen worden voorzien ten aanzien van de functionaliteit voor huidige bezitters van Huawei-telefoons.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het aantal gehouden varkens in Nederland over fraude met dierproductierechten van varkens

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about reports that more pigs are kept in the Netherlands than permitted, a gap between Dutch and German export figures, and whether the animal production rights enforcement system works. The minister replied that no central pig registry exists and disputed the Varkens in Nood conclusions, attributed export discrepancies to data-source issues and TRACES/I&R mismatches, and maintained that the system functions well with criminal enforcement.
I am of the opinion that the system of animal production rights functions well.
Ik ben van oordeel dat het stelsel van dierproductierechten goed functioneert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Van den Hul over problemen door het krimpend frequentiespectrum

MPs Moorlag and Van den Hul asked whether the government knows that shrinking radio spectrum, from 4G/5G expansion and the loss of the 700 MHz band for PMSE users from 2020, will harm media production, events and public broadcasting, and whether promised support for PMSE was delivered. The State Secretary acknowledged the problem, described coordination measures, a joint action plan with the sector, alternative frequency bands and a licensed shared access pilot, while stating that the consequences are being managed in ongoing consultation.
On possible consequences and solutions, my ministry and Agentschap Telecom are in ongoing consultation with the sector.
Over mogelijke gevolgen en oplossingen zijn mijn ministerie en Agentschap Telecom in voortdurend overleg met de sector.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Kuiken over een Europees beroepsverbod

MPs Moorlag and Kuiken asked whether foreign occupational bans can be used in Bibob integrity screening, whether stakeholders can force a Bibob check and challenge refusals in court, and whether improper animal treatment can factor into environmental permit decisions. The minister answered that foreign criminal and administrative sanctions can be considered in Bibob screening, that initiating a Bibob check is discretionary and not appealable, and that animal welfare falls outside environmental protection but criminal animal offences can ground a permit refusal.
Whether or not to apply the Bibob Act is a discretionary power of the administrative body concerned.
Het al dan niet toepassen van de Wet Bibob is een discretionaire bevoegdheid van het betreffende bestuursorgaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over de aanleg van een stroomstation in Voorne-Putten

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether a large converter station and underground cable at Biert in Voorne-Putten, which residents say would harm the landscape, is appropriate, and how the location was chosen and whether industrial sites and local views were considered. The minister confirmed the plans, explained a broad exploration of 25 cable routes and 10 connection sites, and said Simonshaven and Maasvlakte were selected for further study in a Rijkscoördinatieregeling procedure, with regional authorities to advise on a preferred option and landscape integration to be weighed before a spatial decision.
I will give the authorities in the region the opportunity to advise me on a preferred alternative following the IEA.
Ik zal de overheden in de regio de gelegenheid geven mij naar aanleiding van de IEA te adviseren over een voorkeursalternatief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over ongewenste post

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about unwanted unaddressed advertising mail, including whether an opt-in system should be introduced and whether 'aan de bewoners van' mail should be treated as unaddressed. The State Secretary defended the current opt-out system, rejected opt-in and the stricter treatment of such mail, and said talks with the Consumentenbond and Postfilter.nl are ongoing.
I am confident these talks will produce results and at this moment see no reason to reconsider my position.
Ik heb er vertrouwen in dat deze gesprekken resultaat zullen opleveren en zie op dit moment dan ook geen reden om mijn standpunt te heroverwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher en Moorlag over de kabinetsplannen over het klimaatbeleid

PvdA MPs Asscher and Moorlag asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about reports that a draft CO2 levy would largely exempt industry, whether industry would receive the revenue back, and related questions on the Climate Agreement, household energy burdens and planning bureau analyses. The minister answered that the levy is still being explored and that industry revenue will be used to green industry, but refused to send the internal draft note to parliament and gave only general responses on the other points.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer, Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over blazers van ESD

MPs asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about recurring 'blazers' (emission flares) at the ESD factory in Groningen, including carcinogenic particle emissions, public health risks, unclear public information, and what will be done to reduce blazers and stop illegal emissions. The government answered that the province of Groningen, as competent authority, is responsible for enforcement, that health risks from SiC fibres are still under investigation, that a dwangsom (penalty) was imposed for SiC emissions, and that communication was handled by the Veiligheidsregio and municipality.
In this case, the province of Groningen is responsible for enforcement as the competent authority.
In dit geval is de provincie Groningen als bevoegd gezag verantwoordelijk voor de handhaving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer, Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over blazers van ESD

MPs asked about a RIVM advice on silicon carbide fibres and emissions from ESD-SIC near Farsum, and whether a risk limit for air will be set quickly. The state secretary confirmed SiC fibres should be treated as carcinogenic (ZZS), said the company and province must minimise emissions, and explained that RIVM found too little data for an air limit, so amphibole asbestos is used as a worst-case screening value, with a full standard depending on further information and a timeline not given.
RIVM indicated in its advice that there is currently too little data to derive an MTR for SiC fibres.
Het RIVM heeft in haar advies aangegeven dat er op dit moment te weinig gegevens zijn om een MTR voor SiC-vezels af te kunnen leiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het rapport ‘ Epilepsie bij Sint Bernards‘

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a report on epilepsy in St Bernards, including whether breeding practices and the Dutch St Bernard club's approval of carriers cause animal suffering and whether enforcement of breeding rules will be applied. The minister agreed breeding carries a considerable epilepsy risk, said breeders bear primary responsibility and that rearing clubs and the Raad van Beheer will adjust breeding policy, and said the NVWA sets enforcement priorities risk-based without committing to new oversight of St Bernard breeders.
I am of the view that a breeder must do everything to prevent hereditary defects from being passed on, and this is also laid down in regulations.
Ik ben van mening dat een fokker er alles aan moet doen om te voorkomen dat erfelijke gebreken worden overgedragen en dat is ook vastgelegd in regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Moorlag over een breed plan voor technisch onderwijs dat volgens ondernemersorganisatie Techniek Nederland nu nodig is

Two PvdA MPs asked the education and economic affairs ministers how they view Techniek Nederland's call for a broad technical education plan, including hybrid teachers and hybrid programmes. The minister acknowledged the need for technical skills, said youth unemployment is low, welcomed hybrid teaching in principle, referred to existing measures and the Techniekpact, and said the ministry would keep talking with industry without committing to adopt the proposals.
This cabinet therefore considers it important to support schools by improving the transitions between primary education, secondary education, secondary vocational education and higher education.

Dit kabinet vindt het dan ook van belang om scholen te ondersteunen door het verbeteren van de overgangen tussen primair onderwijs, voortgezet onderwijs, middelbaar beroepsonderwijs en hoger onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Moorlag en Agnes Mulder over de miljoenen waardedaling van huizen door windparken

MPs Beckerman, Moorlag and Agnes Mulder asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about property value losses near wind farms, the adequacy of the planning damage scheme, the Rijkscoördinatieregeling (RCR) limiting local participation, and profit-sharing with residents. The Minister defended the existing independent planning damage procedure, promised to update the VU study and reconsider how wind areas are designated, and said participation and ownership shares will be addressed in the Klimaatakkoord framework without legally enforcing some transparency demands.
I will consult with the VU to give substance to the update.
Ik zal in overleg treden met de VU om invulling te geven aan de actualisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het al dan niet invoeren van een CO2-heffing voor de industrie

MP Moorlag (PvdA) asked Minister Wiebes whether he had told industry representatives that no generic CO2 levy would be introduced, and whether the proposed bonus-malus scheme swap was merely cosmetic. The minister confirmed a meeting with about 35 industry representatives on the cabinet's announced measures, said he did not hold a transcript, forwarded the request for one to VNO-NCW, and stated the cabinet will introduce a 'sensible and objective' CO2 levy in place of the bonus-malus system, which PBL found insufficiently effective.
Neither I nor the staff involved have a report of this meeting.
Noch ik, noch de betrokken medewerkers beschikken over een verslag van deze bijeenkomst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Moorlag over het bericht dat vaginaal douchen schade oplevert bij vrouwen

MPs Ploumen and Moorlag asked whether vaginal douching products that claim health benefits, and that can cause harm, should be acted upon and whether more public information is needed. The minister says existing guidance already advises against douching, that the IGJ and NVWA have received almost no complaints, and that no further measures are currently warranted.
I currently see no reason to take further measures.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om nadere maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Nijboer over hinderlijke regelgeving voor de uitrol van zonnepanelen door woningbouwcorporaties

Two PvdA MPs asked whether Woningwet rules that restrict housing corporations from installing solar panels and feeding surplus energy into the grid hinder sustainability goals, and whether corporations should get SDE+ subsidy. The minister confirmed the current limits, said corporations are eligible for SDE+ if they meet conditions, and committed to amend the Woningwet after the evaluation to allow more sustainability measures.
I intend to include these adjustments in the legislative amendments following the evaluation of the revised Housing Act.
Ik ben voornemens om deze aanpassingen mee te nemen in de wetswijzigingen naar aanleiding van de evaluatie van de herziene Woningwet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over ongewenste post

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about unaddressed advertising mail, whether consumers should be able to refuse it, and whether an opt-in system like the one planned for telemarketing should be introduced. The State Secretary replied that existing sticker, register and right-of-objection options are adequate and that no opt-in regime is planned for advertising mail.
As I explained in the answer to question 5, I currently see no reason to introduce an opt-in system for advertising mail or to take other measures.
Zoals ik in het antwoord op vraag 5 heb toegelicht, zie ik op dit moment geen aanleiding om voor reclamepost een opt-in systeem te introduceren, of andere maatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het bericht ‘Keurmerktrammelant’

An MP asked the ministers about the proliferation of food labels and certification marks in supermarkets, whether they are trustworthy, and whether government regulation or a single state-set health logo is needed. The government answered that existing rules suffice, pointed to a Milieu Centraal benchmark and campaign, and said a government-backed food-choice logo is planned by 2020.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Ploumen over een keurmerk voor voedsel

MPs Moorlag and Ploumen asked whether the government would adopt the Nutriscore food labelling system, citing a Consumentenbond survey of snacks. The Secretary of State said the government is still comparing European logos and running consumer research, will decide after summer and no later than end 2019, and gave no commitment to Nutriscore.
I expect to inform you after the summer, but no later than the end of 2019, about the outcomes of the studies and my decision on the new food choice logo.
Ik verwacht u na de zomer, maar uiterlijk eind 2019 te kunnen informeren over de uitkomsten van de onderzoeken en mijn beslissing over het nieuwe voedselkeuzelogo.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Ploumen over landbouwgif in Drenthe

Two MPs asked the ministers whether residents near lily cultivation in Drenthe should be concerned about 57 pesticides found in soil and vegetables, and whether the government would investigate health risks and cumulative effects. The minister acknowledged residents' concern, stated that all measured levels stayed below safe thresholds, and pointed to ongoing OBO exposure research and a Gezondheidsraad advisory request, without committing to new limits.
The cabinet will ask the Health Council to include this issue in its advice, as announced in the letter to the House of 10 April.
Het kabinet zal de Gezondheidsraad vragen om dit vraagstuk te betrekken in hun advies, zoals aangekondigd in de brief aan uw Kamer van 10 april jl.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag, Ploumen en Nijboer over het bericht ‘Westerveld hoopt op snelle publicatie van RIVM rapport’

MPs Moorlag, Ploumen and Nijboer asked about a news report on Westerveld hoping for quick publication of a RIVM report on pesticide exposure, when it was completed, and what legal tools municipalities have to protect residents from pesticide exposure via zoning. The minister answered that the RIVM reports were sent to the House on 10 April, and that municipalities can use zoning plans and the precautionary principle to set buffer zones, with about 50 metres a commonly accepted rule of thumb, while the exposure study shows no unacceptable risk at that distance.
Yes, this is possible and is already happening.
Ja, dit kan en vindt ook al plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over mogelijke geluidsoverlast van een transformatorstation van TenneT

Two Labour MPs asked the ministers whether a TenneT transformer station in the IJmond industrial area could cause noise nuisance in Wijk aan Zee and whether a fully enclosed box should be required. The minister acknowledged concerns, stated the noise contribution is under 2 percent of cumulative noise, and said TenneT will take extra noise-reducing measures including enclosing the transformers with walls and a roof, while the compensation coils remain open at the top.
In these talks the commitment was made to noise-reducing measures, including placing the transformers in a "box".
In deze gesprekken is de toezegging gedaan tot geluidreducerende maatregelen, waaronder het plaatsen van de transformatoren in een «box».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Moorlag en Nijboer over meer banen in Oost-Groningen

MPs from the PvdA asked ministers whether the Opiumwet's ban on industrial use of hemp tops, which blocks CBD extraction at HempFlax in Oost-Groningen, should be relaxed to create jobs, and how Germany regulates this. The minister answered that the law only exempts fibre hemp for fibre or seed, that the juridical options are still being explored, and that talks with the businesses will follow.
At this moment I am exploring the legal possibilities.
Op dit moment ben ik de juridische mogelijkheden aan het verkennen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag, Kuiken en Gijs van Dijk over de gevolgen van het faillissement van Intertoys

MPs Moorlag, Kuiken and Gijs van Dijk asked about reports that the owner of bankrupt Intertoys, as a pledge-holding creditor, would be paid ahead of other creditors, whether this shifts business risk onto the tax authority, UWV and staff, and how workers would be helped. The minister said the specific case is for the curator and courts, explained generally how pledges give priority, said the matter is being examined in the bankruptcy law review, and described UWV information sessions and support for workers.
It is not for me to comment on a specific practical situation.
Het is niet aan mij om in te gaan op een specifieke praktijksituatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Moorlag over het bericht over legitimatieplicht voor verzenders van postpakketten

MPs Kuiken and Moorlag asked about a proposed identification requirement for senders of parcels, following a Taskforce Brabant-Zeeland call, and whether existing measures against drug trafficking via post are adequate. The Minister answers that existing measures (drug-dog checks, sensing, public-private cooperation with PostNL and other carriers) are part of an integrated approach, and that an ID requirement is not proportionate given parcel volumes, privacy and administrative burden.
Given the total volume of parcel post, the intrusion on privacy and the increase in administrative burden, we consider an identification requirement not proportionate to combat drug crime.

Een legitimatieplicht achten wij gelet op het totale volume aan pakketpost, de inbreuk op de privacy en de verzwaring van de administratieve lasten niet proportioneel om drugscriminaliteit tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Moorlag over de verzending van drugs via brievenpost

MPs Kuiken and Moorlag asked whether the government knows how much drugs are mailed from the Netherlands by letter post, whether Dutch businesses and individuals are being misused as senders, whether the Postinterventieteam acts on letter post, and how innocent recipients can avoid being treated as suspects. The Minister answered that volumes are unknown and being studied with partners, that letter post is not structurally checked, that interventions such as taking down darknet sites are desirable, and that people receiving unsolicited drugs should report them to police.
The cabinet is considering with its partners whether the nature and scale can be mapped.
Het kabinet bekijkt met de partners of de aard en omvang in kaart is te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Asscher inzake het bericht “Met nieuwe PBL-cijfers daalt CO2-boete naar nul”

Two MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether, under the proposed bonus-malus system for industrial CO2 emissions, industry would pay no fine at current ETS price forecasts, and why the industry table did not use updated PBL price projections. The minister confirmed the malus could fall to zero at high ETS prices, said a new CO2 levy proposal would follow, and acknowledged citizens' concerns about energy and climate policy costs.
Once the decision-making on this proposal is complete, I will inform the House about it.
Zodra de besluitvorming over dit voorstel is afgerond zal ik de Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Moorlag over de gevolgen van faillissementen van energiebedrijven voor consumenten

An MP asked the minister about consumer losses from energy supplier bankruptcies (Robin Energie, EnergieFlex), whether a guarantee fund should be created, and whether consumer protection should be strengthened. The minister said supply continuity and licensing with financial checks already protect consumers, and rejected a guarantee fund for risk-shifting and cost reasons while promising to examine extra licensing requirements and monitoring in the Energiewet 1.0.

I have no information about the average amount customers of the bankrupt energy companies Robin Energie and Energieflex may have lost, and I have no insight into how the estates of both bankrupt companies are distributed.

Ik heb geen informatie over het gemiddelde bedrag dat de klanten van de inmiddels failliete energiebedrijven Robin Energie en Energieflex mogelijk zijn misgelopen en ik heb geen inzicht in de boedelverdeling van de beide failliete bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over de voortdurende belemmeringen die de aansluiting van kleinschalige duurzame energieprojecten op het elektriciteitsnetwerk blokkeren

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about grid connection bottlenecks blocking small renewable projects, such as a football club's solar panels, and about giving priority to small initiatives and local ownership. The minister said the grid operator must act non-discriminatorily, that work on connection-capacity solutions is ongoing with ACM and grid operators, and that the local 50% ownership target is a general aim still being worked out.
Together with ACM and grid operators, I am working on solution directions for the bottlenecks around connection and transport capacity.
Samen met ACM en netbeheerders werk ik aan oplossingsrichtingen uit voor de knelpunten rondom de aansluit- en transportcapaciteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Moorlag over de grafietregen bij Wijk aan Zee

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Moorlag asked the state secretary and ministers about graphite dust nuisance from Tata Steel and Harsco near Wijk aan Zee, the status of the criminal investigation, and what could be done to end the nuisance. The government answered that the province of Noord-Holland is the competent authority with enforcement instruments, that Harsco was ordered under a penalty to stop the emissions, that it will not comment on ongoing criminal investigations, and that it will send a letter to parliament around May.
As you know, the cabinet does not make statements about ongoing criminal investigations.
Zoals u bekend is doet het kabinet geen uitspraken over lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over de aanleg van glasvezel op het platteland

An MP asked the state secretary about fibre roll-out in rural areas, competition concerns with KPN, whether law should favour whole-municipality plans, and whether competition rules should be relaxed for local initiatives. The state secretary answered that the market decides where fibre is laid, that no change to competition law is needed, that EU state-aid rules will be eased for local authorities, and pointed to an action plan with an annual progress report to parliament.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over het vervangen van asbestdaken voor zonnepanelen

PvdA MPs Moorlag and Gijs van Dijk asked whether projects like Essent's 'Dakvrienden', where an energy company funds asbestos roof removal in exchange for solar panels, should be encouraged and extended to farms and private homeowners. Minister Wiebes replied that the government supports combining asbestos removal with sustainability, will examine whether support is needed, and that such private-homeowner models are for energy companies to consider, noting solar is not profitable on every roof.
Initiatives that combine the removal of asbestos roofs with sustainability are shared as good examples within the programmatic approach, and it is being examined whether support is needed.

Initiatieven die het saneren van asbestdaken combineren met verduurzaming worden in het kader van de programmatische aanpak gedeeld als goed voorbeeld en er wordt onderzocht of ondersteuning nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het bericht dat de productie van de Mini naar Nederland verplaatst zou kunnen gaan worden

An MP asked the economy minister whether Nederland should pursue relocation of MINI production from the UK to the Netherlands after a BMW executive hinted at this in a no-deal Brexit scenario, and what tools exist to attract such investment. The minister said Brexit is negative for the Dutch economy but acquisition opportunities exist, described NFIA support for foreign investors, and declined to speculate on Brexit outcomes while promising to act if concrete opportunities arise.
I will not speculate on the outcome of the Brexit negotiations and the consequences companies attach to them.
Ik ga niet speculeren over de uitkomst van de Brexit-onderhandelingen en de consequenties die bedrijven daar aan verbinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over de consumentenbescherming ingeval van faillissement van een bedrijf dat cadeaukaarten uitgeeft

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about consumer protection when a gift card issuer goes bankrupt, following the Intertoys case where customers redeemed vouchers during a computer outage. The State Secretary said gift card holders are ordinary creditors, rejected giving them priority or mandatory separate accounts, noting that electronic money institutions must safeguard balances while smaller non-EGI issuers fall outside the Wft and voluntary measures are preferred.
A statutory obligation is not necessary in my view at this time, because the current situation provides sufficient consumer protection.
Een wettelijke verplichting vind ik op dit moment niet nodig, omdat de huidige situatie voorziet in voldoende bescherming van de consument.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Kuiken over het bericht ‘Notarissen staken jarenlang kadastergeld in eigen zak’

MPs Moorlag and Kuiken asked about reports that notaries charged clients for cadastral fees and levies never actually incurred, and whether this is widespread, unlawful, and whether clients should be refunded. The Minister replied that the disciplinary judge has ruled on the conduct without imposing a sanction, that no structural problem is known so no estimate can be made, that the matter is for the civil court on undue payment, and that the bar association has urged notaries to compensate clients, which the Minister supports.
It is for the disciplinary judge to assess the conduct of a (candidate) notary and to impose measures where appropriate.
Het is aan de tuchtrechter om te oordelen over het handelen van een (kandidaat-)notaris en eventueel maatregelen op te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Moorlag over het bericht ‘Kritiek op Booking.com om aanbieden van bedden in Israëlische nederzettingen’

MPs Van den Hul and Moorlag asked the government whether Booking.com's listing of accommodations in Israeli settlements contributes to rights violations, whether the company meets the UN Guiding Principles, and what sanctions apply to misleading information. The government answered that businesses bear their own responsibility under OECD guidelines, that the ACM supervises misleading-practice rules, and that Booking.com has committed to labelling settlement accommodations as 'Israeli settlement'.
It is up to companies themselves to decide which activities they undertake and to account for them.
Het is aan bedrijven zelf om te bepalen welke activiteiten zij ontplooien en daar verantwoording over af te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over de Big Brother Award voor de Kamer van Koophandel

An MP asked the state secretary whether the Chamber of Commerce may be required by law to supply business data, including bulk lists sold to third parties, and whether sole traders and legal entities should be shielded from unwanted telemarketing. The secretary answered that the law obliges public register data to be supplied on request, that he will restrict disclosure of home addresses for unincorporated sole traders per a motion, and that legal-entity businesses need no special telemarketing protection.
I consider it desirable to restrict the statutory obligation to supply certain data.
Ik acht het wenselijk om de wettelijke verplichting voor de levering van bepaalde gegevens te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het bericht dat sportclubs tegenwerking ervaren bij verduurzaming

An MP asks whether uncertainty about the replacement of net metering (salderingsregeling) and the timing of a new support scheme is deterring sports clubs from investing in solar panels, and what the government will do. The minister acknowledges the need for certainty, says a concrete proposal is targeted for Q1 2019 with a start on 1 January 2021, and says the sports-sector consultation will be handled by another minister.
It is my aim to present a concrete worked-out proposal for the transformation of the net metering scheme by the end of the first quarter of 2019.
Het is mijn streven om aan het einde van het eerste kwartaal van 2019 met een concreet uitgewerkt voorstel voor de omvorming van de salderingsregeling te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over de berichten ‘Waarschuwing: geen nieuwe zonneparken, het net kan het niet aan’ en ‘Groot probleem: voetbalclub wil zonnepanelen maar krijgt deksel op neus‘

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about grid capacity shortages blocking solar projects and a football club's solar installation, and whether the EDS subsidy's one-year realisation rule is unfair. The minister acknowledged the problem, said the ministry is examining solutions with ACM and grid operators, and noted extensions are possible in exceptional cases and the club may use the successor BOSA scheme.
I am examining with ACM and the grid operators which solution is appropriate for timely investment and whether the regulations should be changed for that.
Ik onderzoek met ACM en de netbeheerders welke oplossing passend is voor tijdig investeren en of de regelgeving daarvoor gewijzigd moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het tekort aan aansluitcapaciteit voor duurzame energie-initiatieven

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about grid connection shortages hindering renewable energy projects, including whether small rooftop solar should get priority over large commercial farmland projects. The minister acknowledged the grid strain, outlined planned investments and locality checks via Regional Energy Strategies, defended technology-neutral SDE+ allocation, and declined a priority rule for small projects citing non-discrimination law.
Grid operators currently may not distinguish between applicants; they may not discriminate, in accordance with Article 23(2) of the Electricity Act 1998.
Netbeheerders mogen nu geen onderscheid maken tussen aanvragers, zij mogen niet discrimineren, conform artikel 23, tweede lid, Elektriciteitswet 1998.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Ploumen over beperking van de geitenhouderij

MPs Moorlag and Ploumen asked whether provinces restricting goat farming, which may push farms into other provinces, call for national policy such as a national settlement ban or herd cap, given the health risks. The minister answered that eight provinces have temporary bans on new or expanded stables under the precautionary principle, that municipalities and provinces may set their own conditions, and that no national ban or cap is being considered until the cause of the elevated pneumonia risk is found, with follow-up research due in 2020.
A national settlement ban or a national maximum on the number of goats is not being considered at this time for that reason.
Een nationaal vestigingsverbod of een nationaal maximum aan het aantal geiten wordt om die reden op dit moment niet overwogen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Nijboer over de aardbeving in het zoutwinningsgebied bij Veendam

MPs Moorlag and Nijboer asked whether the government is studying the effects of a 1.3 magnitude quake near Veendam on salt caverns, whether gas-induced quakes could cause collapse or leakage, whether salt mining should be reconsidered, and whether the precautionary principle requires ending salt mining. Minister Wiebes answered that such a small quake is not expected to harm the caverns, that risks were assessed by SodM and TNO, that licences need not be reconsidered now, and that new knowledge would lead to additional conditions where warranted.

If new insights arise about the risks of salt mining, I will examine whether this gives reason to impose additional conditions on mining plans, and SodM will supervise whether the companies concerned take adequate measures.

Als nieuwe inzichten ontstaan over de risico's van zoutwinning, dan zal ik bezien of dit aanleiding geeft tot het stellen van aanvullende voorwaarden voor winningsplannen en zal SodM toezien op het nemen van adequate maatregelen door de betreffende bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over de gestegen kosten voor het gebruik van warmte

MP Moorlag asks the minister whether heat tariffs rising in 2019 due to coupling to gas prices and energy taxes should be decoupled, arguing this penalises heat-network customers who do not use gas. The minister rejects decoupling for now, keeps the gas reference for maximum heat tariffs, relies on ACM's return monitoring to correct excessive returns, and commissions research on alternatives for the next Heat Act amendment.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over ouderen die geen gebruik kunnen maken van een gunstige financiering van energiebesparingsmaatregelen

An MP asked whether people aged 75 and over can access the Energiebespaarlening and whether this age limit should be lifted given ageing and the energy transition. The minister explained the age limit of 76 applies to the youngest applicant and that some provinces guarantee loans above 75, and said extending access for older homeowners without equity is being examined in the financing fund work.

Because it is important that older people without equity can also take part in the energy transition, I am examining what options there are to better facilitate them in pre-financing sustainability measures.

Omdat het belangrijk is dat ook ouderen zonder overwaarde mee kunnen doen aan de energietransitie, bekijk ik wat de mogelijkheden zijn om hen beter te faciliteren bij de voorfinanciering van verduurzaming.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Yesilgöz-Zegerius over stimuleringsmaatregelen voor zonnecel-dakpannen

MPs Moorlag and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked which subsidies, tax reductions and other incentives exist for solar-roof tiles beyond VAT recovery, and whether such incentives apply to them. The minister replied that the SDE+, net metering and innovation schemes apply, and that he knows of no obstacles to incentivising solar tiles.
As far as I am aware, there are no obstacles to incentivising solar energy from roof tiles under the various incentive measures.
Voor zover ik weet zijn er geen belemmeringen voor de stimulering van zonne-energie uit dakpannen in de verschillende stimuleringsmaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Moorlag over het bericht dat criminelen misbruik maken van pakketbezorgers PostNL

MPs Kuiken and Moorlag asked about reports that criminals exploit PostNL parcel delivery, the cooperation with police, prosecutors and tax authorities, intimidation of couriers, unlicensed courier firms, and whether subcontractor pay drives violations. The government describes the PIT team and seizures, notes the RIEC pilot, says licensing thresholds stay unchanged and that PostNL and subcontractors set their own terms, while liability for wage violations exists under existing law.
No information is given about further outcomes of this approach or follow-up in individual cases.
Over verdere uitkomsten van deze werkwijze en opvolging daarvan in individuele gevallen worden geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Moorlag over woningcorporaties die het moeilijk wordt gemaakt om te verduurzamen

MPs Nijboer and Moorlag asked whether the minister agrees with the Autoriteit Woningcorporaties' rejection of Groninger Huis joining a solar park, and how sustainability goals can be met if such initiatives are blocked. The minister declined to comment on the individual case (under court review), said the Woningwet's proximity rule is assessed case by case, and promised an evaluation of the Woningwet in early 2019 that will examine obstacles to housing-corporation sustainability.
As legislator, it is not for BZK to respond to individual cases.
Als wetgever is het niet aan BZK om te reageren op individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over een boekhoudkundige truc om aan openbaarmaking van de jaarrekening te ontkomen

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the Blokker family evades annual accounts disclosure by periodically inserting a new parent company above HB Capital, and whether this should be closed off. The government answered that a subsidiary's publication duty only lapses if the parent publishes consolidated accounts and files a 403 declaration, that the transparency rules still apply, and that it sees no loophole requiring legislative change.
As appears from the answers above, I see no loophole in the law.
Zoals blijkt uit de bovenstaande antwoorden, zie ik geen maas in de wet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Nijboer over de overslaginstallatie van het bedrijf Noordgastransport in Roodeschool

MPs Moorlag and Nijboer asked the minister to relocate the gas condensate transshipment facility out of the centre of Roodeschool, citing livability and fairness for Groningen. The minister agreed the facility is undesirable there and offered renewed talks, but said the operator holds valid permits, the risks do not justify forced relocation, and no compensation from gas revenues will be earmarked.
I am willing to re-engage in talks with the company and the municipality about an alternative.
Ik ben bereid opnieuw het gesprek met het bedrijf en de gemeente aan te gaan over een alternatief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over dreigende acties bij Tennet

An MP asked the minister about a collective bargaining impasse at TenneT, the state-owned grid operator, and possible strike actions threatening supply security. The minister answered that TenneT seeks its own company CAO, that the state as shareholder has no formal role in collective bargaining, and that safety consultations will precede any action to protect supply.
Collective bargaining is a matter between employer and employees. The shareholder has no formal role in this.
Cao-onderhandelingen zijn een zaak tussen werkgever en werknemer. De aandeelhouder heeft hierbij geen formele rol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over de gevolgen van een faillissement van een energieleverancier voor consumenten

An MP asked the minister about consumer consequences when energy supplier EnergieFlex went bankrupt, including whether prepaid advances are privileged, the Consumentenbond's role and liability, the licence withdrawal timing, and whether solvency requirements or a guarantee fund should apply. The minister answered that consumers have no preferential creditor status, that customers were transferred to another supplier under the security-of-supply decrees, that Consumentenbond liability is a matter for contract law, and that solvency is checked only at licensing.
The handling of the EnergieFlex bankruptcy is still ongoing.
De afhandeling van het faillissement van EnergieFlex loopt nog.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het gebruik van gegevens uit registers van de Kamer van Koophandel voor telemarketing

An MP asked the State Secretary whether unwanted telemarketing using Chamber of Commerce register data should be curbed, including refusal of data release, opt-out options and enforcement cooperation. The State Secretary said the register is public by law, pointed to privacy regulators and the Bel-me-niet register, announced a forthcoming opt-in proposal and more coordination with the Chamber and regulators.
I am considering balanced measures that limit unwanted direct marketing using commercial register data, while safeguarding the openness of the register for its statutory purposes.

Ik beraad mij op evenwichtige maatregelen die ongewenste direct marketing met handelsregistergegevens beperken, en tegelijk de openbaarheid van het handelsregister ten behoeve van haar wettelijke doelen borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over een windmolenpark in Drenthe

Mr Moorlag (PvdA) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate why a Drenthe wind park was permitted at 175.5 MW with 45 turbines, when the policy target was about 150 MW, and whether the turbine count could be reduced despite local opposition. The Minister answered that the chosen turbine type fits the permitted power bandwidth, that the Commission for EIA advice was considered, and that the permits are now final after a Council of State ruling, so reopening the park's size is not possible.

As I indicated during the debate with your House on 8 November 2018, from the perspective of legal certainty and a reliable government I see no possibility of now reopening the size of the wind park for discussion.

Zoals ik tijdens het debat met uw Kamer op 8 november 2018 heb aangegeven zie ik vanuit het perspectief van rechtszekerheid en een betrouwbare overheid geen mogelijkheid om nu opnieuw de omvang van het windpark ter discussie te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over de opbrengst van zonnepanelen van sportclubs

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the falling returns on solar panels for sports clubs and cooperatives, due to tax shifts and the end of net metering, warrant new support. The minister said the successor subsidy is designed to keep investments viable, that existing postcode-rose projects carry an inherent risk, and that a new stimulus scheme is being studied.
I am currently examining, partly in light of the evaluations of the net metering scheme and the postcode-rose scheme, how a new stimulus scheme can be optimally designed.
Ik onderzoek momenteel – onder andere naar aanleiding van de evaluaties van de salderingsregeling en de postcoderoosregeling – hoe een nieuwe stimuleringsregeling optimaal vormgegeven kan worden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Nijboer over energiecoöperaties

MPs Moorlag and Nijboer asked how the Wft applies to small energy cooperatives, including thresholds for membership, capital and transferability, and whether a licensing requirement exists. The government answered that cooperatives mostly qualify as businesses rather than investing, that prospectus rules apply only above a €5 million threshold with exemptions below it, and that it does not intend to burden small initiatives with unreasonable bureaucracy.
Small-scale citizen initiatives to generate sustainable energy are welcomed.
Kleinschalige initiatieven van bewoners om duurzame energie op te wekken worden toegejuicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het verstrekken van Staatsgaranties bij financiering van franchiseondernemingen

MP Moorlag asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about state-guaranteed loans (BMKB) for franchise businesses, including whether banks supply overly rosy or incorrect information, whether RVO acts against applicants who withhold information, and what remedies franchisees have if misled by a bank. The State Secretary answered that banks act as the loan gateway and bear responsibility for the assessment, that RVO checks loss claims and can reject them, and that RVO knows of no cases of deliberate misinformation in franchise guarantees.
The special feature of the BMKB scheme is, however, that it is not RVO but the credit provider that fulfils the gateway role.
Het bijzondere van de BMKB-regeling is echter dat niet RVO, maar de kredietverlener de rol van loketfunctie vervult.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Von Martels en Moorlag over “designer dogs and cats”

MPs Weverling, Von Martels and Moorlag asked the minister about breeding of 'designer dogs and cats' with hereditary health problems, citing a petition, a European conference, and the adequacy of existing rules and enforcement. The minister agreed such breeding is unacceptable, pointed to Article 3.4 of the Besluit houders van dieren and ten NVWA inspections (four with enforcement), announced a review of enforcement due by year end, and said the issue is being raised in an EU subworking group.
I have commissioned research to make this more enforceable.
Ik heb onderzoek uitgezet om dit beter handhaafbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over de gevaren voor de volksgezondheid ten gevolge van niet tegen Q-koorts gevaccineerde geiten

An MP asked whether an exemption from the Q-fever goat vaccination obligation, granted on conscientious-objection grounds in 2011 by the NVWA under ministerial mandate, is lawful and safe for residents. The minister answered that the exemption carries strict additional conditions giving protection equivalent to vaccination, citing Article 107 Gwwd, and committed to a very restrictive exemption policy.
There is currently one company in the Netherlands that does not vaccinate against Q fever.
Er is momenteel één bedrijf in Nederland dat niet vaccineert tegen Q-koorts.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het Bel-me-niet-Register

An MP asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs about why people on the Bel-me-niet register still receive unsolicited sales calls, whether former customers should be exempt from calls, whether small businesses can register, and how consumers can exercise their right of objection more easily. The state secretary acknowledged the confusion, announced a shift to a statutory opt-in system and a review of telemarketing, said self-regulation talks will come first, and explained the register and objection rights are available to individuals and can be invoked during a call.
I am therefore considering measures to address this, but I think it is important to first hold talks with the telemarketing sector.
Ik overweeg dan ook maatregelen om dit aan te pakken maar ik vind het belangrijk om hierover eerst gesprekken te voeren met de telemarketing sector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over winkels die nep-aanbiedingen doen

An MP asked the state secretary whether misleading 'original price' claims by webshops violate the Dutch unfair trading practices law and what would be done about them, including stronger ACM enforcement and talks with the Consumentenbond. The state secretary agreed such claims are prohibited, said the ACM is responsible for enforcement under its independent priority-setting, and committed only to existing regular consultation with the consumer organisation.
However, it is up to the ACM to decide, based on its own priority-setting policy, whether or not to take enforcement action.
Het is echter aan de ACM om op basis van het eigen prioriteringsbeleid te besluiten al dan niet handhavend op te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over de geloofwaardigheid van de Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM)

An MP asked the state secretary whether the competition regulator ACM is less willing than European peers to use formal sanctions, and whether its informal enforcement should be more transparent. The state secretary replied that ACM uses both informal and formal tools, that three formal enforcement decisions were taken since October 2017, and that transparency is sufficient, while promising a broader evaluation of ACM in the future.
I consider it important that infringements of the competition rules can also lead to fines, as they have a deterrent and preventive effect.
Ik vind het van belang dat overtredingen van de mededingingsregels ook tot boetes kunnen leiden, omdat daar een afschrikwekkend en preventief effect van uitgaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het bericht 'Schildklierhormoon in diervoeding'

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a Radar broadcast reporting high thyroid hormone levels in some raw meat pet food, whether the NVWA had investigated this, and what measures would remove the hormone from pet food. The minister said the broadcast alone does not support conclusions, the NVWA had not investigated previously, the producer is responsible for product safety, and the sector is developing a hygiene code that the NVWA will oversee.
The NVWA will ensure that attention is paid to thyroid tissue within the hygiene code.
De NVWA zal er op toezien dat er binnen de hygiënecode aandacht wordt besteed aan schildklierweefsel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het bericht dat groene stroom in Nederland het duurste van Europa is

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether rising prices of Dutch green electricity certificates raise costs for businesses and consumers and what will be done about the price of non-green electricity. The minister said certificate prices reflect demand for Dutch-origin green power, that businesses buy them voluntarily, and pointed to the EU ETS, a planned CO2 minimum price and the forthcoming Klimaatakkoord.
It is not possible to give the exact prices and price increase, because there is no index for GvOs.
Het is niet mogelijk om de exacte prijzen en prijsstijging weer te geven, omdat er geen index voor GvO’s is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over de daling van het aantal weidevogels

An MP asked the minister whether the agri-environment scheme and the Natuurwet adequately protect meadow birds such as the black-tailed godwit, and whether the government will revise rules, enforcement and provincial cooperation. The minister said it is too early to judge the new collective scheme, pointed to ongoing learning and optimisation plans with the provinces, said the Wet natuurbescherming offers good protection, and promised to inform parliament this autumn and to meet the researcher.

At the committee meeting on nature of 8 March 2018, I committed to inform your House this autumn about the elaboration of the plans of provinces and the national government to improve the meadow bird population.

Tijdens het AO Natuur van 8 maart 2018, heb ik uw Kamer toegezegd dat ik u dit najaar zal informeren over de uitwerking van de plannen van provincies en Rijk voor het verbeteren van de weidevogelstand.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag  en Nijboer over de risico's bij zoutwinning

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about risks from salt mining, including long-term cavern instability, sinkholes in Twente, a Heiligerlee cavern, and leakage at Veendam, citing an SodM report. The minister acknowledges long-term risks need more attention, describes monitoring and remediation plans with AkzoNobel and Nedmag, and promises further information on a single damage desk and reports.
SodM has given supervision of the salt sector greater priority.
SodM heeft het toezicht op de zoutsector meer prioriteit gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Nijboer over internationale energiebedrijven die Nederland gebruiken om miljoen te eisen

Dutch MPs Moorlag and Nijboer asked whether international energy investors use the Energy Charter Treaty to claim compensation from states over energy policy, and whether Dutch shell companies are used for such claims. The government answered that investors can bring arbitration under the treaty for unlawful state conduct, that Nederland has never been sued, and that it will work to amend the treaty to stop shell-company claims.
The cabinet is therefore committed to amending the Energy Charter Treaty on this point.
Het kabinet zet zich dan ook in om het Energiehandvestverdrag op dit punt te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Kuiken over het bericht dat informatie van de Kamer van Koophandel gebruikt wordt voor reclamedoeleinden

MPs Moorlag and Kuiken asked why the Chamber of Commerce (KvK) sells business register data that companies are obliged to provide, which is then used for targeted advertising, and what protections businesses have. The State Secretary answered that the register's public nature requires disclosure, that recipients bear their own privacy-law responsibility, and pointed to the Non Mailing Indicator, the Bel-me-niet register and ongoing exploration of extending protections, but committed only to continued contact with the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens.
The KvK is currently investigating the possibilities to extend the NMI to email and telephone.
De KvK onderzoekt momenteel de mogelijkheden om de NMI uit te breiden naar e-mail en telefoon.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Nijboer over de verdringing en verrijking door zonneparken

MPs Moorlag and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about solar parks displacing farmland, land-price effects, overcompensation of landowners, and whether state-owned land should be used. The minister acknowledged land-use pressure, placed primary responsibility on municipalities and provinces, promised to address efficient land use in the Climate Agreement and National Environmental Vision, and deferred the compensation questions to market parties and an interdepartmental policy review.
In this context I consider it important that we handle agricultural land carefully in the Netherlands and that this is taken into account in spatial considerations for placing solar panels.
Ik vind het in dit kader van belang dat we in Nederland zorgvuldig omgaan met landbouwgronden en dat dat wordt betrokken bij de ruimtelijke afwegingen voor de plaatsing van zonnepanelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over ongezonde voedingsproducten

MP Moorlag asked the State Secretary whether it is harmful that less than a third of large food companies' products are healthy by the Access to Nutrition Index standards, and whether the government will push companies to speed up healthier product ranges. The State Secretary agreed the situation is regrettable, said companies share responsibility, and promised more attention to better food supply in the upcoming prevention accord, with further information in autumn.
Yes, see answer to question 3. All parties, including the food industry, will have to put their shoulders to the wheel to improve the food supply.
Ja, zie antwoord op vraag 3. Alle partijen, ook de voedingsmiddelenindustrie, zullen er de schouders onder moeten zetten om het voedingsaanbod te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over de frauduleuze ondergang van het The Hague Institute for Global Justice

Labour MP Moorlag asked the minister about the collapse of The Hague Institute for Global Justice, which received a 17.45 million euro subsidy, and whether the board and management acted improperly and whether the subsidy can be reclaimed. The state secretary answered that the subsidy was used lawfully and verified, that the institute failed to become financially independent, that management did not demonstrably act improperly, and that recovery is only possible in cases of deliberately false information, which is not indicated.
On the basis of the information provided, the subsidy was finalised.
Op basis van de verstrekte informatie is de subsidie vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het bericht dat consumenten opzegkosten moeten betalen voor het opzeggen van een schadeverzekering

An MP asked whether insurers charging exit fees for cancelling damage insurance deter consumers from switching, and whether the industry code and the Van Dam Act should be tightened. The minister answered that exit fees must be disclosed upfront, that the industry says most insurers no longer charge them, and that the code will be tightened, but saw no reason to bring insurers under the Van Dam Act.
I think it is a good thing that insurers are getting to work on this.
Ik vind het een goede zaak dat verzekeraars hiermee aan de slag gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over de telefonische verkoop van ongevraagde producten

An MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about a company selling a 'free' puzzle book that turns out to be a subscription, asking whether this practice is permissible, whether the ACM has fined a related firm, whether it is investigating, how often it receives complaints, and whether the written-consent requirement should extend to telephone sales. The State Secretary says the ACM is responsible for enforcement, confirms a 2015 EUR 200,000 fine against a related company, declines to comment on ongoing investigations, notes the written-consent rule already applies to certain telephone sales, and says the ACM discussions and an EU study will inform whether legislation should change.

I am in discussion with the ACM about the conclusions of this study. The outcomes of these discussions, which also cover the written-consent requirement, I will take into account in considering whether there is sufficient reason to amend legislation.

Ik ben met de ACM in gesprek over de conclusies van dit onderzoek. De uitkomsten van deze gesprekken, waar ook het schriftelijkheidsvereiste aan bod komt, neem ik mee in mijn overweging of er voldoende aanleiding is voor het aanpassen van wetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over de onduidelijke kosten van uitvaartverzorgers

MP Moorlag asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate whether funeral costs are clear in advance, whether bereaved can compare prices, and whether undertakers should be made more transparent. The State Secretary says existing consumer law already requires costs to be clear before contracting, that comparison is possible via offers and websites, and that no additional measures are needed now, leaving improvement to the sector and ACM enforcement.
At this moment I do not consider additional measures necessary.
Op dit moment acht ik aanvullende maatregelen niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over een tekortschietende capaciteit van het stroomnetwerk in Groningen en Drenthe om de geplande zonneparken te faciliteren

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether grid capacity in Groningen and Drenthe is sufficient for planned solar parks, and whether a national spatial vision for solar energy and short-term measures are warranted. The minister acknowledged the grid is reaching its limits, attributed this to rural conditions, low land prices and active local policy, and said the issue will be addressed in climate tables and the National Environmental Vision, without committing to a concrete new measure.
In the short term, the governments involved, grid operators and the sector will have to seek a practical solution in consultation.
Voor de korte termijn zullen de betrokken overheden, netbeheerders en de sector in overleg een praktische oplossing moeten zoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Nijboer over de verduurzaming van woningen

MPs Moorlag and Nijboer asked whether builders place marginal solar panels merely to meet energy norms, and whether the minister would engage the sector, municipalities, or change building rules to improve rooftop solar use. The minister said builders comply legally with permits and contracts, pointed to forthcoming BENG nearly-zero-energy requirements as the solution, and declined to add specific rules or start talks with the sector.
I will therefore not include specific requirements in the building regulations.
Ik zal daarom geen specifieke eisen opnemen in de bouwregelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht 'Luchtwassers werken veel slechter dan gedacht'
