The State Secretary answered at length, acknowledging strain on reception quality, outlining plans for a stable and flexible reception system and a planned legal municipal task, but giving only general answers on several points and deferring details to later letters.
The government's efforts to realise a stable and flexible reception landscape bear this out.
De inzet van het kabinet om een stabiel en flexibel opvanglandschap te realiseren, getuigt hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sylvana Simons over verslag van staatskasfraude in Suriname

An MP asks the government whether it accepts the findings of a report on alleged state-treasury fraud in Suriname, whether Suriname's economy has collapsed, and whether the Prime Minister should make a state visit given these allegations. The minister answers that prosecution of alleged fraud is for the Surinamese prosecutor, that IMF and Paris Club debt steps are underway, and that the visit is a working visit within good bilateral relations.
It is not for the Netherlands to establish the truth regarding a matter occurring in another sovereign country and to pass judgment on it here.
Het is niet aan Nederland om aan waarheidsvinding te doen ten aanzien van een zaak die in een ander, soeverein land speelt en hier een oordeel over te vellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sylvana Simons over het handelen van de politie tijdens de demonstratie van Extinction Rebellion bij het kantoor van de Belastingdienst in Den Haag

Sylvana Simons (BIJ1) asked the Minister of Justice and Security about police conduct at a peaceful Extinction Rebellion sit-in at the Belastingdienst in The Hague, including forceful removal, a closed van with dangerous heat, and unequal treatment compared with farmers' protests. The Minister defended the police as acting on the mayor's authority and under the law, declined to comment on pending complaints, rejected an apology, and said courts and other authorities should judge the force used.
It is not for me but for other authorities – and where appropriate for the court – to judge the force used by the police.
Het is niet aan mij maar aan andere autoriteiten – en in voorkomende gevallen aan de rechter – om te oordelen over het geweld dat door de politie is gebruikt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sylvana Simons over het bericht 'Woonwagenbewoners op de zwarte lijsten bij gemeenten: nationale waakhond doet onderzoek'

Sylvana Simons asked the Justice Minister about a checklist in a municipal information-sharing model protocol that names woonwagenbewoners (Sinti, Roma, Yenishe, Reizigers) as an indicator of undermining crime, and whether this is discriminatory and whether the data gathered should be deleted. The minister acknowledged the reference is wrong and stigmatising, said the checklist will be revised with the SBO and municipalities (expected by September 2022), and that no signals are known of individuals being registered.
That woonwagenbewoners are named as a specific group on the checklist is wrong, because this can be stigmatising.
Dat woonwagenbewoners als specifieke groep worden genoemd op de checklist is verkeerd, want dit kan stigmatiserend werken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sylvana Simons over het verbod van een Apartheid panel op de Universiteit Leiden

An MP asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about Leiden University's cancellation of a panel on Israeli apartheid, the questioning of moderator Dina Zbeidy's neutrality, the handling of past panels, and CIDI lecture-series credits. The Minister defends the university's conduct as a matter for institutional house rules and academic neutrality, says no exclusion occurred, and gives a partial account of the past practice.
It is up to the institution itself to draw up good house rules for making its facilities available, and so every institution has a degree of room to make decisions.

Het is aan de instelling zelf om goede huisregels op te stellen voor het beschikbaar maken van hun voorzieningen en daarmee heeft elke instelling tot een bepaalde hoogte ruimte om beslissingen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sylvana Simons  over antitransgenderflyers bij GGD’s, huisartsenpraktijken en apotheken

MP Sylvana Simons asked the Health Minister whether an anti-transgender flyer from GezinsPlatform.NL and Voorzij, distributed via GGDs, GP practices and pharmacies, was acceptable and what would be done about it. The Minister said the flyer is inconsistent with medical and inclusive standards, that health professionals decide on information in their own practices, and listed promotion and education measures but took no direct action against the flyer.

It is the professional responsibility of healthcare providers to decide on providing information (for example via leaflets or screens) in their own practice, as long as this does not conflict with laws, regulations and applicable guidelines.

Het is de professionele verantwoordelijkheid van zorgverleners om te beslissen over het verstrekken van informatie (via bijvoorbeeld folders of beeldschermen) in hun eigen praktijk, zo lang dit niet in strijd is met de wet- en regelgeving en geldende richtlijnen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Sylvana Simons en Belhaj over het bericht ‘Afghaans ambassadepersoneel moet betalen voor verblijf in azc's’

MPs asked whether it is fair that former Afghan embassy staff must pay a contribution for asylum reception from their severance pay, given they still lack permanent housing and job offers fell through. The Minister says BZ provided extensive psychosocial and job support, that job offers were cancelled in 14 cases due to distance from housing, that 18 of 37 have been allocated housing, and that the small contribution under the REBA rules is justified.
A small contribution under the REBA scheme is realistic and justified, partly in light of all the efforts BZ as former employer has made and is still making.
Een geringe eigen bijdrage conform de REBA-regeling is reëel en gerechtvaardigd, mede in het licht van alle gedane en nog lopende inspanningen die BZ als voormalig werkgever heeft gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sylvana Simons over de berichten 'Voortaan dreigt ontslag voor racistische agenten' en 'Ontslag dreigt voor racistische agenten'1-7-2022

MP Sylvana Simons asked the Justice Minister whether the police announcement that racist officers face dismissal is meaningful, how it applies to past conduct, and how complaints and reporting of racism within the force will be assessed and protected. The minister answered that discrimination will now always be sanctioned, with dismissal possible, that the police are developing clearer processes and reporting channels, and that past disciplinary decisions cannot be revoked, though the AGFA advisory body reviews such sanctions.
Vigorously enforcing a clear norm requires that all available disciplinary options are used, from lighter sanctions to dismissal.
Daadkrachtig handhaven van een heldere norm vereist dat alle disciplinaire mogelijkheden worden benut die hiervoor beschikbaar zijn
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sylvana Simons over de toename van extreme armoede in de wereld

An MP asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about Oxfam's report on rising extreme poverty, its link to tax policy favouring the rich, debt relief, IMF SDR pledges and social protection funds. The minister answered that poverty reduction is a core aim, that a tax policy study is underway, that Nederland supports the Common Framework and global minimum tax, that the SDR commitment is pending possible future decisions, and that Nederland supports social protection programmes.
Unfortunately, no consensus has yet been reached on these measures.
Over deze maatregelen is helaas nog geen consensus bereikt.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sylvana Simons over recente noodgrepen in diverse steden om een begin te maken met noodhulp aan mensen met lage inkomens en mondzorgklachten, en de groeiende roep om landelijke oplossingen

An MP (Simons, BIJ1) asks the Minister of Health about municipal emergency dental funds and the calls for national solutions to dental care shortages for low-income people, including whether dental care should return to the basic insurance package. The Minister answers that a targeted approach with municipalities, insurers and professional bodies is preferred over re-adding dental care to the basic package, and promises a problem analysis by autumn 2022 and further actions.
I am of the view that a targeted and specific approach is more opportune.
Ik ben van mening dat een doelgerichte en specifieke aanpak meer opportuun is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Kuzu , Sylvana Simons en Sjoerdsma over straffeloosheid voor oorlogsmisdaden in Jemen

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about rising Saudi-led coalition airstrikes in Yemen after the UN Human Rights Council ended its war-crimes investigation, and whether Netherlands would push to resume an UN-mandated inquiry. The minister said the April ceasefire is holding, that Netherlands supports UN envoy efforts, but will not launch an initiative at the Council because the chance of success is very small, instead funding local accountability efforts.
The Netherlands will continue to emphasise the importance of combating impunity in international fora and in bilateral talks.
Ook zal Nederland het belang van het tegengaan van straffeloosheid in internationale fora en in bilaterale gesprekken blijven benadrukken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Sylvana Simons over het meest recente IPCC-rapport in relatie tot Bonaire, Statia en Saba

MPs Van Raan and Simons asked the government about the latest IPCC report and its implications for Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, including climate adaptation, water safety, the 1.5-degree target, and energy transition. The government answered that the report lacks a Caribbean-specific assessment, that these islands are largely excluded from national climate laws and plans, and that a sustainable energy route map is promised before the summer recess.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sylvana Simons over opvang en asiel van derdelanders uit Oekraïne in Nederland

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about third-country nationals from Ukraine who were allegedly refused the right to apply for asylum in Ter Apel, the status of those whose Ukrainian residence permits expire, Rotterdam's information to them, municipal duties, and whether a humanitarian residence permit should be granted to all. The State Secretary answered that these persons must formally apply for asylum to access temporary protection, that status is determined by a valid Ukrainian permit on 23 February 2022, that existing procedures are maintained, and that study options are for higher education institutions to decide.
They are therefore given the opportunity to apply for asylum, without the associated procedural steps being carried out at this time.
Zij worden derhalve in de gelegenheid gebracht om asiel aan te vragen, zonder dat de bijbehorende procedurestappen op dit moment al worden doorlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Azarkan en Sylvana Simons over discriminerende rapportages van de NCTV

MPs Azarkan and Simons asked the Justice Minister about NCTV weekly reports that examined and stigmatised parties such as DENK and BIJ1, including a remark calling MP Kuzu the 'long arm of Turkey', and whether this amounted to political monitoring. The Minister acknowledged that some normative remarks about MPs should not have appeared, said the reports were discontinued in March 2021, and explained the planned legal basis and the ongoing data clean-up, while denying that parties were monitored as such.
That should not have happened. Analyses and interpretations must be factual in nature and focused on developments relevant to national security.
Dat had niet gemoeten. Analyses en duidingen moeten feitelijk van aard zijn en gericht zijn op relevante ontwikkelingen voor de nationale veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Westerveld, Van Esch, Agema, Sylvana Simons, Koekkoek, Kuzu, Van der Plas, Eerdmans en Den Haan over de gewiste opnames van de OMT-vergaderingen

MPs asked whether recordings of OMT (Outbreak Management Team) meetings fall under the Archiefwet, whether the 14 April 2020 recording was destroyed and by whom, and about COVID-19 hotspot archiving lists. The minister answered that audio recordings are used only to draft minutes, that the minutes are archived while recordings are deleted as standard practice, and that some answers (selection lists, hotspot lists) would follow later.
An audio recording of an OMT meeting is deleted by the secretariat after the minutes are finalised. There is no registration of this.
Een geluidsopname van een OMT-vergadering wordt door het secretariaat verwijderd na het definitief vaststellen van het verslag. Hier is geen registratie van.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sylvana Simons over de toegenomen geweldsaanwendingen door de politie

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether the police's rise in use of force in 2021, attributed to more demonstrations, reflects a failure of de-escalation, and asked for independent investigation and evaluation. The minister replied that de-escalation is the starting point, that force is used in only 0.12% of incidents, that all force is reviewed internally and by the public prosecutor, and that an evaluation of the new registration method is pending in the second half of 2022.
Every use of force must be reported to the assisting officer of justice.
Iedere geweldsaanwending moet worden gemeld bij de hulpofficier van justitie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sylvana Simons en Piri over de mishandeling van asielzoekers uit Wit-Rusland in Polen

MPs Simons and Piri asked about reported mistreatment, arbitrary detention and possible racism against asylum seekers from Belarus in Poland, and how the government presses Poland and the EU to ensure equal treatment and enforce EU law. The minister said the government finds the reports worrying, supports border detention under EU rules with safeguards, has raised rule-of-law and humanitarian concerns bilaterally and in EU bodies, and noted that the European Commission, as guardian of the treaties, can act under Article 258.
The government attaches importance to member states complying with Union law, especially where fundamental rights are concerned.
Het kabinet hecht eraan dat lidstaten het Unierecht naleven, in het bijzonder wanneer dit fundamentele rechten betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sylvana Simons en Jasper van Dijk over door Nederland veroorzaakte doden, leed en schade in Hawija, Irak

MPs Simons and Van Dijk asked the Defence Minister how the government would respond to a 2022 report finding far greater civilian harm from the 2015 Dutch airstrike on Hawija than previously assumed, including deaths, damaged buildings, and whether individual compensation and apologies would follow. The Minister acknowledged the harm was significant but unverifiable in full, pointed to the EUR 4.4 million community projects, declined individual compensation as the report does not change the assessment, and welcomed the report's recommendations on civilian harm mitigation, promising further talks.
The cabinet has on several occasions stated that it deeply regrets that civilian casualties occurred in Hawija on the night of 2 to 3 June 2015.
Het kabinet heeft bij meerdere gelegenheden aangegeven het ten zeerste te betreuren dat er in de nacht van 2 op 3 juni 2015 in Hawija burgerslachtoffers zijn gevallen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koekkoek, Sylvana Simons  en Arib over de uitkomsten van PwC-onderzoeken naar de Fraude Signalering Voorziening (FSV)

MPs Koekkoek, Simons and Arib asked the government about PwC findings on the Fraud Signalling Facility (FSV), including use of ethnicity-based risk profiles and whether this amounts to institutional racism. The State Secretary largely declined to characterise the practice as racism, stated that nationality will only be used in supervision with a clear legal basis, promised a compensation scheme and reforms, but deferred many substantive questions on racism and definitions.
I cannot make a general statement about that.
Ik kan daar geen algemene uitspraak over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sylvana Simons over het bericht dat Polen niet-Oekraïense vluchtelingen opsluit in detentiecentra

MP Sylvana Simons asked the Dutch ministers whether they knew of reports that Poland detains non-Ukrainian refugees, including Africans, in detention centres without papers, confiscates phones and forces unsigned documents, and what the government would do about this and the discrimination. The government said it is concerned, that UNHCR and IOM confirmed some detentions, that it raised human rights concerns bilaterally and in EU fora, and that it will press the European Commission to act under Article 258 TFEU.
The cabinet considers the reports of possible violations of human rights safeguards during the asylum procedure worrying.
Het kabinet acht de berichtgeving over mogelijke schendingen van mensenrechtelijke waarborgen tijdens de asielprocedure zorgelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sylvana Simons en Omtzigt over het niet openbaren van het onderzoeksrapport over de aanleiding voor de zelfdoding van een politieagent

MPs Simons and Omtzigt asked why the report on the causes of a police officer's suicide was not made public, who decided this, and whether it would be shared with the House, and asked about a whistleblower scheme for national security information. The minister said the report was given to relatives under a confidentiality condition, the police chief decided with all parties, and the report is now being sent to the House with privacy protections, while describing existing whistleblower channels and an announced extra police reporting point.
I am sending your House today the report of the Brouwer Commission.
Ik zend uw Kamer vandaag het rapport van de Commissie Brouwer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sylvana Simons over evaluaties na politiedoden met onbegrepen gedrag, in het bijzonder naar aanleiding van de dood van Sammy Baker

Sylvana Simons (BIJ1) asked whether multidisciplinary evaluations involving police, ambulance, GGD and mental health services are standard after fatal police interventions with people showing confusing behaviour, and whether such evaluations took place after the deaths of Sammy Baker and Cyprian Broekhuis, and whether a standard should be created. The Minister replied that after fatal incidents the prosecutor is notified and the Rijksrecherche investigates, that no standard periodic case review exists though local contacts do, declined to comment on individual cases, and saw no need for a standard, while promising a further letter before summer on police-mental health cooperation.
I cannot go into individual cases.
Op individuele gevallen kan ik niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over het rapport 'Israel’s apartheid against Palestinians: Cruel system of domination and crime against humanity' van Amnesty International.

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the government accepts Amnesty International's conclusion that Israel commits apartheid, a crime against humanity, and what it will do about it, including whether it will seek advice on the matter and how it reconciles intensified relations with that. The minister referred to a separate Kamerbrief for most substantive answers, rejected labelling the Amnesty report antisemitic as inappropriate, and said it is not for the government to obtain a court ruling on the apartheid qualification.
It is not for the cabinet to obtain a ruling from the Dutch court on such qualifications, or to make statements on how a ruling could be obtained.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om bij de Nederlandse rechter een uitspraak te verkrijgen over dergelijke kwalificaties, of uitspraken te doen hoe een uitspraak verkregen kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sylvana Simons over het artikel ‘Corona lijkt kans op diabetes te verhogen bij kinderen’

An MP asked the health and education ministers whether a CDC study linking COVID infection to higher childhood diabetes risk, uncertain long-term effects, and the reopening of schools were adequately weighed, and demanded guarantees on safety, evaluation, and consultation with parents and teachers. The minister replied that the study does not establish general risk, that school closure carries heavy harms, that safety measures such as testing, masks and ventilation apply, and that consultation with education partners is ongoing.
The government's policy is aimed at keeping schools open.
Het beleid van het kabinet is er op gericht scholen open te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sylvana Simons en Sjoerdsma over de mensenrechtensituatie in Oeganda

Two MPs (Simons and Sjoerdsma) asked the ministers about the human rights situation in Uganda, including police violence, detention of opposition MPs, election observation and the use of aid conditionality. The ministers answered at length, describing EU and bilateral diplomatic pressure, a withheld EUR 850,000 payment to the justice sector, and a planned evaluation of Dutch support, while giving no details on the detained MPs' case.
Because it is an ongoing case, the Ugandan government provides no explanation of it.
Omdat het een lopende zaak betreft wordt er door de Oegandese overheid geen toelichting op gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sylvana Simons over AirTags

An MP asks whether AirTags pose stalking and privacy risks, whether the Wet Belaging is adequate given that stalking is a complaint offence, and how the GDPR and anti-stalking policy apply. The minister answers that the existing legal framework is sufficient, that Apple has added anti-misuse safeguards, that the GDPR's household exemption applies and enforcement is for the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens, and points to ongoing stalking-prevention and victim-support efforts.
Of course, the cabinet is closely monitoring developments.
Uiteraard houdt het kabinet de ontwikkelingen nauwlettend in de gaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over het bericht 'U en ik werken mee aan de mishandeling van migranten'

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that EU support to the Libyan coast guard contributes to abuse of migrants, and what action follows from the FIDH 'No Way Out' report. The government rejects the claim that the EU actively contributes to torture, describes calls for detention reform and third-party monitoring, and lists sanctions, prosecutions and funding measures without committing to new steps beyond existing ones.
The Netherlands funds organisations such as FIDH to conduct research into human rights violations and report on them.
Nederland financiert organisaties als FIDH om onderzoek te doen naar mensenrechtenschendingen en hierover te rapporteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Bromet, Jasper van Dijk, Teunissen, Kuzu, Van der Plas, Simons en Dassen over het lot van de Afghaanse ambassadebewakers

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister why the Afghan guards employed by an external contractor at the Dutch embassy in Kabul were not evacuated, when the Belhaj motion called for evacuating those who assisted the Dutch government, and whether the contractor was informed of the decision. The minister answered that the guards were not embassy employees and guarded other states' diplomatic missions, so they fell outside the evacuation criteria; he acknowledged the contractor received no timely written reply and that the lists and correspondence are shared only confidentially.
The request of 15 August and both reminders are shared with you on a confidential basis.
Het verzoek van 15 augustus en beide rappels worden op vertrouwelijke basis met u gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over het toekennen van het recht om het predicaat ‘Koninklijk’ te voeren aan ondernemingen

MP Simons asked whether royal predicate ('Koninklijk') status can be withdrawn from companies that no longer meet the conditions or have harmed their reputation, citing examples of fraud, corruption and environmental damage, and whether a formal appeal procedure exists. The Minister of Economic Affairs answered that the predicate can be revoked via a careful process involving the mayor, the commissioner of the King and ministry advice, that individual cases cannot be discussed, and that no separate appeal procedure is planned.
I cannot go into individual companies.
Op individuele bedrijven kan ik niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Simons en Piri over het artikel 'VN: Taliban hebben al ruim honderd voormalige functionarissen gedood in Afghanistan'

MPs Simons and Piri asked the Foreign Minister whether a UN report of over a hundred killings of former officials by the Taliban proves risks despite their amnesty, and what this means for evacuation policy and protection of Afghans. The minister calls the reports deeply concerning, notes the Taliban deny central policy and attribute killings to personal disputes, says evacuation criteria remain unchanged while alternative routes are explored, and outlines UN human rights monitoring steps including a Special Rapporteur.
These reports are extremely worrying and point to gross violations of human rights.
Deze berichten zijn uiterst zorgelijk en duiden op grove schendingen van de mensenrechten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Simons en Jasper van Dijk over het besluit om financiering aan de Palestijnse organisatie UAWC stop te zetten

MPs Simons and Van Dijk asked why the government ended funding to the Palestinian organisation UAWC, whether the external Proximities report clears it of terrorism links, and why the government does not apply the same scrutiny to Israeli entities or the EU-Israel Association Agreement. The ministers answered that the decision rests on documented individual ties between UAWC staff and the PFLP, that the government will not revisit it, that no external study of Israeli firms is planned, and that suspension of the Association Agreement is not on the table.
The cabinet found that the individual ties, including within the UAWC board and the dual mandates with the PFLP, were widespread and covered the entire 2007–2021 research period.

Het kabinet heeft geconstateerd dat de individuele banden – zeker ook binnen het bestuur van UAWC en de daar geconstateerde dubbelmandaten met de PFLP – wijdverbreid waren en de gehele onderzoeksperiode 2007–2021 bestreken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over harde kritiek op politieonderdeel dat voor geheime operaties verantwoordelijk is

An MP asked the Justice Minister about harsh criticism of the police unit running covert operations, including an unsafe work climate, favouritism and internal conflict, and about the Brouwer commission findings on a death linked to the team's work. The minister acknowledges structural problems, points to a corrective programme ordered by the police chief and a pending Sorgdrager advisory report on safeguards, and says accountability for individual staff rests with police leadership.
It is not appropriate for me as Minister of Justice and Security to make statements about the functioning of individual police officers.
Het past mij als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid niet om uitspraken te doen over het functioneren van individuele politiemedewerkers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over het bericht ‘gigabytes aan data van asielzoekers doorzocht: geen terrorist gevonden’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about press reports that the police's Athene pilot wrongly harvested and analysed data from asylum seekers' phones without finding terrorists, and whether this risked ethnic profiling and privacy violations. The minister defended the project as aimed at identity verification and detecting terrorism and trafficking, said ethnicity was not an indicator, stopped the project, destroyed the data, and pointed to existing algorithm guidelines and a planned algorithm register without accepting wrongdoing or offering compensation.
The project has been stopped and all investigative information previously received by AVIM under the Athene project has been destroyed.
Het project is stopgezet en alle door AVIM eerder ontvangen opsporingsinformatie in het kader van het project Athene is vernietigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ginneken, Van der Laan en Simons over de moorden op, geweld tegen en zelfdodingen door trans-personen in Nederland

MPs Simons, Van der Laan and Van Ginneken asked about murders of, violence against, and suicides among trans people in the Netherlands, including official statistics, a registration system, anti-violence and reporting policy, and suicide prevention. The Minister answered that no separate registration system is planned, cited police and prosecution data, and described existing LHBTI safety, reporting and suicide-prevention measures and waiting-list efforts in trans care.
In light of the available material, I see no reason to set up an additional registration system.
In het licht van het beschikbare materiaal, zie ik geen aanleiding om een aanvullend registratiesysteem in te richten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt, Ceder, Koekkoek, Jasper van Dijk, Simons, Piri  en Kuzu over afwijzingen kort verblijf familieleden Syrische Nederlanders

MPs asked why Syrian visitors for family visits, even when they appear to meet the Visa Code conditions, are refused at a high rate (55% for Syrians overall, about 75% for family visits), and whether the Syrian war is treated as breaking ties to the home country. The Minister of Foreign Affairs answered that each application is assessed on its merits under the Visa Code, that refusals mostly reflect insufficient ties to the country of origin and doubts about timely return, and that Syrian nationals can only obtain a family visit visa if these concerns are resolved.
Every visa application is assessed on its own merits in accordance with the provisions of the Visa Code.
Alle visumaanvragen worden echter op hun eigen merites beoordeeld overeenkomstig de bepalingen van de Visumcode.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over een reis naar Israël in 2019 door de nieuwe minister van Justitie en Veiligheid en medewerkers van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about a 2019 trip to Israel by the current Justice Minister and Foreign Ministry staff, probing funding (including possible Maror funds), CIDI involvement, and gift rules. The government answered that the trip was private, that the involved staffer had no link to the Middle East file and got leave from the employer, that the government lacks full insight into funding, and that the trip was recorded in the Tweede Kamer's side-activity registers.
The cabinet has only limited insight into how this private trip was financed for the whole group of participants, and that is not for the cabinet to determine.
Het kabinet heeft slechts beperkt inzicht in de wijze waarop deze privéreis voor de gehele groep van deelnemers is gefinancierd, en dat is ook niet aan het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over Nederlands hulpgeld voor de wederopbouw van Sint Maarten dat nog steeds niet is uitgekeerd aan Sint Maarten

An MP asked why about half of the Dutch reconstruction aid for Sint Maarten after hurricane Irma still sits at the World Bank trust fund, and what the government would do to speed disbursement and rehousing. The state secretary answered that implementation is Sint Maarten's responsibility with World Bank support, that the Netherlands monitors via a steering committee, that the fourth tranche was transferred in December 2021, and that housing and shelter are Sint Maarten's autonomous competence.
Sint Maarten is responsible for implementing the reconstruction and is supported by the World Bank in doing so.
Sint Maarten is verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering van de wederopbouw en wordt daarbij ondersteund door de Wereldbank.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Kuiken, Pouw-Verweij, Hijink, Gündoğan, Simons en Omtzigt over het behoud van personeel bij de GGD’en

MPs asked the health minister about GGD staffing shortages, the medium-term outlook for testing and contact tracing, and whether temporary staff can be retained given rising demand. The minister replied that GGDs are responsible for their own personnel policy, that enough staff exist for the booster campaign, and that cost compensation and permanent contracts for essential staff provide assurance, though long-term plans are still under review.
Each GGD is responsible for its own personnel policy, and the way its staff is organised can vary considerably.
Elke GGD is verantwoordelijk voor zijn eigen personeelsbeleid, waarbij de manier waarop het personeelsbestand is vormgegeven sterk kan variëren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Simons en Hijink over financiële tekorten en gevolgen in de ouderenzorg

MPs Simons and Hijink asked the minister whether structural financial shortfalls in elderly care, such as job cuts at Hilverzorg, reflect low insurer payments, and whether corona-related costs will be compensated. The minister answered that rates have risen overall, that the 97-96% reimbursement level is in line with other insurers, that welfare activities remain part of care profiles, and that corona costs are covered by an NZa scheme, but declined to commit to renegotiation with insurers.
There is no decrease in reimbursements, but a reduction in the percentage of the maximum NZa tariffs that is reimbursed.
Er is geen sprake van een daling van de vergoedingen, maar van een verlaging van het percentage dat van de maximum NZa-tarieven wordt vergoed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over het artikel 'Jeugdzorgkenner: Kans op terugplaatsing kinderen toeslagenouders 'vrijwel nihil''

An MP asked why the government did not order an independent investigation into returning children taken from childcare-benefit parents, and how the independence of the inspectorates is guaranteed. The minister answered that the inspectorates are independent under the Aanwijzingen inzake de rijksinspecties, will report by mid-February, and that support for parents and children is being arranged without waiting for the inquiry.
The Aanwijzingen provide that the minister responsible for policy may not influence the content of the inspectorates' work.
In de Aanwijzingen is bepaald dat de beleidsverantwoordelijk Minister de inhoud van de taakuitoefening van de inspecties niet mag beïnvloeden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over de aanvallen op betogers van KOZP in Volendam en het politieoptreden

An MP asked the Justice Minister about violent attacks on a Kick Out Zwarte Piet demonstration in Volendam, the police response, investigations, and anti-violence policy for demonstrators and journalists. The government condemned the violence, said the local mayor and police are responsible for demonstrations and any independent inquiry, and pointed to existing de-escalation and journalist-protection frameworks.
It is not for me as Minister to intervene in that.
Het is niet aan mij als Minister om daar in te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over het artikel 'Rutte na roerig jaar: ‘Fouten heb ik te corrigeren’'

An MP from BIJ1 asked Prime Minister Rutte about his public admissions of communication mistakes in the early COVID-19 crisis, whether these hindered parliamentary debate, their effect on public support, concrete lessons learned, and the timing of the official evaluation. The government answered that it has reflected on its conduct in several parliamentary debates, that support for measures differs from compliance, and that the Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid is evaluating the crisis with a first partial report expected in February 2022.
The cabinet is and remains willing to reflect on its own conduct and is open to critical and constructive input from society and from the House.
Het kabinet is en blijft bereid te reflecteren op het eigen handelen en staat open voor kritische en constructieve geluiden vanuit de maatschappij en vanuit de Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over de uitreiking van de Big Brother Award Expertprijs 2021 aan demissionair Minister Grapperhaus op 13 december 2021

An MP asked the Justice Minister to respond to a Big Brother Award citing predictive policing that enables ethnic profiling, weak attention to legal protection, the NCTV's surveillance practices being legalised, a police facial-recognition database, and living labs with surveillance technology in public space. The minister denied that algorithms enable ethnic profiling, cited existing frameworks and laws, and argued that the NCTV and living-lab practices operate within legal bases while committing to no new concrete step beyond the pending NCTV bill.
In addition, the Netherlands Institute for Human Rights has clarified the legal framework on the use of ethnicity and nationality.
Daarnaast heeft het College voor de Rechten van de Mens het juridisch kader over het gebruik van etniciteit en nationaliteit helder in beeld gebracht
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over het artikel 'In 2021 vonden er bijna 12.000 pushbacks plaats aan Europese buitengrens'

Mr Simons (BIJ1) asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs about reports of around 12,000 pushbacks at EU external borders in 2021, including abuse of migrants in the Balkans, and what the government would do about it. The Minister acknowledges the reports and concern, says member states bear primary responsibility for border control, states Dutch concern is raised with the Commission and at the European Council and bilaterally, and says the government will keep raising the issue without committing to a concrete new step.
The cabinet will continue to emphasise the importance of respecting fundamental rights at the border.
Het kabinet zal het belang van het respecteren van fundamentele rechten aan de grens blijven benadrukken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over de noodopvang in Heumensoord

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about critical reports on the Heumensoord emergency asylum shelter, including ombudsman and human rights body findings, why conditions had not improved in five years, the psychological harm to asylum seekers, EU reception standards, and psychiatric care provision. The State Secretary acknowledged the shelter is not optimal, said it will close around mid-January 2022, described improvements and existing care and complaint arrangements, and maintained that Dutch reception exceeds EU minimum standards.
Heumensoord will therefore be scaled down as quickly as possible.
Heumensoord wordt dan ook zo snel mogelijk afgeschaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over het bericht 'Nederland gebruikte martelkampen op Bali tijdens de onafhankelijkheidsoorlog'

An MP asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers why the government declined to respond to reports of Dutch torture camps on Bali during the independence war, and whether it would take the findings into account. The government said it welcomes publications that shed light on the period, that it awaits the results of the independent NIOD/KITLV/NIMH study due in February 2022, and will then take an integral position.
The Cabinet awaits the outcomes of the NIOD, KITLV and NIMH research and will on that basis determine an integral position on the use of violence in Indonesia in 1945–1949.
Het Kabinet wacht de uitkomsten van het onderzoek van NIOD, KITLV en NIMH af en zal op basis daarvan een integraal standpunt bepalen over het geweldsgebruik in de jaren 1945–1949 in Indonesië.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Bromet, Jasper van Dijk, Dassen, Kuzu, Teunissen, Simons, Van der Plas en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Buitenlandse Zaken weigert Afghaanse bewakers ambassade Kabul te evacueren’

MPs asked why Dutch embassy security guards employed via a subcontractor in Kabul were not evacuated while Hungarian guards were, and whether a new direct-employment criterion was introduced without informing parliament. The government answered that the criteria for evacuation (Belhaj motion) were unchanged, that embassy guards fall under host-state responsibility and their employer is responsible, and gave figures on remaining interpreters and Afghans awaiting transfer.
There is no question of a new criterion.
Er is geen sprake van een nieuw criterium.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Simons en Kuzu over de administratieve detentie van Palestijnen

MPs Simons and Kuzu asked the Foreign Minister about over 500 Palestinians held in administrative detention by Israel without charge or trial, including a hunger strike by six detainees, and whether the government would condemn it, press for release, and reconsider the EU-Israel Association Agreement. The minister acknowledged the concern, said five of six hunger strikers had ended their strike via agreements, and said the Netherlands and EU press for strict compliance with safeguards and support NGOs, while declining to commit to sanctions or suspension of the Association Agreement, instead favouring resuming the Association Council.

The Netherlands and the EU consider the specific situation, and more broadly the frequent use of administrative detention, worrying, and regularly stress to the Israeli authorities the importance of a fair legal process.

Nederland en de EU achten de specifieke situatie, en in bredere zin het veelvuldig gebruik van administratieve detentie, zorgelijk en onderstrepen in gesprekken met de Israëlische autoriteiten met regelmaat het belang van een eerlijke rechtsgang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over het publiceren van dronebeelden door de politie

An MP asked the Justice Minister about police publication of drone footage from a Rotterdam housing protest, questioning its purpose, legal basis, selective editing and whether it shapes political debate. The minister defended the release as exceptional, lawful under the Police Act and aimed at giving context, and said police have accounted for force use through the usual reporting and review procedures.
Use of force by the police must always be reported and reviewed by the assisting officer of justice.
Geweldsaanwending door de politie moet altijd worden gemeld en getoetst door de hulpofficier van justitie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Jasper van Dijk, Piri, Ellemeet, Koekkoek en Teunissen over het bericht over mogelijke push back van een groep van 27 vluchtelingen op het Griekse eiland Lesbos

MPs from several parties asked the State Secretary about reports of a group of 27 refugees hiding on Lesbos to avoid alleged pushback, including claims of a pushback of a minor, unlawful strip searches of detained activists, Greek laws criminalising aid and restricting lawyers, and the status of an independent EU monitoring mechanism. The government answered that it awaits findings from Greek and EU investigations, supports an independent monitoring mechanism, notes the Commission is responsible for enforcement, and does not accept that pushbacks are normal practice.
In the absence of independent information, I await the results of such investigations.
Bij het ontbreken van eigenstandige informatie wacht ik de resultaten van dergelijke onderzoeken af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over politie-ingrijpen bij demonstraties en de veiligheid van vreedzame demonstranten en journalisten

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about police intervention at the Rotterdam housing protest, police tactics, arrests of demonstrators and journalists, and the protection of peaceful protest. The minister mostly deferred to local authority and the public prosecutor, confirmed nine arrests in Rotterdam, rejected a pattern of misconduct and any need for a separate investigation, and gave no concrete commitment to prevent recurrence.
I cannot and will not weigh in on the assessment of this.
Ik kan en zal niet in de beoordeling hiervan treden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Wilders, Agema, Hijink, Westerveld, Kuiken, Pouw-Verweij, Van der Staaij, Gündoğan, Van Esch, Simons en Den Haan over de uitspraken van dhr. Gommers dat hij over 10 dagen code zwa

MPs asked the Minister of Health whether the November measures were working, given expert warnings of a 'code black' hospital crisis, and questioned testing, boosters, staffing, supplies, security and a medium-term strategy. The Minister answered that pressure on care is rising, phase 2d was declared with planned care being scaled down, and that no indication yet exists for phase 3, while defending booster timing and deferring some points to earlier letters.
I am in constant contact with field parties in order to maintain a sharp view of the current situation on the shop floor in various care sectors.
Ook ben ik constant in gesprek met veldpartijen, om scherp zicht te houden op de actuele situatie op de werkvloer in verschillende zorgsectoren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koekkoek en Simons over het rapport 'Transcript from the margins' over de behandeling van trans personen uit Latijns-Amerika en de Cariben in Nederlandse asielprocedures

MPs Koekkoek and Simons asked about a report on the treatment of trans asylum seekers from Latin America and the Caribbean in Dutch asylum procedures, including recommendations for trans-specific approaches, misgendering, and police violence. The State Secretary replied that the IND already uses LHBTI coordinators and training, that trans applicants are assessed individually, that Venezuela's trans population was recently classed as a risk group, and that no further structural changes are planned beyond ongoing contact with Transgender Netwerk Nederland.
The IND's approach is always to address the asylum seeker according to their own wishes, regardless of the information in the passport.
De insteek van de IND is om de asielzoeker altijd naar wens van de asielzoeker aan te spreken, ongeacht de informatie in het paspoort.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma, Van Ginneken, Kuiken, Ellemeet en Simons over het faillissement van de ggz-instelling voor transgenderzorg 'Stepwork'

MPs from D66, PvdA, GroenLinks and BIJ1 asked about the bankruptcy of Stepwork, a major transgender care mental health provider, its impact on waiting lists and continuity of care, and what government could have done earlier. The State Secretary answered that continuity of care is secured through takeover by Genderhealthcare, that the government had intervened repeatedly since 2019, and that a review of the psychological assessment requirement is being prepared via ZonMw.
The policy of the Ministry of VWS is aimed at continuity of care for patients and clients, not at continuity of individual institutions.
Het beleid van VWS is gericht op continuïteit van zorg voor patiënten en cliënten, en niet op continuïteit van individuele instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over het nieuwe IND-beleid waardoor honderden minderjarige vluchtelingen dreigen te moeten opgroeien zonder ouders

An MP asked why the State Secretary deployed an IND family-reunification practice narrowing the 'unaccompanied minor' concept without informing parliament, and whether it conflicts with the UN Convention on the Rights of the Child and the EU Family Reunification Directive. The State Secretary answered that the IND practice was not a policy change, that the practice has been abandoned except where a child is clearly not unaccompanied, that fees will be refunded and pending requests reviewed, while largely restating existing legal frameworks on some points.
In March 2021 I was presented with a memo proposing that this more generic practice applied by the IND be abandoned.
In maart 2021 is mij een nota voorgelegd waarin mij is voorgesteld om deze door de IND meer generiek gehanteerde werkwijze los te laten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Simons over nieuwe problemen die dreigen te ontstaan omdat de Commissie Werkelijke Schade nog steeds onderbemenst is

MPs Van Raan and Simons asked whether the Commission Werkelijke Schade (CWS) is still understaffed, creating new emergencies such as forced evictions, and why capacity was not scaled up sooner. The State Secretary answered that the waiting list is undesirable but emergencies are addressed via the pause button, the Brede Hulp Team and priority treatment, that scale-up began in June 2021 with results lagging, and that capacity is expected to suffice within three to six months.
The CWS and UHT will handle her claim for actual damage with urgency.
De CWS en UHT zullen haar aanvraag voor werkelijke schade met spoed behandelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gündoğan, Simons en Kathmann over het bericht “Kabinet wil ‘homogenezing’ ‘krachtig tegengaan’ maar komt niet met een verbod”

MPs Gündoğan, Simons and Kathmann asked the Health Minister whether conversion therapy should be banned, given that it harms minors and that a legal ban was part of the COC Rainbow Accord. The minister agreed that conversion therapy is unacceptable and noted it can already be prosecuted under existing criminal and civil law, but declined to commit to a specific ban, promising a broader exploration of further measures first.
For this reason the cabinet will carry out a broad exploration of possible effective additional measures, including legislation and regulation, including the option of some form of a legal ban.

Om die reden zal het kabinet een brede verkenning uitvoeren naar mogelijke, effectieve nadere maatregelen, waaronder wet- en regelgeving, inclusief de optie van mogelijkheden voor enige vorm van een wettelijk verbod.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over het stilgehouden rapport Woittiez over structurele en ernstige juridische fouten in de jeugdzorg

An MP asked why a 2018 exploratory document ('Incident of Patroon?') on structural legal failures in youth care was not shared with parliament, and how the government chooses the reform agenda and involves experiential experts. The minister answered that the document was a short exploration rather than a full report, judged not to need sharing because the problem was already known and being addressed, and outlined the reform agenda and consultation processes while leaving final decisions to a new cabinet.

Given the nature of the exploration and the fact that it showed the problem was already known and being addressed, there was then no reason seen to inform me about the exploration and therefore not to share it with your House.

Gezien de aard van de verkenning en gelet op het feit dat uit de verkenning bleek dat de problematiek reeds bekend was en werd opgepakt, is destijds geen aanleiding gezien om mij te informeren over de verkenning en daardoor ook niet om de verkenning met uw Kamer te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over het stoppen van WMO- en leerlingenvervoer in verband met Formule 1-race in Zandvoort

An MP asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport whether WMO and school transport in Zandvoort and neighbouring municipalities was stopped for the Formula 1 weekend, and whether essential care transport may be cancelled for events. The minister replied that the provider reversed the decision and will continue transport with possible delays, that transport should in principle continue, and that organising this transport is a municipal responsibility.
The organisation of school transport and WMO transport has deliberately been assigned to municipalities.
Het organiseren van leerlingenvervoer en Wmo-vervoer is bewust bij gemeenten belegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Simons en Van Ginneken over een lek van privéadressen van volksvertegenwoordigers en politieke en maatschappelijke organisaties door de Kamer van Koophandel

MPs Simons and Van Ginneken asked ministers about a leak of private home addresses of MPs and political and civil-society organisations via the Chamber of Commerce, in which a former lawyer had unlawfully retrieved about 1,785 addresses. The government answered that the lawyer's authorisation was revoked, a criminal complaint filed, the police investigate, and that authorisations are being audited and address protections expanded.
Following the unauthorised retrieval, the Chamber of Commerce filed a criminal complaint against the lawyer.
De KVK heeft naar aanleiding van de onbevoegde opvraging aangifte gedaan tegen de advocaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Simons en Westerveld over het bericht 'Jeugdzorg sluit kinderen nog steeds op in isoleercel: belofte ermee te stoppen niet nagekomen'

MPs Simons and Westerveld asked why youth-care JeugdzorgPlus institutions still isolate children despite promises to stop, and what is being done about it. The minister explains the project results, the causes of persistent isolation, and plans such as a new bill (Wet rechtspositie gesloten jeugdhulp) with a 'nee, tenzij' rule and limits on isolation, though not a total ban.
I do not intend to ban forced isolation entirely.
Ik ben niet voornemens om gedwongen afzonderen geheel te verbieden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ginneken, Van der Laan, Ellemeet, Kathmann en Simons over het bericht 'Kabinet biedt excuses aan voor oude transgenderwet'

MPs asked why the compensation scheme for the former transgender sterilisation requirement was not published by 1 July, how the Transgender and Intersex Collective was involved, and why the amount is EUR 5,000. The minister said publication was delayed, the Collective was consulted and its input shaped the scheme, the amount follows an earlier scheme for youth care abuse victims, and the scheme will be published in the Staatscourant with applications from 18 October 2021.
It has become apparent that drafting the scheme and preparing its implementation required more time than originally estimated.
Het is gebleken dat de totstandkoming van de regeling en het voorbereiden van de uitvoering meer tijd vereisten dan op voorhand was ingeschat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Jasper van Dijk, Piri en Simons over het rapport 'Onzichtbaar' van de Amsterdamse Ombudsman en het WODC-onderzoek naar mensen zonder rechtmatig verblijf

MPs asked the government about the Amsterdam Ombudsman's estimate that 4-6% of pupils in Amsterdam schools are undocumented, the national share, post-18 education and work prospects, economic costs, and return figures. The minister gave national percentages of students without a BSN, said the national share of undocumented children is likely lower, announced a study on newcomer funding, and declined further research on economic costs and returns, citing the legal framework.
It is not possible to state how many children staying unlawfully in the Netherlands receive national education.
Het is niet mogelijk om aan te geven hoeveel onrechtmatig in Nederland verblijvende kinderen landelijk onderwijs volgen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Wijngaarden, Piri, Bromet, Belhaj , Teunissen, Kuzu, Dassen, Van der Plas, Leijten , Jasper van Dijk, Simons, Boswijk, Stoffer en Ceder over de evacuatie in Afghanistan

MPs asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers whether the Netherlands would send soldiers to collect evacuees in Kabul and bring them past Taliban checkpoints to the airport, and how the Dutch evacuation would be carried out given the rising number of Dutch nationals in Afghanistan. The ministers replied that the government is doing everything to evacuate the priority groups, that extra special forces have arrived, and that operational details cannot be disclosed for security reasons.
In the interest of the safety of our soldiers, diplomats and evacuees, and so as not to endanger the operation, the cabinet cannot make further detailed statements about this.
In het belang van de veiligheid van onze militairen, diplomaten en de evacués en om de operatie niet in gevaar te brengen kan het kabinet hier verder geen gedetailleerde uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over de sancties tegen Cuba

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the impact of the US embargo on Cuba, Dutch positions on UN resolutions against it, Dutch companies' role in US sanctions, and aid to Cuba during the crisis. The minister said domestic policy and COVID weigh more than the embargo, that Dutch opposition operates mainly via EU channels and the antiboycott regulation, and that Cuba receives no bilateral aid but indirect support via UN and EU programmes.
The Netherlands and other EU member states oppose the undesirable consequences of the extraterritorial effect of third-country sanctions.
Nederland en andere EU-lidstaten zijn tegen de onwenselijke gevolgen van de extraterritoriale werking van sancties van derde landen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over schadeclaims bij de politie

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about how the police handle damage claims, including whether the rules are written down, whether there is an independent review, where complainants can turn, and for statistics on claims in 2020. The Minister answered that police follow written procedures and the law, that disputes go to the courts, that claims data cannot be broken down by incident, and gave 2020 figures showing about 51% of decided claims resulted in payment.
The police are currently exploring the possibility of having a periodic audit carried out.
De politie bekijkt op dit moment de mogelijkheden om periodiek een audit te laten uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over het verbreken van de wapenstilstand door Israël

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Israel's airstrike breaking the Gaza ceasefire was proportionate, who was behind the incendiary balloons, and what Dutch measures were planned for de-escalation and humanitarian aid. The minister said the government lacks operational information to judge the use of force, that Hamas likely allowed or carried out the balloons, and listed an additional EUR 4 million for UN humanitarian response.
The cabinet does not have sufficient operational information required to assess the use of force by the parties to this conflict, in which the Netherlands is not itself involved.
Het kabinet beschikt over onvoldoende operationele informatie die vereist is voor de beoordeling van geweldgebruik door de partijen bij dit conflict, waarbij Nederland niet zelf is betrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wuite, Ceder, Bromet, Wassenberg en Simons over het bericht “heeft premier Jacobs een punt als zij zegt dat Nederland vals speelt”

MPs from several parties asked the Prime Minister about the Rijksministerraad decision of 23 April 2021 to release the fifth tranche of liquidity support to Sint Maarten and why the State Secretary for Interior and Kingdom Relations did not implement it. The Prime Minister answered that concerns about corporate governance at the airport led the State Secretary to resubmit the matter, which the council reversed on 28 May, and that no change to the council's rules of procedure is planned.
I see no reason to amend the rules of procedure of the council of ministers.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om het reglement van orde van de ministerraad te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koekkoek en Simons over de veiligheidssituatie in azc’s voor lhbti-asielzoekers

MPs Koekkoek and Simons asked the State Secretary about safety for LGBTI asylum seekers in reception centres, citing LGBT Asylum Support reports of frequent, unanswered incident reports and weekend gaps in follow-up. The State Secretary replied that Bureau Veiligheid forwards reports to locations without substantive feedback for privacy reasons, that after-hours incidents are handled on site, that the COA now registers suspected discrimination, and that separate LGBTI units are rejected in favour of tailored placement.
Bureau Veiligheid does not give substantive feedback, only a brief email to LGBT Asylum Support confirming the signal was received and passed on.
Bureau Veiligheid geeft geen inhoudelijke terugkoppeling, maar een korte reactie aan LGBT Asylum Support per e-mail dat het signaal is ontvangen en doorgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Simons over ernstige misstanden in de politieorganisatie

MP Simons asked the Minister of Justice and Security about police misconduct, the culture within the police, and the suicide of a police officer amid bullying, and about the KPMG findings on the Dienst Landelijke Informatie Organisatie. The Minister answered that a family-level inquiry into the recent death is ongoing, that the Inspectie found leadership and culture problems to be addressed through a programmatic approach to the Landelijke Eenheid, and that he would inform parliament of outcomes where confidentiality allows.
I cannot anticipate the outcomes of this investigation.
Ik kan niet vooruitlopen op de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over ‘buitenproportionele geweldstoepassing door de Rotterdamse politie’

An MP asks the Minister of Justice about a Rotterdam police officer filmed using disproportionate force against a 17-year-old, the prosecution's dismissal of the case, and whether patterns of excessive force and racism exist. The Minister declines to judge the individual case, says excessive-force incidents are registered and reviewed case by case, and rejects the claim of a systemic pattern while promising more transparency reporting by the police chief.
It is for other authorities – where applicable the judge – to assess whether there is disproportionate use of force or not.
Het is aan andere autoriteiten – in voorkomende gevallen de rechter – om te beoordelen of er wel of niet sprake is van buitenproportionele geweldsaanwending.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over aparte looproutes voor statushouders in Oegstgeest

The MP asks whether the government accepts a local proposal to route asylum status holders away from a park in Oegstgeest, and whether it violates the constitutional non-discrimination clause, and what tools exist to intervene. The minister answers that the municipality confirmed no obligation or ban on routes exists, that discrimination is unacceptable, and that intervention options are limited, with no existing comparable measures known.
The COA can and will never require or prohibit a route, except in situations where a restrictive measure has been imposed under the approach to nuisance behaviour.
Het COA kan en zal nooit een route verplichten dan wel verbieden, behoudens situaties waarin in het kader van de aanpak van overlastgevend gedrag een vrijheidsbeperkende maatregel is opgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over de brief van de President Mr. J.G. Wattilete van de Republik Maluku Selatan

An MP asked the Prime Minister about a letter from the exiled Republic of South Maluku government, the 2010 court commitment to raise the grave of executed president Soumokil with Indonesia, the return of the RMS flag held by the Marines Museum, and a meeting with the RMS president. The government answered that Indonesia was last approached in 2015 without response and further raising is not considered promising, that the flag is not state property and will not be mediated, and that talks are not on the table because the Kingdom does not recognise the RMS.
Therefore I do not consider it promising to raise the matter again.
Daarom acht ik het niet kansrijk om de kwestie nogmaals aan de orde te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over deportatie van Syrische vluchtelingen door Denemarken

An MP asked the State Secretary and Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands would challenge Denmark's decision not to renew or to revoke residence permits of about 380 Syrian refugees and whether the Netherlands would offer them asylum. The government answered that it saw no reason to intervene, citing Denmark's sovereign asylum competence, the mutual trust principle, and the appeal and ECtHR remedies available, and declined to offer asylum to those affected.
Within the normative frameworks of these treaties, member states have room to make their own policy assessment, based on the country information available to them.
Binnen de normatieve kaders van deze verdragen hebben lidstaten de ruimte om een eigen beleidsafweging te maken, aan de hand van de hun beschikbare landeninformatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over de sluiting van de noodopvang voor ‘niet- rechthebbende’ dak- en thuislozen

An MP from BIJ1 asked why emergency shelter for homeless people without residence rights was closed, whether they can isolate or get vaccinated, and whether housing for everyone is possible. The State Secretary replied that the shelter wind-down was tied to step 2 of the reopening plan, that GGD and shelter organisations have quarantine and vaccination arrangements, and that structural housing and a pilot for unlawfully staying migrants are being pursued.
The wind-down period lasts until 2 June.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over “politiegeweld tegen demonstranten in Colombia”

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about alleged excessive police violence against protesters in Colombia, harassment of human rights activists, internet and electricity shutdowns, and whether the Netherlands would press Colombia to stop the violence. The minister condemned excessive force, backed EU and UN statements, said internet cutoffs were unconfirmed, and described diplomatic engagement and monitoring of Colombian investigations without committing to new measures.

The cabinet shares the concerns expressed by the United Nations. It is important that violence against demonstrators is investigated and that those responsible for human rights violations are punished.

Het kabinet deelt de zorgen die door de Verenigde Naties zijn geuit. Het is van belang dat het geweld tegen demonstranten wordt onderzocht en dat verantwoordelijken voor schendingen van mensenrechten worden bestraft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over het rapport van Human Rights Watch aangaande misdaden tegen de menselijkheid door Israël

MP Simons asked the Foreign Minister how the government responds to the Human Rights Watch report accusing Israel of apartheid and persecution as crimes against humanity, including Israel's dual legal system in the occupied territories, the Netherlands' discouragement policy on business in settlements, arms and Elbit contracts, and the EU Association Agreement. The minister acknowledged concern about the violations documented but declined to adopt the term apartheid, rejected several HRW recommendations (new VN inquiry, sanctions, a special envoy, a legal ban on trade with occupied territories, exclusion of firms on the UN database from procurement), while noting existing measures such as restrictive arms export policy and ongoing dialogue with Israël.
The cabinet is however reticent about using qualifications such as "apartheid".
Het kabinet is echter terughoudend met het gebruik van kwalificaties als «apartheid».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over de arrestatie van zeven personen op de Molukken

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the government will inquire with the Indonesian ambassador about the arrest of seven Moluccan activists and whether it will act if Article 2 of the ICCPR has been violated. The minister answered that the Dutch embassy will monitor the case, that the Netherlands does not interfere in other countries' legal processes, and that human rights concerns are raised generally in bilateral and EU contacts.
The normal Indonesian legal process appears to be followed and the Netherlands in principle does not interfere in the legal processes of other countries.
De normale Indonesische rechtsgang lijkt te worden gevolgd en Nederland mengt zich in beginsel niet in de rechtsgang van andere landen.

m: Amendement van het lid Joseph c.s. over het verbod op contante betaling doen gelden vanaf €10.000
Raises the threshold of the ban on cash payments by goods traders from 3,000 to 10,000 euro, aligning it with the EU AML regulation.
In the proposed article 1f in article I, part C, '€ 3,000' is replaced by '€ 10,000'.
In het in artikel I, onderdeel C, voorgestelde artikel 1f wordt «€ 3.000» vervangen door «€ 10.000».
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Vree over het bericht 'Helft stichtingen en verenigingen heeft problemen bank dankzij doorgeschoten anti-terrorismemaatregelen'

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether he knows of reports that half of foundations and associations have banking problems due to overzealous anti-terrorism measures, what steps he will take, and how banks can be encouraged to apply a risk-based approach. The minister answered that banks must apply the Wwft risk-based, that he will raise this with DNB and the Dutch Banking Association, and that a fuller proposal will follow in early 2025.
Early 2025 I will send your House, together with the Minister of Justice and Security, the elaboration of the government programme on preventing money laundering and terrorist financing.
Begin 2025 stuur ik uw Kamer, met de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid, de uitwerking van het regeerprogramma op het terrein van het voorkomen van witwassen en terrorismefinanciering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Vree over het bericht 'Alarm om nieuwe criminele truc met deepfake: 'Hackers kopiëren je gezicht en plunderen je bankrekening''

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether he knows of a reported deepfake facial-recognition bank fraud and how he ensures account holders are protected against AI-enabled hackers. The minister answered yes, noted the incident did not occur in Europe or at a Dutch bank, said banks apply technical safeguards, and that the Maatschappelijk Overleg Betalingsverkeer monitors new fraud forms with stakeholders.
To prevent misuse of identification methods by hackers, banks take various (technical) security measures, including for facial recognition.
Om misbruik van identificatiemethoden door hackers te voorkomen nemen banken verschillende (technische) veiligheidsmaatregelen, zo ook bij gezichtsherkenning.

m: Motie van het lid De Korte over de registratielast integraal aanpakken
Asks the government to tackle the registration burden comprehensively in healthcare, aiming to cut it from 40% to at least 30% within two years.
requests the government to tackle registration burden comprehensively, alongside the use of AI
verzoekt de regering om registratielast integraal aan te pakken, naast de inzet van AI
Motie van het lid De Korte over cao-loonsverhogingen voortaan in de vorm van vaste bedragen regelen
Asks the government to talk with unions and employers about setting care-sector collective wage increases as fixed amounts and to reconsider the FWG job valuation.
requests the government to talk with unions and employers in the care sector and ask whether collective wage increases can be arranged as fixed amounts
verzoekt de regering in gesprek te gaan met vakbonden en werkgevers in de zorgsector en hen te verzoeken of cao-loonsverhogingen voortaan in de vorm van vaste bedragen geregeld kunnen worden
Motie van het lid De Korte over externe inhuur bij VWS binnen één jaar afbouwen naar 10%
Asks the government to reduce external hiring at the Ministry of VWS to ten percent of the personnel budget within one year.
requests the government to reduce external hiring at the Ministry of VWS within one year to 10%, in line with the Roemer norm
verzoekt de regering om externe inhuur bij het Ministerie van VWS binnen één jaar af te bouwen naar 10%, conform de Roemernorm
Motie van het lid De Korte over adviezen van het rapport Elke regio telt! meenemen in beleidsvorming
Asks the government to take into account the advice in the report Elke regio telt! in policy making and inform the House before September.
requests the government to take the advice from the report Elke regio telt! into account in its policy making
verzoekt de regering om de adviezen uit het rapport Elke regio telt! mee te nemen in haar beleidsvorming
Amendement van het lid De Korte over middelen om de eerste stappen te zetten voor een Topinstituut voor internationale conflictbemiddeling
Moves 500,000 euro within the foreign affairs budget article on peace and security to fund first steps toward an international conflict mediation institute, a net-zero reallocation.
the commitment and expenditure amounts are increased by € 500 (x € 1,000)
worden het verplichtingenbedrag en het uitgavenbedrag verhoogd met € 500 (x € 1.000)
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid De Korte t.v.v. nr. 14 over een evaluatie na drie jaar

Requires the health minister to report to parliament within three years on the effectiveness and effects of the quality-registry law, including registry admission assessments, feasibility, registration burden and data security.
Within three years of this law entering into force, the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport sends the States General a report on the effectiveness and effects of this law in practice.

Onze Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport zendt binnen drie jaar na inwerkingtreding van deze wet aan de Staten-Generaal een verslag over de doeltreffendheid en de effecten van deze wet in de praktijk.
Motie van het lid De Korte over beveiliging van landelijke datasets voor kwaliteitsregistraties
Asks the minister to add to the Wkkgz ministerial regulation security requirements, including privacy-enhancing technologies, for national patient datasets used in quality registries.
national databases of patient data are very sensitive to cybercrime and therefore need the very best security.
landelijke databestanden met patiëntengegevens zeer gevoelig zijn voor cybercriminaliteit en daarom de allerbeste beveiliging behoeven
Amendement van het lid De Korte over een evaluatie na twee, vier en zes jaar
Adds a provision requiring the health minister to report to parliament on the effectiveness of the quality registration law after two, four and six years.
within two years and then within four and six years after entry into force sends the States General a report on the effectiveness and effects of this law

zendt binnen twee jaar en vervolgens binnen vier jaar en binnen zes jaar na inwerkingtreding van deze wet aan de Staten-Generaal een verslag over de doeltreffendheid en de effecten van deze wet in de praktijk
Amendement van het lid De Korte over lichte voorhang van enkele ministeriële regelingen
Amends the bill so that certain ministerial regulations cannot be adopted until four weeks after the draft has been submitted to both chambers of parliament.
is not adopted earlier than four weeks after the draft has been submitted to both chambers of the States General
wordt niet eerder vastgesteld dan vier weken nadat het ontwerp aan beide kamers der Staten-Generaal is overgelegd
Motie van het lid De Korte over borgen van kennis en expertise van de Nederlandse maatschappelijke organisaties in het nieuwe beleidskader
Asks the government to safeguard the expertise of Dutch civil society organisations in the new development policy framework and to evaluate it after two years.
to evaluate after two years the progress of the new policy framework
na twee jaar te evalueren wat de voortgang is van het nieuwe beleidskader
Motie van het lid De Korte over de vereenvoudiging van aanspraken voor thuiswonende cliënten
Asks the government to explore simplifying entitlements for home-living clients by separating them from clustered residents under different insurance regimes.
requests the government to further explore how simplification of entitlements for home-living clients can be implemented
verzoekt de regering om verder te verkennen hoe uitwerking gegeven kan worden aan vereenvoudiging van de aanspraken voor thuiswonende cliënten
Motie van het lid De Korte over bij dilemma's rondom domeinoverstijgende projecten verduidelijken welke partij verantwoordelijk is voor de organisatie van de zorg
Asks the government, through illustrative examples, to clarify which participating party is responsible for organising care in cross-domain projects.
requests the government to clarify through guiding examples
verzoekt de regering middels richtinggevende voorbeelden te verduidelijken
Amendement van het lid De Korte over het vervallen van de grondslag voor gegevensverwerking door Vektis
Removes the legal basis letting health insurers and the Wlz implementer have all claims data pseudonymised and aggregated by Vektis for ministerial policy reports.
With this amendment the basis is removed that lets health insurers and Wlz implementers have their data processed by one private organisation for policy purposes.
Met dit amendement vervalt de grondslag dat zorgverzekeraars en Wlz-uitvoerders hun gegevens door één private organisatie mogen laten verwerken voor beleidsmatige doeleinden.
Amendement van het lid De Korte ter vervanging van nr. 8 over het vervallen van de grondslag voor gegevensverwerking door Vektis
Deletes the legal basis allowing health insurers and Wlz implementers to have declaration data for policy purposes processed by the private organisation Vektis.
This amendment removes the basis allowing health insurers and Wlz implementers to have their data processed by one private organisation for policy purposes.
Met dit amendement vervalt de grondslag dat zorgverzekeraars en Wlz-uitvoerders hun gegevens door één private organisatie mogen laten verwerken voor beleidsmatige doeleinden.
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Korte over de brief Oversterfte (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 2234)

An MP asks why RIVM's excess-mortality monitor is limited to acute spikes, whether long-term excess mortality should be investigated, and whether an independent research programme covering 2023-2024 data should be started. The minister answers that the monitor is designed for short-term signals, that CBS publishes trend analyses, that existing research and data access already exist, and that no new overarching study will be commissioned given the advice and limited budget.
No, as I indicated in the answer to question 2, the purpose of the RIVM mortality monitoring is not to produce long-term mortality trends.
Nee, zoals ik in het antwoord op vraag 2 aangaf, is het doel van de RIVM sterftemonitoring niet het maken van lange termijn sterftetrends.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid de Korte-Verhoef over het bericht dat Top Mondzorg Project Floss over wil nemen

An MP asked the Minister of Health about the planned takeover of dental chain Fresh (Project Floss) by a foreign private equity investor, raising concerns about access, prices, profit extraction and care for vulnerable patients. The Minister answered that quality, access and prices are guarded by IGJ, NZa and ACM supervision, announced a bill on merger review and profit distribution (Wibz) expected in Q2 2026, and called profit-driven practice takeovers unacceptable while saying he sees no current signals of structural price differences.
That is why I am working, together with the NZa, on tightening its merger supervision in healthcare and on more transparency in the business operations of dental chains.
Daarom werk ik, samen met de NZa, aan het aanscherpen van haar fusietoezicht in de zorg en aan meer transparantie in de bedrijfsvoering
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Korte over het bericht van nu.nl waarin staat dat 'De Verenigde Staten willen de import van goederen uit de Europese Unie belasten met een heffing van 30 procent'

MP De Korte asked the State Secretary about the announced 30 percent US tariff on EU imports, including which sectors and firms are at risk and what the EU and Netherlands can do.
