The minister confirmed that government sites used DigiNotar certificates, that these are being replaced in a controlled phased migration, that browser warnings and rogue copies are possible during the transition, and that a separate letter will describe events.
The CIOs of central government and decentralised governments have been designated to direct the conversion of the DigiNotar certificates.
De CIO’s (Chief Information Officers) van Rijk en decentrale overheden zijn aangewezen om de omzetting van de certificaten van DigiNotar aan te sturen.
Vragen van het lid El Fassed (GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Buitenlandse Zaken over internetcertificaten (ingezonden 31 augustus 2011).

An MP asked the ministers about the DigiNotar certificate breach, which let Iran intercept Google traffic, covering oversight of the certificate provider, consequences, responsibility and whether private firms should issue government certificates. The government answered that audits and OPTA supervision existed but did not cover the affected certificates, that it is investigating the whole PKI-Overheid system and the hacking, and that it will inform parliament later.
The Cabinet takes the structural significance of the events into account.
Het Kabinet neemt de structurele betekenis van de gebeurtenissen in ogenschouw.

Vragen van de leden Elissen, Hernandez en Kortenoeven (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie, van Buitenlandse Zaken, van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Defensie over een blunder bij Di

The government confirmed the hack, took over operational management of DigiNotar's certificate systems, announced a ministry investigation of the PKI-Overheid system and oversight, and said the Iran question was still under investigation.
As part of this, the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations is conducting an investigation into the entire PKI-Overheid system and process, including the supervision of it.
Als onderdeel daarvan voert het ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties een onderzoek uit naar het gehele stelsel en proces rondom PKI-Overheid, inclusief het toezicht daarop.

Vragen van het lid Monasch (PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de analyse van het SCP dat het kabinet de middeninkomens in de steek laat door zijn eenzijdige beleid op de woningmarkt

The cabinet pursues an integrated income policy that takes into account all income effects of government policy.
Het kabinet voert een integraal inkomensbeleid dat rekening houdt met alle inkomenseffecten van overheidsbeleid.

De rijks- en gemeentelijke overheid hebben wettelijk geen bevoegdheid om voorwaarden aan het beheer te stellen en/of om de privaatrechterlijke bepalingen en de naleving daarvan te toetsen.
Vragen van het lid Schouw (D66) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de Eindrapportage Spelregels Interbestuurlijke Informatie (ingezonden 16 augustus 2011).

This recent introduction currently makes it impossible to measure the precise effect of the guidelines.
Deze recente invoering maakt het op dit moment niet mogelijk het precieze effect van de spelregels te meten.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de bouw van een moskee met een imperialistische minaret van 27 meter hoog (ingezonden 12 augustu

PVV MPs Van Klaveren and Wilders asked the Minister of Interior Affairs whether he knew of a press report that a mosque with a 27-metre minaret lowers house prices, whether he shares the view that the mosque signals Islamisation, how citizens' views on mosque construction are gathered, the average house-price drop near mosques, and how he views a petition against a mosque in Leiden. deel ik u mee dat het niet mogelijk is deze vragen binnen de gestelde termijn te beantwoorden

Jeugdbeleid valt onder het gedecentraliseerde beleid. De gemeente handelt binnen de beleidsruimte die de gemeente heeft.

Vragen van de leden Agema en Lucassen (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht dat hoogbejaarde ouderen in D

No, I do not share that view.
Nee, die opvatting deel ik niet.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de uitbreiding van NuStar op Sint Eustatius (ingezonden 21 juli 2011).

MP Van Raak asked the Minister of Interior whether the Sint Eustatius island council decides on the NuStar expansion, how archaeological and cultural heritage is protected, how the UNESCO appeal is handled, whether irreversible steps can be prevented, and whether a referendum should be held. It is not for the Minister of BZK to guarantee that no irreversible steps are taken.
Het is niet aan de minister van BZK om te waarborgen dat geen onomkeerbare stappen worden gezet.
Vragen van het lid Driessen (PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht dat de Nexus-directeur de PVV fascistisch noemt. (ingezonden 10 augustus 2011).

It is for the Noord-Brabant provincial executive to weigh the subsidisation of the Nexus Institute and other subsidy-receiving institutions.
Het is aan het bestuur van de provincie Noord-Brabant een afweging te maken betreffende de subsidiëring van het Nexus Instituut en andere subsidieontvangende instellingen.
Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Dille (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de weigering van de Amsterdamse en Tilburgse GGD (ingezonden 30 juni 2011).

Apparently a misunderstanding arose because two studies were confused with each other.
Er is kennelijk een misverstand ontstaan doordat er twee onderzoeken door elkaar zijn gehaald.

Vragen van het lid Van Nieuwenhuizen (VVD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over onderzoek van de GGD naar vermeende kindermishandeling bij de weekendlessen in een Tilburgse moskee (ingezonde

An MP asked the minister whether the GGD had been tasked to investigate alleged child abuse at weekend classes in a Tilburg mosque, and why Tilburg and Amsterdam were not chosen for the GGD study. The minister answered that a misunderstanding had arisen between two separate studies, explained the criteria for city selection, and said the GGD study continues with results expected in late 2011.
Apparently a misunderstanding arose because two studies were confused with each other.
Er is kennelijk een misverstand ontstaan doordat er twee onderzoeken door elkaar zijn gehaald.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het afluisteren van mobiele telefoons van ministers (ingezonden 22 juli 2011).

I see no reason for such a new investigation.
Ik zie geen aanleiding voor een dergelijk nieuw onderzoek.
Vragen van de leden Klijnsma en Monasch (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over levensloopbestendig bouwen (ingezonden 28 juli 2011).

Two MPs asked the Minister of the Interior about the Delft 'Wel Thuis' project on age-appropriate housing, the expected demand for such homes, the digital step-by-step guide's continuity after 2011, and national stimulation of lifetime-suitable building. The Minister welcomed the local project, quantified demand at about 40,000 extra suitable homes per year, said continuity of the guide is a local responsibility, and pointed to an extended support programme until end 2011.
I regard the digital step-by-step plan and the model home as good examples.
Het digitale stappenplan en de modelwoning zie ik als goede voorbeelden.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en De Jong (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de gratis parkeermogelijkheden in verband met de Ramadan (ingez

Two PVV MPs asked whether Bergen op Zoom opened parking barriers for Ramadan, whether this shows growing Islamic influence, and whether the municipality's costs should be cut from the municipal fund. The minister answered that the free night parking was a temporary trial to equalise city-centre parking rules, not related to Ramadan, and that parking policy is a municipal responsibility.
Parking policy is an autonomous task of the municipality.
Het parkeerbeleid is een autonome taak van de gemeente.

Vragen van het lid Neppérus (VVD) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Justitie en de staatssecretaris van Financiën over inbreuk op DigiD (ingezonden 4 augustus 2011).

An MP asked the ministers whether reports that DigiD could easily be cracked by criminals, affecting millions, were known, how this squared with earlier answers, whether the scale would be reexamined, and why some neighbourhoods saw more cracking and what screening applied to contractors' staff. The minister answered that the Tax Administration fraud route had been closed and affected households compensated, that DigiD cannot be fully fraud-proof, that only a few hundred cases had been investigated, and that the contractor case is under FIOD and prosecutorial investigation so no further details can be given.
Because of the ongoing investigation, I cannot currently provide any further information.
Vanwege het lopende onderzoek kan ik op dit moment geen nadere mededelingen doen.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Helder en Wilders (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Justitie over de voortgaande straatterreur door Marokkanen (ingezonden 1

PVV MPs asked the ministers of Interior and Justice about a violent street attack by a group on a 17-year-old, whether the perpetrators should be denaturalised and deported, what measures would end such street violence, and how to interpret a German study linking Muslim youth to aggression. The government condemned the conduct, left sentencing to the prosecutor and courts, said denaturalisation applies only to certain offences and not to simple assault, pointed to existing local order instruments and a letter on criminal youth groups, and declined to draw a link between Islam and the incident.
If prosecution is pursued, it is for the public prosecutor to decide which penalty to request, given the offence, the perpetrator(s) and the harm caused.
Indien tot vervolging wordt overgegaan is het aan het OM welke strafvordering wordt gedaan, gelet op het delict, de persoon van de dader(s) en het aangedane leed.
Vragen van lid De Boer (VVD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over huuraftrek (ingezonden 17 juni 2011).

An MP asked the minister for Interior Affairs whether he had noted and what he thought of a proposal from the EIB to introduce a rent deduction as an alternative to the mortgage interest deduction, including its costs and housing-market effects. The minister said he had noted it, argued it would distort housing-price formation without clear benefit to tenants, and estimated costs would be substantially higher than the EIB's 330 million euro, with no financing offered.
In my view a rent deduction would lead to a distortion of price formation in the housing market, and it is not clear in advance whether the benefits would go to tenants or be captured by landlords.

In mijn ogen zal een huuraftrek leiden tot een verstoring in de prijsvorming in de woningmarkt, waarbij niet op voorhand duidelijk is of de voordelen ten goede zullen komen aan de huurder, dan wel door verhuurders zullen worden afgeroomd.

Vragen van het lid Monasch (PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de problemen van mensen met een laag middeninkomen en mensen met een zorgindicatie bij het vinden van een betaalbare pa

An MP asked the Interior Minister about middle-income households and people with care needs struggling to find affordable suitable rented housing under the new 10% allocation rule tied to the EU state-aid income threshold of EUR 33,614. The minister acknowledged fewer households above the threshold can be allocated social housing, said the data do not yet prove a major problem, declined to raise the threshold or pursue it with the EU, and promised monitoring and ongoing consultation with the European Commission.
A complete picture will emerge on the basis of the results for 2011.
Een compleet beeld zal ontstaan op basis van de resultaten over 2011.
Vragen van lid De Boer aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het weigeren van woningen aan middeninkomens door corporaties (ingezonden 29 juli 2011).

An MP asks whether housing corporations refusing middle-income tenants is linked to the loss of state aid rules, and how large the interest-rate difference from losing WSW guarantees is. The minister explains the 10% rule for renting to middle incomes, the sanction of losing WSW guarantee on new financing, and that the rate effect is about 0.5%, with no change to existing loans.
A 0.5% higher interest rate does not lead to a higher investment amount in social new construction, but on average to an approximately €9,000 higher uneconomic top.
Een 0,5% hogere rente leidt bij sociale nieuwbouw niet tot een hoger investeringsbedrag maar gemiddeld wel tot een ca. € 9 000 hogere «onrendabele top».

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Helder, Agema en Wilders (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Justitie over de aanhoudende ellende door Marokkaanse straatterro

PVV MPs asked the Interior and Justice ministers about recurring youth disturbances by Moroccan-background youths, including proposals to cut benefits to parents, a criminological study on Islam and violence, making offenders pay for police deployment, and snelrecht. The minister rejected cutting parents' benefits and police cost recovery, cited a study of German youths with caution, and said no prosecution arose in the Zandvoort case.
I do not share that view. Withdrawing a welfare benefit or allowances does not contribute to solving the problem.
Die visie deel ik niet. Het intrekken van een bijstandsuitkering of toeslagen draagt niet bij aan de oplossing van de problematiek.
Vragen van het lid Van Klaveren (PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de zoveelste antisemitische uiting van Marokkaanse jongeren (ingezonden 6 juni 2011).

An MP from the PVV asks the Interior Minister about an antisemitic incident involving Moroccan youths disrupting a funeral procession, asking how often such incidents occur, how many suspects were arrested, and whether a study of antisemitism in the Islamic community should go ahead. The minister says the police do not register such disruptions specifically, no complaint was filed and no arrests were made, and rejects a further study since antisemitism occurs across all population groups.
This is not known to me. The police do not specifically register the disruption of funeral processions.
Dit is mij niet bekend. Er wordt door de politie niet specifiek geregistreerd op het verstoren van rouwstoeten.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de samenwerking van de AIVD met de veiligheidsdiensten in Marokko (ingezonden 7 juni 2011).

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior why Saddik Sbaa, reportedly acquitted in the Netherlands, was extradited to Morocco where he risks torture, whether AIVD shared his data with Moroccan services, how such data sharing can be checked, and how many people have been sent to Morocco or the Middle East after failed prosecutions. The minister corrected that the case was dismissed rather than acquitted and that Sbaa left voluntarily, declined to comment on concrete cooperation cases, pointed to the CTIVD report and complaint and oversight routes, and said no overview exists of people who cannot be prosecuted.
I cannot publicly make any statements about the (possible) cooperation of the AIVD with foreign services in concrete cases.
Ik kan in het openbaar geen mededelingen doen over de (eventuele) samenwerking van de AIVD met buitenlandse diensten in concrete gevallen.
Vragen van het lid Van Klaveren (PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de verstoring van een begrafenisstoet door islamitische jongeren (ingezonden 24 juni 2011).

An MP asked the minister whether a funeral procession disrupted by Islamic youths reflects a structural problem tied to Islam, how often such disruptions occurred, how many arrests followed, and how municipalities would be made to act. The minister answered that the incident appears to be the first of its kind, no complaint or arrests were made, there is no structural problem or inherent Islamic hostility, and local government is responsible for public order.
The local government is responsible for public order.
Het lokale bestuur is verantwoordelijk voor de openbare orde.
Vragen van het lid Van Klaveren (PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de verstoorde rouwstoeten door islamitische jongeren (ingezonden 29 juni 2011).

An MP asks the minister about disruption of funeral processions by Muslim youths in Amersfoort, including the school director's remarks, a television comment, and whether there is a link to religious background. The minister condemns the disruptions, says the school has responded with a lesson programme, declines to speculate on motives, and refers to earlier answers for frequency data.
See answer 2, parliamentary questions of 6 June 2011 (Appendix Handelingen, session 2010–2011, no. 3339).
Zie antwoord 2, Kamervragen 6 juni 2011 (Aanhangsel Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2010–2011, nr. 3339 ).
Vragen van het lid Brinkman (PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Rouwterreur onbestraft, politie weigert aangifte» (ingezonden 30 juni 2011).

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether police wrongly refused to take a complaint about insults and disruption of a funeral procession. The government answered that police advised filing a complaint, that the citizen chose not to file for now, and that police repeatedly offered to take it.
It is up to the person(s) concerned themselves to decide whether to file a complaint.
Het is aan de betrokkene(n) zelf om te beslissen aangifte te doen.

Vragen van het lid Van Klaveren (PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Justitie over de honderden eerwraken in de politieregio's Haaglanden, Zuid-Holland-Zuid en Rotterd

An MP asked the ministers of Interior and Justice about reports of hundreds of honour killings per year in three police regions, asking for figures, whether the Muslim community's growth is linked to the problem, and concrete measures. The minister's reply is only a postponement notice stating the questions cannot be answered within the deadline because part of the information is still missing, with a promise to answer as soon as possible.
unfortunately cannot be answered within the set deadline because part of the required information is still missing
helaas niet binnen de gestelde termijn kunnen worden beantwoord, omdat een deel van de benodigde informatie nog ontbreekt

Vragen van de leden Van Dam en Spekman (PvdA) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en voor Immigratie en Asiel over de mogelijke strijdigheid van de Wet Inburgering Buitenland met het EU-recht (

Van Dam and Spekman (PvdA) asked whether the Wet Inburgering Buitenland conflicts with EU family reunification law, citing an Advocate General opinion and an Ombudsman finding that no case had ever qualified as hardship. Minister Donner answered that the law is compatible, that individual cases cannot be discussed, and that a handful of exceptions were made since 2008, with hardship exemptions now registered separately.
I cannot go into the individual circumstances of individual cases when answering written questions.
Ik kan in de beantwoording van schriftelijke vragen niet ingaan op de individuele omstandigheden in individuele zaken.
Vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bouwtoezicht in Almere (ingezonden 19 juli 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of the Interior whether Almere may skip parts of Bouwbesluit checks for private commissioned homes, after a local alderman announced reduced testing, and whether the ministry was informed. The minister answers that gemeenten may vary testing intensity but may not omit checks entirely, that the VROM-Inspectie will examine Almere's practice, and that the minister will report on reducing regulatory burden this autumn.
However, completely refraining from supervising compliance is not possible.
Geheel afzien van toezicht op de naleving is echter niet mogelijk.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de uitbreiding van NuStar op Sint Eustatius (ingezonden 21 juli 2011).

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior about who decides on the NuStar expansion on Sint Eustatius, how cultural and archaeological values are weighed, how a UNESCO appeal is handled, whether irreversible steps can be prevented, and whether a referendum should be held. The minister's reply is only a procedural notice: the questions fall under other responsible ministers, so answers will be delayed and future questions should be addressed to them.
The reason for this is that the questions concern the policy field of other, primarily responsible ministers.
De reden hiervoor is dat de vragen betrekking hebben op het beleidsterrein van andere, primair verantwoordelijke bewindspersonen.
Vragen van het lid Karabulut (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over woningcorporaties die lukraak grond aankopen met gigantische risico’s (ingezonden 19 juli 2011).

MP Karabulut asks the minister of Interior about housing associations buying land recklessly with huge risks, citing CFV findings, and whether the financial supervisor warned earlier, whether the Housing Act should ban such commercial activity, the applicable rules on land purchase and director mandates, and the consequences of the WSG Geertruidenberg losses. The minister disputes the characterisation, says CFV recommendations will be followed up, notes existing rules and planned Woningwet changes, and reports WSG's director was dismissed and a recovery plan adopted.
In the revised housing associations law recently sent to you, the working domain of housing associations is defined exhaustively.
In de u onlangs toegestuurde herzieningswet toegelaten instellingen volkshuisvesting is het werkdomein van woningcorporaties limitatief omschreven.
Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het uitbuiten van buitenlandse studenten (ingezonden 19 juli 2011).

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Minister of Interior about landlord DUWO charging foreign students more for rooms, opaque service costs, a bedding and kitchen fee, a cushion deduction, missing smoke detectors, landlord entry without consent, and whether an investigation into exploitation of foreign students would be carried out. The minister largely defended DUWO's practices as cost-based and legal, pointed to tenants' right to a Huurcommissie review, and said the best remedy is more local student housing via an action plan to be drawn up in autumn with stakeholders.
Increasing the supply of student housing at local level is in my view the best means of countering possible abuses.
Het vergroten van het woningaanbod voor studenten op lokaal niveau is in mijn ogen het beste middel om eventuele misstanden tegen te gaan.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de kosten van het nieuwe rijkslogo (ingezonden 6 juli 2011)

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior about the roughly 15 million euro cost of the new government logo and house style, whether it exceeded estimates, and why certain training courses, gifts, and consultant salaries were paid for. The minister answered that costs stayed within the 18.5 million euro budget, that the courses and gifts were justified as personal effectiveness and testing purposes, and that consultant salaries were anonymised for privacy and fell within norms.
The salary details of PP, EE, CC, QQ and PPP have been anonymised for privacy reasons.
De salarisopgaven van PP, EE, CC, QQ en PPP zijn geanonimiseerd uit privacy-overwegingen.
Vragen van het lid Heijnen (PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de informatie over grote ICT projecten bij het Rijk (ingezonden 8 juli 2011).

MP Heijnen asked the Minister of the Interior whether the Rijks ICT-dashboard gives a transparent picture of large government ICT projects, including how traffic-light colours are set and whether the site is kept up to date. Minister Donner answered that the dashboard mirrors the annual report, that colour ratings compare against the last formal re-estimate, and that he is considering adjustments such as comparing against original estimates and adding contractor information.
I am considering an adjustment to the ICT dashboard so that the colour is determined not only by the deviation from the latest re-estimate, but also takes into account all intermediate re-estimates.

Ik beraad me wel op een aanpassing van het ICT-dashboard waarbij de kleur niet alleen wordt vastgesteld op basis van de afwijking ten opzichte van de laatste herijking, maar waarbij ook alle tussenliggende herijkingen in beschouwing worden genomen.
Vragen van het lid Van Klaveren (PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de verstoring van een begrafenisstoet door islamitische jongeren (ingezonden 24 juni 2011).

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of the Interior about a funeral procession disrupted by Islamic youths in Amersfoort, asking how often this happened, how many suspects were arrested, whether it reflects a structural Islamic aversion to non-Muslims, and how municipalities will be made to act. The minister's reply is only a holding notice: the questions cannot be answered within the deadline because not all data has yet been obtained, with an answer promised as soon as possible.
Answering will take place as soon as possible.
Beantwoording zal zo spoedig mogelijk plaatsvinden.
Vragen van het lid Van Klaveren (PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de verstoorde rouwstoeten door islamitische jongeren (ingezonden 29 juni 2011).

An MP asks the Interior Minister about disrupted funeral processions by Muslim youths, including media coverage, a school director's remarks, a funeral company employee's statement, and whether there is a link to religious background; the minister's reply is only a notice that the answers will be delayed because data is not yet available.
Answering will take place as soon as possible.
Beantwoording zal zo spoedig mogelijk plaatsvinden.

Vragen van het lid Lucassen (PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht dat de minister van Financiën van Sint Maarten de controlerende bevoegdheden van het College Financieel Toe

An MP asked the Minister of Interior and Kingdom Relations about reports that Sint Maarten's finance minister wants to limit the Financial Supervisory Board's (CFT) powers by removing its second approval of budgets. The minister answered that no such request was received from the Sint Maarten government, and that the issue can be avoided if the Estates ensure the Council of Ministers submits budgets only after CFT approval.
Incidentally, no request has been received from the government of Sint Maarten to amend the Kingdom Act.
Van de zijde van de regering van Sint Maarten is overigens geen verzoek ontvangen tot wijziging van de Rijkswet.

Vragen van het lid Lucassen (PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht dat een woningcorporatie door een blunder vijf miljoen euro heeft verloren (ingezonden 17 juni 2011).

Lucassen (PVV) asked the minister of Interior whether housing corporation Lefier lost five million euros through a blunder in a land purchase, whether internal oversight failed, and whether he would investigate and see responsible persons removed. Minister Donner confirmed the loss (about 5.5 million euros written off), stated the corporation is financially sound, said a forensic inquiry led to tighter controls, and declined a government investigation, leaving judgement on personnel to the corporation's boards.
No, see the answer to question 4.
Nee, zie het antwoord op vraag 4.

Vragen van het lid Hennis-Plasschaert (VVD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over Nederlanders woonachtig in het buitenland (niet-EU) en de onmogelijkheid om een Nederlandse identiteitskaart

An MP asked why Dutch nationals living outside the EU and certain European countries cannot apply for a Dutch identity card in their country of residence, and whether this would be changed. The minister explained the card is only valid in listed countries and that a pending Paspoortwet amendment will end its travel-document status, so he sees little reason to extend applications abroad given the costs.

Especially against that background, I see little reason to make it possible for people living in a country where they cannot use the Dutch identity card as an identity card, nor as a travel document to the Netherlands, to still obtain the Dutch identity card in their country of residence.

Zeker tegen die achtergrond zie ik weinig aanleiding om het mogelijk te maken om mensen die wonen in een land waar ze de Nederlandse identiteitskaart niet kunnen gebruiken als identiteitskaart en deze ook niet kunnen gebruiken als reisdocument naar Nederland, de mogelijkheid te bieden de Nederlandse identiteitskaart toch in hun land van verblijf te krijgen.
Vragen van het lid De Boer (VVD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over energieverbruik van warmtepompen (ingezonden 22 juni 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the EPC energy rules fail to ensure heat pumps perform as expected, why residents are not informed about high energy use, who is liable for losses at Zutphen, and how many homes are affected. The minister replied that no regulation yet covers overall heat pump performance, that information duties lie with suppliers and that a certification trajectory, guidance and an AMvB are planned, while liability in Zutphen is under discussion.
There is currently no regulation for heat pumps covering the integral quality of the installation, including energy efficiency.
Er is thans geen regelgeving voor warmtepompen die betrekking heeft op de integrale kwaliteit van de installatie, inclusief energierendement.
Vragen van het lid Marcouch (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de brandweerkorpsen die te weinig tegen agressie en geweld tegen hun personeel doen (ingezonden 3 mei 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why eleven fire brigade units received warnings from the Labour Inspectorate for insufficient measures against aggression and violence toward staff, which units still fall short, and what the Public Prosecution Service and police are doing about reporting and prosecution. The government answered that eight units still do not meet the inspectorate's requirements, that the responsibility lies mainly with the employers and regional safety councils, and that it is strengthening reporting, prosecution and monitoring through existing programmes.
The Minister of Security and Justice will press for the fire brigade units to meet the requirements set by the Labour Inspectorate as soon as possible.
De Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie zal er op aandringen dat de brandweerkorpsen op zo kort mogelijke termijn voldoen aan de door de Arbeidsinspectie gestelde eisen

Vragen van het lid Van Klaveren (PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het gegeven dat nog slechts de helft van de Amsterdammers autochtoon is (ingezonden 31 mei 2011).

An MP asked the minister about reports that only half of Amsterdam residents are native Dutch, linking this to immigrant overrepresentation in welfare dependency, school dropout and crime, and asked whether this trend and the multicultural society's failure are acceptable. The minister rejected the framing that origin is decisive, gave demographic projections for G4 cities, and referred to a forthcoming letter on integration.
There is no indication that origin is of decisive significance.
Er is geen indicatie dat afkomst van doorslaggevende betekenis is.
Vragen van het lid Elissen (PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de gemeente Eindhoven die op onverantwoorde wijze bankier speelt (ingezonden 27 mei 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Interior whether Eindhoven's land transaction with PSV is an unsound financial risk, covert state aid, and unfair competition with commercial lenders, and whether measures will follow. The minister answers that financial risk and state-aid compliance are primarily municipal responsibilities, the Commission has been asked to explain, and the minister has no role in judging competition or taking action against the municipality.
Within the framework of the financial autonomy of decentralised governments, it is for the municipality itself to decide which policy it applies regarding professional top sport.
Het is, in het kader van de financiële autonomie van decentrale overheden, aan de gemeente zelf welk beleid zij hanteert met betrekking tot professionele topsport.
Vragen van het lid Monasch (PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het op voorraad bouwen van de Rijksgebouwendienst (ingezonden 7 juni 2011).

The MP Monasch asked the Minister of Interior whether the Rijksgebouwendienst would build office space speculatively in Zwolle, whether this is a precursor to relocating government services there, and how it fits with a motion on shrinking regions. The minister denied speculative building, said the plan concerns efficient housing of existing services under the Compacte Rijksdienst programme, and said Zwolle is not a shrinkage region.
No. There is no speculative building in Zwolle.
Nee. Er is in Zwolle geen sprake van bouwen op voorraad.
Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over inkoop van duurzaam hout (ingezonden 12 april 2011).

An MP asks the State Secretary about a Milieudefensie report finding that 70% of audited central-government projects contained wood not meeting the government's sustainable timber criteria, and about the government's failure to meet its own procurement standards. The State Secretary acknowledges shortcomings in contract compliance and supply-chain verification, commits to exploring improvements with Milieudefensie and market parties, but rejects the advice to require FSC specifically.
Although the 100% target has not yet been reached, I conclude from this that the sustainable timber procurement criteria are widely applied in central-government projects.
Hoewel de 100% nog niet gehaald wordt, concludeer ik hieruit dat de inkoopcriteria voor duurzaam hout breed worden toegepast in rijksprojecten.
Vragen van het lid Hachchi (D66) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht dat inwoners van Curaçao ziek zijn door vervuild water (ingezonden 16 juni 2011).

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of the Interior about reports that residents of Curaçao were ill from contaminated tap water, asking for the government's reaction, whether Curaçao's government responded adequately, and whether the Netherlands would offer analysis capacity. The Minister declined to comment on the press report, said judging Curaçao's response falls to its own Staten, and said assistance depends on a request from Curaçao's government.
It does not befit me to give a judgment on the response of the Curaçao government.
Het past mij niet een oordeel te geven over de reactie van de regering van Curaçao.
Vragen van het lid Van Dam (PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het onderzoek naar de integriteit van instituties op Curaçao (ingezonden 23 juni 2011).

Rep. Van Dam (PvdA) asks the Minister of Interior about the scope, legal basis and independence of the Kingdom Council of Ministers' inquiry into institutional integrity on Curaçao, including the Central Bank dispute and Curaçao's withdrawal of consent. The minister's communication states the questions were already answered in the 29 June debate and no written answer is needed.
All these questions were raised and answered in the debate on this matter on 29 June.
Al deze vragen zijn aan de orde gekomen en beantwoord in het debat over deze materie op 29 juni jl.
Vragen van het lid Lucassen (PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht: «Donner: Geen onderzoek naar regering Curaçao» (ingezonden 28 juni 2011).

An MP asked the Interior Minister about reports that a commission would investigate the integrity of Curaçao's central bank and its director, but not the Curaçao government, including its composition, powers, legal basis, and alleged corruption. The minister's communication states that all these written questions were already answered in a parliamentary debate on 29 June, so no further written answers are required.
All these questions were raised and answered in the debate on this subject on 29 June.
Al deze vragen zijn aan de orde gekomen en beantwoord in het debat over deze materie op 29 juni jl.
Vragen van het lid Schouw (D66) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het stopzetten van de opslag van vingerafdrukken (ingezonden 21 juni 2011).

An MP from D66 asked the Interior Minister why fingerprint storage in decentralised passport databases had not yet been stopped despite the government's own statements that it should be, and about the timetable and possible exemptions for conscientious objectors. The minister replied that shortened retention rules and updated software took effect on 23-24 June 2011, that rollout to all issuing bodies was planned by end July, that full removal of stored traces would be clarified by September, and that the EU rules leave no exemption for conscientious objectors.
I will then inform the House about the planning.
Ik zal dan de Kamer over de planning informeren.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de samenwerking van de AIVD met de veiligheidsdiensten in Marokko (ingezonden 7 juni 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of the Interior why persons acquitted in the Netherlands, such as Saddik Sbaa, are extradited to Morocco where they risk torture, whether the AIVD shared his data with Moroccan services in breach of agreements, how people can check AIVD data shared abroad, how many have been extradited in the past, and whether the AIVD shares data with or uses information from services that torture. The Minister replies only that the questions cannot be answered within the set deadline because not all relevant information has been obtained yet, and that answers will follow once it is.
Answering will take place as soon as all relevant information has been obtained.
Beantwoording zal plaatsvinden zodra alle relevante informatie is verkregen.

Vragen van de leden Schouw en Van Veldhoven (beiden D66) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht dat provincies d

D66 MPs asked the ministers of Interior and of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation how they respond to a report finding provinces involve citizens in landscape policy only at informing, consulting and advising levels, and what they will do to broaden participation as landscape tasks are decentralised. The government disputes the reading, says provinces use many participation instruments, says involving active citizens is difficult, and points to existing programmes and a forthcoming agenda on civic participation, while leaving the choice of participation methods to provinces and municipalities.

Vragen van het lid Schouw (D66) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en voor Immigratie en Asiel over het bericht van dat stateloze Roma met kinderen naar Ter Apel worden gestuurd zonder dat zij

An MP asked the ministers whether stateless Roma children are being moved to the Ter Apel facility without being removable, and about nationality acquisition, EU citizenship and the 12-week detention period. The government defended nationality rules and the use of the restricted-freedom location as a means to keep migrants in reach for return, and refused to exempt children from transfer.
Are you prepared, in situations where the expected preparation time for departure exceeds the usual twelve weeks, to refrain from moving children to Ter Apel? No.
Vraag 6 Bent u bereid in situaties waarin de voorziene voorbereidingstijd voor vertrek de gebruikelijke twaalf weken overschrijdt, af te zien van het verplaatsen van kinderen naar Ter Apel?
Vragen van het lid Van Gent (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over een incident bij de ISLA raffinaderij te Curaçao (ingezonden 7 juni 2011).

An MP asks the Interior Minister whether catalyst powder released in an incident at the ISLA refinery on Curaçao contained heavy metals, whether ISLA refuses to disclose its composition, and whether the minister will urge the Curaçao government to inform residents promptly after incidents. The minister declines to confirm the reports, says Curaçao's government is responsible for informing its parliament and population, and states that relations between the Curaçao administration and its population are a matter for Curaçao under the Statute.
It is the government of Curaçao that is responsible for providing information to the Curaçao parliament and the population.
Het is de regering van Curaçao die verantwoordelijk is voor de informatieverstrekking naar het Curaçaose parlement en de bevolking.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het falen van de AIVD om de notificatieplicht uit te voeren (ingezonden 17 juni 2011).

MP Van Raak asked why the AIVD has failed to carry out its statutory duty to notify citizens who were subject to surveillance, and whether an investigation into the failure would be ordered. Minister Donner answered that the CTIVD's 2010 review found the AIVD largely compliant with the notification duty, with a few erroneous decisions the AIVD has since reconsidered, and that the CTIVD monitors notification ongoingly.
The CTIVD finds that the AIVD, with a single exception, has implemented the notification duty in accordance with the statutory requirements.
De CTIVD constateert dat de AIVD, een enkele uitzondering daargelaten, de notificatieplicht overeenkomstig de wettelijke vereisten ten uitvoer heeft gelegd.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Helder en Brinkman (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Justitie over een weggepest gezin uit Utrecht (ingezonden 3 mei 2011).

PVV MPs asked the Interior and Justice ministers about reports that a family was driven out of a Utrecht neighbourhood by street harassment, and whether the mayor should be removed. The minister says all possible measures were taken, rejects removing the mayor, and lists existing tools such as area bans, behavioural orders and planned restraining measures while ruling out a lifelong area ban.
Inquiries with the municipality of Utrecht have shown that all possible efforts were made to reduce the nuisance.
Navraag bij de gemeente Utrecht heeft opgeleverd dat alle mogelijke inspanningen zijn verricht om de overlast te doen verminderen.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Driessen (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de graai- en bonuscultuur binnen subsidie-instituut Forum (ingezonden 26 mei 2011).

PVV MPs asked the Minister of the Interior about alleged bonus and perk culture at subsidised institute FORUM, including luxury hotel stays and a director's salary, and whether the supervisory board can be trusted. The minister replied that subsidised bodies set their own secondary conditions, that the supervisory board is responsible, that no bonus scheme is known, and that a factual report has been requested for the parliamentary committee.

In response to the request from the parliamentary committee for a factual investigation into events at FORUM, I have asked the FORUM Supervisory Board to send me a factual account as soon as possible.

Mede naar aanleiding van het verzoek van de vaste commissie voor Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties van de Tweede Kamer voor een feitenonderzoek naar de gang van zaken binnen FORUM heb ik de Raad van Toezicht van FORUM verzocht om mij ten spoedigste een feitenrelaas te doen toekomen.

Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het Nationaal Historisch Museum (ingezonden 31 mei 2011).

An MP asked the ministers about the Province of Utrecht's proposal to house the National History Museum in Paleis Soestdijk, transferred to a foundation for a symbolic sum, and whether the government would reconsider and consult the parties. The government replied that it had decided not to subsidise a building for the museum, that the ministers would not reopen talks given that decision, and that the museum's future funding decision had been communicated in the June cultural infrastructure letter.
Given the earlier decision to stop subsidising the NHM, I see no reason to do so.
Gezien het eerder genomen besluit om het NHM niet langer te subsidiëren zie ik daar geen aanleiding toe.

Vragen van het lid Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de uitspraken van de minister in het programma T

The MP asks about the cost and maintenance of Paleis Soestdijk, its possible reuse and the future of the Nationaal Historisch Museum, including whether the government will commission a feasibility study. The minister replies that renovation costs exceed EUR 100 million with no funds available, that the state as owner bears upkeep, that the NHM's future is for the foundation to decide, and that no feasibility study will be commissioned.
The cabinet takes no position on dissolving the NHM.
Het kabinet neemt geen standpunt in over het opheffen van het NHM.

Vragen van de leden Schouw en Van Veldhoven (beiden D66) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht dat provincies d

MPs Schouw and Van Veldhoven asked the ministers how provinces involve citizens in landscape policy, given a report finding participation limited to consultation and mainly active citizens. The government sent only an interim notice that the questions could not be answered within the deadline because not all data had been obtained, with answers to follow later.
The reason is that not all data has yet been obtained. The answers will be provided as soon as all information has been received.
Oorzaak hiervan is dat nog niet alle gegevens zijn verkregen. Beantwoording zal plaatsvinden zodra alle informatie is verkregen.

Vragen van de leden Van Dam en Spekman (beiden PvdA) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de mogelijke strijdigheid van de Wet Inburgering Buitenland de Gezinsherenigingsrichtlijn (ingezonden 30 mei 2011).

MPs Van Dam and Spekman asked the minister whether the Wet Inburgering Buitenland conflicts with the EU Family Reunification Directive after a Zwolle court referred questions to the European Court, and why the minister granted an exemption and visa in one case after two years of defending the policy. The minister confirmed the individual exemption was granted on case-specific grounds, maintained that the law is compatible with the directive, and said the referral was the court's own competence.
The reason for granting was a combination of several individual facts and circumstances raised on appeal that led to the conclusion that this is a very special case.

De reden voor inwilliging is gelegen in een combinatie van een aantal, in beroep opgekomen c.q. aangevoerde, individuele feiten en omstandigheden welke tot de conclusie hebben geleid dat sprake is van een zeer bijzonder geval.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de Commissie integriteit overheid (ingezonden 6 juni 2011).

MP Van Raak asks the Minister of the Interior about the Commission on Government Integrity (CIO), including its role in protecting whistleblowers, criticism from the expert group and others, and whether the CIO keeps a central role under the proposed advice and referral point. The Minister disagrees that whistleblowers are difficult people, agrees a different body is needed, and says he is working to replace the CIO with a government integrity reporting point with investigative powers.
I am working on replacing the CIO with a government integrity violations reporting point with investigative powers.
Ik werk aan vervanging van de CIO door een meldpunt integriteitsschendingen overheid met onderzoeksbevoegdheid.

Vragen van het lid Elissen (PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de AIVD die als vriendendienst medewerkers detacheert bij extreemlinkse terreurnetwerken (ingezonden 7 juni 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether an AIVD infiltrant worked for decades in left-wing extremist networks, whether the AIVD supported such groups or helped organise violent actions, and how the AIVD relates to the Fortuyn murder and the Anti-Fascistische Aktie. The Minister declined to comment on the specific infiltrant and operations, citing the legal duty to protect sources, while confirming that the AIVD may legally instruct agents to take actions that could enable offences but that provocation is forbidden.
The AIVD is legally obliged to keep its sources secret.
De AIVD is wettelijk verplicht zijn bronnen geheim te houden.

Vragen van het lid Karabulut (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de gouden handdruk van € 425 000 euro voor oud-directeur van woningcorporatie Woonbron (ingezonden 8 juni 2011).

The SP MP Karabulut asked the minister whether a €425,000 severance payment to the former director of housing corporation Woonbron, after large losses, is acceptable and what the government will do to prevent such payments. The minister answered that remuneration policy is the responsibility of the supervisory board, that a sector remuneration code applies, and that statutory norming of top pay will only be possible once the WNT bill passes.
It is the responsibility of the supervisory board to set the policy on remuneration and severance arrangements for the executives.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de raad van toezicht om het beleid inzake beloningen en ontslagregelingen voor de bestuurders vast te stellen.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de inzet van journalisten door de veiligheidsdiensten (ingezonden 8 juni 2011).

MP Van Raak asked the Minister of Interior whether the AIVD has infiltrated political organisations since WWII, whether it was involved in activities resulting in violence, how many journalists it deploys and whether the minister knew of such activities. The minister refused to disclose operational details, stated that agents may be deployed under Wiv 2002 rules, and declined to confirm whether an infiltrant also worked as a journalist.
In public I cannot make statements about concrete operational activities, including infiltration of organisations carrying out political activities, by the AIVD or its predecessor the BVD.

In het openbaar kan ik geen mededelingen doen over concrete operationele activiteiten, waaronder begrepen infiltratie in organisaties die politieke activiteiten verrichten, van de AIVD of diens voorganger de BVD.
Vragen van het lid Van Bochove (CDA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over verloting van woningen (ingezonden 9 juni 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether Dudok Wonen's lottery giving 50 applicants a home at 50% discount, and whether a 'Kopen naar wens' scheme, needed legal approval and was a proper way to help starters. The minister answered that the scheme is a split purchase with erfpacht rather than a discount, requires no ministerial permission, and that the lottery is a fair way to allocate scarce homes, and that Dudok currently complies with the rules.
No legal permission is needed for such a lottery.
Voor een dergelijke verloting is geen wettelijke toestemming nodig.

Vragen van de leden Karabulut (SP), Voortman (GroenLinks), Monasch (PvdA) en Van Bochove (CDA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de Maastrichtse woningcorporatie Servatius (ingezonden 28

Opposition and coalition MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether the WSW guarantee fund could cover liquidity shortfalls at Maastricht housing corporation Servatius, including the Campus Calatrava losses, and why a sanitation route via CFV was not used. The minister answered that WSW guarantees under category 6 were permitted, that the financing plan was approved by the appointed supervisor and the CFV/WSW, and that the planned sale of 1,850 homes was acceptable and that no formal council decision was needed.
It has been agreed with the backstoppers (the State and municipalities) that in all cases where the WSW considers guarantees under category 6, consultation with the backstoppers takes place first.
Met de achtervangers (Rijk en gemeenten) is afgesproken dat in alle gevallen dat het WSW borging onder categorie 6 overweegt, eerst overleg plaatsvindt met de achtervangers.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het absurde RMO-advies immigranten de taal niet meer te leren (ingezonden 18 mei 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether the RMO advice to drop mandatory Dutch language and cultural requirements for immigrants conflicts with the cabinet's integration vision, and whether the RMO should be abolished. The minister acknowledged the advice is partly out of line with the integration vision, promised a cabinet response by mid-August 2011 under the Advisory Councils Act, and rejected the view that the RMO should be dismantled.
In accordance with the Advisory Councils Act, the cabinet will send both chambers its response to the advice no later than mid-August 2011.
Conform de Kaderwet op de Adviescolleges zal het kabinet beide Kamers uiterlijk medio augustus 2011 zijn reactie op het advies doen toekomen.
Vragen van het lid Elissen (PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de gemeente Eindhoven die op onverantwoorde wijze bankier speelt (ingezonden 27 mei 2011).

An MP asks the Interior Minister whether Eindhoven municipality's EUR 48.4 million support for PSV amounts to unlawful state aid, excessive financial risk and unfair competition with commercial lenders, and whether measures will follow. The minister replies only that the questions cannot be answered within the deadline because not all required information has yet been obtained, and that answers will follow later.
Answers will be provided as soon as all the information has been obtained.
Beantwoording zal plaatsvinden zodra alle informatie is verkregen.

Vragen van het lid Karabulut (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht dat woningcorporatie Haag Wonen huurders tot 2017 in krotten laat wonen (ingezonden 25 mei 2011).

An MP asked whether it is acceptable that tenants of housing corporation Haag Wonen remain in dilapidated, unsafe homes in the Schilderswijk until demolition around 2017, and whether residents should get urgent-housing status. The minister said the maintenance responsibility lies with the owner, the municipality supervises minimum building standards, decisions on large-scale improvements are expected within a few years, and urgency status is a municipal responsibility on which he would not comment.
The municipality of The Hague monitors that dwellings at least meet the requirements for existing construction in the Building Decree.
De gemeente Den Haag ziet er op toe dat woningen minimaal voldoen aan de voorschriften voor bestaande bouw uit het Bouwbesluit.
Vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over ingestorte galerijen in Leeuwarden (ingezonden 26 mei 2011).

An MP asked the Interior Minister whether the construction system and balcony detailing of the collapsed Antillenflat in Leeuwarden are used elsewhere, and whether a rapid investigation into similar risks would be done. The minister said there was too little information yet, would wait for the owners' association investigation, then check with the VROM-Inspectie and inform owners and municipalities, with an update expected in September 2011.
Since there is currently still insufficient information known about the Antillenflat, I cannot answer this question.
Aangezien op dit moment nog onvoldoende informatie over de Antillenflat bekend is, kan ik geen antwoord geven op deze vraag.
Vragen van het lid Lucassen (PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het instorten van balkons van een flat in Leeuwarden (ingezonden 27 mei 2011).

An MP asked the Interior Minister whether 1950s-1960s flats face elevated collapse risk, how they are inspected, and whether balconies are the main defect source after a balcony collapse in Leeuwarden. The minister said there is no evidence of elevated risk, owners must ensure safety under the Woningwet, inspection methods are not prescribed and municipal oversight is limited to complaints, and that only 3 of 163 reported defects concerned balconies; he referred to earlier answers on the investigation.
I have no information showing that these residential buildings face an elevated risk of collapse compared with other existing buildings.
Ik beschik niet over informatie waaruit blijkt dat deze woongebouwen een verhoogd risico lopen op instorting in vergelijking met andere bestaande gebouwen.

Vragen van het lid Marcouch (PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over rellen en vernielingen bij het huis van de burgemeester van Urk (ingezonden 13 mei 2011

An MP asked the ministers of Justice and Security and of the Interior about riots and vandalism at the Urk mayor's home, the police investigation, the mayor's protection, and whether the Urk culture-change approach is sufficient. The ministers said the mayor deserves support, a criminal investigation is ongoing with three arrests, and that the police and municipality handle the situation locally, with no further intervention planned beyond existing measures.
To protect the investigation, no further details can be given about the start of the investigation, its progress, and the cooperation received.
Ter bescherming van het opsporingsbelang kunnen geen verdere bijzonderheden worden gegeven over de start van het onderzoek, het verloop daarvan en de medewerking daaraan.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Driessen (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bizarre subsidiebeleid van het stadsdeel Amsterdam-Oost (ingezonden 18 mei 2011).

PVV MPs asked the Minister of the Interior about subsidies granted by the Amsterdam-Oost district to organisations offering headscarf-folding lessons, funerals in Egypt and Turkish or Moroccan language classes, questioning how this fits the coalition agreement. The minister replied that municipalities set their own subsidy policy within legal limits, declined to judge Amsterdam's policy or accept the insulting characterisations, and planned no measures.
Decentralised governments are free, within the limits of the law, to determine their own subsidy policy.
Decentrale overheden zijn vrij om – binnen de grenzen van de wet – zelf hun subsidiebeleid te bepalen.
Vragen van het lid Elissen (PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de provincie Utrecht die een bedrijf opricht (ingezonden 20 mei 2011).

PVV MP Elissen asked the Interior Minister about Utrecht province founding a limited company (NV) to redevelop business parks, raising concerns about risk, state aid, unfair competition, democratic control and overhead costs. The minister approved the NV, argued the province retains oversight as sole shareholder, denied that funds would be clawed back from the provinciefonds, and said the province itself must assess state aid rules.

At least through the annual accounts, in particular the section on affiliated parties and any risks in the resilience section, Gedeputeerde Staten account annually to Provinciale Staten for the results of the participation.

Via tenminste de jaarstukken, in het bijzonder de paragraaf Verbonden Partijen en de in de paragraaf weerstandsvermogen opgenomen eventuele risico’s, legt Gedeputeerde Staten jaarlijks verantwoording af aan Provinciale Staten
Vragen van de leden Monasch en Plasterk (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Financiën over erfpachttarieven (ingezonden 8 april 2011).

MPs Monasch and Plasterk asked ministers about banks refusing mortgages on leasehold (erfpacht) land and steep leasehold rent increases by municipalities such as Bernheze. The minister answered that banks see no current problem with mortgages on municipal leasehold, that a roundtable has agreed criteria and model contracts to be developed over four months, and that rent-rise validity is a matter for other ministers and letters.
I cannot make a statement on the validity of proposed increases in leasehold rates.
Ik kan geen uitspraak doen over de validiteit van voorgestelde stijgingen van erfpachttarieven.

Vragen van het lid Van der Burg (VVD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de regeling uitkering substantieel bezwarende functies (SBF)-regeling (ingezonden 21 april 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about the SBF scheme for demanding civil service jobs, including changes that send some employees on unpaid leave at 60 before dismissal, premium and pension effects, and the tax treatment. The Minister described the four age groups, the transitional arrangements, the 80% benefit, the ZVW premium rules and the tax basis, without addressing all of the income-loss concerns directly.
The Regeling uitkering substantieel bezwarende functies 2006 was introduced in 2008 with retroactive effect to 1 January 2006.
De Regeling uitkering substantieel bezwarende functies 2006 is in 2008 ingevoerd met terugwerkende kracht tot 1 januari 2006.
Vragen van het lid Hachchi (D66) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het wegjagen van jong talent bij de overheid. (Ingezonden 10 mei 2011).

An MP from D66 asked the Interior Minister about a survey showing civil servants fear budget cuts will drive young talent away from government, and about succession planning and staffing. The government answered that continuity is not at risk, that young people's exit cannot yet be confirmed from figures, and that it will keep investing in youth intake and discuss retention with unions and local governments.
I am of the view that there is no reason for concern about continuity in operations.
Ik ben van mening dat er geen reden is tot zorg over de continuïteit in de bedrijfsvoering.
Vragen van het lid Schouw (D66) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de openbaarheid van bestuur (ingezonden 13 mei 2011).

The MP asks why the minister did not first carry out three promised actions on freedom of information (reaction to the draft General Information Act, consequences of joining the Council of Europe access convention, and a position on an anti-abuse rule in the Wob) before publicly stating views at a press freedom event, and when these will be done. The minister answers that he is preparing Wob amendments, will incorporate some draft proposals, has an in-progress inventory on the convention with no priority for ratification, and sent a letter on the Wob that addresses the three points.
Mapping the consequences of possibly becoming a party to the Council of Europe Convention on Access to Official Documents requires considerable interdepartmental coordination.
Het in kaart brengen van de consequenties van het eventueel partij worden bij het Verdrag inzake toegang tot officiële documenten vergt een aanzienlijke interdepartementale afstemming.
Vragen van de leden Haverkamp en Koopmans (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het artikel «Vrije meningsuiting beknot» (ingezonden 29 april 2011).

MPs Haverkamp and Koopmans asked the Interior Minister whether Wijdemeren's move to commercially tender outdoor advertising boards threatens free expression, since local associations may lose free posting space. The minister confirmed the change, said eight free digital and poster boards remain for non-commercial notices, and declined to consult the VNG or take further action.
In the case of the municipality of Wijdemeren, as indicated, space remains for posting non-commercial messages through the installation of the eight digital information boards.
In het geval van de gemeente Wijdemeren blijft er, zoals aangegeven, ruimte voor het plaatsen van niet-commerciële berichten met het installeren van de acht digitale informatieborden.

Vragen van de leden Hennis-Plasschaert (VVD) en Van Nieuwenhuizen (beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Justitie over problemen rondom het burgerlijk huwelijk (i

MPs Hennis-Plasschaert and Van Nieuwenhuizen asked whether civil registrars may marry couples already religiously wed, how a legal ban could work, and how to ensure couples understand the ceremony. The minister answered that religious ceremonies have no legal effect, a statutory ban would be counterproductive, and registrars must be satisfied couples understand, with interpreters arranged if needed.
Giving formal status to an earlier religious ceremony would undermine the principle that the Netherlands recognises only civil marriage.
Het geven van een formele status aan een eerdere religieuze plechtigheid zou afbreuk doen aan het uitgangspunt dat Nederland alleen het burgerlijk huwelijk kent.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Helder en Brinkman (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Justitie over een weggepest gezin uit Utrecht (ingezonden 3 mei 2011).

PVV MPs ask the ministers of Interior and of Security and Justice about a family allegedly driven out of a Utrecht neighbourhood by street harassment, asking whether mayor Wolfsen can be removed and what measures will be taken against street terrorists and their families. The government reply is only an interim notice stating the questions cannot be answered within the set deadline because not all necessary information is yet available.
Not all the necessary information needed to answer these parliamentary questions is yet available.
Voor de beantwoording van deze kamervragen is nog niet alle noodzakelijke informatie voorhanden.
Vragen de leden De Boer en Ziengs (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het artikel «Nieuwbouwwoning kost circa 50 000 euro meer» (ingezonden 19 april 2011).

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Interior about a newspaper report that new-build homes cost about 50,000 euros more because of Dutch regulation, and whether he would analyse the price effects of building rules. The minister agreed that construction regulation raises dwelling costs, noted energy-saving benefits, and said he is willing to address building costs, though the study offers limited basis for the requested analysis and he will return to it via the Dekker committee recommendations.
The aforementioned study offers less grounding for the requested analysis because it focuses mainly on the cost effect of regulation and not on its cost-saving effect.
Voornoemde studie biedt minder houvast voor de gevraagde analyse omdat deze vooral op het kosteneffect van regelgeving let en niet op het kostenbesparend effect daarvan.

Vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over mogelijk misbruik van ontheffing ingezetenschap door wethouders (ingezonden 17 mei 2011).

An MP asks the Interior Minister whether a Langedijk alderman's exemption from the residence requirement, which was not complied with, reflects misuse and whether the exemption should be contested by the Crown, and how often exemptions are granted. The minister says he reaffirms the residence requirement as the rule, declines to assess the specific case or to forward a nullification request, and agrees to investigate the frequency and reasons for extensions of exemptions by autumn.
I am willing to examine further how often extensions of exemption were granted in the first half of 2011 and what the experience of the councils involved is with the decision-making on this.
Ik ben bereid nader te onderzoeken hoe vaak in de eerste helft van 2011 verlenging van ontheffing is verleend en wat de ervaring is van betrokken raden bij de besluitvorming hieromtrent.

Vragen van de leden Van Gent en Peters (beiden GroenLinks) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de minister-president, minister van Algemene Zaken over de informatievoorziening aan het parleme

Two GroenLinks MPs asked whether the cabinet's information provision to parliament is adequate: whether risks and counter-indications must be disclosed, whether publicly funded commissioned research must be accessible and published, and whether documents should be provided five days before debates. The minister denied a recurring pattern of deficient information, said the active duty covers relevant facts and arguments including contra-indications, reaffirmed publication of commissioned research by default, and declined a fixed five-day deadline because parliament sets its own agenda.
The government endeavours to inform the House as timely and as fully as possible.
De regering tracht de Kamer tijdig en zo volledig mogelijk te informeren.

Vragen van het lid Van Gent (GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties, van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over abortus en anticonceptie op Cura

An MP asks ministers whether the Kingdom's guarantee function under Article 43(2) of the Statute should be applied given the abortion ban and limited contraception access on Curaçao causing serious complications. The government answers that public health on Curaçao is the country's own responsibility, that the Kingdom guarantee only applies when rights are structurally unprotected, and that it will convey concerns to the Curaçao government.
Promoting public health on Curaçao falls under the responsibility of the country Curaçao.
Het bevorderen van de volksgezondheid op Curaçao behoort tot de verantwoordelijkheid van het land Curaçao.

An MP asks the Interior Minister why the former BVD/AIVD kept long-running surveillance on environmental activist Van Duijn, whether the agency will assess its files, and why his complaint was not handled and the CTIVD was not asked to inventory his file.
