No national figures are known regarding the number of splitting permits.
Over het aantal splitsingsvergunningen zijn geen landelijke cijfers bekend.

Vragen van het lid Leegte (VVD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht dat het budget voor de regeling maatwerkadviezen voor woningen is uitgeput (ingezonden 26 november 2010).

An MP asks why the budget for the home tailored energy advice subsidy was exhausted within weeks, what the consequences are for citizens and municipalities, whether those disappointed can be compensated, and how effectiveness is assessed. The minister attributes the rapid exhaustion to communication campaigns and a grouped application option, raises the budget once by about 1.2 million euros to clear the waiting list, says the scheme will not continue, and cites an interim evaluation.
To accommodate citizens, it was decided at the end of 2010 to one-off increase the maximum subsidy budget for 2010 by almost 1.2 million euros.
Om burgers tegemoet te komen is eind 2010 besloten om het maximale subsidiebudget in 2010 eenmalig op te hogen met bijna € 1,2 miljoen.
Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de vondst van explosieven bij de milieudienst in Dordrecht (ingezonden 4 januari 2011).

Green Left MP Van Tongeren asked the Justice minister about explosives found at the Dordrecht environmental service and whether threats came from landlords, whether similar threats occur, whether the municipality requested help, whether enforcement capacity is affected, and which preventive measures apply. The minister declined to give details of the ongoing police investigation, said such severe threats are rare, noted that the municipality requested no help, said no enforcement shortage arose, and pointed to responsibility of employers and local authorities plus the national VPT programme.
In the interest of the investigation, no further statements can be made about this.
In het belang van het onderzoek kunnen hierover verder geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de inhuur van dure externen (ingezonden 12 januari 2011).

MP Van Raak (SP) asked the Minister of Interior about a reported rise in costly external hires in the public sector and how the government would curb them, including long-serving 'near employees'. The Minister answered that the Atos report did not measure actual hiring growth in government, so no new measures were needed, and that existing external-hiring controls already cover these concerns.
For me, the research is therefore not a reason to adjust the control instruments for external hiring used within central government (spending norm and maximum hourly rate) or to take other measures.

Voor mij is het onderzoek derhalve geen aanleiding het sturingsinstrumentarium externe inhuur zoals dat binnen de rijksoverheid wordt gehanteerd (uitgavennorm en maximumuurtarief) aan te passen of andere maatregelen te treffen.
Vragen het lid Monasch (PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over een reddingsplan voor de huizenmarkt (ingezonden 21 januari 2011).

Monasch (PvdA) asked the minister whether he supports calls for a rescue plan for the housing market, a national housing accord, abolishing subsidies and taxes that hinder mobility, and the impact of stricter mortgage rules on starters. The minister answered that a round table on the Woonvisie is under way, that the mortgage interest deduction is essential to restore confidence, and referred to earlier answers and letters on mortgage rules.
On 9 February, at my initiative, there was a first meeting with parties.
Op 9 februari is er op mijn initiatief een eerste gesprek met partijen geweest.

Vragen van de leden Slob en Ortega-Martijn (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Financiën en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het stopzetten van tenders (ingezonden 4 januari 2011).

MPs Slob and Ortega-Martijn asked whether the government had halted new Rijksgebouwendienst investment projects, what compensation and costs market parties face, whether the investment team capacity and PPP market are harmed, and how this fits the Hoge Raad PPP tender. The minister confirmed a temporary investment stop on new housing and ICT projects, said no compensation is in principle due, and expected no lasting harm to the PPP market.
No, the government has no insight into the costs that private parties incur to make offers.
Nee, de overheid heeft geen inzicht in de kosten die private partijen maken voor het doen van aanbiedingen.

Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het feit dat SP’ers niet mogen inspreken in de raad van de gemeente Oude IJsselstreek (ingezonden 31 januari 2011).

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether Oude IJsselstreek municipality acted lawfully by barring members of political parties from speaking at council meetings, and whether other municipalities do the same and whether the minister would seek annulment. The minister answered that the council may set its own public-speaking rules under the Gemeentewet, that citizens may still speak, that no similar arrangements are known, and that no unlawfulness or public-interest breach was found, so annulment is not at issue.
I have found no evidence of conflict with the law or the general interest, so a proposal for annulment does not arise.
Van strijd met het recht of het algemeen belang is mij niets gebleken, zodat een voordracht tot vernietiging niet aan de orde is.
Vragen van het lid Schouw (D66) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Justitie over opslag biometrische gegevens (ingezonden 4 februari 2011).

An MP asked the ministers whether they were aware of reports on a possible EU inquiry into Dutch passport data storage, whether the Commission had approached the Netherlands, and whether they would drop a central biometric database if the Commission judged it contrary to EU data protection rules. The minister replied that he was aware of the reports, had not yet been approached by the Commission, and would await the outcome of any inquiry without prejudging it.
I am waiting to see what the Commission plans to investigate. I will not anticipate the outcome of that.
Ik wacht af wat de Commissie van plan is te onderzoeken. Op de uitkomsten hiervan loop ik niet vooruit.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Buitenlandse Zaken over infiltratie binnen de milieubeweging (ingezonden 20 januari 2011).

The MP asks whether Dutch authorities used information gathered by an infiltrator in the English environmental movement, whether such infiltration of NGOs and political parties is rejected, and for a guarantee against it without serious suspicion of crime. The minister replies that infiltration is only possible within Code of Criminal Procedure limits and College of Procurators-General approval, that the Public Prosecution Service found no evidence of Dutch use of the information, and that AIVD matters cannot be discussed publicly.
Publicly I cannot go further into your questions on whether the AIVD deploys natural persons in the organisations you name
In het openbaar kan ik niet nader ingaan op uw vragen of de Algemene Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdienst (AIVD) natuurlijke personen inzet in de organisaties die u noemt
Vragen van het lid De Boer (VVD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over verhogen huren (ingezonden 21 januari 2011).

An MP asks the minister whether he agrees that raising the social rent ceiling would be unwise and whether a proposal to harmonise rents of vacated social dwellings up to the liberalisation level deserves study. The minister agrees raising the ceiling would be unwise, notes corporations may house higher incomes within limits, and says he is open to investors in the segment above the ceiling and will examine options with parties.
To that end I am examining the possibilities and preconditions, together with parties.
Ik bezie daartoe, met partijen, de mogelijkheden en randvoorwaarden.

Vragen van de leden Dezentjé Hamming-Bluemink, Van der Burg (beiden VVD) en Omtzigt (CDA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over problemen omtrent het aanvragen van een DigiD (ingezonden 26 ja

Three MPs asked the Interior Minister about Dutch citizens abroad being unable to obtain a DigiD, which blocks access to services such as the pension overview site, and about progress on counter-desk issuance, the Register Niet Ingezetenen and postal or digital issuance. The minister acknowledged the problem, said counter issuance at Schiphol and abroad is being explored with a technical build expected in early 2012, and ruled out postal or digital issuance as too vulnerable to fraud.
I am currently investigating several options to meet the wishes of non-residents for using DigiD.
Momenteel onderzoek ik meerdere mogelijkheden om aan de wensen tot het gebruik van DigiD van niet-ingezetenen tegemoet te komen.
Vragen van het lid Elissen (PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de peperdure website van de gemeente Breda (ingezonden 27 januari 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of the Interior whether a 4-million-euro municipal website in Breda is absurd, how it was financed, whether the Rijk will scrutinise ICT funding requests more critically, and whether national rules make websites more expensive. The Minister replies that costs and ICT spending fall within municipal autonomy and the council's responsibility, that no national grants go to Breda, and that no national requirements inflate website costs.
Decisions on spending on ICT projects fall within municipal autonomy.
De afwegingen met betrekking tot uitgaven aan ICT-projecten behoren tot de gemeentelijke autonomie.
Vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de onrechtmatigheid van de statenverkiezingen van 2 maart 2011 (ingezonden 31 januari 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the 2011 provincial elections are unlawful because the Caribbean Netherlands islands have no voice in Eerste Kamer elections, and whether Dutch equality law requires voting rights there. The minister rejected the view that the elections are unlawful, citing constitutional and treaty grounds, and said a constitutional amendment giving island councils a vote in Eerste Kamer elections is in preparation and will soon go to the Raad van State.
Nevertheless, I consider it desirable to also involve the island councils in the electorate of the Eerste Kamer.
Wel acht ik het wenselijk om de eilandsraden ook in het electoraat van de Eerste Kamer te betrekken.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over moskeeën die medewerking weigeren aan het onderzoek naar lijfstraffen en het verspreiden van ant

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of the Interior whether mosques refusing to cooperate with a study of corporal punishment and anti-Western teaching show contempt for Dutch society, whether the minister had understated the lack of concrete signals of abuses given earlier GGD and municipal reports, and whether the refusing mosques in Amsterdam and Tilburg will be closed. The minister replied only that the questions could not be answered within the deadline because not all required data had been obtained, promising an answer as soon as possible.
it is not possible to answer these questions within the set deadline
het niet mogelijk is deze vragen binnen de gestelde termijn te beantwoorden

Vragen van de leden Kuiken en Heijnen (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de administratieve lasten van commercieel getinte Wob-verzoeken (ingez

MPs Kuiken and Heijnen asked whether commercial FOI (Wob) requests drain scarce police capacity and what the government would do about it. The minister said he has no overview of Wob request purposes, that the Wob lacks a proportionality test, and promised a letter on curbing abuse and reducing police workload.
As previously promised to the House, I will send you a letter shortly with proposals to prevent improper use of the Wob.
Zoals eerder aan de Kamer toegezegd, stuur ik u op korte termijn een brief met daarin voorstellen om oneigenlijk gebruik van de Wob te voorkomen.

Vragen van het lid Schouw (D66) aan de minister-president, minister van Algemene Zaken over de weigering inlichtingen te verschaffen over zakelijke belangen van bewindspersonen (ingezonden 21 januari 2011).

MP Schouw (D66) asks the Prime Minister whether ministers' financial and business interests, even when managed at a distance, must be open to parliamentary scrutiny, and why some ministers refused to disclose such information under article 68 of the Constitution, proposing criteria and a conflict-of-interest rule like the UK Ministerial Code. The answer by Minister Donner (on behalf of the Prime Minister) responds to these questions in writing, with the government's reply summarised in the document only in part.

Are you willing to promote that the ministers of your cabinet provide the information requested on 7 December 2010, which they initially refused to provide, in light of article 68 of the Constitution?

Vraag 4 Bent u bereid te bevorderen, dat de bewindslieden van uw kabinet de inlichtingen, gevraagd op 7 december 2010 2 , die zij in eerste instantie hebben geweigerd te verstrekken, alsnog verstrekken, gelet op artikel 68 van de Grondwet?

Vragen van het lid De Boer (VVD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het aan de laars lappen van de EU-regels inzake staatssteun door woningcorporaties (ingezonden 28 december 2010).

An MP asks the minister whether it is undesirable that housing associations openly disregard EU state aid rules by housing higher-income households, and whether losing guarantees for new loans beyond the 10% threshold is a problem. The minister agrees that disregarding EU rules is undesirable, explains that associations may house higher incomes within the 10% limit without losing state aid, and says that transitional issues are being worked out with the sector and the European Commission.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Beertema (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het verbieden van een hoofddoek op school (ingezonden

Two PVV MPs asked whether schools may ban headscarves, whether such dress conflicts with emancipation, and whether the Commissie Gelijke Behandeling should be abolished. The minister said schools may impose conditions only where necessary for their founding principles and applied consistently, did not share the view that schools may always ban headscarves, declined to endorse the emancipation framing, and defended the Commissie Gelijke Behandeling as valuable.
No, I do not share that view.
Nee, ik deel die visie niet.

Vragen van het lid Van Dam (PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de oproep van Turkse professionals om meer aandacht te schenken aan de integratieproblematiek van Turkse jongeren (inge

The MP Van Dam asks the Minister of Internal Affairs whether the signals of Turkish-Dutch professionals about integration problems among Turkish youth are recognised, whether there is a negative trend, and whether specific policy attention and political climate matter. The minister partly recognises the signals, points to mixed trends, rejects group-specific policy in favour of generic policy with tailored measures, and agrees to continue talks with the professionals.
It was agreed to remain in discussion on this subject with the IOT and the authors of the manifesto.
Afgesproken is om in gesprek te blijven over dit onderwerp met het IOT en de opstellers van het manifest.
Vragen van de leden Brinkman en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over halal-lunch bij de politie (ingezonden 21 december 2010).

PVV MPs Brinkman and Wilders asked the Minister of the Interior whether police lunches served only halal food, calling it unacceptable Islamisation, and whether he would end it. The minister answered that lunch packages without pork were an organisational measure given the number of people who do not eat pork, and refused to end it.
Here it is a matter of providing lunch packages without pork because it is organisationally easier to carry out.
Hier is sprake van het verstrekken van lunchpakketten zonder varkensvlees omdat het organisatorisch beter uitvoerbaar is.

Vragen van de leden Schouw (D66) en Hennis-Plasschaert (VVD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de registratie van een tweede nationaliteit in de Gemeentelijke Basisadministratie (GBA) (in

MPs Schouw and Hennis-Plasschaert asked whether Dutch treaty obligations require automatic GBA registration of a second nationality and how this compares with Belgium, France and Germany, and what the effects of non-registration would be for public tasks, citizens, denaturalisation and foreign authorities. The minister answered that no treaty obliges registration, that registration is declaratory, that the government sees no reason to change the current law, and that non-registration would hamper statutory tasks and burden citizens.
The purpose of the GBA is to provide unambiguous information that is necessary for applying the law.
Doel van de GBA is om eenduidige informatie te verstrekken welke nodig is met het oog op de toepassing van de wet.

Vragen van de leden Heijnen en Recourt (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Justitie over regelgeving in de Nederlandse paspoortwet met betrekking tot biometri

MPs Heijnen and Recourt asked ministers whether EU rules and the UK's abolition of its national ID card change the Dutch plan to centrally store biometric passport data, and asked for the UK's reasons and the timeline for the Dutch reorganisation (ORRA). Minister Donner answered that the EU regulation leaves storage choices to member states, that the UK keeps a central passport register with biometrics, and that the ORRA orientation needs about two more months.
Yes, I still expect to need at least the next two months to complete this orientation.
Ja, ik denk nog zeker de komende twee maanden nodig te hebben voor de afronding van deze oriëntatie.

Vragen van de leden Heijnen en Vermeij (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over burgemeesters die stoppen vanwege de FPU (ingezonden 5 janu

Two PvdA MPs asked the Interior and Social Affairs ministers about mayors stepping down early because of pension loss under the FPU early-retirement scheme, asking how many are affected, what the government thinks, what has been done, and whether it will act quickly so mayors can finish their terms. The Interior Minister's reply only announces that the questions cannot be answered within the deadline because not all necessary information is yet available, and promises a later answer.
The answer will be provided as soon as all relevant information has been received.
Beantwoording zal plaatsvinden zodra alle relevante informatie is gekregen.

Vragen van de leden Van der Burg en Ziengs (beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht dat 2011 een duur jaar belooft te wo

Two VVD MPs asked ministers why municipal taxes for small businesses rise 3.5 to 4.8 percent in 2011, whether municipalities shift their financial problems onto local businesses, and what concrete measures will prevent this. The reply is only an interim notice: answers cannot yet be given because interdepartmental consultation takes more time, and they will follow as soon as possible.

I inform you (on behalf of the Minister of Economic Affairs, Innovation and Agriculture) that the answers to the parliamentary questions cannot yet be given because interdepartmental coordination requires more time.

deel ik u (mede namens de minister van Economische Zaken, Innovatie en Landbouw) mee dat de beantwoording van de kamervragen nog niet kan plaats vinden vanwege het feit dat de interdepartementale afstemming meer tijd vergt.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Brinkman (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bizarre idee banen exclusief beschikbaar te stellen voor niet-westerse allochtonen (ingezon

Two PVV MPs asked the Interior Minister about a reported proposal to reserve senior municipal civil-service posts in Amsterdam for non-Western migrants, asking whether the minister finds it absurd, what action will be taken, and how it fits the coalition agreement ending ethnicity-based preference policy. The minister corrected the article date and referred the MPs to answers given a year earlier by another minister on the same article, without addressing the substance.

I refer you to the answers given by the Minister for Housing, Neighbourhoods and Integration, on behalf of the minister and state secretary of Interior and Kingdom Relations, to the questions the PVV asked a year ago about this same article.

Ik verwijs u naar de beantwoording van de minister voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie, mede namens de minister en staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties, op de vragen die de PVV een jaar geleden over ditzelfde artikel gesteld heeft
Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de organisatie sharia4holland (ingezonden 23 december 2010).

MPs Van Klaveren and Wilders asked whether the Sharia4Holland organisation threatens democracy and whether it should be banned and its members expelled. Minister Donner answered that he rejects introducing sharia, but that freedoms of expression, association and religion protect the group, and the government has no indications it breaks the law or threatens the democratic order.
The government currently has no indications that Shariah4Holland, in exercising its fundamental rights, violates the law or poses a danger to society or the democratic legal order.
De regering heeft vooralsnog geen aanwijzingen dat Shariah4Holland bij het uitoefenen van haar grondrechten de wet overtreedt en een gevaar vormt voor de samenleving of de democratische rechtsorde.

Vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen (SP), Voortman (GroenLinks), Monasch (PvdA), Van Bochove (CDA) en Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het rapport Steenrijk e

MPs asked the minister for Interior Affairs to respond to criticism in the Steenrijk en Straatarm report of Maastricht housing corporation Servatius's sales plan, and to explain when the central housing fund and ministry were informed of Servatius's financial problems and why a formal instruction took six months. The minister rejected the report's criticism as one-sided, said the fund raised concerns once in 2009, and explained the 2008 delay by noting the ministry was not formally notified and checked legal robustness before issuing a pre-announced instruction.
The former ministry of VROM received no signals in June 2008 about the financial problems surrounding Servatius's campus project.
Het toenmalige ministerie van VROM heeft in juni 2008 geen signalen ontvangen over de financiële problematiek rond het campusproject van woningcorporatie Servatius.
Vragen van de leden Heijnen en Groot (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over accountantsdiensten bij gemeenten (ingezonden 21 december 2010).

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether municipal audit costs are known and whether municipalities are breaking the mandatory tendering rules for accountants, with possible effects on control quality. The minister said he has no overview of total audit costs per municipality, sees no reason for a study, and referred the tendering questions to earlier answers without substantive new information.
I have no insight into the total costs per municipality, and inquiries with the VNG revealed that it also has no insight into these costs.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de totale kosten per gemeente en navraag bij de VNG leerde dat deze ook geen inzicht heeft in deze kosten.
Vragen van het lid Koopmans (CDA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over accountantscontrole bij gemeenten (ingezonden 22 december 2010).

MP Koopmans (CDA) asked the Minister of Interior whether municipalities, including large ones, are failing to tender their audit contracts under EU rules, and whether they could save money by doing so. The Minister denied there is evidence of widespread non-compliance, said municipalities are not always obliged to tender and may use their own audit service, and stated that municipalities themselves bear responsibility for audit choices and costs, so no federal measures are planned.
Municipalities are themselves responsible for the choice and costs of an auditor.
Gemeenten zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor de keuze en de kosten van een accountant.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over prestatieloon voor gemeenteambtenaren (ingezonden 12 januari 2011).

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister about a performance-based pay scheme for municipal civil servants in Aalten, whether similar schemes exist elsewhere, whether it complies with law, and whether unions were consulted. The minister replied that the cabinet has no control over municipal pay, which is decentralised, and that municipalities have discretion under the CAR/UWO to apply flexible pay instruments, declining to judge legality or comment further.
The cabinet has no control over the manner in which municipal civil servants are paid.
Het kabinet heeft geen zeggenschap over de wijze van beloning van de gemeenteambtenaren.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de kosten voor verkiezingsborden (ngezonden 14 januari 2011).

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister whether it is undesirable that Apeldoorn plans to charge political parties for placing election posting boards to save money, and which other municipalities plan the same. The minister replied that municipalities may charge cost-recovery fees under the Municipal Act, that the council decides on desirability and amount, and that he is not aware of other municipalities with such plans.
It is up to the municipal council concerned to decide on the desirability and the amount of the costs.
Het is aan de betreffende gemeenteraad om zich over de wenselijkheid en over de hoogte van de kosten uit te spreken.

Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over vrouwelijke inburgeraars die leren voor huisvrouw en niet voor een baan (ingezonden 22 december 2010).

An MP asks the minister whether the civic integration OGO profile (upbringing, health, education) steers women towards housekeeping rather than paid work, and whether it should be abolished or opened to all participants. The minister rejects that reading, notes 87% of OGO participants are women but 52% of women took the Work profile, and says the whole integration system, including the exam, will be reconsidered.
When the system is adjusted, all components of the civic integration system will be reconsidered, therefore also the design of the integration exam.
Bij de aanpassing van het stelsel zullen alle onderdelen van het inburgeringsstelsel worden heroverwogen, derhalve ook de vormgeving van het inburgeringsexamen.

Vragen van de leden Jansen (SP), Van Bochove (CDA), Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie), Voortman (GroenLinks), Monasch (PvdA) en De Boer (VVD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de verliezen va

MPs asked the minister how negative results on subsidiaries (deelnemingen) of housing associations were reflected in the 2010 assessment letters, and how those results break down across core, social and commercial property activities. The minister answered that subsidiary results were not explicitly addressed in the letters, that the CFV will examine more associations in 2011, and that the data do not allow the requested breakdown, while noting that most subsidiary losses likely relate to commercial activities.
The CFV will in 2011 examine more associations where there is an increased risk of unnecessary erosion of the socially bound assets.
Het CFV zal in 2011 meer corporaties onderzoeken waar een verhoogd risico is op onnodige aantasting van het maatschappelijk gebonden vermogen.
Vragen van het lid Sterk (CDA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de remigratiewet (ingezonden 7 januari 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Interior about press reports on a Dutch-funded return scheme for Bosnians, whether the existing remigration scheme is being scaled back, and when the Chamber will see amendments to the Remigration Act. The Minister denies sending any official notice to Bosnia, says the planned changes (higher age threshold, abolishing basic provisions, restricting the target group to the first generation) were set out in a 2009 letter, and promises a bill before summer.
I intend to submit a bill amending the Remigration Act to the House of Representatives before summer of this year, in response to the Van Toorenburg motion.
Ik wil voor de zomer van dit jaar aan de Tweede Kamer een wetswijzigings-voorstel voorleggen voor de Remigratiewet ter beantwoording van de motie Van Toorenburg.
Vragen van het lid Van Klaveren (PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het artikel «Nederland betaalt terugkeer Bosniërs» (ingezonden 10 januari 2011).

An MP asked the Interior Minister about reports that Bosnian returnees aged 45 and over receive lifelong remigration payments, and whether this fits with spending cuts and poor integration. The minister said payments are limited to eligible long-term unemployed, disabled or welfare recipients who renounce Dutch nationality, are capped at about 421 euro per person per month (607 euro per couple), and that the scheme saves the state money.
Only if Bosnian refugees meet the conditions of the Remigration Act can they apply for a monthly payment.
Alleen indien Bosnische vluchtelingen voldoen aan de voorwaarden van de Remigratiewet kunnen zij een maandelijkse uitkering aanvragen.

Vragen van de leden Spekman en Eijsink (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers voor Immigratie en Asiel en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over een remigratieregeling voor Bosnische vluchtelingen (ingezonden 10 janu

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers of Immigration and of Interior about a remigration allowance for Bosnian refugees, including whether it was based on poor integration of older refugees, whether Bosnia was notified, and why funds go there rather than to education or poverty relief. The minister denied the integration motive, said no official notice was sent to Bosnia, confirmed the repayment rule, and defended the allowance levels by referring to earlier answers.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over afrekenbare en controleerbar

Six opposition MPs asked the Interior Minister how the government's planned wage freeze in the public sector would be measured, what milestones apply, how it would be achieved and how it would be accounted for. The minister answered that the target is the budgetary yield (EUR 870 million structurally by 2015), that the measure is legally feasible, that wage talks with unions start when existing collective agreements expire, and that accountability occurs in the spring budget cycle, giving little measurable detail.
The goal is the budgetary yield of structurally 870 million.
Het doel is de budgettaire opbrengst van structureel 870 mln.
Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de vondst van explosieven bij de milieudienst in Dordrecht (ingezonden 4 januari 2011).

Vragen van het lid Schouw (D66) aan de minister-president, minister van Algemene Zaken, over zakelijke belangen (ingezonden 7 december 2010).

An MP from D66 asks the cabinet about ministers' financial and business interests, how they are managed at a distance, ties to interested parties, avoidance of conflicts of interest, and foreign property. The government replies that ministers must avoid any appearance of partiality, that they resign from functions and manage relevant interests under the 2002 framework, but that details of private affairs and formation talks are not disclosed for privacy reasons, referring to earlier answers.

Regarding the content of the conversation between the formateur and the prospective minister, no further statements are made in view of the importance of protecting personal privacy beyond a letter from the prime minister to the House of Representatives after the formation.

Over de inhoud van het gesprek tussen formateur en kandidaat-bewindspersoon worden in verband met het belang van de bescherming van de persoonlijke levenssfeer geen andere mededelingen gedaan dan in een brief van de minister-president aan de Tweede Kamer na afloop van de formatie.
Vragen van de leden Heijnen en Spekman (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de nieuwe huisvesting van de provincie Utrecht (ingezonden 25 november 2010).

PvdA MPs Heijnen and Spekman asked the Interior Minister about the Utrecht provincial government's three headquarters buildings, the associated financial risks, and whether provinces should show restraint on housing investment amid planned cuts. The minister answered that housing investment and its financial risks are the province's autonomous responsibility, that supervision focuses on structural budget balance rather than housing policy, and that no imbalance is expected, while the question of tighter supervision of Randstad provinces will be considered once the regional reorganisation plan takes concrete shape.
Supervision of the provinces is aimed at their financial position, as expressed in a structural budget balance and/or multi-year forecast.
Het toezicht op de provincies is gericht op de financiële positie van de provincies, zoals tot uitdrukking komt in structureel evenwicht op de begroting en/of meerjarenraming.
Vragen van het lid Schouw (D66) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over beveiliging opslag ID-gegevens (ingezonden 12 november 2010).

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the Dutch system and local databases storing ID data are secure against hackers, and whether the planned central database of biometric data will be protected. The minister answered that the questions concern a central database not yet established, that he will examine the matter in coming months, and that no irreversible steps will be taken meanwhile.
In the meantime, no irreversible steps will be taken towards establishing this administration.
In de tussentijd worden er geen onomkeerbare stappen gezet richting de vorming van deze administratie.
Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over vingerafdrukken in een landelijke database (ingezonden 22 november 2010).

Dibi (GroenLinks) asked the Interior Minister about risks of a central fingerprint database for passports, citing the Data Protection Authority's (CBP) concerns and WRR warnings about errors and fraud. Minister Donner rejected the CBP's view, deferred to earlier answers on the substance, and said no irreversible steps would be taken while he studies the matter.
In the meantime, no irreversible steps are being taken toward establishing the central travel document administration.
In de tussentijd worden er geen onomkeerbare stappen gezet richting de vorming van de centrale reisdocumentenadministratie.
Vragen van het lid De Boer (VVD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het artikel «Zonder relatie geen woning» (ingezonden 21 oktober 2010).

An MP asks whether Amsterdam's planned housing allocation rule excluding co-habiting persons without a family relationship breaches privacy, and whether the minister will intervene for low-income students. The minister answers that housing allocation criteria are a local matter within the Huisvestingswet, that the regional ordinance has no family-relationship requirement and does not infringe privacy, and that intervention via the VROM-Inspectie is not warranted for a policy discussion.
Where there is a possible infringement, I can instruct the VROM Inspectorate to investigate further and possibly intervene.
Wanneer er sprake is van een mogelijke overtreding kan ik de VROM-Inspectie opdracht geven hier nader onderzoek naar te doen en eventueel in te grijpen.
Vragen van het lid Verhoeven (D66) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het woningbeleid voor samenwoners (ingezonden 21 oktober 2010).

An MP asks the Interior Minister about Amsterdam housing rules that reportedly push cohabiting people out of social housing, and whether such rules spread to other cities and can be ended. The minister replies that allocation policy is a local matter for the municipal council, that no signals of similar rules elsewhere were received, and that the VROM Inspectorate could investigate only a possible breach of regulations, not a policy disagreement.
Policy choices weighing target groups (both students and low-income families) are in principle a local matter.
Beleidsmatige keuzes waarbij de afweging ten aanzien van doelgroepen (zowel studenten als gezinnen met een laaginkomen) gemaakt wordt zijn in beginsel een lokale aangelegenheid.
Vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over positie van starters op de woningmarkt (ingezonden 12 november 2010).

An MP asked the Interior Minister about the falling borrowing capacity of first-time buyers, the compatibility with affordability goals, the timing of a housing vision, the EU state-aid rules limiting social rental access, abolishing transfer tax for starters, and bank mortgage rates. The minister attributed the capacity drop to tax and premium changes, defended the NHG cost limit, promised an integral housing vision by summer 2011, rejected the state-aid concern, rejected abolishing transfer tax on cost and enforcement grounds, and referred the bank rate question to the Finance Minister.

The cabinet will, partly in response to the motion by Senator R. de Boer (CU) adopted in the Senate on 16 November 2010 and to the debate in the House during the Interior Ministry budget, present an integral vision on the housing market before summer 2011.

Het kabinet zal, mede naar aanleiding van de motie van senator R. de Boer (CU) die in de Eerste Kamer op 16 november 2010 is aangenomen en naar aanleiding van het overleg in de Tweede Kamer bij de behandeling van de begroting van het ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties, voor de zomer van 2011 komen met een integrale visie op de woningmarkt.

Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht dat kamernood op een gezamenlijke manier wordt aangepakt door middel van een nationaal akkoord (inge

MP Voortman asked the minister whether student housing shortages would rise to 60,000 rooms by 2015, how the government would respond to a national accord, and whether it would meet stakeholders, and asked about housing-policy measures. The minister replied that demand will persist, that local authorities should be monitored and encouraged (especially Leiden, Delft, Amsterdam), that existing rules already allow office-to-housing conversion, and that reinstating rent allowance for non-independent student rooms is not planned.
I will continue to monitor this local effort in particular and encourage it where necessary.
Ik zal met name deze lokale inzet blijven volgen en waar nodig stimuleren.

Vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Justitie over bouwregelgeving brandveiligheid voor parkeergarages en andere grote bouww

An MP from ChristenUnie asked the ministers of Interior and of Justice and Security about the absence of mandatory sprinklers in parking garages and large buildings, the fire compartment rules, the 30- versus 60-minute search time, and planned risk-based regulation. The minister replied that Dutch building rules are performance-based with no sprinkler mandate, that sprinklers are one accepted equivalent solution, and that risk-based regulation with standardisation will follow in five to eight years, while rejecting mandatory sprinklers.
Mandatory prescription of (expensive) sprinkler installations is not necessary for this purpose.
Het wettelijk voorschrijven van (dure) sprinklerinstallaties is hierbij niet nodig.

Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het wijzigen van gegevens in de gemeentelijke basisadministratie persoonsgegevens (ingezonden 15 november 2010).

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether a person's birth date recorded as XX-XX-1992 in the municipal population register and passport can be corrected, and why fictitious dates are not used. The minister confirmed about 77,000 people lack a full birth date, explained that correction requires reliable source documents and that partial dates are permitted by regulation, and said a solution for foreigners is being studied.
Against a decision by the college not to record a data item in the GBA, the citizen concerned can lodge an objection or appeal under the General Administrative Law Act.
Tegen een besluit van het college om een gegeven niet op te nemen in de GBA kan door de betrokken burger bezwaar c.q. beroep worden aangetekend op grond van de Algemene wet bestuursrecht.

Vragen van de leden Kuiken en Wolbert (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over geweld tegen verpleegkundigen (ingezonden 22 oktober 2010).

MPs Kuiken and Wolbert asked ministers about a survey showing high levels of aggression against nurses, what hospitals do to train staff and share best practice, why nurses may leave, and why threatened nurses often do not file police reports. The government acknowledges the problem, points to employer responsibility under the Arbo law, the Veilige Zorg project, a planned Expertisecentrum VPT, and an information brochure to encourage reporting.

Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) voor de minister voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie over het bericht dat gemeenten uit de losse pols strooien met religieuze subsidies (ingezonden 27 september 2010).

An MP from GroenLinks asked the minister about reports that municipalities grant religious subsidies arbitrarily and whether this conflicts with the separation of church and state. The minister said subsidies to religious bodies need not violate that principle, acknowledged that municipal criteria are often unclear, pointed to a joint framework (Tweeluik) for municipalities, and promised to consider additional support in consultation with the VNG.
In principle, decentralised authorities are free – within the limits of the law – to determine their own subsidy policy.
In principe zijn decentrale overheden vrij om – binnen de grenzen van de wet – zelf hun subsidiebeleid te bepalen.

Vragen van het lid Karabulut (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht dat de grootschalige stadsvernieuwing in Amsterdam Nieuw West wordt gestaakt (ingezonden 1 november 2010).

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister whether the cancelled Far West urban renewal in Amsterdam Nieuw West, which leaves many neglected dwellings to be rented longer, will be matched by stricter oversight and financial support for maintenance. The minister answered that maintenance is primarily the owner's responsibility, that most homes are structurally sound, that about 500 are in poor condition, and that quality oversight is mainly a municipal matter with no extra funding planned.
Are you willing to exercise stricter oversight of living conditions and housing quality based on the applicable laws and standards?
Bent u bereid verscherpt toe te zien op de omstandigheden en kwaliteit van het wonen op basis van de daarvoor geldende wetten en normen

Vragen van het lid Hachchi (D66) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de wervingscampagne van het Rijk terwijl er grootschalige bezuinigingen en inkrimpingen op het ambtenarenapparaat zijn a

An MP asks why the central government is running a recruitment and image campaign, with posters at train stations, while large cuts and staff reductions are announced and only 58 vacancies are listed. The minister replies that the campaign is mainly about positioning the government as an employer, that it has been scaled down, and that a new contract and labour-market strategy are being prepared.
Because the number of vacancies at the central government has fallen sharply, the campaign has been substantially scaled back.
Omdat het aantal vacatures bij de Rijksoverheid sterk is teruggelopen is de campagne sterk versoberd.

Vragen van de leden Graus, Fritsma en Van Klaveren (allen PVV) aan de ministers voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie en van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over het artikel «Hondje doodgeschopt» (ingezonden 5 oktober 20

PVV MPs asked ministers about a newspaper report of a dog being kicked to death, asking how repression would reduce threats, robberies, and animal cruelty and what measures would be taken against street terror. The minister answered that this is a local matter for the municipality of Amsterdam and that no report or complaint was filed, so no action could be taken.
This concerns a local matter for which the municipality of Amsterdam is responsible.
Het gaat hier om een lokale aangelegenheid waarvoor de gemeente Amsterdam verantwoordelijk is.

Vragen van het lid Karabulut (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de voorgenomen fusie van woningcorporaties PWS Rotterdam en Com.wonen (ingezonden 15 oktober 2010).

Mr Karabulut (SP) asked whether the planned merger of housing corporations PWS Rotterdam and Com.wonen, creating a corporation of about 50,000 units amid tenant complaints about maintenance, should be halted and a supervisor appointed. Minister Donner answered that no formal merger request has yet been filed, that no ideal corporation size exists, that no external supervisor is warranted on the information available, and that tenant organisations will be able to submit objections.
On the basis of the information provided, I see no reason to appoint an external supervisor.
Op basis van de verstrekte informatie zie ik geen aanleiding om over te gaan tot het aanstellen van een externe toezichthouder.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Fritsma (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de uitspraak van de Turkse regering dat Turken in Nederland niet hoeven in te burgeren (ingezond

MPs Van Klaveren and Fritsma asked the Minister of Interior whether the Turkish government's claim that Turks in the Netherlands need not take civic integration courses was acceptable, and what measures would be taken toward Turkey and to keep Turks subject to integration obligations. The minister replied that the Netherlands sets its own integration conditions, that the government has appealed court rulings holding the obligation contrary to the EU-Turkey Association Agreement, and that contacts between states and their nationals abroad are permitted within legal limits.
I have lodged an appeal with the Central Appeals Tribunal, because the Cabinet is of the view that the civic integration obligation falls outside the scope of the EU-Turkey Association Agreement.
Hoger beroep ingesteld bij de Centrale Raad van Beroep, omdat het Kabinet van mening is dat de inburgeringsplicht buiten de werkingssfeer van het Associatieakkoord EU-Turkije valt.
Vragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over voorkruipen bij het aanvragen van gemeentelijke vergunningen (ingezonden 28 oktober 2010).

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether Delfzijl municipality's acceptance of payment from a company to speed up permit handling was lawful and equitable, and whether it risked a wider trend. The Minister answered that the EUR 45,000 contributed by the initiator funds preparatory research for a zoning plan revision, not faster permit processing, so no measures were deemed necessary.
No payment is made for faster processing of permit procedures, according to the municipality.
Er wordt niet betaald voor een snellere afhandeling van vergunningprocedures, aldus de gemeente.

Vragen van de leden Koopmans en Ferrier (beiden CDA) aan de minister voor Wonen Wijken en Integratie en de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs Cultuur en Wetenschappen over te weinig leerlingplekken door de economische crisis

Two CDA MPs asked whether the economic crisis has left too few apprenticeship places for construction trainees and whether the state, as a large client, should require apprenticeship places in its tenders. The minister replied that the construction sector is stabilising, that the government already requires apprenticeship places in Rijksgebouwendienst projects, and that tendering by provinces, municipalities and water boards is their own autonomous matter.
At administrative level, the issue of apprenticeship places will be raised in the bodies suited for it.
Op bestuurlijk niveau zal in de zich daarvoor lenende gremia het onderwerp leerlingplaatsen aan de orde worden gesteld.

Vragen van het lid Uitslag (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de internationale streektaalconferentie «streektaal in de zorg» te Enschede (ingezonden 6 oktober 2010).

An MP asked about the status of applying Part III of the European Charter for Regional or Minority Languages to Low Saxon and the outcome of ministerial review of that request. The minister stated Part III applies only to Frisian in Fryslân, and that review by line ministries is ongoing with the applicants to be informed once it concludes.
Once the outcome of the review is known, the applicants will be informed of their request.
Zodra de uitkomst van de toetsing bekend is, zullen de aanvragers over hun verzoek worden geïnformeerd.
Vragen van het lid Verhoeven (D66) aan de minister voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie over de toegenomen animo voor huurwoningen (ingezonden 11 oktober 2010).

An MP asked the housing minister how to respond to rising demand for rental homes, whether the market can absorb it, and whether a larger private rental segment for middle incomes is needed, given that tenants expect lower rents than the 4.5% return norm implies. The minister answered that the demand is largely cyclical, that the market will respond if structural demand emerges, and that caps on social housing allocation and rent rules will make private rental more attractive, while maintaining that the mortgage interest deduction supports homeownership.
If it were to turn out that there is a structural demand for more rental homes, one may expect market parties to respond to it.
Indien zou blijken dat sprake is van een structurele vraag naar meer huurwoningen, dan mag verwacht worden dat marktpartijen daarop zullen inspelen.

Vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over ex-landsambtenaren BES (Bonaire, Sint Eustatius en Saba) die een deel van hun salaris later krijgen (ing

An MP asked the Interior Minister about roughly 300 former Antillean civil servants on Bonaire, Saba and Sint Eustatius who received only two-thirds of their October salary, and whether the new Caribbean Netherlands service (RCN) acted badly as employer. The minister explained the payment responsibilities were split with the former Netherlands Antilles, that the RCN advanced 40% of the net salary, and that a liquidation commission will settle the remaining claims.
The RCN will consult with the liquidation commission on the manner and timing of the payment.
De RCN zal in overleg treden met de vereffeningscommissie over de wijze en het moment van de uitbetaling.

Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de problemen rondom de screening van ministers op Curaçao en het ontslag van het hoofd van de veiligheidsdienst (ingezon

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior about the vetting of Curaçao ministers and the dismissal of the head of the Netherlands Antilles security service, which was investigating the Schotte cabinet's ministers. The minister replied that the security service and vetting are autonomous matters for Curaçao, that the AIVD is not involved, and that intervention would be a last resort, though he would monitor the process critically.
The direction and functioning of the Security Service is an autonomous matter, in this case of the country Curaçao.
De aansturing en het functioneren van de Veiligheidsdienst is een autonome aangelegenheid, in dit geval van het land Curaçao.

Vragen van het lid Heijnen (PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het WRR-rapport «Happy Landings, het biometrisch paspoort als black box» (ingezonden 3 november 2010).

An MP asks the Interior Minister whether the government will respond to a WRR-commissioned publication on biometric passports, whether it will pause preparations for a central biometric data store, and whether other EU states' implementation can be reported. The minister says the publication is not a WRR report, a WRR report on ICT and government is expected in spring 2011, he will look into the central database options for several months before informing the Chamber, and he will check whether information on other member states is available.
I want to look into this file in order to reach a judgment on how the ORRA could be shaped.
Ik wil mij op dit dossier oriënteren om tot een oordeel te kunnen komen over de wijze waarop de ORRA vorm zou kunnen krijgen.
Vragen van het lid De Boer (VVD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het artikel «Zonder relatie geen woning» (ingezonden 21 oktober 2010).

MP De Boer (VVD) asked the Minister of the Interior whether he had read a Telegraaf article on Amsterdam's proposed rule barring housing for cohabiting unrelated persons, whether he knew of it, and whether it infringes privacy under Article 6(1) of the Constitution and harms low-income students. The minister replied only with a notice that the questions could not be answered within the statutory deadline because the necessary information was not yet available, promising a reply as soon as possible.
The information necessary to answer these parliamentary questions is not yet fully available.
Voor de beantwoording van deze Kamervragen is nog niet alle noodzakelijke informatie voorhanden.
Vragen van het lid Verhoeven (D66) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het woningbeleid voor samenwoners (ingezonden 21 oktober 2010).

MP Verhoeven (D66) asks the Minister of Interior Affairs about housing policy that evicts cohabiting people in Amsterdam, whether similar rules apply in other cities, whether housing flow prioritises over students and cohabitants, and whether the policy will be ended. The minister's reply is only an interim notice that the answers cannot yet be given within the deadline because necessary information is not yet available.
The information necessary to answer these parliamentary questions is not yet available.
Voor de beantwoording van deze Kamervragen is nog niet alle noodzakelijke informatie voorhanden.

Vragen van de leden Kuiken en Wolbert (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over geweld tegen verpleegkundigen (ingezonden 22 oktober 2010).

MPs Kuiken and Wolbert asked ministers about violence against nurses, including a Consumentenbond survey, training, hospital measures, sharing of best practices, job-switching intentions, and why threatened nurses often do not file reports. The government's response is only an interim notice stating that the questions cannot be answered within the deadline because not all data are yet available, with answers promised later.
it is not possible to answer these questions within the stated deadline, because not all data are yet available.
het niet mogelijk is deze vragen binnen de gestelde termijn te beantwoorden. De oorzaak hiervan is dat nog niet alle gegevens beschikbaar zijn.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over sms-gateway (ingezonden 15 oktober 2010).

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister whether SMS gateway services (used for DigiD authentication) were re-tendered, whether existing security requirements were dropped, what this means for quality and security, and whether the tender could be answered before final award. The minister said security requirements were kept and strengthened, promised at least equal security levels, and proceeded to award because a legal obligation to award had arisen after a rejected kort geding.
I will therefore proceed to award the contract.
Ik zal daarom tot gunning overgaan.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de ministers van Financiën, van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het heffen van hondenbelasting voor de financiering van de

MP Ouwehand asked ministers whether it is fair to fund the municipal duty to shelter stray animals through a dog tax on dog owners, and whether a levy on pet breeders and sellers should be introduced. The government answered that the dog tax is a general municipal tax whose use is a local decision, that it sees no need for an extra levy on the pet sector, and that it will not intervene in Veere's decision.
The cabinet cannot and does not want to intervene in this competence.
Het kabinet kan en wil niet in deze bevoegdheid treden.
Vragen van het lid Verhoeven (D66) aan de minister voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie over de toegenomen animo voor huurwoningen (ingezonden 11 oktober 2010).

MP Verhoeven (D66) asks the Minister for Housing, Neighbourhoods and Integration six questions on rising demand for rental homes, including whether the housing market can absorb it, rent levels relative to the required yield, the role of social rental stock, the case for a larger private middle-income rental segment, and how mortgage interest relief fits with rising rental demand. The answer is only a notice that the questions cannot be answered within the deadline because the necessary information is not yet available, with a promise to reply as soon as possible.
The information necessary to answer these parliamentary questions is not yet fully available.
Voor de beantwoording van deze Kamervragen is nog niet alle noodzakelijke informatie voorhanden.

Vragen van de leden Fritsma en Bosma (beiden PVV) aan de ministers voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over een doodsbedreiging op de website Marokko.nl (ingezonden 20 september 2010).

PVV MPs asked why threats against a former PVV candidate on the website Marokko.nl were not removed within an hour as promised, whether the operator should be sanctioned, and whether its subsidy had ended. The minister declined to classify the posts as threats (left to police and courts), said the operator promised to remove such posts within an hour and did so after being asked, and confirmed the subsidy was phased out in 2009.

However, it does not befit me as Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations to classify the statements in this specific case as threats; that is for the police and justice to assess and ultimately for the independent judge.

Het past mij echter als minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties niet om in dit concrete geval de uitingen als bedreiging te kwalificeren; dat is ter beoordeling aan politie en justitie en in laatste instantie aan de onafhankelijke rechter.
Vragen van het lid Koolmees (D66) aan de minister van Financiën over de kwartaalcijfers Nationale Hypotheek Garantie (ingezonden 11 oktober 2010).

An MP asked the Finance Minister about NHG mortgage guarantee quarterly figures, including the share of homes covered, the rise in loss claims, and the state's risk exposure. The minister answered that about 80% of purchases under the €350,000 limit use NHG, that the guarantee fund buffer and premiums cover the claims, and that no state budget provision is needed.
An investigation into the effectiveness of the crisis measures is currently underway.
Op dit moment loopt een onderzoek naar de effectiviteit van de crisismaatregelen.

Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) voor de minister voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie over het bericht dat gemeenten uit de losse pols strooien met religieuze subsidies (ingezonden 27 september 2010).

An MP from GroenLinks asks the minister whether municipalities grant religious subsidies arbitrarily, given reports that most lack specific policy, and whether this conflicts with separation of church and state and what role the minister sees for himself. The document is only an interim notice from minister Donner stating the answers cannot be provided in time due to interdepartmental consultation, with a promise to respond as soon as possible.
Answering these parliamentary questions requires further interdepartmental coordination.
Voor de beantwoording van deze Kamervragen is nadere interdepartementale afstemming noodzakelijk.

Vragen van de leden Graus, Fritsma en Van Klaveren (allen PVV) aan de ministers voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie en van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over het artikel «Hondje doodgeschopt» (ingezonden 5 oktober 20

Three PVV MPs asked whether the minister had read a newspaper article about a dog being kicked to death, how stronger repression would reduce street violence, and what measures would stop 'street terror'. The government reply is only a notice that the answers will be delayed because municipal information is not yet available.
The reason for this is that necessary information from the municipality is not yet available.
De reden hiervoor is dat noodzakelijke informatie van de gemeente nog niet voorhanden is.

Vragen van het lid Recourt (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het massaal kopen van stemmen bij de verkiezingen op Sint Maarten (ingezonden 21 september 2010).

The MP asked whether votes were bought on Sint Maarten in the 2010 elections, whether similar practices occurred on Curaçao, whether vote buying is punishable, and whether the Electoral Council should be placed under the national oversight regime. The minister declined to confirm or deny the reports, said vote buying is criminal under Antillean law and an internal police investigation is underway, and rejected bringing the Electoral Council under the oversight regime.
I cannot confirm or deny such reports.
Ik kan dergelijke berichten niet bevestigen of ontkennen.
Vragen van de leden Recourt en Bouwmeester (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over handhaving van het casinobeleid op Curaçao (ingezonden 22 oktober 2010).

PvdA MPs asked the minister of Interior whether Curaçao's government may fail to enforce a recently amended casino ordinance, whether it may reverse it, and whether this breaches the financial supervision law. The minister answered that enforcement and budgeting are autonomous matters of Curaçao, that the Rijkswet Financieel Toezicht covers budgets rather than policy choices such as casino taxes, and that he lacks the requested information.
Yes, drawing up a budget and enforcing the Island Ordinance on Casinos are autonomous matters of the country of Curaçao.
Ja, het opstellen van een begroting en de handhaving van de Eilandsverordening Casinowezen zijn autonome aangelegenheden van het land Curaçao.

Vragen van het lid Uitslag (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de internationale streektaalconferentie «streektaal in de zorg» te Enschede (ingezonden 6 oktober 2010).

An MP asked the state secretary about the status of Part III of the European Charter for Regional or Minority Languages, the outcome of the review of the request to recognise Low Saxon after referral to other ministries, and when Part III would take effect. The minister replied only that the questions could not be answered within the usual period because not all information had been received, and would be answered once complete.
I hereby inform you that these questions cannot be answered within the usual period, since not all the necessary information has yet been received.
deel ik u hierbij mede dat deze vragen niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn kunnen worden beantwoord, aangezien nog niet alle benodigde informatie is ontvangen.

Vragen van de leden Vermeij en Spekman (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het verkeerd voorlichten van deelnemers door het Pensioenfonds voor Werk en (re)Integratie. (ingezonden 20 se

MPs Vermeij and Spekman asked the minister whether the PWRI pension fund, which won a communication award in 2009, misinformed participants about the AOV supplementary scheme, and whether participants should be fully and clearly informed. The minister confirmed awareness of the press report, acknowledged past communication about the AOV was unfortunate that has since been improved, and agreed participants should receive complete, correct and understandable information.
I note that the communication by PWRI about the AOV scheme has been unfortunate in the past.
Ik constateer dat de communicatie door het PWRI over de AOV-regeling in het verleden ongelukkig is geweest.
Vragen van het lid Karabulut (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over explosieve toename van discriminatie op het werk (ingezonden 22 september 2010).

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment about a reported explosive rise in workplace discrimination against minorities and what the government would do about it, and whether employers were complying with their duty to take anti-discrimination measures and how many were sanctioned. The minister answered that complaint increases largely reflect a 2009 awareness campaign, that monitors do not confirm an explosive growth, that employer measures are in place but no national sickness registration exists, and that the labour inspectorate received 13 complaints, four of which were taken up.
There is no national registration of sickness due to discrimination available.
Er is geen nationale registratie van ziekte wegens discriminatie beschikbaar.

Vragen van de leden Vermeij en Wolbert (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Economische Zaken over het faillissement van Kip caravans (ingezonden 27 september 2010).

MPs Vermeij and Wolbert asked ministers about the bankruptcy of Kip caravans, the chances of a restart, and how UWV, the mobility centre and local/provincial authorities are supporting workers into new jobs. The minister answered that the bankruptcy was declared, 18 parties have expressed interest in a restart, UWV and partners are placing workers, and that businesses and government each bear their own responsibility.
There is thus a realistic chance of a restart, but whether and to what extent results will be achieved with the 18 parties is not yet known at this time.
Er is dus een reële kans op een doorstart, maar of en in hoeverre resultaten bereikt worden met de 18 partijen, is op dit moment nog niet bekend.

Vragen van het lid Karabulut (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat de uitlatingen van de voorzitter van Divosa, over dat jonggehandicapten in de bijstand moeten, op persoonlijke t

An SP MP asks the minister of Social Affairs whether Divosa chairman Paas's proposals to let disabled workers earn below the minimum wage, presented as personal views, are objectionable and whether he disqualified himself. The minister rejects the characterisation, says the proposals are a contribution to policy debate that needs further elaboration, notes existing pilots such as wage-cost subsidies, and says the chairman spoke for Divosa.
No. The chairman of Divosa, Mr R. Paas, refers in a Trouw article to a Divosa proposal from March 2010 to reform the bottom of the labour market.
Nee. De voorzitter van Divosa, dhr. R. Paas refereert in een artikel in Trouw aan een voorstel van Divosa uit maart 2010 om de onderkant van de arbeidsmarkt te hervormen.
Vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Koşer Kaya (beiden D66) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Economische Zaken over asbestslopers (ingezonden 25 augustus 2010).

MPs Verhoeven and Koşer Kaya asked whether stricter asbestos-removal certification rules would bankrupt many small demolition firms, whether industry consent was required, and how small firms would be protected. The minister replied that the rules are drafted by a college including industry, that he sets them himself, that the health risks justify strict enforcement with a transition period, and that he is committed to keeping dialogue open.
Ultimately I myself establish the rules by ministerial regulation.
Uiteindelijk stel ik zelf de regels bij ministeriële regeling vast.

Vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het aanbieden van beleggingsrekeningen als spaarrekeningen door het Pensioenfonds voor Werk en Re-integratie (PWR

An MP asks the minister of Social Affairs about a pension fund (PWRI) allegedly presenting investment accounts as savings accounts, the financial losses for beneficiaries, whether the AFM previously knew of misleading information and why it took no action, and whether current rules suffice. The minister's reply is only a notice that answers cannot be given within three weeks because external information is needed.
because information from external parties is needed to answer
omdat voor de beantwoording nadere informatie van externe partijen nodig is
Vragen van het lid Spekman (PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de toegepaste beslagvrije voet (ingezonden 16 september 2010).

MP Spekman asked whether the Utrecht social affairs department applies only the bare basic exempt amount (beslagvrije voet) in third-party garnishment, whether it can and should be raised for housing and health insurance costs, and whether municipalities should be made to pursue this given growing debt problems. Minister Donner answered that he knows of no deviation from the law, that municipalities are legally bound to apply garnishment but need not inform bailiffs of the increase, and that a calculation tool was developed to apply the statutory increase correctly.
I am not aware that the municipality of Utrecht implements a third-party garnishment in a manner other than that prescribed in the Code of Civil Procedure.
Mij is niet bekend dat de gemeente Utrecht op een andere manier – dan in het Wetboek van Burgerlijke Rechtsvordering is bepaald – uitvoering zou geven aan een derdenbeslag.

Vragen van het lid Koşer Kaya (D66) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de scheefgroei in de premies Werkhervatting Gedeeltelijk Arbeidsongeschikten (WGA) van de Uitvoeringsorganisatie Werkvoorzieni

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the WGA premium structure at UWV makes firms with many disabled workers pay relatively little, and whether this was deliberate and how it relates to the 2009 evaluation of hybrid financing. The minister confirmed the figures, explained that the minimum and maximum premium create the skewed ratio as a deliberate choice for solidarity, and said the evaluation conclusions are not affected.
This is a deliberate choice that provides a certain degree of risk pooling and solidarity in the system.
Dit is een bewuste keuze die voor een bepaalde mate van verevening en solidariteit in het stelsel zorgt.
Vragen van het lid Vermeij (PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de toegenomen arbeidsongeschiktheid onder flexwerkers (ingezonden 31 augustus 2010).

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the sharp rise in disability (WIA) inflow among flexible workers and its causes, and how well UWV reintegrates sick temporary workers, and whether employers should be responsible for reintegration. The minister attributed the WIA growth to more applications and higher award rates, noted rising sickness-benefit trajectories, and said the Ziektewet and responsibility split for reintegration would be reviewed.

In my letter to the House of Representatives of 6 September on developments concerning the Ziektewet safety net, I went into detail on the position of sick temporary workers and UWV's reintegration efforts.

In mijn brief aan de Tweede Kamer van 6 september over ontwikkelingen rond het vangnet-Ziektewet ben ik uitvoerig ingegaan op de positie van zieke vangnetters en de re-integratie-inspanningen van UWV.

Vragen van de leden Vermeij en Heijnen (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het recht van grensarbeiders op AOW (ingezonden 31 augustus

MPs Vermeij and Heijnen asked ministers about cross-border workers' AOW pension rights after a report that a Belgian-resident entrepreneur must prove entitlement despite SVB assurances. The minister answered that verification via registrations is required, premiums are refunded or compensated, and points to existing checks, portals and the border ombudsman, without committing to new measures.
Verification takes place on the basis of registrations of, for example, UWV and the Tax Authority, which will (have to) show the claimed work in the Netherlands.
Verificatie vindt plaats aan de hand van registraties van bijvoorbeeld UWV en Belastingdienst waaruit de gestelde arbeid in Nederland zal (moeten) blijken.
Vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Koşer Kaya (beiden D66) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Economische Zaken over asbestslopers (ingezonden 25 augustus 2010).

Two D66 MPs asked ministers of Social Affairs and Economic Affairs whether new stricter asbestos-removal rules would bankrupt hundreds of demolition firms, whether the sector's consent is required, what concrete steps will be taken to keep asbestos work licensed, and how to protect small firms while improving worker health. The minister replied only that answering within three weeks is not possible because interdepartmental consultation takes more time.

I hereby inform you that answering the parliamentary questions from MPs Verhoeven and Koşer Kaya (D66) on asbestos demolition firms is not possible within the three-week period because interdepartmental coordination requires more time.

Hierbij deel ik u mede dat de beantwoording van de Kamervragen van de leden Verhoeven en Koşer Kaya (D66) over asbestslopers niet binnen de gestelde termijn van drie weken mogelijk is omdat interdepartementale afstemming meer tijd vraagt.

Vragen van de leden Jadnanansing (PvdA) en Ferrier (CDA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de 10-urennorm voor studenten van buiten de Europese Economische Ruimte (EER) (ingezonden 15 juli 2010).

MPs Jadnanansing and Ferrier asked whether the 10-hour weekly work cap for non-EEA students should be relaxed, given that many cannot cover living costs. The government replied it sees no evidence of widespread shortfalls, keeps the 10-hour cap to prevent students becoming labour migrants, and will consider raising it no earlier than 2012.
It must be prevented that working becomes a main activity, whereby study migrants could effectively become labour migrants.
Voorkomen moet worden dat het verrichten van arbeid een hoofdactiviteit wordt waardoor studiemigranten feitelijk arbeidsmigranten zouden kunnen worden.
Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over integriteit bij fraudeonderzoek UWV (ingezonden 12 augustus 2010).

MP Ulenbelt asked the minister about the integrity of UWV fraud investigations, including supervision, whether other cases were reviewed, whether people abandon appeals for lack of resources, and whether the Inspectie Werk en Inkomen should investigate. The minister answered that UWV has integrity measures and quality checks, found no other related cases so no broader inquiry is planned, saw no evidence of barriers to appeal, and reported that the affected client received compensation and rehabilitation.
I therefore see no reason at this time to have the Inspectie Werk en Inkomen carry out an investigation.
Ik zie daarom nu geen aanleiding om de Inspectie Werk en Inkomen een onderzoek uit te laten voeren.

Vragen van het lid De Jong (PVV) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat 149 werkgevers de regels van de deeltijd-WW aan hun laars hebben gelapt. Waardoor 400 mensen zijn ontslagen ondan

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that 149 employers misused the part-time unemployment benefit (deeltijd-WW) scheme and dismissed around 400 staff, and asks whether fines, recovery and control costs should apply, plus how many were dismissed and what support was given. The minister says fraud-based fines already exist, that dismissal after the scheme is not unlawful but triggers a reimbursement duty for UWV benefit costs within 13 weeks, and that some figures and reintegration efforts are not registered.
Compensation that employers give to employees in the context of a dismissal is not registered.
Tegemoetkomingen die werkgevers in het kader van een ontslag aan werknemers doen, worden niet geregistreerd.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Fritsma en De Jong (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en voor wonen, wijken en integratie over werkloosheid onder allochtone jongeren (ingezonden 13 juli 2

PVV MPs asked the ministers of Social Affairs and of Housing, Neighbourhoods and Integration about a report that one in four young people of foreign origin has no job, asking how this fits the Investing in Youth Act, whether mass immigration of unskilled migrants contributes, and whether work ethic differences play a role. The minister answered that the Act's effects will only be visible from Q3 2010, rejected the immigration premise, and cited surveys finding employers see no meaningful work-ethic gap.
Reducing unemployment among young people of foreign origin has the attention of this cabinet.
