Het terugdringen van de werkloosheid onder allochtone jongeren heeft de aandacht van dit kabinet.
Vragen van het lid Blok (VVD) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het groeiend aantal mensen met een arbeidsongeschiktheidsuitkering (ingezonden 25 juni 2010).

MP Blok (VVD) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the rising number of people receiving disability benefits (WIA), including inflows, gender and diagnosis breakdowns, the 2010 budget overrun, causes of the trend, and whether the 'hidden unemployment' could be investigated. Minister Donner answered that inflow has risen due to more applications and higher approval rates, that conjunctural effects are not a 'grey area', and that UWV will intensify quality control on medical work-hour restrictions.

Furthermore, following the finding that benefit applicants on average have received more (granted) limitations, the UWV will intensify quality control on the granting of medical work-hour restrictions.

Voorts zal het UWV naar aanleiding van de constatering dat aanvragers van een uitkering gemiddeld meer beperkingen hebben (toegekend) gekregen, de kwaliteitscontrole op de toekenning van medische urenbeperkingen intensiveren.

Vragen van het lid de Jong (PVV) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat bij een grootschalige controle in de Utrechtse wijk Ondiep ruim 7 miljoen euro aan fraude aan het licht is gekome

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about reported large-scale benefit fraud of over 7 million euro in Utrecht's Ondiep district, asking how long it has lasted, whether the full sum should be recovered, and whether intervention teams should expand. The minister answers that the amounts are preliminary, describes the risk-based checks and recovery procedures, and points to the enforcement programme and planned reporting.
It is therefore not possible to make a general statement now about the duration of the detected frauds.
Het is daarom niet mogelijk om nu al een algemene uitspraak te doen over de duur van de geconstateerde fraudes.
Vragen van het lid Helder (PVV) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Justitie over het bericht «Uitkeringsfraude Deventer» (ingezonden 9 juli 2010).

An MP asked the ministers of Social Affairs and Justice about a news report of benefit fraud in Deventer, where a couple received about 99,000 euros in social assistance before an anonymous tip exposed them, and whether the full amount plus interest should be reclaimed and whether the 180-hour community service sentence was too lenient. The minister confirmed awareness, said municipalities bear responsibility for enforcement and recovery under the WWB, noted the municipality is recovering the full amount and has seized assets, and declined to comment on the judge's sentence.
Since the introduction of the WWB in 2004, the authority to shape municipal enforcement policy lies entirely with the municipalities.
Sinds de invoering van de WWB in 2004 ligt de bevoegdheid om invulling te geven aan het gemeentelijke handhavingsbeleid volledig bij de gemeenten.
Vragen van het lid Karabulut (SP) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Financiën over het vakantiewerkonderzoek van FNV Jong (ingezonden 30 juli 2010).

Karabulut (SP) asked the ministers about an FNV Jong survey showing many young people considering undeclared summer work, low tax-refund awareness, poor understanding of payslips and minimum wage, and whether government information is adequate. Minister Donner answered that the picture is overstated, outlined prevention campaigns, tax-refund outreach, inspections and existing information, and committed to no new structural measures.
It is not possible to indicate on what scale young people work undeclared during the holiday period.
Het is niet mogelijk om aan te geven op welke schaal jongeren tijdens de vakantieperiode zwart werken.
Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over behandeling van buitenlandse arbeiders in de Eemsmond (ingezonden 2 juli 2010).

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the treatment of Portuguese workers at a subcontractor, Ha-Sa Insaat, on the RWE-Essent coal plant in the Eemsmond, including whether the company used the knowledge-migrant scheme correctly and whether subcontractors' compliance with labour and tax law is checked. The minister said the labour dispute is for the parties to resolve, that the Arbeidsinspectie is investigating the company's knowledge migrants at the IND's request, and that inspections of the construction sites are intensified.
The investigation into the knowledge migrants of Ha-Sa Insaat Taahhut Sanayi ve Ticaret is still ongoing.
Het onderzoek naar de kennismigranten van Ha-Sa Insaat Taahhut Sanayi ve Ticaret loopt momenteel nog.

Vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Spekman (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de behandeling van Portugese werknemers bij de in aanbouw zijnde RWE-centrale in de Eemshaven (ingezonden

MPs Van Dekken and Spekman asked the minister about reports that Portuguese workers at the RWE power plant in Eemshaven were evicted after protesting pay and conditions, and what the government would do to secure their rights. The minister declined to judge the labour dispute, said the Labour Inspectorate is monitoring compliance and has started an investigation into minimum wage payments, and pointed to information provision and a memorandum with Portugal.
If supervision of compliance with laws and regulations by the Labour Inspectorate shows that the laws are being violated, action will be taken against it.
Indien in het kader van het toezicht op de wet- en regelgeving door de Arbeidsinspectie mocht blijken dat de wet- en regelgeving wordt overtreden, zal daartegen worden opgetreden.

Vragen van de leden Van Bontes en Van Dijck (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat er in Brussel een voorstel is uitgelekt om zich met pensioenstelsel

PVV MPs asked whether EU involvement in national pension systems breaches subsidiarity and how the Netherlands will prevent EU influence over its pension scheme. The minister answered that pension systems remain national responsibility, that no direct EU threat exists beyond the accounting rules issue, and that the government will respond to the EU Green Paper on pensions and send its position to parliament.
In accordance with the usual procedure, the cabinet's response to the Green Paper on Pensions will be sent to parliament, and parliament will be given the opportunity to respond.
Conform de gebruikelijke procedure zal de kabinetsreactie op het Groenboek Pensioen aan het parlement worden gestuurd en het parlement in de gelegenheid worden gesteld om hierop te reageren.
Vragen van het lid Weekers (VVD) aan de ministers van Financiën en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de berichten over fraude in de champignonteelt (ingezonden 22 juni 2010).

An MP from the VVD asked the ministers of Finance and Social Affairs about reports of fraud in mushroom cultivation, including which agencies took part in the inspections, whether other growers are being checked, how illicit gains are recovered, and whether similar action is needed in other horticulture sectors. The minister answered that a multi-agency intervention team inspected firms in three regions, imposed about 1.5 million euro in fines and back-payments so far, is continuing its work, and is expanding risk analysis and cooperation with sector bodies.
The intervention team determines in advance, based on risk analyses and signals (including reports), whether and which companies are inspected and which instruments are deployed.
Het interventieteam bepaalt op basis van risicoanalyses en signalen (waaronder meldingen) vooraf of, en welke ondernemingen worden geïnspecteerd en welke instrumenten worden ingezet.
Vragen van de leden Vermeij en Spekman (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de onveilige arbeidsomstandigheden van wegwerkers (ingezonden 29 juni 2010).

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about unsafe working conditions for road workers, including whether municipal tendering pushes contractors to cut safety costs. The minister answered that existing Arbo rules and safety plans already protect workers, that the Arbeidsinspectie is already consulting VNG, IPO and Rijkswaterstaat, and that the Interior Minister has no specific role.
The labour inspectorate has already been consulting on this for some time and will continue to do so.
De arbeidsinspectie voert hiermee al langer overleg en zal dat blijven doen.

Vragen van het lid De Jong (PVV) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken & Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat Uitkeringsinstituut UWV 90 miljoen euro te veel heeft uitgegeven aan re-integratietrajecten (ingezonden 2 juli 201

The MP asks the minister how UWV could overspend about 90 million euros on re-integration trajectories, what the investigation costs, how such overruns will be prevented, and whether re-integration should be abolished. The minister refers to his letter of 29 June 2010 for most questions, says the investigation experts will be paid under the standard fee rules, and does not accept that re-integration should be abolished, promising further research into its effectiveness.
See my letter to the Chair of the House of Representatives of 29 June 2010.
Zie mijn brief aan de voorzitter van de Tweede Kamer van 29 juni 2010.

Vragen van het lid Van Gent (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over misstanden als onderbetaling en het in dienst hebben van illegale werknemers uit bijvoorbeeld Bulgarije in de champignont

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Social Affairs about underpayment and illegal employment of workers, such as Bulgarians, in mushroom cultivation, asking how the government will act and whether a large-scale investigation will be launched. The minister replied that the inspectorates have an intervention team active in the sector, that violation rates are higher in mushroom farming, that criminal investigations have led to arrests, and that compensation depends on workers' testimony, with no Wml violations yet proven.
With regard to mushroom cultivation, follow-up steps are being taken with partner organisations to keep inspecting this sector of agriculture and horticulture and to combat abuses.
Ten aanzien van de champignonteelt worden met de samenwerkingspartners vervolgstappen genomen om deze sector van de land- en tuinbouw te blijven inspecteren en misstanden te bestrijden.
Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Financiën over de deal tussen de vereniging SBPVH en de stichting OPTAS (ingezonden 21 mei 2010).

Omtzigt asked the ministers of Social Affairs and Finance whether the €500 million settlement between SBPVH and OPTAS implies OPTAS had no right to the harbour workers' pension money, and whether a similar deal could be reached with Aegon. Minister Donner welcomed the settlement, said the parties have always acted within the law, declined to comment on OPTAS publicly, and said he would facilitate an Aegon-SBPVH agreement if useful.
I therefore have no judgement on the changed position of the OPTAS foundation and also see no reason for a public response to the OPTAS foundation.
Ik heb derhalve geen oordeel over de gewijzigde opstelling van de stichting Optas en zie ook geen reden voor een publiekelijke reactie aan de stichting Optas.

Vragen van het lid Poppe (SP) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over het advies van de Gezondheidsraad om de asbestnormen aan te scherpen

An SP MP asks whether the government endorses the Health Council's advice to tighten asbestos exposure standards, and about SP and TNO reports on asbestos-cement roofs and farm exposure. The minister defers: standards are still under study, a reply on environmental exposure is expected in October, and the roof situation will be addressed in a later government response.
Currently it is being examined which conclusions for asbestos exposure standards can be drawn from this.
Thans wordt onderzocht welke conclusies voor normen voor blootstelling aan asbest hieruit getrokken kunnen worden.
Vragen van het lid Irrgang (SP) aan de minister van Financiën over speculatie op Griekse staatsobligaties door het ABP (ingezonden 18 mei 2010).

MP Irrgang asks the Finance Minister whether the ABP's large holding of Greek government bonds (2.3 billion euro in 2009) was risky, how DNB supervised it, and whether the fund's exposure was a reason for the Greek bailout. The minister answers that pension fund investment decisions are the responsibility of the fund board, that DNB cannot discuss institution-specific matters, and gives aggregate figures showing Dutch pension funds held about 3.7 billion euro in Greece (about 0.6% of assets).
It is not permitted for DNB to answer institution-specific questions.
Het is voor DNB niet toegestaan om instellingspecifieke vragen te beantwoorden.
Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het zwarte gat van het nabestaandenpensioen (ingezonden 26 maart 2010).

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about the gap in survivor's pension coverage for workers who change jobs while their risk-based survivor pension transfer is still pending, including timelines, remedies, and whether the old employer should keep coverage. The minister says the procedure takes up to 14 months, points to Stichting van de Arbeid recommendations such as a 24-month default conversion, and states that additional legal obligations are unnecessary.
Additional legal obligations towards the employer on this subject are therefore neither necessary nor desirable.
Aanvullende wettelijk verplichtingen richting de werkgever ten aanzien van dit onderwerp zijn daarom niet nodig en wenselijk.

Vragen van het lid Van Gent (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het onderzoek van FNV Jong waaruit blijkt dat Wet Investering Jongeren niet naar behoren functioneert (ingezonden 2 juni

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Social Affairs about an FNV Jong study finding that the Wet Investeren in Jongeren (WIJ) is not functioning properly, with only 5% of unemployed youth receiving a work-learning offer and over 75% unaware of the law, and asked about actions by municipalities and partners and the reaction to criticism of the approach as stuck in procedures. The Minister answered that the WIJ is too recent to judge, that the FNV sample is unrepresentative, that youth unemployment is a priority supported by 250 million euro, that responsibility lies deliberately with regions and municipalities, and that a study on reaching non-registrants will be completed in mid-2010.

Moreover, it should be noted that the conclusion that only a quarter of unemployed young people have received a work-learning offer is based on a very limited sample and therefore cannot be considered representative.

Overigens dient te worden opgemerkt dat de conclusie dat slechts een kwart van de werkloze jongeren een werkleeraanbod heeft gekregen, gebaseerd is op een zeer beperkte steekproef en daarmee niet als representatief kan worden aangemerkt.

Vragen van het lid Spekman (PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het onderzoek van FNV Jong waaruit blijkt dat de jeugdwerkloosheid niet wordt verholpen met de Wet WIJ (ingezonden 2 juni 2010).

An MP asks the minister of Social Affairs whether the government will act after an FNV Jong study found that the WIJ law is not reducing youth unemployment, since only a quarter of unemployed youths who register with municipalities get a job or training offer. The minister replies that the WIJ was never meant to prevent youth unemployment, that it is too early to judge its effects, that the study sample was small, and that the government will rely on municipalities and social partners, point to a 250 million euro action plan, and promise an evaluation by 1 October 2011.
The WIJ will be evaluated within two years of entry into force, in line with the Spekman amendment.
De WIJ wordt, conform het amendement Spekman, binnen twee jaar na inwerkingtreding geëvalueerd.

Vragen van de leden Aptroot (VVD), De Rouwe (CDA) en Van der Staaij (SGP) aan de ministers van Verkeer en Waterstaat en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over bijstand voor schippers (ingezonden 20 mei 2010).

MPs Aptroot, De Rouwe and Van der Staaij asked whether the Bbz self-employed assistance scheme applies to bargemen whose vessels lie idle due to the poor market, and what criteria apply, or why not. The minister answered that the Bbz covers self-employed persons including skippers with temporary financial problems, subject to asset, viability and working-hours conditions, with municipalities assessing each application.

The Bbz 2004 forms part of the social assistance legislation and is intended to provide self-employed persons (including skippers) with a fundamentally viable business but temporary financial problems with support.

Het Bbz 2004 vormt onderdeel van de bijstandswetgeving en is bedoeld om zelfstandigen (waaronder ook schippers) met een in beginsel levensvatbaar bedrijf maar met tijdelijke financiële problemen ondersteuning te bieden.
Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het artikel «Lek woekerpensioen gedicht» (ingezonden 13 april 2010).

MP Omtzigt asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the proposed compensation for 'woekerpensioen' collective defined-contribution pension schemes, questioning the use of the Wabek norm, cost transparency, and workers' remedies. Minister Donner defended the agreed norm as set by the parties themselves, said transparency has improved under the Pensioenwet, and declined to change the norm.
The norm was set by the parties involved themselves, and it is not for me to change this norm.
De norm is vastgesteld door de betrokken partijen zelf en het is niet aan mij om deze norm te wijzigen.

Vragen van het lid Irrgang (SP) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Financien over de rol van de Stichting van de Arbeid bij de compensatieregeling voor woekerpensioenen (ingezonden 21 april 2010

Irrgang (SP) asked the ministers of Social Affairs and Finance whether the Stichting van de Arbeid went beyond overseeing the process and shaped the content of the compensation scheme for woekerpensioenen, and questioned the cost levels and the Wabeke norm. The minister answered that the Stichting only followed a process led by the Ombudsman Financiële Dienstverlening, that it cannot judge the norm itself, and that it declines to assess the compensation level, refusing the banksparen suggestion for the second pillar.

Vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie over de registratie van de afkomst van werkloze jongeren (ingezonden 4 mei 2010).

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked ministers whether the UWV's linking of population register data to register the origin of unemployed youth would help them find jobs, and why the government does not focus on strengthening young people's social position. The minister defended the GBA-SONAR linkage as a means to better insight into jobseekers for regional service delivery, acknowledged that social disadvantage matters more, and promised to examine the tool's usefulness.
I consider this an undesirable situation that calls for better insight into the jobseeker files.
Ik vind dit een ongewenste situatie die vraagt om een beter inzicht in de bestanden met werkzoekenden.
Vragen van de leden Timmer en Vermeij (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de remmende invloed van arbo-regels op thuiswerken (ingezonden 29 maart 2010).

Two MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether Arbo rules deter employers from allowing telework and what would be done about fears of liability claims. The minister acknowledged the concern, pointed to a working group preparing a practical guidance note, and said national rules would be reviewed for barriers to flexible work.
This gives me reason to review national legislation again and to remove identified barriers where possible.
Dit geeft mij aanleiding om de nationale wetgeving opnieuw te bezien en waar mogelijk geconstateerde belemmeringen weg te nemen.

Vragen van het lid Irrgang (SP) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Financien over de rol van de Stichting van de Arbeid bij de compensatieregeling voor woekerpensioenen (ingezonden 21 april 2010

Irrgang (SP) asked the ministers of Social Affairs and Finance about the role of the Stichting van de Arbeid in the compensation scheme for 'woekerpensioenen' (predatory pension products), including whether it merely oversaw the process or also shaped the content, and about costs and the Wabeke norm. The minister announced that a full answer cannot be given within three weeks because further information must be requested from parties in the pension sector.

the answers to the parliamentary questions from Omtzigt (CDA) and Irrgang (SP) on the compensation scheme for predatory pensions cannot be given within the three-week deadline because further information must be requested from the parties in the pension sector

de beantwoording van de Kamervragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) en de Kamervragen van het lid Irrgang (SP) beiden over de compensatieregeling woekerpensioenen niet binnen de gestelde termijn van drie weken mogelijk is omdat nadere informatie bij de betrokken partijen in de pensioensector moet worden opgevraagd

Vragen van de leden Timmer en Spekman (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de relatie tussen arbeidsomstandigheden en ziekte dan wel sterfte (ingezonden 3 mei 2010).

MPs Timmer and Spekman asked the Minister of Social Affairs about FNV figures showing over 3,000 work-related deaths a year, the weak coverage of sector OSH catalogues, under-registration by occupational physicians, and the low inspection frequency. The minister said the figures are not new and reflect past exposures, defended existing policy, and promised continued support for catalogues and registration efforts while rejecting statutory sanctions for lacking a catalogue.
I am of the opinion that the OSH policy is successful.
Ik ben van mening dat het arbobeleid succesvol is.
Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over nog steeds slecht gehuisveste Polen (ingezonden 4 mei 2010).

An MP asked the minister of Social Affairs whether recruitment agencies flout their own housing standards for foreign workers, whether the sector's self-regulation has failed, and whether a licensing system should be introduced. The minister said the sector and municipalities are responsible, described ongoing self-regulation measures and a joint housing norm under discussion, and declined to introduce licensing for now.
It is up to the sector itself to monitor compliance with the housing standards belonging to the quality mark the sector itself established.
Het is aan de branche zelf om toe te zien op de naleving van de huisvestingsnormen behorende bij het door de branche zelf ingestelde keurmerk.
Vragen van de leden Vermeij en Vos (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de besteding van scholingsgelden (ingezonden 15 april 2010).

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment why EVC/Ervaringscertificaat funds for training of workers at risk of dismissal are largely unused, and why action was not taken earlier. The minister acknowledged the low uptake, cited about 667 certificates issued by UWV and about 10,000 estimated per year, and listed awareness campaigns and the broadening of the scheme as remedies.
The use of the Ervaringscertificaat/Ervaringsprofiel measure has so far been limited. I regret this.
Het gebruik van de maatregel Ervaringscertificaat/Ervaringsprofiel is tot nu toe beperkt. Dat betreur ik.
Vragen van de leden Heerts en Vermeij (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Justitie en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over ontslagzwendel (ingezonden 1 april 2010).

MPs Heerts and Vermeij ask ministers about dismissal fraud, where IT firms use intermediary agencies to shed staff without normal dismissal procedures, and whether the government bears responsibility, whether employers may pass personal data to such agencies, who supervises this, and whether new legislation is needed. The minister answers that criminal and civil routes exist for victims, that employer and employee share responsibility for prevention, that data transfer needs a legal basis under the Wbp, that the Labour Inspectorate does not investigate such crimes, and that no new legislation is needed.
I therefore see no reason to draft new legislation.
Ik zie daarom geen aanleiding tot het opstellen van nieuwe wetgeving.
Vragen van het lid Meeuwis (VVD) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het afstoten van Briefopbestelling B.V. door het UWV (ingezonden 26 maart 2010).

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether he supports UWV ending its contract with Briefopbestelling, a job-application letter service, and about the effectiveness research and savings claimed for it. The Minister denies that contracts for short-term unemployed are stopped, says UWV is reprioritising limited re-integration funds toward long-term unemployed and that the contract ends 1 July 2010, and notes the effectiveness is hard to measure and the net return unclear.

I consider it legitimate that UWV takes the decision whether or not to contract Briefopbestelling again into account in the weighing it makes given the resources at its disposal and the priorities it sets for its services.

Ik acht het legitiem dat UWV de beslissing om Briefopbestelling al dan niet opnieuw te contracteren, meeneemt in de afweging die het maakt gegeven de middelen die het ter beschikking heeft en de prioriteiten die het met betrekking tot de dienstverlening stelt.

Vragen van de leden Vermeij en Spekman (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de slechte naleving van cao-afspraken door een supermarktketen (ingezonden 24 maart 2010).

Two Labour MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the current room for employers to ignore collective labour agreement (cao) terms, as with a supermarket chain's lunch rules, should be tackled by a dedicated cao police, and what the government will do to ensure compliance. The minister answered that enforcement of cao terms is the responsibility of the social partners, pointed to a planned independent compliance instrument from 2011 and to the Labour Inspectorate's supporting role.
The core is that collective labour agreements are civil-law contracts between social partners concerning employment conditions, to which the government is not a party.
De kern is dat cao's civielrechtelijke overeenkomsten zijn tussen sociale partners die betrekking hebben op arbeidsvoorwaarden waarbij de overheid geen partij is.

Vragen van het lid Van Hijum (CDA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat het UWV steeds vaker «nee» verkoopt aan werklozen die een opleiding willen volgen (ingezonden 11 maart 2010).

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that the UWV increasingly refuses unemployed people's requests for training, questioning the adequacy of the re-integration budget and how it is targeted. The minister answered that the UWV had insufficiently steered the selective use of funds, added extra money, and described the prioritisation of long-term unemployed and the cost increases in UWV re-integration work.
As I set out in my letter to the Speaker of the House of 15 March, the UWV has insufficiently steered the selective deployment of re-integration funds
Zoals ik in mijn brief aan de voorzitter van de Tweede Kamer d.d. 15 maart uiteen heb gezet heeft het UWV onvoldoende gestuurd op het selectief inzetten van de re-integratiemiddelen

Vragen van de leden Van Hijum en De Pater-van der Meer (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Justitie over schijnzelfstandigheid in de prostitutiebranche (ingezonden 21 januari 2010).

MPs Van Hijum and De Pater-van der Meer (CDA) asked whether Bulgarian and Romanian prostitutes registered as self-employed are in fact employees, and whether registration bodies and agencies should apply stricter criteria. The minister answered that no evidence shows large-scale evasion of the foreign employment act, that existing registration checks are adequate, that a fiscal 'voorwaardenpakket' clarifies employment status, and that the registration duty and enforcement measures will help, while registration statistics cannot be provided.
It is likewise not possible to state the number of (domestic or foreign) prostitutes registered in the trade register.
Het is evenmin mogelijk het aantal (binnen- of buitenlandse) prostituees aan te geven dat in het handelsregister staat ingeschreven.
Vragen van het lid Koşer Kaya (D66) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht «Geen re-integratie voor nieuwe ww-ers» (ingezonden 11 maart 2010).

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs why UWV is selectively deploying its re-integration budget and whether it will receive more money, and what effects stopping external re-integration agencies for new unemployment benefit recipients would have. The minister explained that UWV overspent and failed to steer selectively, and committed to reallocating €35 million to cover long-term unemployed re-integration in 2010.

UWV appears to have insufficiently steered the selective deployment of re-integration funds and has not sufficiently taken into account the agreements made on the funds to be deployed per target group.

UWV blijkt onvoldoende gestuurd te hebben op het selectief inzetten van de re-integratiemiddelen en heeft te weinig rekening gehouden met de afspraken die zijn gemaakt over de in te zetten middelen per doelgroep.

Vragen van de leden De Krom, Blok en Meeuwis (allen VVD) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en de staatssecretaris van Justitie over studiefinanciering voor vluc

MPs from the VVD asked the government whether the municipality of Heerlen may exempt higher-educated refugees from the duty to be available for work for four years so they can study, and whether this creates an unfair preference for refugees. The minister answered that municipalities may grant time-limited exemptions based on individual tailoring under the WWB, that Heerlen's approach is individual rather than a special refugee scheme, and that the government supports refugee employment and language training.
It is therefore up to the municipality to determine in individual cases whether, and if so for how long, an exemption from the work obligations is necessary.
Het is dus aan de gemeente om in individuele gevallen te bepalen of, en zo ja, hoelang er een ontheffing van de arbeidsverplichtingen noodzakelijk is.
Vragen van het lid Van Hijum (CDA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het achterblijven van gemeentelijke investeringen in bouw en infrastructuur (ingezonden 19 februari 2010).

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment about lagging municipal construction and infrastructure investment against the 1.5 billion euro pledge, rising part-time unemployment benefit claims in construction, apprenticeship places, and social return clauses. The minister answered that municipalities are responsible for their own stimulus, that construction employment will fall further in 2010 before recovering in 2011, that branch service points support dismissed workers, and that the government will draw attention to social return but leaves municipal investment choices to local authorities.
It is clear that developments in the construction sector lag behind developments in the wider economy.
Het is duidelijk dat de ontwikkelingen in de bouwsector met vertraging de ontwikkelingen in de economie volgen.
Vragen van het lid Vos (PvdA) aan de minister voor Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over payrollondernemers die geen uitzendwerkgever zijn (ingezonden 26 februari 2010).

MP Vos asked the minister for Social Affairs about payroll constructions that bypass employer obligations, citing Zwemmer's critique and asking whether payrollers are really employees of the payroll firm and how many people in government work via payroll. Minister Donner answered that payrolling takes several forms, that the payroll firm is generally the formal employer under article 7:690 BW, that courts decide qualification disputes, and that no central figures exist for government payrolling.
There is no systematic and central administration for the entire government.
Er is geen systematische en centrale administratie voor de gehele overheid.
Vragen van het lid Karabulut (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over minima die € 800 per jaar laten liggen (ingezonden 17 februari 2010).

Karabulut (SP) asks why low-income people miss between €800 and €15,000 a year in benefits because of complex rules, and whether the government will simplify income schemes and bureaucracy. Minister Donner says the figures come from the Arnhem Formulierenbrigade, reports the lessons on non-take-up, and declines a new study, pointing to existing simplification projects.
I have not been able to trace the amount of €15,000.
Het bedrag van € 15 000,– heb ik niet kunnen herleiden.
Vragen van het lid Pieper (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de gemeentelijke terugvordering van bijstand (ingezonden 18 februari 2010).

An MP asks whether the government's confidence that municipalities adequately recover welfare fraud rests only on municipal interest in a Regioplan study, and whether the central government can judge enforcement without reliable fraud data. The minister answers that the conclusion rests on the study's findings on municipal recovery practice, and that the Bijstandsfraudestatistiek publication is suspended pending a quality review, with a promise to inform parliament after it concludes.
Currently SZW and CBS are conducting research into the quality of data submission for the Welfare Fraud Statistics.
Momenteel wordt er door SZW en CBS onderzoek verricht naar de kwaliteit van aanlevering van gegevens voor de Bijstandsfraudestatistiek.
Vragen van het lid Van der Vlies (SGP) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en de minister van Economische Zaken over vakanties op de pof (ingezonden 27 januari 2010).

An SGP MP asked the ministers whether a 'pay-later' holiday credit scheme, letting people travel before repaying in instalments, is undesirable given concerns about problematic debt, and what can be done to stop such holiday credit. The government answered that consumers are primarily responsible for their own financial choices, that credit providers are already bound by the Wft licensing and creditworthiness rules supervised by the AFM, and that it sees no reason for further government action.
I am of the opinion that at this moment there is no further role for the government.
Ik ben van mening dat er op dit moment geen verdere rol voor de overheid is weggelegd.
Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de manier waarop de pensioensector communiceert met de deelnemers (ingezonden 22 februari 2010).

Omtzigt (CDA) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the pension sector's communication with participants, including AFM findings that none of 55 startbrieven met legal requirements and UPO forms contained errors, and asked about supervision, sanctions, and measures on pension awareness and the 70% income target. Minister Donner answered that the sector should improve communication, that AFM has issued norm-conveying letters and is reviewing the UPO, and that he sees no reason to doubt adequate supervision and plans no new measures for now.
It is up to the AFM to assess whether and when any formal measures are taken against individual pension providers, based on the specific circumstances of the case.
Het is aan de AFM om te beoordelen of en wanneer eventuele formele maatregelen getroffen worden tegen individuele pensioenuitvoerders, aan de hand van de specifieke omstandigheden van het geval.
Vragen van het lid Pieper (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht Bijstand beter dan baan (ingezonden 15 februari 2010).

MP Pieper asks whether single parents can be financially worse off moving from welfare to a minimum-wage job and what measures will keep work incentives strong. The minister confirms that full-time work at minimum wage improves income but part-time work may not, says existing schemes are referenced in an earlier answer, and currently considers no additional measures.
I am currently not considering any additional measures.
Ik overweeg op dit moment geen aanvullende maatregelen.
Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over handhaving startersregelingen voor ZZP-ers vanuit de WW (ingezonden 5 maart 2010).

An MP asked the minister whether the ministry or UWV had instructed staff on enforcing the WW starter schemes for self-employed people after a committee debate, and whether enforcement based on contested UWV information activities would be halted. The minister answered that no new instruction was issued, that UWV suspended checks and reclaim decisions for the 2006 and 2007 data comparisons, and that reports of inconsistent regional practice were not recognised.

UWV has suspended the verification activities under the data comparison for the year 2006 since early November 2009, pending the outcome of the National Ombudsman's investigation and the discussion with the House.

UWV heeft sinds begin november 2009 de controleactiviteiten in het kader van de bestandsvergelijking over het jaar 2006 opgeschort in afwachting van de uitkomsten van het onderzoek van de Nationale ombudsman en de discussie met de Kamer.

An MP asks the state secretary of Social Affairs about reports that people moving from welfare into work of 32 hours a week at minimum wage end up financially worse off, and whether a benefit can exceed that wage. The minister confirms the poverty trap exists, explains that lost local tax relief and childcare costs can cause the loss, and lists existing measures such as earnings disregards, premiums and childcare cost coverage, while stressing the importance of work.
It remains the case that a poverty trap exists.
Blijft staan dat er een armoedeval bestaat.

MPs Omtzigt and Blanksma-van den Heuvel asked whether reinsured pension funds can invoke an exclusion clause when an insurer defaults, how many funds and members are affected, and whether they rank below direct policyholders in insolvency, and proposed changes. The minister replied that funds remain fully liable to members, that about 80 near-fully reinsured funds cover about 125,000 people, and that the European Commission's interpretation means reinsurance claims fall under the ranking rule, so the Wft definition of reinsurance will be amended and a short review announced.
Even with such reinsurance, the pension fund remains fully liable for fulfilling its pension obligations to its members.
Ook bij een dergelijke herverzekering blijft het pensioenfonds volledig aansprakelijk voor nakoming van zijn pensioenverplichtingen jegens zijn deelnemers.

An MP asked the state secretary about rising poverty in the Netherlands, long waiting times for special social assistance, and limited access to files in debt assistance, and whether people in financial distress could be helped faster. The minister denied that poverty is rising overall, said special assistance is a municipal responsibility where advances are possible, stated he knew of no blocked file access, and pointed to a maximum waiting time and extra funding in the debt-relief bill.
The granting of special social assistance has been decentralised to the municipalities in policy and finance, so it falls primarily under the responsibility of local municipal government.
De verlening van de bijzondere bijstand is beleidsmatig en financieel gedecentraliseerd aan de gemeenten en valt daarmee primair onder de verantwoordelijkheid van het lokale gemeentebestuur.

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether he would ask the Stichting van de Arbeid and the insurers' association for the status and timing of their talks on compensating excessive past cost charges in defined-contribution pension contracts, and whether he would judge the eventual deal fair or refer it to the AFM and DNB. The minister replied that the parties expect to conclude by 1 April 2010, that fairness is for the parties and ultimately the courts to decide, and that his role is to ensure pension costs are transparent under the Pensioenwet, which the AFM supervises.
It is up to these parties themselves to judge whether it is a fair agreement.
Het is aan deze partijen zelf om te beoordelen of het een billijk akkoord is.

An SP MP asked the Social Affairs minister how the government would respond to allegations that around 800 Polish agency workers at an Albert Heijn distribution centre faced intimidation, forced housing and transport, and other abuses, and whether the government would investigate and share findings, and whether the agency's certification was relevant. The minister answered that the Labour Inspectorate has contacted the union and employer, is monitoring ongoing talks, and will investigate if needed, and explained the certification and sanction mechanisms (SNA, SNCU) and planned signal-sharing.
The Labour Inspectorate will monitor the progress of this and, if necessary, launch an investigation.
De Arbeidsinspectie zal de voortgang hiervan volgen en zonodig een onderzoek instellen.

An SP MP asked whether cleaners should be able to learn Dutch so they can take up vocational training under collective agreements, and whether agreements should be made with unions, employers, VNG and training institutions, or else how municipal rules causing problems be resolved. The minister replied that the cao already provides for employers to facilitate Dutch language courses, that local funding exists under the integration system, and that account managers were deployed and talks held with the cleaning sector.
The cabinet supports such initiatives within the current integration system.
Het kabinet ondersteunt dergelijke initiatieven binnen het huidige inburgeringsstelsel.

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether firms dump older staff via bankruptcy or subsidiary constructions, how to prevent evasion of the collective dismissal notification duty, and what will protect older workers in the crisis. The minister said such constructions are not known to be widespread, that bankruptcy dismissals still require notification under the WMCO, and that he will prepare a bill so notification no longer depends on the dismissal route chosen.
For this – in fact technical – amendment of the law, I have meanwhile instructed that a bill be prepared.
Voor deze – feitelijk technische wijziging van de wet – heb ik inmiddels opdracht gegeven een wetsvoorstel voor te bereiden.

An MP asked the minister of Social Affairs whether using a bankruptcy-style constructie or a separate BV to dismiss staff more easily, and other alternative dismissal routes, are acceptable. The minister replied that no evasion of the collective dismissal notification law was evident, but announced a bill so that the duty to notify applies regardless of the dismissal route, including dismissal by mutual consent.
For this – in fact technical – amendment of the law, I have meanwhile instructed that a bill be prepared.
Voor deze – feitelijk technische wijziging van de wet – heb ik inmiddels opdracht gegeven een wetsvoorstel voor te bereiden.
